i: Sit or stand with the band looped under the balls of your feet.
Hold the ends firmly so the band is taut.
Press up onto your toes as high as you can.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Keep your ankles straight and avoid rolling out.

exercises.n: jalón con agarre cerrado y banda elástica
exercises.d: A close-grip pulldown with a band, pulling down toward the chest. It trains the lats and biceps.
i: Sujeta la banda a un punto de anclaje alto, como una barra de dominadas o una viga resistente.
Ponte de pie frente al punto de anclaje y agarra la banda con un agarre supino, con las manos separadas a la altura de los hombros.
Da un paso atrás para generar tensión en la banda, manteniendo los pies separados a la altura de las caderas.
Activa el core y mantén la espalda recta mientras tiras de la banda hacia el pecho, juntando los omóplatos.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte inferior del movimiento, luego suelta lentamente la banda de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: flexiones con agarre cerrado y banda elástica
exercises.d: A push-up with a band around the upper arms to keep the elbows in. It trains the triceps and chest.
i: Coloca una banda alrededor de la parte superior de los brazos, justo por encima de los codos.
Adopta una posición de flexión de brazos con las manos justo debajo de los hombros y el cuerpo en línea recta desde la cabeza hasta los talones.
Flexiona los codos y baja el pecho hacia el suelo, manteniendo los codos cerca de los costados.
Empuja con las palmas para extender los brazos y regresar a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: curl concentrado con banda elástica
exercises.d: A seated concentration curl with a band, with the elbow braced on the thigh. It isolates the biceps.
i: Siéntate en un banco o silla con las piernas separadas y los pies apoyados en el suelo.
Sostén un extremo de la banda en la mano y pisa el otro extremo con el pie del mismo lado.
Inclínate ligeramente hacia adelante y apoya el codo en la parte interna del muslo, justo encima de la rodilla.
Con la palma hacia arriba, flexiona lentamente la mano hacia el hombro, manteniendo quieta la parte superior del brazo.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte superior, luego baja lentamente la mano de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado, luego cambia de lado.

exercises.n: elevación lateral frontal con banda elástica
exercises.d: A front raise with a band, lifting straight arms to shoulder height. It trains the front delts.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros y sostén la banda frente a los muslos con las palmas hacia abajo.
Mantén los brazos rectos y levanta la banda frente a ti hasta que los brazos queden paralelos al suelo.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte superior, luego baja lentamente la banda de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: elevación frontal con banda elástica
exercises.d: A front raise with a band, raising both arms forward. It builds the front shoulders.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros y sostén la banda frente a los muslos con las palmas hacia abajo.
Mantén los brazos rectos y levántalos lentamente hacia adelante hasta que queden paralelos al suelo.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte superior, luego baja lentamente los brazos de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: pallof press horizontal con banda elástica
exercises.d: A Pallof press with a band anchored to the side, pressing out and holding. It trains the core to resist rotation.
i: Sujeta la banda a un punto de anclaje resistente a la altura de la cintura.
Ponte de pie perpendicular al punto de anclaje con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros.
Agarra la agarradera de la banda con ambas manos y aléjate del punto de anclaje para generar tensión en la banda.
Lleva las manos hacia el pecho, manteniendo los codos flexionados y cerca del cuerpo.
Activa el core y mantén una postura estable.
Extiende los brazos rectos frente a ti, empujando la banda alejándola del cuerpo.
Mantén la posición extendida durante unos segundos, enfocándote en mantener la tensión en el core.
Lleva lentamente las manos de vuelta al pecho, resistiendo el tirón de la banda.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: extensión de cadera inclinado con banda elástica
exercises.d: A bent-over hip extension with a band, kicking one leg back. It trains the glutes.
i: Sujeta la banda a un punto de anclaje resistente a la altura del tobillo.
Ponte de pie de espaldas al punto de anclaje con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros.
Da un paso atrás para generar tensión en la banda, manteniendo las rodillas ligeramente flexionadas.
Flexiona las caderas e inclínate hacia adelante, manteniendo la columna en posición neutral.
Extiende la pierna derecha recta hacia atrás, apretando los glúteos en la parte superior.
Baja la pierna derecha de vuelta y repite con la pierna izquierda.
Continúa alternando las piernas durante el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: abdominal navaja con banda elástica
exercises.d: A jackknife sit-up with a band, lifting legs and torso together. It trains the abs and hip flexors.
i: Túmbate sobre tu espalda con las piernas rectas y los brazos extendidos por encima de la cabeza, sosteniendo la banda.
Activa el abdomen y levanta las piernas y la parte superior del cuerpo simultáneamente, llevando las manos hacia los pies.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte superior, luego baja lentamente las piernas y la parte superior del cuerpo de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: rotación externa de cadera acostado con banda elástica
exercises.d: A side-lying clam-style move with a band around the knees that fires up the outer hip and glute muscles.
i: Lie on your side with knees bent and a loop band around your thighs just above the knees.
Keep your feet together and your hips stacked.
Rotate the top knee upward, opening like a clamshell.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat, then switch sides.
Keep your pelvis still so the movement comes from the hip.

exercises.n: jalón de rodillas a un brazo con banda elástica
exercises.d: A kneeling one-arm pulldown with a band, driving the elbow toward the ribs. It trains the lats.
i: Sujeta la banda a un punto de anclaje resistente por encima de tu cabeza.
Arrodíllate y sostén la banda con una mano, con la palma hacia abajo.
Extiende el brazo por completo por encima de la cabeza, manteniendo el codo ligeramente flexionado.
Activa los dorsales y tira de la banda hacia el costado, llevando el codo hacia las costillas.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte inferior, luego suelta lentamente la tensión y regresa a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado, luego cambia de lado.

exercises.n: rotación interna de cadera acostado con banda elástica
exercises.d: A lying hip rotation with a band around the feet or legs, rotating the knees out and back. It works the glutes and hips.
i: Túmbate sobre tu espalda con las piernas rectas y una banda elástica enrollada alrededor de los pies.
Flexiona las rodillas y llévalas hacia el pecho, manteniendo los pies juntos.
Rota lentamente las rodillas hacia afuera, separándolas entre sí, mientras mantienes los pies juntos.
Haz una pausa por un momento al final de la rotación, luego regresa lentamente a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: abdominal con giro de rodillas con banda elástica
exercises.d: A kneeling crunch with a twist using a band. It trains the abs and obliques.
i: Sujeta la banda a un punto de anclaje resistente a la altura de la cintura.
Arrodíllate de espaldas al punto de anclaje y sostén la banda con ambas manos, manteniendo los codos flexionados y cerca de los costados.
Activa el abdomen y gira lentamente el torso hacia un lado, llevando las manos hacia la cadera opuesta.
Haz una pausa por un momento, luego regresa lentamente a la posición inicial.
Repite del otro lado.
Continúa alternando lados durante el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: curl de bíceps sobre la cabeza a un brazo con banda elástica
exercises.en: band one arm overhead biceps curl
exercises.d: A standing one-arm curl with the arm held overhead against band tension. It trains the biceps.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros y coloca un extremo de la banda bajo el pie.
Sostén el otro extremo de la banda con el brazo completamente extendido por encima de la cabeza, con la palma hacia adelante.
Manteniendo quieta la parte superior del brazo, flexiona el antebrazo hacia el hombro, apretando el bíceps.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte superior, luego baja lentamente el antebrazo de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado, luego cambia de brazo.

exercises.n: sentadilla búlgara a un brazo con banda elástica
exercises.en: band one arm single leg split squat
exercises.d: A single-leg split squat with a band, back foot raised. It trains the quads and glutes.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de las caderas y coloca una banda elástica alrededor de los tobillos.
Extiende una pierna hacia adelante y apoya la parte superior del pie sobre un banco o escalón detrás de ti.
Sujétate de un apoyo con una mano para mantener el equilibrio.
Flexiona la pierna de apoyo y baja el cuerpo hacia una posición de sentadilla, manteniendo la rodilla alineada con los dedos del pie.
Empuja con el talón para regresar a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado, luego cambia de pierna.

exercises.n: remo bajo de pie a un brazo con banda elástica
exercises.en: band one arm standing low row
exercises.d: A standing one-arm low row with a band. It trains the back and biceps.
i: Sujeta la banda a un punto de anclaje estable a la altura de la cintura.
Ponte de pie frente al punto de anclaje con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros.
Sostén la banda con una mano, con la palma hacia adentro, y da un paso atrás para generar tensión en la banda.
Flexiona ligeramente las rodillas e inclínate hacia adelante desde las caderas, manteniendo la espalda recta.
Tira de la banda hacia la cintura, juntando los omóplatos.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte superior del movimiento, luego suelta lentamente la banda de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado, luego cambia de lado.

exercises.n: press de pecho con giro a un brazo y banda elástica
exercises.en: band one arm twisting chest press
exercises.d: A one-arm chest press with a band that adds a twist. It trains the chest and core.
i: Sujeta la banda a un punto de anclaje resistente a la altura del pecho.
Ponte de pie con el costado hacia el punto de anclaje y agarra la banda con una mano.
Aléjate del punto de anclaje para generar tensión en la banda.
Coloca los pies separados a la altura de los hombros y flexiona ligeramente las rodillas.
Lleva la mano que sostiene la banda a través del cuerpo, hacia el hombro opuesto.
Manteniendo la tensión en la banda, empuja la mano hacia adelante y alejándola del cuerpo, extendiendo el brazo.
Regresa lentamente a la posición inicial y repite el número de repeticiones deseado.
Cambia de lado y repite el ejercicio con la otra mano.

exercises.n: remo sentado con giro a un brazo y banda elástica
exercises.en: band one arm twisting seated row
exercises.d: A seated one-arm row with a band and a torso twist. It trains the back and obliques.
i: Siéntate en un banco o silla con los pies apoyados en el suelo y la espalda recta.
Sostén la banda con una mano y extiende el brazo completamente frente a ti.
Manteniendo la espalda recta, tira de la banda hacia el cuerpo flexionando el codo y juntando los omóplatos.
Al mismo tiempo, gira el torso hacia el lado del brazo que tira.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte superior, luego suelta lentamente la tensión de la banda y regresa a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado, luego cambia al otro brazo.

exercises.n: pull through con banda elástica
exercises.d: A hip hinge pulling a band through the legs. It trains the glutes and hamstrings.
i: Sujeta una banda elástica a un punto de anclaje resistente a nivel del suelo.
Ponte de pie de espaldas al punto de anclaje con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros.
Da un paso adelante para generar tensión en la banda, manteniendo las rodillas ligeramente flexionadas.
Flexiona las caderas y lleva los glúteos hacia atrás, manteniendo una ligera flexión en las rodillas.
Baja el torso hasta que quede paralelo al suelo, sintiendo un estiramiento en los isquiotibiales.
Empuja las caderas hacia adelante y aprieta los glúteos para regresar a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: abdominal con empuje y banda elástica
exercises.d: A sit-up that pushes a band forward as you come up. It trains the abs.
i: Sujeta la banda de forma segura a un punto de anclaje estable.
Túmbate sobre tu espalda con las rodillas flexionadas y los pies apoyados en el suelo.
Sostén la banda con ambas manos y extiende los brazos rectos hacia el techo.
Activando el abdomen, levanta lentamente la parte superior del cuerpo del suelo, curvándote hacia adelante hasta que tu torso forme un ángulo de 45 grados.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte superior, luego baja lentamente la parte superior del cuerpo de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: apertura invertida con banda elástica
exercises.d: A reverse fly with a band, opening the arms to the sides. It trains the rear delts and upper back.
i: Sujeta la banda a un objeto fijo a la altura del pecho.
Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros y sostén la banda con ambas manos frente a ti.
Mantén los brazos rectos y levántalos hacia los lados hasta que queden paralelos al suelo.
Junta los omóplatos en la parte superior del movimiento.
Baja lentamente los brazos de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: curl de muñeca inverso con banda elástica
exercises.d: A reverse wrist curl with a band, lifting the back of the hands. It strengthens the forearms.
i: Siéntate en un banco o silla con los pies apoyados en el suelo.
Sostén la banda con un agarre prono, con las palmas hacia abajo, y envuélvela alrededor de los dedos.
Apoya los antebrazos sobre los muslos, con las muñecas colgando del borde.
Flexiona lentamente las muñecas hacia arriba, apretando los antebrazos.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte superior, luego baja lentamente las muñecas de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: rotación externa de cadera sentado con banda elástica
exercises.d: A seated hip rotation with a band for resistance, working the glutes and deep hip rotators.
i: Sit on a bench or chair with a band looped around your knees or thighs.
Keep your feet planted and your back tall.
Push your knees apart against the band.
Hold briefly at the widest point.
Bring your knees back together slowly.
Keep your torso still and avoid leaning.

exercises.n: rotación interna de cadera sentado con banda elástica
exercises.d: A seated hip rotation against a band around the thighs. It works the glutes and hip muscles.
i: Siéntate en una silla o banco con la espalda recta y los pies apoyados en el suelo.
Coloca una banda elástica alrededor de los muslos, justo por encima de las rodillas.
Mantén las rodillas flexionadas formando un ángulo de 90 grados y los pies separados a la altura de los hombros.
Activa los glúteos y rota lentamente las rodillas hacia afuera, empujando contra la resistencia de la banda.
Haz una pausa por un momento al final del movimiento, luego regresa lentamente a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: press de hombros con banda elástica
exercises.d: A shoulder press with a band under the feet. It builds the shoulders and triceps.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros y coloca la banda bajo los pies.
Sostén la banda con las palmas hacia adelante y eleva las manos a la altura de los hombros, con los codos flexionados.
Empuja la banda por encima de la cabeza, extendiendo completamente los brazos.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte superior, luego baja lentamente la banda de vuelta a la altura de los hombros.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: extensión de tríceps lateral con banda elástica
exercises.d: A triceps extension with a band, extending the arms out to the sides. It works the triceps.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros y sostén la banda con ambas manos, con las palmas hacia abajo.
Extiende los brazos hacia los lados, manteniéndolos paralelos al suelo.
Flexiona lentamente los codos y lleva las manos hacia los hombros, manteniendo quieta la parte superior de los brazos.
Haz una pausa por un momento, luego extiende lentamente los brazos de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: elevación de gemelos a una pierna con banda elástica
exercises.d: A single-leg calf raise with a band around the foot. It trains the calves.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de las caderas y coloca la banda alrededor de la base de los dedos del pie izquierdo.
Sujétate de un objeto estable para mantener el equilibrio si es necesario.
Levanta lentamente el talón izquierdo del suelo, llevando el peso del cuerpo hacia la punta del pie.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte superior, luego baja lentamente el talón izquierdo de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado, luego cambia a la pierna derecha.

exercises.n: elevación de gemelos inversa a una pierna con banda elástica
exercises.en: band single leg reverse calf raise
exercises.d: A single-leg calf raise with a band, rising onto the ball of the foot. It trains the calves.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de las caderas y coloca la banda alrededor de la base de los dedos del pie.
Sujétate de un objeto estable para mantener el equilibrio.
Levanta lentamente el talón del suelo, llevando el peso del cuerpo hacia la punta del pie.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte superior, luego baja lentamente el talón de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado, luego cambia a la otra pierna.

exercises.n: dorsiflexión de tobillo sentado en el suelo con banda elástica
exercises.en: resistance band sitting floor ankle dorsi flexion
exercises.d: Pull your toes toward your shin against a band while seated. It strengthens the muscles at the front of the lower leg.
i: Sit on the floor with your legs straight and loop the band around the top of one foot.
Hold the band ends or anchor them so there is light tension.
Pull your toes toward your shin.
Pause, then return slowly.
Complete all reps, then switch feet.

exercises.n: sentadilla búlgara con banda elástica
exercises.d: A single-leg split squat with a band. It trains the quads and glutes.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de las caderas y coloca una banda elástica alrededor de los tobillos.
Da un paso grande hacia adelante con el pie derecho y un paso más pequeño hacia atrás con el pie izquierdo.
Flexiona las rodillas y baja el cuerpo hasta que el muslo derecho quede paralelo al suelo, manteniendo la rodilla izquierda ligeramente por encima del suelo.
Empuja con el talón derecho para regresar a la posición inicial.
Repite del otro lado.

exercises.n: aducción de cadera boca arriba asistida con balón
exercises.en: ball assisted lying supine hip adduction
exercises.d: Squeeze a ball between your knees while lying on your back. It targets the inner thighs.
i: Lie on your back with knees bent and a ball between your knees.
Rest your arms by your sides and keep your lower back relaxed.
Squeeze the ball with your inner thighs.
Hold for a moment, then release slowly.
Keep your hips level throughout.

exercises.n: elevación de piernas rectas acostado con banda elástica
exercises.d: A lying straight leg raise with a band held in the hands. It trains the abs and hip flexors.
i: Túmbate sobre tu espalda con las piernas rectas y los pies juntos.
Coloca la banda alrededor de los arcos de los pies y sostén los extremos de la banda con las manos.
Activando el abdomen, levanta ambas piernas del suelo hasta que queden perpendiculares al suelo.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte superior, luego baja lentamente las piernas de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: remo en sentadilla con banda elástica
exercises.d: A squat combined with a band row, pulling the handles as you stand. It works the legs and back.
i: Sujeta la banda a un punto de anclaje resistente a la altura de la cintura.
Ponte de pie frente al punto de anclaje con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros.
Sostén las agarraderas de la banda con las palmas mirándose entre sí y los brazos extendidos frente a ti.
Flexiona las rodillas y baja a una posición de sentadilla, manteniendo la espalda recta y el pecho elevado.
Desde la posición de sentadilla, tira de las agarraderas de la banda hacia el cuerpo, juntando los omóplatos.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte superior, luego suelta lentamente la tensión y regresa a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: flexión de dedos con extensión del pulgar
exercises.d: A small hand mobility drill where you curl your fingers while holding the thumb straight. It helps finger and thumb control.
i: Hold one hand out with your palm open.
Extend your thumb out to the side and keep it straight.
Curl your four fingers slowly toward your palm.
Open the fingers again.
Repeat 10-15 times, then switch hands.
Keep the movement smooth and pain free.

exercises.n: abducción del pulgar
exercises.d: A simple thumb movement where you lift the thumb away from the palm to improve hand mobility.
i: Rest your hand on a table with the palm facing up.
Keep your fingers relaxed and straight.
Slowly move your thumb away from your palm.
Pause at the end of the range.
Return slowly to the start.
Do 10-15 reps, then switch hands.

exercises.n: supinación de muñeca con mancuerna
exercises.d: Rotating a dumbbell so your palm turns up, working the muscles that twist the forearm.
i: Sit and rest your forearm on your thigh or a bench with the hand hanging free.
Hold a light dumbbell with your palm facing down.
Rotate your forearm so the palm turns up.
Pause at the top.
Rotate back slowly to the start.
Finish your reps, then switch arms. Keep your elbow still.

exercises.n: sentadilla con banda elástica
exercises.d: A squat with a band above the knees. It trains the glutes and thighs.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros, con la banda colocada justo por encima de las rodillas.
Manteniendo el pecho arriba y el core activado, lleva las caderas hacia atrás y flexiona las rodillas para bajar a una posición de sentadilla.
Asegúrate de que las rodillas se alineen con los dedos de los pies y de que el peso recaiga en los talones.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte inferior, luego empuja con los talones para regresar a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: elevación cruzada alterna de pie con mancuernas
exercises.d: A raise where each dumbbell sweeps across the front of your body. It trains the front delts and upper chest.
i: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Raise one arm up and across your body toward the opposite shoulder, elbow slightly bent.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control.
Repeat with the other arm, alternating.
Keep your torso steady and avoid swinging.

exercises.n: plancha lateral con mancuerna v. 2
exercises.d: A side plank with a dumbbell added, usually held in the top hand, to make the hold harder.
i: Lie on your side, elbow under your shoulder, with a dumbbell in your top hand.
Lift your hips into a straight line from head to feet.
Hold the dumbbell either at your side or pointing to the ceiling.
Hold for 15-30 seconds.
Lower with control, then switch sides.
Keep your hips high and don't rotate.

exercises.n: press de apretón acostado en el suelo con mancuernas
exercises.d: A floor press with the dumbbells pressed together. The squeeze keeps your chest working throughout the lift.
i: Lie on the floor with a dumbbell in each hand, pressed together above your chest.
Squeeze the dumbbells against each other.
Lower them until your upper arms touch the floor.
Press back up while still squeezing.
Keep your wrists straight and elbows tucked.
Lower slowly each rep.

exercises.n: press z a un brazo con mancuerna
exercises.d: A seated overhead press on the floor with legs straight, using one arm. It removes leg drive and challenges your trunk.
i: Sit on the floor with legs straight out and back tall.
Hold a dumbbell at shoulder height in one hand.
Press the dumbbell overhead until your arm is straight.
Lower back to your shoulder with control.
Finish your reps and switch arms.
Brace your abs and don't lean back.

exercises.n: arranque desde colgado con mancuerna
exercises.d: A powerful one-arm lift where the dumbbell goes from hip height to overhead in one motion.
i: Stand with a dumbbell hanging in front of your thighs, hips hinged slightly.
Drive your hips forward and shrug.
Pull the dumbbell up close to your body.
Punch it overhead and catch it with a straight arm.
Stand tall, then lower back to the hang.
Switch arms and keep the weight light enough to move fast.

exercises.n: ángel de nieve boca abajo
exercises.d: Lying face down, you sweep your arms and legs like a snow angel. It works the muscles along your back.
i: Lie face down with arms by your sides and legs together.
Lift your chest and arms slightly off the floor.
Sweep your arms out and overhead while opening your legs.
Bring them back to the start in the same arc.
Repeat in a smooth rhythm.
Keep your neck long and look at the floor.

exercises.n: ángel de nieve boca arriba
exercises.d: Lying face up, you sweep arms and legs out like a snow angel. It trains the abs and keeps your shoulders mobile.
i: Lie on your back with arms by your sides and legs together.
Press your lower back toward the floor.
Sweep your arms overhead while opening your legs.
Bring them back together in the same arc.
Repeat at a steady pace.
Keep your abs braced and lower back flat.

exercises.n: peso muerto rumano con piernas divididas y barra
exercises.d: A Romanian deadlift in a split stance, with most of the load on the front leg. It builds hamstrings and glutes and tests balance.
i: Hold a barbell at your thighs and stand with one foot a step ahead of the other.
Put most of your weight on the front leg.
Hinge at the hips and slide the bar down your front leg.
Lower until you feel a stretch in your hamstring.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: subida al cajón en polea
exercises.d: A step-up with cable resistance that adds load to the legs and hips.
i: Stand facing a box or bench with a cable handle in your hands.
Place one foot fully on the box.
Push through that heel to step up.
Stand tall on top of the box.
Step back down with control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: press z mariposa con barra
exercises.d: A seated floor press overhead with a barbell and a wide hand position. It builds strong shoulders with a stable trunk.
i: Sit on the floor with legs out in front and the bar at upper-chest height.
Take a wide grip and brace your abs.
Press the bar overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower it back to your upper chest under control.
Keep your back tall and avoid arching.
Use a light weight at first.

exercises.n: abdominal de pie con banda elástica
exercises.d: A standing crunch with a band, curling the torso forward. It trains the abs.
i: Sujeta la banda a un punto de anclaje resistente a la altura de la cintura.
Ponte de pie de espaldas al punto de anclaje con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros.
Sostén la banda con ambas manos y llévala hacia el pecho, manteniendo los codos flexionados y cerca del cuerpo.
Activa el abdomen y flexiona lentamente el torso hacia adelante, llevando el pecho hacia las rodillas.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte más alta del movimiento, luego regresa lentamente a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: superman a flexión
exercises.d: A combo move where you lift into a superman on the floor, then press into a push-up.
i: Lie face down with arms extended in front.
Lift your arms, chest and legs off the floor and hold briefly.
Lower and place your hands under your shoulders.
Press up into a push-up.
Lower your chest back to the floor.
Repeat, keeping your body straight.

exercises.n: zancada con sentadilla estrecha con peso corporal
exercises.d: A lunge done with a narrow stance and no weight. It targets the quads and glutes while challenging balance.
i: Stand with feet close together and hands on your hips or in front of you.
Step one foot back and lower into a lunge, keeping your feet in a narrow line.
Drop your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and chest up.
Push through the front heel to stand back up.
Switch legs and repeat.

exercises.n: sentadilla cosaca en landmine
exercises.d: A side-to-side deep squat holding a landmine end at your chest. It works the glutes, inner thighs and hip mobility.
i: Stand with feet wide, holding the end of a landmine bar at your chest.
Shift to one side and bend that knee deeply.
Keep the other leg straight with the toes up.
Push through the bent leg to return to centre.
Shift to the other side.
Keep your chest tall and heel down on the working side.

exercises.n: salto desde posición sentada
exercises.d: An explosive jump that starts from a seated position on a box or chair, building power in the legs.
i: Sit on a sturdy box or bench with feet flat.
Lean slightly forward with arms ready.
Explode upward, swinging your arms.
Land softly on both feet with bent knees.
Sit back down and reset.
Repeat with a short pause each time.

exercises.n: zancada estática con barra
exercises.d: A lunge held in one place with a barbell on your back, so the feet stay put while you lower and rise.
i: Place a barbell across your upper back.
Step into a split stance with one foot forward.
Lower straight down until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Keep your chest tall and torso upright.
Press through the front heel to rise.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: zancada con sentadilla estrecha con mancuernas
exercises.d: A narrow-stance lunge holding a dumbbell in each hand to add load for the quads and glutes.
i: Stand with feet close together, a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step one foot back and lower into a lunge, keeping your feet in a narrow line.
Drop your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and chest up.
Push through the front heel to stand back up.
Switch legs and repeat.

exercises.n: press landmine con banda elástica
exercises.d: A landmine press with a band adding extra resistance on the way up.
i: Set up a landmine with a band attached and hold the end of the bar at your shoulder.
Stand with feet staggered and core braced.
Press the bar up and forward until your arm is straight.
Lower it to your shoulder under control.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
Keep your ribs down and avoid leaning back.

exercises.n: puente en mesa con jack
exercises.d: From a reverse tabletop, you hop your feet apart and together like a jumping jack. It works the glutes and legs.
i: Sit with hands behind you, then lift hips into a tabletop with knees bent.
Squeeze your glutes to keep your hips high.
Hop your feet wide.
Hop them back together.
Keep going at a steady pace.
Keep your hips high and don't let them sag.

exercises.n: alternar de rodillas a media rodilla
exercises.d: A floor-to-stand drill moving from kneeling to half kneeling, alternating sides. It builds hip mobility and control.
i: Kneel upright with both knees on the floor.
Step one foot forward into a half-kneeling position.
Pause and keep your torso tall.
Step back to full kneeling.
Repeat with the other foot.
Move slowly and use your arms for balance if needed.

exercises.n: remo para deltoide posterior con banda elástica
exercises.d: Pull a band toward you with elbows flared wide. It targets the rear delts and upper back.
i: Anchor a band at chest height and hold the ends with arms extended.
Step back until the band is taut.
Pull your hands toward your chest with elbows high.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly without letting your shoulders round forward.

exercises.n: rotación de torso en máquina
exercises.d: A machine rotation that trains the abs and obliques with controlled twisting.
i: Sit in the machine and secure your torso against the pads.
Grip the handles.
Rotate your torso to one side while keeping your hips still.
Pause at the end.
Return to centre and rotate the other way.
Go slowly and avoid momentum.

exercises.n: abdominal de pie con giro y banda elástica
exercises.d: A standing twisting crunch with a band, bringing the elbow toward the opposite knee. It trains the abs and obliques.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros y coloca la banda alrededor de la parte superior de la espalda, cruzándola frente al pecho.
Sujeta los extremos de la banda con las manos, manteniendo los codos flexionados y cerca de los costados.
Activa el abdomen y gira el torso hacia un lado, llevando el codo hacia la rodilla opuesta.
Haz una pausa breve y luego vuelve a la posición inicial.
Repite del otro lado.
Continúa alternando lados durante el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: subida al cajón con banda elástica
exercises.d: A step-up with a band around the thighs. It trains the glutes and quads.
i: Coloca una banda alrededor de los muslos, justo por encima de las rodillas.
Ponte de pie frente a un escalón o plataforma con los pies separados a la altura de las caderas.
Sube a la plataforma con el pie derecho, empujando con el talón.
Extiende la pierna izquierda hacia atrás, manteniéndola recta.
Baja el pie izquierdo de nuevo hasta el suelo.
Repite subiendo a la plataforma con el pie izquierdo.
Continúa alternando las piernas durante el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: peso muerto con piernas semirrígidas y banda elástica
exercises.d: A stiff-leg deadlift with a band, hinging at the hips. It trains the hamstrings and glutes.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros y coloca la banda alrededor de los tobillos.
Sujeta la banda con ambas manos frente a los muslos, con las palmas mirando hacia el cuerpo.
Manteniendo la espalda recta y el core activado, flexiona las caderas y baja lentamente la parte superior del cuerpo hacia el suelo.
Mientras bajas, empuja las caderas hacia atrás y deja que las rodillas se flexionen ligeramente.
Baja la banda hacia el suelo, sintiendo un estiramiento en los isquiotibiales.
Haz una pausa breve en la posición baja, luego activa los glúteos y los isquiotibiales para levantar la parte superior del cuerpo de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: sentadilla core con barra
exercises.d: A barbell squat focused on bracing your core hard through the lift. It builds leg strength and trunk stability.
i: Rest a barbell on your upper back and stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Take a deep breath and brace your abs.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel.
Keep your torso tight and chest up.
Drive through your feet to stand back up.
Exhale at the top and reset your brace each rep.

exercises.n: levantamiento thor a media rodilla con mancuerna
exercises.d: A diagonal lift from low to high while half kneeling, working the trunk, hips and shoulders together.
i: Kneel in a half-kneeling position and hold a dumbbell near the outside of your back hip.
Brace your abs and keep your torso upright.
Lift the dumbbell diagonally up and across your body.
Finish with it above the opposite shoulder.
Lower along the same path.
Finish reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: cargada cruzada de pie con mancuerna
exercises.d: A one-arm clean where the dumbbell travels across your body to the opposite shoulder.
i: Stand with a dumbbell hanging in front of your thigh, hips hinged slightly.
Drive your hips forward and shrug.
Pull the dumbbell up and across your body.
Catch it at the opposite shoulder.
Lower it back to the hang.
Finish reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: apertura de oso a un brazo en polea
exercises.d: A single-arm cable fly done in a braced, staggered stance, working the chest and keeping the trunk steady.
i: Set a cable at chest height and stand with a staggered stance.
Grab the handle with one hand and brace your core.
Keep your elbow slightly bent and sweep your arm across your body.
Squeeze your chest at the end.
Return slowly to the start.
Finish reps and switch arms.

exercises.n: zancada hacia atrás con press de hombros a un brazo y mancuerna
exercises.en: dumbbell rear lunge to single arm shoulders press
exercises.d: A combo move: a rear lunge followed by a single-arm press as you stand. It works legs and shoulders together.
i: Hold a dumbbell at one shoulder and stand tall.
Step one leg back into a lunge.
Push through the front foot to stand up.
As you rise, press the dumbbell overhead.
Lower it to your shoulder and repeat.
Switch arms or legs each set.

exercises.n: sentadilla con disco al costado
exercises.d: A squat holding a weight plate in front of your chest. The plate acts as a counterweight and helps keep your torso upright.
i: Hold a weight plate at your chest with both hands.
Stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Squat down until your thighs are parallel.
Keep your chest up and elbows in.
Push through your heels to stand.
Keep the plate close to your body.

exercises.n: peso muerto con piernas rectas y banda elástica
exercises.d: A straight-leg deadlift with a band, hinging forward at the hips. It trains the lower back and hamstrings.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros y coloca la banda alrededor de los pies.
Sujeta la banda con ambas manos, con las palmas mirando hacia el cuerpo, y mantén los brazos rectos.
Activa el core y mantén una ligera flexión en las rodillas.
Inclínate lentamente hacia delante desde las caderas, manteniendo la espalda recta y el pecho elevado.
Baja la banda hacia el suelo manteniendo las piernas rectas.
Haz una pausa breve en la posición baja y luego contrae los glúteos y los isquiotibiales para volver a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: tirón alto con barra
exercises.d: An explosive pull taking the bar from the thighs to chest height. It builds power in the traps, hips and legs.
i: Hold a barbell at mid-thigh with an overhand grip, hips hinged slightly.
Drive your hips forward and shrug hard.
Pull the bar up to chest height, elbows high.
Let the bar settle and lower it to the thighs.
Reset your stance.
Keep the bar close to your body.

exercises.n: tirón alto de cargada desde colgado con barra
exercises.d: A high pull starting from the hang position above the knees, training explosive hip and shoulder power.
i: Hold a barbell just above the knees with an overhand grip.
Hinge at the hips and keep your back flat.
Explode up through the legs and shrug.
Pull the bar to chest height with high elbows.
Lower to the hang position.
Reset and repeat. Keep the bar close.

exercises.n: lanzamiento sobre la cabeza con balón medicinal
exercises.d: An explosive throw of a medicine ball from behind the head forward. It builds power from hips to arms.
i: Stand holding a medicine ball overhead.
Reach back slightly and brace your abs.
Throw the ball forward powerfully.
Follow through with your arms.
Pick up the ball and reset.
Keep your back neutral.

exercises.n: lanzamiento hacia atrás sobre la cabeza con balón medicinal
exercises.d: A backward throw of a medicine ball over the head from a squat. It builds hip and back power.
i: Stand holding a medicine ball in front of your thighs.
Squat down and swing the ball between your legs.
Drive up and extend your hips.
Throw the ball up and backward over your head.
Retrieve the ball and reset.
Keep your arms long and make sure the space behind you is clear.

exercises.n: giro sentado con banda elástica
exercises.d: A seated twist with a band around the waist. It trains the abs and obliques.
i: Siéntate en el suelo con las piernas extendidas frente a ti y la espalda recta.
Envuelve la banda alrededor de la cintura y sostén los extremos con ambas manos.
Activa el abdomen y gira lentamente el torso hacia un lado, manteniendo la espalda recta y los pies en el suelo.
Haz una pausa por un momento al final de la rotación, luego regresa lentamente a la posición inicial.
Repite el giro hacia el otro lado.
Continúa alternando lados durante el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: curl inverso con barra gruesa
exercises.d: A reverse curl with a thick bar, which challenges your grip and the forearm muscles even more.
i: Hold a fat barbell with an overhand grip.
Stand with elbows by your sides.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your wrists straight.

exercises.n: remo sentado a un brazo en polea enfocado en dorsales
exercises.en: cable seated single arm lats focused row
exercises.d: A one-arm seated cable row that keeps the pull in the lats. Great for fixing side-to-side strength gaps.
i: Sit at the cable station with your feet braced and grab the handle with one hand.
Sit tall and let the arm extend with a slight stretch in the lat.
Pull your elbow down and back toward your hip, leading with the elbow.
Squeeze the lat for a moment, then slowly let the handle return.
Keep your torso still and shoulders down. Finish all reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: sentadilla isométrica con abducción de cadera en máquina
exercises.d: Hold a squat while pressing out against a machine pad. It trains the outer hips and glutes.
i: Set the machine pads against the outsides of your knees.
Lower into a half squat and keep your chest up.
Press your knees outward against the pads.
Hold the position steadily for the target time.
Release and stand up slowly.

exercises.n: elevación lu con disco
exercises.d: A plate raise that sweeps the weight out and up in a U shape, working the shoulders and upper traps.
i: Stand tall holding a weight plate with both hands at thigh height.
Raise the plate out and up in a wide arc until it is about overhead.
Pause briefly, keeping your ribs down and core tight.
Lower the plate back along the same path with control.
Use a light plate and avoid leaning back.

exercises.n: press declinado con agarre cerrado y barra
exercises.d: A close grip press on a decline bench that loads the triceps and lower chest together.
i: Lie on a decline bench and grab the bar with hands about shoulder width apart.
Unrack the bar and hold it over your lower chest with locked elbows.
Lower the bar to your lower chest, keeping elbows tucked close.
Press the bar back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your wrists stacked over your elbows and use a spotter.

exercises.n: press de banca inclinado con agarre cerrado en smith
exercises.en: smith incline close grip bench press
exercises.d: A close grip press on an incline bench using the guided Smith bar to hit the triceps and upper chest.
i: Set an incline bench under the Smith bar and lie back with eyes under the bar.
Grip the bar slightly narrower than shoulder width and unrack it.
Lower the bar to your upper chest with elbows close to your sides.
Press the bar up until your arms are straight.
Keep your feet planted and your shoulder blades pulled back.

exercises.n: cargada y press a media rodilla a un brazo con mancuerna
exercises.en: dumbbell half kneeling single arm clean press
exercises.d: A half kneeling clean and press that trains the shoulder while the stance forces your core and hips to stay stable.
i: Kneel on one knee with the dumbbell on the floor by your front foot and grab it.
Pull the dumbbell up to your shoulder in one smooth motion, rotating your wrist.
Press it overhead until your arm is straight.
Lower it back to your shoulder, then to the floor with control.
Keep your torso upright. Finish the reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: círculo con golpe sobre la cabeza con balón medicinal
exercises.d: A medicine ball slam combined with a circular sweep, building power through the core, lats and shoulders.
i: Stand with feet shoulder width apart holding a medicine ball overhead.
Circle the ball to one side and around as you start to bend your knees.
Slam the ball hard into the floor in front of you.
Catch it on the bounce or pick it up, and reset overhead.
Alternate the circle direction every set and keep your core braced.

exercises.n: subida lateral al cajón en polea
exercises.d: A sideways step up against cable tension that works the glutes and thighs and challenges balance.
i: Stand sideways to a box with the cable handle held at your chest.
Place the near foot on the box and press through that heel.
Step up until your leg is straight and stand tall on top.
Lower slowly back to the floor with control.
Do all reps on one side, then turn around and switch.

exercises.n: press sobre la cabeza con giro y banda elástica
exercises.d: An overhead press with a band, twisting the torso as you press. It trains the shoulders and core.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros y coloca la banda bajo los pies.
Sujeta las asas de la banda a la altura de los hombros con las palmas mirando hacia delante.
Activa el core y empuja la banda por encima de la cabeza, extendiendo completamente los brazos.
Mientras empujas, gira el torso hacia un lado, manteniendo las caderas estables.
Haz una pausa breve en la parte alta y luego vuelve a la posición inicial.
Repite el empuje y el giro hacia el lado opuesto.
Continúa alternando lados durante el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: subida unilateral al cajón en polea
exercises.d: A single leg step up with cable resistance that builds leg strength and balance one side at a time.
i: Face a box with the cable handle held at your chest or by your side.
Place one foot fully on the box.
Drive through that heel and stand up straight on the box.
Lower your trailing foot back to the floor slowly.
Keep your knee tracking over your toes. Finish the reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: rotación externa isométrica de hombro de pie con toalla
exercises.en: standing isometric shoulder external rotation with towel
exercises.d: Press the back of your hand into a towel on a wall while standing. It trains the rotator cuff without moving the joint.
i: Stand next to a wall with a towel between the back of your hand and the wall.
Bend your elbow to 90 degrees, tucked at your side.
Press your hand outward into the towel.
Hold the effort for 10 to 20 seconds.
Relax, then switch sides.

exercises.n: jalón con agarre supino y banda elástica
exercises.d: An underhand pulldown with a band, pulling toward the chest. It trains the lats and biceps.
i: Sujeta la banda a un punto de anclaje alto, como una barra de dominadas o una viga resistente.
Ponte de pie frente al punto de anclaje con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros.
Agarra la banda con un agarre supino, con las manos un poco más separadas que el ancho de los hombros.
Extiende completamente los brazos por encima de la cabeza, manteniendo los codos ligeramente flexionados.
Activa los dorsales y tira de la banda hacia abajo en dirección al pecho, juntando los omóplatos.
Haz una pausa breve en la parte baja del movimiento, luego libera lentamente la tensión y vuelve a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: sostén isométrico de bíceps de pie
exercises.d: A static curl hold where you keep the elbows bent and the biceps working without moving.
i: Stand tall with feet hip width apart and your elbows at your sides.
Bend your elbows to about 90 degrees with palms facing up.
Squeeze your fists and flex your biceps hard.
Hold the position for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and elbows pinned, then rest and repeat.

exercises.n: sostén isométrico de curl de isquiotibiales sentado con balón de estabilidad
exercises.en: sitting isometric hamstring curl hold with exercise ball
exercises.d: Hold a ball under your heels in a curled position. It builds endurance in the back of the thighs.
i: Sit on the floor with legs out and the ball under your heels.
Lean back on your hands.
Press your heels into the ball and slide it in until knees bend.
Hold the position steadily.
Slowly extend your legs again.

exercises.n: v-up con banda elástica
exercises.d: A V-up with a band, lifting legs and torso together. It trains the abs and hip flexors.
i: Túmbate sobre tu espalda con las piernas rectas y los brazos extendidos por encima de la cabeza, sosteniendo la banda.
Activando el abdomen, levanta las piernas y la parte superior del cuerpo del suelo al mismo tiempo, llevando las manos hacia los dedos de los pies.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte superior, luego baja lentamente las piernas y la parte superior del cuerpo de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: pallof press vertical con banda elástica
exercises.d: A vertical Pallof press with a band, pressing at chest height and holding. It trains the core to resist rotation.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros y enrolla la banda alrededor de un objeto firme a la altura del pecho.
Sujeta la banda con ambas manos y aléjate del punto de anclaje, creando tensión en la banda.
Colócate perpendicular al punto de anclaje, con el costado mirando hacia la banda.
Extiende los brazos rectos hacia delante, manteniendo las manos a la altura del pecho.
Activa el core y empuja la banda alejándola del pecho, extendiendo completamente los brazos.
Mantén la posición durante unos segundos y luego lleva lentamente la banda de vuelta hacia el pecho.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado, luego cambia de lado.

exercises.n: curl de muñeca con banda elástica
exercises.d: A wrist curl with a band, curling the wrists upward. It strengthens the forearms.
i: Siéntate en un banco o silla con los pies apoyados en el suelo.
Sujeta la banda con ambas manos, con las palmas hacia arriba, y apoya los antebrazos sobre los muslos.
Flexiona lentamente las muñecas hacia arriba, apretando los antebrazos.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte superior, luego baja lentamente las muñecas de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: caída desde cajón con aterrizaje a dos pies
exercises.d: A drop from a box with a soft two foot landing that trains landing control and leg power.
i: Stand on a sturdy box with your toes near the edge.
Step off the box, do not jump.
Land on both feet at the same time with soft, bent knees.
Sink into a quarter squat to absorb the impact and hold the landing.
Step back up and repeat. Keep your knees in line with your toes.

exercises.n: sentadilla al cajón con peso corporal
exercises.d: A squat that lightly touches a box behind you to teach depth, hip hinge and control.
i: Place a box behind you and stand with feet a bit wider than shoulders.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower toward the box.
Lightly touch the box without dropping onto it.
Drive through your heels to stand back up.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.

exercises.n: elevación en Y con banda elástica
exercises.d: A Y-raise with a band, lifting the arms into a Y shape. It trains the delts and upper back.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros y sujeta la banda frente a los muslos con las palmas mirando hacia adentro.
Mantén los brazos rectos y levántalos hacia arriba y hacia los lados, formando una 'Y' con el cuerpo.
Junta los omóplatos en la parte superior del movimiento.
Baja lentamente los brazos de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: encogimientos de hombros con banda elástica
exercises.d: A shrug with a band, lifting the shoulders toward the ears. It trains the traps.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros y coloca la banda bajo los pies, sosteniendo los extremos con las manos.
Mantén los brazos rectos y relajados, y deja que la banda cuelgue frente a los muslos.
Activa los trapecios encogiendo los hombros hacia arriba, levantando la banda lo más alto posible.
Mantén la contracción por un momento, luego baja lentamente los hombros de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: burpee sobre la mancuerna
exercises.d: A burpee where you jump sideways over a dumbbell each rep, raising the heart rate and working the whole body.
i: Stand beside a dumbbell lying on the floor.
Squat down, place your hands on the floor, jump your feet back and do a push up.
Jump your feet forward under your hips.
Jump up and sideways over the dumbbell, landing softly.
Turn and repeat in the other direction at a steady pace.

exercises.n: elevación frontal de pie con giro y mancuernas
exercises.d: A front raise combined with a torso twist, working the shoulders and the obliques together.
i: Stand with feet shoulder width apart, holding a dumbbell in both hands at thigh level.
Raise the dumbbell in front of you to chest height.
Rotate your torso to one side, turning from the ribs while your hips face forward.
Rotate back to the center and lower the dumbbell with control.
Alternate sides each rep and keep the weight light.

exercises.n: press pallof alterno con piernas divididas y banda elástica
exercises.en: resistance band alternating split stance pallof press
exercises.d: A Pallof press from a split stance that resists the band pull and trains anti-rotation strength.
i: Anchor the band at chest height and stand sideways to it in a split stance.
Hold the handle at your chest with both hands.
Press the band straight out in front of you without letting your torso turn.
Hold for a second, then bring the hands back to your chest.
Switch which foot is forward on each set or rep and keep your hips square.

exercises.n: remo alterno en plancha de oso con mancuerna
exercises.d: A row from a bear plank position that builds back strength while the core fights to stop hip rotation.
i: Start on all fours with a dumbbell in each hand and knees hovering just off the floor.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Row one dumbbell to your ribs without twisting your hips.
Lower it back to the floor with control.
Row with the other arm and keep alternating at a steady pace.

exercises.n: pullover a press en puente con mancuerna
exercises.d: A glute bridge combined with a pullover and press, training the hips, chest and triceps in one flow.
i: Lie on your back with knees bent and hold a dumbbell over your chest.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips into a bridge.
Lower the dumbbell back overhead in a pullover arc.
Pull it back over your chest and press it straight up.
Lower your hips with control and repeat, keeping your ribs down.

exercises.n: salto lateral con impulso
exercises.d: A vertical jump followed by a hop to the side, building leg power and agility.
i: Stand with feet hip width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Jump straight up, swinging your arms for momentum.
Land softly and immediately hop sideways to one side.
Land on both feet with soft knees and reset your balance.
Alternate the side of each hop and keep a steady rhythm.

exercises.n: toque alterno de pies con inclinación de pie
exercises.d: A quick standing toe touch where you reach to opposite feet in turn, warming up the hamstrings and midsection.
i: Stand tall with your feet wider than your hips and arms out to the sides.
Hinge forward and twist to reach one hand toward the opposite foot.
Return to standing with arms out.
Reach the other hand to the opposite foot.
Keep a flat back and move at a lively pace.

exercises.n: peso muerto con zancada hacia atrás y press sobre la cabeza con disco
exercises.en: weighted plate deadlift rear lunge with overhead press
exercises.d: A plate flow that links a deadlift, a reverse lunge and an overhead press for a full body hit.
i: Stand holding a weight plate in front of your thighs.
Hinge at the hips and lower the plate toward your shins, then stand up.
Step one foot back into a reverse lunge as you press the plate overhead.
Return the foot and bring the plate back to your thighs.
Keep a flat back and repeat, alternating the lunging leg.

exercises.n: push press a un brazo en landmine
exercises.d: A one-arm push press with a landmine, using leg drive to move the bar up and the shoulder to control it.
i: Stand facing the landmine end and hold it at your shoulder with one hand.
Dip a few inches by bending your knees.
Drive up with your legs and press the bar up and forward until your arm is straight.
Lower the end back to your shoulder with control.
Keep your ribs down and brace your core. Finish the reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: sentadilla goblet reloj
exercises.d: A goblet squat that steps around an imaginary clock, training the legs from several directions.
i: Hold a dumbbell at your chest and picture a clock on the floor around you.
Step to 12 o'clock and squat down with your chest up.
Stand up and return to the center.
Step to the next position on the clock and squat again.
Work your way around the clock with control and switch direction on the next set.

exercises.n: swing lateral con kettlebell
exercises.d: A kettlebell swing that travels to the side, adding rotation work for the obliques to the hip snap.
i: Stand with feet wider than shoulders and a kettlebell in both hands.
Hinge at the hips and swing the bell back between your legs.
Snap your hips forward and swing the bell up toward chest height, angled to one side.
Let it swing back down with a flat back.
Finish the reps on one side, then switch.

exercises.n: burpee con empuje de trineo
exercises.d: A conditioning move that pairs a burpee with a hard sled push for a tough full body effort.
i: Stand behind a loaded sled and drop into a burpee, chest to the floor.
Jump up to your feet explosively.
Grab the sled handles with your arms extended and lean in.
Drive with short, powerful steps to push the sled for a set distance.
Return and repeat, keeping your back flat while pushing.

exercises.n: balanceo hacia atrás en mariposa
exercises.d: Rock back and forth on your spine with legs in a butterfly position. It massages the back and loosens the hips.
i: Sit with the soles of your feet together and knees open.
Hold your feet or ankles.
Roll back slowly along your spine.
Roll forward to sit up again.
Repeat smoothly for 8 to 10 reps.

exercises.n: levantamiento thor a media rodilla con barra
exercises.d: A half kneeling barbell lift that sweeps the bar diagonally up, training the core to control rotation.
i: Kneel on one knee holding one end of a barbell in a landmine setup near your hip.
Brace your core and stay tall.
Lift the bar diagonally across your body and up toward the opposite shoulder.
Return the bar slowly to the start.
Keep your hips square. Finish the reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: complejo de hombros con mancuernas
exercises.d: A chained set of dumbbell shoulder moves done without rest, building shoulder strength and endurance.
i: Stand with a light dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Do a set of lateral raises, then straight into front raises.
Move into a set of overhead presses without putting the weights down.
Lower the dumbbells under control and rest.
Keep the weights light and your torso still throughout.

exercises.n: golpe horizontal con balón medicinal
exercises.d: An explosive sideways medicine ball slam that builds rotational power in the chest, core and shoulders.
i: Stand sideways to a wall or rebound surface holding a medicine ball at chest height.
Wind the ball slightly away from the target.
Rotate and throw the ball hard against the wall with both hands.
Catch it, reset your stance and go again.
Use your hips and keep your core tight. Finish the reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: press negativo alterno a una pierna en trineo
exercises.en: sled alternating single leg negative press
exercises.d: A sled leg press done one leg at a time, with a slow lowering phase to build leg strength.
i: Sit in the sled with feet on the platform and release the safety.
Press the platform up with both legs and lock out gently.
Shift the load to one leg and lower it slowly for 3-4 seconds.
Press back up with both legs.
Alternate the lowering leg each rep and never let your lower back round.

exercises.n: peso muerto rumano cruzado con mancuernas
exercises.d: A Romanian deadlift where the dumbbells reach across the body, training the hamstrings and glutes.
i: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand with a soft bend in the knees.
Push your hips back and lower the weights down your legs.
Reach one dumbbell across toward the opposite foot, keeping your back flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Alternate the crossing side each rep.

exercises.n: abdominal lateral con banda elástica
exercises.d: Crunch sideways against a band. It works the obliques.
i: Anchor a band overhead and kneel or stand beside it.
Hold the band at your shoulder with the near hand.
Bend sideways toward your hip.
Return to upright under control.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: rotación de rodillas alrededor de la cabeza con mancuerna
exercises.d: A kneeling dumbbell halo that circles the weight around your head to warm up and mobilize the shoulders.
i: Kneel tall holding a dumbbell by one end at chest level.
Circle the dumbbell around your head, keeping it close.
Keep your ribs down and your hips still.
Complete the circle back to the front.
Do a few reps one way, then reverse direction.

exercises.n: elevación de pierna de pie con banda elástica
exercises.d: Raise a leg forward against a band loop. It targets the hip flexors and front thigh.
i: Loop a band around your ankles or one ankle and anchor it.
Stand tall and hold a support if needed.
Lift one straight leg forward to hip height.
Lower slowly.
Complete reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: remo para deltoide posterior de pie con banda elástica
exercises.d: A standing rear delt row with a band, pulling the handles toward the chest. It trains the rear delts.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros y coloca la banda bajo los pies.
Sostén las agarraderas de la banda con las palmas mirándose entre sí y los brazos extendidos frente a ti.
Flexiona ligeramente las rodillas e inclínate hacia adelante desde las caderas, manteniendo la espalda recta.
Tira de la banda hacia el pecho, juntando los omóplatos.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte superior, luego suelta lentamente la tensión y regresa a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: peso muerto con piernas semirrígidas y espalda recta con banda elástica
exercises.en: band straight back stiff leg deadlift
exercises.d: A stiff-leg deadlift with a band, hinging at the hips with a straight back. It trains the glutes and hamstrings.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros y coloca la banda alrededor de la parte superior de las piernas.
Sujeta la banda con ambas manos frente a los muslos, con las palmas mirando hacia el cuerpo.
Manteniendo la espalda recta y las rodillas ligeramente flexionadas, flexiona las caderas y baja la banda hacia el suelo.
Siente el estiramiento en los isquiotibiales mientras bajas la banda.
Activa los glúteos y los isquiotibiales para levantar el cuerpo de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: prensa de pierna a una pierna asistida
exercises.d: A machine press done with one leg at a time, helping you build leg strength and fix imbalances.
i: Sit on the machine and place one foot on the platform.
Release the safety and lower the platform until your knee is bent about 90 degrees.
Press through your heel to straighten the leg without locking the knee.
Lower back with control.
Keep your hips on the seat. Finish the reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: fondos de tríceps de pie asistidos
exercises.d: A dip with machine assistance that lets you build triceps strength while handling less of your bodyweight.
i: Set the assistance and stand on the pad holding the handles.
Keep your elbows close and your chest up.
Lower your body by bending the elbows until they are at 90 degrees.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Avoid shrugging your shoulders and move smoothly.

exercises.n: press de pecho paralelo en máquina
exercises.d: A seated machine press with parallel handles, working the chest with a stable path.
i: Adjust the seat so the handles are at mid-chest height and sit back.
Grip the handles with your elbows slightly below shoulder level.
Press the handles forward until your arms are almost straight.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch in the chest.
Keep your back against the pad.

exercises.n: caminata sobre talones
exercises.d: Walking on your heels with the toes lifted, strengthening the shins and loosening the ankles.
i: Stand tall with arms relaxed at your sides.
Lift your toes and forefoot off the floor so you balance on your heels.
Walk forward with small, controlled steps.
Keep your toes pulled up the whole time.
Walk for 20-30 seconds, then rest.

exercises.n: apertura en contractora (pec deck) en máquina
exercises.d: A machine fly where the arms sweep together in front, isolating the chest.
i: Sit on the pec deck with your back flat and the arms at chest level.
Place your forearms or hands on the pads with elbows slightly bent.
Bring the arms together in front of your chest.
Squeeze for a moment, then open slowly until you feel a chest stretch.
Keep your shoulders down and back.

exercises.n: extensión de cadera de pie en máquina
exercises.d: A standing machine move that drives one leg back to work the glutes.
i: Stand facing the machine and rest your hands on the support.
Place the back of your working leg against the lever pad.
Push the leg back and slightly up by squeezing the glute.
Return slowly to the start.
Keep your torso upright without arching your back. Finish the reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: curl de bíceps alterno en máquina
exercises.d: A machine curl done one arm at a time, so each biceps works independently.
i: Sit with your upper arms resting on the pad and grab the handles.
Curl one handle up toward your shoulder.
Squeeze the biceps at the top.
Lower it slowly while curling the other arm.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and avoid swinging.

exercises.n: salto de plancha a sentadilla
exercises.d: A fast move from a plank to a squat jump position, raising the heart rate and training the legs and core.
i: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
Jump both feet forward, landing outside your hands in a wide squat.
Stand or hop up briefly if you like, then lower your hands.
Jump your feet back to the plank.
Keep a tight core and land softly.

exercises.n: giro ruso fuerte con kettlebell
exercises.d: A seated Russian twist with a kettlebell, taking the weight side to side to work the obliques and abs.
i: Sit on the floor with knees bent and lean back slightly.
Hold a kettlebell at your chest with both hands.
Rotate your torso to bring the bell beside one hip.
Rotate to the other side in a smooth motion.
Keep your chest lifted and feet raised for more challenge.

exercises.n: sentadilla búlgara con cinturón en máquina
exercises.d: A split squat with your back foot raised, loaded through a belt machine to hit the quads and glutes.
i: Set up in the belt squat machine and place your back foot on the bench behind you.
Stand tall with the front foot far enough forward.
Lower straight down until your front thigh is parallel.
Press through the front heel to stand.
Keep your torso upright. Finish the reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: remo kroc con mancuerna
exercises.d: A heavy, high rep one-arm row with a little body momentum, great for lat and grip strength.
i: Stand beside a bench with one hand and knee supported on it and hold a heavy dumbbell.
Let the weight hang with a stretch in the lat.
Row the dumbbell to your hip using controlled momentum.
Lower slowly to a full stretch.
Keep your back flat. Finish the reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: extensión de tríceps en máquina v. 2
exercises.d: A seated machine extension that isolates the triceps through a stable path.
i: Sit and adjust the seat so your upper arms rest on the pad.
Grab the handles with your elbows bent.
Press the handles down until your arms are straight.
Squeeze the triceps for a second.
Return slowly without lifting your shoulders.

exercises.n: elevación powell con mancuerna
exercises.d: A side-lying raise that targets the rear shoulder with a long range of motion.
i: Lie on your side on a bench holding a light dumbbell in your top hand.
Start with the arm hanging in front of your body.
Raise the arm out and back in an arc until it is in line with your torso.
Pause briefly, then lower with control.
Use a light weight and switch sides after your set.

exercises.n: curl de pie con pronación, giro y peso con banda elástica (pulso de brazo)
exercises.en: resistance band weighted standing pronation twist curl (arm wrestler)
exercises.d: A curl that adds a forearm twist, mimicking arm wrestling to build the biceps and forearms.
i: Stand on a resistance band and hold the handle with your palm turned to the side.
Curl the handle up while rotating your wrist.
Finish with your palm facing you and the biceps squeezed.
Lower slowly and untwist back to the start.
Keep your elbow tucked. Finish the reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: abducción lateral de cadera en máquina
exercises.d: A machine move that presses the leg out to the side, working the outer hips.
i: Stand next to the machine and place the outer side of your leg against the pad.
Hold the support for balance.
Push your leg out to the side in a smooth motion.
Pause briefly, then return slowly.
Keep your torso upright. Finish the reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: pulso de superman
exercises.d: Lie face down and lift arms and legs with small pulses. It strengthens the lower back and glutes.
i: Lie face down with arms extended in front.
Lift your arms, chest and legs a few inches.
Pulse them up and down in small movements.
Keep your neck neutral.
Lower and rest after your set.

exercises.n: aducción lateral de cadera en máquina
exercises.d: A machine move that pulls the leg across the body, working the inner thighs.
i: Stand next to the machine with the inner side of your leg against the pad.
Hold the support for balance.
Pull your leg across your body, squeezing your inner thigh.
Return slowly to the start.
Keep your hips level and avoid leaning. Finish the reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: elevación de pierna de pie en máquina
exercises.d: A standing machine raise that lifts the leg forward to train the hip flexors and the front of the thigh.
i: Stand facing the machine with your hands on the support.
Place the front of your thigh against the pad.
Raise your leg forward until the thigh is about parallel with the floor.
Lower slowly to the start.
Keep your torso tall. Finish the reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: press de tibial sentado en el suelo con banda elástica
exercises.en: resistance band sitting floor tibialis press
exercises.d: A seated move that pulls the toes toward the shins against a band to strengthen the front of the lower leg.
i: Sit on the floor with your legs out and loop a band around your foot, anchored in front.
Keep your leg straight and your heel on the floor.
Pull your toes up toward your shin against the band.
Hold briefly, then slowly release.
Do all reps on one foot, then switch.

exercises.n: press de tibial sentado con kettlebell
exercises.d: A seated press that lifts a kettlebell on the top of the foot to strengthen the muscles at the front of the shin.
i: Sit on a bench or box with a kettlebell hanging from the top of one foot.
Plant your heel on the floor.
Lift the toes up toward your shin to raise the kettlebell.
Pause, then lower slowly.
Use a light weight. Finish the reps, then switch feet.

exercises.n: patada trasera de pie en máquina
exercises.d: A standing machine kickback that squeezes the glutes as you press the leg behind you.
i: Stand facing the machine and hold the handles for support.
Place the back of your working leg against the pad.
Kick the leg back by squeezing the glute.
Pause at the top, then return slowly.
Keep your torso upright. Finish the reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: sentadilla en silla en máquina
exercises.d: A machine squat performed with a chair-like support, a stable way to train the legs.
i: Position yourself in the machine with the pads on your shoulders and feet shoulder width apart.
Release the safety and brace your core.
Bend your knees and sit back and down.
Drive through your heels to stand back up.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.

exercises.n: peso muerto con saco de arena
exercises.d: A deadlift with a sandbag, building hip and back strength with an awkward, grippy load.
i: Stand over a sandbag with feet hip width apart.
Hinge at your hips, bend your knees and grip the bag.
Brace your core and drive through your feet to stand tall with the bag.
Push your hips back and lower the bag to the floor.
Keep your back flat throughout.

exercises.n: sentadilla con saco de arena
exercises.d: A squat holding a sandbag against the chest, training the legs and the core.
i: Hold a sandbag in a bear hug against your chest.
Stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Sit back and down into a squat with your chest up.
Drive through your heels to stand up.
Keep the bag tight to your body.

exercises.n: carga al hombro con saco de arena
exercises.d: A lift that heaves the sandbag from the floor up onto your shoulder, building power and total body strength.
i: Stand over a sandbag and grip it firmly with both hands.
Lift the bag, driving through your legs and hips.
Pull it to your lap, then heave it up onto one shoulder.
Lower it to the floor with control.
Alternate shoulders each rep.

exercises.n: acarreo con saco de arena (en hombros)
exercises.d: A walking carry with a sandbag across the shoulders, building posture and trunk strength.
i: Lift the sandbag onto your shoulders and hold it there.
Stand tall with your core braced.
Walk forward with steady, controlled steps.
Keep your ribs stacked over your hips.
Carry for a set distance or time, then set the bag down carefully.

exercises.n: acarreo con saco de arena (abrazo de oso)
exercises.d: A walking carry with a sandbag held to the chest, taxing the core, arms and grip.
i: Lift the sandbag and hug it against your chest.
Stand tall with your core braced.
Walk forward with steady steps.
Keep your arms squeezing the bag tight.
Carry for a set distance or time, then lower the bag with care.

exercises.n: press militar con saco de arena
exercises.d: A standing overhead press using a sandbag, which shifts as you push, so your shoulders and core must stay tight.
i: Hold a sandbag at your upper chest or shoulders.
Stand with feet hip width apart and brace your core.
Press the bag straight overhead.
Lock out the arms, then lower the bag with control.
Keep your ribs down and avoid leaning back.

exercises.n: remo con saco de arena
exercises.d: A bent-over row with a sandbag, training the back and grip.
i: Stand over a sandbag, hinge forward and grab it with both hands.
Keep your back flat and knees slightly bent.
Row the bag toward your lower ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly back to full arm extension.

exercises.n: sentadilla completa en máquina
exercises.d: A full range machine squat that builds the thighs and glutes with a guided path.
i: Step into the machine with the pads on your shoulders and feet shoulder width apart.
Release the safety and brace your core.
Squat as deep as you comfortably can.
Drive through your heels to stand.
Keep your chest up and knees over your toes.

exercises.n: sentadilla pistol en máquina
exercises.d: A single leg squat on a machine that supports balance while you load one leg through full depth.
i: Step into the machine and put one foot on the platform with the other leg lifted or extended.
Brace your core and release the safety.
Lower slowly into a deep squat on one leg.
Press through your heel to stand.
Keep your knee in line with your toes. Finish the reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: press de pecho acostado en máquina (con discos)
exercises.d: A plate-loaded press from a lying position, working the chest with a guided path.
i: Lie back on the machine bench and grip the handles at chest level.
Plant your feet and keep your shoulders pulled back.
Press the handles up until your arms are almost straight.
Lower slowly until you feel a stretch in the chest.
Keep your back on the pad throughout.

exercises.n: sentadilla con mazo de acero (con peso)
exercises.d: A squat holding a steel mace across the shoulders or upper back. It builds leg strength and a braced trunk.
i: Rest the mace on your shoulders and hold it with both hands.
Stand with feet about shoulder width apart.
Sit your hips back and down until your thighs are about parallel.
Keep your chest tall and knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your feet to stand back up.

exercises.n: halo con mazo de acero (con peso)
exercises.d: Circle a steel mace around your head while standing tall. It trains shoulder control and stability under an awkward load.
i: Stand tall with feet shoulder width apart and hold the mace upright near your chest.
Brace your core and keep your ribs down.
Circle the mace around your head in a smooth, controlled arc.
Keep your elbows close and your head still.
Do all reps, then reverse the direction.

exercises.n: extensión de cuello acostado con peso
exercises.d: Lying face down, you lift your head against a light load. It strengthens the muscles at the back of the neck.
i: Lie face down on a bench with your head past the edge and a light weight on the back of your head.
Start with your chin tucked toward your chest.
Slowly lift your head until your neck is in line with your torso.
Pause briefly, then lower with control.
Keep the load light and the motion smooth.

exercises.n: lanzamiento de saco de arena sobre el hombro (con peso)
exercises.d: Explosively hinge and heave a sandbag backwards over your shoulder. It trains hip power and full body force.
i: Stand over the sandbag with feet shoulder width apart.
Hinge down, grip the bag and keep your back flat.
Drive your hips forward and pull the bag up the front of your body.
Extend fully and throw the bag back over your shoulder.
Reset and repeat, facing the same way.

exercises.n: flexión de cuello acostado con peso
exercises.d: Lying on your back, you lift your head against a light load. It strengthens the muscles at the front of the neck.
i: Lie on your back on a bench with your head past the edge and a light weight on your forehead.
Hold the weight with a hand for control.
Slowly curl your head up, tucking your chin.
Pause briefly, then lower with control.
