Keep the load light and avoid jerking.

exercises.n: remo bajo a un brazo en polea (con cuerda)
exercises.en: cable single arm low row (with rope)
exercises.d: A one-armed seated row with a rope handle on a low pulley. It works the lats and upper back one side at a time.
i: Attach a rope to a low pulley and sit facing the stack with your feet braced.
Hold the rope in one hand with your arm extended.
Pull your elbow back along your side, squeezing your shoulder blade.
Pause, then let the arm extend slowly.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: colgado alterno
exercises.d: Hang from a bar and shift your weight from side to side. It decompresses the shoulders and stretches the lats.
i: Grab a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, hands about shoulder width apart.
Hang with your arms long and your body relaxed.
Shift your weight toward one hand, letting that side stretch.
Shift to the other side and keep alternating.
Hold the hang for 20-30 seconds in total.

exercises.n: trepa de dos cuerdas
exercises.d: Climb up using two ropes, pulling with your arms one hand over the other. It builds a strong pull and grip.
i: Grab one rope in each hand and hang with arms long.
Pull up with one arm while you bend your elbow close to your body.
Reach higher with the other hand and pull again.
Keep your core tight and your legs steady.
Climb to a safe height, then lower under control.

exercises.n: pellizco de discos
exercises.d: Pinch a weight plate between your fingers and thumb and hold it. It builds finger and thumb grip strength.
i: Pick up two smooth plates and stack them with the smooth sides facing out.
Pinch them together with your fingertips and thumb.
Stand tall with your arm hanging by your side.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without letting the plates slip.
Switch hands and repeat.

exercises.n: press militar sentado con barra (dentro del rack)
exercises.en: barbell seated military press (inside squat cage)
exercises.d: A seated overhead press performed inside a squat cage so the rack gives you safe bar positions. It builds shoulder and triceps strength.
i: Set a bench inside the cage and the bar at shoulder height.
Sit tall, grip the bar just outside shoulder width and unrack it.
Press the bar straight overhead until your arms are extended.
Lower it to your upper chest with control.
Keep your ribs down and your back against the pad.

exercises.n: remo elevado en polea
exercises.d: A cable row where the handle sits higher than usual, pulled toward your upper chest. It targets the upper back.
i: Set a cable handle at about head height and take a stable stance.
Grab the handle and lean back slightly with arms extended.
Pull toward your upper chest, driving your elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.n: estiramiento de isquiotibiales sentado en silla
exercises.en: seated hamstring stretch on a chair
exercises.d: A gentle seated stretch for the back of the thigh, done on a chair. It helps loosen tight hamstrings.
i: Sit near the front edge of a chair.
Extend one leg straight with your heel on the floor and toes up.
Hinge forward from your hips with a flat back until you feel a stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily.
Switch legs and repeat.

exercises.n: estiramiento de pecho sentado en silla juntando los omóplatos
exercises.en: seated squeeze shoulder blades chest stretch on a chair
exercises.d: Sit on a chair and squeeze your shoulder blades together to open the chest. It eases tight pecs from desk posture.
i: Sit tall on a chair with your feet flat.
Reach your hands behind you and clasp them or hold the chair back.
Pull your shoulder blades together and lift your chest.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without arching your lower back.
Relax and repeat.

exercises.n: jalón frontal con agarre cerrado en polea
exercises.en: cable close grip front lat pulldown
exercises.d: A lat pulldown with a narrow grip, pulling the bar to your upper chest. It trains the lats and biceps.
i: Sit at the pulldown station and secure your thighs under the pads.
Grab the bar with a close grip.
Lean back slightly and pull the bar down to your upper chest.
Drive your elbows down and squeeze your lats.
Let the bar rise slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.n: elevación lateral posterior acostado a un brazo con mancuerna v. 2
exercises.en: dumbbell lying one arm rear lateral raise v. 2
exercises.d: Lying on your side on a bench, you raise a dumbbell out to the side. It isolates the rear shoulder.
i: Lie on your side on a bench holding a light dumbbell in your top hand.
Start with your arm hanging in front of you, slight bend in the elbow.
Raise the arm out and up until it is about shoulder height.
Pause, then lower with control.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: patada trasera a una pierna (con apoyo en banco)
exercises.d: Support yourself on a bench and kick one leg back and up. It works the glutes without any equipment.
i: Place your hands on a bench and step back into a hinged position.
Keep your back flat and your core braced.
Kick one leg straight back and up, squeezing your glute.
Lower without letting your hips rotate.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: elevación de gemelos en smith (con bloque)
exercises.d: A standing calf raise under the Smith bar with the balls of your feet on a block. The block lets you stretch deeper.
i: Place a block under the Smith bar and rest the bar on your upper back.
Stand with the balls of your feet on the block.
Lower your heels for a full stretch.
Rise onto your toes as high as you can.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.

exercises.n: jalón con agarre inverso estrecho en polea
exercises.en: cable reverse narrow grip lat pulldown
exercises.d: A lat pulldown with an underhand, narrow grip. It uses the biceps more and works the lower lats.
i: Sit at the pulldown station and secure your thighs.
Grab the bar with a narrow underhand grip.
Lean back a little and pull the bar to your upper chest.
Keep your elbows close to your sides.
Return slowly until your arms are fully extended.

exercises.n: estiramiento del gato
exercises.d: A gentle spinal stretch on hands and knees, rounding the back like a cat. It loosens the spine.
i: Start on hands and knees with hands under shoulders.
Tuck your chin and round your back toward the ceiling.
Draw your belly button in and hold for a few breaths.
Return to a neutral spine.
Repeat slowly, holding the rounded position 15-20 seconds.

exercises.n: círculo de cadera de pie a una pierna con apoyo en silla
exercises.en: standing single leg hip swirl with chair support
exercises.d: Hold a chair and swirl one leg in circles. It loosens the hip joint and warms up the glutes.
i: Stand beside a chair and hold it for balance.
Lift one leg slightly off the floor.
Draw slow, controlled circles with your leg.
Do half of the reps one way, then reverse the direction.
Switch legs and repeat.

exercises.n: estiramiento de espalda en barra fija
exercises.d: Hold a fixed bar and sit your hips back to stretch your back and lats. It opens the upper body.
i: Grip a fixed bar or post at about hip height.
Step back until your arms are straight.
Sink your hips back and let your chest drop.
Feel the stretch along your back and sides.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.

exercises.n: estiramiento de flexor de cadera de rodillas
exercises.d: A lunge-style stretch on one knee that lengthens the front of the hip. It helps with tightness from sitting.
i: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward in a lunge.
Tuck your pelvis under and squeeze your back glute.
Shift your hips forward gently.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, keeping your torso tall.
Switch sides and repeat.

exercises.n: flexión de rodilla sentado a una pierna
exercises.d: Sitting down, you bend one knee by sliding your heel back. It is a gentle way to build knee mobility and hamstring control.
i: Sit on a chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Slide one foot back under the chair, bending the knee.
Pause briefly at the end of the range.
Return the foot slowly to the start.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: press de tibial sentado a una pierna
exercises.d: Press the top of your foot upward against resistance while seated. It strengthens the shin muscle.
i: Sit with one foot resting flat and the other leg crossed over it.
Hook the toes of the lower foot under your other foot for light resistance.
Lift the toes and forefoot up toward your shin.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch feet.

exercises.n: extensión de rodilla de pie a una pierna con banda elástica
exercises.en: resistance band standing single leg knee extension
exercises.d: Standing on one leg with a band behind the knee, you straighten the other knee. It builds quad strength with gentle load.
i: Anchor a band behind you and loop it around one ankle or behind the knee.
Stand tall and hold on for balance if needed.
Straighten your knee against the band.
Pause with the leg extended.
Bend slowly back, then switch legs after your reps.

exercises.n: extensión de rodilla sentado a una pierna
exercises.d: Seated on a chair, you straighten one knee to lift your foot. A gentle move that wakes up the thigh.
i: Sit tall on a chair with your feet flat.
Slowly straighten one knee to lift your foot.
Squeeze your thigh at the top for a second.
Lower the foot back to the floor with control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: extensión de rodilla sentado a una pierna v. 2
exercises.en: seated single leg knee extension v. 2
exercises.d: A variation of the seated knee extension. It builds thigh strength with a small, controlled range.
i: Sit tall on a chair, holding the seat edge for support.
Straighten one knee until the leg is level.
Hold for a second, tightening your thigh.
Lower slowly to the start.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: extensión de rodilla sentado a una pierna con peso v. 2
exercises.en: weighted seated single leg knee extension v. 2
exercises.d: A seated knee extension with a light weight on the ankle. It adds load to build thigh strength.
i: Strap a light ankle weight on and sit tall on a chair.
Hold the seat edge for support.
Straighten the knee until your leg is level.
Hold for a second and squeeze your thigh.
Lower slowly, then switch legs after your reps.

exercises.n: estiramiento de gemelos en zancada con pierna recta
exercises.d: Lunge forward with the back leg straight to stretch the calf. It improves ankle mobility.
i: Step into a lunge with hands on a wall or knee.
Keep the back leg straight with heel down.
Lean forward until you feel a stretch.
Keep your foot pointing forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.n: press de tibial acostado con rodilla flexionada
exercises.d: Lying on your back with knees bent, you press your foot toward your shin. It targets the front of the lower leg.
i: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Slide one foot under the other for light resistance.
Lift the toes of the lower foot toward your shin.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch feet.

exercises.n: flexión de rodilla abrazada sentado a una pierna
exercises.en: seated single leg hugging knee flexion
exercises.d: Seated, you hug one knee toward your chest and bend it. It mobilizes the hip and knee gently.
i: Sit tall on a chair with feet flat.
Lift one knee and clasp your hands around the shin.
Gently pull the knee toward your chest and flex it.
Hold for a moment, then release.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: flexión de rodilla abrazada sentado a una pierna con toalla
exercises.en: seated single leg hugging knee flexion with towel
exercises.d: The same hugging knee flexion, using a towel around the shin to help. It adds a gentle assisted bend.
i: Sit tall on a chair and loop a towel around one shin.
Hold the towel ends with both hands.
Pull the knee gently toward your chest, bending it.
Hold for a moment, then release.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: flexión de rodilla de rodillas con apoyo en silla
exercises.d: Kneeling beside a chair for support, you gently bend the knee. It builds comfortable knee range of motion.
i: Hold the back of a chair and kneel on one knee on a soft surface.
Keep your torso upright.
Slowly sit back toward your heel to bend the knee.
Stay within a comfortable range.
Return to the start and switch sides after your reps.

exercises.n: balanceo de gemelos de pie a una pierna
exercises.d: Balance on one leg and rock between heel and toes. It warms up the calf and ankle.
i: Stand on one leg next to a wall for balance.
Rock your weight back onto your heel, lifting the toes.
Roll forward onto the ball of your foot.
Keep the movement smooth and controlled.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: elevación de gemelos concentrada de pie a una pierna
exercises.en: standing single leg concentration calf raise
exercises.d: A one-legged calf raise performed slowly with full focus. It builds calf strength and ankle control.
i: Stand on one leg and hold a wall or rail lightly.
Lower your heel slightly for a stretch.
Rise high onto your toes, squeezing the calf.
Pause for a second at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: puente a una pierna elevado
exercises.d: A single-leg glute bridge with your feet raised. It strongly works the glutes and hamstrings.
i: Lie on your back with one foot raised on a bench or step.
Extend the other leg straight up.
Drive through your heel and lift your hips.
Squeeze your glute at the top without arching your back.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: press svend acostado en el suelo
exercises.d: Press a plate out from your chest while lying on the floor, squeezing it with both hands. It targets the inner chest.
i: Lie on your back holding a plate between your palms at your chest.
Squeeze the plate firmly.
Press it straight up until your arms are extended.
Keep squeezing as you lower it back to your chest.
Repeat with steady control.

exercises.n: movilización de sentadilla
exercises.d: A deep squat hold with gentle movements. It opens up the hips and ankles.
i: Stand with feet slightly wider than your shoulders.
Squat down as deep as is comfortable.
Press your elbows against your knees and keep your chest up.
Rock gently side to side.
Stay for 20-30 seconds, then stand.

exercises.n: giro de torso con piernas divididas y balón medicinal
exercises.en: medicine ball split stance torso twist
exercises.d: Rotate your torso side to side with a medicine ball in a split stance. It trains the trunk rotators.
i: Stand in a split stance and hold a medicine ball at chest height.
Brace your core.
Rotate your torso to one side, keeping your hips steady.
Return to the centre and rotate the other way.
Complete all reps, then switch the front foot.

exercises.n: golpe sobre la cabeza con banda elástica
exercises.d: Swing a resistance band from overhead down in front of you in a chopping motion. It builds powerful chest and core strength.
i: Anchor a band overhead and hold the handles with both hands.
Stand with a staggered stance and your arms raised.
Pull the handles down and forward in a controlled hit.
Brace your core as you finish.
Return slowly and repeat.

exercises.n: plancha golpeando el balón alternado
exercises.d: From a plank, tap a ball with alternating hands. It challenges your core to stay stable.
i: Start in a straight-arm plank with a ball in front of you.
Tighten your core and glutes.
Lift one hand and tap the ball.
Return the hand and tap with the other.
Keep your hips as still as possible.

exercises.n: flexión a extensión de cuello sentado en silla
exercises.en: seated neck flexion to extension on chair
exercises.d: Seated, you slowly nod your head forward and back. It loosens the neck.
i: Sit tall on a chair with your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly lower your chin toward your chest.
Gently lift your head and look slightly upward.
Keep the motion smooth and pain free.
Repeat for several slow reps.

exercises.n: giro de cuello de lado a lado sentado en silla
exercises.en: seated side to side neck twist on chair
exercises.d: Seated, you turn your head from side to side. It restores easy neck rotation.
i: Sit tall on a chair with your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly turn your head to look over one shoulder.
Return to the centre.
Turn to the other side.
Repeat for several slow reps.

exercises.n: inclinación de cuello de lado a lado sentado en silla
exercises.en: seated side to side neck bend on chair
exercises.d: Seated, you tilt your ear toward each shoulder. It eases side neck tightness.
i: Sit tall on a chair with your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly tilt your head so your ear moves toward one shoulder.
Return to the centre.
Tilt toward the other shoulder.
Repeat for several slow reps.

exercises.n: abdominal con golpe de balón medicinal
exercises.d: Sit up while raising a medicine ball overhead and slam it down. It combines a crunch with power.
i: Lie on your back with knees bent, holding a medicine ball overhead.
Sit up in one motion, bringing the ball forward.
Slam the ball down in front of your feet.
Catch it on the bounce or pick it up.
Lie back with control and repeat.

exercises.n: atrape de elevación frontal completa con mancuerna
exercises.d: Raise a dumbbell in front of you all the way overhead and catch it with control. It trains the front shoulder.
i: Stand tall holding a dumbbell with both hands in front of your thighs.
Raise it straight up in front of you to overhead.
Control it at the top and keep your core braced.
Lower it slowly back down.
Use a moderate weight and avoid arching your back.

exercises.n: estiramiento de glúteo acostado
exercises.d: Pull a knee toward your chest while lying down. It releases the glutes.
i: Lie on your back.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Pull the bottom leg toward your chest.
Keep your head and shoulders relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.n: atrape de press de banca con barra
exercises.d: A bench press where you lower the bar and catch it quickly before pressing. It trains chest strength and control.
i: Lie on a bench with a spotter or safety pins set.
Unrack the bar over your chest.
Lower the bar toward your chest under control.
Stop it just above the chest and press up.
Keep your feet planted and your shoulder blades pinched.

exercises.n: pase de peso muerto a una pierna con kettlebell
exercises.d: A single-leg deadlift where you pass a kettlebell from hand to hand. It trains balance and the hip hinge.
i: Stand on one leg holding a kettlebell in one hand.
Hinge at the hips and reach the bell toward the floor.
Pass the bell to the other hand below your knee.
Stand back up using your glute and hamstring.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: zancada hacia atrás ipsilateral con rodilla alta y kettlebell
exercises.en: kettlebell ipsilateral reverse lunge high knee
exercises.d: A reverse lunge holding a kettlebell on the same side as the working leg, ending with a high knee. It trains balance and leg drive.
i: Hold a kettlebell in one hand and stand tall.
Step back with the leg on the same side as the bell.
Lower into a lunge.
Drive up and lift that knee high as you stand.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: estiramiento de gemelos con rodilla al cajón
exercises.d: Press one knee forward toward a box with your foot flat to stretch the calf. It improves ankle flexibility.
i: Place a foot flat a short distance from a box or step.
Keep your heel down.
Push your knee forward to touch the box.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a calf stretch.
Switch legs and repeat.

exercises.n: pronación y supinación del pie sentado
exercises.d: Seated, you roll the foot inward and outward. It mobilizes the ankle and foot.
i: Sit on a chair with one foot lifted slightly off the floor.
Roll the sole of your foot inward.
Roll it outward as far as is comfortable.
Keep the lower leg still.
Finish your reps, then switch feet.

exercises.n: estiramiento con press a 90 y 90
exercises.d: Sit in a 90-degree hip position and press forward to stretch the glutes and hips. It improves hip rotation.
i: Sit on the floor with both knees bent at 90 degrees, one leg in front, one to the side.
Sit tall.
Hinge forward over the front shin with a flat back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides and repeat.

exercises.n: giro de torso a media rodilla
exercises.d: From a half-kneeling stance, rotate your torso. It opens the spine and warms up the trunk.
i: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward.
Hold your arms crossed in front of your chest.
Rotate your upper body toward the front leg.
Return to the centre and keep your hips square.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: estiramiento de pecho de pie a un brazo
exercises.d: Place one arm against a wall and turn away to open the chest. It eases tight pecs.
i: Stand next to a wall or door frame.
Place your forearm or hand on the wall at shoulder height.
Slowly turn your body away from the arm.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch arms and repeat.

exercises.n: elevación frontal acostado con barra
exercises.d: Lying on a bench, you raise a barbell from your thighs to above your chest. It builds the front shoulder.
i: Lie on a bench holding a barbell at arm's length over your thighs.
Keep your arms straight with a soft elbow.
Raise the bar in an arc until it is above your chest.
Lower it slowly back down.
Use a light weight and keep your back flat.

exercises.n: elevación frontal acostado con palo
exercises.d: Lying on your back, raise a light stick from your hips to overhead. It helps shoulder mobility.
i: Lie on your back holding a stick with an overhand grip.
Keep your arms straight.
Raise the stick overhead as far as is comfortable.
Return to your thighs slowly.
Keep your ribs down throughout.

exercises.n: estiramiento de cuádriceps de pie
exercises.d: Pull your heel toward your glute while standing to stretch the front of the thigh. It is a classic quad stretch.
i: Stand tall and hold something for balance if needed.
Bend one knee and grab your ankle.
Pull your heel toward your glute, knees together.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs and repeat.

exercises.n: estiramiento de dorsales caminando con las manos
exercises.d: Walk your hands out and sit your hips back to stretch the lats. It opens the sides of the back.
i: Stand and hinge forward to place your hands on the floor.
Walk your hands out in front of you.
Sit your hips back and press your chest down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Walk your hands back in and stand up.

exercises.n: flexión de rodilla abrazada sentado a una pierna con banda elástica
exercises.en: resistance band seated single leg hugging knee flexion
exercises.d: Seated knee flexion with a band under your foot, hugging one knee. It adds resistance to the bend.
i: Sit tall on a chair with a band around one foot.
Hold the band ends in your hands.
Pull the knee up and bend it toward your chest.
Hold for a moment, then release slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: estiramiento de isquiotibiales a media rodilla
exercises.d: From half kneeling, straighten the front leg and lean forward to stretch the hamstring. It lengthens the back of the thigh.
i: Kneel on one knee with the other leg extended, heel on the floor.
Keep your toes pointing up.
Hinge forward from your hips with a flat back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs and repeat.

exercises.n: plancha inclinada con jacks
exercises.d: A plank with hands on a raised surface, jumping your feet in and out like a jumping jack. It builds core and gets the heart rate up.
i: Place your hands on a bench in an incline plank.
Brace your core and keep your body straight.
Jump your feet wide.
Jump them back together.
Keep your hips level and the pace steady.

exercises.n: golpe lateral con banda elástica
exercises.d: A standing band press that sweeps across the body from the side. It builds chest power and trains the trunk to resist rotation.
i: Anchor the band at chest height beside you and hold the handle at your chest.
Stand tall in a stable stance with your core braced.
Press the handle forward and across your body in a quick controlled motion.
Return slowly to your chest without letting the band pull you around.
Keep your hips square throughout.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: atrape de pullover con balón medicinal
exercises.d: A lying throw and catch that sends a medicine ball overhead and back. It trains explosive lat and core strength.
i: Lie on your back with knees bent, holding a medicine ball overhead.
Pull the ball forward over your chest to throw it up toward a partner or wall.
Catch the ball with soft elbows as it returns.
Let it travel back overhead in a controlled arc.
Keep your lower back pressed to the floor.
Repeat at a steady rhythm.

exercises.n: atrape de rotación interna a 90 grados en polea
exercises.d: A cable drill with the upper arm at shoulder height and elbow bent to 90 degrees. It trains the rotator cuff to catch and control a quick rotation.
i: Set the cable at shoulder height and stand sideways to it.
Raise your upper arm out to the side with the elbow bent 90 degrees.
Let the cable pull your forearm back into external rotation.
Catch it, then rotate the forearm forward and down smoothly.
Keep your upper arm still and level.
Complete the reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: atrape de press cerrado acostado en el suelo con balón medicinal
exercises.en: medicine ball lying floor close press catch
exercises.d: A floor press throw with narrow hands. It builds explosive pushing power through the chest and triceps.
i: Lie on your back with knees bent, holding a medicine ball above your chest.
Press the ball up quickly with your hands close together.
Catch it as it comes down with soft elbows.
Lower it to just above your chest.
Keep your back flat and ribs down.
Repeat for controlled, crisp reps.

exercises.n: empuje de cadera con barra
exercises.d: A bench-supported bridge with a barbell across your hips. It is a go-to move for building strong glutes.
i: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and a padded barbell over your hips.
Plant your feet hip-width apart and drive through your heels.
Lift your hips until your torso is level with the floor.
Squeeze your glutes at the top and keep your chin tucked.
Lower your hips under control.
Repeat without arching your lower back.

exercises.n: empuje de cadera a una pierna con barra
exercises.d: A single-leg version of the barbell hip thrust that demands more balance and glute strength on each side.
i: Set your upper back on a bench with a padded barbell over your hips.
Extend one leg or hold it bent in the air.
Drive through the planted heel to lift your hips level.
Squeeze your glute at the top without twisting.
Lower under control.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: empuje de cadera a una pierna con peso
exercises.d: A single-leg hip thrust with weight resting on your hips. It strengthens each glute separately and fixes side-to-side gaps.
i: Rest your upper back on a bench and place the weight on your hips.
Plant one foot and lift the other leg off the floor.
Push through your heel to raise your hips until your torso is level.
Pause and squeeze your glute.
Lower slowly.
Complete the reps, then change legs.

exercises.n: sentadilla sumo con barra
exercises.d: A wide-stance squat with a barbell on your back. It hits the glutes and inner thighs along with the quads.
i: Set the bar on your upper back and stand with feet well wider than your shoulders.
Turn your toes out about 30 degrees.
Brace your core and sit down between your legs.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Descend to thigh level or lower, then push through your heels to stand.
Keep your chest tall.

exercises.n: abdominal completo en banco ghd
exercises.en: glute ham developer full sit up
exercises.d: A full-range sit-up on a glute ham developer. The extended range makes the abs and hip flexors work through a long path.
i: Lock your feet in the machine and sit with your hips on the pad.
Lean back until your torso is in line with or just below your hips.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Curl up until your chest reaches your thighs.
Lower back slowly with a braced core.
Avoid yanking on your neck.

exercises.n: sentadilla sumo
exercises.d: A bodyweight squat in a wide stance with toes turned out. It targets the glutes and inner thighs.
i: Stand with feet wide and toes turned out.
Hold your hands together at your chest.
Sit your hips down and back between your legs.
Keep your knees over your toes and chest upright.
Lower to thigh level.
Push through your heels to stand and squeeze your glutes.

exercises.n: remo inclinado boca abajo en máquina
exercises.d: A chest-supported row on an incline lever machine. The support keeps your back steady so the upper back does the work.
i: Lie chest-down on the incline pad and grab the handles.
Let your arms extend fully.
Pull the handles back, driving your elbows toward your hips.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your head neutral.

exercises.n: elevación de cadera acostado (en balón de estabilidad)
exercises.d: A glute bridge with your feet or upper back on a stability ball. The unstable surface adds a balance challenge.
i: Lie on your back with your heels resting on the stability ball.
Press your arms into the floor for support.
Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower your hips under control.
Keep the ball steady throughout.

exercises.n: flexión explosiva con banda elástica
exercises.d: A push-up with a band across your back and a fast push at the top. It trains explosive chest and triceps power.
i: Loop the band across your upper back and hold the ends under your palms.
Set up in a push-up position with a straight body.
Lower your chest to the floor with control.
Push up hard so your hands briefly leave the floor.
Land softly with elbows slightly bent.
Keep your hips in line.

exercises.n: abducción a una pierna de pie en bosu con banda elástica
exercises.en: band standing on bosu ball single leg abduction
exercises.d: A standing hip abduction on a bosu ball against band tension. It works the outer hip and challenges your balance.
i: Place a band around your ankles and stand on the bosu with one foot.
Hold your core tight and stay tall.
Lift your free leg out to the side against the band.
Pause briefly at the top.
Return slowly without leaning.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: extensión de rodilla acostado en máquina de pilates sobre puntas
exercises.en: pilates machine lying knee extension on toes
exercises.d: Straighten your knees on a reformer with feet on toes. It trains the front thighs.
i: Lie on the carriage with feet on the bar, on your toes.
Bend your knees with a neutral spine.
Press the carriage away until legs straighten.
Return under control.
Keep your hips still.

exercises.n: extensión de rodilla acostado en máquina de pilates
exercises.d: Straighten your knees on a reformer with feet flat. It trains the front thighs.
i: Lie on the carriage with feet on the bar.
Bend your knees.
Press out until legs are straight.
Return slowly.
Keep your lower back stable.

exercises.n: extensión de rodilla acostado en máquina de pilates sobre talones
exercises.en: pilates machine lying knee extension on heels
exercises.d: Straighten your knees on a reformer pressing through the heels. It works the thighs.
i: Lie on the carriage with heels on the bar.
Bend your knees.
Press out through the heels until straight.
Return slowly.
Keep your hips level.

exercises.n: elevación de gemelos acostado en máquina de pilates
exercises.d: Press the carriage with just your toes on a reformer. It builds calf strength.
i: Lie on the carriage with legs straight, balls of feet on the bar.
Press your heels down.
Rise up onto your toes.
Return slowly.
Keep your knees locked softly.

exercises.n: the hundred en máquina de pilates
exercises.d: Pump your arms against the straps while holding your legs up. It builds core endurance.
i: Lie on the carriage holding the straps.
Lift your head and legs.
Pump your arms in small movements.
Breathe in for five counts and out for five.
Continue for 100 pumps.

exercises.n: dominada a un brazo asistida con banda elástica
exercises.en: resistance band assisted single arm pull up
exercises.d: A one-arm pull-up with a band under your foot or knee to reduce the load. It builds toward unassisted single-arm pulling.
i: Loop a band over the bar and place your foot or knee in it.
Hang with one hand on the bar and the other holding your wrist or the band.
Pull your chin toward the bar, driving the elbow down.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control to a full hang.
Switch arms after each set.

exercises.n: dominada a un brazo en anillas asistida con banda elástica
exercises.en: ring resistance band assisted single arm pull up
exercises.d: A band-assisted single-arm pull-up on gymnastic rings. The rings add instability and grip demand.
i: Hang a band from the rings or bar and place your foot in it.
Grip one ring with one hand and hold the other ring loosely or let it go.
Pull your chest toward the ring.
Keep your body tight and avoid swinging.
Lower slowly to a full hang.
Repeat, then switch sides.

exercises.n: dominada rocky con jalón en anillas
exercises.d: A ring pull-up variation where you pull up, then press down toward the hips. It builds pulling strength and shoulder control.
i: Hang from the rings with arms straight and shoulders engaged.
Pull your chest up toward the rings.
At the top, drive the rings down toward your hips.
Pause with your arms close to your sides.
Return to the top, then lower slowly.
Keep your core braced.

exercises.n: skin the cat en anillas
exercises.d: A gymnastic move where you rotate backward through the rings. It builds shoulder mobility and control.
i: Hang from the rings with a firm grip.
Tuck your knees and lift your hips overhead.
Rotate backward, passing your legs between your arms.
Lower your feet toward the floor until you stretch your shoulders.
Pause, then reverse the motion with control.
Move slowly and stop if you feel pinching.

exercises.n: press de planche
exercises.d: An advanced gymnastics skill where you press from a lean into a planche shape. It builds shoulder strength and a strong core.
i: Start in a deep planche lean with hands under your shoulders.
Protract your shoulders and squeeze your glutes.
Lean forward and lift your feet from the floor.
Press into the ground and hold the position.
Lower under control.
Warm up your wrists first.

exercises.n: planche de codos
exercises.d: A planche hold with your elbows tucked into your waist. It is an early step toward a full planche.
i: Place your hands on the floor and tuck your elbows into your waist.
Lean forward over your hands.
Lift your feet off the floor one at a time.
Hold your body level with a tight core.
Keep your shoulders pressed forward.
Lower down after the hold.

exercises.n: remo horizontal de rodillas a un brazo en polea
exercises.en: cable kneeling single arm horizontal row
exercises.d: A one-arm cable row from a kneeling position. Kneeling removes leg drive so your back does the pulling.
i: Set a cable at chest height and kneel facing it.
Hold the handle with one hand and brace your core.
Pull your elbow back along your side.
Squeeze your shoulder blade toward your spine.
Extend the arm slowly.
Complete the reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: remo horizontal de rodillas a un brazo con banda elástica
exercises.en: band kneeling single arm horizontal row
exercises.d: A one-arm band row from a kneeling position. It builds the lats and mid back with simple equipment.
i: Anchor a band at chest height and kneel facing it.
Hold the band with one hand and keep your torso upright.
Pull the elbow back past your ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blade in.
Return slowly against the tension.
Switch arms after the set.

exercises.n: press de pecho inclinado sentado en máquina de placas
exercises.en: lever stack seated incline chest press
exercises.d: A seated press on an incline lever machine with a weight stack. It emphasises the upper chest.
i: Adjust the seat so the handles are at upper-chest height.
Sit back with your feet flat and shoulder blades pinched.
Press the handles forward and up until your arms are almost straight.
Pause briefly.
Return slowly to a stretch across your chest.
Keep your back against the pad.

exercises.n: jalón con brazos rectos en polea v. 3
exercises.d: Pull a cable down with straight arms. It isolates the lats.
i: Stand facing a high pulley and grip the bar.
Hinge slightly forward.
Pull the bar down to your thighs.
Squeeze your lats.
Return slowly.

exercises.n: press de pecho inclinado sentado a un brazo en máquina de placas
exercises.en: lever stack seated incline single arm chest press
exercises.d: A one-arm incline press on a lever machine. Working one side at a time evens out strength differences.
i: Sit on the machine and grab one handle at upper-chest height.
Brace your core to avoid twisting.
Press the handle forward and up.
Pause, then lower slowly.
Keep your shoulder pulled back.
Do all reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: press de pecho sentado en máquina de placas
exercises.d: A seated machine press with a weight stack. It is a stable way to build the chest and triceps.
i: Set the seat so the handles are level with your mid chest.
Sit back and pull your shoulder blades together.
Press the handles forward until your arms are nearly straight.
Pause without locking out.
Return slowly to a gentle chest stretch.
Keep your feet flat.

exercises.n: press de pecho sentado a un brazo en máquina de placas
exercises.en: lever stack seated single arm chest press
exercises.d: A one-arm seated press on a lever machine. It builds the chest on each side and trains the core to resist twisting.
i: Sit with your back against the pad and grip one handle.
Brace your core and keep your torso square.
Press the handle forward in a smooth line.
Pause, then lower slowly.
Keep your shoulder down.
Do the reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: sentadilla con kettlebell
exercises.d: A squat holding a kettlebell at your chest. The weight in front helps you stay upright and use your legs.
i: Hold a kettlebell by the horns at your chest.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit your hips down and back while keeping your chest tall.
Lower until your thighs are parallel or lower.
Push through your heels to stand.
Keep your elbows close to your body.

exercises.n: sentadilla trasera con kettlebell
exercises.d: A squat with a kettlebell held across your upper back. It loads the legs and challenges your trunk.
i: Hold the kettlebell behind your neck on your upper back with both hands.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Brace your core and sit down and back.
Lower to parallel while keeping your chest up.
Drive through your heels to stand.
Keep your elbows pointing down.

exercises.n: salto de sentadilla en landmine
exercises.d: A squat holding a landmine bar at your chest, followed by a jump. It builds explosive leg power.
i: Hold the end of a landmine bar at your chest.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down with a tall chest.
Jump up explosively through your feet.
Land softly with bent knees.
Reset and repeat.

exercises.n: caminata con mochila con peso
exercises.d: Walking with a loaded backpack to add resistance. It builds leg endurance and trunk strength.
i: Put on a backpack and tighten the straps snug.
Stand tall with your shoulders back.
Walk at a steady pace on flat ground.
Take natural strides and breathe evenly.
Keep your core lightly braced.
Walk for 10-30 minutes depending on your fitness.

exercises.n: carrera con mochila con peso
exercises.d: Running with a loaded backpack to raise the effort. It builds endurance and leg strength.
i: Strap a snug backpack with a modest load on your back.
Start with an easy jog on flat ground.
Keep your torso tall and your steps light.
Maintain a pace where you can breathe steadily.
Cut back the load if your form suffers.
Run for 10-20 minutes.

exercises.n: patada trasera en polea v. 3
exercises.d: Extend your arm back against cable resistance. It isolates the triceps.
i: Hinge forward and hold a handle with elbow bent.
Keep your upper arm parallel to the floor.
Extend your arm back.
Squeeze the triceps.
Return slowly and switch sides.

exercises.n: giro en polea v. 3
exercises.d: Rotate your torso against a cable. It works the obliques.
i: Stand sideways to the pulley and hold the handle with both hands.
Keep your arms extended.
Rotate your torso away from the stack.
Return slowly.
Switch sides.

exercises.n: curl de brazos en suspensión
exercises.d: Curl yourself toward the straps while leaning back. It works the biceps.
i: Hold the handles and lean back with arms extended.
Keep your body straight.
Bend your elbows to pull yourself up.
Squeeze the biceps.
Lower slowly.

exercises.n: remo invertido con rodillas flexionadas en suspensión
exercises.d: Row yourself up under straps with knees bent. It builds the back.
i: Lie under the straps and grip the handles.
Bend your knees with feet flat.
Lift your hips and pull your chest toward the handles.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly.

exercises.n: abdominal acostado con disco
exercises.d: Crunch while holding a plate. It works the abs.
i: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Hold the plate on your chest.
Curl your shoulders up.
Pause and squeeze.
Lower slowly.

exercises.n: fondos de pecho en suspensión
exercises.d: Dip between straps. It works the chest and triceps.
i: Support yourself on the straps with arms straight.
Lean slightly forward.
Lower until elbows reach 90 degrees.
Press back up.
Keep the straps steady.

exercises.n: bicicleta acuática
exercises.d: Pedal your legs in the water as if cycling. It raises your heart rate with low impact.
i: Stand in chest-deep water, holding the pool edge.
Lift your knees alternately.
Pedal at a steady rhythm.
Keep your core tight.
Continue for several minutes.

exercises.n: press de pecho en suspensión
exercises.d: Press yourself away from the straps. It works the chest.
i: Face away from the anchor and hold the handles at chest level.
Lean forward in a straight line.
Press your body away.
Squeeze the chest.
Return slowly.

exercises.n: peso muerto rumano con saco de arena
exercises.d: A hip hinge with a sandbag held in front of your thighs. It builds the hamstrings and glutes.
i: Hold a sandbag in front of your thighs with a firm grip.
Stand with feet hip-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and slide the bag down your legs.
Lower until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Keep your back flat.

exercises.n: trepa de cuerda en l sit
exercises.d: A rope climb done with your legs held out in an L shape. It is a tough test for the lats, grip and abs.
i: Grip the rope and hang with your legs raised in front of you.
Keep your legs straight and together.
Pull with one hand over the other while staying in the L position.
Reach up and repeat.
Lower under control.
Stop if your legs drop.

exercises.n: salto de lado a lado sobre el cajón de step
exercises.en: side to side jump over stepbox
exercises.d: A lateral jump back and forth over a step box. It builds agility and leg power.
i: Stand beside a low box with your feet together.
Bend your knees and swing your arms.
Jump sideways over the box.
Land softly on both feet.
Jump back the other way at once.
Keep the pace fast but controlled.

exercises.n: equilibrio a una pierna en tabla de equilibrio
exercises.d: A single-leg stand on a balance board. It trains ankle stability and control.
i: Place a balance board on a flat floor next to a wall for safety.
Step on with one foot and find your centre.
Lift the other foot off the floor.
Hold steady for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your hips level.
Switch legs.

exercises.n: equilibrio a una pierna en almohadilla de equilibrio
exercises.d: A one-legged stand on a foam balance pad. It improves ankle stability and body control.
i: Place the pad on a flat floor.
Step on with one foot and stand tall.
Lift the other foot off the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your eyes on a fixed point.
Switch legs.

exercises.n: elevación alterna de rodillas colgado
exercises.d: A hanging ab move where you lift one knee at a time. It strengthens the lower abs and hip flexors.
i: Hang from a bar with arms straight.
Brace your core and keep your body still.
Lift one knee toward your chest.
Lower it slowly and lift the other knee.
Avoid swinging.
Alternate for the reps.

exercises.n: headbanger
exercises.d: A gentle bending drill that works the back and hips. The motion loosens your spine and posterior chain.
i: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hands behind your head.
Soften your knees.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back.
Nod your head slightly and return to standing.
Move at a smooth pace.
Keep your neck relaxed.

exercises.n: salto al cajón pasando por los brazos
exercises.d: A box jump with a swing-through arm action. It builds explosive power and coordination.
i: Stand facing a sturdy box.
Swing your arms back and bend your knees.
Jump onto the box, driving your arms through.
Land softly with both feet.
Stand tall at the top.
Step down and reset.

exercises.n: estiramiento de tríceps acostado a un brazo
exercises.d: A floor stretch for the back of your upper arm. Lying down lets you relax into it.
i: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Raise one arm and bend the elbow, hand reaching behind your head.
Use your other hand to press the elbow gently toward the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your ribs down.
Switch arms.

exercises.n: apertura en suspensión
exercises.d: Open your arms wide against the straps. It stretches and works the chest.
i: Face away from the anchor, hands at chest level.
Lean forward with arms together.
Open your arms wide.
Pull back together.
Keep your elbows slightly bent.

exercises.n: estiramiento de tríceps acostado a un brazo con palo
exercises.en: stick lying single arm triceps stretch
exercises.d: A triceps stretch on the floor using a stick to deepen the stretch. It opens the back of your upper arm and shoulder.
i: Lie on your back holding a stick in both hands.
Bend one arm and take that hand behind your head.
Use the other hand to push the stick and press that elbow down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your neck relaxed.
Switch arms.

exercises.n: estiramiento de tríceps de pie a un brazo con banda elástica
exercises.en: resistance band standing single arm triceps stretch
exercises.d: A standing triceps stretch with a band assisting. The band helps you ease into a deeper stretch.
i: Stand tall and hold a band behind your back with one hand low.
Raise the other arm overhead and bend the elbow, holding the band.
Gently pull down with the lower hand.
Feel a stretch in the back of the upper arm.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch arms.

exercises.n: deslizamiento acostado a un brazo de y a t
exercises.en: lying single arm slide from y to t
exercises.d: A prone shoulder drill where one arm slides from a Y shape to a T shape. It wakes up the mid back and shoulder blades.
i: Lie face down with your arms overhead in a Y.
Lift one arm slightly off the floor.
Slide it out and down into a T position.
Hold for a moment.
Slide it back to the Y.
Switch arms after each set.

exercises.n: salto al cajón desde rodillas
exercises.d: An explosive move that goes from kneeling straight into a box jump. It trains hip drive and power.
i: Kneel in front of a sturdy box.
Swing your arms back and drive your hips forward.
Pop up from your knees onto your feet.
Jump onto the box in one motion.
Land softly and stand tall.
Step down and reset.

exercises.n: estiramiento de isquiotibiales sentado a una pierna con banda elástica
exercises.en: resistance band seated single leg hamstring stretch
exercises.d: A seated hamstring stretch with a band around your foot. The band lets you control the pull.
i: Sit tall with one leg extended and a band around that foot.
Hold the band ends in both hands.
Keep your leg straight and gently pull your toes toward you.
Hinge forward until you feel a stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.

exercises.n: medio círculo sentado a una pierna
exercises.d: A seated hip mobility drill where you sweep one leg in a half circle. It warms up the hips.
i: Sit tall on the floor with hands behind you for support.
Lift one leg slightly with the knee straight.
Draw a half circle with your foot from one side to the other.
Keep your torso steady.
Repeat for the reps.
Switch legs.

exercises.n: extensión de rodilla sentado a una pierna con banda elástica
exercises.en: resistance band seated single leg knee extension
exercises.d: A seated knee extension against band tension. It isolates the quads one leg at a time.
i: Sit on a bench and secure a band around one ankle.
Anchor the other end behind you.
Straighten your knee against the band.
Squeeze the front of your thigh at the top.
Lower slowly.
Switch legs.

exercises.n: carrera rápida de pies dentro y fuera
exercises.d: Run in place with feet moving in and out quickly. It boosts your heart rate.
i: Stand tall with feet together.
Jog in place.
Quickly move your feet in and out.
Stay light on your toes.
Continue for the set time.

exercises.n: toque de punta de pie a una pierna adelante, atrás y a los lados
exercises.en: standing single leg front back side to side toe tap
exercises.d: Tap your toes in different directions while balancing. It works hip stability.
i: Stand on one leg.
Tap the other toe forward.
Tap to the side, then back.
Keep your balance.
Switch legs.

exercises.n: caminata con patada
exercises.d: Walk while kicking each leg up. It warms the legs.
i: Stand tall.
Step forward and kick the opposite leg up.
Alternate legs.
Swing your arms.
Continue for the set time.

exercises.n: elevación frontal en suspensión
exercises.d: Raise your body with arms in front using straps. It works the front delts.
i: Hold the handles and lean back with arms down.
Keep your body straight.
Raise your arms overhead.
Pause.
Lower slowly.

exercises.n: de rodillas a de pie
exercises.d: A smooth transition from kneeling to standing. It builds leg strength and control.
i: Kneel with your torso upright.
Place one foot forward into a lunge.
Push through that foot to stand.
Bring your back foot to meet it.
Reverse the motion to return to kneeling.
Alternate the lead leg.

exercises.n: salto de gemelos
exercises.d: Jump using only your calves. It builds explosive lower legs.
i: Stand tall.
Keep knees nearly straight.
Jump using your ankles.
Land softly.
Repeat quickly.

exercises.n: curl jefferson con peso corporal
exercises.d: A slow forward bend that rolls through the spine one segment at a time. It builds back and hamstring mobility.
i: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Tuck your chin and roll down one vertebra at a time.
Let your arms hang toward the floor.
Reach only as far as is comfortable.
Reverse slowly to stand.
Move with control and keep the load light.

exercises.n: elevación de rodilla sentado con banda elástica
exercises.d: Seated knee raise against band tension. It works the hip flexors and lower abs.
i: Sit tall on a bench or chair with a band looped around your foot and anchored low.
Hold the seat edge and brace your core.
Lift one knee toward your chest against the band.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower the foot slowly with control.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: salto de gemelos a una pierna
exercises.d: Hopping on one leg using mostly the ankles. It builds calf power and springy ankles.
i: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend and arms relaxed.
Push through the ball of your foot and jump up using mainly your ankles.
Keep the knee nearly straight in the air.
Land softly on the ball of the same foot.
Rebound right away into the next hop.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: salto de gemelos a una pierna con apoyo en cajón
exercises.en: single leg calf jump step box supported
exercises.d: A single-leg calf hop with a step box nearby for balance. It trains ankle power with extra stability.
i: Stand beside a step box and rest a hand lightly on it for balance.
Lift one foot off the floor.
Hop up using mostly your ankle and calf.
Land softly on the ball of your foot.
Keep the hops small and quick.
Switch legs after your set.

exercises.n: salto de gemelos hacia adelante
exercises.d: Small forward hops driven by the calves. They build ankle stiffness and reactive power.
i: Stand tall with feet together and knees slightly soft.
Push off the balls of your feet and hop forward a short distance.
Keep your knees nearly straight.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Hop back or turn around and repeat.
Stay light and quick through the whole set.

exercises.n: salto de gemelos de lado a lado
exercises.d: Quick lateral hops powered by the calves. They improve ankle strength and foot speed.
i: Stand tall with feet together and knees slightly soft.
Spring off your toes and hop to one side.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Immediately hop to the other side.
Keep your chest up and hips level.
Continue alternating for the set.

exercises.n: salto de patinador con balón medicinal
exercises.d: A lateral hop from leg to leg while holding a medicine ball. It trains balance and side-to-side power.
i: Hold a medicine ball at your chest.
Hop sideways onto one leg.
Land softly with a bent knee.
Pause briefly, then push off to the other side.
Keep your chest up.
Alternate for the reps.

exercises.n: caminata con rodillas altas
exercises.d: A walking warm-up where you lift each knee high. It primes the hips and legs.
i: Stand tall with your arms relaxed.
Lift one knee toward your chest.
Step forward and lower it to the floor.
Repeat on the other side.
Keep your torso upright.
Walk 10-20 steps per leg.

exercises.n: corredor de isquiotibiales en suspensión
exercises.d: A hamstring curl with heels in straps, alternating legs like running. It trains the hamstrings and core control.
i: Lie on your back with both heels in the straps and lift your hips.
Press your arms into the floor for balance.
Curl one heel toward your glutes while the other leg extends.
Switch legs in a smooth running rhythm.
Keep your hips high and level.
Continue for the set.

exercises.n: caminata sobre puntas con banda elástica
exercises.d: A walk on your toes with a band around your feet. It builds calf and ankle strength.
i: Place a band around your forefeet or ankles.
Rise onto the balls of your feet.
Walk forward in small controlled steps.
Stay high on your toes.
Keep your hips level.
Walk for 20-30 steps.

exercises.n: caminata lateral sobre puntas con banda elástica
exercises.d: A sideways walk on your toes against band tension. It works calves, ankles and outer hips.
i: Place a band around your ankles.
Rise onto your toes with knees slightly bent.
Step sideways in small steps.
Keep tension on the band.
Do not let your heels drop.
Walk one way, then back.

exercises.n: caminata lateral sobre puntas
exercises.d: A sideways walk on tiptoe. It builds calf strength and ankle stability.
i: Stand tall and rise onto your toes.
Bend your knees slightly.
Step sideways with small controlled steps.
Stay high on your toes.
Keep your hips level.
Walk one way, then return.

exercises.n: curl de pierna sentado a una pierna en máquina (con discos)
exercises.en: lever seated single leg curl (plate loaded)
exercises.d: A one-leg seated hamstring curl on a plate-loaded machine. It builds each hamstring separately.
i: Sit on the machine and set the pad above your ankle.
Hold the handles and keep your back against the seat.
Curl one leg down and back.
Squeeze at the bottom.
Return slowly.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: sentadilla a una pierna acostado en trineo
exercises.d: A single-leg press-like squat on a sled while lying back. It builds leg strength with back support.
i: Lie back on the sled with one foot on the platform.
Hold the handles and brace your core.
Bend your knee and lower the sled toward you.
Stop before your lower back lifts.
Push through your heel to extend the leg.
Do all reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: abducción de cadera en suspensión
exercises.d: Standing leg raise to the side with one foot in a strap. It works the outer hip and stability muscles.
i: Put one foot in a strap and stand tall on the other leg, holding the anchor for balance.
Brace your core.
Sweep the strapped leg out to the side.
Pause briefly at the end.
Bring it back under control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: puente de cadera en suspensión
exercises.d: A glute bridge with heels in straps, which adds an instability challenge. It builds glutes and hamstrings.
i: Lie on your back with your heels in the straps and knees bent.
Place your arms by your sides.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top in a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Lower slowly without touching down.
Repeat for reps.

exercises.n: flexión de cuello acostado
exercises.d: Gentle chin tuck while lying on your back. It strengthens the front neck muscles.
i: Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Relax your shoulders.
Tuck your chin and lift your head slightly off the floor.
Hold for a second.
Lower slowly.
Keep the motion small and smooth.

exercises.n: extensión de cuello acostado
exercises.d: Lying face down, you lift the head slightly to train the back of the neck.
i: Lie face down with your forehead hanging near the edge of a bench or resting just off the floor.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.
Lift your head a few centimeters, keeping your chin slightly tucked.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly.
Use small, controlled reps.

exercises.n: hiperextensión en suspensión
exercises.d: Hip hinge back extension with feet in straps. It strengthens the lower back and glutes.
i: Place your feet in the straps and lie face down, hands behind your head or across your chest.
Brace your core.
Lift your chest by extending your back and hips.
Stop when your body forms a straight line.
Lower slowly.
Avoid overarching at the top.

exercises.n: remo invertido en suspensión
exercises.d: A bodyweight row hanging under straps. It builds the upper back and biceps.
i: Hold the handles and lean back with arms extended and body straight.
Brace your abs and glutes.
Pull your chest toward your hands, driving elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower with control to full arm extension.
Walk your feet forward to make it harder.

exercises.n: navaja en pica en suspensión
exercises.d: From a plank with feet in straps, you pike the hips up. It hits the abs hard and challenges the shoulders.
i: Start in a plank with your feet in the straps and hands under shoulders.
Keep your legs straight.
Lift your hips high toward the ceiling.
Roll to an inverted V shape.
Lower back to plank slowly.
Keep your arms straight throughout.

exercises.n: rotación de muñeca con mancuerna
exercises.d: A forearm drill where you rotate a dumbbell through your palm. It builds wrist and forearm control.
i: Sit with your forearm resting on your thigh or a bench.
Hold a light dumbbell with your palm facing up.
Rotate your forearm so the palm turns down.
Pause, then rotate back.
Move slowly with control.
Switch arms.

exercises.n: salto a una pierna en 4 direcciones v. 2
exercises.d: A balance hop on one leg in four directions. It trains power, balance and ankle stability.
i: Stand on one leg with a soft knee.
Hop forward and land softly.
Hop back to the start, then out to the side and back.
Hop in the fourth direction.
Stick every landing.
Switch legs.

exercises.n: elevación de gemelos a una pierna con piernas divididas
exercises.en: split stance single leg calf raise
exercises.d: A calf raise in a split stance, with most work on the front leg. It trains the calf with balance support.
i: Stand in a split stance, front foot flat and back toes lightly touching the floor.
Keep most weight on the front leg.
Rise onto the ball of the front foot.
Pause at the top.
Lower the heel slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: navaja en suspensión
exercises.d: From a plank with feet in straps, you pull the knees toward the chest. It trains the abs and core control.
i: Start in a plank with your feet in the straps and hands under shoulders.
Brace your core.
Pull your knees toward your chest by rolling your hips up.
Pause briefly.
Extend your legs back to plank.
Keep your shoulders stacked over your hands.

exercises.n: abducción de cadera con rodilla flexionada en equilibrio de pie con banda elástica
exercises.en: resistance band standing balance bent leg hip abduction
exercises.d: A standing hip abduction on one leg with a band. The bent working knee changes the angle.
i: Place a band around your ankles or knees.
Balance on one leg with a soft knee.
Bend the other knee and lift it out to the side.
Keep your torso upright.
Return slowly.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: curl de pierna en suspensión
exercises.d: Hamstring curl with heels in straps while bridging. It works the hamstrings and glutes.
i: Lie on your back with your heels in the straps and legs extended.
Lift your hips off the floor.
Curl your heels toward your glutes.
Keep your hips high.
Extend your legs slowly.
Repeat for reps.

exercises.n: escalador en suspensión
exercises.d: Mountain climbers with feet in straps, which adds instability. It trains the core and conditioning.
i: Start in a plank with your feet in the straps.
Keep your hands under your shoulders.
Drive one knee toward your chest.
Switch legs in a quick running rhythm.
Keep your hips level.
Continue for the set.

exercises.n: rana y círculo de pierna acostado en máquina de pilates
exercises.en: pilates machine lying frog and leg circle
exercises.d: Reformer leg work: frog press followed by circles. It trains the hips and inner thighs with control.
i: Lie on the reformer with your feet in the straps or on the bar.
Bend your knees and open them out, heels together, in a frog shape.
Press your legs straight.
Circle them out, around and back together.
Reverse the circle direction after a few reps.
Keep your back steady on the pad.

exercises.n: carrera acostado en máquina de pilates
exercises.d: Reformer footwork that alternates the legs like running. It trains the calves, quads and glutes.
i: Lie on the reformer with the balls of your feet on the bar.
Straighten both legs.
Lower one heel while bending the other knee.
Alternate smoothly.
Keep your pelvis still.
Maintain steady breathing.

exercises.n: elevación pélvica acostado en máquina de pilates
exercises.d: A reformer bridge that lifts the hips. It strengthens the glutes and hamstrings.
i: Lie on your back with your feet on the bar and knees bent.
Press your arms into the pad.
Lift your hips one vertebra at a time.
Hold at the top.
Roll down slowly.
Keep your ribs relaxed.

exercises.n: apertura lateral en máquina de pilates
exercises.d: A reformer move where you open and close the legs sideways. It works the inner thighs and balance.
i: Stand with one foot on the carriage and one on the platform.
Brace your core.
Slide the carriage out to widen your stance.
Pause.
Draw it back under control with your inner thighs.
Keep your hips square.

exercises.n: sentadilla rusa en máquina de pilates
exercises.d: A reformer squat variation that builds the legs. It focuses on controlled bending and straightening.
i: Set your feet on the carriage and platform.
Stand tall and brace your core.
Bend your knees into a squat.
Keep your chest lifted and knees over toes.
Press back up to standing.
Move with the carriage smoothly.

exercises.n: apertura rusa en máquina de pilates
exercises.d: A reformer split stance with the carriage sliding. It works the legs, glutes and balance.
i: Place one foot on the carriage and one on the platform.
Stand tall with your core braced.
Slide the carriage back while lowering into a split squat.
Pause.
Press back to the start.
Switch sides after your set.

exercises.n: long spine en máquina de pilates
exercises.d: A reformer roll-over that mobilises the spine. It stretches the back and works the abs.
i: Lie on your back with your feet against the shoulder rests.
Press your legs straight up.
Roll your hips off the pad.
Lift your hips over your shoulders.
Roll down slowly one vertebra at a time.
Avoid pressing on your neck.

exercises.n: círculo de brazos en máquina de pilates
exercises.d: A reformer arm circle holding straps. It works the shoulders and the upper back.
i: Lie on your back holding the straps with arms up.
Bend your knees and brace your core.
Lower your arms out to the sides.
Circle them down and up in a smooth arc.
Reverse the direction after a few reps.
Keep your ribs down.

exercises.n: expansión de pecho en máquina de pilates
exercises.d: A reformer move pulling the straps behind you. It opens the chest and works the upper back.
i: Kneel facing the straps with your torso upright.
Hold the straps with straight arms.
Pull the straps back behind your body.
Turn your head gently to each side.
Return slowly to the start.
Keep your chest lifted and ribs down.

exercises.n: overhead en máquina de pilates
exercises.d: Reformer work with straps overhead. It trains the shoulders, abs and posture.
i: Sit or kneel on the carriage holding the straps overhead.
Brace your core.
Press the straps forward and down in a controlled arc.
Return to the overhead position.
Keep your spine tall.
Move smoothly with breath.

exercises.n: curl jefferson con barra
exercises.d: A slow, loaded forward bend that rolls through the spine. Keep the barbell light and the motion smooth.
i: Stand holding a very light barbell in front of your thighs.
Tuck your chin and roll down one segment at a time.
Let the bar hang close to your legs.
Go only as low as feels controlled.
Roll back up slowly.
Keep your knees soft.

exercises.n: elevación lu con mancuernas
exercises.d: A dumbbell raise that lifts the arms out and up in an L to U path. It builds shoulder strength and upper back control.
i: Stand tall holding a light dumbbell in each hand, arms by your sides.
Raise both arms out to the sides until they reach shoulder height, elbows bent to 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearms upward so the dumbbells point to the ceiling.
Pause, then lower back down the same path with control.
Keep your ribs down and avoid shrugging.

exercises.n: elevación de tibial de pie con apoyo en pared
exercises.en: standing floor tibialis raise wall supported
exercises.d: Standing with your back against a wall, you lift your toes off the floor. It strengthens the muscles on the front of the shin.
i: Stand with your back and hips against a wall, feet a little way out in front.
Keep your legs straight and your heels planted on the floor.
Pull your toes up toward your shins as high as you can.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower your toes slowly and repeat.

exercises.n: tirón potente en suspensión
exercises.d: A powerful pull from a long position under the straps. It builds the lats and upper back.
i: Hold the handles with arms straight and lean back.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Pull explosively with your arms and back.
Bring your chest toward your hands.
Lower slowly.
Keep your core tight.

exercises.n: patada lateral hacia atrás en polea
exercises.en: cable side leg kick from back
exercises.d: A standing cable kick that sweeps the leg out and back. It works the outer hip and glutes.
i: Attach an ankle cuff to a low pulley and strap it to one ankle.
Stand side-on to the machine and hold the frame for balance.
Kick the working leg out and slightly behind you, keeping the knee mostly straight.
Pause, then return slowly without letting the weight stack touch down.
Keep your torso still. Finish all reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: hiperextensión inversa con balón con peso en ghd
exercises.en: weighted ball reverse hyperextension on ghd
exercises.d: Reverse hyper on a GHD, with a ball held between your feet. It trains glutes and hamstrings.
i: Lie face down on the GHD with hips at the edge and a ball between your feet.
Hold the pad.
Lift your legs until they line up with your torso.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly.
Do not swing.

exercises.n: peso muerto a una pierna con peso corporal contra balón
exercises.en: bodyweight single leg deadlift against ball
exercises.d: A single-leg hinge with a ball against the wall for balance. It trains hamstrings and balance.
i: Stand facing a wall with a ball between your hand and the wall.
Lift one foot slightly.
Hinge at the hip as the free leg extends back.
Keep your back flat.
Return to standing.
Switch legs after the set.

exercises.n: press de hombros sentado a un brazo con agarre neutro en smith
exercises.en: smith seated single arm neutral grip shoulders press
exercises.d: A one-arm seated press on the smith machine with a neutral grip. It trains the shoulder while the bar path stays guided.
i: Set a bench under the smith bar and sit upright with your back supported.
Hold the bar with one hand in a neutral grip and unhook it.
Press the bar overhead until your arm is almost straight.
Lower it slowly to around chin height.
Keep your torso steady. Finish all reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: subida a cajón alto
exercises.d: Stepping up onto a tall box. It builds the quads and glutes.
i: Stand facing a high box.
Place one foot fully on top.
Drive through that heel to stand up.
Bring the other foot up.
Step down with control.
Switch leading legs.

exercises.n: peso muerto rumano a una pierna en banco con mancuerna
exercises.en: dumbbell single leg romanian deadlift on bench
exercises.d: A single-leg Romanian deadlift with the rear foot on a bench. It targets hamstrings and glutes.
i: Hold dumbbells with your rear foot resting on a bench.
Keep your front knee soft.
Hinge forward at the hips.
Lower the weights along your leg.
Squeeze your glutes to stand up.
Switch legs after the set.

exercises.n: remo inclinado a un brazo en máquina enfocado en dorsales
exercises.en: lever bent over single arm lats focused row
exercises.d: A one-arm machine row done from a bent-over stance. It targets the lats with a strong squeeze.
i: Set the machine and lean forward from the hips with a flat back.
Grip the handle with one hand and let the arm reach forward.
Pull the elbow back and down toward your hip.
Squeeze your lat at the end of the pull.
Return slowly, then switch sides after your reps.

exercises.n: remo inclinado boca abajo con agarre neutro en máquina
exercises.en: lever incline prone neutral grip row
exercises.d: A chest-supported machine row on an incline with a neutral grip. It builds the mid back without loading the lower back.
i: Lie face down on the incline pad with your chest supported.
Grip the neutral handles and extend your arms.
Pull your elbows back past your torso, squeezing the shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment.
Let the handles return slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.n: sentadilla en bosu
exercises.d: Squat standing on a Bosu ball. The unstable surface adds a balance challenge.
i: Stand on the Bosu with feet shoulder width apart.
Hold your arms forward.
Sit your hips back and bend your knees.
Keep your chest lifted.
Stand tall.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.

exercises.n: sentadilla a una pierna en bosu
exercises.d: A single-leg squat on a Bosu ball. It challenges the legs and balance.
i: Stand on one foot on the Bosu.
Extend your arms for balance.
Lower into a controlled squat.
Keep your knee in line with your toes.
Press back up.
Switch legs after the set.

exercises.n: pull through en suspensión
exercises.d: A hip hinge with a strap held between your legs. It trains the glutes and hamstrings.
i: Face away from the anchor, holding the handles between your legs.
Step forward to create tension.
Hinge at the hips and let your hands pass between your legs.
Drive your hips forward.
Stand tall and squeeze your glutes.
Keep your back flat.

exercises.n: caminata de puente de glúteos con banda elástica
exercises.d: A glute bridge held with a band while stepping sideways. It targets glutes and outer hips.
i: Lie on your back with a band above your knees and feet flat.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Step your feet out and in sideways.
Keep the band tight.
Keep your hips high.
Lower after the set.

exercises.n: abdominal con disco (manos sobre la cabeza)
exercises.d: A crunch holding a weight plate overhead. The long lever makes your abs work harder.
i: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Hold a plate with both hands and extend your arms overhead.
Curl your shoulders and upper back off the floor, reaching the plate upward.
Pause at the top and squeeze your abs.
Lower slowly without dropping your head back.

exercises.n: abdominal con mancuerna (manos sobre la cabeza)
exercises.d: A crunch with a dumbbell held overhead. The extra load and long lever challenge your abs.
i: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Hold one dumbbell upright with both hands and extend your arms overhead.
Curl your shoulders off the floor, driving the dumbbell toward the ceiling.
Pause and squeeze your abs.
Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.n: inclinación lateral a 45 grados con disco
exercises.d: A side bend holding a plate, done with the body at a 45 degree angle. It works the obliques.
i: Set up on a 45 degree bench or hyperextension frame, side-on, feet secured.
Hold a plate against your chest.
Lower your torso sideways with control.
Bend back up until your body is in a straight line.
Avoid twisting. Finish your reps and switch sides.

exercises.n: abdominal con disco (manos sobre la cabeza) v. 2
exercises.d: A second take on the overhead plate crunch. It trains the abs with a long, loaded lever.
i: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet planted.
Hold a plate with straight arms overhead.
Crunch up, lifting your shoulder blades off the floor.
Keep your arms by your ears as you rise.
Lower back down slowly and repeat.

exercises.n: abdominal con mancuerna (manos sobre la cabeza) v. 2
exercises.d: A second version of the overhead dumbbell crunch. It builds ab strength with a loaded reach.
i: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Hold a dumbbell at one end with both hands, arms extended overhead.
Crunch up and let the dumbbell travel in an arc toward your knees.
Squeeze your abs at the top.
Lower with control and repeat.

exercises.n: dominada en suspensión
exercises.d: A pull-up using suspension handles. It builds the lats and arms.
i: Hang from the handles with arms extended.
Brace your core.
Pull your chest up between the handles.
Lead with your elbows.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.

exercises.n: flexión pliométrica de rodillas
exercises.d: An explosive push-up from the knees. It builds pressing power.
i: Kneel in a push-up position with hands under shoulders.
Keep a straight line from knees to head.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Push up explosively so your hands leave the floor.
Land softly with bent elbows.
Go straight into the next rep.

exercises.n: salto de puntas en cama elástica
exercises.d: Toe jumps on an elastic bed. It trains calves and ankle bounce.
i: Stand on the elastic bed with feet together.
Rise onto your toes.
Jump using your ankles.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Stay quick and light.
Continue for the set.

exercises.n: abducción acostado con banda elástica
exercises.d: A lying leg lift against a band that works the outer hip. Good for glute and hip stability.
i: Loop a band around both legs just above the knees and lie on your side.
Stack your hips and bend your knees slightly.
Lift the top knee or leg away from the bottom one against the band.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly. Finish your reps and switch sides.

exercises.n: apertura invertida en suspensión
exercises.d: A reverse fly using suspension handles. It trains the rear shoulders and upper back.
i: Hold the handles and lean back with arms extended.
Keep your body straight.
Open your arms out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return slowly.
Do not shrug.

exercises.n: encogimiento a un brazo con mancuerna
exercises.d: A one-arm shrug with a dumbbell. It builds the upper traps and grip.
i: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in one hand at your side.
Keep your arm straight and your shoulders relaxed.
Lift your shoulder straight up toward your ear.
Hold for a moment at the top.
Lower slowly. Finish your reps and switch arms.

exercises.n: dominada excéntrica a un brazo
exercises.d: A slow lowering phase of a one-arm pull-up. It builds the strength needed for the full move.
i: Get into the top position of a pull-up, with one hand on the bar and the other assisting or at rest.
Let go of any help and shift your weight onto the working arm.
Lower yourself as slowly as you can until your arm is straight.
Keep your body tight and avoid swinging.
Step back up to the top and repeat, then switch arms.

exercises.n: dominada a un brazo asistida con banda elástica v. 2
exercises.en: resistance band assisted single arm pull up v. 2
exercises.d: A one-arm pull-up where a band takes some of your body weight. It helps you work toward an unassisted rep.
i: Hang a band from the bar and place a foot or knee in the loop.
Grip the bar with one hand and keep the other arm across your chest.
Pull your chin toward the bar, driving your elbow down.
Pause at the top.
Lower under control. Finish your reps and switch arms.

exercises.n: puente de isquiotibiales v. 2
exercises.d: A bridge with heels planted that emphasises the back of the thighs. Good for the hamstrings and glutes.
i: Lie on your back with knees bent and heels on the floor, a bit further from your hips.
Press through your heels.
Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your hamstrings and glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.n: puente de isquiotibiales con patada v. 2
exercises.d: A hamstring bridge with an added leg extension. It adds a balance challenge for hips and thighs.
i: Lie on your back with knees bent and heels on the floor.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Straighten one leg out in front, keeping hips level.
Bring the foot back to the floor without dropping your hips.
Alternate legs or finish one side first.

exercises.n: sostén de sentadilla dividida con peso corporal
exercises.d: A held split stance that opens the front of the hip and loads the front thigh.
i: Step one foot far forward and the other back into a split stance.
Lower your hips until the front knee is bent to about 90 degrees.
Keep your torso upright and your front heel down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily.
Rise up and switch legs.

exercises.n: sostén de media sentadilla dividida con peso corporal
exercises.d: A half split position that stretches the back of the front leg while you sit back on the rear leg.
i: Kneel on one knee with the other leg extended in front, heel on the floor.
Sit your hips back toward the rear heel.
Keep the front leg straight and your back long.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.

exercises.n: círculo de pie sentado a una pierna
exercises.d: Seated ankle circles on one leg. They loosen the ankle and warm up the lower leg.
i: Sit tall on a chair and lift one foot slightly off the floor.
Keep your lower leg still.
Draw slow circles with your toes, as wide as is comfortable.
Do half your reps clockwise, then switch to counterclockwise.
Repeat on the other foot.

exercises.n: círculo de pies sentado
exercises.d: Circling both feet while seated. A simple way to mobilise the ankles.
