i: Sit tall on a chair with both feet lifted off the floor.
Keep your knees still.
Circle both feet in the same direction, as wide as feels comfortable.
Reverse the direction after several turns.
Keep your breathing relaxed.

exercises.n: rodillo abdominal en suspensión
exercises.d: A rollout using suspension handles. It challenges the abs and shoulders.
i: Kneel holding the handles close to your chest.
Brace your core.
Push your arms forward as you lean out.
Keep your back flat.
Pull back to the start.
Do not let your hips sag.

exercises.n: movimiento de pie de lado a lado sentado a una pierna
exercises.en: seated single leg foot side to side
exercises.d: A seated ankle move that sweeps the foot from side to side. It improves ankle mobility.
i: Sit tall and lift one foot slightly off the floor.
Keep your lower leg still.
Turn your foot inward, then outward, in a smooth motion.
Move through a comfortable range.
Repeat for your reps, then switch feet.

exercises.n: apretar los dedos de los pies sentado
exercises.d: Curling and squeezing the toes while seated. It wakes up the small muscles of the feet.
i: Sit on a chair with both feet flat on the floor.
Curl all your toes down as if gripping the floor.
Squeeze for a couple of seconds.
Relax and spread your toes wide.
Repeat smoothly.

exercises.n: apretar los dedos de los pies sentado a una pierna
exercises.d: A one-foot toe curl while seated. It trains the muscles under the foot.
i: Sit on a chair and place one foot flat on the floor.
Curl your toes down and squeeze.
Hold for a second or two.
Relax and spread the toes.
Finish your reps, then switch feet.

exercises.n: elevación de pierna acostado a una pierna
exercises.d: A lying leg raise on one leg. It strengthens the thigh and hip flexors.
i: Lie on your back with one knee bent and that foot flat.
Straighten the other leg and tighten the thigh.
Raise it to the height of your bent knee.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly. Finish your reps and switch legs.

exercises.n: cuarto de sentadilla con peso corporal
exercises.d: A shallow squat that goes only a quarter of the way down. Good for beginners and for warm-ups.
i: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Push your hips back and bend your knees a short way.
Keep your chest up and heels down.
Press through your feet to stand tall.
Repeat at a steady pace.

exercises.n: sostén de peso muerto a una pierna con peso corporal
exercises.d: A one-legged hinge held at the bottom. It builds balance and the hamstrings.
i: Stand on one leg with a soft knee.
Hinge forward from the hips as the other leg extends behind you.
Keep your back flat until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor.
Hold for several seconds, hips level.
Return upright and switch legs.

exercises.n: peso muerto a una pierna con toque de pie y peso corporal
exercises.en: bodyweight single leg deadlift toe touch
exercises.d: A single-leg hinge where you reach to touch your toes. It trains balance and the hamstrings.
i: Stand on one leg with a soft knee.
Hinge forward as the free leg lifts behind you.
Reach your hands toward the toes of the standing foot.
Keep your back flat and hips square.
Stand back up with control. Finish your reps and switch legs.

exercises.n: press de tibial sentado a una pierna v. 2
exercises.en: seated single leg tibialis press v. 2
exercises.d: A gentle seated press that engages the shin muscle. Useful for ankle control.
i: Sit on a chair with one foot flat and the other crossed over it.
Press the top foot up against the resistance of the bottom foot.
Feel the front of your shin work.
Hold for a second.
Relax and repeat, then switch feet.

exercises.n: apretar los dedos de los pies sentado a una pierna v. 2
exercises.en: seated single leg squeezing toes v. 2
exercises.d: Another one-foot toe squeeze while seated. It strengthens the small muscles in the foot.
i: Sit with one foot flat on the floor.
Curl your toes down and hold the squeeze.
Keep your heel planted.
Release and spread your toes.
Do all reps, then switch feet.

exercises.n: movimiento de pie de lado a lado sentado a una pierna v. 2
exercises.en: seated single leg foot side to side v. 2
exercises.d: A second version of the side-to-side seated foot move for ankle mobility.
i: Sit tall and lift one foot a little off the floor.
Keep your leg still.
Sweep the foot to the inside, then to the outside.
Keep the motion smooth and pain free.
Repeat, then switch feet.

exercises.n: press de dedos de los pies sentado a una pierna
exercises.d: Pressing the toes into the floor while seated. It activates the foot and calf muscles.
i: Sit on a chair with one foot on the floor.
Lift your heel slightly and press your toes into the floor.
Hold briefly.
Lower your heel again.
Finish your reps, then switch feet.

exercises.n: sostén de extensión de rodilla sentado a una pierna con banda elástica
exercises.en: resistance band seated single leg knee extension hold
exercises.d: A seated band-resisted knee extension that you hold at the top. It builds quad endurance.
i: Sit on a chair with a band anchored around one ankle behind you.
Straighten that knee against the band.
Hold the leg straight for 10-20 seconds.
Keep the thigh tight and your back upright.
Lower slowly and switch legs.

exercises.n: estiramiento de talón de aquiles de pie hacia atrás
exercises.d: A standing stretch for the back of the lower leg and the Achilles area.
i: Stand facing a wall and step one foot back.
Keep the back heel down and the knee slightly bent.
Lean forward until you feel the stretch low in the calf.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.

exercises.n: salto de dos a una pierna
exercises.d: A jump taking off from two feet and landing on one. It builds power and landing control.
i: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Dip into a quarter squat and swing your arms back.
Jump up and land on one foot.
Absorb the landing with a bent knee and hold steady.
Reset and alternate landing legs.

exercises.n: cuarto de sentadilla con deslizamiento en la pared de pie (sostén)
exercises.en: standing wall slide quarter squat hold
exercises.d: A wall-supported quarter squat that you hold. It gently loads the thighs.
i: Stand with your back against a wall and feet slightly forward.
Slide down until your knees bend about a quarter of the way.
Keep your back flat to the wall.
Hold for 15-30 seconds.
Slide back up.

exercises.n: press con deslizamiento hacia adelante de pie con toalla
exercises.en: standing forward slide press with towel
exercises.d: A towel slid forward along a wall that presses the arm out. It builds gentle shoulder control.
i: Stand facing a wall and place a towel under your hand against it.
Keep your elbow bent and the hand at chest height.
Slide the towel forward as your arm straightens.
Slide it back slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: deslizamiento de serrato en la pared de pie con toalla
exercises.en: standing wall serratus slide with towel
exercises.d: A towel slide up the wall that works the muscle along the ribs. It supports healthy shoulder blade motion.
i: Stand facing a wall with a towel under your forearm on the wall.
Keep your elbow bent and your body upright.
Slide your arm upward along the wall.
Reach the top without shrugging.
Slide back down slowly and switch arms.

exercises.n: deslizamiento de rotación interna de pie con toalla
exercises.en: standing internal rotation slide with towel
exercises.d: A towel slide that rotates the shoulder inward. It works the rotator cuff gently.
i: Stand side-on to a wall with a towel under your forearm.
Bend your elbow to 90 degrees against your side.
Slide your hand across your body along the wall.
Return slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: fondos de pecho autoasistidos en suspensión
exercises.d: A chest dip with your feet on the floor for help. It builds the chest and triceps.
i: Hold the handles with arms straight and feet on the floor.
Lean your chest forward.
Lower your body by bending your elbows.
Use your legs for light help.
Press back up.
Keep your shoulders down.

exercises.n: deslizamiento de rotación externa de pie con toalla
exercises.en: standing external rotation slide with towel
exercises.d: A towel slide that rotates the shoulder outward. It strengthens the back of the shoulder.
i: Stand side-on to a wall with a towel under your forearm.
Keep your elbow at 90 degrees, tucked at your side.
Slide your hand outward along the wall.
Return slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: rotación externa detrás de la espalda de pie con toalla
exercises.en: standing external rotation behind back with towel
exercises.d: Holding a towel behind your back to rotate the shoulder outward. It improves shoulder control.
i: Stand tall holding a towel behind your back with both hands.
Keep the lower hand still and pull the upper hand away.
Rotate the upper shoulder outward.
Hold briefly and release.
Finish your reps, then switch hands.

exercises.n: estiramiento de hombro detrás de la espalda con toalla
exercises.en: shoulder stretch behind the back with towel
exercises.d: A towel stretch behind the back that opens the shoulder.
i: Hold a towel with one hand over your shoulder and the other behind your lower back.
Gently pull the towel upward with the lower hand.
Keep your chest open and neck relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

exercises.n: rotación externa acostado de lado
exercises.d: A light side-lying rotation for the back of the shoulder. Often used for shoulder stability.
i: Lie on your side with your top elbow bent to 90 degrees against your ribs.
Hold your forearm across your stomach.
Rotate your forearm upward without moving your elbow.
Lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: rotación externa de hombro acostado de lado con peso corporal
exercises.en: bodyweight side lying shoulder external rotation
exercises.d: A side-lying outward shoulder rotation with no weight. It trains rotator cuff control.
i: Lie on your side with a small towel under the top elbow.
Bend the elbow to 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm up toward the ceiling.
Pause, then lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: movilización de hombro con palo en abducción detrás de la espalda
exercises.en: stick shoulder mobilization in abduction behind back
exercises.d: Using a stick to guide the arm out and back behind you. It improves shoulder range.
i: Stand tall holding a stick behind your back.
Hold it with one hand low and the other high.
Use the low hand to guide the top arm out and up.
Move only in a comfortable range.
Return slowly and switch sides.

exercises.n: rotación de hombro con palo sobre la cabeza
exercises.d: Passing a stick overhead and around the body. It opens up the shoulders.
i: Hold a stick with a wide grip in front of your thighs.
Raise it overhead with straight arms.
Continue the arc behind your back as far as comfortable.
Return along the same path.
Narrow your grip over time.

exercises.n: rotación de hombro de pie en la pared
exercises.d: Rotating the shoulder against a wall. It gives gentle mobility and awareness.
i: Stand facing a wall and place your forearm against it.
Bend your elbow to 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm up and down against the wall.
Keep your shoulder relaxed.
Switch arms after your reps.

exercises.n: dominada autoasistida en suspensión
exercises.d: A pull-up using your legs for help. It builds back and arms.
i: Hold the handles with feet on the floor.
Lean back.
Pull your chest toward your hands.
Use your legs for light help.
Lower slowly.
Keep your core tight.

exercises.n: balanceo en dominada escapular
exercises.d: A scapular pull-up with a gentle swing. It builds shoulder blade control and grip.
i: Hang from a pull-up bar with straight arms.
Pull your shoulder blades down without bending your elbows.
Swing your body forward and back in a small arc.
Keep the motion controlled.
Lower to a full hang and repeat.

exercises.n: balanceo de bíceps con brazos rectos y mancuernas
exercises.d: Swinging the dumbbells with straight arms to load the biceps. A shoulder and arm builder.
i: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand, palms forward.
Keep your arms nearly straight.
Swing the dumbbells forward and up in a controlled arc.
Lower them back down.
Keep your torso still and avoid momentum.

exercises.n: fondos de tríceps autoasistidos en suspensión
exercises.d: A triceps dip with your feet on the floor for help. It trains the triceps.
i: Hold the handles with arms straight and feet on the floor.
Keep your torso upright.
Bend your elbows to lower.
Use your legs for light help.
Press back up.
Keep your elbows close.

exercises.n: sostén de flexión con brazos largos en anillas
exercises.en: ring long arms push up hold
exercises.d: A push-up hold on rings with arms fully extended. It demands shoulder stability and core tension.
i: Set the rings low and take a plank with your hands on them.
Keep your arms straight and rings close to your sides.
Squeeze your glutes and abs.
Hold for 15-30 seconds.
Lower to the floor to rest.

exercises.n: elevación de piernas en l sit
exercises.d: A raise from an L-sit position. It builds strong abs and hip flexors.
i: Sit on the floor with your hands on parallettes or flat beside you.
Press down to lift your hips.
Extend your legs in front of you.
Raise your legs higher and lower them back to the L position.
Keep your arms straight and shoulders down.

exercises.n: rotación externa de hombro en suspensión
exercises.d: External rotation using straps. It strengthens the rotator cuff.
i: Hold the handles with elbows bent at 90 degrees.
Lean back slightly.
Rotate your forearms outward and upward.
Keep your elbows by your sides.
Return slowly.
Keep the motion small.

exercises.n: inclinación lateral en suspensión
exercises.d: A side bend using a strap. It works the obliques.
i: Hold a handle and stand sideways to the anchor.
Brace your core.
Bend sideways away from the anchor.
Return to upright using your side muscles.
Do all reps, then switch sides.
Keep your hips still.

exercises.n: hiperextensión con mancuerna v. 2
exercises.d: Back extension holding a dumbbell. It trains the lower back and glutes.
i: Set the pad at hip height and hold a dumbbell at your chest.
Lower your torso with a flat back.
Lift until you are in a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes.
Lower slowly.
Do not overextend.

exercises.n: puente lateral en suspensión
exercises.d: A side plank with your feet in the straps. It strengthens the obliques and stabilisers.
i: Lie on your side with feet in the straps and your elbow below your shoulder.
Lift your hips.
Hold a straight line.
Breathe steadily.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

exercises.n: salto al cajón con mancuernas
exercises.d: A box jump holding dumbbells. It builds explosive leg power.
i: Stand in front of a sturdy box holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Dip into a quarter squat and swing your arms back.
Jump onto the box, landing softly with bent knees.
Stand tall on top.
Step down carefully and reset.

exercises.n: salto al cajón desde rodillas con mancuernas
exercises.d: Starting kneeling, you jump onto a box holding dumbbells. A very explosive move.
i: Kneel in front of a box holding dumbbells at your sides.
Swing your arms and drive up to your feet.
Jump onto the box, landing softly.
Stand tall.
Step down carefully and reset to kneeling.

exercises.n: tuck planche en paralelas bajas
exercises.d: A hold on parallettes with knees tucked and hips lifted. It builds shoulder and core strength.
i: Place your hands on parallettes and squat down.
Lean forward over your hands, arms straight.
Lift your feet with knees tucked toward the chest.
Hold for a few seconds, rounding your upper back slightly.
Lower your feet gently.

exercises.n: sentadilla dividida a una pierna en suspensión (autoasistida)
exercises.en: suspension single leg split squat (self assisted)
exercises.d: A split squat holding the handles for help. It trains the legs and balance.
i: Hold the handles and place your back foot behind you.
Stand tall.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Use your arms for light help.
Press up through your front heel.
Switch legs.

exercises.n: caminata de cangrejo hacia adelante y atrás
exercises.d: A walk on hands and feet facing up. It works the arms, glutes and core.
i: Sit with hands behind you and feet flat, then lift your hips.
Keep your chest open and hips high.
Walk forward with alternating hands and feet.
Then walk backward the same way.
Keep your core braced.

exercises.n: negativa de pino con apoyo en pared a tuck planche
exercises.en: wall assisted handstand to tuck planche negative
exercises.d: Lowering from a wall handstand into a tuck planche. It builds advanced shoulder strength.
i: Kick up into a handstand with your heels on the wall.
Brace your core and keep your arms straight.
Slowly lower your body forward.
Tuck your knees as you reach the planche position.
Control the descent and then reset.

exercises.n: sostén de pino con piernas divididas a una pierna de cara a la pared
exercises.en: wall facing single leg split handstand hold
exercises.d: A wall-facing handstand with one leg split off the wall. It trains balance and shoulder endurance.
i: Kick up into a handstand facing the wall.
Keep your arms straight and push the floor away.
Lift one leg off the wall.
Hold for 10-20 seconds with control.
Return the leg and come down safely.

exercises.n: sentadilla dividida a una pierna en suspensión
exercises.d: A split squat with the rear foot in a strap. It builds the front leg and balance.
i: Put your rear foot in the strap and step forward.
Stand tall.
Lower your hips, back knee down.
Keep your front knee over your foot.
Press up.
Switch legs.

exercises.n: cruce de brazos y pecho afuera sentado en silla
exercises.en: seated arm crossover and chest out on a chair
exercises.d: A seated stretch that crosses the arms and then opens the chest. It loosens the upper body.
i: Sit tall on a chair.
Cross your arms in front of your chest and hug yourself.
Open your arms wide and push your chest out.
Hold the open position for 5-10 seconds.
Repeat.

exercises.n: sentadilla a una pierna en suspensión
exercises.d: A single-leg squat holding the handles for balance. It builds leg strength.
i: Hold the handles and stand on one leg.
Extend the other leg forward.
Sit back and lower.
Keep your knee over your toes.
Stand up.
Switch legs.

exercises.n: elevación de cadera con espalda baja despegada del suelo
exercises.en: hip lift low back off floor
exercises.d: A lying move where you lift the hips so the lower back leaves the floor. It targets the lower abs.
i: Lie on your back with legs raised toward the ceiling.
Press your arms into the floor.
Lift your hips so your lower back comes off the floor.
Lower slowly with control.
Avoid swinging.

exercises.n: elevación frontal con agarre supino y mancuernas
exercises.d: A front raise with palms facing up. It targets the front of the shoulders.
i: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Keep your elbows slightly soft.
Raise your arms in front of you to shoulder height.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and avoid leaning back.

exercises.n: dominada escapular v. 2
exercises.d: Hang from a bar and move only your shoulder blades. It builds the shoulder control you need for solid pull-ups.
i: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, arms straight.
Let your shoulders relax up toward your ears.
Pull your shoulder blades down and together to lift your body a few centimetres.
Keep your elbows locked straight the whole time.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly back to the full hang.

exercises.n: press de hombros a media rodilla a un brazo con mancuerna
exercises.en: dumbbell half kneeling single arm shoulder press
exercises.d: A one-arm overhead press from a half kneeling stance. It trains the shoulder while the position challenges your balance and core.
i: Kneel on one knee with the other foot flat in front, and hold a dumbbell at shoulder height.
Brace your core and squeeze the glute of the kneeling leg.
Press the dumbbell straight overhead until your arm is extended.
Lower it under control back to your shoulder.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: press de hombros de rodillas a un brazo con mancuerna
exercises.en: dumbbell kneeling single arm shoulder press
exercises.d: A one-arm overhead press done on both knees. The kneeling position takes the legs out so your shoulder and core do the work.
i: Kneel on both knees with your hips tall and hold a dumbbell at shoulder height.
Brace your abs and keep your ribs down.
Press the dumbbell overhead until your arm is straight.
Lower it slowly back to your shoulder without leaning sideways.
Complete your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: curl de pierna con cadera recta en suspensión
exercises.d: A leg curl with your hips kept straight. It works the hamstrings.
i: Lie on your back with heels in the straps.
Lift your hips into a straight line.
Curl your heels toward you.
Keep your hips high.
Extend slowly.
Repeat.

exercises.n: fondos de tríceps en suspensión
exercises.d: A dip with suspension handles. It trains the triceps.
i: Hold the handles with arms straight.
Keep your body upright.
Lower by bending your elbows.
Keep your elbows close.
Press back up.
Stay controlled.

exercises.n: extensión de tríceps en suspensión v. 2
exercises.d: A triceps extension leaning on straps. It isolates the triceps.
i: Hold the handles and lean forward.
Keep your elbows bent and by your head.
Straighten your arms.
Keep your body straight.
Return slowly.
Keep your elbows still.

exercises.n: abducción acostado
exercises.d: A side-lying leg raise that targets the outer hip. It is a simple way to strengthen the muscles that keep your pelvis steady.
i: Lie on your side with your legs straight and stacked.
Rest your head on your lower arm and keep your hips stacked.
Lift your top leg up and slightly back without rolling your torso.
Pause at the top, then lower with control.
Finish your reps, then roll over and do the other side.

exercises.n: abducción sentado con rodillas flexionadas
exercises.d: Seated, you press your knees outward. It trains the outer hips.
i: Sit tall with your knees bent and feet on the floor.
Place your hands on your outer knees.
Press your knees outward against your hands.
Hold briefly.
Release slowly.
Keep your back straight.

exercises.n: abducción sentado con rodillas flexionadas y pies sin tocar el suelo
exercises.en: seated bent knee abduction feet floor off
exercises.d: Seated knee abduction with the feet lifted. It trains the outer hips and core.
i: Sit tall and lift your feet off the floor.
Hold the seat edge.
Open your knees outward.
Pause.
Close slowly.
Keep your back straight.

exercises.n: giro en suspensión
exercises.d: From a plank with feet in straps, you twist the hips side to side. It trains the obliques.
i: Start in a plank with your feet in the straps.
Keep your arms straight.
Rotate your hips to one side.
Return to centre.
Rotate to the other side.
Keep your shoulders steady.

exercises.n: abducción sentado con rodillas flexionadas y pies sin tocar el suelo con banda elástica
exercises.en: resistance band seated bent knee abduction feet floor off
exercises.d: Seated knee abduction against band resistance with feet lifted. It trains the outer hips.
i: Sit tall with a band around your thighs and feet off the floor.
Hold the seat edge.
Open your knees against the band.
Pause.
Close slowly.
Keep your back straight.

exercises.n: extensión de tríceps cruzada alta de pie con agarre neutro en polea
exercises.en: cable standing high cross neutral grip triceps extension
exercises.d: A triceps pushdown with the cable set high and the handles crossed, using a neutral grip. It isolates the back of the arm.
i: Set both pulleys high and stand in the middle, holding the handles with palms facing in.
Cross your hands in front of your chest with elbows tucked to your sides.
Press the handles down and out until your arms are straight.
Squeeze your triceps for a moment.
Let the handles rise back slowly without moving your elbows.

exercises.n: empuje de cadera con piernas escalonadas en smith
exercises.d: A hip thrust on the Smith machine with a staggered stance. It builds the glutes.
i: Sit with your upper back on a bench and the bar over your hips.
Stagger your feet, one slightly ahead.
Drive through your heels.
Lift your hips to full extension.
Squeeze your glutes.
Lower slowly and switch the stance.

exercises.n: empuje de cadera con piernas escalonadas en máquina (con discos)
exercises.en: lever staggered stance hip thrust (plate loaded)
exercises.d: A plate-loaded machine hip thrust with a staggered stance. It targets the glutes.
i: Sit in the machine with the pad over your hips.
Stagger your feet.
Drive through your heels.
Lift your hips fully.
Squeeze your glutes.
Lower slowly and switch the stance.

exercises.n: peso muerto sumo con cinturón en máquina (barra v)
exercises.d: A sumo deadlift on a belt squat style lever machine holding a V bar. It loads the legs and hips with less strain on the back.
i: Stand wide on the platform with toes angled out and grip the V bar.
Sit your hips back, chest up, and keep your arms straight.
Push through your heels to stand fully upright.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower under control, letting your knees track over your toes.

exercises.n: retracción escapular sentado en máquina (con discos)
exercises.d: A seated machine move where you pull your shoulder blades together. It strengthens the muscles between your shoulder blades.
i: Sit with your chest against the pad and grab the handles with straight arms.
Let your shoulder blades spread forward slightly.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together without bending your elbows.
Hold the squeeze for a second.
Return slowly to the start.

exercises.n: retracción escapular sentado en polea
exercises.d: A seated cable move that trains your shoulder blades to pull back. It helps posture and builds the mid back.
i: Sit at a low cable station, feet braced, and hold the handle with straight arms.
Sit tall and let your shoulder blades stretch forward.
Pull your shoulder blades together, keeping your arms straight.
Hold the squeeze briefly.
Return slowly to the start.

exercises.n: peso muerto rumano con cadera apoyada y mancuernas
exercises.d: A Romanian deadlift with your hips supported against a surface. It teaches a clean hip hinge and loads the hamstrings.
i: Stand with your hips lightly against the support, holding dumbbells in front of your thighs.
Soften your knees and keep your back flat.
Push your hips back and slide the dumbbells down your legs.
Stop when you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.

exercises.n: patada trasera de rodillas en banco con banda elástica
exercises.en: resistance band kneeling leg kickback on bench
exercises.d: Kneeling on a bench, you kick one leg back against band tension to work the glutes.
i: Anchor the band and loop it around one foot, then kneel on a bench with hands on the front.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Kick the working leg back and up until the hip is fully extended.
Squeeze the glute for a moment at the top.
Lower slowly under control without letting the band yank your leg.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: navaja con giro en suspensión
exercises.d: From a plank with feet in the straps, you pull the knees toward one side of the chest, which hits the abs and obliques hard.
i: Set your feet in the straps and get into a straight-arm plank.
Keep your shoulders stacked over your hands.
Pull both knees toward your chest, twisting them toward one elbow.
Pause briefly, then extend the legs back to plank.
Alternate sides each rep.
Keep your hips from sagging as you return.

exercises.n: face pull con rotación externa en polea
exercises.en: cable face pull with external rotation
exercises.d: A face pull that finishes with a rotation of the arms. It hits the rear shoulders and rotator cuff for healthy shoulders.
i: Set a rope at upper chest height and hold it with both hands, arms extended.
Pull the rope toward your face with elbows high.
At the end, rotate your fists upward so your hands finish above your elbows.
Squeeze your rear shoulders for a second.
Reverse the rotation and return slowly.

exercises.n: elevación lateral en y en suspensión
exercises.d: Leaning back on the straps, you pull your arms up into a Y shape to train the shoulders and upper back.
i: Hold the handles and lean back with arms straight and body in a line.
Keep your core tight and feet planted.
Raise your arms up and out until they form a Y overhead.
Pause at the top without shrugging.
Lower slowly back to the start.
Step your feet forward to make it harder.

exercises.n: abducción acostado con mancuerna sobre el pecho
exercises.en: dumbbell over the chest lying abduction
exercises.d: A side-lying hip abduction while you hold a dumbbell over your chest. It trains the outer hips and adds a core challenge.
i: Lie on your side with legs stacked and hold a dumbbell over your chest with both hands.
Keep your hips stacked and core braced.
Raise your top leg without rotating your torso.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control, finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: curl de brazos a las orejas en suspensión
exercises.d: You curl your body up toward your hands with the straps at head height, a bodyweight biceps builder.
i: Hold the handles with palms up and lean back with arms extended.
Keep your body straight from head to heels.
Bend your elbows and pull your hands toward your ears.
Keep elbows high and out to the sides.
Squeeze the biceps at the top.
Lower with control until the arms are straight.

exercises.n: zancada hacia atrás con alcance y giro de brazo
exercises.d: A reverse lunge with an overhead reach and a twist. It warms up the legs, hips and spine together.
i: Stand tall with your arms by your sides.
Step one leg back into a lunge and reach both arms overhead.
Twist your torso toward the front leg.
Untwist, then push through your front foot to stand.
Alternate legs for the set.

exercises.n: estiramiento en split con rodado de columna
exercises.d: A seated straddle position with a rolling spine movement. It loosens your back and inner thighs.
i: Sit on the floor with your legs spread wide in a comfortable split.
Sit tall and reach your arms forward.
Round your spine and roll down slowly, one segment at a time.
Roll back up slowly until you are upright.
Repeat for 8-10 slow reps without forcing the stretch.

exercises.n: agarre de bíceps en suspensión
exercises.d: A strap curl where you hold the contraction close to the head, great for biceps peak work and arm control.
i: Grab the handles palms up and lean back with arms straight.
Keep your body rigid.
Curl yourself up, drawing the hands in beside your head.
Hold the top position for a second and squeeze.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
Walk your feet closer to make it easier.

exercises.n: elevación negativa de front lever
exercises.d: An advanced hanging move where you lower slowly toward a front lever. It builds serious core and lat strength.
i: Hang from a bar and pull your body up so your hips and legs are above you.
Straighten your body and keep your arms locked.
Lower slowly toward a horizontal position, keeping your body in a straight line.
Stop when you cannot hold the line, then bend your knees to come back up.
Rest and repeat for a few careful reps.

exercises.n: elevación de pies a la barra colgado a un brazo
exercises.en: single arm hanging toes to bar
exercises.d: A hanging core move done from one hand. Lifting your toes to the bar trains the abs and grip.
i: Hang from a bar with one hand and keep your shoulder active.
Brace your core and keep your legs together.
Lift your toes up toward the bar.
Lower your legs slowly without swinging.
Finish your reps, then switch hands.

exercises.n: landmine 180° de rodillas
exercises.d: A kneeling rotational move with a landmine bar, swinging it in a wide arc side to side. It builds strong, rotating abs.
i: Kneel facing the landmine and hold the end of the bar with both hands in front of your chest.
Keep your hips squared and core tight.
Swing the bar in an arc to one side by rotating your torso.
Swing across to the other side in a controlled sweep.
Keep a steady rhythm for the set.

exercises.n: peso muerto 2 3 con barra
exercises.d: A deadlift variation with a two-thirds range of motion. It is a good way to drill the lower, hardest part of the lift.
i: Stand with your feet hip width and the bar over your mid foot.
Grip the bar, brace your core, and keep your back flat.
Push the floor away and stand up.
Lower the bar back toward the floor under control.
Reset each rep and keep your back neutral.

exercises.n: gato y vaca sentado en silla
exercises.en: sitting cat cow stretch on a chair
exercises.d: A gentle spinal stretch you can do on a chair. It moves your back through flexion and extension to ease stiffness.
i: Sit tall on a chair with your hands on your knees and feet flat.
Inhale, arch your back and lift your chest.
Exhale, round your spine and tuck your chin.
Move slowly between the two positions.
Repeat for 8-10 breaths.

exercises.n: sierra corporal en suspensión
exercises.d: From a forearm plank with feet in the straps, you rock your body back and forth like a saw to challenge the core.
i: Place your feet in the straps and set up on your forearms.
Brace your abs and keep your body straight.
Shift your body backward by pushing through the forearms.
Rock forward past the starting point in a short controlled motion.
Keep your hips level, do not let your lower back arch.
Continue for the planned reps or time.

exercises.n: press de pecho con agarre cerrado en suspensión
exercises.d: A narrow-hand push on the straps that shifts work toward the triceps and inner chest.
i: Hold the handles close together and lean forward with arms straight.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Lower your chest between the handles, elbows tucked close.
Pause when your chest is near your hands.
Press back up until the arms are straight.
Move your feet back to increase difficulty.

exercises.n: abdominal en suspensión
exercises.d: From a plank with feet in the straps, you pull the knees in and curl the hips up, a direct ab move.
i: Put your feet in the straps and set a straight-arm plank.
Keep shoulders over hands.
Pull your knees toward your chest while rounding your spine slightly.
Squeeze your abs at the top.
Extend your legs back to plank slowly.
Avoid dropping the hips as you return.

exercises.n: face pull en suspensión
exercises.d: A strap row to the face with elbows high that targets the rear shoulders and upper back.
i: Hold the handles with palms facing in and lean back.
Keep your body straight and arms extended.
Pull the handles toward your forehead, elbows flaring high.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
Lower slowly to full arm extension.
Do not let your hips drop.

exercises.n: flexión en pino en suspensión
exercises.d: An advanced inverted press with hands on the straps, working the triceps and shoulders strongly.
i: Set the straps low and place your hands in the handles in a pike position.
Kick or walk your feet up into an inverted position with a tight core.
Bend your elbows to lower your head between the handles.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your body steady, using a wall or spotter if needed.
Come down carefully when finished.

exercises.n: flexión inclinada en suspensión
exercises.d: A push-up with the hands in the straps and the body angled upward, a gentler version that builds the chest.
i: Hold the handles and walk your feet back so your body is at a slant.
Keep your body straight and core tight.
Lower your chest to the handles by bending the elbows.
Keep elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press up to straight arms.
Walk your feet back to make it harder.

exercises.n: sentadilla con salto en suspensión
exercises.d: Holding the straps for balance, you squat and jump explosively to build leg power.
i: Hold the handles with slightly bent arms and stand tall.
Lower into a squat with your chest up.
Drive through your feet and jump up.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and sink into the next squat.
Use the straps for balance only.
Keep knees tracking over toes.

exercises.n: zancada hacia atrás cruzada en suspensión
exercises.d: A rear lunge where the back leg crosses behind the front one, hitting the glutes and outer hips.
i: Hold the handles and stand facing the anchor.
Step one leg back and across behind the other.
Lower until the front thigh is near parallel.
Keep your chest tall and front knee over the ankle.
Push through the front heel to stand.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: remo medio en suspensión
exercises.d: A strap row to mid-chest height that works the upper back and arms using your body weight.
i: Grip the handles and lean back with arms straight.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Pull your chest toward your hands, elbows close by.
Squeeze the shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
Step forward to ease the load.

exercises.n: flexión con escalador en suspensión
exercises.d: A hard conditioning move combining a push-up with mountain climber knee drives while the feet sit in the straps.
i: Place your feet in the straps and set up in a high plank.
Do one push-up, keeping your body straight.
Drive one knee toward your chest, then the other.
Alternate legs in a steady rhythm.
Keep your hips level.
Repeat the sequence for the set.

exercises.n: rodillo oblicuo en suspensión
exercises.d: Rolling out on the straps with a slight side angle, you hit the obliques and deep core.
i: Hold the handles kneeling or standing, arms in front.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Roll forward and angle your arms toward one side.
Go only as far as you can hold a flat back.
Pull back to the start using your abs.
Alternate sides each rep.

exercises.n: curl de bíceps a un brazo en suspensión
exercises.d: You curl yourself up with one arm holding a single strap, a tough unilateral biceps move.
i: Hold one handle palm up and lean back at an angle.
Keep your feet planted and body straight.
Bend the elbow and pull your body toward your hand.
Squeeze the biceps at the top.
Lower slowly to a straight arm.
Finish your reps and switch arms.

exercises.n: press de pecho a un brazo en suspensión
exercises.d: A single-arm push on one strap that trains the chest while the core fights rotation.
i: Hold one handle, lean forward and place your feet wide for balance.
Keep your hips square.
Bend your elbow and lower your chest toward the hand.
Resist twisting at the torso.
Press back to a straight arm.
Do all reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: flexión a un brazo y una pierna en suspensión
exercises.en: suspender one arm leg push up
exercises.d: A push-up with feet in the straps and one hand lifted, building chest strength and total-body stability.
i: Put your feet in the straps and set a plank with one hand on the floor.
Brace your core firmly.
Lower your chest by bending the supporting elbow.
Keep your hips level and avoid twisting.
Press back up.
Complete your reps, then switch hands.

exercises.n: apertura de pie en polea v. 3
exercises.d: A standing cable fly that trains your chest through a wide hugging arc. The constant cable tension keeps the muscle working.
i: Set both pulleys at shoulder height and hold a handle in each hand.
Step forward with a staggered stance and lean slightly.
With soft elbows, bring your hands together in front of your chest.
Squeeze your chest for a moment.
Open your arms slowly until you feel a stretch.

exercises.n: leñador de rodillas en polea v. 3
exercises.d: A kneeling cable chop that works your obliques and core with a diagonal pull.
i: Set the cable high, kneel side-on to it and hold the handle with both hands.
Keep your hips square and your core tight.
Pull the handle diagonally across your body down toward the opposite hip.
Rotate through your torso, not your arms.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: sentadilla con brazos sobre la cabeza en polea v. 3
exercises.d: A squat while holding a cable overhead. It trains the legs and challenges shoulder stability and core control.
i: Set a cable low and hold the handle overhead with straight arms, standing tall.
Brace your core and keep your ribs down.
Squat down by pushing your hips back and bending your knees.
Keep the handle over your head and chest up.
Drive through your heels to stand.

exercises.n: jalón de rodillas en polea v. 3
exercises.d: A straight-arm style pulldown from a kneeling position. It targets the lats without help from your legs.
i: Kneel facing a high pulley and hold the bar or handles with arms extended.
Sit tall with your core braced.
Pull the handle down toward your chest, driving your elbows down.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom.
Let the handle rise back slowly to a full stretch.

exercises.n: apertura invertida de pie en polea v. 3
exercises.d: A standing cable reverse fly aimed at the rear shoulders and upper back. It helps balance all the pressing you do.
i: Set the pulleys at shoulder height and hold the opposite handles, arms crossed.
Stand tall with soft elbows.
Pull your hands apart and back in a wide arc.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly to the crossed start.

exercises.n: zancada lateral en polea v. 3
exercises.d: A side lunge with cable resistance. It builds strength in your hips and thighs through a sideways step.
i: Stand side-on to a low pulley and hold the handle at your chest.
Step wide to the side and sit your hips back.
Keep the other leg straight and your chest up.
Push through the bent leg to return to standing.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: press de banca en polea v. 3
exercises.d: A bench press using cables. The steady tension gives your chest and triceps constant work.
i: Lie on a bench between two low pulleys and hold a handle in each hand at chest level.
Plant your feet and keep your shoulder blades back.
Press the handles up until your arms are straight.
Squeeze your chest at the top.
Lower slowly until you feel a stretch.

exercises.n: remo alto sentado en polea v. 3
exercises.d: A seated row with the handle pulled toward your upper chest. It targets the upper back and rear shoulders.
i: Sit at a cable station with the pulley set high and grab the handles.
Sit tall with your chest up.
Pull the handles toward your upper chest, elbows flaring slightly.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly to full arm extension.

exercises.n: empuje y jalón de pie en polea v. 3
exercises.d: A standing move with one arm pressing while the other rows. It trains pushing and pulling together and tests your core.
i: Stand in a staggered stance between two cables, one handle in each hand.
Brace your core and keep your hips square.
Press one handle forward while pulling the other back toward your ribs.
Reverse the roles slowly.
Alternate sides for the set.

exercises.n: extensión de cadera de pie en polea v. 3
exercises.d: A standing cable kickback that targets the glutes. It teaches you to extend the hip without arching your back.
i: Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley and stand facing the machine, holding on for balance.
Keep your core tight and your torso upright.
Push your working leg straight back.
Squeeze your glute at the top without arching.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: press de pecho a una pierna en suspensión
exercises.d: A strap chest press with one foot lifted, adding a balance challenge to the pressing movement.
i: Hold the handles, lean forward and lift one foot off the floor.
Keep your body straight.
Lower your chest between your hands.
Press back up without letting the hips drop.
Keep the raised leg in line with your body.
Switch legs after your set.

exercises.n: press militar de rodillas en polea v. 3
exercises.d: A kneeling overhead press with cables. The position keeps your legs out of it, so the shoulders do the work.
i: Kneel between two low pulleys and hold the handles at shoulder height.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs.
Press both handles straight overhead.
Lock out without leaning back.
Lower under control to your shoulders.

exercises.n: curl de bíceps de pie en polea (con cuerda) v. 3
exercises.en: cable standing biceps curl (rope attachment) v. 3
exercises.d: A standing curl with a rope on a low cable. The rope lets you turn your hands at the top for a stronger squeeze.
i: Attach a rope to a low pulley and hold it with palms facing each other.
Stand tall with your elbows at your sides.
Curl the rope up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly without swinging your body.

exercises.n: navaja alterna con rodilla flexionada acostado en polea v. 3
exercises.en: cable lying alternating bent leg jackknife v. 3
exercises.d: A lying leg-raise style core move against cable resistance, alternating legs. It hits the lower abs.
i: Lie on your back with your feet attached to a low cable and hands by your sides.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Bring one bent knee toward your chest.
Lower it slowly and switch legs.
Keep a controlled alternating rhythm.

exercises.n: remo a un brazo con rotación en polea v. 3
exercises.en: cable single arm row with rotation v. 3
exercises.d: A one-arm cable row that adds a torso rotation. It trains the back and the twisting muscles of the core.
i: Stand facing a cable at chest height with a single handle in one hand.
Take a staggered stance and brace your core.
Row the handle to your ribs while rotating your torso slightly.
Squeeze your back at the end.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: press de banca inclinado en polea v. 3
exercises.d: A cable press on an incline bench. It shifts the work toward the upper chest with constant tension.
i: Set an incline bench between two low pulleys and hold a handle in each hand.
Plant your feet and pull your shoulder blades back.
Press the handles up and slightly together.
Squeeze your upper chest at the top.
Lower slowly to a comfortable stretch.

exercises.n: flexión de cadera de pie en polea v. 3
exercises.d: A standing cable knee raise that trains the hip flexors. It helps lifting your leg with control.
i: Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley, face away from the machine, and hold on for balance.
Stand tall with your core braced.
Drive your working knee forward and up.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: abducción de cadera de pie en polea v. 3
exercises.d: A standing cable leg raise to the side. It strengthens the outer hip.
i: Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley on the near side and hold something for balance.
Stand tall with your core tight.
Lift your outside leg out to the side.
Pause at the top without leaning.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: aducción de cadera de pie en polea v. 3
exercises.d: A standing cable move where you pull your leg across your body. It works the inner thigh.
i: Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley on the far side and hold something for balance.
Stand tall with your core tight.
Sweep your working leg across in front of the other leg.
Squeeze your inner thigh.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: sentadilla en polea v. 3
exercises.d: A squat holding a cable at the chest. The cable adds load and encourages an upright torso.
i: Hold a cable handle at your chest and stand with feet shoulder width.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Sit down and back until your thighs are about parallel.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your heels to stand.

exercises.n: remo inclinado a un brazo en polea v. 3
exercises.en: cable bent over single arm row v. 3
exercises.d: A bent-over one-arm row with a low cable. It builds the lats and mid back with steady tension.
i: Face a low pulley, hinge forward with a flat back and hold the handle.
Brace your core and keep your hips back.
Row the handle toward your hip.
Squeeze your back at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: dominada en suspensión v. 2
exercises.d: A strap-based pull-up variation that builds the lats and arms, with an angled body you can adjust.
i: Hold the handles overhead and hang with arms straight.
Brace your core.
Pull your chest up toward the handles, elbows down.
Squeeze your back at the top.
Lower slowly to full extension.
Bend your knees or lean back to make it easier.

exercises.n: abdominal de rodillas en polea v. 3
exercises.d: A kneeling cable crunch that loads the abs. You curl your spine to bring your elbows toward your knees.
i: Kneel under a high pulley and hold the rope beside your head.
Keep your hips still.
Curl your torso down, bringing elbows toward your knees.
Squeeze your abs at the bottom.
Return slowly to the upright start.

exercises.n: giro de torso de pie en polea v. 3
exercises.d: A standing cable rotation that trains the obliques. Turn through your torso with your arms staying in front.
i: Stand side-on to a cable set at chest height and hold the handle with both hands.
Keep your arms straight and feet planted.
Rotate your torso away from the machine.
Pause, then return slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: curl de bíceps de pie a press arnold en polea v. 3
exercises.en: cable standing biceps curl to arnold press v. 3
exercises.d: A combo of a biceps curl flowing into an Arnold press with cables. It works arms and shoulders in one fluid move.
i: Hold low cable handles, palms forward, arms down.
Curl the handles up to your shoulders.
Rotate your palms inward as you start to press.
Press overhead, turning your palms forward.
Reverse the move and lower under control.

exercises.n: apertura acostado en polea v. 3
exercises.d: A lying cable fly that stretches and squeezes the chest. The cables keep tension on at the top.
i: Lie on a bench between two low pulleys and hold a handle in each hand over your chest.
Keep a soft bend in your elbows.
Lower your arms out to the sides in a wide arc.
Stop at a comfortable stretch.
Bring the handles back together over your chest.

exercises.n: press de pecho diagonal alterno de pie en polea v. 3
exercises.en: cable standing alternating diagonal chest press v. 3
exercises.d: A standing diagonal cable press done one arm at a time. It trains the chest and challenges your core.
i: Stand in a staggered stance holding a high cable handle in each hand.
Brace your core.
Press one handle forward and down diagonally.
Return slowly and press with the other arm.
Alternate for the set without twisting your hips.

exercises.n: remo en plancha lateral en polea v. 3
exercises.d: A side plank held while you row a cable. It trains the core, shoulders and back at the same time.
i: Set up in a side plank with a low cable handle in your top hand.
Lift your hips so your body is in a straight line.
Row the handle toward your ribs.
Keep your hips high and stable.
Extend slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: curl de pierna a una pierna boca abajo en polea v. 3
exercises.en: cable prone single leg curl v. 3
exercises.d: A lying face-down leg curl on a cable. Training one leg at a time builds the hamstrings evenly.
i: Lie face down with an ankle strap attached to a low cable.
Keep your hips pressed down.
Curl your heel toward your glutes.
Squeeze your hamstring at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: elevación frontal de pie en polea v. 3
exercises.d: A front raise using a low cable. It builds the front of the shoulders with steady tension.
i: Stand facing away from a low pulley, holding the handle between your legs.
Keep your core tight and arm nearly straight.
Raise the handle forward to shoulder height.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: inclinación lateral de pie en polea v. 3
exercises.d: A standing side bend that loads the obliques with a cable. It trains your core to resist and control sideways motion.
i: Stand side-on to a low pulley and hold the handle at your side.
Keep your chest tall.
Bend sideways away from the machine.
Contract your obliques to return upright.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: extensión de tríceps sobre la cabeza de pie a un brazo en polea v. 3
exercises.en: cable standing single arm overhead triceps extension v. 3
exercises.d: A one-arm overhead triceps extension with a cable. The overhead position stretches and works the long head of the triceps.
i: Hold a handle from a low pulley overhead, elbow bent, with your upper arm close to your head.
Brace your core.
Straighten your arm overhead.
Squeeze your triceps at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: flexión en suspensión
exercises.d: A push-up with your hands in unstable straps, making the chest, arms and core work harder.
i: Hold the handles and get into a plank with hands under shoulders.
Keep your body in one line.
Lower your chest between the handles.
Keep the straps steady and elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press up to straight arms.
Do not let the hips sag.

exercises.n: abdominal con brazos rectos en banco ghd
exercises.en: glute ham developer straight arms sit up
exercises.d: A sit-up on a glute ham developer with your arms extended. The longer range makes your abs work harder.
i: Set up on the GHD with your feet secured and hips on the pad.
Extend your arms overhead and lean back.
Curl up, bringing your arms forward.
Reach your torso over your knees.
Lower slowly with control.

exercises.n: salto encogido cruzado
exercises.d: A jump where you tuck the knees and cross the feet in the air, great for conditioning and leg power.
i: Stand tall with feet shoulder width apart.
Jump up and pull your knees toward your chest.
Cross your feet in the air.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Uncross on the next jump, alternating the crossing foot.
Keep a steady quick rhythm.

exercises.n: apertura alterna a un brazo con kettlebell
exercises.d: A lying chest fly with a kettlebell, alternating arms. It trains the chest and challenges your control.
i: Lie on your back holding a kettlebell over your chest in one hand.
Keep a soft bend in your elbow.
Lower the kettlebell out to the side in an arc.
Bring it back over your chest.
Switch hands and alternate.

exercises.n: press de pecho acostado en el suelo con banda elástica
exercises.en: resistance band lying floor chest press
exercises.d: A floor chest press using a resistance band. It trains the chest and triceps with tension that increases at the top.
i: Lie on your back with the band under your upper back and a handle in each hand.
Start with your hands at chest level.
Press your hands straight up until your arms extend.
Squeeze your chest.
Lower slowly back to the start.

exercises.n: zancada lateral a media rodilla con kettlebell
exercises.d: A half kneeling side lunge with a kettlebell. It opens the inner thigh and hips while loading the legs.
i: Start in a half kneeling position holding a kettlebell at your chest.
Straighten the front leg to the side as you shift your weight back.
Feel a stretch in your inner thigh.
Return to the start.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: peso muerto rumano de pie con kettlebell detrás de la espalda
exercises.en: kettlebell standing behind back romanian deadlift
exercises.d: A Romanian deadlift holding a kettlebell behind you. It trains the hamstrings and glutes and reinforces a straight back.
i: Hold a kettlebell behind your back in both hands, feet hip width.
Soften your knees and brace your core.
Push your hips back and hinge forward with a flat back.
Stop when you feel your hamstrings stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.

exercises.n: encogimiento de hombros de pie sobre la cabeza con peso corporal
exercises.d: A shrug done with your arms overhead. It wakes up the upper traps and builds shoulder awareness.
i: Stand tall and raise your arms straight overhead.
Keep your ribs down and core tight.
Shrug your shoulders up toward your ears.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.n: ejercicio de tobillo y cadera de pie
exercises.d: A standing drill that loosens the ankles and hips. It is a good warm-up for squats and lunges.
i: Stand tall with your feet hip width.
Shift your weight onto one foot.
Rotate your ankle and hip through a smooth circle.
Keep your upper body steady.
Do 8-10 slow reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: zancada hacia atrás en suspensión
exercises.d: A reverse lunge with the hands on the straps for balance, working the thighs and glutes.
i: Hold the handles and stand tall, facing the anchor.
Step one leg back and lower into a lunge.
Keep your front knee above the ankle.
Press through the front heel to return.
Use the straps for balance only.
Alternate legs or finish one side first.

exercises.n: apertura invertida despertar en suspensión
exercises.d: A reverse fly on the straps that works the rear shoulders and upper back to improve posture.
i: Hold the handles and lean back with arms straight in front.
Keep your body in a line.
Open your arms wide, pulling the shoulder blades together.
Keep arms slightly bent and level with the shoulders.
Return slowly to the start.
Walk your feet forward to lighten the load.

exercises.n: sentadilla en banco en smith
exercises.d: A squat on the Smith machine to a bench. The bench gives you a consistent depth and a stable path.
i: Set a bench behind you and place the bar on your upper back.
Unrack and step your feet slightly forward.
Sit down until you lightly touch the bench.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your heels to stand.

exercises.n: jalón lateral a un brazo con agarre inverso en máquina (con discos)
exercises.en: lever single arm reverse grip lateral pulldown (plate loaded)
exercises.d: A one-arm pulldown on a plate-loaded machine using an underhand grip. It trains the lats and biceps one side at a time.
i: Sit in the machine and grab one handle with an underhand grip.
Sit tall and brace your core.
Pull the handle down, driving your elbow toward your side.
Squeeze your lat at the bottom.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: zancada lateral cruzada en suspensión
exercises.d: A lunge stepping out to the side and across, with straps for support, training the glutes and inner thighs.
i: Hold the handles and stand tall.
Step one leg out and slightly behind the other, crossing the body.
Sink back into the hip with a flat back.
Push through the working foot to return.
Keep your knee in line with your toes.
Switch sides after your reps.

exercises.n: flexión inclinada con agarre cerrado con silla contra la pared
exercises.en: incline close grip push up with chair against wall
exercises.d: A close grip incline push-up with your hands on a chair. It is a good way to build triceps strength.
i: Brace a chair against a wall and place your hands close together on the seat.
Walk your feet back until your body is in a straight line.
Lower your chest toward the chair, elbows close to your body.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your hips in line.

exercises.n: media sentadilla con deslizamiento en la pared de pie
exercises.d: A half squat with your back sliding against a wall. It builds leg strength with support and good alignment.
i: Stand with your back against a wall and your feet slightly forward.
Slide down until your knees are bent to about 45 degrees.
Keep your back flat on the wall.
Press through your heels to rise.
Repeat for the set.

exercises.n: hiperextensión con disco v. 2
exercises.d: A back extension holding a weight plate. The plate adds resistance for the lower back and glutes.
i: Set up on a hyperextension bench with your feet secured and hold a plate against your chest.
Keep your back straight and body in a line.
Lower your torso with control.
Raise until you are back in a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top without overarching.

exercises.n: zancada lateral en suspensión
exercises.d: Stepping wide to the side while holding the straps works the thighs, glutes and inner legs.
i: Hold the handles and stand with feet together.
Step out wide to one side.
Bend that knee and push your hips back, keeping the other leg straight.
Keep your chest up and heel down.
Push off to return to the start.
Alternate sides.

exercises.n: remo para deltoide posterior a un brazo en suspensión
exercises.en: suspender single arm rear delt row
exercises.d: A one-arm strap row with the elbow flared, aimed at the rear shoulder.
i: Hold one handle and lean back at an angle.
Keep your hips level and free hand on your chest or hip.
Pull the handle toward your shoulder with the elbow flared out.
Squeeze the rear delt at the end.
Lower slowly to a straight arm.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: plancha a una pierna con brazos rectos en suspensión
exercises.en: suspender single leg plank straight arm
exercises.d: A straight-arm plank with feet in the straps and one leg lifted, which challenges core stability.
i: Put your feet in the straps and set a high plank.
Lift one leg slightly higher.
Keep your hips level and body straight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower the leg and switch sides.
Breathe steadily throughout.

exercises.n: plancha a una pierna en suspensión
exercises.d: A forearm plank with feet in the straps and one leg raised, fighting rotation and sag.
i: Place your feet in the straps and rest on your forearms.
Lift one leg a bit higher than the other.
Keep your hips square and abs tight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower and switch legs.
Do not let the lower back arch.

exercises.n: figura de sentadilla a una pierna en suspensión
exercises.d: A one-leg squat holding the straps for support, building leg strength and balance.
i: Hold the handles and stand on one leg, other leg forward.
Sit your hips back and bend the knee.
Lower as far as you can control.
Keep your knee over your toes and chest tall.
Drive through the heel to stand.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: abdominal con incorporación en suspensión
exercises.d: Lying down with your feet in the straps, you sit up to train the abs.
i: Lie on your back with your feet in the straps and knees bent.
Place your hands by your head or across your chest.
Curl your torso up toward your knees.
Squeeze the abs at the top.
Lower back down slowly.
Avoid pulling on your neck.

exercises.n: estiramiento sleeper
exercises.d: A side-lying stretch that opens up the back of the shoulder. Handy for keeping internal rotation smooth.
i: Lie on your side with the bottom arm in front of you, elbow bent to 90 degrees.
Keep your shoulder stacked and the upper arm at chest height.
Use your top hand to gently press the bottom forearm toward the floor.
Stop where you feel a mild stretch at the back of the shoulder.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.n: flexión spiderman en suspensión
exercises.d: A push-up with feet in the straps where one knee drives toward the elbow as you lower.
i: Put your feet in the straps and set a high plank.
Lower into a push-up.
As you descend, bring one knee toward the same elbow.
Press up and extend the leg back.
Alternate sides each rep.
Keep your hips low and steady.

exercises.n: estiramiento de extensores de muñeca
exercises.d: Stretches the muscles on top of the forearm that lift the wrist. Good after typing, climbing or heavy gripping.
i: Extend one arm in front of you with the elbow straight and palm facing down.
Bend the wrist so your fingers point toward the floor.
With your other hand, gently pull the back of the hand toward you.
Keep the stretch mild and your shoulder relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch arms.

exercises.n: apertura dividida en suspensión
exercises.d: A fly on the straps with a split stance, opening the arms to work the shoulders and chest.
i: Hold the handles and step into a split stance leaning forward.
Keep arms slightly bent and hands in front of you.
Open your arms out wide to the sides.
Squeeze at the end of the stretch without shrugging.
Bring the arms back together under control.
Switch the lead leg halfway through.

exercises.n: sprinter en suspensión
exercises.d: You hold the straps and drive the knees like a sprinter, a quick leg and cardio move.
i: Hold the handles and lean slightly forward.
Stand on one leg with the other knee raised.
Drive one knee up as the opposite arm moves.
Switch legs with a quick hop.
Stay on the balls of your feet.
Keep your core tight and pace steady.

exercises.n: sentadilla con brazos sobre la cabeza en suspensión
exercises.d: A squat while holding the straps overhead, working the legs and mobility of the shoulders and torso.
i: Hold the handles overhead with arms straight.
Stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Sit back and down into a squat.
Keep your arms up and chest tall.
Drive through your heels to stand.
Do not let the lower back round.

exercises.n: sentadilla en suspensión
exercises.d: A bodyweight squat where you hold the straps for balance and can lean back for depth.
i: Hold the handles with arms extended.
Stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Sit your hips back and bend your knees.
Lower until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Push through the heels to stand.
Keep your chest tall and knees tracking over toes.

exercises.n: extensión de tríceps sobre la cabeza de pie con agarre neutro en polea
exercises.en: cable standing neutral grip overhead triceps extension
exercises.d: Overhead cable extension with a neutral grip that loads the long head of the triceps through a deep stretch.
i: Attach a rope or neutral handle to a low pulley and face away from the stack.
Hold it overhead with elbows bent and pointing forward, one foot slightly ahead.
Keep your upper arms close to your ears and your ribs down.
Extend your elbows until your arms are straight overhead.
Lower slowly back to a deep stretch and repeat.

exercises.n: rodillo abdominal de pie en suspensión
exercises.d: Standing with the straps, you lean forward and roll out with straight arms, a challenging core move.
i: Hold the handles in front of you and lean forward.
Brace your abs and tuck the pelvis.
Extend your arms overhead as your body leans out.
Stop before your lower back arches.
Pull back to the start with your abs.
Take a smaller range if you need.

exercises.n: plancha estrella en suspensión
exercises.d: A plank with the feet in the straps spread wide like a star, challenging the core and hips.
i: Put your feet in the straps and set a high plank.
Spread your legs wide.
Keep your hips level and body straight.
Brace the abs.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Breathe steadily and do not sag.

exercises.n: subida de escalón (1.º y 2.º peldaño)
exercises.d: A simple stair step-up done on the first and second steps. It builds leg strength and balance using everyday stairs.
i: Stand facing the stairs with your feet hip-width apart.
Place one foot on the first step and push through the heel to climb up.
Continue onto the second step, then step back down in control.
Keep your torso tall and your knee tracking over your toes.
Alternate the leading leg each rep or finish all reps on one side first.

exercises.n: media sentadilla con deslizamiento en la pared de pie (sostén)
exercises.en: standing wall slide half squat hold
exercises.d: A wall-supported half squat held in place to build quad endurance with low joint stress.
i: Stand with your back against a wall and feet about a step in front of you.
Slide down until your knees are bent to about 45-60 degrees.
Keep your back flat on the wall and your knees over your ankles.
Press through your whole foot and breathe steadily.
Hold for 20-45 seconds, then slide back up.

exercises.n: estiramiento de gemelos v. 2
exercises.d: A standing calf stretch variation that lengthens the lower leg muscles and helps ankle mobility.
i: Stand facing a wall and place your hands on it at chest height.
Step one foot back with the heel flat on the floor and the toes pointing forward.
Bend the front knee and lean in until you feel the back calf stretch.
Keep the back leg straight and the heel down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

exercises.n: flexión estrella en suspensión
exercises.d: A push-up with the feet spread in the straps, which adds a big core and hip challenge.
i: Place your feet in the straps spread wide in a high plank.
Keep your core tight.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Keep elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press back up.
Hold the wide leg position the whole set.

exercises.n: abdominal boca arriba en suspensión
exercises.d: Lying on your back with your feet in the straps, you curl the hips up to work the lower abs.
i: Lie on your back with your feet in the straps and legs up.
Place your arms flat on the floor.
Curl your hips up, pulling the knees toward your chest.
Squeeze your abs at the top.
Lower slowly to the start.
Do not swing the legs.

exercises.n: plancha boca arriba en suspensión
exercises.d: A back-facing plank with the heels in the straps that strengthens the glutes, back and core.
i: Lie on your back with heels in the straps.
Press through your heels and lift your hips.
Make a straight line from shoulders to heels.
Squeeze your glutes and keep abs tight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower under control.

exercises.n: flexión con extensión de tríceps en suspensión
exercises.d: Lowering your head toward the handles then pushing out, a strap extension that hammers the triceps.
i: Hold the handles and lean forward with arms straight.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Bend your elbows and lower your forehead between the hands.
Keep elbows pointing forward.
Press back up to straight arms.
Move your feet back for more challenge.

exercises.n: patada de tríceps en suspensión
exercises.d: Leaning forward with the straps, you straighten the elbow behind you to isolate the triceps.
i: Hold the handles and hinge forward with elbows by your sides.
Keep your upper arms still.
Straighten your arms and push them behind you.
Squeeze the triceps at the end.
Bend the elbows slowly to return.
Keep your back flat.

exercises.n: giro lateral en suspensión
exercises.d: From a side-facing plank position with the straps, you twist to hit the obliques.
i: Place your feet in the straps and set a high plank.
Brace your core.
Twist your hips to one side, bringing the knees across.
Return to the center with control.
Twist to the other side.
Keep your shoulders square.

exercises.n: giro hacia arriba en suspensión
exercises.d: You pull the knees up and twist across the body from a plank with the feet in the straps.
i: Put your feet in the straps and set a high plank.
Pull your knees up and rotate them toward one elbow.
Pause and squeeze the obliques.
Extend your legs back to plank.
Repeat to the other side.
Keep your hands firmly planted.

exercises.n: peso muerto rumano a una pierna con cinturón en máquina
exercises.en: lever belt single leg romanian deadlift
exercises.d: A single-leg hip hinge on a belt-loaded lever machine that trains hamstrings and glutes with extra balance support.
i: Fasten the belt and stand on one leg on the platform with a slight knee bend.
Hinge at the hips and push them back as your torso lowers.
Let the free leg extend behind you for balance.
Lower until you feel a hamstring stretch, keeping your back flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall, then switch legs after your reps.

exercises.n: estiramiento de espalda alta en suspensión
exercises.d: Leaning back on the straps with your arms extended, you stretch the upper back and shoulders.
i: Hold the handles and step back so your arms are straight.
Sit your hips back and lower your chest.
Round the upper back gently and push the straps away.
Feel the stretch between the shoulder blades.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Breathe slowly and return.

exercises.n: elevación de gemelos en suspensión
exercises.d: Holding the straps for balance, you rise onto your toes to train the calves.
i: Hold the handles and stand with feet hip width apart.
Keep your body upright.
Rise onto the balls of your feet as high as you can.
Pause and squeeze the calves.
Lower the heels slowly below the start if comfortable.
Use the straps only for balance.

exercises.n: peso muerto a una pierna en suspensión
exercises.d: A one-leg hip hinge with the straps for balance, training the hamstrings and glutes.
i: Hold the handles and stand on one leg.
Soften the standing knee.
Hinge at the hip as the other leg extends behind you.
Keep your back flat and hips square.
Squeeze the glute to stand back up.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: péndulo en suspensión
exercises.d: Lying or planking with the feet in the straps, you swing the legs side to side like a pendulum to train the obliques.
i: Put your feet in the straps and set a high plank.
Brace your core.
Swing your legs together to one side.
Swing back through the center to the other side.
Keep the movement slow and controlled.
Keep your shoulders stable.

exercises.n: curl de pierna acostado a hiperextensión inversa en máquina
exercises.en: lever lying leg curl to reverse hyperextension
exercises.d: A combo move on a lever machine: curl the legs up, then lift the hips and legs to work hamstrings and glutes together.
i: Lie face down on the machine with the pads behind your lower legs.
Curl your heels toward your glutes, then lower with control.
Move into the reverse hyperextension position with the pad behind your legs.
Squeeze your glutes to raise your legs until they line up with your torso.
Lower slowly and avoid swinging.

exercises.n: sentadilla búlgara unilateral desde déficit en smith
exercises.en: smith unilateral bulgarian split squat from deficit
exercises.d: A Bulgarian split squat on a Smith machine with the front foot raised, giving extra depth for quads and glutes.
i: Set the bar on your upper back and stand with the front foot on a low plate or step.
Place the rear foot on a bench behind you.
Lower straight down until the front thigh is about parallel or deeper.
Keep your torso upright and the front knee tracking over the toes.
Push through the front heel to stand, then switch legs.

exercises.n: elevación lateral de pierna de pie con banda elástica
exercises.en: resistance band standing side leg raise
exercises.d: Standing, you lift one leg out to the side against band tension, working the outer hips.
i: Loop the band around your ankles or above the knees and stand tall.
Hold onto something for balance if needed.
Lift one leg out to the side with a straight knee.
Pause at the top without leaning.
Lower slowly.
Finish your reps and switch legs.

exercises.n: bisagra de cadera en suspensión
exercises.d: Holding the straps, you hinge the hips back and forth to train the glutes and hamstrings.
i: Hold the handles with arms straight and feet hip width apart.
Soften your knees.
Push your hips back with a flat back.
Lean on the straps for balance.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Squeeze the glutes at the top.

exercises.n: extensión de cadera de pie con banda elástica
exercises.d: Standing, you extend one leg behind you against band tension to work the glutes.
i: Loop the band around your ankles or secure it low, and stand tall.
Hold a support for balance.
Keep your core tight.
Kick one leg straight back without arching the back.
Squeeze the glute at the end.
Return slowly, then switch legs.

exercises.n: caminata sobre glúteos
exercises.d: Sitting on the floor with legs extended, you shuffle forward on your glutes to warm up the hips and work the glutes.
i: Sit on the floor with legs straight and arms crossed.
Lean back slightly.
Shift your weight to one side and swing the other hip forward.
Alternate sides to walk forward.
Keep your torso upright.
Walk back to reverse.

exercises.n: extensiones torácicas acostado sobre rodillo de espuma
exercises.en: lying thoracic extensions on foam roller
exercises.d: Lying over a foam roller, you gently arch the upper back to open up the thoracic spine.
i: Lie on your back with the roller under your upper back.
Support your head with your hands.
Keep your hips on the floor and knees bent.
Gently lean back over the roller.
Return to neutral and shift the roller up or down.
Move slowly and breathe out as you extend.

exercises.n: estiramiento lateral con tirantes
exercises.d: Using the straps for support, you sink into a wide side stance to stretch the inner thighs.
i: Hold the handles and step your legs wide.
Shift your weight to one side and bend that knee.
Keep the other leg straight.
Sit back into the stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

exercises.n: zancada de abducción con tirantes
exercises.d: A side lunge with the straps for balance, working the outer hips and legs.
i: Hold the handles and stand tall.
Step out wide to one side.
Bend that knee and push the hips back.
Keep your chest up and the other leg straight.
Push off to return.
Alternate sides.

exercises.n: burpee
exercises.d: A full-body move: squat, kick back to a plank, push-up, jump up. It builds endurance and strength.
i: Comienza de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros.
Baja el cuerpo hacia una posición de sentadilla flexionando las rodillas y colocando las manos en el suelo frente a ti.
Lleva los pies hacia atrás de una patada hasta una posición de flexión de brazos.
Realiza una flexión de brazos, manteniendo el cuerpo en línea recta.
Salta con los pies de vuelta a la posición de sentadilla.
Salta hacia arriba explosivamente, llevando los brazos por encima de la cabeza.
Aterriza suavemente y baja de inmediato a una posición de sentadilla para comenzar la siguiente repetición.

exercises.n: remo (en máquina de remo)
exercises.d: Steady rowing on an indoor machine for full-body cardio conditioning.
i: Sit on the machine, strap in your feet and grab the handle with straight arms.
Push through your legs first, then lean back slightly.
Pull the handle to your lower ribs with elbows close.
Reverse the order: arms out, hips hinge, then knees bend to slide forward.
Keep a smooth rhythm for 10-30 minutes at a comfortable pace.

exercises.n: press militar de pie con barra
exercises.d: A strict standing overhead press with a barbell. It builds shoulder and triceps strength.
i: Unrack the bar at shoulder height, hands just outside your shoulders.
Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and squeeze your glutes.
Press the bar straight up, moving your head slightly back then through.
Lock out overhead with the bar over your mid-foot.
Lower the bar back to your collarbone with control.

exercises.n: elevación de piernas acostado
exercises.d: A floor exercise that raises straight legs to hit the lower abs.
i: Lie on your back with legs straight and hands under your hips.
Press your lower back gently into the floor.
Lift your legs together until they point at the ceiling.
Lower them slowly, stopping just above the floor.
Keep your back from arching throughout.

exercises.n: elevación de gemelos en smith v. 2
exercises.d: Calf raise under a Smith machine bar, working the calves with a fixed bar path for stable loading.
i: Set the bar on your shoulders and stand with the balls of your feet on a step.
Keep your knees almost straight and your torso upright.
Lower your heels for a full stretch.
Rise onto your toes as high as you can.
Pause at the top, then lower under control.

exercises.n: abducción de cadera acostado de lado con banda elástica
exercises.en: resistance band side lying hip abduction
exercises.d: Lying on your side, you lift the top leg against band resistance to work the outer hip.
i: Lie on your side with the band around your thighs or ankles.
