Keep your legs straight and stacked.
Lift the top leg up without rolling backward.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.
Finish reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: contracción estática de cuádriceps (isométrica)
exercises.d: Seated or lying with your leg straight, you tighten the thigh muscle and hold, an easy way to activate the quads.
i: Sit or lie with one leg straight in front.
Relax your upper body.
Tighten the front of the thigh and press the knee down.
Hold for 5-10 seconds.
Relax fully.
Repeat, then switch legs.

exercises.n: contracción estática de glúteos (isométrica)
exercises.d: Squeezing the glutes and holding without moving, a simple way to activate the hips.
i: Lie on your back or stand with your body relaxed.
Squeeze both glute muscles together.
Keep your legs and back still.
Hold the squeeze for 5-10 seconds.
Release fully.
Repeat for several reps.

exercises.n: salto pogo a una pierna
exercises.d: Small, springy hops on one leg that build calf and ankle stiffness, elasticity and balance.
i: Stand on one leg with a soft knee and your arms relaxed at your sides.
Hop straight up by pushing through the ball of your foot, keeping the knee almost straight.
Land softly on the ball of the same foot and rebound right away.
Keep your hops small and quick, with your hips level and your core tight.
Hop for the planned time or reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: elevación en W en el suelo
exercises.d: A prone raise that moves the arms into a W shape to strengthen the muscles between the shoulder blades.
i: Lie face down with arms bent and elbows out to the sides.
Rest your forehead lightly on the floor.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together and lift your arms and chest slightly.
Form a W shape with your arms and hold for a second.
Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.n: estiramiento de gemelos con rodilla flexionada
exercises.d: A calf stretch with a bent back knee that targets the deeper soleus muscle near the Achilles tendon.
i: Stand facing a wall with hands on it and one foot back.
Bend both knees, keeping the back heel flat on the floor.
Lean forward until you feel a stretch low in the back calf.
Keep your hips square and chest up.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

exercises.n: press militar de pie con barra (sin rack)
exercises.d: A strict overhead press where you clean or lift the bar to your shoulders without a rack.
i: Lift the barbell from the floor to your collarbone using a safe clean or deadlift and curl.
Set your feet hip-width apart with hands just outside your shoulders.
Brace your core and glutes.
Press the bar straight overhead to full lockout.
Lower to your collarbone under control and repeat.

exercises.n: elevación de gemelos sentado a una pierna en silla
exercises.en: seated single leg calf raise on a chair
exercises.d: A seated one-leg calf raise that mainly hits the soleus using only your body weight.
i: Sit on a chair with one foot flat on the floor, knee bent to 90 degrees.
Lift the other foot off the floor or tuck it behind.
Press through the ball of the working foot and raise your heel.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: movilización de rótula sentado
exercises.d: Gentle kneecap sliding while seated that loosens the tissue around the knee and warms up the front of the thigh.
i: Sit tall on a chair or bench with one leg extended and the thigh muscle relaxed.
Place your fingertips or the heel of your hand on the edges of your kneecap.
Gently glide the kneecap side to side and up and down in small, slow motions.
Keep the quad relaxed and stay in a comfortable range with no sharp pain.
Move for 30-60 seconds, then switch legs.

exercises.n: deslizamiento del nervio ciático
exercises.d: A seated nerve glide that alternates straightening the leg and moving the head to ease the back of the leg and improve mobility.
i: Sit tall at the edge of a chair with your hands on the seat or resting in your lap.
Slowly straighten one knee while you lower your chin toward your chest.
Bend the knee back down while you lift your head and look up.
Keep the motion smooth and gentle, never forcing into a strong stretch or tingling.
Repeat for 10-15 slow reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: contracción de glúteos de pie
exercises.d: A simple standing contraction that wakes up the glutes and helps you feel them working before heavier lifts.
i: Stand tall with your feet hip width apart and your arms relaxed.
Tighten your abs lightly so your ribs stay stacked over your hips.
Squeeze your glutes together as hard as you comfortably can.
Hold for 3-5 seconds without leaning back or tucking your hips excessively.
Relax fully, then repeat for 10-15 reps.

exercises.n: bajada de rodilla sentado
exercises.d: A seated hip opener that lets one knee drop to the side to loosen the hips and inner thighs.
i: Sit tall on the floor or a bench with the soles of your feet together or one leg crossed in.
Let one knee drop slowly out to the side toward the floor.
Keep your back straight and your chest lifted as the knee lowers.
Pause briefly at the end of the comfortable range, then lift the knee back up.
Repeat for 8-12 reps per side.

exercises.n: caminata en el sitio en hidroterapia
exercises.d: Gentle walking in place in chest-deep water, a low-impact way to move the legs and raise your heart rate.
i: Stand in waist-to-chest-deep water with your feet hip width apart.
Lift one knee up in front of you, then lower it and lift the other.
Swing your arms naturally and keep your posture tall.
Walk at a relaxed, steady pace without leaning forward.
Continue for 2-5 minutes at an easy to moderate effort.

exercises.n: zancada inversa con disco sobre la cabeza
exercises.d: A reverse lunge while holding a plate overhead, which trains the legs and challenges shoulder and core stability.
i: Hold a weight plate overhead with straight arms.
Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot back and lower until both knees are about 90 degrees.
Keep your ribs down and the plate stable over your head.
Push through the front foot to return, then alternate legs.

exercises.n: salto con zancada
exercises.d: An explosive lunge jump where you switch legs in the air. It builds power and conditioning.
i: Start in a split stance with a slight lunge dip.
Drop down and jump up powerfully.
Switch leg positions in mid-air.
Land softly in a lunge with the other leg in front.
Keep your torso upright and repeat at a steady pace.

exercises.n: estiramiento dinámico de pecho (masculino)
exercises.d: A dynamic chest stretch, swinging the arms out and across the chest. It loosens the chest and shoulders.
i: Ponte de pie con la espalda recta y los pies separados a la altura de los hombros.
Extiende los brazos hacia los lados, paralelos al suelo.
Lleva lentamente los brazos hacia adelante, cruzándolos frente al cuerpo.
Siente el estiramiento en los músculos del pecho.
Mantén el estiramiento durante 10-30 segundos.
Vuelve a la posición inicial y repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: estiramiento abdominal boca abajo
exercises.d: A face-down stretch that lengthens the abdominals, similar to a cobra position.
i: Lie face down with your hands under your shoulders.
Press up slowly, straightening your arms as far as is comfortable.
Keep your hips on the floor and relax your glutes.
Look forward and feel the stretch along your belly.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then lower down.

exercises.n: estiramiento de ingle sentado
exercises.d: A seated butterfly-style stretch for the inner thighs.
i: Sit tall on the floor and bring the soles of your feet together.
Hold your feet or ankles and let your knees fall out.
Keep your back straight and chest lifted.
Lean forward slightly from the hips until you feel a stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and breathe slowly.

exercises.n: hiperextensión a 45 grados a una pierna (brazos frente al pecho)
exercises.en: 45 degree one leg hyperextension (arms in front of chest)
exercises.d: A single-leg back extension on a 45 degree bench that trains the glutes, hamstrings and lower back one side at a time.
i: Set the pad under your hips and hook one foot under the roller, with the other leg lifted off.
Cross your arms over your chest and keep your body in a straight line.
Lower your torso toward the floor with a flat back.
Raise back up by squeezing your glute until your body is level, without overarching.
Complete all reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: hiperextensión a 45 grados con giro
exercises.d: A back extension on a 45 degree bench with a rotation at the top that adds work for the obliques and lower back.
i: Position yourself on the bench with your ankles under the pads and your hips just off the edge.
Cross your arms over your chest and lower your torso with a flat back.
Raise your torso back up, squeezing your glutes.
At the top, rotate your upper body gently to one side, then return to center.
Alternate sides each rep and keep the movement slow and controlled.

exercises.n: dominada en cuerda con peso corporal
exercises.d: A pull-up done hanging from ropes, which adds a big grip challenge to the vertical pull.
i: Hang from two ropes with arms straight and legs together.
Brace your core and pull your shoulder blades down.
Pull yourself up until your hands reach chest or chin level.
Keep your elbows pointing down and close.
Lower under control to a full hang.

exercises.n: remo invertido en cuerda con peso corporal
exercises.d: A horizontal row hanging under rope handles that works the back and grip.
i: Set ropes at about waist height and lie under them, holding the ends.
Keep your body straight from heels to head, heels on the floor.
Pull your chest toward your hands, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Keep your elbows close to your body.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.n: press de potencia sobre la cabeza de pie con piedra con peso
exercises.en: weighted stone standing power overhead press
exercises.d: A strongman-style overhead press with a heavy stone, using a small leg drive for power.
i: Lift the stone to your chest, hugging it close.
Stand with feet hip-width apart and brace your core.
Dip slightly and drive up through your legs.
Press the stone overhead to full lockout.
Lower it back to your chest with control.

exercises.n: flexión pliométrica v. 2
exercises.d: An explosive push-up variation where your hands leave the floor, building upper-body power.
i: Start in a high plank with hands under your shoulders.
Lower your chest toward the floor with control.
Explode upward so your hands leave the ground.
Land softly with slightly bent elbows.
Reset your body line and repeat.

exercises.n: apertura invertida inclinada con pecho apoyado en máquina (con discos)
exercises.en: lever incline chest supported reverse delt fly (plate loaded)
exercises.d: A chest-supported reverse fly on a plate-loaded lever machine that isolates the rear delts.
i: Sit with your chest against the incline pad and grab the handles.
Start with arms forward and slightly bent.
Sweep your arms out and back in a wide arc.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the end.
Return slowly without letting the weight crash.

exercises.n: flexión asistida con peso
exercises.d: A push-up with extra load and assistance so you can adjust difficulty while keeping good form.
i: Get into a plank with hands under your shoulders and load placed on your upper back.
Brace your core and keep your body in a straight line.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up until your elbows are straight.
Use the assistance as needed to keep every rep clean.

exercises.n: press de banca inclinado con agarre abierto e inverso y barra
exercises.en: barbell incline wide reverse grip bench press
exercises.d: An incline bench press with a wide underhand grip that emphasizes the upper chest.
i: Lie on an incline bench and grip the bar wide with palms facing you.
Unrack and hold the bar over your upper chest.
Lower it to the upper chest with elbows slightly tucked.
Press back up to lockout.
Use a spotter, as this grip is less stable.

exercises.n: flexión diamante (de rodillas)
exercises.d: An easier knee version of the diamond push-up that targets the triceps with hands close together.
i: Kneel on the floor and place your hands under your chest, thumbs and fingers forming a diamond.
Keep your body straight from knees to head.
Lower your chest toward your hands, elbows close.
Press up until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight throughout.

exercises.n: zancada con inclinación hacia delante con mancuernas
exercises.d: A lunge with a forward torso lean that shifts more of the load onto the glutes and hamstrings.
i: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand tall with your feet hip width apart.
Step forward with one foot and lean your chest slightly forward with a flat back.
Lower until both knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Push through the front heel to return to standing.
Alternate legs or finish all reps on one side before switching.

exercises.n: elevación frontal inclinada con mancuernas
exercises.d: A front raise performed lying on an incline bench to reduce swinging and isolate the front delts.
i: Lie face down or back on an incline bench holding dumbbells.
Start with your arms hanging or in front of you.
Raise the weights forward to shoulder height with straight arms.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly under control.

exercises.n: remo inclinado en smith (pecho apoyado)
exercises.d: A chest-supported row on the Smith machine that takes stress off the lower back.
i: Set an incline bench under the bar and lie chest down on it.
Grip the bar just wider than shoulder width.
Pull the bar toward your lower ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.n: curl inclinado sentado en polea
exercises.d: A curl on an incline seat with cable resistance for a deep, constant-tension biceps stretch.
i: Set a bench to incline and place a low pulley behind you.
Sit back with your arms hanging and grab the handles.
Curl the handles toward your shoulders, keeping elbows back.
Squeeze the biceps at the top.
Lower slowly to a full stretch.

exercises.n: press de pecho de pie a un brazo con agarre supino en polea
exercises.en: cable standing single arm supinated grip chest press
exercises.d: A standing one-arm press with a palm-up grip that works the chest and tests core stability.
i: Set a cable at chest height and hold the handle with a palm-up grip.
Stand facing away in a staggered stance.
Press the handle forward until your arm is straight.
Keep your torso still and resist twisting.
Return slowly and switch arms after your reps.

exercises.n: press martillo acostado con mancuernas v. 2
exercises.d: A bench press with dumbbells held in a neutral grip that is easier on the shoulders.
i: Lie on a bench holding dumbbells with palms facing each other.
Start with the weights above your chest.
Lower them to the sides of your chest, elbows slightly tucked.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your feet planted and shoulder blades pinched.

exercises.n: elevación de gemelos de pie a una pierna con mancuerna
exercises.en: dumbbell standing single leg calf raise
exercises.d: A one-leg calf raise holding a dumbbell for a challenging calf workout.
i: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and stand on one foot on a step.
Hold a wall or rail with your other hand for balance.
Lower your heel to a full stretch.
Press up onto your toes as high as possible.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: salto al cajón
exercises.d: An explosive jump onto a low step box that builds power in the legs and trains soft, controlled landings.
i: Stand facing a step box with your feet hip width apart.
Dip into a quarter squat and swing your arms back.
Jump explosively up onto the box, landing softly with bent knees.
Stand tall on top, then step back down one foot at a time.
Reset and repeat, staying quick but controlled.

exercises.n: salto lateral
exercises.d: A side-to-side jump that develops lateral power, balance and leg stability.
i: Stand on both feet with your knees slightly bent and your arms ready.
Push off and jump sideways, covering a comfortable distance.
Land softly on both feet with your knees tracking over your toes.
Immediately jump back to the starting side.
Keep your chest up and repeat for the planned reps or time.

exercises.n: dedos explosivos
exercises.d: A quick open-and-close finger drill that warms up the hands and forearms.
i: Hold your hands out in front of you.
Close both hands into tight fists.
Open them fast, spreading your fingers as wide as possible.
Repeat quickly for 20-30 reps.
Keep your wrists relaxed.

exercises.n: sentadilla colgado explosiva
exercises.d: A squat jump while hanging from a bar that lets you focus on explosive leg drive.
i: Hang from a bar with arms straight and knees slightly bent.
Lower into a deep squat position.
Explode upward through your legs.
Absorb the movement softly and return to the start.
Keep your core tight and repeat.

exercises.n: movilización de hombros con rotación interna
exercises.d: A gentle shoulder mobility drill that trains internal rotation.
i: Stand or sit tall with one elbow bent to 90 degrees at your side.
Rotate your forearm across your belly.
Move slowly through a comfortable range.
Return to the start and repeat 8-12 times.
Switch arms.

exercises.n: movilización del nervio radial sentado
exercises.d: A gentle seated nerve glide that moves the radial nerve along the arm.
i: Sit tall with one arm down at your side, palm facing back.
Lower your shoulder slightly and rotate your arm inward.
Bend your wrist gently and tilt your head away.
Move slowly and stop at a mild pull, never pain.
Repeat 8-10 times, then switch arms.

exercises.n: movilización del nervio mediano sentado
exercises.d: A gentle seated nerve glide for the median nerve running down the arm to the hand.
i: Sit tall and lift one arm out to the side, palm up.
Extend your wrist and fingers backward.
Tilt your head slightly away from that arm.
Return slowly and repeat 8-10 times.
Stay within a mild stretch, then switch arms.

exercises.n: movilización del nervio cubital sentado
exercises.d: A gentle seated nerve glide for the ulnar nerve on the inner side of the arm.
i: Sit tall with one arm out to the side.
Bend your elbow and bring your hand toward your face like a mask.
Tilt your head slightly away.
Straighten the arm back out, keeping it gentle.
Repeat 8-10 times, then switch arms.

exercises.n: peso muerto con piernas rígidas y postura escalonada con barra
exercises.en: barbell staggered stance stiff legged deadlift
exercises.d: A stiff-leg deadlift with a staggered stance that loads the hamstrings and glutes while shifting weight to the front leg.
i: Hold a barbell in front of your thighs and place one foot slightly behind the other, mostly on the ball of the back foot.
Keep most of your weight on the front leg with a soft knee.
Hinge at the hips, sliding the bar down your legs with a flat back.
Lower until you feel a strong hamstring stretch, then drive your hips forward to stand.
Finish all reps, then switch the stance.

exercises.n: patadas de aleteo v. 2
exercises.d: Small alternating leg kicks that burn the lower abs.
i: Lie on your back with hands under your hips.
Lift both legs a few inches off the floor.
Kick your legs up and down in small, quick alternating moves.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Continue for 20-40 seconds.

exercises.n: equilibrio con toque de punta en 3 puntos
exercises.d: A balance drill where you stand on one leg and tap the other foot to three points, training hip control and stability.
i: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend and your hands on your hips.
Tap the free foot out in front of you, then lightly out to the side.
Tap it behind you, keeping your torso upright.
Return to center and repeat the sequence under control.
Complete all reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: press de dedos a un brazo con pelota
exercises.en: single arm fingers press with ball
exercises.d: A hand-strengthening drill pressing the fingers into a ball.
i: Hold a small ball in one palm.
Press down on it with your fingers.
Spread and squeeze with control, keeping your wrist neutral.
Hold the press for 2-3 seconds.
Repeat for reps, then switch hands.

exercises.n: sostén isométrico de bíceps de rodillas
exercises.d: A static curl hold that builds biceps endurance.
i: Kneel upright with your elbows bent at about 90 degrees.
Hold your hands in front of you with palms up.
Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.
Squeeze your biceps and hold the position.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then rest.

exercises.n: movilización de hombros con empuje externo
exercises.d: A gentle shoulder mobility drill pressing outward to warm up the joint.
i: Stand tall with your elbow bent at your side.
Press your forearm outward away from your body.
Hold for a moment at the end of your comfortable range.
Return slowly and repeat 8-12 times.
Switch arms.

exercises.n: press de dedos a un brazo con pelota v. 2
exercises.en: single arm fingers press with ball v. 2
exercises.d: A second version of the fingers-on-ball drill for forearm and hand strength.
i: Place a ball under one hand on a table or hold it in your palm.
Spread your fingers over the ball.
Press down and hold for 2-3 seconds.
Release with control.
Repeat for reps, then switch hands.

exercises.n: movilización de hombros con empuje hacia atrás
exercises.d: A shoulder mobility drill moving the arm backward to open the front of the shoulder.
i: Stand tall with your arms at your sides.
Press one arm backward, keeping the elbow straight.
Move through a comfortable range.
Return slowly and repeat 8-12 times.
Switch arms.

exercises.n: movilización de hombros con rotación externa
exercises.d: A gentle shoulder mobility drill for external rotation.
i: Stand tall with your elbow bent to 90 degrees at your side.
Rotate your forearm outward away from your belly.
Keep your elbow tucked in.
Return slowly and repeat 8-12 times.
Switch arms.

exercises.n: movilización de hombros con empuje hacia delante
exercises.d: A shoulder mobility drill pressing the arm forward to warm up the joint.
i: Stand tall with your elbows bent in front of you.
Press your arm forward until it is straight.
Keep your shoulder relaxed.
Return slowly and repeat 8-12 times.
Switch arms.

exercises.n: elevación de brazos inclinado de espalda a lateral a frontal
exercises.en: bent over back to side to front arms raise
exercises.d: A flowing bent-over arm sweep from back to side to front that warms up and strengthens the rear and side shoulders.
i: Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back and let your arms hang down.
Sweep both arms back behind your hips.
Swing them out wide to the sides up to shoulder height.
Continue the arc forward until your arms point ahead of you, then reverse the path.
Keep your neck neutral and move smoothly for the planned reps.

exercises.n: elevación de brazos inclinado de espalda a lateral a frontal con mancuernas
exercises.en: dumbbell bent over back to side to front arms raise
exercises.d: A bent-over sweeping raise with light dumbbells that targets the rear and side delts through a long arc.
i: Hold light dumbbells and hinge forward at the hips with a flat back.
Start with your arms back by your hips.
Sweep the dumbbells out to the sides up to shoulder height.
Continue forward in an arc, then reverse the path with control.
Use light weights and avoid swinging your torso.

exercises.n: elevación de piernas rectas alternada y simultánea acostado
exercises.en: lying simultaneous alternating straight leg raise
exercises.d: A floor core move where both legs work together in an alternating pattern, challenging the lower abs and hip flexors.
i: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your hands under your hips or at your sides.
Press your lower back into the floor and brace your abs.
Raise one leg while the other lowers toward the floor, keeping both straight.
Switch legs in a smooth scissor pattern without letting your back arch.
Continue for the planned reps or time.

exercises.n: press a un brazo recto acostado en el suelo con mancuerna
exercises.en: dumbbell lying single straight arm press on floor
exercises.d: A one-arm press from the floor with a straight arm that trains the chest and shoulder stabilisers.
i: Lie on your back on the floor with knees bent and one dumbbell held above your chest.
Keep the other arm resting on the floor beside you.
Press the dumbbell up until your arm is straight and the shoulder reaches forward.
Lower it back with control until your upper arm touches the floor.
Complete the reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: movilización de cuádriceps acostado a una pierna
exercises.d: A lying quad mobilization that gently bends the knee to loosen the front of the thigh.
i: Lie on your side or stomach with your legs extended.
Bend one knee and bring your heel toward your glute, holding the ankle if needed.
Move the knee in and out of the bend in a slow, controlled rhythm.
Keep your hips level and stay within a comfortable range.
Repeat for 10-15 reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: elevación de piernas rectas acostado v. 2
exercises.d: A lying leg raise that targets the lower abs and hip flexors while you keep your legs long.
i: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your hands under your hips.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Raise both legs together until they point to the ceiling.
Lower them slowly, stopping just above the floor.
Keep your core braced and your back from arching.

exercises.n: flexión (de rodillas)
exercises.d: An easier push-up variation from the knees that builds chest, shoulder and arm strength.
i: Kneel on the floor with your hands slightly wider than shoulder width.
Keep your body in a straight line from your head to your knees.
Lower your chest toward the floor by bending your elbows.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight and your hips from sagging.

exercises.n: patada trasera de rodillas en smith
exercises.d: A glute kickback done kneeling with one foot pressing against a smith machine bar, a focused move for the glutes.
i: Set the bar at a low height and kneel on all fours facing it, with the sole of one foot under the bar.
Brace your abs and keep your back flat.
Press your foot up and back against the bar until your hip is fully extended.
Squeeze your glute at the top, then lower under control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: remo invertido con peso
exercises.d: An inverted row with extra weight placed on your body for added back challenge.
i: Set a bar at waist height and lie under it with extra weight on your torso.
Grip the bar just wider than shoulders.
Keep your body straight from heels to head.
Pull your chest to the bar.
Lower under control.

exercises.n: elevación de piernas rectas alternada (en bosu)
exercises.en: alternate straight leg raise (on bosu ball)
exercises.d: A lying leg raise on a bosu ball that adds an unstable surface to challenge the lower abs and balance.
i: Lie back on a bosu ball with your lower back supported and your hands holding it lightly.
Brace your abs and extend both legs.
Raise one leg while keeping it straight.
Lower it and switch to the other leg.
Keep your torso steady and move with control.

exercises.n: curl a un brazo con mancuerna y sostén isométrico
exercises.en: dumbbell single arm curl with isometric hold
exercises.d: A one-arm curl that pauses at the halfway point to increase biceps tension.
i: Stand holding a dumbbell at your side, palm forward.
Curl the weight up until your elbow is bent to 90 degrees.
Hold that position for 2-3 seconds.
Finish the curl, then lower slowly.
Complete your reps and switch arms.

exercises.n: abdominal con kettlebell
exercises.d: A sit-up holding a kettlebell for extra resistance on the abs.
i: Lie on your back with knees bent and hold a kettlebell at your chest.
Brace your core.
Curl up until your torso is upright.
Keep the kettlebell close to you.
Lower slowly back down.

exercises.n: L-sit colgado
exercises.d: A hanging hold with legs straight out in front that challenges the abs and grip.
i: Hang from a bar with straight arms.
Lift your legs straight in front until they are parallel to the floor.
Keep your toes pointed and your knees locked.
Avoid swinging.
Hold for 10-20 seconds, then lower.

exercises.n: elevación de piernas en espaldera
exercises.d: A hanging leg raise performed on stall bars.
i: Hang on a stall bar with arms straight.
Brace your core and keep your body still.
Raise your legs up in front of you.
Lift as high as you can without swinging.
Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.n: subida al banco en smith
exercises.d: A step-up with a Smith machine bar across your back for loaded leg work.
i: Set the bar across your upper back and stand in front of a bench.
Place one foot on the bench.
Drive through that heel to stand up fully.
Step back down under control.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: abdominal con giro y peso (en banco)
exercises.d: A weighted crunch with a rotation done on a bench that trains the abs and obliques.
i: Lie back on a bench with your knees bent and a weight held on your chest.
Brace your abs and curl your upper body up.
Rotate your torso so one elbow moves toward the opposite knee.
Lower back down slowly without letting go of tension.
Alternate sides each rep.

exercises.n: remo en barra T con agarre cerrado en máquina (con discos)
exercises.en: lever t bar close grip row (plate loaded)
exercises.d: A plate-loaded T-bar row with a close grip for thick back work.
i: Stand on the platform with your chest supported.
Grab the close-grip handle with straight arms.
Pull the handle toward your torso, elbows close.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly to full extension.

exercises.n: abdominal en V con peso (en bosu)
exercises.d: A V-shaped crunch on a bosu ball with added weight, which challenges the abs and balance together.
i: Sit on a bosu ball and lean back slightly, holding a weight in front of you.
Lift your feet off the floor with your legs bent or straight.
Bring your chest and knees toward each other in a V shape.
Lower back with control, keeping your spine long.
Stay stable on the ball throughout.

exercises.n: abdominal inclinado con giro v. 2
exercises.d: An incline sit-up with a twist to work the obliques as well as the abs.
i: Lie on an incline bench with your feet secured.
Place your hands lightly behind your head.
Curl up while rotating your torso to one side.
Lower slowly.
Alternate sides each rep.

exercises.n: estiramiento de flexores de cadera de pie
exercises.d: A standing stretch for the front of the hip and thigh, useful after long periods of sitting.
i: Stand tall and hold a wall or support for balance.
Bend one knee and bring your heel toward your glute, holding the ankle.
Tuck your pelvis slightly and push your hips gently forward.
Keep your knees close together and your chest upright.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

exercises.n: estiramiento de flexores de cadera de pie en media rodilla
exercises.en: standing half kneeling hip flexors stretch
exercises.d: A half-kneeling position that opens the front of the hip and the quad of the back leg.
i: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward and a pad under your knee.
Keep your torso upright and tuck your pelvis under.
Shift your weight forward until you feel a stretch at the front of the back hip.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and your core engaged.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.n: press de tríceps (cabeza fuera del banco)
exercises.d: A triceps extension lying with your head off the bench edge for an extra stretch.
i: Lie on a bench with your head just past the end, holding a weight overhead.
Keep your upper arms still and pointing up.
Bend your elbows to lower the weight toward your head.
Extend your arms to straight.
Keep your elbows tucked in.

exercises.n: plancha cruz de hierro
exercises.d: A plank variation with arms and legs spread wide to challenge the core.
i: Start in a plank position with hands under your shoulders.
Spread your arms and legs wide in an X shape.
Brace your core and keep your hips level.
Breathe steadily.
Hold for 20-40 seconds.

exercises.n: remo en barra T acostado en máquina
exercises.d: A chest-supported T-bar row lying on the machine pad.
i: Lie chest-down on the pad and grab the handles.
Start with your arms straight.
Pull the handles toward your torso.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower under control.

exercises.n: press de pecho martillo inclinado en máquina
exercises.d: Pressing on an incline chest machine with neutral hammer handles. It builds the upper chest and is gentle on the shoulders.
i: Adjust the seat so the handles sit at upper chest height.
Sit back with your shoulder blades pinned to the pad and grip the neutral handles.
Press the handles up and forward until your arms are almost straight.
Lower slowly until you feel a stretch across the chest.
Keep your wrists straight and your back against the pad.

exercises.n: estiramiento pretzel acostado
exercises.d: A lying twist that pulls one leg across and bends the other back, stretching the glutes, hips and thighs.
i: Lie on your side with your hips stacked and your bottom leg bent in front.
Bend the top knee and bring that foot back toward your glutes, holding it with your hand.
Gently roll your top knee back and open your chest toward the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

exercises.n: curl de bíceps alternado con mancuernas v. 2
exercises.d: Curling one dumbbell at a time while standing. A classic way to build the biceps with a steady rhythm.
i: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Keeping your elbow by your side, curl one dumbbell up toward your shoulder.
Squeeze at the top, then lower it under control.
Repeat with the other arm and keep alternating.
Avoid swinging your torso to lift the weight.

exercises.n: sentadilla
exercises.d: The basic bodyweight squat. It trains the thighs and glutes and teaches solid lower body mechanics.
i: Stand with your feet about shoulder width apart and toes slightly out.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower down.
Go as deep as you can while keeping your heels down and chest up.
Drive through your feet to stand back up.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.

exercises.n: dominada con salto
exercises.d: A pull-up that uses a small jump to help you up, then a slow lowering phase. Good for building pulling strength.
i: Stand under a pull-up bar and grip it slightly wider than your shoulders.
Bend your knees and jump up, pulling your chin above the bar.
Pause for a moment at the top.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight.
Reset on the floor and repeat.

exercises.n: jalón alto de peso muerto sumo
exercises.d: A wide-stance deadlift finished with an upright row. It works the thighs, glutes and shoulders in one smooth motion.
i: Stand with a wide stance and grip the barbell between your legs with hands close together.
Keep your back flat and drive through your legs to stand up.
As the bar passes your hips, pull it up to chest height with your elbows high.
Lower the bar back along the same path.
Keep the bar close to your body throughout.

exercises.n: push press
exercises.d: An overhead press helped by a quick leg dip and drive. It lets you handle heavier loads for the shoulders and triceps.
i: Hold the barbell at your upper chest with your elbows slightly in front of the bar.
Dip a few inches by bending your knees, keeping your torso upright.
Drive up through your legs and press the bar overhead.
Lock out with the bar over your mid foot, then lower it back to your chest.
Brace your core and avoid leaning back.

exercises.n: burpee con mancuernas
exercises.d: A burpee with dumbbells that finishes with an overhead press. It builds strength and endurance.
i: Comienza de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros y una mancuerna en cada mano.
Baja el cuerpo a una posición de sentadilla, colocando las mancuernas en el suelo frente a ti.
Lleva los pies hacia atrás a una posición de flexión de brazos, manteniendo el cuerpo en línea recta.
Realiza una flexión de brazos, flexionando los codos y bajando el pecho hacia el suelo.
Salta con los pies hacia tus manos, aterrizando en una posición de sentadilla.
Ponte de pie de forma explosiva, levantando las mancuernas del suelo y llevándolas a los hombros.
Empuja las mancuernas por encima de la cabeza, extendiendo completamente los brazos.
Baja las mancuernas de vuelta a los hombros y repite toda la secuencia el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: slingshots con kettlebell de pie (avanzado)
exercises.d: Passing a kettlebell around your torso in quick circles. It challenges the core, grip and coordination.
i: Stand with your feet hip width apart holding a kettlebell by the handle.
Pass it around your waist from one hand to the other behind your back.
Continue the circle to the front, keeping the movement smooth.
Keep your core tight and your hips still.
After several reps, reverse the direction.

exercises.n: press pallof horizontal en polea
exercises.d: Pressing a cable straight out from your chest while resisting the pull to rotate. It trains anti-rotation core strength.
i: Set a cable at chest height and stand sideways to the stack.
Hold the handle at your chest with both hands and brace your core.
Press the handle straight out until your arms are extended.
Hold for a second without letting your torso twist.
Bring it back to your chest and finish the set, then switch sides.

exercises.n: curl de bíceps interno a un brazo en polea
exercises.en: cable one arm inner biceps curl
exercises.d: A single-arm cable curl with the elbow pointing slightly out to emphasise the inner biceps.
i: Attach a handle to a low cable and stand facing the stack.
Hold the handle with one hand, palm up, and turn your elbow slightly out.
Curl the handle toward your shoulder.
Squeeze at the top, then lower under control.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: jalón al pecho a un brazo en polea
exercises.d: A single-arm pulldown on a high cable. It lets each side of the lats work on its own.
i: Attach a handle to a high pulley and sit facing the stack.
Grab the handle with one hand and sit tall.
Pull the handle down to the side of your chest, driving your elbow toward your hip.
Pause, then let your arm rise slowly.
Complete your reps and switch sides.

exercises.n: remo sentado con giro a un brazo en polea
exercises.en: cable one arm twisting seated row
exercises.d: A seated one-arm cable row with a rotation of the torso. It trains the back and gives the core a twist.
i: Sit at a low cable with your feet braced and grab the handle with one hand.
Start with your torso turned slightly toward the cable.
Row the handle to your side while rotating your torso open.
Squeeze your shoulder blade back, then return slowly.
Do all reps, then change arms.

exercises.n: pull through en polea
exercises.d: A hip hinge facing away from a low cable. It builds the glutes and hamstrings and teaches a good hinge.
i: Attach a rope to a low pulley and face away from the stack, holding the rope between your legs.
Step forward until the cable is taut and bend your knees slightly.
Push your hips back, letting the rope travel behind you.
Drive your hips forward and squeeze your glutes to stand tall.
Keep your back flat throughout.

exercises.n: giro en polea (de abajo hacia arriba)
exercises.d: A diagonal cable rotation from low to high that trains the obliques and builds rotational strength.
i: Set the cable pulley low and stand sideways to the machine, holding the handle with both hands.
Start with the handle near your lower hip, arms mostly straight.
Rotate your torso and pull the handle diagonally up across your body.
Pivot your back foot and keep your hips stable.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: giro en polea (de arriba hacia abajo) v. 2
exercises.d: A diagonal cable rotation from high to low that trains the obliques and builds rotational strength.
i: Set the cable pulley high and stand sideways to the machine, holding the handle with both hands.
Start with the handle above your shoulder, arms mostly straight.
Rotate your torso and pull the handle diagonally down across your body.
Keep your hips steady and your core braced.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: press sobre la cabeza con giro en polea
exercises.d: An overhead cable press where you rotate your torso as you push. It works the shoulders and the core together.
i: Set a cable low and stand sideways, holding the handle at your shoulder.
Brace your core and turn slightly toward the cable.
Press the handle overhead while rotating your torso to face forward.
Lower the handle back to your shoulder with control.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: remo alto de pie con giro en polea
exercises.d: A standing cable row at a high angle with a torso twist. It hits the upper back and rear shoulders.
i: Set a cable at about head height and stand facing it with the handle in one hand.
Take a split stance and lean back slightly.
Pull the handle toward your upper chest, turning your torso as you go.
Squeeze your shoulder blade, then return slowly.
Complete the set and switch sides.

exercises.n: press de pecho de pie con giro a un brazo en polea
exercises.en: cable twisting standing one arm chest press
exercises.d: A standing single-arm cable press with a rotation. It trains the chest and the core's ability to resist and produce twist.
i: Set the cable at chest height and stand sideways with the handle in your inside hand.
Take a stable stance and hold the handle at your chest.
Press the handle forward while rotating your torso toward the press.
Return to the start with control.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: remo de pie con giro en polea
exercises.d: A standing cable row where you turn your torso as you pull. It works the back with some added core rotation.
i: Set a cable at mid height and stand facing it, holding the handle with one hand.
Stand in a stable stance with a slight lean back.
Pull the handle to your ribs and rotate your torso open.
Squeeze your shoulder blade at the end.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: press pallof vertical en polea
exercises.d: A cable press performed upward or downward in a vertical line while holding the core still. It trains anti-rotation and shoulder stability.
i: Set a cable at a high or low position and stand sideways to it.
Hold the handle at your chest with both hands.
Press the handle straight up (or down) along a vertical line.
Hold for a second without letting your torso twist.
Return to your chest, finish the set, then switch sides.

exercises.n: press de banca inclinado a 30 grados con agarre inverso y mancuernas
exercises.en: dumbbell incline reverse grip 30 degrees bench press
exercises.d: A low-incline dumbbell press with palms facing you. The reverse grip puts extra focus on the upper chest.
i: Set a bench to about 30 degrees and lie back with dumbbells held palms facing you.
Start with the dumbbells at your chest.
Press them up until your arms are almost straight.
Lower slowly back to your chest.
Keep your elbows close to your body.

exercises.n: zancada lateral con mancuernas
exercises.d: A lateral lunge with dumbbells that trains the glutes, quads and inner thighs in the frontal plane.
i: Hold a dumbbell in each hand or one at your chest and stand tall.
Step out wide to one side and sit your hips back.
Keep the other leg straight and your chest upright.
Push through the bent leg to return to the middle.
Alternate sides or finish all reps on one side before switching.

exercises.n: elevación de gemelos sentado a una pierna en máquina
exercises.en: lever seated one leg calf raise
exercises.d: A one-leg seated calf raise on a machine. Working each leg alone helps balance strength and targets the soleus.
i: Sit on the machine and place the ball of one foot on the platform.
Set the pad on your thigh and release the safety.
Lower your heel for a stretch.
Press up as high as you can onto your toes.
Pause, lower slowly, then switch legs.

exercises.n: elevación de gemelos en máquina (máquina de press de banca)
exercises.d: A calf raise done on a chest press style lever machine, using the seat and handles to load the calves.
i: Sit on the machine and place the balls of your feet on the lower platform or press plate.
Push to straighten your legs and release the safety.
Lower your heels as far as is comfortable.
Rise up onto your toes as high as possible.
Pause at the top and lower under control.

exercises.n: encogimientos en máquina (máquina de press de banca)
exercises.d: Shrugging with a lever press machine as the load. It builds the upper traps with a stable, guided path.
i: Set the machine so the handles are at your sides and grip them firmly.
Stand or sit tall with your arms straight.
Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Pause at the top for a moment.
Lower your shoulders slowly without rolling them.

exercises.n: dominadas asistidas supinas con agarre cerrado
exercises.en: assisted close grip underhand chin up
exercises.d: A chin-up with machine assistance and a narrow underhand grip. It lets you build pulling strength with less bodyweight.
i: Set the assistance weight and kneel or stand on the platform.
Grip the bar with palms facing you, hands close together.
Pull yourself up until your chin clears the bar.
Squeeze your back and biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.n: remo invertido con agarre supino
exercises.d: A bodyweight row under a low bar with an underhand grip. It builds the back and biceps.
i: Set a bar at waist height and lie under it, gripping it with palms facing you.
Straighten your body from heels to head.
Pull your chest up to the bar, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower yourself under control until your arms are straight.
Keep your hips up the whole time.

exercises.n: press de hombros de pie en smith
exercises.d: A standing overhead press on the Smith machine. The fixed bar path lets you focus on pushing.
i: Set the bar at shoulder height and stand under it with a shoulder width grip.
Unrack the bar and hold it at your collarbone.
Press up until your arms are straight.
Lower the bar back to your shoulders slowly.
Brace your core and keep your ribs down.

exercises.n: press de disco de pie
exercises.d: Pressing a weight plate overhead with both hands. A simple way to train the shoulders and arms.
i: Stand tall holding a plate at the sides with both hands at chest height.
Brace your core and keep your elbows slightly forward.
Press the plate overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower it slowly to your chest.
Keep your ribs down and avoid arching.

exercises.n: press sobre la cabeza de pie con barra EZ
exercises.d: An overhead press with an EZ bar. The angled grips can feel kinder on the wrists while you train the shoulders.
i: Stand holding an EZ bar at your upper chest with a comfortable grip.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Press the bar overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower it slowly back to your chest.
Keep your head neutral and avoid leaning back.

exercises.n: extensión de tríceps de pie a un brazo en polea (agarre prono)
exercises.en: cable standing one arm triceps pushdown (overhand grip)
exercises.d: A single-arm pushdown with an overhand grip. It isolates one triceps at a time.
i: Attach a handle to a high pulley and stand facing it.
Hold the handle with an overhand grip and tuck your elbow to your side.
Push down until your arm is fully straight.
Squeeze your triceps, then let the handle rise slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: curl de bíceps interno de pie con mancuernas
exercises.d: A standing dumbbell curl with the elbows turned slightly out to emphasise the inner head of the biceps.
i: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, elbows slightly out from your sides.
Curl the weights toward your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower them slowly to the start.
Keep your upper arms still.

exercises.n: jalón de dorsales de pie en polea (con cuerda)
exercises.d: A straight-arm pushdown with a rope on a high cable. It isolates the lats with almost no help from the arms.
i: Attach a rope to a high pulley and stand facing it, hinging slightly forward.
Grab the rope with straight arms.
Push the rope down to your thighs, keeping your arms nearly straight.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom.
Let the rope rise slowly to shoulder height.

exercises.n: elevaciones frontales verticales alternadas de pie con mancuernas
exercises.en: dumbbell standing alternate vertical front raises
exercises.d: Raising one dumbbell at a time in front of you with a neutral grip. It works the front shoulders.
i: Stand holding dumbbells at your thighs with palms facing in.
Raise one dumbbell straight up to shoulder height.
Pause, then lower it slowly.
Repeat with the other arm and keep alternating.
Avoid swinging your body.

exercises.n: press de hombros sentado a un brazo con mancuerna
exercises.en: dumbbell seated one arm shoulder press
exercises.d: A seated overhead press with one dumbbell. Working one arm at a time shows any imbalances.
i: Sit on a bench with back support, holding a dumbbell at your shoulder.
Brace your core.
Press the dumbbell up until your arm is straight.
Lower it slowly to your shoulder.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: sentadilla sentado en máquina
exercises.d: A squat on a seated lever machine with a supported torso. It loads the thighs and glutes with a guided path.
i: Sit in the machine with your back against the pad and shoulders under the supports.
Place your feet on the platform about shoulder width apart.
Push through your feet to extend your legs.
Lower slowly until your knees are comfortably bent.
Keep your knees in line with your toes.

exercises.n: curl martillo inclinado alternado con mancuernas
exercises.d: Hammer curls on an incline bench, one arm at a time. The stretched position makes the biceps and brachialis work hard.
i: Sit back on an incline bench holding dumbbells with palms facing in.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Curl one dumbbell up without twisting your wrist.
Lower it slowly and repeat with the other arm.
Keep your upper arms still.

exercises.n: hiperextensión con disco
exercises.d: A back extension holding a plate at your chest. It strengthens the lower back, glutes and hamstrings.
i: Set the hyperextension bench so your hips are just past the pad.
Hold a weight plate against your chest and cross your arms over it.
Lower your torso toward the floor with a flat back.
Raise your torso until your body forms a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top and avoid overarching.

exercises.n: remo sentado a un brazo en máquina (máquina de remo sentado)
exercises.en: lever one arm seated row (seated row machine)
exercises.d: A single-arm row on a seated machine. It lets you load one side of the back at a time.
i: Sit at the machine with your chest on the pad and grab one handle.
Start with your arm extended.
Pull the handle toward your torso, driving your elbow back.
Squeeze your shoulder blade, then return slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: remo a un brazo con mancuerna (apoyo en rack)
exercises.d: A one-arm row with your free hand braced on a rack for support. It lets you pull heavy while keeping your back steady.
i: Place one hand on a rack or sturdy support and hinge forward with a flat back.
Hold a dumbbell in your other hand with your arm hanging.
Row the dumbbell toward your hip.
Squeeze your back at the top, then lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: remo en máquina (con discos)
exercises.d: A plate-loaded machine row. The guided path lets you pull heavy with good back engagement.
i: Adjust the seat and chest pad, then grab the handles.
Sit tall with your chest against the pad.
Pull the handles toward your torso, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Pause for a moment.
Return slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.n: remo sentado en polea (barra curva)
exercises.d: A seated cable row using a bent bar. The angled bar suits many wrists while you train the back.
i: Sit at a low cable station with your feet on the platform and knees slightly bent.
Grab the bent bar with both hands.
Pull the bar to your lower ribs, keeping your back straight.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Extend your arms slowly without rounding forward.

exercises.n: bird dog
exercises.d: From hands and knees, you extend opposite arm and leg. It builds core control and back stability.
i: Start on all fours with hands under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
Extend your right arm forward and left leg back.
Keep your hips level and your back flat.
Hold for a moment, then return.
Repeat on the other side and alternate.

exercises.n: abdominal (en bosu)
exercises.d: A crunch on a bosu ball. The unstable surface asks more from your core.
i: Sit on the bosu ball and lie back so it supports your lower back.
Place your hands lightly behind your head.
Curl your shoulders up by contracting your abs.
Hold the top briefly.
Lower slowly and keep your feet planted.

exercises.n: dead bug v. 2
exercises.d: A lying core drill where arms and legs reach out while your back stays down. It trains core control.
i: Lie on your back with arms pointing up and knees bent at 90 degrees.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Lower your right arm and left leg toward the floor.
Return and switch sides.
Move slowly and keep your back flat.

exercises.n: patadas de aleteo v. 3
exercises.d: Small alternating leg kicks while lying down. They fire up the lower abs and hip flexors.
i: Lie on your back with your legs straight and hands under your hips.
Lift your legs a few inches off the floor.
Kick your legs up and down in small alternating motions.
Keep your lower back pressed to the floor.
Continue for a set time and breathe steadily.

exercises.n: elevación de piernas acostado con sostén
exercises.d: Raising your legs from the floor and holding them up. It targets the lower abs.
i: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your hands by your sides.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Raise your legs until they are vertical.
Lower them to just above the floor and hold for a couple of seconds.
Repeat without letting your back arch.

exercises.n: sostén hollow
exercises.d: A gymnastics-style hold with your shoulders and legs lifted. It builds deep core strength.
i: Lie on your back with your arms overhead and legs straight.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Lift your shoulders and legs a few inches off the ground.
Hold the shape and breathe steadily.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then rest.

exercises.n: giro ruso (con balón medicinal)
exercises.d: Rotating a medicine ball from side to side while seated. It works the obliques.
i: Sit with your knees bent and lean back slightly, holding a medicine ball at your chest.
Lift your feet slightly if you can.
Rotate your torso to one side and tap the ball by your hip.
Rotate to the other side.
Keep your chest tall and move with control.

exercises.n: medio limpiaparabrisas (pierna flexionada)
exercises.d: Lying on your back and swinging bent legs side to side. It trains the obliques and lower abs.
i: Lie on your back with your arms out to the sides for support.
Lift your knees to 90 degrees.
Lower both knees to one side, stopping before the floor.
Bring them back to the middle and go to the other side.
Keep your shoulders on the floor.

exercises.n: limpiaparabrisas (pierna recta)
exercises.d: Swinging straight legs from side to side like windshield wipers. It is a tough one for the obliques and lower abs.
i: Lie on your back with your arms out to the sides.
Raise your legs straight up over your hips.
Lower both legs to one side with control.
Lift them back to the middle and lower to the other side.
Keep your shoulders flat on the floor.

exercises.n: abdominal con peso (detrás de la cabeza)
exercises.d: A crunch with a weight held behind your head. The extra load makes it harder on the abs.
i: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Hold a weight behind your head with your elbows out.
Curl your shoulders up, contracting your abs.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly without pulling on your neck.

exercises.n: elevación de gemelos burro en máquina
exercises.d: A donkey calf raise on a lever machine. It trains the calves.
i: Ajusta la máquina de palanca a la altura adecuada para tu cuerpo.
Colócate de frente a la máquina, con los dedos de los pies en la plataforma y los talones colgando fuera del borde.
Coloca las manos en las asas o en las barras de soporte para mayor estabilidad.
Activa las pantorrillas y levanta los talones tan alto como sea posible, usando la parte delantera de los pies.
Haz una pausa breve en la parte alta y luego baja lentamente los talones de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: press de banca con banda elástica
exercises.d: A bench press using resistance bands. It trains the chest, shoulders and triceps.
i: Túmbate sobre un banco con los pies apoyados en el suelo y la espalda presionada contra el banco.
Agarra las agarraderas de la banda con un agarre prono, un poco más separadas que el ancho de los hombros.
Extiende los brazos por completo, empujando las bandas alejándolas del pecho.
Baja lentamente las bandas de vuelta hacia el pecho, manteniendo los codos en un ángulo de 90 grados.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: pullover declinado con barra
exercises.d: A pullover on a decline bench with a barbell. It trains the chest and lats.
i: Túmbate en un banco declinado con la cabeza más baja que las caderas y los pies sujetos.
Sujeta la barra con un agarre pronado (palmas mirando hacia afuera) y las manos un poco más separadas que el ancho de los hombros.
Extiende los brazos por encima del pecho, manteniendo una ligera flexión en los codos.
Baja la barra describiendo un arco detrás de la cabeza, sintiendo un estiramiento en el pecho y los hombros.
Haz una pausa breve y luego devuelve la barra a la posición inicial invirtiendo el movimiento.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: press de banca declinado con agarre inverso y barra
exercises.en: barbell reverse grip decline bench press
exercises.d: A reverse-grip bench press on a decline bench. It trains the lower chest and triceps.
i: Túmbate en un banco declinado con los pies sujetos y la cabeza más baja que las caderas.
Agarra la barra con un agarre invertido, un poco más ancho que la separación de los hombros.
Saca la barra del soporte y bájala lentamente hacia el pecho, manteniendo los codos pegados al cuerpo.
Haz una pausa breve en la parte baja y luego empuja la barra de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: press de banca inclinado con agarre inverso y barra
exercises.en: barbell reverse grip incline bench press
exercises.d: A reverse-grip bench press on an incline bench. It trains the upper chest and triceps.
i: Coloca un banco inclinado a un ángulo de 45 grados.
Túmbate en el banco con los pies planos sobre el suelo.
Agarra la barra con un agarre invertido, manos un poco más separadas que el ancho de los hombros.
Saca la barra del soporte y bájala lentamente hacia el pecho, manteniendo los codos pegados al cuerpo.
Haz una pausa breve cuando la barra toque el pecho.
Empuja la barra de vuelta a la posición inicial, extendiendo completamente los brazos.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: press de banca abierto con agarre inverso y barra
exercises.en: barbell wide reverse grip bench press
exercises.d: A wide reverse-grip bench press. It trains the chest and triceps.
i: Túmbate sobre un banco con los pies apoyados en el suelo y la espalda presionada contra el banco.
Sujeta la barra con un agarre supino amplio, un poco más separado que el ancho de los hombros.
Levanta la barra del soporte y sostenla directamente sobre el pecho con los brazos completamente extendidos.
Baja la barra lentamente hacia el pecho, manteniendo los codos pegados al cuerpo y las muñecas rectas.
Haz una pausa breve cuando la barra toque el pecho y luego empújala de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: estiramiento de pecho por detrás de la cabeza
exercises.d: A stretch with the hands behind the head, pulling the elbows back. It opens the chest and shoulders.
i: Ponte de pie con la espalda recta y los pies separados a la altura de los hombros.
Entrelaza los dedos detrás de la cabeza con los codos apuntando hacia afuera.
Junta lentamente los omóplatos y empuja el pecho hacia adelante.
Mantén el estiramiento durante 15-30 segundos.
Suelta el estiramiento y repite cuantas veces lo desees.

exercises.n: press declinado a un brazo en polea
exercises.d: A one-arm cable press from a decline angle. It trains the chest and triceps.
i: Ajusta la máquina de cable a una posición declinada.
Ponte de pie de espaldas a la máquina y sujeta la agarradera con una mano.
Colócate con la espalda contra el banco declinado y el brazo extendido recto frente a ti.
Flexiona el codo y baja la agarradera hacia el pecho, manteniendo el brazo superior quieto.
Haz una pausa breve en la parte más baja, luego empuja la agarradera de vuelta hacia la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado, luego cambia de brazo.

exercises.n: press declinado en polea
exercises.d: A decline cable press for the lower chest. It trains the chest, shoulders and triceps.
i: Ajusta la máquina de cable a una posición declinada.
Siéntate en el banco declinado frente a la máquina de cable.
Sujeta las agarraderas con agarre prono y colócalas a la altura del pecho.
Mantén los pies planos en el suelo y la espalda firmemente apoyada en el banco.
Exhala y empuja las agarraderas alejándolas del cuerpo, extendiendo completamente los brazos.
Haz una pausa breve al final del movimiento, contrayendo los músculos del pecho.
Inhala y vuelve lentamente las agarraderas a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: apertura de pecho declinada a un brazo en polea
exercises.en: cable one arm decline chest fly
exercises.d: A one-arm decline chest fly with a cable. It trains the lower chest.
i: Sujeta una agarradera en D a una máquina de cable con polea baja y coloca el banco en un ángulo declinado.
Túmbate en el banco con la cabeza orientada hacia la máquina y agarra la agarradera con la mano derecha.
Extiende el brazo recto por encima del pecho, manteniendo una ligera flexión en el codo.
Con un movimiento controlado, baja el brazo hacia el lado hasta que la mano quede alineada con el hombro.
Haz una pausa por un momento y luego invierte el movimiento para regresar el brazo a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado y luego cambia al brazo izquierdo y repite el ejercicio.

exercises.n: apertura a un brazo en balón de estabilidad (polea)
exercises.en: cable one arm fly on exercise ball
exercises.d: A one-arm cable fly seated on an exercise ball. It trains the chest and core.
i: Siéntate sobre un balón de ejercicio con los pies apoyados planos en el suelo y la espalda recta.
Sujeta una agarradera del cable con una mano y extiende el brazo hacia el lado, paralelo al suelo.
Mantén el codo ligeramente flexionado y la palma hacia adelante.
Lleva lentamente el brazo a través del cuerpo, apretando los músculos del pecho.
Haz una pausa por un momento al final del movimiento, luego regresa lentamente a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado, luego cambia de lado.

exercises.n: apertura inclinada a un brazo en balón de estabilidad (polea)
exercises.en: cable one arm incline fly on exercise ball
exercises.d: A one-arm incline cable fly on an exercise ball. It trains the upper chest.
i: Siéntate sobre un balón de ejercicio con los pies apoyados planos en el suelo y la espalda contra un banco inclinado.
Sujeta una agarradera del cable con una mano, con el brazo extendido y la palma hacia adentro.
Manteniendo una ligera flexión en el codo, baja lentamente el brazo hacia el lado hasta que la mano quede alineada con el hombro.
Haz una pausa por un momento y luego aprieta los músculos del pecho para regresar el brazo a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado, luego cambia de brazo.

exercises.n: press inclinado a un brazo en polea
exercises.d: A one-arm incline cable press. It trains the upper chest and shoulders.
i: Ajusta la máquina de cable a una posición de polea baja.
Siéntate en un banco inclinado de espaldas a la máquina de cable.
Sujeta la agarradera con una mano y llévala hasta la altura del hombro.
Coloca los pies firmemente en el suelo y mantén una posición estable.
Empuja la agarradera hacia adelante y hacia arriba, extendiendo el brazo por completo.
Haz una pausa breve en la parte más alta, luego baja lentamente la agarradera de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado, luego cambia de lado.

exercises.n: press inclinado a un brazo en balón de estabilidad (polea)
exercises.en: cable one arm incline press on exercise ball
exercises.d: A one-arm incline cable press on an exercise ball. It trains the upper chest and balance.
i: Siéntate sobre un balón de ejercicio con los pies apoyados planos en el suelo y la espalda contra un banco inclinado.
Sujeta una agarradera del cable con una mano y coloca el brazo en un ángulo de 90 grados con el codo flexionado.
Empuja la agarradera del cable hacia adelante y hacia arriba, extendiendo el brazo por completo.
Haz una pausa breve en la parte más alta, luego baja lentamente la agarradera del cable de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado, luego cambia al otro brazo.

exercises.n: press a un brazo en balón de estabilidad (polea)
exercises.en: cable one arm press on exercise ball
exercises.d: A one-arm cable press on an exercise ball. It trains the chest and core.
i: Siéntate sobre un balón de ejercicio con los pies apoyados planos en el suelo y la espalda recta.
Sujeta una agarradera del cable con una mano y coloca el brazo a la altura del pecho, con el codo flexionado.
Coloca la otra mano en la cadera para mantener el equilibrio.
Empuja la agarradera del cable hacia adelante, extendiendo el brazo por completo.
Haz una pausa por un momento, luego regresa lentamente a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado, luego cambia de brazo.

exercises.n: press en balón de estabilidad (polea)
exercises.d: A cable chest press on an exercise ball. It trains the chest and challenges balance.
i: Siéntate sobre un balón de ejercicio con los pies apoyados planos en el suelo y las rodillas en un ángulo de 90 grados.
Sujeta las agarraderas del cable a la altura del pecho con las palmas hacia abajo y los codos flexionados.
Activa el core y empuja las agarraderas del cable hacia adelante hasta que los brazos queden completamente extendidos.
Haz una pausa por un momento y luego libera lentamente la tensión, regresando las agarraderas del cable a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: cruces de poleas de pie hacia arriba
exercises.d: Standing cable crossovers with the hands crossing in front. It trains the chest.
i: Ponte de pie en el medio de una máquina de cable con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros.
Sujeta los mangos de los cables con las palmas hacia abajo y los brazos extendidos hacia los lados.
Manteniendo los brazos rectos, junta las manos frente a tu cuerpo, cruzándolas una sobre la otra.
Haz una pausa breve, luego regresa lentamente a la posición inicial, manteniendo los brazos extendidos.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: cruces de poleas para pecho superior
exercises.d: Cable crossovers aimed at the upper chest. It trains the upper pecs.
i: Coloca los mangos en los cables a la altura del pecho.
Ponte de pie en el centro de la máquina de cable con un pie ligeramente delante del otro.
Sujeta las agarraderas con las palmas hacia abajo y los brazos extendidos hacia los lados.
Mantén una ligera flexión en los codos y activa el core.
Tira de los cables juntos frente al pecho, cruzándolos uno sobre el otro.
Aprieta los músculos del pecho en el punto máximo del movimiento.
Suelta lentamente los cables de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: estiramiento de pecho y frente de hombro
exercises.en: chest and front of shoulder stretch
exercises.d: A stretch for the chest and the fronts of the shoulders with the hands clasped. It loosens the chest.
i: Ponte de pie con la espalda recta y los pies separados a la altura de los hombros.
Extiende los brazos rectos frente a ti a la altura de los hombros.
Cruza los brazos frente a tu cuerpo, con el brazo derecho sobre el brazo izquierdo.
Entrelaza los dedos y presiona las palmas entre sí.
Aprieta suavemente los omóplatos entre sí y empuja las manos hacia adelante, sintiendo un estiramiento en el pecho y la parte delantera de los hombros.
Mantén el estiramiento durante 20-30 segundos, luego suelta.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: estiramiento de pecho con balón de estabilidad
exercises.d: A chest stretch using an exercise ball held out in front. It loosens the chest.
i: Siéntate en el balón de estabilidad con los pies planos en el suelo y la espalda recta.
Sujeta el balón de ejercicio con ambas manos y extiende los brazos rectos frente a ti.
Lleva lentamente el balón de ejercicio hacia tu pecho, sintiendo un estiramiento en los músculos del pecho.
Mantén el estiramiento durante unos segundos, luego regresa lentamente a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: flexiones con palmada
exercises.d: An explosive push-up with a clap in mid-air. It builds power in the chest, shoulders and triceps.
i: Comienza en posición de plancha alta con las manos un poco más separadas que el ancho de los hombros.
Baja el cuerpo hacia el suelo flexionando los codos, manteniendo el core activado.
Empuja con las palmas de forma explosiva para impulsar tu cuerpo fuera del suelo.
Mientras estás en el aire, junta las manos en un aplauso antes de aterrizar de vuelta en la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: flexiones profundas
exercises.d: A deep push-up with a longer range of motion. It trains the chest, shoulders and triceps.
i: Comienza en posición de plancha alta con las manos un poco más separadas que el ancho de los hombros y el cuerpo en línea recta.
Baja el pecho hacia el suelo flexionando los codos, manteniéndolos cerca del cuerpo.
Empuja con las palmas para extender los brazos y regresar a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: flexiones con caída
exercises.d: A push-up that drops to the knees and presses back up. It trains the chest and triceps.
i: Comienza en posición de plancha alta con las manos un poco más separadas que el ancho de los hombros.
Baja el pecho hacia el suelo, manteniendo los codos cerca del cuerpo.
Una vez que tu pecho esté justo por encima del suelo, baja rápidamente las rodillas al suelo.
Empuja tu cuerpo de vuelta a la posición inicial extendiendo los brazos.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: apertura declinada a un brazo con mancuerna
exercises.d: Lying on a decline bench, you open one arm out to the side with a dumbbell and bring it back over your chest. It works the lower chest one side at a time.
i: Túmbate en un banco declinado con una mancuerna en una mano, apoyándola sobre el muslo.
Usando el muslo para ayudar a levantar la mancuerna, álzala hasta la altura de los hombros con la palma mirando hacia el torso.
Gira la muñeca de modo que la palma de la mano quede mirando hacia adelante.
Mientras inhalas, baja la mancuerna lentamente hacia el lado hasta sentir un estiramiento en el pecho.
Exhala y usa los músculos del pecho para llevar la mancuerna de nuevo hacia arriba hasta la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado, luego cambia de brazo.

exercises.n: apertura con mancuernas en balón de estabilidad
exercises.d: A dumbbell fly done lying back on a stability ball. The unstable surface makes your core work while the chest does the opening and closing.
i: Siéntate sobre un balón de estabilidad y sostén una mancuerna en cada mano.
Camina con los pies hacia adelante y baja el cuerpo rodando hasta que la cabeza, el cuello y la parte superior de la espalda queden apoyados sobre el balón.
Extiende los brazos rectos por encima del pecho, con las palmas enfrentadas entre sí.
Flexiona ligeramente los codos y baja los brazos hacia los lados describiendo un amplio arco hasta sentir un estiramiento en el pecho.
Haz una pausa por un momento, luego invierte el movimiento y contrae los músculos del pecho mientras llevas las mancuernas de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: apertura inclinada con mancuernas en balón de estabilidad
exercises.en: dumbbell incline fly on exercise ball
exercises.d: Dumbbell fly with your upper back on an incline bench and your hips supported by a stability ball. It hits the upper chest and challenges balance.
i: Coloca un banco inclinado a un ángulo de 45 grados.
Siéntate sobre un balón de estabilidad y rueda hacia adelante hasta que la parte superior de la espalda quede apoyada en el banco inclinado.
Sostén una mancuerna en cada mano con las palmas enfrentadas entre sí y los brazos extendidos por encima del pecho.
Baja las mancuernas hacia los lados describiendo un amplio arco hasta sentir un estiramiento en el pecho.
Haz una pausa por un momento, luego contrae los músculos del pecho para llevar las mancuernas de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: apertura inclinada a un brazo con mancuerna
exercises.d: A single-arm fly on an incline bench that targets the upper chest. Working one side at a time helps you spot and fix left-right differences.
i: Ajusta el banco inclinado a un ángulo de 30-45 grados.
Siéntate en el banco con una mancuerna en una mano, apoyándola sobre el muslo.
Recuéstate en el banco, manteniendo los pies apoyados en el suelo.
Sostén la mancuerna con el brazo extendido recto hacia arriba sobre el pecho.
Baja la mancuerna hacia el lado describiendo un amplio arco, manteniendo una ligera flexión en el codo.
Haz una pausa cuando el brazo esté paralelo al suelo, luego invierte el movimiento para llevar la mancuerna de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado, luego cambia de brazo.

exercises.n: apertura inclinada a un brazo con mancuerna en balón de estabilidad
exercises.en: dumbbell incline one arm fly on exercise ball
exercises.d: One-arm incline fly with your back supported on a stability ball. The unstable base adds a core challenge to the upper chest stretch.
i: Siéntate sobre un balón de estabilidad con una mancuerna en una mano.
Camina con los pies hacia adelante y baja el cuerpo rodando hasta que la cabeza, el cuello y la parte superior de la espalda queden apoyados sobre el balón.
Sostén la mancuerna con el brazo extendido recto hacia arriba sobre el pecho, con la palma hacia adentro.
Baja lentamente la mancuerna hacia el lado, manteniendo una ligera flexión en el codo.
Haz una pausa por un momento cuando el brazo esté paralelo al suelo.
Activa los músculos del pecho para llevar la mancuerna de nuevo hacia arriba hasta la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado, luego cambia de brazo.

exercises.n: press inclinado a un brazo con mancuerna
exercises.d: Press a single dumbbell up from shoulder height on an incline bench. It builds the upper chest and shoulders and evens out strength between sides.
i: Siéntate en un banco inclinado con una mancuerna en una mano, apoyada sobre el muslo.
Recuéstate en el banco y coloca la mancuerna a la altura del hombro, con la palma hacia adelante.
Empuja la mancuerna hacia arriba y ligeramente hacia adentro, extendiendo completamente el brazo.
Haz una pausa breve en la parte más alta, luego baja lentamente la mancuerna de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado, luego cambia al otro brazo.

exercises.n: press inclinado a un brazo con mancuerna en balón de estabilidad
exercises.en: dumbbell incline one arm press on exercise ball
exercises.d: A one-arm dumbbell press done with your upper back on a stability ball. Your core has to stay tight to keep you steady while the chest presses.
i: Siéntate sobre un balón de estabilidad con una mancuerna en una mano, con los pies apoyados en el suelo.
Camina lentamente con los pies hacia adelante, haciendo rodar el balón hasta que la cabeza, el cuello y la parte superior de la espalda queden apoyados sobre el balón.
Sostén la mancuerna a la altura del hombro con la palma hacia adelante.
Empuja la mancuerna hacia arriba hasta que el brazo quede completamente extendido.
Haz una pausa breve en la parte más alta, luego baja lentamente la mancuerna de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado, luego cambia al otro brazo.

exercises.n: press inclinado con mancuernas en balón de estabilidad
exercises.en: dumbbell incline press on exercise ball
exercises.d: A two-dumbbell press with your upper back on a stability ball. It trains the chest and shoulders while your core works to keep you balanced.
i: Siéntate sobre un balón de estabilidad con una mancuerna en cada mano, con las palmas hacia adelante.
Camina lentamente con los pies hacia adelante, bajando el cuerpo rodando sobre el balón hasta que la cabeza, el cuello y la parte superior de la espalda queden apoyados sobre el balón.
Sostén las mancuernas a la altura de los hombros, con los codos flexionados y apuntando hacia los lados.
Empuja las mancuernas hacia arriba, extendiendo completamente los brazos.
Haz una pausa breve en la parte alta, luego baja lentamente las mancuernas de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: pullover acostado con mancuerna en balón de estabilidad
exercises.en: dumbbell lying pullover on exercise ball
exercises.d: Lying across a stability ball, you arc one dumbbell back over your head and return it. It stretches and works the chest and lats.
i: Siéntate sobre un balón de estabilidad y rueda hacia adelante hasta que la parte superior de la espalda quede apoyada en el balón.
Sostén una mancuerna con ambas manos y extiende los brazos rectos hacia arriba sobre el pecho.
Baja lentamente la mancuerna detrás de la cabeza manteniendo los brazos rectos.
Haz una pausa por un momento, luego levanta la mancuerna de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: apertura a un brazo en banco con mancuerna
exercises.d: Flat bench fly with a single dumbbell. Lowering in a wide arc stretches one side of the chest, and bringing it back squeezes it.
i: Siéntate en un banco plano con una mancuerna en una mano, apoyándola sobre el muslo.
Recuéstate en el banco, manteniendo la mancuerna presionada contra el muslo.
Usando la mano libre, ayuda a levantar la mancuerna hasta la posición inicial.
Sostén la mancuerna directamente sobre el hombro con el brazo extendido y la palma hacia adentro.
Baja la mancuerna hacia el lado describiendo un amplio arco, manteniendo una ligera flexión en el codo.
Haz una pausa cuando el brazo esté paralelo al suelo, luego invierte el movimiento y lleva la mancuerna de vuelta a la posición inicial.
