exercises.n: estiramiento de espalda alcanzando arriba
exercises.d: Reaching both arms up and slightly back lengthens the lats and upper back. A simple stretch to open your sides.
i: Stand tall and reach both arms overhead with your palms facing each other.
Reach up and lean slightly back, keeping your lower back relaxed and your ribs down.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento de cuerpo completo acostado
exercises.d: Lying flat and reaching long through your arms and legs gives your whole body a gentle stretch. A nice reset after training.
i: Lie on your back with your arms overhead and your legs straight.
Reach your fingertips up and your toes down, as if you want to get taller.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento de espalda colgado con dos manos (con espaldera)
exercises.en: two handed hang back stretch (with training wall bars)
exercises.d: Hanging from wall bars with both hands lets gravity stretch your lats and decompress your back. Great after heavy pulling days.
i: Grip a wall bar overhead with both hands and walk your feet out slightly.
Let your body hang and sink your hips back, relaxing your upper back and shoulders.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento de espalda en suspensión en polea
exercises.d: Holding a cable attachment, you lean back and let your weight stretch your lats and back. Good for opening up the upper body.
i: Hold the cable attachment or handles with both hands at about chest height.
Lean back with straight arms and sit your hips back until you feel your back lengthen.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento de dorsal a un brazo
exercises.d: Reaching one arm overhead and leaning to the side stretches a single lat. Good for finding tight spots on each side.
i: Stand tall and hold a pole or frame with one hand above head height.
Lean away from the arm and sit your hips slightly back to feel a stretch along your side.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento lateral de dorsal
exercises.d: Bending sideways with an arm overhead lengthens the lat and the side of your trunk. A quick stretch for the flanks.
i: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and raise one arm overhead.
Lean to the opposite side from the raised arm, reaching over without twisting.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento de extensores del tronco inferior sentado
exercises.d: Seated and folding forward, you stretch the muscles along your lower back. A gentle way to ease lower back tightness.
i: Sit on the floor or a bench with your knees slightly bent and your feet flat.
Round your back and fold your chest toward your thighs, letting your arms hang down.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento de extensores y flexores laterales del tronco inferior sentado
exercises.en: seated lower trunk extensor lateral flexor stretch
exercises.d: Seated, you fold forward and sideways to stretch both the lower back and the side of your trunk. It targets one side at a time.
i: Sit tall on a chair or bench with your feet flat on the floor.
Fold forward and reach your hands toward one foot, letting your trunk bend slightly to that side.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento de espalda sentado inclinado
exercises.d: Sitting and bending over lets your upper body hang to stretch your whole back. A relaxed stretch to release tension.
i: Sit on a bench or chair with your feet flat and your knees apart.
Bend forward from your hips and let your head and arms hang between your knees.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento lateral sentado alcanzando
exercises.d: Seated, reaching over to the side stretches your lats and obliques. It is easy on the hips and good for desk breaks.
i: Sit tall with your legs crossed or your feet flat and place one hand on the floor beside you.
Reach your other arm up and over your head toward the side, lengthening along your flank.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento sentado con piernas cruzadas alcanzando hacia delante
exercises.en: sitting cross legged reach forward stretch
exercises.d: Sitting cross-legged and reaching forward opens your lower back and hips. It is a calm stretch that suits cooldowns.
i: Sit on the floor with your legs crossed and your back tall.
Walk your hands forward along the floor and fold from your hips until you feel a stretch.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento de extensores del tronco inferior recostado
exercises.d: Lying on your back and pulling your knees in stretches your lower back and hips. A soothing option after long periods of sitting.
i: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat.
Draw both knees toward your chest and hold them with your hands.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento sentado con pies juntos alcanzando hacia delante
exercises.en: sitting feet together reach forward stretch
exercises.d: Sitting with your soles together and reaching forward stretches your back and inner thighs. A gentle hip and back opener.
i: Sit on the floor with the soles of your feet together and your knees falling out.
Hold your feet and fold forward from your hips, keeping your spine long.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento de rodilla al pecho acostado
exercises.d: Pulling one knee toward your chest while lying down stretches your glutes and lower back. A classic, easy hip release.
i: Lie on your back with both legs extended.
Pull one knee toward your chest with both hands while the other leg stays flat.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento de rodilla al pecho de pie
exercises.d: Standing on one leg and hugging the other knee to your chest stretches your glutes and tests your balance. A good warm-up move.
i: Stand tall, using a wall for balance if needed.
Lift one knee and pull it gently toward your chest with both hands.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento de rotación de espalda de rodillas
exercises.d: Kneeling on all fours and rotating through your trunk mobilises and stretches your mid back. Slow and controlled works best.
i: Start on your hands and knees with your hands under your shoulders.
Place one hand behind your head and rotate your elbow up toward the ceiling.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento de rotación de espalda de pie
exercises.d: Rotating through your trunk while standing stretches your back and obliques. It is a quick way to loosen up your torso.
i: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms at chest height.
Rotate your upper body to one side, keeping your hips facing forward.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento de flexores del codo
exercises.d: Extending your arm and turning the palm outward stretches the muscles that bend your elbow. It targets the biceps and brachialis.
i: Extend one arm in front of you with your palm facing up.
Use your other hand to gently press the fingers down and back until you feel the stretch.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento de pronadores del antebrazo
exercises.d: Rotating your forearm outward stretches the muscles that turn the palm down. Handy for anyone who types or lifts a lot.
i: Extend one arm in front of you with your elbow straight and palm down.
Use your other hand to rotate the palm outward until you feel a stretch along your forearm.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

exercises.n: extensión de brazos en estiramiento vertical
exercises.en: extension of arms in vertical stretch
exercises.d: Arms stretched out vertically open up the front of the arm and shoulder. It lengthens the biceps and chest.
i: Stand tall with your arms raised straight overhead.
Press your arms back slightly and reach long through your fingertips.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento de brazos sobre un apoyo
exercises.d: Resting your arms on a support and sinking down stretches the biceps and front of the shoulders. The support does part of the work for you.
i: Place your hands or forearms on a bench or other stable support behind you.
Lower your body slightly and lean away until you feel a stretch in the front of your arms.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento en suspensión de barra en supinación
exercises.d: Hanging from a bar with palms facing you stretches the biceps and forearms. Let your body weight do the lengthening.
i: Grip a pull-up bar with an underhand, shoulder-width grip.
Let your body hang with your arms straight, relaxing your shoulders downward.
Take as much weight through your legs as you need to stay comfortable.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento en suspensión en máquina de polea en supinación
exercises.en: suspension in pulley machine in supination stretch
exercises.d: Hanging lightly from a pulley handle with palms up stretches the biceps and forearm. The pulley lets you control how much weight you load.
i: Hold a pulley handle with an underhand grip and your arm straight.
Lean your body weight back gently until you feel a stretch in the biceps and forearm.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento de brazos en banco predicador con barra EZ
exercises.d: Resting your arms on a preacher bench while holding an EZ bar lets the arms extend fully, stretching the biceps.
i: Sit at a preacher bench and rest your upper arms on the pad, holding an EZ bar.
Let the bar lower under control until your arms are fully extended, using a light load.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento de antebrazo con extensión de codo y supinación y pronación
exercises.en: elbow extension and supination pronation forearm stretch
exercises.d: Straightening your elbow and rotating your forearm stretches the muscles on both sides of the lower arm.
i: Extend one arm in front of you with your elbow straight.
Slowly rotate your palm up and down and let your other hand add gentle pressure at each end.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento de desviador cubital y extensor de muñeca
exercises.en: wrist ulnar deviator and extensor stretch
exercises.d: A forearm stretch that targets the wrist extensors with ulnar deviation, easing tightness after gripping or typing.
i: Extend one arm in front of you with the palm down.
Bend the wrist so your fingers point down.
Gently tilt the hand toward the little finger side.
Use the other hand to apply light pressure.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch arms.

exercises.n: estiramiento de desviador radial y extensor de muñeca
exercises.en: wrist radial deviator and extensor stretch
exercises.d: A forearm stretch that targets the wrist extensors with radial deviation.
i: Extend one arm in front of you with the palm down.
Bend the wrist so your fingers point down.
Gently tilt the hand toward the thumb side.
Use the other hand to apply light pressure.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch arms.

exercises.n: estiramiento de desviador radial y flexor de muñeca
exercises.en: wrist radial deviator and flexor stretch
exercises.d: A forearm stretch that targets the wrist flexors with radial deviation.
i: Extend one arm in front of you with the palm up.
Use your other hand to pull the fingers back toward you.
Gently tilt the hand toward the thumb side.
Keep the elbow straight and your shoulder relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch arms.

exercises.n: estiramiento de desviador cubital y flexor de muñeca
exercises.en: wrist ulnar deviator and flexor stretch
exercises.d: A forearm stretch that targets the wrist flexors with ulnar deviation.
i: Extend one arm in front of you with the palm up.
Use your other hand to pull the fingers back toward you.
Gently tilt the hand toward the little finger side.
Keep the elbow straight and your shoulder relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch arms.

exercises.n: estiramiento de flexores de los dedos
exercises.d: Pulling your fingers back stretches the muscles on the palm side of your forearm. Great after grip-heavy training or typing.
i: Extend one arm forward with your palm facing up or out.
Use your other hand to gently pull your fingers and palm back toward you.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento de extensores de los dedos
exercises.d: Bending your fingers down stretches the muscles on the back of your forearm. Handy to loosen up after lots of gripping.
i: Extend one arm forward with your palm facing down and your wrist relaxed.
Use your other hand to gently press your fingers and hand down toward you.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento de tríceps alcanzando hacia abajo
exercises.d: Reaching your hand down your upper back stretches the triceps and the back of the shoulder. A common warm-up and cooldown stretch.
i: Raise one arm overhead, bend the elbow and drop your hand behind your head.
Use your other hand to press your elbow gently back and down.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento de tríceps contra la pared
exercises.d: Leaning into a wall with your elbow bent overhead stretches the triceps. The wall gives a steady anchor.
i: Stand next to a wall and place your bent elbow on it above head height.
Lean your body forward and down until you feel the stretch along the back of your upper arm.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento de extensores del codo y ancóneo
exercises.d: A forearm and elbow stretch for the small muscle at the back of the elbow along with the triceps. Useful after pressing or typing.
i: Extend one arm forward and bend the elbow fully with your palm down.
Use your other hand to press your forearm toward your upper arm, then rotate it gently.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento de cuello con rotación
exercises.d: Turning your head slowly from side to side stretches the muscles around the neck. It is a gentle way to ease stiffness.
i: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly turn your head to one side, then to the other, as far as is comfortable.
Keep your chin level and avoid pushing into any pain.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento de cuello con flexión diagonal
exercises.d: Tilting your head diagonally forward stretches the back and side of the neck. It targets the muscle running from the neck to the shoulder blade.
i: Sit tall and gently turn your head about 45 degrees to one side.
Drop your chin diagonally toward your chest, using your hand for light added pressure.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento de extensión de cuello
exercises.d: Tilting your head back stretches the front of the neck. Go slowly and stay within a comfortable range.
i: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly tilt your head back to look up at the ceiling, keeping your jaw relaxed.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento de protracción de cuello
exercises.d: A gentle stretch that glides the head forward to open the back of the neck and the base of the skull.
i: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Keep your eyes level and slide your chin and head straight forward.
Stop when you feel a stretch at the back of the neck.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Draw your head back to neutral and relax.

exercises.n: estiramiento de flexión de cuello sentado
exercises.d: Seated chin-to-chest stretch for the muscles along the back of the neck.
i: Sit tall on a chair with your hands resting in your lap.
Slowly lower your chin toward your chest.
Let the weight of your head do the work, without forcing it.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Lift your head back to neutral slowly.

exercises.n: estiramiento de flexión de cuello hacia delante
exercises.d: Bends the neck forward to lengthen the muscles at the back of the neck and upper shoulders.
i: Stand or sit tall with your shoulders down.
Place both hands lightly behind your head.
Let your elbows drop forward and ease your head toward your chest.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Release your hands and return to neutral.

exercises.n: estiramiento de extensores del cuello
exercises.d: Lengthens the extensor muscles at the back of the neck by tucking the chin down.
i: Sit tall with your back straight.
Tuck your chin toward your chest.
Rest one hand on the back of your head and add very light pressure down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Remove your hand and lift your head slowly.

exercises.n: estiramiento de extensores del cuello con rotación
exercises.d: Combines forward bending with a turn of the head to stretch the back and side of the neck.
i: Sit tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Turn your head about 45 degrees to one side.
Rest a hand on the back of your head and ease your nose toward your armpit.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

exercises.n: estiramiento de flexores del cuello
exercises.d: Tilts the head back to stretch the muscles at the front of the neck.
i: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Lift your chin and slowly tilt your head back.
Keep the movement small and comfortable.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Return your head to neutral.

exercises.n: estiramiento de flexores del cuello con rotación
exercises.d: Stretches the front and side of the neck by combining a head tilt back with a turn.
i: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders down.
Turn your head slightly to one side.
Tilt your chin up and back until you feel a stretch along the front of your neck.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

exercises.n: estiramiento de extensores del cuello acostado
exercises.d: Lets gravity help stretch the back of the neck while you lie on your back.
i: Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Clasp your hands behind your head.
Gently lift your head and ease your chin toward your chest.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Lower your head back down slowly.

exercises.n: estiramiento de extensión de cuello acostado
exercises.d: Stretches the front of the neck by letting the head drop back from the edge of a bench or bed.
i: Lie on your back with your head near the edge of a bench or bed, shoulders supported.
Slowly let your head relax backward past the edge.
Support it with your hands if it feels heavy.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Use your hands to lift your head back up carefully.

exercises.n: estiramiento de cuello con rotación asistido
exercises.d: A hand-assisted head turn that stretches the muscles at the side of the neck.
i: Sit tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Turn your head to one side as far as is comfortable.
Place one hand on your chin and the other on the back of your head.
Add light pressure to deepen the turn.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

exercises.n: estiramiento de cuello con extensión e inclinación
exercises.d: Tilts the head back and to the side to stretch the front and side of the neck.
i: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders down.
Tilt your head back slightly.
Lower one ear toward the same shoulder.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

exercises.n: abdominal reverso declinado con piernas flexionadas
exercises.d: Reverse crunch on a decline bench that curls the hips toward the chest and trains the lower abs.
i: Lie on a decline bench and hold the top edge above your head.
Bring your knees up and bend them.
Curl your hips off the bench, drawing your knees toward your chest.
Lower back down slowly without swinging.
Keep the movement controlled throughout.

exercises.n: estiramiento estático de gemelos
exercises.d: A static calf stretch that lengthens the lower leg muscles and the Achilles area.
i: Stand facing a wall with one foot back and your heel on the floor.
Keep your back leg straight and lean toward the wall.
Press your back heel down until you feel a stretch in the calf.
Keep your hips square and your toes pointing forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

exercises.n: estiramiento de flexores de muñeca
exercises.d: A simple forearm stretch for the wrist flexors, helpful after gripping or typing.
i: Extend one arm in front of you with the palm up.
Use your other hand to pull the fingers back toward you.
Keep your elbow straight and your shoulder relaxed.
Feel the stretch along the inner forearm.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch arms.

exercises.n: push press inclinado
exercises.d: An incline press with a small leg drive that lets you move heavier loads and trains the upper chest and shoulders.
i: Set an incline bench and hold the bar at your upper chest.
Dip slightly through your legs to start momentum.
Drive the bar up while pressing with your arms.
Lock out above your chest, then lower under control.
Keep your core braced and your lower back from arching.

exercises.n: elevación de piernas con elevación de cadera
exercises.d: A lying leg raise finished with a hip lift that targets the lower abs.
i: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your hands by your sides.
Raise your legs to vertical.
Curl your hips up off the floor, pushing your feet toward the ceiling.
Lower your hips, then your legs, with control.
Keep your movement smooth and avoid swinging.

exercises.n: elevación de piernas con rodillas ligeramente flexionadas
exercises.d: A leg raise with slightly bent knees, a gentler version for the lower abs.
i: Lie on your back with your hands under your hips.
Bend your knees slightly and lift your feet off the floor.
Raise your legs until they are above your hips.
Lower slowly without letting your back arch.
Keep your core tight throughout.

exercises.n: elevación de piernas con elevación de cadera y cabeza arriba
exercises.en: leg raise hip lift with head up
exercises.d: Lying leg raise finished with a hip lift while the head stays raised, working the whole abdominal wall.
i: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your hands by your sides.
Lift your head and shoulders slightly off the floor.
Raise your legs to vertical.
Push your hips a little off the floor, lifting your feet toward the ceiling.
Lower your hips and legs slowly with control.

exercises.n: elevación de piernas acostado en máquina (rodillas flexionadas)
exercises.d: Machine-based lying leg raise with bent knees that loads the lower abs and hip flexors.
i: Lie back on the machine and grip the handles.
Bend your knees and place your legs under the pads.
Curl your knees up toward your chest.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly until you feel tension, then repeat.

exercises.n: abdominal total en máquina
exercises.d: Seated machine crunch that works the abs through a full range, loading the crunch with plates.
i: Adjust the seat and sit with your chest against the pad.
Hold the handles and set your feet firmly.
Curl your torso forward by contracting your abs.
Pause at the bottom.
Return slowly to the start without letting the weight drop.

exercises.n: abdominal declinado en máquina
exercises.d: Decline sit-up on a lever machine that adds resistance for stronger abdominal work.
i: Lie back on the decline seat and hook your feet under the pads.
Cross your arms or hold the handles.
Curl your torso up toward your knees.
Squeeze your abs at the top.
Lower back slowly under control.

exercises.n: extensión de tríceps de rodillas en polea v. 2
exercises.d: Kneeling cable extension that isolates the triceps by pushing the handle down from head height.
i: Attach a rope or bar to a high pulley and kneel facing away.
Hold it overhead with your elbows bent behind your head.
Keep your upper arms still and straighten your elbows.
Squeeze your triceps at full extension.
Return slowly to the start.

exercises.n: hiperextensión v. 2
exercises.d: Back extension on a bench that strengthens the lower back, glutes and hamstrings.
i: Set the pad at hip level and hook your heels under the rollers.
Cross your arms over your chest and keep your body straight.
Bend forward at the hips with a flat back.
Lift your torso until it forms a straight line with your legs.
Do not overarch at the top, then lower with control.

exercises.n: curl en polea con barra V multiuso
exercises.en: cable curl with multipurpose v bar
exercises.d: Standing cable curl using a V bar, giving constant tension on the biceps.
i: Attach a multipurpose V bar to a low pulley and grip it with palms up.
Stand tall with your elbows at your sides.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly without letting your elbows drift.

exercises.n: press de hombros en polea con palanca
exercises.d: Seated machine press that builds the shoulders and triceps along a guided path.
i: Adjust the seat so the handles are at shoulder height.
Sit back with your feet flat and grip the handles.
Press upward until your arms are nearly straight.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly back to the start.

exercises.n: jalón trasero en polea con palanca
exercises.d: Machine pulldown behind the line of the body that trains the lats and upper back.
i: Adjust the seat and grip the handles overhead.
Sit tall with your chest up.
Pull the handles down, driving your elbows toward your sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the bottom.
Return slowly to full stretch.

exercises.n: abdominal con declinación extra
exercises.d: A steeper decline sit-up that increases the load on the abs.
i: Set a decline bench to a steep angle and hook your feet under the pads.
Lie back and cross your arms over your chest.
Curl your torso up until you are sitting.
Squeeze your abs at the top.
Lower slowly back down.

exercises.n: dominada con agarre martillo en jaula de fondos
exercises.en: hammer grip pull up on dip cage
exercises.d: Pull-up with palms facing each other on the dip cage handles, hitting the lats and arms.
i: Grab the neutral grip handles with your palms facing each other.
Hang with your arms fully extended.
Pull your chest toward the handles by driving your elbows down.
Pause with your chin above the bars.
Lower slowly to a full hang.

exercises.n: dominada con agarre abierto en jaula de fondos
exercises.en: wide grip pull up on dip cage
exercises.d: Wide-grip pull-up performed on the dip cage that emphasises the lats.
i: Grab the wide handles with your palms facing forward.
Hang with your arms fully extended.
Pull yourself up by driving your elbows down and back.
Pause when your chin clears the bar.
Lower slowly to a full hang.

exercises.n: aducción de cadera sentado en máquina v. 2
exercises.d: Seated machine move that squeezes the legs together to train the inner thighs.
i: Sit on the machine with your back against the pad.
Place your legs against the pads, set wide.
Squeeze your legs together smoothly.
Pause for a moment when they meet.
Open slowly back to the start.

exercises.n: sentadilla con barra baja (con rack)
exercises.d: Squat with the bar low on the back, taken from a rack, that works the glutes, thighs and back.
i: Set the bar in the rack and place it on your rear delts, below the traps.
Step back and set your feet shoulder width.
Lean forward slightly and sit your hips back and down.
Descend until your thighs are at least parallel.
Drive through your heels to stand, keeping your chest up.

exercises.n: abducción de cadera sentado en máquina v. 2
exercises.d: Seated machine move that pushes the legs outward to train the outer hips.
i: Sit with your back against the pad and your legs inside the pads.
Hold the handles for stability.
Push your legs apart smoothly.
Pause at the widest point.
Return slowly without letting the weights crash.

exercises.n: jalón lateral en máquina (con discos)
exercises.d: Plate-loaded machine pulldown that trains the lats and upper back.
i: Adjust the seat and grip the handles overhead.
Sit tall with your chest up.
Pull down until the handles reach chest level.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly to full stretch.

exercises.n: fondos de tríceps en máquina (con discos)
exercises.d: Seated plate-loaded dip machine that builds the triceps.
i: Sit upright and grip the handles beside you.
Set your elbows tight to your sides.
Press down until your arms are straight.
Squeeze your triceps.
Return slowly to the start.

exercises.n: curl predicador en máquina (con discos)
exercises.d: Plate-loaded preacher curl that isolates the biceps with the arms supported.
i: Adjust the seat so your upper arms rest on the pad.
Grip the handles with your palms up.
Curl up until your biceps are fully contracted.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly until your arms are almost straight.

exercises.n: extensión de pierna en máquina (con discos)
exercises.d: Plate-loaded leg extension that isolates the front of the thighs.
i: Sit with your back against the pad and your shins behind the roller.
Hold the handles.
Extend your knees until your legs are straight.
Squeeze your quads at the top.
Lower slowly under control.

exercises.n: extensión de pierna alternada en máquina (con discos)
exercises.d: One leg at a time on a plate-loaded extension machine, evening out strength between the legs.
i: Sit with your back against the pad and your shins behind the rollers.
Hold the handles.
Extend one leg until it is straight.
Lower it slowly.
Repeat with the other leg and keep alternating.

exercises.n: sentadilla en máquina (con discos)
exercises.d: Plate-loaded squat machine that lets you load the legs with a supported back.
i: Step under the shoulder pads and set your feet shoulder width.
Release the safeties and stand tall.
Sit down and back until your thighs are parallel.
Drive through your heels to stand.
Keep your chest up and your knees tracking over your toes.

exercises.n: elevación lateral en máquina (con discos)
exercises.d: Plate-loaded machine raise that targets the side of the shoulders.
i: Adjust the seat and place your arms against the pads.
Sit upright.
Raise your arms out to the sides until about shoulder height.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly to the start.

exercises.n: estiramiento de aductores de pie con cadera hacia fuera
exercises.d: Standing stretch that pushes the hip out to the side to lengthen the inner thigh.
i: Stand tall with your feet wider than hip width.
Shift your weight onto one leg and bend that knee.
Keep the other leg straight, foot flat.
Push your hip out until you feel a stretch in the inner thigh.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

exercises.n: estiramiento de abductores de pie con piernas cruzadas
exercises.d: Cross one leg behind the other to stretch the outer hip and thigh.
i: Stand tall, next to a wall if you need balance.
Cross one leg behind the other.
Lean your hips toward the side of your back leg.
Feel the stretch along the outer hip.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

exercises.n: estiramiento de cadera de pie con pierna apoyada
exercises.d: Rest one leg on a raised surface and lean in to stretch the hips.
i: Stand facing a bench or step.
Place one heel on it with the knee slightly bent.
Keep your chest tall and hinge forward at the hips.
Feel the stretch in the hip and glute.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

exercises.n: estiramiento de abductores inclinado
exercises.d: Leaning stretch for the outer hip and thigh.
i: Stand next to a wall and lean on it with one hand.
Cross your outer leg behind the inner one.
Lean your hips toward the wall.
Keep both feet flat.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

exercises.n: estiramiento de abductores de pie con pierna por debajo
exercises.d: Tuck one leg under the other in standing to stretch the outer hip.
i: Stand tall near a support.
Pass one leg behind and under the other.
Push your hips gently to the side of the back leg.
Keep your torso upright.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

exercises.n: estiramiento de abductores acostado
exercises.d: Floor stretch that pulls one leg across the body to open the outer hip.
i: Lie on your back with your legs straight.
Bring one knee up and across your body.
Use the opposite hand to ease it toward the floor.
Keep your shoulders flat on the ground.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

exercises.n: estiramiento de abductores acostado en balón de estabilidad
exercises.d: Lying stretch using a stability ball for support while opening the outer hip.
i: Lie on your back with your calves resting on a stability ball.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Roll the ball gently to bring your legs toward your chest.
Feel the stretch in the outer hip.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

exercises.n: estiramiento de abductores acostado con pierna colgando
exercises.d: Lie on a bench and let one leg hang across for a gravity-assisted hip stretch.
i: Lie on your back on a bench.
Cross one leg over your body and let it hang off the side.
Keep your shoulders flat.
Let gravity lower the leg slowly.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

exercises.n: estiramiento de aquiles de pie con punta arriba
exercises.d: Stretches the calf and Achilles by lifting the toes against a wall.
i: Stand facing a wall with one foot forward.
Place the ball of the forward foot against the wall, heel on the floor.
Lean your hips toward the wall.
Feel the stretch in the calf and Achilles.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

exercises.n: estiramiento de aquiles con caída de un talón
exercises.d: Lets one heel drop off a step to stretch the Achilles and calf.
i: Stand on a step with the ball of one foot on the edge.
Hold a rail for balance.
Lower your heel slowly below the step.
Keep the knee straight for the calf, then slightly bent for the soleus.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

exercises.n: estiramiento de aquiles de pie con talón atrás
exercises.d: Classic lunge-style calf stretch with the back heel kept down.
i: Stand facing a wall and step one foot back.
Keep the back leg straight and the heel down.
Bend your front knee and lean forward.
Feel the stretch in the back calf.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

exercises.n: estiramiento de aquiles de pie
exercises.d: Simple standing stretch for the Achilles tendon and calf.
i: Stand near a wall or support.
Step one foot back with the heel down.
Slightly bend the back knee to target the lower Achilles.
Keep your back foot pointing forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

exercises.n: estiramiento de aquiles sentado tirando de la punta
exercises.d: Seated stretch where you pull the toes toward you.
i: Sit on the floor with one leg straight.
Loop a towel around the ball of your foot or grip your toes.
Pull your toes toward your shin.
Keep your knee straight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

exercises.n: estiramiento de aquiles en cuclillas con talón atrás
exercises.d: Low crouch stretch with one heel pushed back to lengthen the Achilles.
i: Crouch down with your hands on the floor for balance.
Extend one leg back with the heel down.
Press the heel toward the floor.
Keep your chest lifted.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

exercises.n: estiramiento de dedos del pie en sentadilla
exercises.d: Kneeling on the toes to stretch the feet and front of the ankles.
i: Kneel on a mat with your toes tucked under.
Sit back onto your heels slowly.
Rest your hands on your thighs.
Ease off if the stretch is too sharp.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Release and shake out your feet.

exercises.n: estiramiento de aquiles de rodillas con talón abajo
exercises.d: Kneeling stretch with the heel pressed down to lengthen the Achilles.
i: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward.
Lean forward, keeping your front heel on the floor.
Press your front knee over your toes.
Feel the stretch behind the ankle.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

exercises.n: estiramiento de aquiles en cuclillas
exercises.d: Deep squat hold that opens the ankles and calves.
i: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Sink into a deep squat with your heels down.
Hold on to a support if needed.
Gently shift your weight forward over your toes.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Stand up slowly.

exercises.n: estiramiento de aductores de pie con rodillas abiertas
exercises.d: A standing wide-stance stretch for the inner thighs.
i: Stand with your feet wide apart and toes pointing slightly out.
Bend your knees and place your hands on your thighs.
Shift your weight from side to side, sinking into the stretch.
Keep your chest tall and your back flat.
Hold for 20-30 seconds on each side.

exercises.n: estiramiento rotacional de cadera de pie
exercises.d: Rotates the hip in standing to stretch the glutes and deep hip muscles.
i: Stand tall near a support.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Sit your hips back as if sitting into a chair.
Feel the stretch in the hip of the crossed leg.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

exercises.n: estiramiento de aductores de cadera de pie con pierna elevada
exercises.en: standing raised leg hip adductor stretch
exercises.d: A standing stretch with one leg raised on a support that opens the inner thigh.
i: Stand tall and place one foot on a bench or raised surface to the side.
Keep your standing leg straight and your toes forward.
Shift your weight toward the raised leg side until you feel a stretch.
Keep your chest upright and your hips square.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

exercises.n: estiramiento de aductores de pie con pierna arriba
exercises.d: Stretch for the inner thigh with one leg raised and out to the side.
i: Stand next to a bench or low support.
Place one foot on it with the leg out to the side.
Keep your hips square.
Shift your weight toward the raised leg.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

exercises.n: estiramiento de aductores de rodillas con pierna hacia fuera
exercises.d: A kneeling stretch with one leg extended to the side to open the inner thigh and groin.
i: Kneel on all fours with your knees under your hips.
Extend one leg out to the side with the foot flat.
Sit your hips back toward the opposite heel.
Keep your back straight and your extended leg straight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

exercises.n: estiramiento de aductores con zancada lateral
exercises.d: A wide side lunge that stretches the inner thigh of the straight leg.
i: Stand with your feet wide apart.
Shift your weight to one side and bend that knee.
Keep the other leg straight with the foot flat.
Keep your chest tall.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

exercises.n: estiramiento de aductores de cadera de pie con rodilla flexionada
exercises.en: standing bent knee hip adductor stretch
exercises.d: Standing stretch with a bent knee that opens the inner thigh and hip.
i: Stand with your feet wide.
Bend one knee and lower into that side.
Keep your other leg straight.
Push the bent knee gently out with your hand.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

exercises.n: estiramiento de aductores de rodillas boca abajo
exercises.d: A floor stretch that opens up the inner thighs while you rest face down on your forearms.
i: Kneel on a mat, then lower your chest and forearms to the floor.
Slide your knees wide apart and sink your hips back toward your heels until you feel the inner thighs stretch.
Keep your breathing slow and stay relaxed, without bouncing.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento de aductores sentado con piernas abiertas
exercises.d: Seated straddle that stretches the inner thighs.
i: Sit on the floor with your legs spread wide.
Keep your knees pointing up.
Hinge forward from the hips with a long spine.
Walk your hands forward until you feel the stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Come up slowly.

exercises.n: estiramiento de abducción de cadera con flexión al frente
exercises.en: hip abduction with flexion in front stretch
exercises.d: Brings the leg forward and out to open the outer hip.
i: Sit on the floor with one leg bent in front of you.
Place the other leg to the side.
Lean your torso forward over the front shin.
Keep your hips grounded.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

exercises.n: estiramiento de aductores de pie con piernas abiertas
exercises.d: A standing side lunge position that lengthens the inner thighs.
i: Stand with your feet wide apart, toes pointing slightly out.
Shift your weight to one side and bend that knee while the other leg stays straight, and feel the inner thigh stretch.
Keep your chest up and the straight leg's foot flat on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento acostado apoyado contra la pared
exercises.en: lying leaning against the wall stretch
exercises.d: Lie with your legs resting on a wall and let them fall open to stretch the inner thighs.
i: Lie on your back with your hips close to a wall.
Rest your legs straight up the wall.
Let your legs fall slowly out to the sides.
Relax and let gravity do the work.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Bring your legs together to finish.

exercises.n: estiramiento de abducción de una pierna con flexión
exercises.en: abduction of one leg flexion stretch
exercises.d: Lying on your back, you open one leg out to the side to stretch the inner thigh and groin.
i: Lie on your back with your legs straight.
Bend one knee, let it fall out to the side and, if needed, ease it down with your hand until the inner thigh stretches.
Keep your lower back and the opposite hip flat on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento asistido de aductores acostado
exercises.d: Partner-assisted stretch for the inner thighs.
i: Lie on your back with your legs straight.
Have your partner lift one leg slightly and move it out to the side.
Keep your hips level.
Tell your partner to stop at a comfortable stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

exercises.n: estiramiento de isquiotibiales de pie con punta abajo
exercises.d: Stretches the back of the thigh with the toes lowered.
i: Stand with one heel on the floor in front of you.
Point your toes down.
Hinge forward from the hips with a flat back.
Keep the front leg nearly straight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

exercises.n: estiramiento de isquiotibiales de pie con punta arriba
exercises.d: Standing stretch with one heel on the floor and toes pulled up, lengthening the back of the thigh and calf.
i: Stand tall and step one foot forward, resting the heel on the floor with the toes pulled up.
Keep the front leg straight and the back knee slightly bent.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back until you feel a pull behind the thigh.
Keep your chest open and avoid rounding your spine.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.n: estiramiento de isquiotibiales de pie con pierna arriba
exercises.d: Rest one heel on a raised surface and lean forward to stretch the back of the thigh.
i: Stand facing a low support and place one heel on it with the leg straight.
Hinge forward from the hips with a long back until you feel the back of the thigh stretch.
Keep your toes pointing up and your standing knee soft.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento de flexores de rodilla con pierna elevada
exercises.d: A hamstring stretch with one leg raised onto a support, easing tension in the back of the thigh.
i: Place one heel on a low bench or step in front of you with the leg straight.
Stand tall with the standing knee soft.
Hinge forward from the hips, keeping your back flat, until you feel a stretch behind the raised thigh.
Keep your toes pointing up and breathe slowly.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.n: estiramiento de isquiotibiales de pie con pierna alta y rodilla flexionada
exercises.en: standing high leg bent knee hamstring stretch
exercises.d: A hamstring stretch with the foot raised high and the knee slightly bent for a deeper but friendlier pull.
i: Stand tall and place one heel on a high support with the knee slightly bent.
Lean your chest toward your thigh with a flat back until you feel the stretch behind the thigh.
Straighten the knee a little more as you get looser.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento de isquiotibiales de rodillas con punta arriba
exercises.d: Kneeling on one knee with the other leg extended and toes up to stretch the hamstring and calf.
i: Kneel on one knee and extend the other leg in front, heel on the floor and toes pulled up.
Place your hands on the floor or the front thigh for support.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back until you feel a pull behind the extended leg.
Keep the extended knee straight but not locked.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.n: estiramiento de flexores de rodilla y aductores de cadera sentado
exercises.en: seated knee flexor and hip adductor stretch
exercises.d: Seated wide leg stretch that opens the inner thighs while lengthening the hamstrings.
i: Sit on the floor with your legs spread wide and knees straight.
Sit tall with your toes pointing up.
Hinge forward from the hips, walking your hands out in front of you.
Stop when you feel a stretch along the inner thighs and backs of the legs.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly, then sit back up.

exercises.n: estiramiento de flexores de rodilla sentado
exercises.d: A seated reach toward the toes that lengthens the hamstrings.
i: Sit on the floor with one leg straight out in front of you.
Reach toward your toes with a long back until you feel the back of the thigh stretch.
Keep your knee straight but not locked, and avoid rounding your back too much.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento de isquiotibiales de pie alcanzando hacia abajo
exercises.d: A standing forward fold that stretches the hamstrings and calves.
i: Stand with your feet hip width apart.
Hinge at the hips and reach your hands down toward your shins or toes until you feel the back of the thighs stretch.
Let your head and neck hang relaxed and keep a slight bend in the knees.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento de isquiotibiales de pie alcanzando hacia abajo con piernas cruzadas
exercises.en: standing reach down hamstring crossed legs stretch
exercises.d: A standing forward fold with the legs crossed, which shifts the stretch to the back of the rear leg.
i: Stand tall and cross one foot over the other.
Hinge forward at the hips and reach toward the floor until the back of the thighs stretch.
Keep both legs fairly straight and let your head hang relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento de rotadores externos y extensores de cadera sentado
exercises.en: seated hip external rotator and hip extensor stretch
exercises.d: A seated figure four style stretch for the buttocks and deep hip rotators.
i: Sit upright on the floor or a chair and cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Gently press the raised knee down and lean your chest forward with a long back until the buttock stretches.
Keep your spine long instead of collapsing forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento de cadera sentado con la pierna contraria desde atrás
exercises.en: seated hip stretch with opposite leg from behind
exercises.d: A seated hip stretch with one leg folded in front and the other tucked behind you.
i: Sit on the floor with one leg bent in front of you and the other leg bent behind.
Lean your chest forward over the front shin until you feel the stretch deep in the hip and buttock.
Keep both sit bones as level as you can.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento de flexión plantar
exercises.d: Pointing the foot downward to stretch the front of the ankle and shin.
i: Sit on a chair or the floor with one leg extended.
Point your toes away from you as far as is comfortable.
Gently press the top of the foot with your hand for a little extra stretch.
Keep the movement slow and avoid forcing the ankle.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.n: estiramiento de flexores de rodilla recostado
exercises.d: Lying on your back, you lift one straight leg to stretch the hamstring with the lower back supported.
i: Lie on your back with both legs straight.
Lift one leg toward the ceiling, holding behind the thigh or calf.
Keep the knee as straight as is comfortable and the other leg flat on the floor.
Gently draw the leg toward you until you feel a pull behind the thigh.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.n: estiramiento de flexores de rodilla recostado con toalla
exercises.en: recumbent knee flexor stretch with towel
exercises.d: A lying hamstring stretch where a towel around the foot lets you pull the leg closer without strain.
i: Lie on your back and loop a towel around the ball of one foot.
Raise that leg toward the ceiling, holding both ends of the towel.
Keep the knee nearly straight and the other leg flat on the floor.
Gently pull the towel until you feel a stretch behind the thigh.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.n: estiramiento asistido de isquiotibiales acostado
exercises.d: A partner lifts your straight leg to deepen a relaxed hamstring stretch.
i: Lie on your back with your legs straight and relax completely.
Have a partner lift one leg by the heel, keeping the knee straight.
Tell your partner to stop when you feel a pull behind the thigh.
Keep your other leg and lower back flat on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

exercises.n: estiramiento de gemelos de pie con punta arriba
exercises.d: Standing with the toes lifted against a surface to stretch the calf.
i: Stand facing a wall or step and place the ball of one foot against it with the heel on the floor.
Keep the leg straight.
Lean your hips gently toward the wall until you feel a stretch in the calf.
Keep your heel down and your back tall.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.n: estiramiento de gemelos con caída de un talón
exercises.d: Dropping one heel off a step to stretch the calf through a full range.
i: Stand on the edge of a step with the ball of one foot on it and hold a rail for balance.
Slowly lower that heel below the step until you feel the calf stretch.
Keep the knee straight to hit the calf, then bend it slightly to reach deeper into the soleus.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento de flexores plantares y eversores del pie
exercises.en: plantar flexor and foot everter stretch
exercises.d: A seated ankle stretch that lengthens the calf and the outer side of the lower leg.
i: Sit with one leg extended and hold the foot with your hand.
Point the foot down and turn the sole slightly outward.
Gently press the foot until you feel a stretch along the front and outer ankle.
Move slowly and stop at a mild stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.n: estiramiento de flexores plantares e inversores del pie
exercises.en: plantar flexor and foot inverter stretch
exercises.d: A seated ankle stretch that lengthens the front of the lower leg and the inner side of the ankle.
i: Sit with one leg extended and hold the foot with your hand.
Point the foot down and turn the sole slightly inward.
Gently press the foot until you feel a stretch along the front and inner ankle.
Move slowly and stop at a mild stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.n: estiramiento tibial en espaldera
exercises.en: tibial flexion stretch on wall bar
exercises.d: A stretch using a wall bar to flex the ankle and lengthen the muscles of the lower leg.
i: Stand facing the wall bars and place the front of one foot against a low bar.
Lean your body forward and press your heel toward the floor until the lower leg stretches.
Hold the bars with your hands to stay balanced.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento tibial con rodilla semiflexionada
exercises.en: tibial stretch with semi flexed knee
exercises.d: A bent-knee stretch that targets the lower calf and the muscles around the shin.
i: Stand facing a wall with one foot back and the toes pressed against the wall or floor.
Bend the knee of the stretching leg slightly.
Shift your weight forward until you feel a stretch low in the calf.
Keep the heel on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.n: estiramiento de gemelos en cuclillas con talón atrás
exercises.d: A deep crouch with the heels pressed back to stretch the calves and Achilles area.
i: Crouch down with your feet flat and hands on the floor for balance.
Shift one heel backward and press it toward the floor.
Keep the other leg bent and supporting your weight.
Feel the stretch in the calf of the pressing leg.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.n: estiramiento en cuclillas con flexión de cadera y rodilla
exercises.en: hip and knee flexion squatting stretch
exercises.d: A deep squat hold that opens the hips and loosens the knees and ankles.
i: Stand with your feet a little wider than your shoulders and toes turned slightly out.
Sink down into a deep squat and press your elbows against your inner knees to open the hips.
Keep your heels on the floor and your chest tall.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento asistido de cadera boca arriba
exercises.en: assisted lying hip stretch in supine position
exercises.d: A partner guides your bent knee toward your chest to stretch the hips and glutes while you stay relaxed.
i: Lie on your back with your legs straight and relax.
Have a partner bring one knee slowly toward your chest.
Tell them to stop when you feel a stretch in the hip and buttock.
Keep the other leg flat on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

exercises.n: estiramiento de rotación sentado con rodilla arriba
exercises.d: A seated twist with one knee raised that stretches the hip and buttock.
i: Sit on the floor with one leg straight and the other knee bent, foot flat on the floor.
Cross the bent leg over the straight one, and rotate your torso toward the raised knee, hugging it with the opposite arm.
Sit tall and twist from the middle of your back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento de rotación extendida sentado con rodilla arriba
exercises.en: seated knee up extended rotation stretch
exercises.d: A seated twist with the raised knee and the back leg extended, giving the hip a longer stretch.
i: Sit on the floor with one leg extended and the other knee bent and crossed over it.
Rotate your torso toward the bent knee, using the opposite elbow to guide it, until the hip stretches.
Keep your spine long and look over your back shoulder.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento acostado con rodilla cruzada tirando hacia arriba
exercises.en: lying cross over knee pull up stretch
exercises.d: Lying on your back and drawing a crossed knee up toward the opposite shoulder to stretch the glutes and hips.
i: Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Hold the knee of the lower leg or behind the thigh and pull it up toward your chest.
Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.n: estiramiento acostado con rodilla cruzada tirando hacia abajo
exercises.en: lying cross over knee pull down stretch
exercises.d: Lying on your back and guiding a crossed knee down across the body to stretch the outer hip and glutes.
i: Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Use your hand to guide the crossed knee gently down and across your body.
Keep your shoulders on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.n: estiramiento de glúteo sentado con rodilla flexionada al pecho
exercises.en: seated bent knee to chest buttock stretch
exercises.d: Pulling a bent knee toward your chest to stretch the buttock muscles.
i: Sit on the floor with your legs out in front.
Bend one knee, hold it with both hands and gently pull it toward your chest.
Keep your back tall and avoid rounding it as you pull.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento de cadera sentado con pierna ligeramente flexionada
exercises.en: seated hip stretch with slightly bent leg
exercises.d: A relaxed seated hip stretch with the front leg slightly bent, easy on the knee.
i: Sit on the floor with one leg slightly bent in front of you and the other leg folded comfortably.
Hinge forward from the hips with a long back until you feel the hip and buttock stretch.
Keep the knee of the front leg soft throughout.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento de rotadores externos y extensores de cadera recostado
exercises.en: recumbent hip external rotator and hip extensor stretch
exercises.d: A lying stretch for the deep hip rotators and glutes, pulling the knee toward the chest.
i: Lie on your back and bend both knees.
Bring one knee toward your chest and turn it slightly outward.
Hold the shin and ankle and draw the leg closer.
Keep your lower back resting on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.n: estiramiento de glúteos sentado con pie al pecho
exercises.en: sitting foot to chest buttocks stretch
exercises.d: A seated stretch pulling the foot toward the chest to open the hips and buttocks.
i: Sit on the floor with your back tall and legs extended.
Bend one knee and hold the foot and shin.
Pull the foot gently toward your chest while keeping your spine upright.
Feel the stretch deep in the buttock and hip.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.n: estiramiento de aducción de cadera de pie
exercises.d: Crossing one leg behind the other and leaning aside to stretch the outer hip.
i: Stand tall and cross one leg behind the other, feet close together.
Lean your torso away from the back leg and push the hip out slightly until you feel the outer hip stretch.
Keep both feet flat on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento de banda iliotibial de pie
exercises.d: A standing side lean that stretches the iliotibial band along the outside of the thigh.
i: Stand next to a wall or support and cross your outer leg behind the other.
Lean your hips toward the wall and reach the outer arm overhead until the outside of the hip and thigh stretches.
Keep your chest facing forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento de cadera de paloma
exercises.d: A yoga-style hip opener with one shin folded in front, stretching the glutes and the hip flexors of the back leg.
i: Start on hands and knees and slide one knee forward behind your wrist.
Extend the other leg straight behind you.
Lower your hips toward the floor and keep your chest tall.
Fold forward over the front leg for a deeper stretch if comfortable.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.n: estiramiento de rotadores externos de cadera
exercises.d: A floor stretch for the deep hip rotators and buttock muscles.
i: Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee and pull the lower thigh toward your chest until the buttock stretches.
Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento de cadera de pie con pierna recogida
exercises.d: A standing stretch drawing one knee up and in to open the hip and glutes.
i: Stand tall, holding a wall or support for balance.
Lift one knee and hold the shin and ankle with both hands.
Pull the leg gently toward your chest and slightly across the body.
Keep your standing leg soft and your back straight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.n: estiramiento de cadera externa de pie
exercises.d: A standing side stretch that lengthens the outer hip and thigh.
i: Stand next to a wall and cross one leg behind the other.
Push your hips sideways toward the wall.
Lean your upper body away from the hips until you feel the outer hip stretch.
Keep both feet flat on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.n: estiramiento rotacional de cadera sentado
exercises.d: A seated rotation that works the hip through a twisting stretch.
i: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and both feet flat.
Let both knees drop to one side and rotate your torso the opposite way until you feel the hip stretch.
Keep your hands behind you for support.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento de flexores de cadera de pie
exercises.d: A standing lunge-style stretch for the front of the hip and thigh.
i: Stand and step one foot forward and the other back into a staggered stance.
Tuck your pelvis and squeeze the glute of the back leg.
Shift your hips slightly forward until you feel a stretch at the front of the back hip.
Keep your torso upright.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.n: estiramiento externo sentado a una pierna
exercises.d: A seated stretch that opens one hip by turning the leg outward.
i: Sit on the floor and bend one leg so the foot rests against the opposite thigh.
Lean your chest forward over the bent leg while pressing the knee toward the floor until the hip stretches.
Keep your back long.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

exercises.n: extensión de una pierna asistida
exercises.d: A partner-assisted leg movement that gently stretches the hip and thigh.
i: Lie on your back and relax.
Have a partner support one leg and gently extend it.
Let the partner move the leg only to a mild stretch.
Keep your lower back flat on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

exercises.n: estiramiento de flexores de cadera y extensores de rodilla de pie sobre una pierna con apoyo
exercises.en: supported one leg standing hip flexor and knee extensor stretch
exercises.d: A supported standing quad stretch that also opens the front of the hip.
i: Stand tall holding a wall or chair for support.
Bend one knee and hold the ankle behind you.
Pull the heel toward your glutes and push the hip slightly forward.
Keep your knees close together.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.n: estiramiento de cuádriceps en cajón
exercises.d: A quad stretch with the back foot resting on a box or bench, opening the front of the thigh.
i: Stand facing away from a box or bench and place the top of one foot on it behind you.
Stand tall on the front leg with a soft knee.
Tuck your pelvis and lower the hips slightly until you feel a stretch in the front of the thigh.
Hold a support for balance if needed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.n: estiramiento de cuádriceps inclinado hacia atrás a una pierna
exercises.d: Kneeling with one leg folded and leaning back to stretch the quadriceps.
i: Kneel on both knees, then lift one foot out in front so that the other leg is folded.
Place your hands behind you on the floor.
Lean back slowly until you feel a stretch in the front of the folded thigh.
Keep your hips lifted and avoid sagging into the lower back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.n: estiramiento de cuádriceps inclinado hacia atrás con ambas piernas
exercises.d: Sitting back on your heels and leaning back to stretch both quadriceps at once.
i: Kneel and sit back so your hips rest on your heels.
Place your hands on the floor behind you.
Lean back slowly and lift the hips slightly until you feel a stretch in the front of both thighs.
Stop if you feel any pinch in the knees.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then come back up slowly.

exercises.n: estiramiento de espinilla de pie
exercises.d: Standing with the top of the foot on the floor to stretch the muscles at the front of the shin.
i: Stand tall and hold a wall for balance.
Place the top of one foot on the floor behind you with the toes curled under.
Gently press the foot down by bending the standing knee.
Feel the stretch along the front of the shin and ankle.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.n: estiramiento de extensores de los dedos del pie de pie
exercises.d: Pressing the tops of the toes against the floor to stretch the front of the foot and shin.
i: Stand next to a support and place the top of one foot on the floor behind you with the toes curled under.
Gently bend your standing knee and press the toes down until you feel the stretch on top of the foot and shin.
Keep the pressure light and controlled.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento de espinilla con pie elevado
exercises.d: A stretch with the foot raised on a support, easing the shin and top of the ankle.
i: Stand next to a wall and lift one foot behind you onto a low support with the top of the foot down.
Keep your torso upright and your standing leg soft.
Press your hips forward gently until you feel the shin stretch.
Keep the movement slow and controlled.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.n: estiramiento de espinilla de rodillas con ambas piernas
exercises.d: Kneeling and sitting back onto your heels to stretch the front of the shins and ankles.
i: Kneel on a mat with your feet pointing straight back and the tops of the feet on the floor.
Slowly sit back toward your heels until you feel the shins and ankles stretch.
Place your hands on the floor in front of you to control the pressure.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento de dedos del pie en cuclillas
exercises.d: A deep squat on the balls of the feet that stretches the toes and the bottom of the feet.
i: Crouch down with your heels lifted and toes tucked under.
Place your hands on the floor in front of you for support.
Slowly sit back toward your heels until you feel the toes and soles stretch.
Ease off if the stretch is too sharp.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then release.

exercises.n: estiramiento de extensores de los dedos del pie sentado
exercises.d: A seated stretch for the muscles that lift the toes, using your hand to point the toes downward.
i: Sit and cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Hold the top of the foot and toes with your hand.
Gently curl the toes and foot downward until you feel a stretch on the top.
Keep the motion gentle.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.n: estiramiento de extensores de los dedos y eversores del pie sentado
exercises.en: seated toe extensor and foot everter stretch
exercises.d: Seated stretch combining pointing the toes down with a turn of the sole outward.
i: Sit and cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Hold the top of the foot and toes with your hand.
Curl the toes down and turn the sole gently outward.
Feel the stretch along the top and outer edge of the foot.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.n: estiramiento de extensores de los dedos e inversores del pie sentado
exercises.en: seated toe extensor and foot inverter stretch
exercises.d: Seated stretch combining pointing the toes down with a turn of the sole inward.
i: Sit and cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Hold the top of the foot and toes with your hand.
Curl the toes down and turn the sole gently inward.
Feel the stretch along the top and inner edge of the foot.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.n: estiramiento de flexores de los dedos del pie sentado
exercises.d: A seated stretch pulling the toes back to lengthen the bottom of the foot.
i: Sit and cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Hold the toes with your hand.
Gently pull the toes back toward your shin.
Feel the stretch along the sole of the foot.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.n: estiramiento de flexores de los dedos y eversores del pie sentado
exercises.en: seated toe flexor and foot everter stretch
exercises.d: Seated stretch pulling the toes back while turning the sole outward.
i: Sit and cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Hold the toes with your hand.
Pull the toes back toward your shin and turn the sole gently outward.
Feel the stretch along the sole and inner edge of the foot.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.n: estiramiento de flexores de los dedos e inversores del pie sentado
exercises.en: seated toe flexor and foot inverter stretch
exercises.d: Seated stretch pulling the toes back while turning the sole inward.
i: Sit and cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Hold the toes with your hand.
Pull the toes back toward your shin and turn the sole gently inward.
Feel the stretch along the sole and outer edge of the foot.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.n: estiramiento de flexores de los dedos del pie de pie
exercises.d: Pulling the toes back against a wall to stretch the sole of the foot and the calf.
i: Stand facing a wall and place the toes of one foot on it with the heel on the floor.
Lean forward gently until you feel the stretch along the bottom of the foot and into the calf.
Keep your heel firmly on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento de movilización del tobillo
exercises.d: A gentle rocking stretch that improves ankle movement and loosens the calf.
i: Stand facing a wall with one foot forward, toes a few inches from it.
Keep your front heel on the floor.
Bend the front knee and glide it toward the wall.
Return and repeat slowly for 10-15 reps, then switch feet.

exercises.n: estiramiento de hombros de pie erguido
exercises.d: A tall standing stretch that opens the shoulders and chest.
i: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Clasp your hands behind your back.
Straighten your arms and lift them gently away from your body.
Keep your chest open and your neck relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.

exercises.n: estiramiento de hombro inverso
exercises.d: Clasping your hands behind your back and lifting them to open the front of the shoulders.
i: Stand tall and clasp your hands behind your back.
Straighten your arms and lift your hands up and away from your body until the shoulders and chest stretch.
Keep your chest open and avoid leaning forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento de hombros sentado en banco
exercises.d: A seated stretch that opens the front of the shoulders using a bench.
i: Sit on the edge of a bench and place your hands behind you on it, fingers pointing back.
Walk your hips slightly forward off the bench.
Lower your hips gently until you feel a stretch at the front of the shoulders.
Keep your back close to the bench and shoulders down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then rise up.

exercises.n: estiramiento de hombro inverso sentado asistido
exercises.d: A partner gently draws your arms back to stretch the front of the shoulders.
i: Sit tall and put your arms behind you, palms facing down.
Have a partner stand behind and hold your wrists or forearms.
Ask them to lift your arms slowly until you feel a stretch.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and chest open.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then lower slowly.

exercises.n: estiramiento de hombro inverso de pie
exercises.d: Standing with your hands clasped behind you to open the front of the shoulders.
i: Stand tall and clasp your hands behind your back.
Straighten your arms and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lift your hands slightly away from your body.
Keep your chest up and avoid arching your lower back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then release.

exercises.n: estiramiento de flexores, depresores y retractores del hombro sentado
exercises.en: seated shoulder flexor depressor retractor stretch
exercises.d: A seated stretch that lengthens the shoulder and chest by pressing the arms back and down.
i: Sit tall on a chair or bench.
Place your hands behind you on the seat, fingers pointing back.
Press your shoulders down and back, opening your chest.
Lean slightly forward until you feel the stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then relax.

exercises.n: estiramiento de flexores del hombro a un brazo
exercises.d: Stretching one arm back and down to lengthen the front of the shoulder.
i: Stand next to a wall or post and place one hand on it behind you with the arm straight.
Slowly turn your body away until you feel the front of the shoulder stretch.
Keep the arm straight and the shoulder relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento de aducción del brazo hacia la espalda
