exercises.en: adduction of arm in back stretch
exercises.d: Reaching one arm behind your back and pulling it across to stretch the shoulder.
i: Stand or sit tall.
Reach one arm behind your back.
Grab that wrist with the other hand and gently pull it across your body.
Keep your shoulders level.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.n: estiramiento de extensores, aductores y retractores del hombro
exercises.en: shoulder extensor adductor and retractor stretch
exercises.d: A stretch for the back of the shoulder and the muscles between the shoulder blades.
i: Stand tall and extend one arm behind you.
Reach across to grab it with the other hand.
Draw the arm gently back and across the body.
Keep your chest open and your shoulders down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.n: estiramiento de aductores, elevadores y protractores del hombro
exercises.en: shoulder adductor elevator and protractor stretch
exercises.d: A cross body stretch that loosens the back of the shoulder and the muscles between the shoulder blades.
i: Stand or sit tall and bring one arm across your chest.
Use the opposite hand to press the arm toward you until the shoulder and upper back stretch.
Keep your shoulders down away from your ears.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento de hombro cruzando el pecho
exercises.d: A classic cross-body stretch for the back of the shoulder.
i: Stand tall and bring one arm straight across your chest.
Use your other forearm to press the arm gently toward your body.
Keep the shoulder relaxed and down.
Feel the stretch in the back of the shoulder.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.n: estiramiento de hombro con brazo flexionado
exercises.d: A cross-body shoulder stretch with the elbow bent, easing the back of the shoulder.
i: Stand tall and bring one arm across your chest with the elbow bent.
Hold the elbow with your other hand.
Gently pull the elbow toward the opposite shoulder.
Keep your shoulders level and your neck relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.n: estiramiento de hombro con rotación
exercises.d: A gentle rotation stretch for the shoulder joint.
i: Stand tall and bend one elbow to 90 degrees at your side.
Slowly rotate your forearm outward or inward, using the other hand to assist, until you feel the shoulder stretch.
Keep your elbow tucked in close to your body.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento de hombro alcanzando arriba
exercises.d: Reaching overhead to stretch the shoulders and the sides of the upper body.
i: Stand tall with your feet hip width apart.
Reach one or both arms overhead and up as high as you can, then press them slightly backward.
Do not arch your lower back as you reach.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento del manguito rotador
exercises.d: A stretch aimed at the small stabilizing muscles around the shoulder joint.
i: Stand tall and bring one arm across your body at chest height.
Hold the arm just above the elbow with the other hand and draw it in until the back of the shoulder stretches.
Keep the shoulder blade down and relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento de rotadores con codo hacia fuera
exercises.d: A stretch for the rotator cuff with the elbow lifted out to the side.
i: Stand tall and lift one elbow out to the side, hand behind your head.
Hold the elbow with your other hand.
Gently press the elbow back and slightly down.
Feel the stretch in the shoulder.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.n: estiramiento de rotadores con brazo arriba
exercises.d: An overhead stretch for the rotator cuff and back of the arm.
i: Raise one arm overhead and bend the elbow, palm resting on your upper back.
Use your other hand to hold the elbow.
Gently press the elbow back and down.
Keep your ribs down and chest open.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.n: estiramiento de rotadores con brazo abajo
exercises.d: A stretch for the rotator cuff with the arm held low behind the body.
i: Stand tall and place one arm behind your back, bent at the elbow.
Hold the wrist with the other hand.
Gently draw the hand away from your body and slightly up.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.n: estiramiento de rodillas a un brazo cruzando el cuerpo
exercises.en: kneeling one arm cross body stretch
exercises.d: A kneeling stretch where you reach one arm across the body to open the back of the shoulder.
i: Kneel on a mat and slide one arm across the floor in front of you, palm down.
Sink your chest toward the floor and keep reaching until the shoulder and upper back stretch.
Keep your hips over your knees.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento en depresión en barras paralelas
exercises.d: A hanging stretch between parallel bars that opens the shoulders and lengthens the lats.
i: Stand between parallel bars and grip them at hip height.
Walk back slightly, letting your arms straighten.
Lower your chest toward the floor and press your head between your arms.
Feel the stretch in the lats and shoulders.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then walk forward to release.

exercises.n: estiramiento de rotación externa del hombro
exercises.d: A stretch that eases the shoulder into outward rotation.
i: Stand next to a doorframe and bend your elbow to 90 degrees with your forearm on the frame.
Slowly turn your body away from the arm until you feel the front of the shoulder stretch.
Keep your elbow level with your shoulder.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento de rotación interna del hombro
exercises.d: A stretch that eases the shoulder into inward rotation.
i: Stand tall and place one hand behind your lower back with the elbow bent.
Use the other hand or a towel to gently draw the hand up your back until the back of the shoulder stretches.
Keep your shoulders level and do not twist.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

exercises.n: sentadilla hack completa en trineo
exercises.d: A hack squat on a sled machine through a full range of motion, loading the quads and glutes.
i: Set your shoulders under the pads and your feet shoulder-width on the platform.
Unlock the safety and straighten your legs.
Lower your hips slowly until your thighs are below parallel.
Keep your back flat against the pad and knees tracking over your toes.
Press through your whole foot to stand back up.

exercises.n: hip thrust a una pierna
exercises.d: A one-leg hip thrust that works the glutes hard and challenges balance and hip stability.
i: Sit with your upper back against a bench and one foot flat on the floor.
Extend the other leg or hold it up.
Drive through the heel to lift your hips until your body is flat.
Squeeze your glute at the top, then lower under control.
Complete the reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: hip thrust
exercises.d: A glute-focused bridge with the upper back on a bench, lifting the hips to build strong glutes.
i: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and knees bent.
Plant your feet flat, hip-width apart.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips until your torso is level.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.n: estiramiento de aductores, protractores y elevadores del hombro
exercises.en: shoulder adductor protractor and elevator stretch
exercises.d: A stretch for the back of the shoulder and the muscles along the upper back.
i: Stand tall and bring one arm across your chest.
Hold it with the other arm just above the elbow.
Gently pull while rounding the upper back slightly forward.
Keep your neck relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.n: estiramiento de hombro con toalla detrás de la espalda
exercises.en: shoulder stretch with towel behind the back
exercises.d: Using a towel behind the back to ease the shoulders into a deeper stretch.
i: Hold a towel in one hand and raise that arm overhead, bending the elbow.
Reach the other hand up from behind your back and grab the towel.
Gently pull the towel down with the lower hand.
Keep your head upright.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.n: estiramiento de dedos
exercises.d: A simple stretch that opens the fingers and forearm muscles, useful after typing or gripping.
i: Hold one arm out in front of you with the elbow straight.
Use the other hand to gently pull the fingers back until you feel a stretch in the palm and forearm.
Keep the fingers straight and relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento de antebrazo con palmas hacia fuera
exercises.d: Clasped hands pressed forward with the palms facing out to stretch the forearms.
i: Stand or sit tall and interlace your fingers.
Turn your palms outward and straighten your arms in front of you.
Push your hands gently away until you feel the stretch in the forearms.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then release.

exercises.n: estiramiento de antebrazo con dedos hacia abajo
exercises.d: A stretch for the top of the forearm with the fingers pointing down.
i: Extend one arm in front of you with the palm facing down.
Bend the wrist so the fingers point toward the floor.
Use your other hand to press the back of the hand gently toward you.
Keep your elbow straight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.n: estiramiento de flexores en la pared
exercises.d: Pressing the palm against a wall to stretch the forearm flexors.
i: Stand facing a wall and place one palm on it with the fingers pointing down.
Keep your arm straight.
Slowly turn your body away until you feel the stretch in the forearm.
Keep your fingers flat on the wall.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.n: estiramiento de desviador cubital y flexor de muñeca sentado
exercises.en: seated wrist ulnar deviator and flexor stretch
exercises.d: A seated wrist stretch for the inner forearm and the little finger side of the wrist.
i: Sit tall and extend one arm forward with the palm facing up.
Use the other hand to bend the wrist back and tilt it toward the thumb side until the forearm stretches.
Keep the elbow straight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento de pulgar
exercises.d: A gentle stretch for the thumb and the muscles at its base.
i: Extend one arm with the palm facing up.
Use your other hand to hold the thumb.
Gently pull the thumb back and away from the palm.
Stop at a mild stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.n: estiramiento de extensión de dedos
exercises.d: A stretch that bends the fingers back to lengthen the palm side of the forearm.
i: Extend one arm in front with the palm facing up.
Use your other hand to hold the fingers.
Gently pull the fingers back toward you.
Keep your elbow straight and the wrist relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.n: estiramiento de flexión de dedos
exercises.d: Gently bends the fingers down to stretch the tight tissue on the top of the hand and fingers. Handy after typing or gripping work.
i: Hold one arm out in front of you with the palm facing down.
Use your other hand to press the fingers of the extended hand gently downward.
Keep the elbow of the extended arm straight and the shoulders relaxed.
Stop at a mild pull, never at pain.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release and repeat on the other hand.

exercises.n: estiramiento de separación de dedos
exercises.d: Spreads the fingers wide apart to open up the hand and loosen the small muscles between the fingers.
i: Hold one hand up in front of you with the palm facing you.
Spread your fingers as far apart as feels comfortable.
If you want more stretch, press between the fingers with your other hand.
Keep the wrist straight and the shoulder relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Relax the hand and switch sides.

exercises.n: estiramiento de aducción de mano con codo extendido
exercises.en: adduction hand with elbow extended stretch
exercises.d: Tilts the hand sideways at the wrist with a straight elbow to stretch the forearm muscles along the outer edge of the arm.
i: Stand tall and extend one arm in front of you with the elbow straight.
Turn the palm so the thumb points up.
Grab the hand with your other hand and tilt it gently toward the little finger side.
Keep the elbow locked and the shoulder down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release and repeat on the other arm.

exercises.n: estiramiento de rotadores externos y extensores de cadera recostado (pierna cruzada)
exercises.en: recumbent hip external rotator and hip extensor stretch (crossed leg)
exercises.d: A reclined figure four stretch for the buttocks and deep hip muscles.
i: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee, then pull the legs toward your chest until the buttock stretches.
Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento de cuádriceps sentado
exercises.d: Stretches the front of the thigh from a seated position by folding one leg back while the other stays supported.
i: Sit sideways on a bench or sturdy seat with one leg hanging off the side.
Bend the hanging knee and bring the heel back toward your glutes.
Hold the foot or ankle with your hand and gently pull the heel closer.
Keep your torso upright and your knees close together.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release and switch legs.

exercises.n: estiramiento de espinilla cruzando al frente
exercises.d: Crossing one foot in front and pressing the toes down to stretch the front of the shin.
i: Stand tall and cross one leg in front of the other.
Point the toes of the back foot against the floor and gently bend the knee until the shin and ankle stretch.
Hold a wall or chair for balance.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento de gemelos sentado tirando de la punta
exercises.d: Pulls the toes back toward the shin while sitting, giving the calf and the back of the lower leg a gentle stretch.
i: Sit on the floor with one leg straight out in front of you.
Reach forward and grab the toes or the ball of the foot of that leg.
Gently pull the toes toward your shin while keeping the knee straight.
Sit tall and avoid rounding your back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release and switch legs.

exercises.n: estiramiento de separación entre los dedos
exercises.d: Spreads the toes apart to wake up and loosen the small muscles of the foot.
i: Sit comfortably and bring one foot up to rest on the opposite knee.
Hold the foot with your hand.
Slide your fingers between the toes and gently spread them apart.
Keep the movement slow and easy.
Hold the spread for 15-20 seconds.
Release and switch feet.

exercises.n: estiramiento de aquiles inclinado con talón atrás
exercises.d: Targets the lower calf and Achilles tendon area by leaning into a wall with the back heel pressed down and the knee bent.
i: Stand facing a wall and place your hands on it at chest height.
Step one foot back and keep that heel on the floor.
Bend both knees slightly and lean forward until you feel a pull low in the back calf.
Keep the back heel flat and the toes pointing forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.

exercises.n: estiramiento de flexores del tronco inferior
exercises.d: A backbend style stretch that lengthens the front of the abdomen and hips.
i: Lie face down with your hands under your shoulders.
Press up through your hands and let your hips sink toward the floor until the lower abdomen stretches.
Keep your hips on the floor and your shoulders relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento del gato v. 2
exercises.d: Rounds the spine upward from all fours to loosen the back and gently engage the abs. A classic mobility move for stiff backs.
i: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Tuck your chin and tilt the pelvis as you push the floor away.
Round your back up toward the ceiling like a cat.
Hold the rounded position for a few seconds.
Return slowly to the neutral starting position.
Repeat for 8-10 slow reps.

exercises.n: estiramiento de la vaca
exercises.d: Lets the belly sink and the chest lift from all fours to stretch the front of the trunk and mobilise the spine.
i: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Inhale and let your belly drop toward the floor.
Lift your chest and tailbone while looking slightly forward.
Keep your arms straight and shoulders away from your ears.
Hold for a couple of seconds, then return to neutral.
Repeat for 8-10 slow reps.

exercises.n: estiramiento de abdomen de pie inclinado hacia atrás
exercises.d: A standing lean back that stretches the abdominal wall.
i: Stand tall with your hands on your hips.
Gently lean back and push your hips slightly forward until you feel a stretch across the stomach.
Keep your movement small and avoid cranking your lower back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento abdominal de rodillas
exercises.d: A kneeling backbend that opens the front of the torso.
i: Kneel with your knees hip width apart and place your hands on your lower back.
Push your hips forward and lean back until the abdominal muscles stretch.
Tuck your chin a little and avoid dropping your head back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento de rotación abdominal de pie
exercises.d: Rotates the upper body from a standing position to stretch the abs and obliques and loosen the trunk.
i: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and arms relaxed.
Place your hands on your hips or hold them out to the sides.
Keep the hips facing forward and turn your upper body slowly to one side.
Look over your shoulder and breathe steadily.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return to the front and rotate to the other side.

exercises.n: estiramiento de abdomen con rotación
exercises.d: Combines a gentle lift of the chest with a twist to stretch the stomach muscles and the sides of the trunk.
i: Lie face down and prop yourself up on your forearms or hands.
Keep your hips on the floor and lift your chest.
Slowly turn your head and shoulders toward one side.
Stay relaxed and avoid pushing into pain in the lower back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return to centre and rotate to the other side.

exercises.n: extensión de cadera con apoyo en la espalda
exercises.d: Lifts the hips while the upper back is supported, teaching the glutes to extend the hip through a full range.
i: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Place your arms by your sides for support.
Push through your heels and lift the hips until the body forms a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top without arching the lower back.
Lower the hips back down with control.
Repeat for 10-12 reps.

exercises.n: estiramiento de flexores laterales del tronco inferior de pie
exercises.en: standing lower trunk lateral flexor stretch
exercises.d: Bends the lower trunk sideways from a standing position to stretch the muscles along the flank and low back.
i: Stand with feet slightly wider than hip-width.
Place one hand on your hip and reach the other arm overhead.
Push the hips slightly to the side opposite your reach.
Bend sideways from the waist without leaning forward or back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return to upright and switch sides.

exercises.n: estiramiento de flexores laterales del tronco inferior sentado
exercises.en: seated lower trunk lateral flexor stretch
exercises.d: A seated side bend that lengthens the muscles along the side of the waist.
i: Sit tall on the floor or a chair with your legs crossed or feet flat.
Reach one arm overhead and bend sideways away from it until you feel the side of the waist stretch.
Keep both hips grounded and avoid leaning forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

exercises.n: extensión de cadera de rodillas
exercises.d: Opens the front of the hips from a kneeling position by pushing the pelvis forward, which also wakes up the glutes.
i: Kneel on a soft surface with knees hip-width apart and thighs upright.
Place your hands on your hips or the back of your pelvis.
Squeeze your glutes and push your hips forward.
Keep your ribs down and avoid over-arching your lower back.
Hold for a moment, then return to the start.
Repeat for 8-12 reps.

exercises.n: estiramiento de rodillas rodando acostado
exercises.d: Rolls the knees to one side while lying on your back to twist the lower spine and loosen the hips and sides.
i: Lie on your back with arms out to the sides and knees bent.
Keep your shoulders flat on the floor.
Slowly lower both knees to one side.
Turn your head the other way if it feels comfortable.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Bring the knees back to centre and roll to the other side.

exercises.n: estiramiento lateral de pie
exercises.d: A standing side bend for the sides of the waist and ribs.
i: Stand tall with your feet hip width apart.
Reach one arm overhead and bend sideways away from it until you feel the side stretch.
Keep your chest open and your hips level.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento lateral sentado
exercises.d: A seated side bend that stretches the sides of the waist and the lats.
i: Sit tall with your legs crossed or feet flat on the floor.
Reach one arm overhead and lean sideways away from it, placing the other hand on the floor for support.
Keep both sit bones grounded.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento de costado de pie
exercises.d: Reaches an arm overhead and leans to the side to lengthen the flank, lats and obliques.
i: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Raise one arm overhead with the palm facing inward.
Lean your torso sideways away from the raised arm.
Keep both hips level and your chest facing forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return upright and repeat on the other side.

exercises.n: estiramiento de costado de pie con palo
exercises.d: Uses a stick held overhead to guide a deeper side bend, stretching the flank and the lats.
i: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart holding a stick with both hands overhead.
Keep your arms straight and your shoulders relaxed.
Lean your torso slowly to one side without twisting.
Keep your hips steady and your chest facing forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return to upright and lean to the other side.

exercises.n: flexión lateral acostado
exercises.d: Curves the body sideways while lying down, which stretches the flank without any need to balance.
i: Lie on your back with legs together and arms stretched overhead.
Slide both feet and both hands to the same side so the body forms a gentle arc.
Keep your hips and shoulders on the floor.
Breathe slowly and relax into the curve.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return to centre and bend to the other side.

exercises.n: flexión lateral asistida
exercises.d: A partner helps guide a sideways bend of the trunk, making it easier to relax into the stretch along the flank.
i: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart and one arm overhead.
Have your partner stand behind you with a hand on your hip and a hand on your raised arm.
Lean sideways as your partner gently guides the movement.
Tell your partner to stop at a mild pull.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return upright and switch sides.

exercises.n: estiramiento asistido de oblicuos
exercises.d: With help from a partner, this stretch lengthens the oblique muscles on the side of the trunk through a slow bend or twist.
i: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart.
Raise one arm overhead while your partner steadies your hips.
Lean away from the raised arm while your partner gently guides your arm.
Keep your chest open and avoid leaning forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Come back to upright and switch sides.

exercises.n: flexión lateral en el suelo de rodillas
exercises.en: lateral bend on floor by kneeling
exercises.d: A kneeling side bend where you reach along the floor to stretch the side of the waist.
i: Kneel on a mat and extend one arm sideways along the floor.
Walk your hands to one side and sink your hips the other way until the side of the waist stretches.
Keep your hips over your knees.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

exercises.n: estiramiento lateral en el suelo acostado
exercises.en: lateral stretch on floor lying down
exercises.d: A lying side stretch that gently lengthens one side of the body.
i: Lie on your back with your arms extended overhead.
Shift your feet and your upper body to one side to form a gentle banana curve until the opposite side stretches.
Keep both shoulders and hips on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

exercises.n: elevación de piernas en silla romana con peso
exercises.d: A captain's chair leg raise with added weight, building lower ab and hip flexor strength.
i: Position yourself on a captain's chair with your forearms on the pads and back against the backrest.
Hold the weight securely between your feet or on your ankles.
Brace your core and raise your knees or legs up toward your chest.
Curl your pelvis slightly at the top.
Lower your legs slowly without swinging.
Repeat for the planned reps.

exercises.n: abdominal declinado con peso
exercises.d: A decline bench crunch with a weight held at the chest, adding resistance for the abs.
i: Lie on a decline bench and hook your feet under the pads.
Hold a weight plate or dumbbell against your chest.
Curl your upper body up by contracting the abs.
Pause briefly at the top without pulling on your neck.
Lower back down with control.
Repeat for the planned reps.

exercises.n: caminata del granjero
exercises.d: A loaded carry holding a dumbbell in each hand while walking tall. Builds grip, core and total-body strength.
i: Ponte de pie con una mancuerna en cada mano, palmas hacia los costados.
Mantén la espalda recta y los hombros hacia atrás.
Da pasos pequeños y controlados hacia adelante, manteniendo una postura erguida.
Continúa caminando durante la distancia o el tiempo deseado.
Para terminar, deja de caminar y baja con cuidado las mancuernas a los costados.

exercises.n: plancha frontal con peso
exercises.d: A forearm plank held with extra weight on your back. Builds core strength and stability.
i: Comienza tumbándote boca abajo en el suelo.
Coloca los antebrazos en el suelo, con los codos justo debajo de los hombros.
Extiende las piernas rectas hacia atrás, con la punta de los pies en el suelo.
Activa el core y levanta el cuerpo del suelo, equilibrándote sobre los antebrazos y la punta de los pies.
Mantén el cuerpo en línea recta desde la cabeza hasta los talones.
Mantén esta posición durante el tiempo deseado.
Baja el cuerpo de nuevo a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: press cubano con mancuernas v. 2
exercises.d: A cuban press variation with dumbbells that mixes a press and a wrist rotation. Works the shoulders and rotator cuff.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros, sosteniendo una mancuerna en cada mano a la altura de los hombros con las palmas hacia abajo.
Manteniendo el core activado y la espalda recta, empuja las mancuernas directamente hacia arriba por encima de la cabeza hasta que los brazos queden completamente extendidos.
Gira las muñecas de modo que las palmas queden mirando hacia adelante.
Baja las mancuernas de nuevo hasta la altura de los hombros, girando las muñecas de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: press Arnold con mancuernas
exercises.d: A seated dumbbell press that rotates the palms from facing you to facing forward as you lift. Hits all three heads of the shoulder.
i: Siéntate en un banco con respaldo y sujeta una mancuerna en cada mano a la altura del hombro, con las palmas hacia tu cuerpo y los codos flexionados.
Empuja las mancuernas hacia arriba hasta que los brazos estén completamente extendidos y las palmas miren hacia adelante.
Rota las muñecas mientras levantas, de modo que las palmas miren hacia adelante en la parte alta del movimiento.
Haz una pausa breve en la parte alta, luego baja lentamente las mancuernas de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: carrera en bicicleta fija v. 3
exercises.d: Steady pedalling on a stationary bike at a pace that suits you. Builds endurance and leg conditioning.
i: Ajusta la altura y la posición del asiento para asegurar una alineación correcta.
Coloca los pies sobre los pedales y sujétalos con las correas si están disponibles.
Comienza a pedalear a un ritmo cómodo.
Mantén un ritmo constante y aumenta la resistencia según lo desees.
Activa los músculos del core para mantener la estabilidad y una postura correcta.
Continúa pedaleando durante la duración deseada de tu entrenamiento.
Disminuye gradualmente la resistencia y reduce la velocidad antes de detenerte por completo.
Estira las piernas y enfría después del entrenamiento.

exercises.n: bicicleta de brazos
exercises.d: Cranking pedals with your hands on an upper body ergometer. Gets your heart rate up using the arms and shoulders.
i: Ajusta la altura del asiento y la posición del manillar a un nivel cómodo.
Siéntate en el ergómetro con la espalda recta y los pies sobre los pedales.
Sujeta las asas con las manos y coloca los brazos en un ángulo de 90 grados.
Comienza a pedalear con las manos, empujando y tirando de las asas con un movimiento controlado.
Continúa pedaleando durante el tiempo o el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: máquina de caminata ondulante
exercises.d: A low-impact cardio machine session that works the legs in a smooth walking motion to raise your heart rate.
i: Step onto the machine and hold the handles lightly.
Start moving your legs in a smooth walking rhythm.
Keep your posture tall and your core lightly braced.
Pick a pace that lets you breathe steadily.
Keep going for 10-30 minutes depending on your fitness.
Slow down for the last minute before stepping off.

exercises.n: caminata en elíptica
exercises.d: Smooth walking-style motion on an elliptical cross trainer. Low-impact cardio that builds endurance.
i: Ajusta el nivel de resistencia y la inclinación de la máquina elíptica a los valores deseados.
Sube a los pedales de la máquina y agarra las asas con suavidad.
Comienza empujando hacia abajo con los pies y tirando de las asas hacia tu cuerpo.
Continúa con este movimiento, alternando entre empujar y tirar, para simular un movimiento de caminar o correr.
Mantén un ritmo constante y conserva el core activado durante todo el ejercicio.
Continúa durante la duración deseada de tu entrenamiento cardiovascular.
Disminuye gradualmente la intensidad y la velocidad de la máquina antes de bajarte.

exercises.n: ergómetro de esquí
exercises.d: Pulling the handles of a ski ergometer down in a rhythmic stroke. Works the arms, back and core while raising your heart rate.
i: Ajusta la altura del asiento y los apoyapiés a una posición cómoda.
Sujeta las agarraderas con un agarre prono, con las palmas hacia abajo.
Siéntate erguido con los pies planos sobre los apoyapiés.
Extiende los brazos rectos frente a ti, manteniendo los codos ligeramente flexionados.
Activa los tríceps y empuja las asas hacia abajo, hacia los muslos.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte inferior, luego regresa lentamente a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: círculo mundial de pie con mancuernas
exercises.d: Dumbbell circles around the body with straight arms, going out to the side and overhead. Works the shoulders through a wide range.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros y sostén una mancuerna en cada mano.
Extiende los brazos rectos hacia los lados a la altura de los hombros, con las palmas hacia abajo.
Manteniendo los brazos rectos, gira lentamente los brazos en un movimiento circular, llevando las mancuernas frente al cuerpo y luego por encima de la cabeza.
Continúa el movimiento circular, bajando las mancuernas de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: press de pecho sentado en polea
exercises.d: A seated cable press pushing the handles away from your chest. Builds the chest, shoulders and triceps.
i: Ajusta la altura del asiento y las agarraderas del cable a una posición cómoda.
Siéntate en el banco con la espalda recta y los pies apoyados planos en el suelo.
Sujeta las agarraderas del cable con un agarre prono a la altura del hombro.
Empuja las agarraderas hacia adelante y alejándolas del cuerpo, extendiendo los brazos por completo.
Haz una pausa por un momento y luego regresa lentamente las agarraderas a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: hip thrust en máquina
exercises.d: A machine version of the hip thrust that loads the glutes with a fixed path of motion.
i: Sit on the machine with your upper back against the pad and the belt across your hips.
Plant your feet flat, about hip width apart.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips until your torso and thighs are in line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top for a moment.
Lower with control and repeat, keeping your chin tucked.

exercises.n: hip thrust en máquina con banda elástica
exercises.en: lever hip thrust with resistance band
exercises.d: A machine hip thrust with a band around the thighs, adding hip abductor work to the glute drive.
i: Sit on the machine with your upper back on the pad and a band around your thighs above the knees.
Place your feet flat and push your knees gently out against the band.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips until your torso and thighs are in line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat, keeping the knees pressed out.

exercises.n: hip thrust a una pierna en máquina
exercises.d: A one sided machine hip thrust that hits each glute on its own and challenges hip stability.
i: Sit on the machine with your upper back on the pad and the belt across your hips.
Plant one foot flat and lift the other leg off the floor.
Drive through the planted heel and raise your hips until your torso is level.
Squeeze your glute at the top, keeping your hips level.
Lower with control, finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: patada trasera con pierna flexionada de rodillas con banda elástica
exercises.d: A kneeling kickback with a band that isolates the glutes by pressing the bent leg up and back.
i: Anchor the band low and loop it around one foot, then get on all fours.
Keep your back flat and your core braced.
Press the foot with the bent knee up toward the ceiling against the band.
Squeeze your glute at the top without arching your lower back.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: almeja con banda elástica
exercises.d: A side-lying clam with a band around the thighs that strengthens the outer hip and glutes.
i: Lie on your side with a loop band just above your knees and knees bent.
Stack your hips and keep your feet together.
Open the top knee away from the bottom one like a clam.
Keep your pelvis still and do not roll backward.
Lower the knee slowly.
Complete the reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: rotación externa con banda elástica
exercises.d: Rotates the arm outward against band tension to strengthen the small muscles that stabilise the shoulder.
i: Anchor a band at elbow height and stand sideways to it.
Hold the handle with the hand farther from the anchor.
Tuck your elbow against your side with the elbow bent to 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm outward, away from your belly.
Return slowly to the start.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: plancha frontal con patada y banda elástica
exercises.en: resistance band front plank with kicked leg
exercises.d: A plank hold while one leg kicks back against a band, working the glutes and core together.
i: Place a band around your feet or ankles and get into a forearm or high plank.
Brace your core so your body forms a straight line.
Kick one leg back and up against the band without shifting your hips.
Return the leg with control.
Alternate legs, keeping your hips level throughout.

exercises.n: sentadilla completa con banda elástica
exercises.d: A deep squat with a band for added resistance, training the thighs and glutes.
i: Stand on the band with your feet shoulder width apart and hold the handles at your shoulders.
Keep your chest up and your core braced.
Sit your hips back and down into a full squat.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes and heels on the floor.
Drive up through your feet to stand tall.

exercises.n: puente de glúteos con banda elástica
exercises.d: A floor bridge with a band around the thighs to keep the glutes working hard.
i: Lie on your back with your knees bent and a band around your thighs just above the knees.
Place your feet flat, hip width apart.
Push your knees gently out against the band.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips until your body forms a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes, then lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.n: plancha lateral de rodillas con banda elástica
exercises.d: A side plank from the knees with a band, training the sides of the waist and the hips with less load than a full plank.
i: Wrap a band around your thighs and lie on one side with your knees bent.
Place your elbow under your shoulder.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line from knees to head.
Push your top knee gently out against the band.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.n: elevación de piernas acostado con banda elástica
exercises.d: A side lying leg raise against a band that works the outer hip and glutes.
i: Place a band around your thighs or ankles and lie on your side with your legs straight.
Rest your head on your arm and keep your hips stacked.
Raise the top leg against the band without rolling backward.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: puente de glúteos a una pierna con pierna recta y banda elástica
exercises.en: resistance band one leg glute bridge with straight leg
exercises.d: A single leg bridge with a band and the free leg held straight, demanding strong glutes and a level pelvis.
i: Lie on your back with a band around your thighs and one knee bent, foot flat.
Extend the other leg straight, in line with your thigh.
Drive through the planted heel and lift your hips.
Keep your hips level and squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: puente de glúteos a una pierna con banda elástica
exercises.en: resistance band one leg glute bridge
exercises.d: A single-leg glute bridge with a band added, making your glutes and hamstrings work harder on each side.
i: Lie on your back with a loop band above your knees and knees bent.
Lift one foot off the floor and extend that leg.
Drive through the other heel and lift your hips.
Squeeze the glutes at the top and keep the hips level.
Lower with control.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: patada trasera a una pierna con banda elástica
exercises.d: A standing or all fours kickback with a band that targets the glutes one leg at a time.
i: Loop a band around your ankles or anchor it and loop it around one foot.
Stand holding a support, or get on all fours, with your core braced.
Kick one leg back against the band, keeping the knee straight.
Squeeze your glute and avoid arching your lower back.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: marcha en plancha con banda elástica
exercises.d: Marching the knees while holding a plank with a band around the legs, which challenges the core and hips together.
i: Place a loop band around your thighs or ankles and get into a forearm or high plank.
Keep a straight line from head to heels.
Lift one knee toward your chest against the band.
Return it quietly and lift the other knee.
Keep your hips from rocking side to side.
Alternate for the planned time or reps.

exercises.n: hiperextensión inversa con banda elástica
exercises.d: Swings the legs up behind you against a band to train the glutes and the muscles along the lower back.
i: Lie face down over a bench or box with a band anchored near your feet.
Hold the bench edge and loop the band around your ankles.
Squeeze your glutes and lift your legs until they are in line with your body.
Avoid swinging or arching the lower back.
Lower the legs slowly.
Repeat for the planned reps.

exercises.n: plancha lateral con banda elástica
exercises.d: A side plank with a band around the legs to fire up the hips and the sides of the waist.
i: Place a band around your thighs and lie on one side with your legs straight.
Put your elbow under your shoulder.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line from head to feet.
Press your top leg gently up against the band.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.n: caminata lateral con banda elástica
exercises.d: A lateral band walk that strengthens the outer hips and glutes.
i: Place a band around your thighs or ankles and stand with your feet hip width apart.
Bend your knees slightly into a quarter squat.
Step sideways with the lead foot, keeping tension on the band.
Bring the trailing foot in without letting the feet touch.
Take 10-15 steps one way, then walk back the other way.

exercises.n: marcha en puente de cadera boca arriba con banda elástica
exercises.en: resistance band supine hip bridge march
exercises.d: A glute bridge held while you march your knees one at a time against a band, testing hip stability.
i: Lie on your back with a band around your thighs and your knees bent.
Lift your hips into a bridge and squeeze your glutes.
Lift one foot off the floor, drawing the knee toward your chest.
Lower it and lift the other foot, keeping your hips level.
Continue alternating at a steady pace, then lower your hips.

exercises.n: extensión de tríceps declinada con barra EZ
exercises.d: A decline EZ bar triceps extension lowering the bar toward your forehead. Builds triceps strength.
i: Túmbate en un banco declinado con la cabeza más baja que los pies y los pies asegurados.
Sostén la barra EZ con agarre prono, manos separadas a la altura de los hombros.
Extiende completamente los brazos, manteniendo los codos cerca de la cabeza.
Baja la barra lentamente hacia la frente, doblando los codos.
Haz una pausa por un momento y luego extiende los brazos de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: press de banca con agarre cerrado inverso y barra
exercises.d: A close-grip bench press using a reverse (underhand) grip. Emphasises the triceps and upper chest.
i: Túmbate sobre un banco con los pies apoyados en el suelo y la espalda presionada contra el banco.
Agarra la barra con un agarre invertido, manos separadas a la altura de los hombros.
Levanta la barra del soporte y sostenla directamente sobre el pecho con los brazos completamente extendidos.
Baja la barra lentamente hacia el pecho, manteniendo los codos cerca del cuerpo.
Haz una pausa breve cuando la barra esté justo encima del pecho.
Empuja la barra de vuelta a la posición inicial, extendiendo completamente los brazos.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: extensión de tríceps sentado con mancuerna
exercises.d: A seated overhead extension with one dumbbell held in both hands. Builds the back of the upper arms.
i: Siéntate en un banco con la espalda recta y los pies planos sobre el suelo.
Sujeta una mancuerna con ambas manos y extiende los brazos rectos por encima de la cabeza.
Flexiona los codos y baja la mancuerna detrás de la cabeza, manteniendo la parte superior de los brazos cerca de las orejas.
Haz una pausa por un momento, luego endereza los brazos y vuelve a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: extensión de tríceps sentado con mancuernas
exercises.d: A seated overhead extension with one dumbbell held in both hands. Builds the back of the upper arms.
i: Siéntate en un banco con la espalda recta y los pies planos sobre el suelo.
Sujeta una mancuerna con ambas manos con agarre prono y levántala por encima de la cabeza.
Flexiona los codos y baja la mancuerna detrás de la cabeza, manteniendo la parte superior de los brazos cerca de las orejas.
Extiende los brazos y sube la mancuerna de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: caminata en elíptica
exercises.d: A steady, low-impact walk on the elliptical that builds endurance and works the legs without pounding the joints.
i: Step onto the pedals and hold the handles.
Start walking forward in a smooth rhythm.
Stand tall and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Set a resistance and pace you can keep up while breathing steadily.
Continue for 15-45 minutes.
Slow down for a minute before you step off.

exercises.n: caminata en bicicleta reclinada
exercises.d: A relaxed walking-style pedal motion on a recumbent bike that builds leg endurance with the back well supported.
i: Sit on the recumbent bike and adjust the seat so your knees stay slightly bent at full extension.
Place your feet on the pedals and hold the handles.
Pedal at an easy, walking-like pace.
Keep your back against the backrest and breathe steadily.
Continue for 15-30 minutes.
Cool down by slowing the pedalling gradually.

exercises.n: correr en cinta
exercises.d: Running at a steady pace on a treadmill to build endurance and burn energy.
i: Step onto the belt and clip the safety key to your clothing.
Start at a walk and raise the speed gradually to a comfortable jog.
Keep your chest tall and your arms swinging loosely at your sides.
Land softly under your hips and keep your steps quick.
Run for 10-30 minutes at a pace where you can still breathe steadily.
Slow to a walk for a few minutes to cool down.

exercises.n: extensión de tríceps en máquina v. 3
exercises.d: A machine-based triceps extension that lets you load the back of the arm with a steady, guided path.
i: Adjust the seat and sit with your upper arms on the pad.
Grip the handles with your elbows bent.
Press down by straightening your elbows.
Squeeze your triceps at the bottom.
Return slowly to the start without lifting your shoulders.
Repeat for the planned reps.

exercises.n: hip thrust con rodillo
exercises.d: A hip thrust done by rolling a ball under your body, which trains the glutes and challenges your balance.
i: Lie on your back with your heels on a stability ball and your arms by your sides.
Brace your core and press your heels into the ball.
Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your glutes at the top for a second.
Lower your hips slowly without letting the ball drift away.
Repeat for the planned reps, keeping the ball steady.

exercises.n: estiramiento de cadera con rodillo
exercises.d: A roller-assisted hip opener for the glutes. Helps loosen tight hips with a controlled rolling motion.
i: Comienza sentándote en el suelo con las piernas extendidas frente a ti.
Coloca el rodillo debajo de los glúteos, justo por encima de las rodillas.
Inclínate hacia atrás y coloca las manos en el suelo detrás de ti para apoyarte.
Activa los glúteos y rueda lentamente el rodillo hacia adelante, flexionando las rodillas y llevándolas hacia el pecho.
Haz una pausa al final del movimiento, sintiendo un estiramiento en los glúteos.
Rueda lentamente el rodillo de vuelta a la posición inicial, extendiendo las piernas.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: flexor depresor retractor de hombro sentado con rodillo
exercises.en: roller seated shoulder flexor depresor retractor
exercises.d: A seated roller drill that rolls forward and back to work shoulder control. Helps with shoulder mobility and posture.
i: Siéntate sobre una superficie plana con las piernas extendidas frente a ti.
Sostén el rodillo con ambas manos, con las palmas hacia abajo, y colócalo sobre tus muslos.
Inclínate ligeramente hacia delante y aleja el rodillo de tu cuerpo, extendiendo los brazos rectos frente a ti.
Haz una pausa por un momento, luego rueda el rodillo lentamente de vuelta hacia tu cuerpo, doblando los brazos y trayéndolo de nuevo hacia los muslos.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: sierra corporal con rodillo
exercises.d: A plank with forearms on a roller, rolling forward and back like a saw. Challenges the abs and core.
i: Comienza en posición de plancha con los antebrazos sobre el rodillo y el cuerpo en línea recta.
Activa el core y rueda lentamente el rodillo hacia adelante, extendiendo el cuerpo tanto como puedas mientras mantienes el control.
Haz una pausa por un momento en el punto más lejano y luego rueda lentamente el rodillo de vuelta hacia tu posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: estiramiento de cadera y dorsales con rodillo
exercises.d: A kneeling roller stretch that opens the hips and glutes. Helps release tension around the hips.
i: Comienza arrodillándote en el suelo con el rodillo colocado debajo de las caderas.
Coloca las manos sobre el rodillo para mayor apoyo.
Rueda lentamente el rodillo hacia adelante, extendiendo las caderas y estirando los glúteos.
Mantén el estiramiento durante unos segundos, luego regresa a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: abdominal reverso con rodillo
exercises.d: A reverse crunch where you roll a roller toward you with your feet. Trains the lower abs.
i: Túmbate boca arriba con los brazos extendidos rectos por encima de la cabeza y las piernas rectas frente a ti.
Coloca el rodillo entre los pies y sujétalo con los dedos de los pies.
Activando el abdomen, levanta las piernas del suelo y flexiona las rodillas hacia el pecho, rodando el rodillo hacia tu cuerpo.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte alta y luego baja lentamente las piernas de vuelta a la posición inicial, rodando el rodillo alejándolo de tu cuerpo.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: estiramiento lateral de dorsales con rodillo
exercises.d: A roller stretch that reaches forward to lengthen the sides of your back. Helps loosen the lats.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros y sujeta el rodillo con ambas manos frente al cuerpo.
Flexiona ligeramente las rodillas e inclínate hacia adelante desde las caderas, manteniendo la espalda recta.
Extiende los brazos hacia delante y rueda el rodillo hacia los pies, sintiendo un estiramiento en los dorsales.
Mantén el estiramiento durante unos segundos, luego rueda el rodillo lentamente de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: estiramiento de espalda con rodillo
exercises.d: Rolling your back over a roller to loosen it up. Helps ease stiffness along the spine.
i: Comienza sentándote en el suelo con las piernas extendidas frente a ti.
Coloca el rodillo perpendicular a tu cuerpo, justo debajo de los glúteos.
Rueda lentamente el cuerpo hacia atrás, dejando que el rodillo se desplace hacia arriba por tu espalda.
Continúa rodando hasta que el rodillo llegue a la parte superior de tu espalda.
Haz una pausa por un momento y luego rueda lentamente de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: flexor depresor retractor de hombro sentado a una pierna con rodillo
exercises.en: roller seated single leg shoulder flexor depresor retractor
exercises.d: A seated single-leg roller drill for shoulder control. Helps with shoulder mobility and posture.
i: Siéntate sobre una superficie plana con las piernas extendidas frente a ti.
Sostén el rodillo con ambas manos, con las palmas hacia abajo, y colócalo sobre tus muslos.
Inclínate ligeramente hacia atrás y contrae los músculos del core.
Eleva el rodillo hasta la altura de los hombros, manteniendo los brazos rectos.
Baja lentamente el rodillo de nuevo hacia los muslos.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: prensa de piernas a 45 grados en trineo
exercises.d: A leg press on a 45 degree sled that loads the thighs and hips while your back stays supported.
i: Sit in the seat with your back and head flat against the pad.
Place your feet shoulder-width apart in the middle of the platform.
Release the safety handles and lower the sled until your knees are bent to about 90 degrees.
Keep your lower back pressed into the pad as you descend.
Push through your whole foot to extend your legs without locking your knees.
Lower under control and repeat.

exercises.n: elevación lateral de pie con mancuernas
exercises.d: Raising dumbbells out to your sides to build the middle part of the shoulders.
i: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing in.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows and brace your core.
Raise both arms out to the sides until they reach shoulder height.
Lead with your elbows and avoid shrugging.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly to the start and repeat.

exercises.n: extensión de tríceps en polea (barra V)
exercises.d: A cable pushdown with a V bar that isolates the back of the upper arm.
i: Attach a V bar to a high pulley and stand facing the stack.
Grip the bar with your elbows pinned to your sides.
Push the bar down until your arms are fully straight.
Squeeze your triceps for a moment at the bottom.
Let the bar rise until your forearms are just past parallel.
Keep your upper arms still throughout the set.

exercises.n: caminar
exercises.d: Plain walking at an easy to brisk pace, a simple way to build endurance and stay active.
i: Stand tall with your shoulders relaxed and your gaze ahead.
Start walking with a natural stride.
Swing your arms gently opposite to your legs.
Land softly on your heel and roll through to the toes.
Keep a pace that lets you breathe comfortably.
Walk for 20-60 minutes.

exercises.n: caminar en cinta
exercises.d: Walking on a treadmill lets you control speed and incline for steady, low-impact cardio.
i: Step onto the belt and hold the rails while you start at a slow speed.
Increase to a comfortable walking pace.
Let go of the rails and swing your arms naturally.
Keep your head up and your steps even.
Add some incline if you want more challenge.
Walk for 20-45 minutes and slow down before stepping off.

exercises.n: remo sentado en máquina v. 2
exercises.d: A plate-loaded seated row that trains the upper back and lats through a guided pulling path.
i: Adjust the seat and chest pad, then sit with your chest against the pad.
Grip the handles with arms extended.
Pull the handles toward your torso by driving the elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly until your arms are straight again.
Repeat for the planned reps.

exercises.n: extensión de espalda en máquina v. 2
exercises.d: A machine back extension that strengthens the muscles along the lower back with support from the pad.
i: Adjust the machine and sit with your back against the pad.
Cross your arms or hold the handles as the machine allows.
Push back by extending at the hips and lower back.
Stop when your torso is in a neutral, tall position.
Return slowly to the start.
Repeat for the planned reps.

exercises.n: prensa de piernas sentado en máquina
exercises.d: A seated machine leg press that drives the legs forward to build thigh and glute strength with back support.
i: Adjust the seat and sit with your back flat against the pad.
Place your feet on the platform about shoulder-width apart.
Push through your heels until your legs are nearly straight.
Do not lock your knees.
Bend your knees slowly to return.
Repeat for the planned reps.

exercises.n: abdominal sentado en máquina (almohadilla para manos)
exercises.d: A seated machine crunch where the hands press on a pad, working the abs against steady resistance.
i: Sit on the machine and adjust the seat so your hands reach the pad.
Place your hands on the pads and brace your feet.
Curl your torso forward by contracting your abs.
Pause briefly at the bottom.
Return slowly to the upright start.
Repeat for the planned reps.

exercises.n: abdominal con rueda abdominal
exercises.d: A crunch done with an ab wheel that works the abdominal wall through a compact range.
i: Kneel on a mat and hold the ab wheel with both hands in front of your knees.
Round your lower back slightly and brace your abs.
Roll forward a short distance while keeping your hips stable.
Pull the wheel back toward your knees by curling your ribs toward your hips.
Exhale as you crunch and avoid arching your back.
Repeat with smooth control.

exercises.n: gancho de izquierda (boxeo)
exercises.d: A boxing left hook thrown with a hip and torso rotation. Builds rotational power and conditioning.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros y las rodillas ligeramente flexionadas.
Mantén la mano izquierda arriba para proteger el rostro y la mano derecha junto a la barbilla.
Rota las caderas y pívota sobre el pie izquierdo mientras extiendes el brazo izquierdo hacia adelante con un movimiento de golpe.
Gira el torso y activa los músculos del core para generar potencia en el golpe.
Lleva el brazo rápidamente de vuelta a la posición inicial y repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: jab de boxeo
exercises.d: A quick straight punch with the lead hand, used to build speed, shoulder endurance and timing.
i: Stand in a boxing stance with your lead foot forward and hands up by your chin.
Extend your lead hand straight toward the target.
Rotate your fist so the palm faces down as it lands.
Keep your chin tucked and your rear hand guarding.
Snap the hand back to the guard quickly.
Repeat, then switch stance if you want.

exercises.n: cruzado derecho de boxeo
exercises.d: A powerful straight punch with the rear hand, driven by a turn of the hips and back foot.
i: Stand in a boxing stance with hands up.
Push off the back foot and rotate your hips and shoulders.
Throw your rear hand straight toward the target.
Keep your lead hand up to protect your chin.
Pull the hand back along the same line.
Return to your stance and repeat.

exercises.n: uppercut derecho de boxeo
exercises.d: A rising punch with the right hand aimed upward, using leg drive and a hip turn.
i: Stand in a boxing stance with hands up.
Bend your knees slightly and dip your right side.
Drive up through your legs as you rotate your hips.
Throw your right fist upward with the palm facing you.
Keep your left hand guarding your chin.
Return to stance and repeat.

exercises.n: uppercut izquierdo de boxeo
exercises.d: A rising punch with the left hand, thrown upward from the hips and legs.
i: Stand in a boxing stance with hands up.
Bend your knees slightly and dip your left side.
Drive up through your legs as you rotate your hips.
Throw your left fist upward with the palm facing you.
Keep your right hand guarding your chin.
Return to stance and repeat.

exercises.n: abdominal acostado en máquina
exercises.d: A machine crunch performed lying back, letting you load the abs while the lower back stays supported.
i: Lie back on the machine and place your hands or arms as indicated.
Hook your feet or grip the handles for stability.
Curl your torso up by contracting your abs.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly back to the start.
Repeat for the planned reps.

exercises.n: press de pecho en máquina v. 4
exercises.d: A plate-loaded chest press that trains the pecs and triceps along a guided path.
i: Adjust the seat so the handles are at mid-chest height.
Sit back with your shoulder blades pulled together.
Press the handles forward until your arms are almost straight.
Do not lock your elbows.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch in the chest.
Repeat for the planned reps.

exercises.n: press de pecho declinado en máquina v. 2
exercises.d: A decline-angle machine press that emphasises the lower part of the chest.
i: Adjust the seat and sit with your back against the pad.
Grip the handles with elbows bent.
Press forward and slightly downward until your arms are almost straight.
Keep your shoulders down and your chest up.
Return slowly under control.
Repeat for the planned reps.

exercises.n: carrera en bicicleta estática v. 4
exercises.d: A stationary bike session at a brisk pace, similar to running in effort, to build heart and leg endurance.
i: Adjust the seat so your knees stay slightly bent at the bottom of the stroke.
Hold the handles and sit tall.
Start pedalling at an easy pace to warm up.
Raise the speed to a brisk rhythm you can sustain.
Keep your upper body relaxed.
Continue for 10-30 minutes, then slow down to cool off.

exercises.n: extensión de cuello en máquina (con discos)
exercises.d: A plate-loaded machine movement that strengthens the muscles at the back of the neck.
i: Set the weight light and adjust the pad to rest on the back of your head.
Sit tall and bring your chin slightly down.
Press your head back against the pad slowly.
Move only through a comfortable range.
Return slowly to the start.
Repeat for the planned reps with control.

exercises.n: flexión lateral izquierda de cuello en máquina (con discos)
exercises.en: lever neck left side flexion (plate loaded)
exercises.d: A plate-loaded neck exercise that bends the head sideways to the left to strengthen the side neck muscles.
i: Set the weight light and position the pad against the left side of your head.
Sit tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Tilt your head to the left against the resistance.
Keep the movement small and smooth.
Return slowly to the centre.
Repeat for the planned reps with control.

exercises.n: flexión lateral derecha de cuello en máquina (con discos)
exercises.en: lever neck right side flexion (plate loaded)
exercises.d: A plate-loaded neck exercise that bends the head sideways to the right to strengthen the side neck muscles.
i: Set the weight light and position the pad against the right side of your head.
Sit tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Tilt your head to the right against the resistance.
Keep the movement small and smooth.
Return slowly to the centre.
Repeat for the planned reps with control.

exercises.n: pullover en máquina
exercises.d: A machine pullover that sweeps the handles toward you. Works the lats with a long range of motion.
i: Ajusta el asiento y las asas de la máquina de palanca a una posición cómoda.
Siéntate en la máquina con la espalda apoyada en la almohadilla y sujeta las asas con un agarre prono.
Mantén los brazos ligeramente flexionados y el core activado.
Tira lentamente de las asas hacia el pecho, apretando los dorsales.
Haz una pausa breve en el punto máximo de contracción, luego vuelve lentamente a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: extensión de cadera en máquina v. 2
exercises.d: A machine hip extension that drives your leg back against resistance. Targets the glutes and hamstrings.
i: Ajusta la máquina a tu cuerpo y siéntate en ella con la espalda apoyada en el respaldo.
Coloca los pies en los apoyapiés y sujeta las asas para mayor estabilidad.
Activa los glúteos y los isquiotibiales, luego empuja contra los apoyapiés para extender las caderas y levantar las piernas hacia atrás.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte superior, luego baja lentamente las piernas de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: prensa de piernas alternada en máquina
exercises.d: A machine leg press done one leg at a time, alternating. Builds the quads and glutes.
i: Ajusta el asiento y la plataforma para los pies de la máquina de palanca a la posición deseada.
Siéntate en la máquina con la espalda apoyada en el respaldo y los pies sobre la plataforma para los pies.
Coloca las manos en las asas o en los lados de la máquina para mayor estabilidad.
Empuja un pie contra la plataforma para los pies, extendiendo la pierna hasta que esté casi completamente recta.
Haz una pausa breve, luego flexiona lentamente la pierna y vuelve a la posición inicial.
Repite con la otra pierna.
Continúa alternando las piernas durante el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: fortalecedor de agarre en máquina
exercises.d: A machine gripper where you squeeze the handles closed. Strengthens the forearms and grip.
i: Ajusta la altura del asiento y sujeta las asas de la máquina de palanca.
Mantén la espalda recta y los pies planos en el suelo.
Exhala y aprieta las asas, contrayendo los antebrazos.
Mantén la contracción durante un segundo, luego suelta lentamente y vuelve a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: prensa de gemelos en máquina
exercises.d: A machine calf press pushing the pad with your toes. Builds the calf muscles.
i: Ajusta el asiento de la máquina de palanca de modo que los hombros queden alineados con la almohadilla de la palanca.
Coloca los dedos de los pies sobre la almohadilla de la palanca, con los talones colgando fuera del borde.
Sujeta las asas o los soportes laterales para mayor estabilidad.
Empuja la almohadilla de la palanca hacia abajo extendiendo los tobillos, contrayendo los músculos de las pantorrillas.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte baja del movimiento.
Vuelve lentamente a la posición inicial dejando que los talones se eleven de nuevo.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: sentadilla búlgara con mancuernas
exercises.d: A single-leg squat with the back foot raised, building leg strength and balance.
i: Stand a stride length in front of a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Rest the top of your back foot on the bench.
Lower straight down until your front thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee tracking over your toes.
Drive through your front heel to stand back up.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: jalón al pecho con agarre abierto en polea
exercises.d: A pulldown with a wide grip that builds the broad muscles of the upper back.
i: Sit at the pulldown station and secure your thighs under the pads.
Grab the bar with a wide overhand grip.
Lean back slightly and pull the bar down to your upper chest.
Drive your elbows down and back, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Control the bar back up until your arms are fully extended.
Avoid swinging your torso.

exercises.n: elevación de deltoide posterior con mancuernas
exercises.d: A bent-over dumbbell raise to the sides. Trains the rear delts and upper back.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros y sostén una mancuerna en cada mano, con las palmas hacia el cuerpo.
Flexiona ligeramente las rodillas e inclínate hacia adelante desde las caderas, manteniendo la espalda recta.
Levanta los brazos hacia los lados, manteniendo una ligera flexión en los codos, hasta que queden paralelos al suelo.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte superior, luego baja lentamente los brazos de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: curl predicador Zottman de pie con mancuernas
exercises.d: A standing zottman curl against a preacher bench, curling up then turning your palms down to lower. Works the biceps and forearms.
i: Ponte de pie con una mancuerna en cada mano, con las palmas hacia adelante.
Apoya la parte superior de los brazos contra el banco scott y mantén los codos ligeramente flexionados.
Flexiona las mancuernas hacia los hombros mientras mantienes fija la parte superior de los brazos.
En la parte superior del movimiento, gira las muñecas de modo que las palmas queden hacia abajo.
Baja lentamente las mancuernas de vuelta a la posición inicial, girando también las muñecas a su posición original.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: curl predicador Zottman con mancuernas
exercises.d: A seated zottman curl on a preacher bench, curling up then turning your palms down to lower. Works the biceps and forearms.
i: Siéntate en un banco scott con una mancuerna en cada mano, con las palmas hacia arriba y los codos apoyados en la almohadilla.
Flexiona las mancuernas hacia los hombros, manteniendo fija la parte superior de los brazos y las palmas hacia arriba.
En la parte superior del curl, gira las muñecas de modo que las palmas queden hacia abajo.
Baja lentamente las mancuernas de vuelta a la posición inicial, girando también las muñecas a su posición original mientras lo haces.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: rodillo en balón de estabilidad
exercises.d: Rolling a ball forward with your forearms to challenge the abs and core stability.
i: Kneel in front of a stability ball and place your forearms on it.
Brace your abs and keep your body in a straight line from knees to head.
Roll the ball forward by extending your arms and body.
Stop when you feel your core working hard without your back sagging.
Pull the ball back by squeezing your abs.
Repeat slowly.

exercises.n: abdominal en balón de estabilidad (rango completo, manos detrás de la cabeza)
exercises.en: stability ball crunch (full range hands behind head)
exercises.d: A full-range crunch on a stability ball with hands behind your head. Works the abs through a longer range.
i: Siéntate en el balón de estabilidad con los pies planos en el suelo y las rodillas flexionadas en un ángulo de 90 grados.
Coloca las manos detrás de la cabeza con los codos apuntando hacia afuera.
Activando el abdomen, curva lentamente la parte superior del cuerpo hacia adelante, llevando el pecho hacia las rodillas.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte superior, luego baja lentamente la parte superior del cuerpo de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: remo invertido en banco
exercises.d: A bodyweight row hanging beneath a bench or bar, pulling your chest up. Trains the upper back and biceps.
i: Coloca un banco a una altura que permita que el cuerpo cuelgue libremente debajo de él.
Túmbate boca arriba en el suelo con la cabeza hacia el banco.
Estira los brazos hacia arriba y agarra el banco con agarre prono, ligeramente más ancho que la altura de los hombros.
Coloca el cuerpo de manera que los talones queden en el suelo y los brazos completamente extendidos.
Activa el core y aprieta los omóplatos entre sí mientras tiras del pecho hacia el banco.
Haz una pausa breve en la parte superior del movimiento, luego baja lentamente el cuerpo de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: remo invertido con rodillas flexionadas
exercises.d: A bodyweight row beneath a bar with knees bent to make it easier. Builds the upper back and biceps.
i: Coloca una barra a la altura de la cintura y túmbate debajo de ella.
Agarra la barra con agarre prono, ligeramente más ancho que la altura de los hombros.
Coloca el cuerpo de manera que los talones queden en el suelo y el cuerpo esté recto.
Tira del pecho hacia arriba en dirección a la barra apretando los omóplatos entre sí.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte superior, luego baja lentamente el cuerpo de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: patada de gancho trasera
exercises.d: A martial arts kick with the back leg that swings in an arc to strike with the heel, training hip mobility and control.
i: Stand in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Shift your weight onto the lead foot.
Lift the rear knee and extend the leg across the target.
Hook the heel around in an arc.
Bring the leg back under control.
Return to stance and repeat, then switch sides.

exercises.n: patada de gancho delantera
exercises.d: A hooking kick with the lead leg that swings the heel across the target, building balance and hip control.
i: Stand in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Lift the lead knee and point it forward.
Extend the leg and hook the heel across the target.
Keep your supporting foot grounded and your core tight.
Bring the leg back under control.
Return to stance and repeat, then switch sides.

exercises.n: patada frontal a la ingle
exercises.d: A straight forward kick aimed low with the toes or the instep, practising speed and hip flexor power.
i: Stand in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Lift your knee in front of you.
Snap the lower leg forward and low.
Keep your torso upright and balanced.
Pull the leg back quickly.
Return to stance and repeat, then switch legs.

exercises.n: patada de hacha trasera
exercises.d: A kick with the back leg that rises high and then drops down like an axe, training flexibility and control.
i: Stand in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Swing your rear leg straight up in front of you.
Reach the top with the leg extended.
Bring the heel sharply down.
Keep your supporting leg slightly bent and balanced.
Return to stance and repeat, then switch sides.

exercises.n: patada frontal rápida
exercises.d: A quick forward kick that snaps out from the knee, building leg speed and balance.
i: Stand in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Lift your knee toward your chest.
Snap your lower leg forward to the target.
Pull the leg back quickly along the same line.
Keep your supporting foot grounded.
Return to stance and repeat, then switch legs.

exercises.n: patada de gancho giratoria
exercises.d: A spinning kick where you turn your body and sweep the heel in a hook around the target. Great for balance and coordination.
i: Stand in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Turn your head and shoulders to look behind you.
Spin on the ball of your supporting foot.
Swing your kicking leg around and hook the heel across the target.
Land in a balanced stance.
Repeat, then switch sides.

exercises.n: patada lateral
exercises.d: A kick that thrusts the heel out to the side, using hip strength and balance.
i: Stand sideways in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Lift your knee toward your chest.
Extend the leg sideways and push the heel to the target.
Keep your supporting foot turned slightly away.
Pull the leg back and set it down.
Repeat, then switch legs.

exercises.n: patada circular
exercises.d: A kick that swings in an arc to hit with the shin or instep, powered by a hip turn.
i: Stand in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Pivot on your supporting foot and turn the hip over.
Lift the knee and swing the leg in an arc across the target.
Extend the lower leg at the end.
Pull the leg back and return to stance.
Repeat, then switch legs.

exercises.n: patada de empuje con el talón
exercises.d: A pushing front kick that drives the heel forward to create distance, working hips and quads.
i: Stand in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Lift the knee and point the toes up.
Push your heel straight forward, leaning back slightly.
Keep your supporting foot grounded.
Bring the leg back and set it down.
Repeat, then switch legs.

exercises.n: patada trasera giratoria
exercises.d: A kick where you turn your back to the target and thrust the heel straight back, building rotation and balance.
i: Stand in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Turn your head and shoulders to look behind you.
Pivot on your supporting foot.
Kick your leg straight back with the heel leading.
Keep your torso leaning slightly forward for balance.
Return to stance and repeat, then switch sides.

exercises.n: caminata en escalera mecánica
exercises.d: Stepping on a stepmill at a steady pace. A tough, low-impact cardio workout for legs and glutes.
i: Ajusta la máquina de escalones a un nivel cómodo.
Sube a la máquina y coloca las manos sobre los pasamanos para apoyarte.
Comienza a caminar colocando un pie en un escalón y luego el otro, alternando entre las piernas.
Mantén una postura erguida y activa los músculos del core.
Continúa caminando durante la duración o distancia deseada.
Aumenta gradualmente la intensidad o la velocidad a medida que te sientas más cómodo con el ejercicio.
Recuerda enfriar y estirar después de completar el ejercicio.

exercises.n: codo a rodilla acostado
exercises.d: A floor crunch that brings elbow to opposite knee. Works the abs and obliques.
i: Túmbate sobre tu espalda con las rodillas flexionadas y los pies apoyados en el suelo.
Coloca las manos detrás de la cabeza con los codos apuntando hacia afuera.
Activa el abdomen y levanta la parte superior del cuerpo del suelo, llevando el codo derecho hacia la rodilla izquierda.
Al mismo tiempo, extiende la pierna derecha en línea recta y levántala del suelo.
Haz una pausa breve y luego vuelve a la posición inicial.
Repite el movimiento, esta vez llevando el codo izquierdo hacia la rodilla derecha y extendiendo la pierna izquierda.
Continúa alternando lados durante el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: abdominal acostado en máquina v. 2
exercises.d: A machine crunch performed lying back, targeting the abdominal muscles with adjustable resistance.
i: Lie back on the machine and set your feet or hands as the machine requires.
Grip the handles lightly and set your lower back against the pad.
Curl your ribs toward your hips to crunch up.
Exhale and squeeze your abs at the top.
Lower slowly without letting the weight stack rest.
Repeat for the planned reps.

exercises.n: gemelos rotativos en máquina
exercises.d: A seated rotary calf raise on a machine. Builds the calf muscles.
i: Ajusta la altura del asiento de modo que las rodillas queden ligeramente flexionadas y los pies queden planos sobre la placa para los pies.
Coloca los dedos de los pies sobre la placa para los pies, con los talones colgando fuera del borde.
Sujeta las asas o los lados de la máquina para mayor estabilidad.
Empuja con la parte delantera de los pies, elevando los talones tan alto como sea posible.
Haz una pausa breve en la parte alta y luego baja lentamente los talones de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: elevación lateral sentado con brazos flexionados (mancuernas)
exercises.en: dumbbell seated bent arm lateral raise
exercises.d: A seated lateral raise with bent elbows. Targets the side delts with a shorter lever.
i: Siéntate en un banco con la espalda recta y los pies planos sobre el suelo.
Sujeta una mancuerna en cada mano con las palmas hacia tu cuerpo y los brazos flexionados en un ángulo de 90 grados.
Manteniendo los codos flexionados, levanta los brazos hacia los lados hasta que queden paralelos al suelo.
