Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte superior, luego baja lentamente los brazos de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: press de hombros en máquina v. 3
exercises.d: A machine shoulder press, pushing the handles overhead. Builds shoulder and triceps strength.
i: Ajusta la altura del asiento y el respaldo de la máquina de palanca a una posición cómoda.
Siéntate en la máquina con la espalda apoyada en el respaldo y los pies planos en el suelo.
Agarra las asas de la máquina con un agarre prono, un poco más separadas que la anchura de los hombros.
Empuja las asas hacia arriba y hacia adelante hasta que los brazos queden completamente extendidos, pero sin bloquear los codos.
Haz una pausa breve en lo alto, luego baja lentamente las asas de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: curl interno de bíceps de pie con mancuernas v. 2
exercises.en: dumbbell standing inner biceps curl v. 2
exercises.d: A standing biceps curl with the palms turning to face forward as you lift. Works the biceps and brachialis.
i: Ponte de pie con una mancuerna en cada mano, con las palmas mirando hacia el torso.
Mantén los codos cerca del torso y gira las palmas de las manos hasta que queden mirando hacia adelante.
Manteniendo fija la parte superior de los brazos, flexiona los pesos mientras contraes los bíceps.
Continúa levantando las pesas hasta que los bíceps estén completamente contraídos y las mancuernas estén a la altura de los hombros.
Mantén la posición contraída durante una breve pausa mientras aprietas los bíceps.
Comienza a llevar lentamente las mancuernas de vuelta a la posición inicial mientras inhalas.
Repite el número de repeticiones recomendado.

exercises.n: sentadilla sumo con mancuernas
exercises.d: A wide stance squat holding dumbbells that emphasises the glutes and inner thighs.
i: Stand with your feet wider than your shoulders and toes pointing out.
Hold one or two dumbbells with both hands in front of you.
Sit your hips down and back, keeping your chest up.
Lower until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Push through your heels and squeeze your glutes to stand.
Keep your knees in line with your toes.

exercises.n: pull through con piernas rectas en polea (con cuerda)
exercises.en: cable straight legs pull through (with rope)
exercises.d: A cable hinge with straight legs that trains the glutes and hamstrings.
i: Attach a rope to a low pulley and stand facing away from the stack.
Reach through your legs and grab the rope, then step forward to add tension.
Keep your legs nearly straight and hinge forward at the hips.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall while the rope passes between your legs.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Hinge back with control and repeat.

exercises.n: remo con mancuernas de agarre prono a neutro
exercises.en: dumbbell pronated to neutral grip row
exercises.d: A dumbbell row that begins with an overhand grip and turns to a neutral grip, working the back and arms.
i: Hinge forward with a flat back, holding dumbbells with an overhand grip.
Let your arms hang straight below your shoulders.
Row the weights toward your hips while rotating your palms to face each other.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower the dumbbells slowly while turning your palms back down.
Keep your torso still.

exercises.n: remo con mancuernas y agarre prono
exercises.d: A bent-over row with an overhand grip, building the muscles of the mid and upper back.
i: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and hinge forward with a flat back.
Let your arms hang with palms facing your legs.
Pull the dumbbells up toward your lower ribs.
Keep your elbows close to your body and squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Avoid jerking with your torso.

exercises.n: remo con agarre inverso y mancuernas (femenino)
exercises.d: A bent-over dumbbell row using an underhand grip. Trains the upper back and biceps.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros y las rodillas ligeramente flexionadas.
Sujeta una mancuerna en cada mano con agarre prono, con las palmas hacia tu cuerpo.
Inclínate hacia adelante desde la cintura, manteniendo la espalda recta y el core activado.
Deja que tus brazos cuelguen rectos hacia abajo, completamente extendidos, con una ligera flexión en los codos.
Tira de las mancuernas hacia arriba, hacia el pecho, apretando los omóplatos entre sí.
Haz una pausa breve en la parte alta, luego baja lentamente las mancuernas de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: flexiones cerradas en balón de estabilidad
exercises.d: A close-hand push-up with hands on a stability ball. Hits the triceps and chest while the ball challenges your balance.
i: Coloca el balón de estabilidad en el suelo y ponte en posición de flexión con las manos sobre el balón, un poco más juntas que la anchura de los hombros.
Activa el core y mantén el cuerpo en línea recta de la cabeza a los pies.
Baja el pecho hacia el balón flexionando los codos, manteniéndolos cerca del cuerpo.
Haz una pausa breve en la parte baja, luego empújate de nuevo hacia arriba a la posición inicial estirando los brazos.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: giro de columna
exercises.d: A seated torso rotation, twisting side to side. Loosens the spine and works the obliques.
i: Siéntate en el suelo con las piernas extendidas frente a ti.
Dobla las rodillas y coloca los pies planos sobre el suelo, separados a la altura de la cadera.
Coloca las manos detrás de la cabeza con los codos apuntando hacia afuera.
Activa el abdomen y gira lentamente el torso hacia la derecha, llevando el codo derecho hacia la rodilla izquierda.
Haz una pausa por un momento al final de la rotación, luego regresa lentamente a la posición inicial.
Repite el giro hacia el lado izquierdo, llevando el codo izquierdo hacia la rodilla derecha.
Continúa alternando lados durante el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: jalón al pecho en polea (recorrido completo)
exercises.en: cable lat pulldown full range of motion
exercises.d: A cable lat pulldown using the full range of motion. Builds the lats and upper back.
i: Siéntate en la máquina de jalón al pecho con las rodillas colocadas debajo de las almohadillas.
Sujeta la barra del cable con un agarre prono, un poco más separado que el ancho de los hombros.
Inclínate ligeramente hacia atrás y mantén el pecho elevado, conservando un ligero arco en la zona lumbar.
Jala la barra hacia la parte superior del pecho, apretando los omóplatos entre sí.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte baja del movimiento y luego suelta lentamente la barra de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: bicicleta elíptica
exercises.d: Pedalling a cycle cross trainer with arms and legs moving together. Steady, low-impact cardio.
i: Ajusta la altura del asiento y colócate en la bicicleta elíptica.
Coloca los pies en los pedales y sujeta el manillar.
Comienza a pedalear con un movimiento suave y controlado.
Mantén un ritmo constante y aumenta la resistencia si lo deseas.
Continúa pedaleando durante la duración deseada de tu entrenamiento cardiovascular.

exercises.n: colgado con piernas rectas (arm slingers)
exercises.d: A hanging straight-leg raise. Strengthens the abs and hip flexors and challenges your grip.
i: Cuélgate de una barra de dominadas con los brazos completamente extendidos y las piernas estiradas hacia abajo.
Activa el core y levanta las piernas hacia adelante hasta que queden paralelas al suelo.
Mantén un momento en la parte superior, luego baja lentamente las piernas de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: prensa de gemelos acostado en trineo
exercises.d: A calf press on a sled machine while lying back. Builds the calf muscles.
i: Ajusta la máquina de trineo a un peso adecuado.
Siéntate en la máquina de trineo con la espalda contra el respaldo y los pies sobre la plataforma.
Coloca la punta y la almohadilla de los pies en el borde de la plataforma, con los talones colgando.
Empuja la plataforma alejándola de ti extendiendo los tobillos, manteniendo las rodillas ligeramente flexionadas.
Continúa empujando hasta que las pantorrillas estén completamente contraídas.
Mantén la contracción por un momento, luego baja lentamente la plataforma de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: prensa de gemelos sentado en máquina
exercises.d: A seated machine calf press. Builds the calf muscles.
i: Ajusta el asiento de la máquina de modo que los hombros queden alineados con la almohadilla de la palanca.
Coloca los dedos de los pies en la parte inferior de la plataforma y posiciona las rodillas debajo de la almohadilla de la palanca.
Sujeta las asas a los lados del asiento para mayor estabilidad.
Presiona la almohadilla de la palanca hacia abajo extendiendo los tobillos, elevando los talones tan alto como sea posible.
Haz una pausa breve en la parte alta del movimiento, luego baja lentamente los talones de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: press de banca con barra, antebrazos (control de técnica)
exercises.en: barbell chest bench press forearms (form check)
exercises.d: A bench press form check that shows how the forearms should line up under the bar for a safe and strong press.
i: Lie on a bench with your eyes under the bar and your feet planted.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Keep your forearms vertical when the bar is at your chest.
Lower the bar with control to the mid-chest.
Press it up to straight arms without flaring the elbows.
Repeat for the planned reps.

exercises.n: apertura de pecho con mancuernas, brazos (control de técnica)
exercises.d: A chest fly form check that shows how to keep a soft elbow bend and a wide, smooth arc through the movement.
i: Lie on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand above your chest.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Lower your arms out to the sides in a wide arc.
Stop when you feel a gentle stretch across the chest.
Bring the dumbbells back together above your chest.
Repeat for the planned reps.

exercises.n: press de banca, glúteos (control de técnica)
exercises.d: A side-by-side form check for keeping your butt on the bench during a chest press, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
i: Lie on the bench with your eyes under the bar and your feet flat on the floor.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your hips stay planted on the pad and never lift off.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

exercises.n: press de banca, ancho de agarre (control de técnica)
exercises.en: chest bench press grip width (form check)
exercises.d: A side-by-side form check for choosing the right grip width on the bench press, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
i: Lie on the bench and grip the bar at a moderate width.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your forearms are vertical at the bottom, with hands just wider than the shoulders.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

exercises.n: press de banca, hombros (control de técnica)
exercises.d: A side-by-side form check for shoulder position during the bench press, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
i: Lie on the bench and pinch your shoulder blades together before unracking.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your shoulder blades stay pulled back and down against the bench.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

exercises.n: press de banca, brazos (control de técnica)
exercises.d: A side-by-side form check for arm path during the bench press, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
i: Lie on the bench and unrack the bar over your shoulders.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your arms move in a controlled line and the bar tracks over the lower chest.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

exercises.n: press de banca, codos (control de técnica)
exercises.d: A side-by-side form check for elbow position during the bench press, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
i: Lie on the bench with the bar unracked above your chest.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your elbows sit at roughly 45 degrees from the torso instead of flaring wide.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

exercises.n: remo inclinado, espalda (control de técnica)
exercises.d: A side-by-side form check for back position during a bent over row, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
i: Hold the bar and hinge forward at the hips with soft knees.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your spine stays long and flat, not rounded.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

exercises.n: abdominal, espalda (control de técnica)
exercises.d: A side-by-side form check for back position during a crunch, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
i: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands by your head.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your lower back stays gently on the floor while only the upper back curls up.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

exercises.n: sentadilla hack en trineo, piernas (control de técnica)
exercises.d: A side-by-side form check for leg position on the hack squat sled, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
i: Set your back and shoulders against the pads and place your feet on the platform.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your knees track over your toes and your feet sit flat on the platform.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

exercises.n: fondos en banco, espalda y brazos (control de técnica)
exercises.d: A side-by-side form check for back and arm position in bench dips, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
i: Sit on the edge of a bench, grip it beside your hips and slide your butt off.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your back stays close to the bench and your elbows point straight behind you.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

exercises.n: plancha frontal, glúteos (control de técnica)
exercises.d: A front plank form check that compares a raised butt with a straight body line.
i: Place your forearms on the floor with elbows under your shoulders.
Extend your legs behind you with your toes on the floor.
Lift your body into a straight line from head to heels.
Avoid pushing your butt up or letting your hips sag.
Squeeze your abs and glutes to keep the line.
Hold for 20-40 seconds and breathe steadily.

exercises.n: curl predicador, muñecas (control de técnica)
exercises.d: A side-by-side form check for wrist position during a preacher curl, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
i: Sit at the preacher bench with your upper arms flat on the pad.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your wrists stay neutral and straight rather than bending back or curling in.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

exercises.n: plancha lateral, glúteos (control de técnica)
exercises.d: A side plank form check that compares a piked butt with a straight body line.
i: Lie on your side with your forearm on the floor and elbow under your shoulder.
Stack your feet and lift your hips off the floor.
Make a straight line from your head to your feet.
Avoid letting your butt stick out or your hips drop.
Squeeze your abs and glutes to stay level.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.n: flexión, posición inicial (control de técnica)
exercises.d: A side-by-side form check for the starting position of a push-up, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
i: Set your hands on the floor under your shoulders and extend your legs back.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your body forms one straight line from head to heels with hands under the shoulders.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

exercises.n: flexión, posición final (control de técnica)
exercises.d: A side-by-side form check for the bottom position of a push-up, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
i: Start in a high plank and lower yourself under control.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your chest nearly touches the floor, elbows angled back, and hips stay in line.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

exercises.n: curl de bíceps, brazos y cuerpo (control de técnica)
exercises.d: A side-by-side form check for arm and body position during a biceps curl, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
i: Stand tall holding dumbbells at your sides with palms forward.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your elbows stay pinned at your sides and your torso does not swing.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

exercises.n: curl concentrado, brazos (control de técnica)
exercises.d: A side-by-side form check for arm position during a concentration curl, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
i: Sit on a bench, lean forward and brace your elbow against your inner thigh.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your upper arm rests against the inner thigh and only the forearm moves.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

exercises.n: peso muerto, espalda (control de técnica)
exercises.d: A side-by-side form check for back position during a deadlift, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
i: Stand with the bar over mid-foot, hinge down and grip it just outside your legs.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your back stays neutral and braced from the floor to lockout.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

exercises.n: colgado con piernas flexionadas (arm slingers)
exercises.en: arm slingers hanging bent knee legs
exercises.d: A hanging knee raise bringing knees toward your elbows. Strengthens the abs and hip flexors.
i: Cuélgate de una barra de dominadas con los brazos completamente extendidos y las rodillas flexionadas formando un ángulo de 90 grados.
Activa el core y levanta las rodillas hacia el pecho, acercándolas lo más posible a los codos.
Baja lentamente las piernas de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: peso muerto, cadera (control de técnica)
exercises.d: A side-by-side form check for hip position during a deadlift, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
i: Stand with the bar over mid-foot and set your hips at a mid height before gripping.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your hips start above the knees and rise together with your shoulders.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

exercises.n: plancha, glúteos (control de técnica)
exercises.d: A side-by-side form check for hip position in a plank, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
i: Set your forearms on the floor with elbows under the shoulders and legs extended.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your butt stays level with your shoulders, not piked up or sagging down.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

exercises.n: sentadilla con barra, rodillas en posición final (control de técnica)
exercises.en: barbell squat knees end position (form check)
exercises.d: A side-by-side form check for knee position at the bottom of a barbell squat, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
i: Set the bar on your upper back and descend into a full squat.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your knees push out over your toes and do not cave inward.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

exercises.n: sentadilla, rodillas en posición media (control de técnica)
exercises.d: A side-by-side form check for knee position midway through a squat, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
i: Stand with feet shoulder width apart and begin to squat.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your knees keep tracking in line with your toes on the way up and down.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

exercises.n: sentadilla con barra, cadera (control de técnica)
exercises.d: A side-by-side form check for hip position during a barbell squat, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
i: Set the bar on your upper back and squat down to depth.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your hips and chest rise together, without the hips shooting up first.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

exercises.n: sentadilla, espalda (control de técnica)
exercises.d: A side-by-side form check for back position during a squat, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
i: Set the bar on your upper back, brace your core and squat down.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your back stays flat and braced without rounding at the bottom.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

exercises.n: fondos para pecho con agarre abierto en barras paralelas altas
exercises.en: wide-grip chest dip on high parallel bars
exercises.d: A wide-grip dip on high parallel bars, leaning forward. Targets the chest and shoulders.
i: Colócate sobre las barras paralelas con los brazos completamente extendidos y el cuerpo suspendido en el aire.
Inclínate ligeramente hacia adelante y baja el cuerpo flexionando los codos hasta que el pecho quede justo por encima de las barras.
Haz una pausa breve, luego empújate de nuevo hacia arriba a la posición inicial estirando los brazos.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: fondos para pecho asistidos con agarre abierto (de rodillas)
exercises.d: A machine-assisted wide-grip dip with your knees on a pad. Lets you train the chest with less bodyweight.
i: Ajusta la máquina a la altura deseada y asegura las rodillas sobre la almohadilla.
Agarra las agarraderas con un agarre amplio y mantén los codos ligeramente flexionados.
Baja el cuerpo flexionando los codos hasta que los brazos queden paralelos al suelo.
Empuja tu cuerpo de vuelta a la posición inicial extendiendo los brazos.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: pullover con brazos rectos y mancuernas v. 2
exercises.d: A pullover with straight arms that stretches and works the lats and chest.
i: Lie on a bench with your upper back supported and hold a dumbbell over your chest.
Keep your arms nearly straight with a slight bend in the elbows.
Lower the dumbbell in an arc behind your head until you feel a stretch.
Keep your ribs down and your hips stable.
Pull the dumbbell back over your chest using your lats.
Repeat with control.

exercises.n: zancada trasera desde escalón con mancuernas
exercises.d: A reverse lunge from a raised step that works the legs and glutes with a deeper range.
i: Stand on a low step with a dumbbell in each hand.
Step one foot back and off the step.
Lower your back knee toward the floor while keeping your torso upright.
Keep your front knee over your ankle.
Push through your front heel to return to standing.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: sentadillas búlgaras
exercises.d: A bodyweight split squat with a long stance. Builds the quads and glutes one leg at a time.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros.
Da un paso adelante con un pie y colócalo aproximadamente a dos pies de distancia por delante del otro pie.
Baja el cuerpo flexionando las rodillas y las caderas, manteniendo la espalda recta.
Sigue bajando hasta que el muslo delantero quede paralelo al suelo y la rodilla trasera quede justo por encima del suelo.
Haz una pausa breve, luego empuja con el talón delantero para volver a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado y luego cambia de pierna y repite.

exercises.n: giro ruso con peso v. 2
exercises.d: A weighted russian twist, rotating a weight side to side while leaning back. Works the abs and obliques.
i: Siéntate en el suelo con las rodillas flexionadas y los pies apoyados en el suelo.
Sostén el peso con ambas manos frente al pecho.
Inclínate ligeramente hacia atrás para activar los músculos del core.
Gira el torso hacia la derecha, llevando el peso hacia el lado derecho de tu cuerpo.
Haz una pausa de un momento, luego gira el torso hacia la izquierda, llevando el peso hacia el lado izquierdo de tu cuerpo.
Continúa alternando lados durante el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: sentadilla a una pierna con apoyo
exercises.d: A one-leg squat using a support for balance, building strength in each leg.
i: Stand next to a sturdy support and hold it lightly with one hand.
Lift one foot slightly off the floor in front of you.
Sit your hips back and lower on the standing leg.
Keep your knee tracking over your toes.
Push through your heel to stand back up.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: press de hombros a un brazo con mancuerna v. 3
exercises.en: dumbbell one arm shoulder press v. 3
exercises.d: A one-arm overhead press that builds the shoulders and challenges your core.
i: Hold a dumbbell at shoulder height with your palm facing forward.
Stand or sit tall and brace your core.
Press the dumbbell overhead until your arm is straight.
Avoid leaning to the side.
Lower the dumbbell slowly back to your shoulder.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: remo inclinado a un brazo con mancuerna
exercises.en: dumbbell one arm bent over row
exercises.d: A one-arm row in a bent-over position that works the back and arm.
i: Hinge forward with a flat back, one hand on a bench or knee for support.
Hold a dumbbell in the other hand with your arm hanging straight.
Pull the dumbbell toward your hip, keeping your elbow close.
Squeeze your shoulder blade toward your spine.
Lower slowly until your arm is straight.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: hiperextensión en el suelo
exercises.d: A floor-based back extension that strengthens the glutes and lower back.
i: Lie face down with your arms extended or by your head.
Squeeze your glutes and lift your chest and legs slightly off the floor.
Keep your neck neutral and look at the floor.
Pause at the top for a second.
Lower slowly to the floor.
Repeat without forcing a big arch.

exercises.n: bicicleta de aire v. 2
exercises.d: A bicycle crunch variation that trains the abs and obliques through alternating twists.
i: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head.
Lift your shoulders and bring your knees up.
Bring one elbow toward the opposite knee while extending the other leg.
Switch sides in a smooth pedalling motion.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
Continue for the planned reps or time.

exercises.n: curl de bíceps acostado en polea v. 2
exercises.d: Lying on your back with a cable pulling from the floor, you curl the handle toward your shoulders to isolate the biceps under steady tension.
i: Lie on your back on the floor facing the cable stack and hold the bar or handle with palms up.
Keep your upper arms still and pinned to the floor.
Curl the handle toward your shoulders, squeezing the biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are almost straight.
Keep your back flat and avoid lifting your shoulders as you curl.

exercises.n: press Scott con mancuernas
exercises.d: A seated dumbbell press from shoulder height. Builds the shoulders and triceps.
i: Siéntate en un banco con una mancuerna en cada mano, con las palmas hacia adelante.
Sube las mancuernas hasta la altura de los hombros, con los codos flexionados y las palmas hacia adelante.
Empuja las mancuernas hacia arriba hasta que los brazos estén completamente extendidos.
Haz una pausa breve en la parte alta, luego baja lentamente las mancuernas de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: flexiones con agarre cerrado (de rodillas)
exercises.d: A close-grip push-up done on your knees. An easier way to train the triceps and chest.
i: Comienza apoyándote sobre las manos y las rodillas, con las manos separadas a la altura de los hombros y las rodillas separadas a la altura de las caderas.
Baja la parte superior del cuerpo hacia el suelo flexionando los codos, manteniéndolos cerca de los costados.
Haz una pausa breve cuando tu pecho esté justo por encima del suelo.
Empuja con las palmas para estirar los brazos y regresar a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: giro sentado en polea
exercises.d: A seated cable twist, rotating the torso against resistance. Works the obliques and core.
i: Siéntate en una máquina de cable con los pies apoyados planos en el suelo y las rodillas ligeramente flexionadas.
Sujeta la agarradera del cable con ambas manos y extiende los brazos rectos frente a ti.
Manteniendo el core activado, rota lentamente el torso hacia un lado, jalando el cable a través del cuerpo.
Haz una pausa por un momento al final del rango de movimiento y luego rota lentamente de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite del otro lado.
Continúa alternando lados durante el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: curl femoral inverso (en máquina de poleas)
exercises.en: inverse leg curl (on pull-up cable machine)
exercises.d: A bodyweight inverse leg curl using a pull-up cable machine setup. Targets the hamstrings.
i: Ajusta la máquina de cable para que las correas de tobillo estén en el ajuste más bajo.
Túmbate boca abajo en el banco con las piernas extendidas y las correas de tobillo sujetas a los pies.
Sujétate de las agarraderas del banco para mantener la estabilidad.
Dobla las rodillas y curva las piernas hacia los glúteos, contrayendo los isquiotibiales.
Haz una pausa breve en la parte superior del movimiento, luego baja lentamente las piernas de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: curl de bíceps con mancuernas (con arm blaster)
exercises.d: A standing dumbbell curl with an arm blaster to keep your upper arms still. Isolates the biceps.
i: Ponte de pie con una mancuerna en cada mano, con las palmas hacia adelante.
Mantén los codos cerca del torso y los brazos superiores quietos.
Exhala y flexiona las pesas mientras contraes los bíceps.
Continúa levantando las pesas hasta que los bíceps estén completamente contraídos y las mancuernas estén a la altura de los hombros.
Mantén la posición contraída durante una breve pausa mientras aprietas los bíceps.
Inhala y comienza a bajar lentamente las mancuernas de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: curl martillo con mancuernas (con arm blaster)
exercises.d: A standing hammer curl with an arm blaster to prevent swinging. Targets the biceps and brachialis.
i: Ponte de pie con una mancuerna en cada mano, con las palmas mirando hacia el torso.
Mantén los codos cerca del torso y gira las palmas de las manos hasta que queden mirando hacia adelante.
Esta será tu posición inicial.
Ahora, manteniendo el brazo superior quieto, exhala y flexiona los brazos contrayendo los bíceps.
Continúa levantando las pesas hasta que los bíceps estén completamente contraídos y las mancuernas estén a la altura de los hombros.
Mantén la posición contraída durante una breve pausa mientras aprietas los bíceps.
Luego, inhala y comienza a bajar lentamente las mancuernas de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones recomendado.

exercises.n: curl de bíceps alternado con mancuernas (con arm blaster)
exercises.en: dumbbell alternate biceps curl (with arm blaster)
exercises.d: An alternating dumbbell curl with an arm blaster. Keeps your upper arms fixed so the biceps do the work.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros y sujeta una mancuerna en cada mano, con las palmas hacia adelante.
Coloca el soporte para brazos en la parte superior de tus brazos, asegurándote de que quede bien ajustado.
Manteniendo los brazos superiores quietos, exhala y flexiona una mancuerna hacia el hombro mientras contraes el bíceps.
Continúa levantando la mancuerna hasta que el bíceps esté completamente contraído y la mancuerna esté a la altura del hombro.
Mantén la posición contraída durante una breve pausa mientras aprietas los bíceps.
Inhala y baja lentamente la mancuerna de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el movimiento con el brazo contrario.
Continúa alternando los brazos durante el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: curl de bíceps con barra EZ (con arm blaster)
exercises.d: An EZ bar curl with an arm blaster. Isolates the biceps with a comfortable wrist angle.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros y sostén la barra EZ con agarre supino, palmas hacia arriba.
Coloca los brazos superiores contra el soporte de aislamiento de brazos, manteniéndolos inmóviles durante todo el ejercicio.
Manteniendo los codos cerca del cuerpo, exhala y sube la barra hacia los hombros.
Haz una pausa breve en la parte alta, apretando los bíceps.
Inhala y baja lentamente la barra de vuelta a la posición inicial, extendiendo completamente los brazos.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: extensión de tríceps en polea con barra V (con arm blaster)
exercises.d: A cable pushdown with a v-bar and an arm blaster. Isolates the triceps.
i: Coloca un accesorio en V en la máquina de cable en el ajuste más alto.
Ponte de pie frente a la máquina de cable con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros.
Agarra el accesorio en V con un agarre prono, con las palmas hacia abajo y las manos separadas a la altura de los hombros.
Mantén los codos cerca de los costados y los brazos superiores quietos durante todo el ejercicio.
Activa los tríceps y exhala mientras empujas el accesorio en V hacia abajo hasta que los brazos estén completamente extendidos.
Haz una pausa breve en la parte baja del movimiento, apretando los tríceps.
Inhala mientras regresas lentamente el accesorio en V a la posición inicial, manteniendo el control.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: extensión de tríceps en polea con agarre inverso y barra SZ (con arm blaster)
exercises.en: cable reverse grip triceps pushdown (sz-bar) (with arm blaster)
exercises.d: A reverse grip cable pushdown with an arm blaster. Targets the triceps with a different hand angle.
i: Sujeta una barra recta a la máquina de cable en el ajuste más alto.
Ponte de pie frente a la máquina de cable con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros.
Sujeta la barra con un agarre supino, con las palmas hacia arriba y las manos separadas a la altura de los hombros.
Mantén los codos cerca de los costados y los brazos superiores quietos durante todo el ejercicio.
Activa los tríceps y empuja lentamente la barra hacia abajo hasta que los brazos queden completamente extendidos.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte baja y luego regresa lentamente la barra a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: curl de bíceps con barra (con arm blaster)
exercises.d: A barbell curl with an arm blaster. Keeps your elbows still so the biceps do the work.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros y sujeta una barra con un agarre supino, con las palmas hacia arriba.
Coloca los brazos superiores contra el soporte para brazos, manteniendo los codos cerca del torso.
Manteniendo los brazos superiores fijos, exhala y levanta el peso mientras contraes los bíceps.
Continúa levantando la barra hasta que los bíceps estén completamente contraídos y la barra esté a la altura de los hombros.
Mantén la posición contraída durante una breve pausa mientras aprietas los bíceps.
Inhala y comienza a bajar lentamente la barra de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: extensión de cuello acostado con peso (con arnés de cabeza)
exercises.en: weighted lying neck extension (with head harness)
exercises.d: Lying face down with a harness on your head, you lift against added weight to strengthen the muscles at the back of the neck.
i: Lie face down on a bench with your head past the edge and the weighted harness fitted.
Start with your chin tucked toward your chest.
Raise your head slowly until your face looks forward.
Pause, then lower back under control.
Use a light weight and smooth reps, never jerking the neck.

exercises.n: flexión de cuello acostado con peso (con arnés de cabeza)
exercises.en: weighted lying neck flexion (with head harness)
exercises.d: Lying on your back with a weighted head harness, you lift your chin toward your chest to train the neck flexors.
i: Lie on your back on a bench with your head past the edge and the harness fitted.
Let your head hang back slightly in a comfortable range.
Curl your chin toward your chest slowly.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower under control and keep the weight light with smooth reps.

exercises.n: extensión de cuello de pie con peso (con arnés de cabeza)
exercises.en: weighted standing neck extension (with head harness)
exercises.d: Standing and bent forward with a weighted harness, you raise your head against the load to build the back of the neck.
i: Fit the head harness with a light weight hanging in front.
Stand and hinge forward, resting your hands on your thighs.
Let your chin drop toward your chest.
Lift your head until your gaze is forward.
Lower slowly and keep the movement small and controlled.

exercises.n: extensión de cuello sentado en polea (con arnés de cabeza)
exercises.en: cable seated neck extension (with head harness)
exercises.d: Seated with a harness attached to a cable, you pull your head back against steady resistance to train the neck extensors.
i: Fit the head harness and sit facing the cable with it attached at head height.
Start with your head tipped slightly forward.
Pull your head back until it is upright.
Pause, then return slowly against the cable.
Keep the load light and your shoulders relaxed.

exercises.n: flexión de cuello sentado en polea (con arnés de cabeza)
exercises.en: cable seated neck flexion (with head harness)
exercises.d: Seated with a harness attached to a cable behind you, you tuck your chin forward to train the neck flexors.
i: Fit the head harness and sit facing away from the cable, attached at head height.
Start with your head tilted slightly back.
Bring your chin toward your chest.
Pause, then return slowly in control.
Keep the load light and your shoulders relaxed.

exercises.n: curl drag con agarre abierto y barra
exercises.d: A curl where the bar drags up your torso with a wide grip, targeting the biceps.
i: Stand holding a barbell with a wide underhand grip.
Keep your elbows pointing back and the bar close to your body.
Drag the bar up your torso by pulling your elbows behind you.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly along the same path.
Keep your torso upright.

exercises.n: curl concentrado de pie con barra
exercises.d: A one-arm barbell curl while standing, with the other hand resting on your thigh. Isolates the biceps.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros y sujeta una barra con una mano, con la palma hacia arriba.
Apoya la otra mano sobre el muslo para mayor estabilidad.
Manteniendo el brazo superior quieto, exhala y flexiona el peso hacia el hombro.
Haz una pausa breve en la parte alta, apretando los bíceps.
Inhala y baja lentamente el peso de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado, luego cambia de brazo.

exercises.n: elevación lateral inclinada a un brazo con mancuerna
exercises.en: dumbbell single arm leaning lateral raise
exercises.d: A lateral raise done while leaning away from a support for a greater range on the side delt.
i: Hold a support with one hand and lean your body away.
Hold a dumbbell in your free hand by your side.
Raise the dumbbell out to the side until it reaches shoulder height.
Keep a slight bend in your elbow.
Lower slowly to the start.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: caminata de pato con banda elástica
exercises.d: A low squat walk with a band around the legs that fires up the glutes and hips.
i: Place a loop band around your thighs or knees.
Lower into a half squat with your chest up.
Step sideways or forward with a wide stride.
Keep tension on the band and your knees out.
Bring your other foot in, staying low.
Walk for the planned distance, then return.

exercises.n: patada lateral con pierna flexionada de rodillas con banda elástica
exercises.en: resistance band bent leg side kick (kneeling)
exercises.d: A kneeling side kick with a band that targets the glutes and outer hips.
i: Kneel on all fours with a band around your thighs.
Keep your core braced and your back flat.
Lift one bent leg out to the side against the band.
Pause when your thigh is about hip height.
Lower slowly without twisting your torso.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: elevación de pierna con banda elástica
exercises.d: A leg lift against band tension that trains the glutes and hips.
i: Place a loop band around your ankles or thighs.
Get on all fours or stand with support.
Lift one leg back or out against the band.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly without arching your back.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: bicicleta de aire con banda elástica
exercises.d: A bicycle crunch with a band adding resistance to the leg movement.
i: Lie on your back with a band looped around your feet.
Hold the ends with your hands or place them by your head.
Lift your shoulders and bring your knees up.
Pedal your legs while twisting your elbow toward the opposite knee.
Keep your lower back flat.
Continue for the planned reps.

exercises.n: hiperextensión en el suelo con banda elástica
exercises.d: A floor back extension with band resistance for the lower back and glutes.
i: Lie face down and anchor a band under your hands or around your upper back.
Squeeze your glutes and lift your chest slightly off the floor.
Keep your neck neutral.
Pause for a second at the top.
Lower slowly to the floor.
Repeat without overarching.

exercises.n: zancada con banda elástica
exercises.d: A lunge with band resistance that works the legs and glutes.
i: Stand on the middle of a band and hold the ends at your shoulders.
Step forward into a lunge.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and your torso tall.
Push through your front heel to return.
Alternate legs for the planned reps.

exercises.n: elevación de gemelos con banda elástica
exercises.d: A calf raise with a band that builds lower leg strength.
i: Sit or stand with the band under the balls of your feet.
Hold the ends firmly.
Press up onto your toes against the band.
Pause at the top and squeeze your calves.
Lower your heels slowly.
Repeat for the planned reps.

exercises.n: abdominal rana
exercises.d: A crunch that curls your upper body up with your knees bent. Works the abs.
i: Túmbate sobre tu espalda con las rodillas flexionadas y los pies apoyados en el suelo.
Coloca las manos detrás de la cabeza con los codos apuntando hacia afuera.
Activando el abdomen, levanta la parte superior del cuerpo del suelo, curvándote hacia adelante hasta que el torso forme un ángulo de 45 grados.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte superior, luego baja lentamente la parte superior del cuerpo de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: sentadilla sumo entre bancos con mancuerna
exercises.d: A wide squat with feet on benches that extends the range of motion for the glutes and inner thighs.
i: Place a bench under each foot with a wide stance.
Hold a dumbbell in front of you with both hands.
Sit your hips down between the benches.
Lower until you feel a deep stretch in your hips.
Push through your heels to stand.
Keep your chest up throughout.

exercises.n: press de banca con agarre cerrado y barra EZ
exercises.d: A close-grip bench press with an EZ bar. Targets the triceps with less wrist strain.
i: Túmbate sobre un banco con los pies apoyados en el suelo y la espalda presionada contra el banco.
Sujeta la barra EZ con agarre cerrado, manos separadas a la altura de los hombros, palmas hacia adelante.
Levanta la barra del soporte y sostenla directamente sobre el pecho con los brazos completamente extendidos.
Baja la barra lentamente hacia el pecho, manteniendo los codos cerca del cuerpo.
Haz una pausa breve cuando la barra toque el pecho.
Empuja la barra de vuelta a la posición inicial, extendiendo completamente los brazos.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: giro sentado en el suelo en polea
exercises.d: A seated rotation with a cable that trains the obliques and core.
i: Sit on the floor facing a low cable and hold the handle.
Lean back slightly and lift your feet if you can.
Rotate your torso from side to side.
Keep your arms steady and your core tight.
Move slowly without jerking.
Continue for the planned reps.

exercises.n: wall ball
exercises.d: A squat-to-throw movement with a medicine ball that conditions the whole body.
i: Stand facing a wall holding a medicine ball at your chest.
Squat down with your chest up.
Drive up powerfully and throw the ball to a target on the wall.
Catch the ball as it returns.
Flow straight into the next squat.
Keep a steady rhythm.

exercises.n: volteo de llanta
exercises.d: Flipping a heavy tire end over end by driving through your legs. Builds full-body power, especially glutes and legs.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros, de frente al neumático.
Flexiona las rodillas y dobla las caderas, bajando a una posición de sentadilla.
Agáchate y agarra el borde inferior del neumático con ambas manos, con los dedos apuntando hacia ti.
Activa los glúteos y los músculos de las piernas, y empuja con fuerza a través de las piernas para levantar el neumático del suelo.
Mientras el neumático se voltea, usa la fuerza de la parte superior del cuerpo para guiarlo y mantener el control.
Una vez que el neumático esté completamente volteado, retrocede rápidamente y reinicia tu postura.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: almeja acostado de lado
exercises.d: Lying on your side with knees bent, you open the top knee like a clam to strengthen the outer hip and glutes.
i: Lie on your side with knees bent and feet stacked, head on your arm.
Keep your hips stacked and your core lightly braced.
Lift the top knee while keeping your feet together.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Do all reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: fondos para pecho en barra recta
exercises.d: A chest dip on a bar, leaning forward and crossing your ankles. Targets the chest and triceps.
i: Agarra las barras paralelas con las palmas hacia abajo y los brazos completamente extendidos.
Flexiona las rodillas y cruza los tobillos.
Baja el cuerpo flexionando los brazos hasta que los hombros queden por debajo de los codos.
Empújate de vuelta hacia arriba a la posición inicial extendiendo los brazos.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: toque de pies con banda elástica
exercises.d: A crunch variation where you reach up to your toes with band tension.
i: Lie on your back with a band around your feet.
Lift your legs toward the ceiling.
Hold the band ends and reach toward your toes.
Curl your shoulders off the floor.
Lower with control.
Repeat for the planned reps.

exercises.n: remo kayak Thibaudeau en polea
exercises.d: A one-arm cable row with a rotating kayak-style pull. Trains the lats and upper back.
i: Coloca un mango de cable en una polea baja y siéntate frente a la máquina con los pies planos en el suelo.
Agarra el mango con la mano derecha y extiende completamente el brazo, manteniendo una ligera flexión en el codo.
Inclínate hacia adelante desde las caderas, manteniendo la espalda recta y el abdomen activado.
Tira del mango hacia tu torso retrayendo el omóplato y flexionando el codo, manteniendo el brazo cerca del cuerpo.
Aprieta los músculos de la espalda en la parte alta del movimiento, luego regresa lentamente a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado, luego cambia de lado y realiza el ejercicio con el brazo izquierdo.

exercises.n: jumping jack con banda elástica
exercises.d: A jumping jack with a band that raises your heart rate and adds a challenge to the hips and shoulders.
i: Stand with a loop band around your thighs or ankles.
Keep your knees soft and your core tight.
Jump your feet apart while raising your arms overhead.
Push against the band as you land.
Jump back to the start with your arms down.
Keep a steady rhythm.

exercises.n: puente con escaladores cruzados
exercises.d: A plank-position mountain climber driving knee across the body. Works the abs and obliques, and raises your heart rate.
i: Comienza en una posición de plancha alta con las manos justo debajo de los hombros y el cuerpo en línea recta.
Activa el core y levanta el pie derecho del suelo, llevando la rodilla derecha hacia el codo izquierdo.
Vuelve a colocar el pie derecho en la posición inicial y repite el movimiento llevando el pie izquierdo hacia el codo derecho.
Continúa alternando los lados, moviéndote a un ritmo controlado.
Mantén las caderas niveladas y evita levantarlas demasiado alto o dejarlas caer demasiado bajo.
Mantén un patrón de respiración constante durante todo el ejercicio.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: subida lateral al banco con mancuernas
exercises.d: A side-on step up with dumbbells that builds the legs and glutes.
i: Stand beside a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Place your near foot on the bench.
Drive through that heel to step up onto the bench.
Bring your other foot up to balance.
Step down with control.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: abdominal de rana en balón de estabilidad
exercises.d: A crunch on a stability ball with the legs in a frog position to hit the lower abs.
i: Lie back on a stability ball with your lower back supported.
Place the soles of your feet together with your knees out.
Place your hands lightly by your head.
Crunch up while pulling your knees toward your chest.
Squeeze your abs.
Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.n: elevación de deltoide posterior acostado en el suelo (mancuernas)
exercises.en: dumbbell lying on floor rear delt raise
exercises.d: A rear delt raise performed lying face down on the floor. Targets the rear shoulders and upper back.
i: Túmbate boca abajo en el suelo con una mancuerna en cada mano, con las palmas enfrentadas entre sí.
Extiende los brazos rectos frente a ti, manteniendo una ligera flexión en los codos.
Activando los músculos de los hombros, levanta los brazos hacia arriba y hacia los lados, juntando los omóplatos.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte superior, luego baja lentamente los brazos de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: puente de glúteos con dos piernas en el suelo
exercises.en: glute bridge two legs on floor
exercises.d: A floor bridge with both feet down that strengthens the glutes and hamstrings.
i: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Place your arms by your sides.
Push through your heels to lift your hips.
Make a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.n: puente de glúteos a una pierna en banco
exercises.en: glute bridge one leg on bench
exercises.d: A single-leg bridge with a foot on a bench that targets the glutes harder.
i: Lie on your back with one foot on a bench and the other leg extended.
Brace your core.
Push through the planted heel to lift your hips.
Keep your hips level.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: puente de glúteos a una pierna en el suelo (pierna recta)
exercises.en: glute bridge one leg on floor (straight leg)
exercises.d: A single-leg bridge with the free leg straight, working the glutes and core.
i: Lie on your back with one knee bent and the other leg straight up.
Keep your arms by your sides.
Push through your planted heel to lift your hips.
Keep your hips level.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: puente de glúteos a una pierna en el suelo (rodilla flexionada)
exercises.en: glute bridge one leg on floor (bent knee)
exercises.d: A single-leg bridge with the free knee bent toward your chest.
i: Lie on your back with one foot on the floor and the other knee pulled up.
Place your arms by your sides.
Push through the planted heel to lift your hips.
Keep your pelvis level.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: curl martillo con mancuernas v. 3
exercises.d: A curl with a neutral grip that works the biceps and forearms.
i: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides with palms facing in.
Keep your elbows close to your torso.
Curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders.
Keep your wrists straight.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.n: apertura posterior con mancuernas
exercises.d: A bent-over fly that targets the rear of the shoulders.
i: Hinge forward with a flat back, holding dumbbells below your chest.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise the dumbbells out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly to the start.
Keep your neck neutral.

exercises.n: apertura posterior inclinada con mancuernas
exercises.d: A chest-supported rear fly on an incline bench that isolates the rear shoulders.
i: Lie face down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang with a slight bend in the elbows.
Raise the dumbbells out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your chest on the pad.

exercises.n: remo inclinado con agarre inverso y barra
exercises.d: A chest-supported row with an underhand grip that works the lats and upper back.
i: Lie chest down on an incline bench holding a barbell with an underhand grip.
Let your arms hang straight.
Row the bar toward your lower ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your chest on the pad.

exercises.n: remo inclinado con agarre inverso y mancuernas
exercises.d: A chest-supported dumbbell row with an underhand grip for the lats and upper back.
i: Lie chest down on an incline bench holding dumbbells with an underhand grip.
Let your arms hang straight.
Row the dumbbells toward your lower ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your chest on the pad.

exercises.n: elevación frontal en polea v. 2
exercises.d: A cable raise to the front that works the front of the shoulders.
i: Stand facing away from a low pulley, holding the handle in front of your thighs.
Keep a slight bend in your elbow.
Raise your arm forward to shoulder height.
Avoid leaning back.
Lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: abdominal declinado con giro
exercises.d: A sit up on a decline bench with a twist to work the abs and obliques.
i: Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured.
Place your hands lightly behind your head.
Sit up while rotating your torso to one side.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control.
Alternate sides each rep.

exercises.n: de pie sobre plataforma vibratoria
exercises.d: A standing hold on a vibrating platform that engages the legs and core.
i: Step onto the vibrating plate with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Keep your knees slightly bent.
Hold your posture tall and your core braced.
Keep your weight balanced over your feet.
Hold for 30-60 seconds.
Step off carefully.

exercises.n: plancha sobre plataforma vibratoria
exercises.d: A plank held on a vibrating platform that adds challenge to your core.
i: Place your forearms or hands on the vibrating plate.
Extend your legs behind you.
Form a straight line from head to heels.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes.
Hold for 20-40 seconds.
Come down carefully.

exercises.n: zancada sobre plataforma vibratoria
exercises.d: A lunge with the front foot on a vibrating plate for added stability work.
i: Place one foot on the vibrating plate and step the other back.
Lower into a lunge with your torso upright.
Keep your front knee over your ankle.
Hold the bottom briefly.
Push up to return.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: jalón trasero con agarre abierto tras nuca en polea v. 2
exercises.en: cable wide grip rear pulldown behind neck v. 2
exercises.d: A wide pulldown to the back of the neck that works the lats and upper back.
i: Sit at the pulldown station with your thighs secured.
Grab the bar with a wide overhand grip.
Lean forward slightly and pull the bar down behind your head to the base of your neck.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Control the bar back up.
Move gently and keep your neck neutral.

exercises.n: puente de glúteos con banda elástica v. 2
exercises.d: A glute bridge with a band around the thighs that adds hip activation.
i: Lie on your back with a loop band around your thighs.
Bend your knees with feet flat.
Push your knees out against the band.
Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.n: sentadilla completa en banco
exercises.d: A deep squat down to a bench that builds the legs and hips.
i: Stand in front of a bench with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Keep your chest up.
Sit your hips back and lower until you touch the bench.
Pause briefly without relaxing.
Push through your heels to stand.
Repeat for the planned reps.

exercises.n: salto lateral al banco
exercises.d: A side-on jump onto a bench that builds explosive leg power.
i: Stand beside a sturdy bench.
Bend your knees and swing your arms back.
Jump up and sideways onto the bench.
Land softly with your knees bent.
Step down carefully.
Repeat, alternating sides.

exercises.n: salto lateral y subida al escalón
exercises.d: A side-on step with a jump that trains power in the legs.
i: Stand beside a low step.
Place your near foot on the step.
Drive up with a small jump.
Land softly on the step.
Step down with control.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: remo con tirón de trineo de potencia
exercises.d: A row performed while pulling a loaded sled for back and grip strength.
i: Attach a rope or handles to a loaded sled.
Hold the rope with your knees slightly bent.
Pull the sled toward you with a rowing motion.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Keep your back flat.
Repeat for the planned distance.

exercises.n: plancha jack sobre balón medicinal
exercises.d: A plank with jumping jack feet on a medicine ball, challenging core stability.
i: Place your hands on a medicine ball in a plank.
Brace your abs and keep your body straight.
Jump your feet wide.
Jump them back together.
Keep your hips level.
Continue for the planned reps.

exercises.n: pullover con brazos flexionados y rodillas flexionadas con mancuerna
exercises.en: dumbbell bent arm pullover with knees bent
exercises.d: A lying pullover with a bent elbow that stretches and works the chest, with help from the lats and triceps.
i: Lie back on a bench or the floor with knees bent and feet flat, holding one dumbbell over your chest.
Bend your elbows slightly and lock that angle.
Lower the dumbbell back over your head in a slow arc until you feel a stretch in your chest.
Pull the weight back over your chest along the same arc.
Keep your ribs down and your lower back from arching.

exercises.n: estiramiento del piriforme sentado
exercises.d: A seated stretch for the piriformis and glute muscles. Helps loosen tight hips.
i: Siéntate en el suelo con las piernas extendidas frente a ti.
Dobla la rodilla derecha y coloca el pie derecho en la parte exterior de la rodilla izquierda.
Coloca el codo izquierdo en la parte exterior de la rodilla derecha y gira suavemente el torso hacia la derecha.
Mantén el estiramiento durante 20-30 segundos, luego cambia de lado y repite.

exercises.n: sentadillas cosaco
exercises.d: A wide side-to-side squat where you sink onto one leg while the other stays straight. It builds leg strength and hip mobility.
i: Stand with your feet much wider than shoulder width and toes slightly out.
Shift your weight to one side and bend that knee, sitting your hips down and back.
Keep the other leg straight with the heel down and toes up.
Push through the bent leg to slide back to the centre.
Repeat on the other side and keep your chest tall.

exercises.n: círculo de pierna flexionada de rodillas
exercises.d: A kneeling Pilates move where one bent leg draws circles in the air. It works the glutes and hips while the core keeps you steady.
i: Start on hands and knees with your hands under your shoulders.
Lift one leg out to the side with the knee bent.
Draw slow circles in the air with your knee.
Keep your hips level and your spine still.
Switch direction, then repeat on the other leg.

exercises.n: estiramiento de rana con balanceo
exercises.d: A rocking frog stretch that opens the hips and inner thighs. Helps loosen the glutes and groin.
i: Comienza arrodillándote en el suelo con las rodillas separadas a la altura de las caderas.
Coloca las manos en el suelo frente a ti para mayor apoyo.
Inclínate lentamente hacia adelante, desplazando el peso hacia las manos y extendiendo las piernas detrás de ti.
Mantén la espalda recta y activa los glúteos mientras empujas las caderas hacia atrás y hacia arriba en dirección al techo.
Mantén esta posición durante unos segundos, sintiendo un estiramiento en los glúteos.
Vuelve lentamente a la posición inicial flexionando las rodillas y bajando las caderas de nuevo.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: roll overs a v sits
exercises.d: You roll back over your shoulders and then roll forward into a V sit, working the abs and building control.
i: Sit with knees bent and arms reaching forward.
Roll back, lifting your legs up and over toward your head.
Roll forward with control and extend your legs.
Land in a balanced V sit, with arms reaching toward your feet.
Move smoothly and use your abs to drive the motion.

exercises.n: extensión de tríceps acostado con mancuernas v. 2
exercises.d: A classic lying extension that isolates the triceps by bending only at the elbows.
i: Lie on a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand above your chest, palms facing in.
Keep your upper arms still and bend your elbows to lower the weights beside your head.
Stop when you feel a stretch in the triceps.
Straighten your arms back to the start.
Keep your elbows pointing at the ceiling.

exercises.n: prensa horizontal a una pierna en máquina
exercises.d: A horizontal machine leg press done one leg at a time. Builds the glutes and quads.
i: Ajusta el asiento de la máquina de modo que las rodillas queden en un ángulo de 90 grados cuando los pies estén sobre la placa para los pies.
Siéntate en la máquina con la espalda apoyada en el respaldo y los pies separados a la altura de los hombros sobre la placa para los pies.
Coloca las manos en las asas o en los lados de la máquina para mayor estabilidad.
Empuja la placa para los pies alejándola del cuerpo extendiendo la pierna, manteniendo la espalda apoyada en el respaldo.
Haz una pausa breve en la posición completamente extendida, luego flexiona lentamente la pierna para volver a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado, luego cambia de pierna.

exercises.n: saltar la cuerda
exercises.d: Skipping over a rope at a steady pace. Classic cardio that builds endurance and coordination.
i: Sujeta las asas de la cuerda de saltar con las manos, palmas hacia adentro.
Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros y las rodillas ligeramente flexionadas.
Balancea la cuerda por encima de la cabeza y salta sobre ella cuando se acerque a los pies.
Aterriza suavemente sobre la punta de los pies y repite el salto cuando la cuerda vuelva a pasar.
Continúa saltando durante el tiempo o el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: jalón lateral con barra V en polea
exercises.d: A lat pulldown with a v-bar attachment. Builds the lats and upper back.
i: Siéntate en la máquina de jalón de cable y agarra el accesorio en V con un agarre prono.
Ajusta la almohadilla de rodillas para que tus muslos queden asegurados debajo de ella.
Mantén la espalda recta e inclínate ligeramente hacia atrás.
Jala el accesorio en V hacia la parte superior del pecho manteniendo los codos cerca del cuerpo.
Aprieta los músculos de la espalda en la parte baja del movimiento.
Regresa lentamente el accesorio en V a la posición inicial y repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: curl de bíceps a un brazo en polea v. 2
exercises.en: cable one arm biceps curl v. 2
exercises.d: A one-arm curl using a cable for constant tension, great for working each biceps on its own.
i: Stand facing the cable with the handle at low height and grip it with one hand, palm up.
Keep your elbow tucked at your side.
Curl the handle toward your shoulder and squeeze the biceps.
Lower slowly until the arm is nearly straight.
Finish all reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: esquí en elíptica
exercises.d: A ski-style stride on the elliptical that keeps your heart rate up and works the whole body.
i: Step onto the elliptical and hold the handles.
Start striding in a smooth, ski-like rhythm, swinging your arms with your legs.
Stay upright and keep your core engaged.
Hold a steady pace for your chosen time.
Slow down gradually to finish.

exercises.n: press de pecho inclinado en máquina (con discos)
exercises.d: A plate-loaded machine press on an incline that targets the upper chest and the front of the shoulders.
i: Adjust the seat so the handles are level with your upper chest.
Sit back and grip the handles with feet flat on the floor.
Press forward until your arms are nearly straight.
Squeeze the chest, then return slowly.
Keep your back against the pad and your shoulders down.

exercises.n: curl predicador en máquina (con discos) v. 2
exercises.d: A plate-loaded preacher machine curl that isolates the biceps with your upper arms supported.
i: Adjust the seat so your upper arms rest flat on the pad.
Grip the handles with palms up.
Curl the handles toward your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly.
Do not lift your elbows off the pad or let the weight drop.

exercises.n: remo sentado en polea con barra V
exercises.en: cable seated row with v bar
exercises.d: A seated cable row with a V-shaped grip that trains the mid back and lats.
i: Sit at the cable row station with your feet on the platform and knees slightly bent.
Grip the V bar and sit tall with arms extended.
Pull the bar toward your lower ribs and squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your chest up and avoid rocking.

exercises.n: remo alto en máquina (con discos) v. 2
exercises.d: A plate-loaded high row machine that pulls from above to train the lats and upper back.
i: Adjust the seat and chest pad so you can grip the handles with arms extended.
Sit tall with your chest on the pad.
Pull the handles down and back, driving the elbows toward your hips.
Squeeze the shoulder blades together.
Return slowly and keep your shoulders down.

exercises.n: remo alto en máquina (con discos) v. 3
exercises.d: A plate-loaded high row machine that pulls from above to train the lats and upper back.
i: Adjust the seat and chest pad so you can grip the handles with arms extended.
Sit tall with your chest on the pad.
Pull the handles down and back, driving the elbows toward your hips.
Squeeze the shoulder blades together.
Return slowly and keep your shoulders down.

exercises.n: remo sentado en máquina (con discos)
exercises.d: A plate-loaded seated row machine with a chest pad that builds the mid back and lats.
i: Adjust the seat so the handles line up with your mid chest.
Sit with your chest against the pad and grip the handles.
Pull your elbows back and squeeze the shoulder blades.
Pause briefly, then return slowly.
Keep your torso tight against the pad.

exercises.n: jalón lateral abierto en máquina
exercises.d: A machine pulldown with a wide grip that targets the lats for a broad back.
i: Adjust the seat and thigh pad, then grip the wide handles.
Sit tall with your chest up.
Pull the handles down toward your upper chest, leading with the elbows.
Squeeze the lats, then let the handles rise slowly.
Avoid leaning far back or using momentum.

exercises.n: elevación de gemelos sentado en máquina (con discos) v. 2
exercises.en: lever seated calf raise (plate loaded) v. 2
exercises.d: A seated plate-loaded calf raise that focuses on the soleus under the calf.
i: Sit with the balls of your feet on the platform and the pad over your thighs.
Release the safety and lower your heels for a stretch.
Press up through the balls of your feet as high as you can.
Pause and squeeze the calves.
Lower slowly to full stretch.

exercises.n: remo cerrado en smith v. 2
exercises.d: A bent-over row on the smith machine with a narrow grip, working the lats and mid back.
i: Set the bar at knee height and grip it with hands close together.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back and slightly bent knees.
Pull the bar toward your lower ribs, keeping elbows close to your body.
Squeeze your back at the top.
Lower the bar under control to full arm extension.

exercises.n: curl de muñeca inverso con barra v. 2
exercises.d: A wrist curl with an overhand grip that builds the muscles on top of the forearm.
i: Sit and rest your forearms on your thighs or a bench, palms down, holding a barbell.
Let your wrists drop so the bar hangs down.
Extend your wrists to raise the bar as high as you can.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly and keep your forearms still.

exercises.n: elevación frontal a un brazo en polea
exercises.d: A single-arm front raise with constant cable tension, training the front of the shoulder.
i: Stand facing away from a low cable pulley with the handle in one hand.
Keep your arm nearly straight and raise it forward to shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower with control.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: elevación lateral a un brazo con mancuerna v. 2
exercises.en: dumbbell one arm lateral raise v. 2
exercises.d: A one-sided raise out to the side that builds the middle part of the shoulder.
i: Stand holding a dumbbell in one hand at your side.
Keep a soft bend in the elbow.
Raise the arm out to the side until it reaches shoulder height.
Lower slowly without swinging.
Do all reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: pronación acostado en el suelo con mancuerna
exercises.d: A lying dumbbell forearm pronation on the floor. Works the forearm muscles.
i: Túmbate boca abajo en el suelo con los brazos extendidos rectos frente a ti, sosteniendo una mancuerna en cada mano.
Gira las palmas de modo que queden mirando hacia el suelo.
Manteniendo los brazos rectos, levanta las mancuernas del suelo contrayendo los antebrazos.
Continúa levantando hasta que los antebrazos estén completamente contraídos y las mancuernas queden a la altura de los hombros.
Mantén la posición por un momento, luego baja lentamente las mancuernas de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: supinación acostado en el suelo con mancuerna
exercises.d: A lying dumbbell forearm supination on the floor. Works the forearm muscles.
i: Túmbate boca arriba en el suelo con las piernas extendidas y los brazos a los costados, sosteniendo una mancuerna en cada mano.
Gira las palmas hacia arriba, manteniendo los codos cerca de los costados.
Flexiona lentamente las mancuernas hacia los hombros, contrayendo los antebrazos.
Haz una pausa breve en la parte alta, luego baja lentamente las mancuernas de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: levantamiento de tronco (strongman)
exercises.d: Lifting a heavy log from the ground to overhead, building full-body strength and power.
i: Stand over the log with feet shoulder width apart and grip it with a firm hold.
Lift it to your lap with a flat back and drive the hips forward.
Rack it on your chest with elbows high.
Dip your knees, then drive up and press the log overhead.
Lock out, then lower with control.
Start light and keep your core braced.

exercises.n: mas wrestling (strongman)
exercises.d: A grip and pull contest with a stick, building grip strength and total body tension.
i: Sit facing a partner with feet against theirs and both hands on a stick.
Brace your core.
Pull the stick toward you with a strong grip.
Resist your partner while keeping your back straight.
Keep the effort steady and control the end of each pull.

exercises.n: arrastre mano sobre mano (strongman)
exercises.d: A heavy rope pull where you move hand over hand, training pulling strength and grip.
i: Face the load with the rope in both hands and feet set wide.
Lean back slightly with a braced core.
Pull the rope with one arm and then the other.
Keep a steady rhythm.
Reach and pull smoothly while keeping your back flat.

exercises.n: arrastre de camión (strongman)
exercises.d: Pulling a heavy truck with a rope over a distance, building leg drive and grip.
i: Stand facing away from the truck with the rope held across your body.
Lean forward and dig your feet in.
Take short, powerful steps driving through the legs.
Keep your core braced and the rope close.
Pull the full distance, then rest.

exercises.n: caminata de pato (strongman)
exercises.d: A low squat-walk holding a load, building leg endurance and hip strength.
i: Hold the weight in front of you and lower into a deep squat.
Keep your chest up.
Take small steps while staying low.
Keep your core braced and your knees tracking over your toes.
Walk the full distance, then stand and rest.

exercises.n: caminata con saco de arena (strongman)
exercises.d: Carrying a heavy sandbag over a set distance to train grip, back and core.
i: Lift the sandbag off the floor and hug it against your chest.
Stand tall with your core braced.
Walk forward at a steady pace with short steps.
Keep your posture upright and do not lean back.
Set the bag down under control at the end.

exercises.n: press de bloque de hierro (strongman)
exercises.d: An overhead press using a heavy iron block, building shoulder and arm strength.
i: Lift the block to your shoulders and set your feet hip width apart.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Press the block overhead until your arms lock out.
Pause at the top.
Lower it back to your shoulders under control.

exercises.n: cruz de islandia (strongman)
exercises.d: A hold with a heavy weight in each hand, arms held out to the sides, building shoulder and grip endurance.
i: Pick up a weight in each hand and stand tall.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Hold them there with a braced core.
Keep your shoulders down and avoid shrugging.
Hold as long as you can, then lower under control.

exercises.n: acarreo de tronco (strongman)
exercises.d: Carrying a heavy timber on your shoulder, training full-body strength and stability.
i: Lift the timber onto your shoulder and balance it.
Stand tall with your core braced.
Walk with short, steady steps.
Keep the load balanced and avoid leaning to one side.
Set it down under control, then switch shoulders.
