exercises.n: círculo de conan (strongman)
exercises.d: A heavy walk in a circle holding a load, building grip, back and leg strength.
i: Pick up the load and hold it against your body.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Walk in a circle with steady steps.
Stay balanced and avoid leaning away.
Set the load down under control when you finish.

exercises.n: sostén en crucifijo (strongman)
exercises.d: Holding weights out to your sides at shoulder height, building shoulder endurance.
i: Pick up a weight in each hand and stand tall.
Raise your arms out to the sides until level with your shoulders.
Hold the position with a braced core.
Keep your shoulders down and wrists straight.
Hold as long as you can, then lower with control.

exercises.n: sostén frontal (strongman)
exercises.d: Holding a load out in front of your body, building shoulder and core endurance.
i: Pick up the weights and stand tall.
Raise your arms forward to shoulder height.
Hold with a braced core.
Keep your shoulders down and avoid leaning back.
Hold as long as you can, then lower with control.

exercises.n: press vikingo (strongman)
exercises.d: An overhead press with a heavy viking-press frame, building shoulders and triceps.
i: Stand inside the frame and grab the handles.
Lift the handles to shoulder height and set your feet.
Brace your core and press overhead.
Lock out your arms.
Lower back to shoulder height under control.

exercises.n: sentadillas con plataforma (strongman)
exercises.d: A squat while holding a heavy platform, building leg strength and trunk stability.
i: Stand with the platform loaded on your shoulders and feet shoulder width apart.
Brace your core.
Squat down with your chest up and knees tracking over toes.
Drive back up through your heels.
Stand tall and lock out at the top.

exercises.n: carga de piedras (strongman)
exercises.d: Lifting heavy objects onto a platform in sequence, building full-body strength.
i: Stand over the first object with feet shoulder width apart.
Hinge at the hips and grip it with a flat back.
Lift it by driving through the hips.
Carry it to the platform and load it.
Return, repeat with the next object, and keep your core braced.

exercises.n: piedras de hood (strongman)
exercises.d: Lifting a heavy stone to a platform, building power through the hips and back.
i: Straddle the stone and squat down to hug it.
Lift it to your lap by driving the hips forward.
Roll the stone up your chest.
Extend your hips to land it on the platform.
Lower the stone under control and reset.

exercises.n: carretilla (strongman)
exercises.d: Pushing a loaded wheelbarrow over a distance, building leg drive and grip.
i: Grip the wheelbarrow handles and lift them with a flat back.
Brace your core.
Push forward with strong steps.
Keep your arms straight and your body in line.
Set it down under control at the end.

exercises.n: piedras de atlas (strongman)
exercises.d: Lifting heavy round stones onto a platform, a classic test of full-body strength.
i: Straddle the stone and squat down to wrap your arms around it.
Lift it to your lap by driving the hips forward.
Roll the stone up your chest.
Extend your hips to load it on the platform.
Lower it back to the floor under control and reset.

exercises.n: escaleras de poder (strongman)
exercises.d: Carrying a heavy load up a flight of stairs, building leg power and grip.
i: Pick up the load and hold it against your chest.
Brace your core and stand tall.
Climb the stairs one step at a time.
Push through your whole foot and keep your chest up.
Set the load down under control at the top.

exercises.n: sostén de hércules (strongman)
exercises.d: Holding two heavy weights, arms out, for time to build grip and shoulder endurance.
i: Pick up the weights and stand tall.
Hold your arms out to your sides.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders down.
Hold the position as long as you can.
Lower under control when done.

exercises.n: acarreo de escudo (strongman)
exercises.d: Carrying a heavy shield-like load over a distance, training core and back strength.
i: Lift the shield and hold it in front of you.
Stand tall with your core braced.
Walk forward at a steady pace.
Keep your posture upright.
Set it down under control when you finish.

exercises.n: sentadilla frontal al pecho (strongman)
exercises.d: A front squat with a heavy load hugged to the chest, building quads and trunk strength.
i: Hold the load tight against your chest with your elbows up.
Stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Squat down keeping your chest tall.
Drive up through your heels.
Lock out the hips at the top.

exercises.n: peso muerto (strongman)
exercises.d: A heavy deadlift in strongman style, pulling a loaded bar from the floor to a full stand. Builds total posterior chain and grip strength.
i: Stand with feet hip width apart and the bar over mid foot.
Hinge down and grip the bar just outside your knees, chest up and back flat.
Brace your core and push the floor away, keeping the bar close to your legs.
Stand tall by driving your hips forward, then lower the bar under control.

exercises.n: volteo de neumático (strongman)
exercises.d: Flipping a large tire end over end by driving up from a deep hinge. A full body power move that hits legs, back and chest.
i: Stand close to the tire and squat down, getting your fingers under its edge.
Press your chest against the tire with a flat back and hips low.
Explode up with your legs and hips, lifting the tire as you rise.
Shove the tire over with your hands and shoulders, then step in and reset for the next flip.

exercises.n: peso a altura (strongman)
exercises.d: Throwing a heavy weight up and over a high bar. It is an explosive power move that trains hips, back and shoulders together.
i: Hold the weight with both hands low in front of you, feet shoulder width apart.
Swing it back between your legs while hinging at the hips.
Drive your hips and legs up hard and swing the weight up and overhead.
Release it over the bar, then step back and reset for the next throw.

exercises.n: cargada y envión a un brazo con mancuerna (strongman)
exercises.en: strongman dumbbell one arm clean and jerk
exercises.d: A one arm dumbbell clean followed by a jerk overhead. Trains explosive power from the legs through the shoulder.
i: Stand over a dumbbell with feet shoulder width apart and grab it with one hand.
Pull it explosively to your shoulder with a hip drive, dipping slightly under it.
Dip your knees, then drive up and press the dumbbell overhead to a locked arm.
Lower it back to the shoulder and then the floor with control, then switch arms.

exercises.n: barra de apolo (strongman)
exercises.d: Lifting a thick axle bar from the floor to overhead. The fat grip makes it a brutal test for hands, forearms and shoulders.
i: Stand over the thick axle with feet shoulder width apart and grip it firmly.
Pull it up the thighs with a flat back and clean it to your chest.
Dip and drive with your legs, pressing the axle overhead until your arms lock.
Bring it back down to your chest and then the floor with control.

exercises.n: paseo del granjero con barra (strongman)
exercises.d: Walking while carrying a heavy loaded bar at your sides. Builds grip strength, upper back and trunk stability.
i: Stand inside the loaded bar and grip the handle, then lift it to hang at your sides.
Keep your chest tall, shoulders back and core braced.
Walk forward with short, quick steps for a set distance.
Stop, lower the weights to the floor with a flat back, and rest.

exercises.n: caminata con yugo (strongman)
exercises.d: Carrying a heavy yoke frame across your upper back and walking with it. Strengthens the legs, trunk and traps.
i: Step under the yoke so it rests across your upper back and grip the frame.
Brace your core and stand up to lift it off the supports.
Walk forward in quick, controlled steps, keeping your torso upright.
At the end, lower the yoke back onto the supports with care.

exercises.n: jalón lateral con agarre inverso en máquina
exercises.d: A reverse grip lat pulldown on a machine. Builds the lats and biceps.
i: Ajusta la altura del asiento y colócate en la máquina con las rodillas debajo de las almohadillas y los pies planos en el suelo.
Agarra las agarraderas con un agarre prono, un poco más separadas que el ancho de los hombros.
Siéntate erguido con el pecho hacia afuera y los hombros hacia atrás, manteniendo un ligero arco en la zona lumbar.
Tira de las asas hacia el pecho, liderando con los codos y juntando los omóplatos.
Haz una pausa breve en la parte baja del movimiento, luego suelta lentamente las asas de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: extensión de cadera de pie (pierna recta)
exercises.d: A standing kickback with a straight leg that targets the glutes.
i: Stand tall and hold a support for balance.
Keep your standing knee slightly soft.
Lift one straight leg back behind you without arching your lower back.
Squeeze the glute at the top.
Lower with control and switch legs after your reps.

exercises.n: extensión de tríceps acostado en el suelo con mancuernas
exercises.en: dumbbell lying triceps extension on floor
exercises.d: A floor version of the lying triceps extension, where the floor limits how far you lower the weight.
i: Lie on the floor with knees bent, holding a dumbbell in each hand over your chest.
Keep upper arms still and bend your elbows to lower the weights toward your head.
Stop just before the weights touch the floor.
Press back up by straightening your arms.
Keep your elbows pointing up.

exercises.n: flexiones abiertas (pared)
exercises.d: A beginner-friendly standing push-up against a wall with a wide hand position to emphasise the chest.
i: Stand facing a wall and place your hands on it, wider than your shoulders.
Step your feet back so your body leans in a straight line.
Bend your elbows to bring your chest toward the wall.
Push back to the start.
Keep your hips in line with your shoulders.

exercises.n: curl de bíceps de pie con agarre abierto y barra EZ
exercises.en: ez-barbell standing wide grip biceps curl
exercises.d: A standing EZ bar curl with a wide grip. Emphasises the biceps.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros y sostén la barra EZ con agarre supino, manos más separadas que la altura de los hombros.
Mantén los codos cerca del torso y los brazos superiores quietos durante todo el movimiento.
Sube la barra hacia los hombros contrayendo los bíceps.
Haz una pausa breve en la parte alta y luego baja lentamente la barra de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: empuje de cadera en máquina (con cajón) v. 2
exercises.d: A machine hip thrust with the feet raised on a step box, for a deeper glute contraction.
i: Sit in the machine with your feet on the step box and the pad across your hips.
Brace your core and drive through your heels.
Lift your hips until your body is straight from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly to the start.

exercises.n: empuje de cadera en máquina v. 2
exercises.d: A machine hip thrust that loads the glutes in a controlled path.
i: Sit in the machine with your back against the pad and your feet flat.
Secure the hip pad over your lap.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower with control without letting the weight crash.

exercises.n: empuje de cadera de pie en polea
exercises.d: A standing hip thrust against cable resistance, training hip extension and the glutes.
i: Attach a belt or strap to a low cable and stand facing away from the stack.
Hold the cable at your hips with feet shoulder width apart.
Hinge slightly, then thrust your hips forward.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Return slowly and keep your ribs down.

exercises.n: hiperextensión inversa en smith
exercises.d: A reverse hyperextension on the smith machine that works the glutes and hamstrings with support from the lower back.
i: Lie face down over a bench with your hips at the edge and legs hanging.
Hook your heels under the smith bar if it is set low.
Lift your legs by extending the hips until they are in line with your body.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly without swinging.

exercises.n: sentadilla con abducción en máquina
exercises.d: A machine squat that adds an outward leg push to work the outer hips and glutes.
i: Set the machine and step in with the pads on your shoulders.
Squat down with control, keeping your chest up.
Drive up through your feet.
Push your knees slightly outward as you rise.
Keep your core braced.

exercises.n: empuje de aducción en máquina
exercises.d: A machine hip thrust that squeezes the legs inward, training the inner thighs and glutes.
i: Sit in the machine with the pads between or around your legs as set.
Brace your core.
Thrust your hips up while squeezing your legs inward.
Hold the squeeze briefly at the top.
Lower with control.

exercises.n: hiperextensión inversa de rodillas en máquina
exercises.d: A kneeling machine kickback that extends the hip and works the glutes.
i: Kneel on the machine pad and hold the handles.
Place the back of your working leg against the lever pad.
Press the leg back and up until your hip is fully extended.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly and switch legs.

exercises.n: prensa de piernas asistida en máquina
exercises.d: A machine leg press with assistance, building the thighs and glutes with a controlled path.
i: Sit in the machine and place your feet on the platform about shoulder width apart.
Release the safety handles.
Lower the platform by bending your knees until they reach about 90 degrees.
Push through your heels to extend the legs.
Do not lock your knees fully.

exercises.n: peso muerto a una pierna con apoyo en la pared y mancuerna
exercises.en: dumbbell single leg deadlift with wall support
exercises.d: A one-legged deadlift where a wall helps you balance while the hamstrings and glutes do the work.
i: Stand near a wall, holding a dumbbell and resting one hand on it for balance.
Lift one leg behind you.
Hinge at the hips and lower the dumbbell down your standing leg.
Keep your back flat.
Squeeze your glute to stand tall, then switch legs.

exercises.n: sentadilla sumo desde cajón con kettlebell y mancuerna
exercises.en: kettlebell dumbbell sumo squat off stepbox
exercises.d: A sumo squat from a raised step box, adding range of motion for deeper work on the glutes and inner thighs.
i: Stand on a step box in a wide stance with toes out.
Hold a kettlebell or dumbbell in front of you.
Sit down between your legs, keeping your chest up.
Lower as far as comfortable.
Push through your feet to stand.

exercises.n: sentadilla dividida v. 2
exercises.d: A static lunge-style squat that trains the legs one at a time with balance and control.
i: Stand in a long stride with one foot forward and one back.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front knee over your ankle.
Push through the front heel to rise.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: sentadilla completa desde déficit con kettlebell y banda elástica
exercises.en: kettlebell resistance band full squat from deficit
exercises.d: A deep squat from a raised platform with a band for added resistance, training the legs and glutes.
i: Stand on a low platform, band under your feet and a kettlebell at your chest.
Sit down into the deepest squat you can control.
Keep your heels flat and chest up.
Push through your feet to stand.
Keep tension in the band all the way up.

exercises.n: empuje de cadera con peso
exercises.d: A hip thrust with added weight for building strong glutes.
i: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and the weight across your hips.
Plant your feet flat and bend your knees.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.n: abducción de cadera en polea (pie hacia fuera)
exercises.d: A cable leg raise to the side with the toes turned out, targeting the outer hip.
i: Attach an ankle cuff to a low cable and stand side-on to the stack.
Hold a support for balance.
Turn your toes out slightly.
Lift the working leg out to the side.
Return slowly, then switch legs.

exercises.n: abducción de cadera en polea (pie hacia dentro)
exercises.d: A cable leg raise to the side with the toes turned in, shifting the work toward the outer glute.
i: Attach an ankle cuff to a low cable and stand side-on to the stack.
Hold a support for balance.
Turn your toes inward slightly.
Lift the working leg out to the side.
Return slowly, then switch legs.

exercises.n: empuje de cadera de rana
exercises.d: A hip thrust with the soles of the feet together and knees out, which shifts work to the glutes and inner thighs.
i: Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together and knees falling out.
Keep your heels near your hips.
Drive through the feet to lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.n: levantarse en polea
exercises.d: Rising from a low squat against cable tension to train the glutes and legs.
i: Hold the cable handle at your chest and sit back into a deep squat.
Keep your chest tall.
Push through your heels to stand fully.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower with control.

exercises.n: empuje de cadera con banda elástica
exercises.d: A hip thrust with a resistance band over the hips, adding load that increases toward the top.
i: Sit with your upper back against a bench and the band over your hips, anchored at both sides.
Plant your feet flat.
Drive your hips up against the band.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly.

exercises.n: dorsiflexión de tobillo
exercises.d: Pulling the toes up toward the shin, working the front of the lower leg. A simple way to keep the ankle moving well.
i: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Sit with one leg out and your heel resting on the floor.
Pull your toes and the top of your foot toward your shin as far as is comfortable.
Pause briefly, then lower the foot back down slowly.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

exercises.n: flexión plantar de tobillo
exercises.d: Pointing the foot away from the shin, engaging the calf. Good for warming up and mobilising the ankle.
i: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Sit with one leg out and your foot relaxed.
Point your toes down and away from you, as if pressing a gas pedal.
Pause briefly at the end, then return to the neutral position.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

exercises.n: extensión de codo
exercises.d: Straightening the elbow from a bent position, which works the back of the upper arm and keeps the joint moving.
i: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Hold your upper arm still with the elbow bent.
Straighten the arm slowly until it is almost fully extended.
Pause briefly, keeping the shoulder relaxed and the upper arm fixed.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

exercises.n: flexión de codo
exercises.d: Bending the elbow to bring the hand toward the shoulder, working the front of the upper arm.
i: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Start with your arm straight down at your side, palm forward.
Bend the elbow to bring your hand up toward your shoulder.
Pause briefly, then lower back down slowly without swinging.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

exercises.n: pronación de antebrazo
exercises.d: Rotating the forearm so the palm turns down. Helps forearm control and wrist mobility.
i: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Hold your elbow close to your side bent at 90 degrees, palm facing up.
Rotate your forearm so your palm turns down to face the floor.
Keep the elbow still and pause briefly at the end.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

exercises.n: supinación de antebrazo
exercises.d: Rotating the forearm so the palm turns up. Helps forearm control and wrist mobility.
i: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Hold your elbow close to your side bent at 90 degrees, palm facing down.
Rotate your forearm so your palm turns up to face the ceiling.
Keep the elbow still and pause briefly at the end.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

exercises.n: abducción de cadera
exercises.d: Lifting the leg out to the side away from the body, working the outer hip and glutes.
i: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall holding a support, with your weight on one leg.
Lift the other leg straight out to the side, toes pointing forward.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly without leaning your torso.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

exercises.n: aducción de cadera
exercises.d: Bringing the leg inward across the body, working the inner thigh.
i: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall holding a support, with your weight on one leg.
Lift the other leg slightly out to the side.
Bring it back in and across the front of the standing leg, then pause.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

exercises.n: extensión de cadera
exercises.d: Moving the leg back behind the body, which works the glutes and hamstrings.
i: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall holding a support, with your weight on one leg.
Swing the other leg straight back, keeping your knee mostly straight.
Squeeze the glute at the top, avoiding any arching of your lower back.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

exercises.n: flexión de cadera
exercises.d: Lifting the thigh forward and up, working the hip flexors and front of the thigh.
i: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall holding a support, with your weight on one leg.
Lift the other knee up in front of you toward hip height.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly without rounding your back.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

exercises.n: rotación lateral de cadera (rotación externa)
exercises.d: Rotating the thigh outward at the hip, working the deep hip rotators and glutes.
i: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Sit tall on a bench or chair, one knee bent at 90 degrees.
Keep your thigh still and swing your lower leg inward, which rotates the hip outward.
Pause briefly, then return to the starting position under control.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

exercises.n: rotación medial de cadera (rotación interna)
exercises.d: Rotating the thigh inward at the hip, working the muscles that turn the leg in.
i: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Sit tall on a bench or chair, one knee bent at 90 degrees.
Keep your thigh still and swing your lower leg outward, which rotates the hip inward.
Pause briefly, then return to the starting position under control.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

exercises.n: extensión de rodilla
exercises.d: Straightening the knee, which works the front of the thigh.
i: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Sit tall on a bench or chair with your feet off the floor.
Straighten one knee until the leg is almost fully extended.
Squeeze your thigh at the top, then lower slowly.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

exercises.n: flexión de rodilla
exercises.d: Bending the knee to bring the heel toward the glutes, working the back of the thigh.
i: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall holding a support, with your weight on one leg.
Bend the other knee to bring your heel up toward your glutes.
Keep your thighs side by side, pause, then lower slowly.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

exercises.n: abducción de hombro
exercises.d: Raising the arm out to the side, working the side of the shoulder.
i: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall with your arms at your sides.
Raise one arm out to the side up to about shoulder height.
Lower slowly without shrugging.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

exercises.n: aducción de hombro
exercises.d: Bringing the arm down toward the body from the side, working the lats and chest.
i: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall with one arm raised out to the side at shoulder height.
Pull the arm down toward your side with control.
Keep your torso still and finish with the arm next to your body.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

exercises.n: extensión de hombro
exercises.d: Moving the arm back behind the body, working the lats and rear shoulder.
i: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall with your arm straight down at your side.
Swing the arm back behind you, keeping it straight.
Avoid leaning forward, pause, then return to the start.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

exercises.n: flexión de hombro
exercises.d: Raising the arm forward and up in front of the body, working the front of the shoulder.
i: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall with your arms at your sides, palms facing in.
Raise one arm forward and up to about shoulder height or higher.
Keep your ribs down, then lower slowly.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

exercises.n: rotación lateral de hombro (rotación externa)
exercises.d: Rotating the upper arm outward, which works the rotator cuff muscles at the back of the shoulder.
i: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand with your elbow at your side bent at 90 degrees, forearm pointing forward.
Rotate your forearm outward, keeping the elbow tucked against your side.
Pause briefly, then return slowly.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

exercises.n: rotación medial de hombro (rotación interna)
exercises.d: Rotating the upper arm inward, working the muscles that turn the shoulder in.
i: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand with your elbow at your side bent at 90 degrees, forearm pointing forward.
Rotate your forearm inward across your stomach, keeping the elbow tucked in.
Pause briefly, then return slowly.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

exercises.n: abducción transversal de hombro
exercises.d: Moving the arm backward in a horizontal arc, working the rear delts and upper back.
i: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall with one arm held out in front at shoulder height.
Sweep the arm out and back in a horizontal arc as far as is comfortable.
Keep the arm at shoulder height, pause, then return.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

exercises.n: aducción transversal de hombro
exercises.d: Moving the arm forward and across the body in a horizontal arc, working the chest.
i: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall with one arm held out to the side at shoulder height.
Sweep the arm forward and across your body in a horizontal arc.
Keep the arm at shoulder height, pause, then return.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

exercises.n: extensión transversal de hombro
exercises.d: Drawing the arm back in a horizontal plane, working the rear shoulder and upper back.
i: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall with your arm held in front at shoulder height.
Pull the arm back and out to the side, keeping it level.
Squeeze your shoulder blade lightly, then return slowly.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

exercises.n: flexión transversal de hombro
exercises.d: Bringing the arm forward in a horizontal plane, working the chest and front shoulder.
i: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall with your arm held out to the side at shoulder height.
Bring the arm forward in front of your chest, keeping it level.
Pause briefly, then return slowly to the side.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

exercises.n: extensión de columna (lumbar)
exercises.d: Gently arching the lower back backward, working the muscles along the spine.
i: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand with feet hip width apart and your hands on your hips.
Lean back gently, arching your lower back within a comfortable range.
Pause briefly, then return upright.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

exercises.n: flexión de columna (lumbar)
exercises.d: Curling the lower back forward, working the abs and mobilising the lumbar spine.
i: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand with feet hip width apart and knees slightly soft.
Round your lower back forward and tuck your chin and pelvis in.
Pause briefly, then return upright.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

exercises.n: flexión lateral de columna (lumbar)
exercises.d: Bending the trunk sideways, working the obliques and mobilising the spine.
i: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand with feet hip width apart and your arms at your sides.
Slide one hand down the outside of your leg as you bend sideways.
Keep your hips level, return to upright, then bend to the other side.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

exercises.n: rotación de columna (lumbar)
exercises.d: Twisting the trunk to each side, working the obliques and mobilising the spine.
i: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand with feet hip width apart and your arms crossed over your chest.
Rotate your torso to one side while keeping the hips facing forward.
Return to center, then rotate to the other side.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

exercises.n: aducción de muñeca
exercises.d: Tilting the wrist toward the little finger side, working the forearm muscles that guide the wrist.
i: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Rest your forearm on a table with your hand hanging off the edge, thumb up.
Tilt your hand down toward the little finger side.
Pause briefly, then return to neutral under control.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

exercises.n: extensión de muñeca
exercises.d: Lifting the back of the hand up, working the top of the forearm.
i: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Rest your forearm on a table with your hand hanging off the edge, palm down.
Raise your hand upward by bending the wrist back.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

exercises.n: flexión de muñeca
exercises.d: Curling the hand toward the forearm, working the underside of the forearm.
i: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Rest your forearm on a table with your hand hanging off the edge, palm up.
Curl your hand upward by bending the wrist toward your forearm.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

exercises.n: salto de plancha
exercises.d: A jumping plank drill that raises your heart rate and challenges the core.
i: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
Jump both feet out wide.
Jump them back together.
Keep your hips level and core tight.
Move at a steady pace.

exercises.n: plancha con subida y bajada
exercises.d: Moving between a forearm and a high plank, building core and arm endurance.
i: Start in a forearm plank.
Place one hand and then the other on the floor to rise to a high plank.
Lower one forearm and then the other back down.
Keep your hips steady.
Alternate the leading arm each rep.

exercises.n: zancada con subida al cajón y mancuernas
exercises.d: A step up that flows into a lunge while holding dumbbells. Builds single leg strength and balance.
i: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand facing a sturdy box or step.
Step one foot onto the box and drive up until you stand on it.
Step the same foot back down behind you into a lunge.
Push back up to the start, keeping your torso upright.
Finish all reps on one leg, then switch sides.

exercises.n: zancada con subida al cajón y mancuernas
exercises.d: A dumbbell step-up that finishes with a lunge motion. Builds the quads and glutes.
i: Ponte de pie frente a un escalón o plataforma con una mancuerna en cada mano, con las palmas hacia tus costados.
Coloca el pie derecho sobre el escalón, asegurándote de que todo el pie esté sobre la superficie.
Empuja con el talón derecho y sube el cuerpo sobre el escalón, llevando también el pie izquierdo hacia arriba.
Una vez que ambos pies estén sobre el escalón, baja el pie izquierdo de vuelta a la posición inicial, manteniendo el pie derecho sobre el escalón.
Repite el movimiento, alternando el pie con el que subes cada vez.
Continúa durante el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: sentadilla con salto y zancada trasera con barra v. 2
exercises.en: barbell squat jump step rear lunge v. 2
exercises.d: A barbell squat, a small jump and a step back into a rear lunge. A demanding combo for leg strength and power.
i: Rest the barbell across your upper back and stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Squat down, then jump up lightly and land softly.
Step one foot back into a rear lunge, lowering your back knee toward the floor.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs on each rep, keeping your chest tall.

exercises.n: sentadilla con salto y zancada trasera con barra
exercises.en: barbell squat jump step rear lunge
exercises.d: A barbell squat jump followed by a rear lunge. Builds explosive leg power.
i: Empieza de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros, sujetando una barra sobre la parte superior de la espalda.
Baja el cuerpo hacia una posición de sentadilla flexionando las rodillas y empujando las caderas hacia atrás.
Impúlsate explosivamente hacia arriba, saltando del suelo lo más alto que puedas.
Aterriza suavemente sobre los pies y de inmediato retrocede con una pierna hacia una zancada inversa.
Baja el cuerpo hasta que el muslo delantero quede paralelo al suelo, manteniendo la espalda recta.
Empuja con el talón delantero para volver a la posición inicial.
Repite la secuencia de salto y zancada con la otra pierna.
Continúa alternando las piernas durante el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: elevación alternada de piernas sentado con barra
exercises.d: A seated alternate leg raise holding a barbell across the thighs. Works the abs and hip flexors.
i: Siéntate en un banco con la espalda recta y sujeta una barra sobre los muslos.
Manteniendo las piernas rectas, levanta una pierna lo más alto posible mientras mantienes la otra pierna en el suelo.
Baja la pierna elevada y repite con la otra pierna.
Continúa alternando las piernas durante el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: elevación alternada de piernas sentado con barra (femenino)
exercises.d: A seated alternate leg raise with a barbell across the thighs and hands on the bench. Works the abs and hip flexors.
i: Siéntate en un banco con la espalda recta y sujeta una barra sobre los muslos.
Coloca las manos a los lados del banco para apoyarte.
Manteniendo las piernas rectas, levanta una pierna lo más alto posible manteniéndola paralela al suelo.
Baja la pierna y repite con la otra pierna.
Continúa alternando las piernas durante el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: elevación de piernas con giro (femenino)
exercises.d: A lying leg raise with a hip twist. Works the abs and obliques.
i: Túmbate sobre tu espalda con las piernas extendidas y los brazos a los lados.
Flexiona las rodillas y levanta las piernas del suelo, llevándolas hacia el pecho.
Mientras levantas las piernas, gira las caderas hacia un lado, llevando las rodillas hacia el hombro opuesto.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte superior, luego baja lentamente las piernas de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el movimiento, esta vez girando las caderas hacia el otro lado.
Continúa alternando lados durante el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: elevación de piernas con giro
exercises.d: A lying leg raise with a hip twist and hands under the glutes. Works the abs and obliques.
i: Túmbate sobre tu espalda con las piernas extendidas y los brazos a los lados.
Coloca las manos debajo de los glúteos como apoyo.
Activa el abdomen y levanta ambas piernas del suelo, manteniéndolas rectas.
Mientras levantas las piernas, gira las caderas hacia un lado, llevando las piernas hacia el hombro opuesto.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte superior, luego baja lentamente las piernas de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el movimiento, esta vez girando las caderas hacia el otro lado.
Continúa alternando lados durante el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: sentadilla con apoyo y mancuernas
exercises.d: A dumbbell squat done with a support for balance. Builds the quads and glutes.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros, sosteniendo una mancuerna en cada mano a los costados.
Manteniendo el pecho arriba y el core activado, baja lentamente el cuerpo flexionando las rodillas y empujando las caderas hacia atrás.
Continúa bajando hasta que los muslos queden paralelos al suelo, o tan abajo como puedas hacerlo cómodamente.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte inferior, luego empuja con los talones para regresar a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: sentadilla con apoyo y mancuernas v. 2
exercises.d: A dumbbell squat with a hand on a support for balance. Lets you focus on a deep, steady squat pattern.
i: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and rest the other hand on a stable support.
Stand with feet shoulder width apart and toes slightly out.
Sit your hips back and down until your thighs are about parallel.
Drive through your heels to stand, keeping your chest up.
Switch the dumbbell hand halfway through if needed.

exercises.n: peso muerto a una pierna con apoyo en cajón y mancuernas
exercises.en: dumbbell single leg deadlift with stepbox support
exercises.d: A single leg dumbbell deadlift with the rear foot supported on a step box. Works the glutes and hamstrings.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de las caderas, sujetando una mancuerna con la mano derecha.
Coloca el pie izquierdo sobre un cajón de step o una superficie elevada detrás de ti.
Manteniendo la espalda recta y el core activado, inclínate hacia adelante desde las caderas, bajando la mancuerna hacia el suelo.
Mientras bajas la mancuerna, levanta al mismo tiempo la pierna izquierda detrás de ti, manteniendo una línea recta desde la cabeza hasta el talón.
Baja la mancuerna hasta sentir un estiramiento en el isquiotibial derecho, luego vuelve a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado, luego cambia de lado.

exercises.n: peso muerto a una pierna con apoyo en cajón y mancuerna v. 2
exercises.en: dumbbell single leg deadlift with stepbox support v. 2
exercises.d: A one leg deadlift with the rear foot resting on a step box for balance. Works hamstrings and glutes with less wobble.
i: Hold a dumbbell and rest the toes of one foot on a step box behind you.
Soften the front knee and hinge at the hips, lowering the dumbbell along your leg.
Keep your back flat and go as far as your hamstring allows.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Complete all reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: pull through sumo con mancuerna v. 2
exercises.d: A wide stance hinge where a dumbbell swings between the legs. Trains glutes, inner thighs and hamstrings.
i: Stand with feet wide and toes turned out, holding one dumbbell with both hands.
Hinge at the hips and swing the dumbbell back between your legs.
Keep your back flat and chest up.
Drive your hips forward and stand tall, swinging the dumbbell to hip height.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.

exercises.n: pull through sumo con mancuerna
exercises.d: A sumo-stance dumbbell pull through between the legs. Trains the glutes and hamstrings.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies más separados que la altura de los hombros, con las puntas de los pies hacia afuera.
Sujeta una mancuerna con ambas manos frente a tu cuerpo, con los brazos extendidos.
Flexiona las rodillas y baja las caderas hasta una posición de sentadilla, manteniendo la espalda recta.
Baja la mancuerna entre las piernas, manteniendo los brazos rectos.
Empuja con los talones y extiende las caderas hacia adelante, llevando la mancuerna hacia arriba y frente a tu cuerpo.
Aprieta los glúteos en la parte superior del movimiento, luego baja la mancuerna de vuelta entre las piernas.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: sentadilla dividida con barra v. 3
exercises.d: A split squat with a barbell on your back, a second variation. Builds single leg strength and balance.
i: Rest the barbell across your upper back and step into a split stance.
Keep your torso upright and core braced.
Lower straight down until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Press through your front foot to rise.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: sentadilla búlgara con barra v. 2
exercises.d: A barbell split squat with a long stance. Builds the quads and glutes one leg at a time.
i: Empieza de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros, sujetando una barra sobre la parte superior de la espalda.
Da un paso grande hacia adelante con el pie derecho, manteniendo el torso erguido.
Baja el cuerpo flexionando las rodillas y las caderas hasta que el muslo derecho quede paralelo al suelo.
Haz una pausa breve, luego empuja con el talón derecho para volver a la posición inicial.
Repite con la pierna izquierda adelante el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: press con giro de piernas y barra
exercises.d: A combined move where a leg rotation pairs with an overhead press with a barbell. Trains legs, trunk and shoulders together.
i: Hold a barbell at your shoulders with feet shoulder width apart.
Step one foot out and rotate your hips and torso with it, bending into a rotated lunge.
Drive back up and press the bar overhead as you stand.
Lower the bar to your shoulders.
Alternate sides on each rep.

exercises.n: sentadilla búlgara con subida al cajón y mancuernas
exercises.d: A dumbbell step-up combined with a knee drive. Builds the quads and glutes.
i: Ponte de pie frente a un banco o escalón con una mancuerna en cada mano, con las palmas hacia tu cuerpo.
Coloca el pie derecho sobre el banco o escalón, asegurándote de que todo el pie esté en contacto con la superficie.
Sube al banco o escalón con el pie derecho, empujando con el talón para levantar el cuerpo.
Mientras subes, levanta al mismo tiempo la rodilla izquierda hacia el pecho.
Haz una pausa en la parte superior del movimiento, luego baja lentamente el pie izquierdo de vuelta al suelo mientras mantienes el pie derecho sobre el banco o escalón.
Repite el movimiento con el pie izquierdo sobre el banco o escalón.
Continúa alternando entre el pie derecho y el izquierdo durante el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: cargada y press con giro a un brazo
exercises.en: one arm twisted clean and press
exercises.d: A one arm clean with a body twist followed by a press overhead. Builds power and coordination from hips to shoulder.
i: Stand with feet shoulder width apart, holding a weight in one hand low in front of you.
Pull it up to your shoulder with a hip drive and a slight turn of the body.
Turn your feet and hips back to face forward as you dip your knees.
Press the weight overhead until your arm locks.
Lower with control and repeat, then switch sides.

exercises.n: v up y baja (con balón de estabilidad)
exercises.d: A V up where you pass a stability ball between hands and feet. Works the abs and builds control.
i: Lie on your back holding the stability ball overhead with straight arms.
Lift your arms and legs up together, curling into a V.
Pass the ball from your hands to your feet.
Lower back down slowly, holding the ball between your feet.
Repeat, passing the ball back to your hands.

exercises.n: elevación lateral con cuerdas de batalla
exercises.d: Raising battling ropes out to the side with a fast, wave-making motion. Boosts shoulder endurance and heart rate.
i: Stand in a slight squat holding a rope end in each hand.
Keep your core braced and elbows soft.
Raise both arms out to the sides to about shoulder height in a quick, controlled motion.
Lower and repeat at a steady fast pace.
Work in intervals of 20-30 seconds.

exercises.n: zancada trasera con trineo
exercises.d: A rear lunge while pushing or holding a power sled. Builds leg strength with extra resistance.
i: Hold the sled handles and stand tall with your feet together.
Step one foot back into a lunge, lowering your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee over your ankle.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs on each rep.

exercises.n: flexión pike (en banco)
exercises.d: A pike push up with your feet raised on a bench, shifting more load to the shoulders. A bodyweight alternative to the overhead press.
i: Place your feet on a bench and your hands on the floor, hips raised in an inverted V.
Keep your legs straight and your core braced.
Bend your elbows and lower your head toward the floor.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your elbows at about 45 degrees to your body.

exercises.n: remo invertido con peso y suspensión
exercises.d: An inverted row on suspension straps with added weight on your body. Builds the back and biceps.
i: Hold the suspension handles and lean back with your body in a straight line, with weight on your torso.
Keep your arms straight and heels on the floor.
Pull your chest up toward the handles, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly to full arm extension.

exercises.n: levantarse de silla en polea con agarre cerrado
exercises.d: A weighted sit-to-stand with a narrow stance and cable resistance.
i: Sit on a chair holding the cable handle at your chest.
Keep your feet close together.
Lean forward slightly.
Push through your heels to stand.
Lower back under control.

exercises.n: peso muerto con piernas rectas desde cajón en polea
exercises.en: cable stiff leg deadlift from stepbox
exercises.d: A straight-leg hinge from a raised box for a longer range on the hamstrings.
i: Stand on a step box facing a low cable and hold the handle.
Keep your knees nearly straight.
Hinge at the hips and lower the handle.
Keep your back flat.
Squeeze your glutes to stand.

exercises.n: zancada trasera desde cajón en polea
exercises.d: A reverse lunge from a step box with cable tension, training the glutes and legs.
i: Stand on a step box facing a cable and hold the handle.
Step one leg back and down to lunge.
Lower the back knee toward the floor.
Push through your front foot to return.
Switch legs after your reps.

exercises.n: bicicleta
exercises.d: A pedalling leg movement lying on your back that works the abs and hip flexors.
i: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head.
Lift your legs and curl your shoulders up.
Extend one leg while bringing the opposite elbow toward the other knee.
Switch sides in a slow pedalling motion.
Keep your lower back pressed down.

exercises.n: elevación de pecho con rotación
exercises.d: A curl up with a twist that trains the abs and obliques.
i: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands behind your head.
Curl your head and shoulders up.
Rotate your torso to one side.
Return to centre and lower.
Alternate sides.

exercises.n: control balance
exercises.d: A challenging Pilates move where you balance on your shoulders while switching legs, building control and core strength.
i: Lie on your back and roll your legs overhead.
Hold one ankle with both hands.
Extend the other leg out above you.
Switch legs with control.
Roll down slowly.

exercises.n: sacacorchos
exercises.d: A Pilates move where the legs trace circles overhead, training the obliques and lower abs.
i: Lie on your back with arms by your sides and legs raised up.
Lift your hips slightly and swing your legs across to one side.
Circle them down and around.
Bring them back up to the start.
Reverse the direction.

exercises.n: cangrejo
exercises.d: A rolling Pilates move in a seated crab shape that works the core and spine mobility.
i: Sit with your legs crossed and hold your feet.
Roll back onto your shoulders.
Cross your legs the other way.
Roll back up.
Keep your movement smooth.

exercises.n: estiramiento de doble pierna
exercises.d: A core-driven move where arms and legs stretch out together and then draw back in.
i: Lie on your back and curl your head and shoulders up.
Hug your knees to your chest.
Reach your arms overhead while extending your legs.
Circle your arms and draw your knees back in.
Keep your lower back down.

exercises.n: hiperextensión en el suelo v. 2
exercises.d: A face-down back lift that strengthens the spine and glutes.
i: Lie face down with arms extended in front.
Lengthen your neck.
Lift your arms, chest and legs off the floor.
Hold briefly.
Lower slowly.

exercises.n: giro de cadera con brazos de apoyo
exercises.d: A seated twist with the legs lifted, working the obliques and core.
i: Sit with your hands behind you and legs lifted.
Keep your chest open.
Rotate your hips to one side.
Circle your legs back to the centre.
Switch sides.

exercises.n: el cien (hundred)
exercises.d: The classic Pilates warm-up where you pump your arms while holding your legs up, building abdominal endurance.
i: Lie on your back and lift your head and shoulders.
Raise your legs to a tabletop or extend them.
Pump your arms up and down in small beats.
Breathe in for five beats and out for five.
Aim for one hundred beats.

exercises.n: leg pull lateral
exercises.d: A side-plank style Pilates move where one leg lifts, challenging the obliques and shoulders.
i: Start in a side plank on one hand.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Lift your top leg.
Hold briefly.
Lower and switch sides.

exercises.n: leg pull
exercises.d: A plank-based Pilates move where you lift one leg at a time, training core stability.
i: Start in a high plank.
Brace your core.
Lift one leg a few inches.
Lower and switch legs.
Keep your hips level.

exercises.n: elevación de pierna (rodilla flexionada)
exercises.d: A lying leg raise with bent knees that makes it easier to focus on the lower abs.
i: Lie on your back with arms by your sides.
Bend your knees.
Raise your legs until your thighs are vertical.
Lower slowly without arching.
Keep your lower back on the floor.

exercises.n: patada doble de piernas acostado
exercises.d: A face-down Pilates move that opens the chest and strengthens the back.
i: Lie face down with your hands clasped behind your back.
Kick both heels toward your glutes.
Lift your chest and extend your arms back.
Lower down.
Repeat smoothly.

exercises.n: elevación lateral de pierna acostado
exercises.d: A side-lying leg lift that works the outer hip.
i: Lie on your side with legs stacked.
Support your head with your arm.
Lift your top leg.
Lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: tirón de cuello acostado
exercises.d: A roll up from lying with your hands behind your head, training the abs.
i: Lie on your back with hands behind your head.
Curl your head and shoulders up.
Roll up to sit.
Reach forward.
Roll down with control.

exercises.n: círculo a una pierna acostado
exercises.d: A hip mobility move where one leg draws circles in the air.
i: Lie on your back with one leg extended up.
Keep your pelvis still.
Draw small circles with that leg.
Reverse direction.
Switch legs.

exercises.n: patada a una pierna acostado
exercises.d: A face-down move kicking one heel toward the glute while the chest stays lifted.
i: Lie face down and prop yourself on your forearms.
Keep your chest lifted.
Kick one heel toward your glute twice.
Lower and switch legs.
Keep your hips down.

exercises.n: balancín con piernas abiertas
exercises.d: A balance and rolling move with the legs open in a V shape.
i: Sit and hold your ankles with your legs in a V.
Balance on your tailbone.
Roll back onto your shoulders.
Roll up to balance again.
Keep your back rounded.

exercises.n: balanceo
exercises.d: A rocking move on the stomach that stretches the front and strengthens the back.
i: Lie face down and reach back to hold your ankles.
Lift your chest and legs.
Rock forward and back.
Keep your movement smooth.
Lower down to finish.

exercises.n: roll up v. 2
exercises.d: A slow roll up from lying to sitting, training abdominal control and spine flexibility.
i: Lie on your back with arms overhead.
Lift your arms and curl your head and chest up.
Roll up one vertebra at a time.
Reach over your legs.
Roll back down slowly.

exercises.n: rodar hacia atrás
exercises.d: A rolling move that massages the spine and trains abdominal control.
i: Sit with your knees tucked and hold your shins.
Round your back.
Roll back onto your shoulders.
Roll back up to balance.
Keep your chin tucked.

exercises.n: rollover
exercises.d: A controlled move where the legs travel overhead and back, challenging the abs.
i: Lie on your back with legs raised.
Roll your legs overhead.
Open them to hip width.
Roll down slowly.
Keep your arms pressing down.

exercises.n: sierra
exercises.d: A seated twist that reaches toward the opposite foot, training the obliques and stretching the back of the legs.
i: Sit with legs wide and arms out.
Rotate your torso to one side.
Reach your hand past your opposite foot.
Return to centre.
Switch sides.

exercises.n: tijeras
exercises.d: A leg-switching move lying on your back, building lower abdominal strength.
i: Lie on your back with your hips lifted and hands supporting them.
Raise your legs up.
Lower one leg while the other stays up.
Switch legs.
Keep the movement steady.

exercises.n: puente de hombros
exercises.d: A bridge that lifts the hips and adds a leg raise, working the glutes and hamstrings.
i: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Extend one leg up.
Lower it and switch legs.
Roll down slowly.

exercises.n: flexión lateral
exercises.d: A Pilates side bend from a seated or side-supported position that works the obliques and the sides of the trunk.
i: Sit tall on your side with your bottom hand pressed into the mat and your legs stacked.
Lift your hips so your body forms a long diagonal line.
Reach your top arm overhead and bend sideways over the supporting arm.
Lift back up to the long line while keeping your hips high.
Lower with control and repeat, then switch sides.

exercises.n: giro lateral
exercises.d: A Pilates twist from a side-supported position that trains the obliques and shoulder stability.
i: Set up in a side support with one hand on the mat and your feet stacked.
Lift your hips and reach your top arm to the ceiling.
Thread the top arm under your body as you rotate your torso.
Open back up and reach to the ceiling again.
Keep your hips lifted throughout, then switch sides.

exercises.n: giro de columna v. 2
exercises.d: A seated Pilates twist that mobilises the spine and strengthens the obliques.
i: Sit tall with your legs extended and arms reaching out to the sides.
Flex your feet and grow tall through the crown of your head.
Twist your torso to one side, pulsing gently for a small extra turn.
Return to center without sagging in the chest.
Twist to the other side and repeat.

exercises.n: salto de cisne
exercises.d: A rocking Pilates move on your belly that builds back extensor strength and control.
i: Lie face down with your hands under your shoulders and legs together.
Press up into a swan, lifting your chest off the mat.
Let your arms float forward as you rock your chest and legs up.
Rock back and forth in a smooth, controlled rhythm.
Keep your neck long and your abs gently drawn in.

exercises.n: nado
exercises.d: A prone Pilates exercise with alternating arm and leg flutters that trains the back and glutes.
i: Lie face down with arms extended overhead and legs long.
Lift your arms, chest and legs slightly off the mat.
Flutter opposite arm and leg up and down in a quick, small rhythm.
Keep your abs drawn in and your neck long.
Continue for 20-30 seconds, then rest.

exercises.n: teaser
exercises.d: A classic Pilates V-sit that challenges abdominal strength and balance.
i: Lie on your back with legs extended and arms overhead.
Roll up while lifting your legs to form a V shape.
Reach your arms parallel to your legs and balance on your sit bones.
Hold briefly with a flat, strong back.
Roll down slowly with control and repeat.

exercises.n: estiramiento a una pierna (rodilla flexionada) v. 2
exercises.d: A Pilates ab move with alternating knee pulls that builds core endurance and coordination.
i: Lie on your back and curl your head and shoulders off the mat.
Pull one knee toward your chest, with hands on that shin.
Extend the other leg long at a low angle.
Switch legs in a steady rhythm.
Keep your lower back anchored to the mat.

exercises.n: estiramiento de columna hacia delante v. 2
exercises.d: A seated Pilates stretch that rounds the spine forward to lengthen the back and hamstrings.
i: Sit tall with legs extended hip-width apart and arms reaching forward.
Draw your belly in and flex your feet.
Curl forward one vertebra at a time, reaching over an imaginary ball.
Hold for a breath at the bottom.
Roll back up to tall sitting and repeat.

exercises.n: leg pull frontal con apoyo
exercises.d: A Pilates plank variation with a leg lift that builds core and shoulder stability.
i: Start in a high plank with hands under your shoulders.
Keep your body in one straight line from head to heels.
Lift one leg a few inches without shifting your hips.
Lower it and repeat on the other leg.
Keep your abs tight and your neck long.

exercises.n: patada lateral de rodillas
exercises.d: A kneeling Pilates side kick that works the outer hip and core stability.
i: Kneel on one knee with the opposite leg extended to the side.
Place your bottom hand on the mat and keep the top hand light behind your head.
Kick the top leg forward, then sweep it back with control.
Keep your torso steady and tall.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: boomerang
exercises.d: An advanced Pilates sequence of rolling and balancing that tests core control.
i: Sit tall with legs extended and crossed at the ankles.
Roll back and lift your legs overhead, then switch the cross.
Roll up to a teaser with your legs lifted.
Hold your hands behind you and then reach forward over your legs.
Move smoothly, using your abs to control each roll.

exercises.n: foca
exercises.d: A rolling Pilates exercise that massages the spine and builds ab control.
i: Sit balanced on your tailbone with knees open and hands inside your ankles.
Tuck your chin and round your back into a ball.
Roll back to your shoulders and clap your feet together.
Roll up to the balance position and clap again.
Keep the roll smooth and avoid rolling onto your neck.

exercises.n: cisne con press boca abajo
exercises.d: A Pilates back extension on your belly that lifts the chest and strengthens the spine.
i: Lie face down with hands beside your chest and legs together.
Press your pubic bone into the mat and engage your glutes.
Press through your hands to lift your chest.
Keep your neck long and shoulders away from your ears.
Lower slowly with control and repeat.

exercises.n: sirena
exercises.d: A seated Pilates side stretch that opens the sides of the torso and ribs.
i: Sit with your legs folded to one side in a comfortable position.
Place one hand on the mat beside you.
Reach the other arm overhead and bend sideways over the supporting hand.
Hold for a breath, feeling the side stretch.
Return to tall sitting and switch sides.

exercises.n: nado a cuatro apoyos
exercises.d: A quadruped Pilates move with opposite arm and leg lifts for back stability.
i: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back.
Flutter them in small, quick pulses.
Keep your spine neutral and your hips level.
Switch sides and repeat.

exercises.n: elevación de piernas colgado en polea
exercises.d: A hanging leg raise with cable resistance at your feet. Strengthens the abs and hip flexors.
i: Hang from a pull-up bar with the cable attached to your ankles.
Keep your arms straight and your body steady.
Raise your legs up in front of you toward hip height or higher.
Curl your pelvis slightly at the top.
Lower slowly without swinging.

exercises.n: abdominal estrella (avanzado)
exercises.d: A wide-limb crunch that works the abs while your arms and legs open and close like a starfish.
i: Lie on your back with arms and legs spread wide.
Brace your core and press your lower back into the floor.
Crunch up, bringing your arms and legs toward the center.
Slowly open back out to the starfish shape.
Keep your movements controlled and repeat.

exercises.n: plancha frontal a flexión
exercises.d: A move that moves from forearm plank to full push-up position, training the chest, arms and core.
i: Start in a forearm plank with elbows under shoulders.
Place one hand on the floor and press up, then the other.
Reach a high plank with straight arms.
Lower back to your forearms one arm at a time.
Alternate the leading arm each rep and keep your hips level.

exercises.n: patadas de aleteo (manos bajo las caderas, cabeza arriba)
exercises.en: flutter kicks (hands under hips head up)
exercises.d: Fast alternating leg lifts with your head raised that fire up the lower abs.
i: Lie on your back with hands tucked under your hips.
Lift your head and shoulders slightly off the floor.
Raise both legs a few inches above the ground.
Kick your legs up and down in small alternating pulses.
Keep your lower back pressed down and breathe steadily.

exercises.n: tijeras (principiante)
exercises.d: A beginner floor exercise crossing the legs like scissors to train the lower abs.
i: Lie on your back with arms by your sides.
Lift both legs a little off the floor.
Open them wide, then cross one over the other.
Alternate which leg is on top with each rep.
Keep your lower back flat on the floor.

exercises.n: plancha frontal con elevación de brazo
exercises.d: A plank where one arm lifts at a time, challenging core stability and anti-rotation.
i: Set up in a forearm plank with elbows under shoulders.
Squeeze your glutes and keep a straight line from head to heels.
Lift one arm forward without letting your hips twist.
Return it and lift the other arm.
Alternate in a slow, controlled rhythm.

exercises.n: plancha frontal con elevación de brazo (posición de flexión)
exercises.en: front plank with arm lift (push up position)
exercises.d: A high plank where you lift one arm at a time, training anti-rotation core strength.
i: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
Set your feet slightly wider for balance.
Lift one hand and reach it forward without twisting your hips.
Place it down and switch arms.
Keep your core braced throughout.

exercises.n: plancha frontal con elevación de brazo y pierna (posición de flexión)
exercises.en: front plank with arm and leg lift (push up position)
exercises.d: A high plank holding the opposite arm and leg in the air, which tests balance and core strength.
i: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
Lift one arm and the opposite leg at the same time.
Hold them in line with your body for a moment.
Lower them back to the floor with control.
Switch to the other arm and leg and repeat.

exercises.n: plancha lateral (principiante)
exercises.d: A bent-knee side plank that builds oblique and hip strength for beginners.
i: Lie on your side with knees bent and your elbow under your shoulder.
Stack your hips and knees.
Press into your forearm to lift your hips off the floor.
Hold a straight line from knees to head.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.n: curl predicador de pie con barra ez
exercises.d: A preacher style curl performed standing at an angled pad. Isolates the biceps with strict form.
i: Stand facing a preacher pad and hold an EZ bar with an underhand grip.
Rest your upper arms on the pad with the arms extended.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until the arms are almost straight.

exercises.n: curl de bíceps con trineo
exercises.d: A biceps curl using a power sled as the resistance. Adds a unique load for arm strength.
i: Stand facing the sled and grip the handle or strap with an underhand grip.
Keep your elbows tucked at your sides.
Curl your hands up toward your shoulders, moving the sled.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly and keep your torso still.

exercises.n: remo con zancada trasera y trineo
exercises.d: A rear lunge combined with a row using a power sled. Works legs and back together.
i: Hold the sled handles with arms extended and feet together.
Step back into a rear lunge, lowering your back knee.
As you rise, row the handles toward your ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Return to standing and extend your arms.
Alternate legs on each rep.

exercises.n: zancada trasera con trineo v. 2
exercises.d: A rear lunge using a power sled for resistance. Builds glute and thigh strength.
i: Hold the sled handles and stand tall with feet together.
Step one foot back into a lunge, lowering your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your torso upright.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs on each rep.

exercises.n: batwing trasero con trineo
exercises.d: A movement with a power sled where you pull the handles out and back like wings. Works the hamstrings, back and rear shoulders.
i: Hold the sled handles and hinge slightly at the hips.
Keep your back flat and knees soft.
Pull the handles back and out to the sides like wings.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly to the start.

exercises.n: apertura posterior con trineo
exercises.d: A rear fly done with a power sled for resistance. Works the rear shoulders and upper back.
i: Hold the sled handles with arms out in front and hinge slightly at the hips.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Sweep your arms out to the sides, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Pause briefly.
Return slowly.

exercises.n: arrastre hacia atrás con trineo
exercises.d: Walking backward while dragging a power sled. Great for quads and conditioning with low joint stress.
i: Face the sled, holding its handles or straps with a slight lean back.
Keep your chest up and core braced.
Walk backward in steady steps, pulling the sled with you.
Keep your knees soft and drive through your legs.
Cover a set distance, then rest.

exercises.n: empuje hacia atrás con trineo
exercises.d: Pushing a power sled while walking backward. Builds quad strength and conditioning.
i: Stand behind the sled with your back to it and grip the handles.
Brace your core and lean slightly into the load.
Walk forward in powerful steps, pushing the sled.
Keep your stride steady and breathing controlled.
Cover a set distance, then rest.

exercises.n: caminata antirrotación hacia delante con trineo
exercises.en: power sled anti rotation forward walk
exercises.d: Walking a loaded sled forward while resisting twist from a side-on pull or hold. It builds hip and trunk stability under load.
i: Set a light load and stand side-on to the pull, gripping the handle at chest height.
Brace your abs and keep your hips and shoulders square.
Walk forward in controlled steps without letting the torso twist.
Walk the set distance, then reset and repeat.
Switch sides and do the same distance.

exercises.n: tirón alto con trineo
exercises.d: A pull from low to chest height on a sled, using hip drive. It trains the shoulders and upper back with a bit of power.
i: Stand facing the sled and hold the handles or rope with arms long.
Hinge slightly at the hips with a flat back.
Drive your hips forward and pull the handles up toward your chest, elbows high.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower under control and repeat.

exercises.n: acarreo de maleta con mancuerna
exercises.d: Carrying one heavy dumbbell at your side like a suitcase. It challenges your grip and forces your trunk to resist leaning.
i: Pick up one dumbbell with a tall, braced posture and hold it at your side.
Keep your shoulders level and your ribs stacked over your hips.
Walk with steady steps without leaning toward the weight.
Cover the set distance, then put the weight down safely.
Switch hands and repeat.

exercises.n: acarreo alto y bajo con mancuernas
exercises.d: A walking carry with one dumbbell overhead and one at your side. The mismatch trains shoulder stability and trunk control.
i: Hold one dumbbell overhead with a locked, stable arm and the other at your side.
Stand tall with your ribs down and abs braced.
Walk with steady steps and keep the top arm stacked over your shoulder.
Walk the set distance, then lower the weights carefully.
Swap positions and repeat.

exercises.n: paseo del granjero con barra hexagonal
exercises.d: Carrying a loaded trap bar at your sides while walking. It works grip, traps and the whole trunk together.
i: Stand inside the trap bar and hinge down to grip the handles.
Stand up with a flat back, shoulders back and chest tall.
Walk with short, quick steps, keeping the bar still.
Cover the set distance without leaning or shrugging.
Lower the bar back to the floor with control.

exercises.n: acarreo sobre la cabeza con mancuerna
exercises.d: Walking with a dumbbell held overhead. It builds shoulder stability and a strong, braced trunk.
i: Press a dumbbell overhead and lock out your elbow with the biceps near your ear.
Brace your abs and keep your ribs down.
Walk with steady steps without letting the arm drift forward.
Cover the set distance, then lower the weight with control.
Switch arms and repeat.

exercises.n: acarreo sobre la cabeza con barra
exercises.d: Walking while holding a barbell locked out overhead. It trains shoulder stability and whole-body bracing.
i: Press the barbell overhead with a grip just outside shoulder width.
Squeeze your glutes and keep your ribs down.
Walk with small, steady steps, keeping the bar over your mid-foot.
Cover the set distance without arching your back.
Lower the bar to your shoulders and set it down safely.

exercises.n: acarreo zercher con barra
exercises.d: Carrying a barbell in the crooks of your elbows. It loads the legs, upper back and trunk in a tough front-loaded position.
i: Set the bar in your elbow crooks, hugging it tight to your chest.
Stand tall with your chest up and your abs braced.
Walk with controlled steps while keeping the bar close.
Cover the set distance without rounding forward.
Lower the bar to the rack or floor carefully.

exercises.n: acarreo goblet con kettlebell
exercises.d: Walking while hugging a kettlebell at chest height. It trains posture, the trunk and the upper back.
i: Hold a kettlebell by the horns close to your chest, elbows tucked.
Stand tall with your ribs down and abs braced.
Walk with steady steps without leaning back.
Cover the set distance, keeping the bell high and still.
Set the kettlebell down with a flat back.

exercises.n: paseo del granjero con mancuernas
exercises.d: Walking while holding a heavy dumbbell in each hand. It builds grip strength, traps and overall posture.
i: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides and stand tall.
Pull your shoulders back and down and brace your abs.
Walk with quick, controlled steps without swinging the weights.
Cover the set distance, then lower the dumbbells safely.

exercises.n: acarreo de maleta con barra
exercises.d: Carrying a barbell off to one side with a single-handed grip. It trains your trunk to resist leaning and builds grip.
i: Stand with the barbell at your side and grip it near its center of balance.
Lift it while keeping your torso tall and level.
Walk with steady steps and resist tilting toward the weight.
Cover the set distance, then lower the bar carefully.
Switch hands and repeat.

exercises.n: press hexagonal en smith
exercises.d: A press with the weights squeezed together, done on a Smith machine. The squeeze keeps tension on the chest throughout.
i: Lie on a bench under the Smith bar and hold a weight plate between your palms if you like.
Unrack the bar with a close grip and hold it over your chest.
Squeeze your hands inward as you lower the bar to your mid chest.
Press back up while still squeezing.
Rerack the bar when done.

exercises.n: peso muerto a una pierna con peso corporal y brazo y pierna extendidos
exercises.en: single leg bodyweight deadlift with arm and leg extended
exercises.d: A single-leg hinge with your arms extended that trains hamstrings, glutes and balance.
i: Stand on one leg with arms reaching forward.
Soften your standing knee slightly.
Hinge at the hips as your free leg lifts behind you.
Keep your back flat and body in a long line.
Return to standing and repeat, then switch legs.

exercises.n: flexión pike
exercises.d: A push-up with hips lifted high so you press more overhead. It builds shoulder strength using only your body weight.
i: Start in a push-up position, then walk your feet in and lift your hips into an inverted V.
Keep your arms and back straight.
Bend your elbows and lower the top of your head toward the floor.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight throughout.

exercises.n: curl de bíceps de pie con peso corporal
exercises.d: A curl done with your own body resistance, such as pushing one hand against the other. It is a simple way to train the biceps without equipment.
i: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Place one hand under the wrist of your other hand to give resistance.
Curl the working hand toward your shoulder while the other hand pushes down.
Squeeze the biceps at the top.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: elevación lateral acostado de lado en polea
exercises.d: A lateral raise performed while lying on your side with a cable. Lying down keeps constant tension on the side delt.
i: Lie on your side next to a low cable pulley and grab the handle with your top hand.
Keep your arm straight with a slight bend in the elbow.
Raise your arm out to the side until it is near shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: subida al cajón a una pierna con mancuernas
exercises.d: Stepping up onto a bench with one leg while holding dumbbells. It builds single-leg strength in the quads and glutes.
i: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand facing a box or bench.
Place one foot fully on the box.
Drive through that heel to stand up tall.
Lower back down under control without bouncing off the floor foot.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: caminata lateral con banda en x
exercises.d: Stepping sideways against a band anchored in an X pattern. It fires up the hips and outer glutes.
i: Cross the band into an X and place it around your feet or lower legs, holding the ends as needed.
Stand in a quarter squat with your chest up.
Step sideways, keeping tension on the band.
Bring the trailing foot in without letting your feet touch.
Walk the set distance, then return the other way.

exercises.n: press bottoms-up a un brazo de rodillas con kettlebell
exercises.en: kettlebell kneeling one arm bottoms up press
exercises.d: Pressing a kettlebell held upside down from a kneeling position. The unstable load demands shoulder control and grip.
i: Kneel on both knees and hold a kettlebell bottoms up at shoulder height.
Squeeze the handle tight and keep your wrist straight.
Press the bell straight overhead.
Lower slowly to your shoulder, keeping the bell balanced.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: encogimiento sobre la cabeza con barra
exercises.d: A shrug done with the barbell locked out overhead. It targets the traps and helps with overhead stability.
i: Hold a barbell locked out overhead with a wide grip.
Keep your arms straight and your ribs down.
Shrug your shoulders up toward your ears.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly without bending your elbows.

exercises.n: cuerdas de batalla de rodillas
exercises.d: Making waves with heavy ropes while kneeling. It raises your heart rate and burns the shoulders and arms.
i: Kneel in front of the anchored ropes and hold an end in each hand.
Brace your abs and keep your chest up.
Raise and lower your arms alternately to create waves.
Keep the waves quick and steady.
Work for a set time, then rest.

exercises.n: apertura con banda elástica (supinación a 90 grados)
exercises.d: A band pull-apart with palms facing up and elbows bent at 90 degrees. It targets the rear delts and external shoulder rotation.
i: Hold a band in front of you at chest height with palms up and elbows bent at 90 degrees.
Keep your elbows tucked near your sides.
Rotate your forearms outward, pulling the band apart.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together briefly.
Return slowly and repeat.

exercises.n: flexión de hombro con la espalda contra la pared
exercises.d: Raising your arms overhead while your back stays against a wall. It improves shoulder mobility and posture.
i: Stand with your back, head and hips against a wall.
Keep your arms at your sides with elbows straight.
Raise your arms forward and up overhead as far as you can without arching your back.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.n: press de hombros a un brazo de rodillas con kettlebell
exercises.en: kettlebell kneeling one arm shoulder press
exercises.d: A one-arm kettlebell press from a kneeling position. Kneeling takes the legs out of it and challenges your trunk.
i: Kneel on both knees with a kettlebell racked at your shoulder.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs.
Press the kettlebell overhead until your arm is straight.
Lower it slowly back to your shoulder.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: zancada trasera con cuerdas de batalla
