exercises.d: Alternating rear lunges while making waves with heavy ropes. It combines leg work with a hard cardio effort.
i: Stand holding the ends of the battle ropes, feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot back into a lunge while making a wave with the ropes.
Push through your front heel to return to standing.
Alternate legs, keeping the rope waves going.
Work for a set time, then rest.

exercises.n: press de hombros en media rodilla con kettlebell
exercises.d: A one-arm kettlebell press from a half-kneeling stance. The position teaches hip stability while you press.
i: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward and a kettlebell racked at your shoulder.
Brace your abs and squeeze the glute of the kneeling leg.
Press the bell straight overhead.
Lower it back under control.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: estiramiento de movilización de pectoral en media rodilla con tubo
exercises.en: half kneeling pvc pec mobilization stretch
exercises.d: A chest opener using a PVC pipe from a half-kneeling position. It loosens tight pecs and the front of the shoulder.
i: Kneel on one knee and grip a pipe or stick with one hand while the other arm reaches out.
Place the working forearm against a wall or post.
Gently rotate your torso away until you feel a stretch across your chest.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

exercises.n: estiramiento de tobillo con balanceo
exercises.d: Rocking forward over a bent knee to open the ankle and calf. It helps ankle mobility for squats and walking.
i: Kneel on one knee with the front foot flat on the floor.
Keep your front heel down.
Rock your front knee forward over your toes until you feel a stretch.
Rock back and forth slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.

exercises.n: rollout redondeado con balón de estabilidad
exercises.d: A rollout on a stability ball with a rounded back that trains the abs hard.
i: Kneel in front of a stability ball with forearms on top.
Round your back slightly and tuck your pelvis.
Roll the ball forward by extending your arms.
Pull it back using your abs.
Keep your hips from sagging and move slowly.

exercises.n: dead bug con banda para tren superior
exercises.en: band upper body resistance dead bug
exercises.d: A dead bug with a band resisting your arms. It adds shoulder and trunk demand to a classic core drill.
i: Lie on your back holding a band overhead and bring your knees up at 90 degrees.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Lower the opposite arm and leg while keeping band tension.
Return to the start and switch sides.
Keep your ribs down and move slowly.

exercises.n: rotación de kettlebell alrededor de la cabeza
exercises.d: Circling a kettlebell around your head, also called a halo. It loosens the shoulders and warms up the upper back.
i: Hold a kettlebell by the horns at chest height.
Stand tall with your abs braced.
Circle the bell around your head, keeping it close.
Keep your hips and ribs still.
Finish the reps, then reverse direction.

exercises.n: elevación de trapecio a un brazo boca abajo
exercises.d: A raise lying face down on a bench or floor with one arm. It targets the lower and middle traps and shoulder blade control.
i: Lie face down with one arm hanging or reaching overhead, thumb up.
Keep your forehead down and neck relaxed.
Lift your arm in a Y shape by squeezing your shoulder blade down and back.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: deslizamiento de antebrazos en la pared
exercises.d: Sliding your forearms up a wall to wake up the shoulder blade muscles. It improves overhead movement.
i: Stand facing a wall with your forearms on it, elbows at shoulder height.
Lean in slightly and keep your abs braced.
Slide your forearms up the wall as you reach upward.
Pause at the top without arching your back.
Slide back down and repeat.

exercises.n: press en ángulo con kettlebell
exercises.d: A kettlebell press at an angle between a front and a side raise path. It suits natural shoulder movement and builds pressing strength.
i: Hold a kettlebell at your shoulder and stand tall.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes.
Press the bell up and slightly out to the side in a diagonal path.
Lock out your arm without leaning back.
Lower under control, finish the reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: arrastre de araña con banda elástica
exercises.d: A spider crawl performed with a band around your legs. The band adds hip effort to a classic core and shoulder crawl.
i: Place a band around your thighs and start in a push-up position.
Brace your core.
Bring one knee toward the same-side elbow while crawling forward.
Alternate sides while keeping the band under tension.
Crawl the set distance, then rest.

exercises.n: flexión de foca
exercises.d: A push-up where your hands lift off the floor and reach out at the top. It builds chest and back strength together.
i: Lie face down with your hands under your shoulders and legs straight.
Push your upper body up with your arms like a seal.
Keep your hips on the floor and your core tight.
Lower slowly to the floor.
Repeat for smooth, controlled reps.

exercises.n: deslizamiento de escápulas con la espalda en la pared
exercises.d: Sliding your shoulder blades along a wall to improve their control. It helps shoulder blade mobility and posture.
i: Stand with your back flat against a wall and your elbows bent at your sides.
Press your forearms and head lightly into the wall.
Slide your arms up the wall while keeping your shoulder blades down.
Stop before your back arches.
Slide down slowly and repeat.

exercises.n: flexión de escápula a un brazo
exercises.d: A small push-up movement with one arm that moves only the shoulder blades. It builds control of the serratus anterior.
i: Start in a plank with one hand on the floor, the other behind your back or on your hip.
Keep your elbow locked straight.
Let your chest sink slightly between your shoulder blades.
Push the floor away to round your upper back slightly.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: masaje con rodillo en el tibial anterior
exercises.d: Rolling the front of the lower leg on a foam roller. It can loosen the muscles beside your shin.
i: Kneel on the floor and place the roller under the front of your shin.
Support yourself with your hands on the floor.
Roll slowly up and down the shin muscle.
Pause on tight spots for a few seconds.
Switch legs and keep the pressure comfortable.

exercises.n: masaje con rodillo en el pectoral
exercises.d: Rolling the chest on a foam roller. It can loosen tight pecs before pressing or after desk work.
i: Lie face down and place the roller under one side of your chest.
Extend that arm out to the side.
Roll slowly side to side and up and down.
Pause on tight spots for a few seconds.
Switch sides and keep the pressure comfortable.

exercises.n: masaje con rodillo en el dorsal ancho
exercises.d: Rolling the side of your back on a foam roller. It can loosen tight lats before overhead work.
i: Lie on your side with the roller under your armpit area and your arm extended.
Support yourself with your lower arm and legs.
Roll slowly along your side toward the ribs.
Pause on tight spots for a few seconds.
Switch sides and keep the pressure comfortable.

exercises.n: sentadilla con cinturón en máquina
exercises.d: A squat on a machine where the weight hangs from a belt at your hips. It loads the legs without stressing your spine.
i: Step into the belt and stand on the platforms with the belt snug on your hips.
Stand tall and brace your abs.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel.
Push through your heels to stand back up.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.

exercises.n: prensa de piernas horizontal en máquina
exercises.d: A leg press on a horizontal lever machine. It builds the quads and glutes with back support.
i: Sit on the machine with your back flat against the pad and feet on the platform.
Set your feet about shoulder-width apart.
Press the platform away until your legs are nearly straight.
Do not lock your knees.
Lower slowly until your knees are bent about 90 degrees and repeat.

exercises.n: patada trasera de rodillas en smith (con compañero)
exercises.d: A kneeling glute kick using a Smith machine with a partner helping. It works the glutes with a steady guided path.
i: Get on all fours and place the sole of one foot on the Smith bar, with your partner steadying you if needed.
Brace your core.
Press the bar up by extending your hip.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: curl de pie con agarre inverso en polea (barra recta)
exercises.en: cable standing reverse grip curl (straight bar)
exercises.d: A standing curl with an overhand grip on a straight cable bar. It targets the forearms and brachialis.
i: Stand facing a low cable with a straight bar in an overhand grip.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders without swinging.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.n: sentadilla dividida goblet con pie delantero elevado y mancuerna
exercises.en: dumbbell goblet split squat front foot elevated
exercises.d: A goblet split squat with the front foot on a raised platform. The extra height deepens the range for the quads and glutes.
i: Hold one dumbbell at your chest and place your front foot on a low platform.
Place your back foot behind you on the floor.
Lower your back knee toward the floor with your torso upright.
Push through your front heel to stand.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: sentadilla dividida con pie delantero elevado y mancuernas
exercises.en: dumbbell split squat front foot elevated
exercises.d: A split squat holding dumbbells at your sides with the front foot raised. It deepens the range for the quads and glutes.
i: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and place your front foot on a low platform.
Step your back foot behind you.
Lower your back knee toward the floor with your torso upright.
Push through your front heel to stand.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: sentadilla dividida con mancuernas
exercises.d: A stationary lunge with dumbbells at your sides. It strengthens one leg at a time, mainly the quads and glutes.
i: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and take a long stance, one foot forward.
Keep your torso upright.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Push through your front heel to stand.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: remo con flexión desde plancha
exercises.d: A plank sequence combining a push-up and a row. It trains the chest, back and core in one flowing move.
i: Start in a plank with a dumbbell in each hand and your feet wide.
Do a push-up, keeping your body straight.
Row one dumbbell up to your ribs without twisting your hips.
Lower it and row the other side.
Repeat the sequence with control.

exercises.n: press de hombros sentado con agarre martillo en máquina
exercises.en: lever seated hammer grip shoulder press
exercises.d: A seated machine shoulder press with a neutral hammer grip. It trains the delts with a joint-friendly hand position.
i: Sit with your back against the pad and grip the neutral handles.
Keep your feet flat on the floor.
Press the handles overhead until your arms are almost straight.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly to shoulder height and repeat.

exercises.n: elevación de piernas rectas en silla romana
exercises.d: A straight leg raise on a captain's chair, lifting your legs in front of you. Works the abs and hip flexors.
i: Siéntate en la silla romana con la espalda apoyada en el respaldo y los antebrazos apoyados en las almohadillas.
Mantén la parte superior del cuerpo estable y la espalda recta.
Activa el abdomen y levanta las piernas frente a ti, manteniéndolas rectas.
Continúa levantando hasta que las piernas estén paralelas al suelo o tan alto como puedas llegar cómodamente.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte superior, luego baja lentamente las piernas de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: puente de glúteos con barra (manos en la barra)
exercises.d: A glute bridge with the barbell resting on your hips and your hands on the bar. It builds the glutes and hamstrings with load.
i: Sit on the floor with a barbell over your hips, padded if needed.
Roll back, set your feet, and hold the bar with both hands.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.n: sentadilla frontal con mancuernas
exercises.d: A squat with dumbbells held at your shoulders. The front load keeps your chest upright and challenges the quads and core.
i: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your shoulders, elbows forward.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking your toes.
Drive through your heels to stand.

exercises.n: thruster con mancuernas
exercises.d: A front squat that flows into an overhead press. It is a hard whole-body move that raises your heart rate.
i: Hold dumbbells at your shoulders and stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down with your chest up.
Drive up through your heels and press the dumbbells overhead in one motion.
Lock out your arms at the top.
Lower the weights to your shoulders and go straight into the next rep.

exercises.n: thruster con mancuernas v. 2
exercises.d: A squat into overhead press with dumbbells that works the legs and shoulders in one flow.
i: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your shoulders.
Squat down with your chest tall and knees tracking over your toes.
Drive up through your heels as you stand.
Use that momentum to press the dumbbells overhead.
Lower them to your shoulders and go into the next squat.

exercises.n: thruster con banda elástica
exercises.d: A squat into an overhead press using a band for resistance. It trains the legs, shoulders and heart in one move.
i: Stand on the band and hold the ends at your shoulders.
Squat down with your chest up.
Drive up and press your hands overhead in one motion.
Lock out your arms at the top.
Lower your hands to your shoulders and repeat.

exercises.n: zancada lateral
exercises.d: Stepping out to the side into a deep lunge. It works the quads and glutes while opening the inner thighs.
i: Stand tall with your feet together and hands in front of your chest.
Step wide to one side.
Bend that knee and sit your hips back, keeping the other leg straight.
Push off the bent leg to return.
Alternate sides.

exercises.n: press de pecho a un brazo en máquina (con discos)
exercises.en: lever one arm chest press (plate loaded)
exercises.d: A single-arm chest press on a plate-loaded machine. It lets each side work on its own.
i: Sit on the machine with your back against the pad and grip one handle.
Set your feet flat on the floor.
Press the handle forward until your arm is nearly straight.
Pause briefly.
Return slowly, finish the reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: sentadilla y press con landmine
exercises.d: A squat that flows into a press with a landmine bar. It works legs and shoulders in one smooth motion.
i: Hold the end of the landmine bar at your chest with both hands.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down with your chest up.
Drive up and press the bar away until your arms are straight.
Lower the bar to your chest and repeat.

exercises.n: plancha dinámica subiendo y bajando de codos
exercises.en: elbow up and down dynamic plank
exercises.d: Moving between a forearm plank and a high plank, one arm at a time. It builds the core and shoulders under constant tension.
i: Start in a forearm plank with your body in a straight line.
Place one hand on the floor and press up to a high plank.
Place the other hand down.
Lower back to your forearms one arm at a time.
Alternate the leading arm and keep your hips still.

exercises.n: remo renegado con mancuernas
exercises.d: A row from a plank position with dumbbells. It builds the back while your core fights rotation.
i: Start in a high plank with a dumbbell in each hand and your feet wide.
Brace your core.
Row one dumbbell to your ribs without twisting your hips.
Lower it with control.
Repeat on the other side.

exercises.n: press de suelo alternado con mancuernas
exercises.d: A floor press where you press one dumbbell at a time. It trains the chest and triceps with a limited range for the shoulders.
i: Lie on the floor with a dumbbell in each hand and knees bent.
Press both dumbbells up over your chest.
Lower one dumbbell until your upper arm touches the floor.
Press it back up and lower the other side.
Keep alternating.

exercises.n: sentadilla pistol al cajón
exercises.d: A single-leg squat down to a box. The box gives you a target for depth as you build strength.
i: Stand in front of a box with one leg extended forward.
Brace your core and reach your arms forward for balance.
Sit back and down slowly on the standing leg until you touch the box.
Drive through your heel to stand.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: dominadas con agarre martillo y peso en jaula de fondos
exercises.en: weighted hammer grip pull up on dip cage
exercises.d: A weighted pull-up with a neutral hammer grip on a dip cage. It builds the lats and arms with extra load.
i: Attach a belt or vest with weight and grip the neutral handles of the cage.
Hang with your arms straight and your core braced.
Pull your chest up until your chin passes the handles.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly to a full hang and repeat.

exercises.n: dominada supina con agarre cerrado y peso en jaula de fondos
exercises.en: weighted close grip chin-up on dip cage
exercises.d: A weighted close-grip chin-up on a dip cage. Builds the lats, biceps and upper back.
i: Ponte de pie frente a la jaula de fondos y agarra las barras paralelas con un agarre supino, con las manos separadas a la altura de los hombros.
Cuélgate de las barras con los brazos completamente extendidos, los pies levantados del suelo y el cuerpo recto.
Activa los músculos de la espalda y tira de tu cuerpo hacia arriba en dirección a las barras, manteniendo los codos cerca de los costados.
Continúa tirando hasta que tu barbilla quede por encima de las barras, luego haz una pausa de un momento.
Baja lentamente el cuerpo de nuevo a la posición inicial, extendiendo completamente los brazos.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: movilidad de sentadilla
exercises.d: A deep squat hold and rock that opens the hips and ankles.
i: Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulder width.
Sink into a deep squat, keeping your heels down.
Press your elbows gently against your knees.
Rock side to side and sit tall.
Spend 30-45 seconds there, then stand up.

exercises.n: complejo de movilidad de sentadilla
exercises.d: A short flow of deep squat positions that opens up the hips, knees and ankles. Good as a warm-up before leg work.
i: Stand with your feet a little wider than shoulder width and toes turned out slightly.
Sink into a deep squat and keep your heels on the floor.
Press your elbows against your knees to open the hips and hold for a moment.
Shift gently from side to side, then rock forward and back.
Stand up tall and repeat the flow for 6-8 rounds.
Keep your chest lifted and your back long throughout.

exercises.n: activación de gemelos caminando con barra
exercises.d: Walking on the balls of your feet with a barbell on your back to wake up the calves before heavy lower body training.
i: Rest a light barbell across your upper back and hold it with both hands.
Stand tall with your core braced and rise onto the balls of your feet.
Walk forward in small, controlled steps without letting your heels drop.
Keep your ankles steady and your hips level.
Walk 10-15 metres, rest, then repeat for a few rounds.
Use a light load so you can stay high on your toes.

exercises.n: flexión, depresión y retracción de hombro sentado a una pierna con balón
exercises.en: rollball seated single leg shoulder flexor depressor retractor
exercises.d: A seated shoulder control drill on a ball with one leg lifted. It challenges balance while you raise, lower and pull back the shoulder blades.
i: Sit tall on a stability ball with your feet on the floor.
Lift one foot slightly off the ground and hold your balance.
Raise your arms forward, then press your shoulders down away from your ears.
Pull your shoulder blades back and together without arching your back.
Return slowly to the start and complete your reps.
Switch legs and repeat on the other side.

exercises.n: automasaje de gemelos con barra
exercises.d: A self-massage for the calves using a barbell to roll over tight spots.
i: Sit on the floor with one calf resting on a barbell.
Support yourself with your hands behind you.
Roll your calf slowly back and forth over the bar.
Pause on tender spots for a few breaths.
Switch to the other leg.

exercises.n: movilidad de sentadilla goblet con kettlebell
exercises.d: A goblet squat held low with a kettlebell as a counterweight, used to loosen the hips and ankles.
i: Hold a kettlebell by the horns against your chest.
Stand with your feet wider than your shoulders and toes slightly out.
Squat down as deep as you comfortably can with your chest up.
Use your elbows to push your knees out and pause at the bottom.
Rock gently side to side to open the hips.
Drive through your feet to stand back up.

exercises.n: automasaje con rodillo en el tibial anterior
exercises.d: A foam roller technique for the front of the lower leg that eases tightness.
i: Kneel on a mat with the foam roller under your shins.
Support yourself with your hands in front.
Shift your weight to roll along the front of your lower leg.
Move slowly and pause on tight spots.
Roll for 30-60 seconds per leg.

exercises.n: press de hombros a un brazo con banda elástica
exercises.d: A one-arm overhead press against a band. It trains the shoulders and makes your core resist twisting.
i: Stand on the band with your feet hip width apart and hold the other end at shoulder height.
Brace your core and keep your ribs down.
Press the hand straight overhead until your arm is almost straight.
Lower under control back to your shoulder.
Complete your reps without leaning sideways.
Switch arms and repeat.

exercises.n: dominadas asistidas con banda elástica v. 3
exercises.d: A pull-up where a band under your foot or knee takes some of your weight, so you can build up to full reps.
i: Loop a band over the pull-up bar and place a foot or knee in it.
Grab the bar with an overhand grip a little wider than your shoulders.
Hang with your arms long and your shoulders engaged.
Pull your chest toward the bar by driving your elbows down.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight again.
Use a thinner band as you get stronger.

exercises.n: estiramiento de tobillo sentado
exercises.d: A gentle seated stretch for the front of the ankle and shin that eases stiffness after sitting or training.
i: Sit on a chair or the floor with one leg extended.
Point your toes away from you so the top of the foot lengthens.
Slowly circle or press the foot until you feel a comfortable stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without forcing it.
Release and switch legs.
Repeat 2-3 times on each side.

exercises.n: estiramiento de talón de aquiles de pie hacia atrás con banda elástica
exercises.en: resistance band standing back achilles stretch
exercises.d: A calf and Achilles stretch with a band that gently pulls the toes toward you while the leg is behind you.
i: Loop a resistance band around the front of the foot of your back leg.
Hold the band ends in your hands and stand tall.
Step that leg back with the heel on the floor.
Pull the band gently so your toes move toward your shin.
Hold for 20-30 seconds with your back leg fairly straight.
Switch sides and repeat.

exercises.n: estiramiento de talón de aquiles de pie hacia delante con banda elástica
exercises.en: resistance band standing forward achilles stretch
exercises.d: A standing calf stretch with a band around the forward foot, pulling the toes back to lengthen the Achilles area.
i: Loop a resistance band around the ball of your front foot.
Hold the band ends and stand tall.
Place the front heel on the floor with the toes lifted.
Pull the band so your toes draw toward you and lean slightly forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds with a comfortable stretch.
Switch feet and repeat.

exercises.n: posición de rodillas en sentadillas
exercises.d: A bodyweight squat focused on where your knees travel, helping you learn to track them over your toes.
i: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and toes slightly out.
Brace your core and lift your chest.
Bend at the hips and knees to lower into a squat.
Push your knees out so they follow the line of your toes.
Go down as deep as feels controlled.
Drive up through your whole foot to stand.

exercises.n: flexión a un brazo (de rodillas)
exercises.d: A one-arm push-up from the knees, a stepping stone toward the full single-arm version. It builds chest and trunk strength.
i: Kneel and place one hand under your shoulder, with the other arm behind your back.
Spread your knees a bit wider for balance.
Keep a straight line from your head to your knees.
Lower your chest toward the floor with control.
Press back up without twisting your hips.
Switch arms and repeat.

exercises.n: caminar a paso ligero
exercises.d: A fast-paced walk that lifts your heart rate without the impact of running. Easy on the joints and good for steady fitness.
i: Stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Start walking at a pace faster than a stroll.
Swing your arms naturally with elbows bent.
Land on your heel and roll through to your toes.
Keep breathing steadily and stay able to talk.
Walk for 20-45 minutes.

exercises.n: abducción de cadera sentado con banda elástica
exercises.d: A seated hip abduction pushing your knees apart against a resistance band. Works the outer hips and glutes.
i: Siéntate en una silla o banco con la espalda recta y los pies apoyados en el suelo.
Envuelve la banda elástica alrededor de los muslos, justo por encima de las rodillas.
Coloca las manos en los lados de la silla o el banco para mayor apoyo.
Activa los abductores (los músculos externos del muslo) y empuja lentamente las rodillas hacia afuera, contra la resistencia de la banda.
Haz una pausa al final del movimiento y luego junta lentamente las rodillas de nuevo.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: extensión de piernas con banda elástica
exercises.d: A leg extension with a resistance band around your ankle. Builds the quads.
i: Sujeta la banda elástica a un punto de anclaje firme y asegúrala alrededor de tu tobillo.
Ponte de pie frente al punto de anclaje con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros.
Manteniendo el core activado y la parte superior del cuerpo estable, extiende la pierna recta frente a ti.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte alta y luego vuelve lentamente la pierna a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado, luego cambia de pierna.

exercises.n: subir escaleras
exercises.d: Stepping up stairs at a steady pace to train the legs and raise your heart rate.
i: Stand at the bottom of a staircase, standing tall.
Step up with one foot, placing your whole foot on the step.
Press through your heel and bring the other foot up.
Keep your torso upright and swing your arms naturally.
Continue at a steady pace and alternate the leading leg.

exercises.n: pullover acostado con brazos flexionados y barra EZ
exercises.en: ez bar lying bent arms pullover
exercises.d: A lying EZ bar pullover with slightly bent arms. Works the lats and chest.
i: Túmbate boca arriba en un banco con la cabeza en un extremo y los pies en el suelo.
Sostén la barra EZ con agarre prono (palmas hacia afuera) y las manos separadas a la altura de los hombros.
Extiende los brazos rectos por encima del pecho, manteniendo una ligera flexión en los codos.
Baja la barra describiendo un arco detrás de la cabeza, manteniendo la ligera flexión en los codos.
Haz una pausa breve, luego regresa la barra a la posición inicial invirtiendo el movimiento del arco.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: flexión escapular inclinada
exercises.d: An incline push-up where you retract your shoulder blades. Strengthens the serratus anterior and upper back.
i: Coloca un banco inclinado a un ángulo de 45 grados.
Coloca las manos en el banco, ligeramente más separadas que la altura de los hombros.
Coloca los pies en el suelo, separados a la altura de las caderas.
Baja el pecho hacia el banco, manteniendo los codos pegados al cuerpo.
Mientras bajas, retrae los omóplatos, apretándolos entre sí.
Empuja con las palmas para extender los brazos y regresar a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: fondos escapulares
exercises.d: A scapular dip, moving the shoulder blades while your arms stay straight. Strengthens the traps and shoulder stabilisers.
i: Comienza de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros y los brazos extendidos frente a ti.
Flexiona ligeramente las rodillas e inclínate hacia adelante desde las caderas, manteniendo la espalda recta.
Baja el cuerpo doblando los codos y retrayendo las escápulas, como si intentaras apretar un lápiz entre ellas.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la posición baja, luego empuja con las manos para extender los codos y volver a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: puente de glúteos bajo en el suelo
exercises.d: A low glute bridge on the floor, lifting your hips. Works the glutes and hamstrings.
i: Túmbate sobre tu espalda con las rodillas flexionadas y los pies apoyados en el suelo.
Coloca los brazos a los lados del cuerpo, con las palmas hacia abajo.
Activa los glúteos y el core, y luego eleva las caderas del suelo hasta que tu cuerpo forme una línea recta desde las rodillas hasta los hombros.
Haz una pausa breve en la parte alta, apretando los glúteos.
Baja lentamente las caderas de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: abdominal corto (curl-up)
exercises.d: A curl-up lifting your shoulders off the floor. Works the abs.
i: Túmbate sobre tu espalda con las rodillas flexionadas y los pies apoyados en el suelo.
Coloca las manos detrás de la cabeza con los codos apuntando hacia afuera.
Activando el abdomen, levanta lentamente la parte superior del cuerpo del suelo, curvándote hacia adelante hasta que tu torso forme un ángulo de 45 grados.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte superior, luego baja lentamente la parte superior del cuerpo de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: remo Pendlay con barra
exercises.d: A pendlay row from the floor, pulling the barbell to your upper abdomen. Builds the upper back and lats.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros y las rodillas ligeramente flexionadas.
Inclínate hacia delante desde las caderas manteniendo la espalda recta y el pecho elevado.
Agarra la barra con un agarre pronado un poco más ancho que la separación de los hombros.
Tira de la barra hacia la parte superior del abdomen, juntando los omóplatos.
Baja la barra de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: elevación de gemelos de pie
exercises.d: A bodyweight calf raise that builds lower-leg strength and ankle stability.
i: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Rise up onto the balls of your feet as high as you can.
Pause at the top for a second.
Lower your heels slowly back to the floor.
Hold a wall for balance if needed.

exercises.n: dominadas en banco
exercises.d: A bodyweight bench pull-up variation hanging beneath a bar. Works the lats and biceps.
i: Colócate debajo de una barra o una superficie horizontal resistente que esté a la altura del pecho.
Sujeta la barra o la superficie con agarre prono, un poco más separado que el ancho de los hombros.
Cuélgate con los brazos completamente extendidos y el cuerpo recto.
Lleva el pecho hacia la barra o la superficie juntando los omóplatos y flexionando los codos.
Continúa tirando hasta que la barbilla quede por encima de la barra o la superficie.
Baja de nuevo a la posición inicial con control.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: flexión escapular
exercises.d: A scapular push-up, protracting and retracting the shoulder blades. Strengthens the serratus anterior and upper back.
i: Comienza en una posición de plancha alta con las manos justo debajo de los hombros y el cuerpo en línea recta.
Baja el pecho hacia el suelo, manteniendo los codos cerca del cuerpo.
A medida que bajas, junta las escápulas y empuja el pecho hacia delante.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la posición baja, luego empuja de nuevo hacia arriba hasta la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: rotación interna de cadera acostado con banda elástica v. 2
exercises.en: band lying hip internal rotation v. 2
exercises.d: Lying hip internal rotation against a band to build control through the hip.
i: Lie on your back with a band around your lower leg anchored to the side.
Bend your knees with your feet on the floor.
Rotate your lower leg outward against the band, turning the hip inward.
Return slowly to the start.
Complete your reps and switch legs.

exercises.n: sentadilla dividida con barra
exercises.d: A split-stance squat with a barbell on your back. It works each leg on its own and builds strength and balance.
i: Rest a barbell across your upper back and step one foot forward.
Stand with a long stride and your torso upright.
Bend both knees and lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front heel down and your front knee over your foot.
Press through the front foot to rise.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: patada trasera con rodilla flexionada (de rodillas)
exercises.d: From all fours, you drive one bent knee up toward the ceiling. It targets the glutes without any equipment.
i: Start on hands and knees with your hands under your shoulders.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Lift one leg with the knee bent at 90 degrees.
Push the sole of your foot toward the ceiling and squeeze your glute.
Lower slowly without arching your back.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: patada lateral con rodilla flexionada (de rodillas)
exercises.d: From all fours, you lift one bent leg out to the side. It works the outer hip and glutes.
i: Start on hands and knees with a flat back.
Keep your knee bent at about 90 degrees.
Lift the bent leg out to the side to hip height.
Squeeze your outer hip at the top without rotating your torso.
Lower under control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: talones al glúteo
exercises.d: A running drill where your heels flick up toward your glutes. It warms up the hamstrings and raises your heart rate.
i: Stand tall with your arms bent at your sides.
Jog on the spot or move forward slowly.
Kick each heel up toward your glute.
Stay on the balls of your feet and keep your knees pointing down.
Pump your arms in rhythm.
Continue for 20-40 seconds.

exercises.n: extensión de tríceps sobre la cabeza con barra en polea alta
exercises.en: cable bar high pulley overhead tricep extension
exercises.d: A cable overhead extension from a high pulley that isolates the triceps.
i: Attach a bar to a high pulley and face away from the machine.
Hold the bar behind your head with elbows pointing forward.
Step forward and stagger your feet.
Extend your arms to press the bar overhead.
Lower slowly back and keep your elbows in place.

exercises.n: abducción de cadera en polea v. 2
exercises.d: Standing hip abduction against a low cable that trains the outer hip and glutes.
i: Attach an ankle cuff to a low pulley and strap it to your outer ankle.
Stand sideways to the machine and hold a support.
Keep your torso upright and your standing leg slightly bent.
Lift the cuffed leg out to the side.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Finish your reps and switch legs.

exercises.n: curl de bíceps de pie en polea (con cuerda)
exercises.d: A standing cable curl with a rope for constant tension on the biceps.
i: Attach a rope to a low pulley and hold an end in each hand.
Stand tall with elbows by your sides.
Curl the rope up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower under control without swinging.

exercises.n: press con agarre cerrado y mancuernas v. 2
exercises.d: A press with dumbbells held close together that shifts the work toward the triceps and inner chest.
i: Lie on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand pressed together over your chest.
Keep your palms facing each other.
Lower the dumbbells to your chest with your elbows tucked.
Press back up while keeping the weights touching.
Keep your wrists straight.

exercises.n: curl sentado con mancuernas v. 2
exercises.d: A seated curl that keeps the body steady while the biceps do the work.
i: Sit on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang by your sides, palms forward.
Curl the weights up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top and keep elbows pinned.
Lower slowly to full extension.

exercises.n: curl predicador a un brazo con mancuerna
exercises.d: A one-arm curl braced on a preacher pad for strict biceps isolation.
i: Sit at a preacher bench with your upper arm on the pad.
Hold a dumbbell with your palm facing up.
Curl the weight toward your shoulder.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly until nearly straight, then switch arms.

exercises.n: giros de codo a rodilla
exercises.d: A standing move where you twist to bring an elbow toward the opposite knee. It raises your pulse and works the sides of your waist.
i: Stand tall with your hands behind your head.
Lift one knee up and across your body.
Twist your torso to meet the knee with the opposite elbow.
Return to standing.
Alternate sides at a steady pace.
Keep your chest lifted and breathe evenly.

exercises.n: saltos de rana
exercises.d: Explosive hops from a deep squat, like a frog. They build leg power and get your heart pumping.
i: Stand with your feet wider than your shoulders and sink into a deep squat.
Place your fingertips on the floor between your feet.
Jump forward and up, swinging your arms.
Land softly back in the squat.
Reset and hop again right away.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.

exercises.n: saltitos con rodillas altas
exercises.d: A bouncy skip with high knee lifts. It warms up the legs and raises your heart rate.
i: Stand tall and relaxed.
Skip forward, driving one knee up high.
Hop lightly on the other foot.
Swing the opposite arm forward with each knee.
Alternate legs in a smooth rhythm.
Keep your chest up and land softly.

exercises.n: sentadilla con rodillas altas
exercises.d: A squat followed by a high knee drive as you stand. It combines leg strength with a cardio push.
i: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Squat down with your chest up.
Drive up through your feet to stand.
Lift one knee toward your chest as you reach the top.
Lower the foot and go back into the squat.
Alternate knees on each rep.

exercises.n: salto de tijera (jumping jack)
exercises.d: The classic jump where your arms and legs swing out and back. A simple full-body warm-up that raises your heart rate fast.
i: Stand with your feet together and your arms at your sides.
Jump your feet apart as you swing your arms overhead.
Jump back to the start position.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep a steady rhythm.
Continue for 30-60 seconds.

exercises.n: salto lateral
exercises.d: A sideways leap from one leg to the other. It builds lateral power and balance.
i: Stand on one leg with a slight bend in the knee.
Push off hard to leap sideways.
Land on the opposite foot and bend to absorb the impact.
Hold the landing for a second to stay balanced.
Bound back the other way.
Keep your chest up and your knee over your toes.

exercises.n: remo sentado alternado con agarre cerrado en máquina (con discos)
exercises.en: lever alternating narrow grip seated row (plate loaded)
exercises.d: A plate-loaded seated row with a narrow grip, one arm at a time for balanced back strength.
i: Sit with your chest against the pad and grab the narrow handles.
Pull one handle back, driving your elbow behind you.
Squeeze your shoulder blade at the end.
Return slowly and pull with the other arm.
Alternate sides and keep your torso still.

exercises.n: remo sentado con agarre cerrado en máquina (con discos)
exercises.en: lever narrow grip seated row (plate loaded)
exercises.d: A plate-loaded machine row with a narrow grip for the lats and mid back.
i: Sit with your chest against the pad and take the narrow handles.
Pull both handles toward your torso.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
Pause briefly.
Return slowly with control.

exercises.n: jacks pliométricos
exercises.d: A jumping jack with a squat landing. The extra depth makes it harder on the legs and your heart.
i: Stand with your feet together.
Jump your feet wide and land in a quarter squat.
Swing your arms out as you land.
Jump your feet back together.
Land softly each time.
Keep a quick, controlled pace.

exercises.n: patinador
exercises.d: A side-to-side leap like a speed skater. It trains leg power, balance and stamina.
i: Stand on one leg with a slight bend in the knee.
Leap sideways to the other leg.
Land softly and sweep the back leg behind you.
Swing your arms across your body for balance.
Immediately bound back the other way.
Keep your hips low and your chest forward.

exercises.n: empuje de cadera en smith
exercises.d: A hip thrust with the bar on a Smith machine, giving a steady path to load the glutes.
i: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and the Smith bar over your hips.
Pad the bar and roll it into the crease of your hips.
Plant your feet hip width apart and unrack the bar.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips until your body is level.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.n: split jacks
exercises.d: A jumping move where your legs split front and back while your arms swing. It's a light, fast cardio burst.
i: Stand tall with your arms at your sides.
Jump one foot forward and the other back as you swing opposite arms.
Land softly with soft knees.
Jump again and switch legs.
Keep your torso upright.
Continue at a steady pace for 30-45 seconds.

exercises.n: patada trasera con pierna recta (de rodillas)
exercises.d: From all fours, you extend one straight leg back and up. It isolates the glutes and hamstrings.
i: Start on hands and knees with a flat back.
Brace your core.
Extend one leg straight back.
Lift it to hip height and squeeze your glute.
Lower without letting your back arch.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: jalón con agarre supino y espalda fija con banda elástica
exercises.d: A band pulldown with an underhand grip from an overhead anchor. Builds the lats and biceps.
i: Sujeta la banda a un punto de anclaje resistente por encima de tu cabeza.
Ponte de pie frente al punto de anclaje con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros.
Agarra la banda con un agarre supino, con las manos un poco más separadas que el ancho de los hombros.
Da un paso atrás para generar tensión en la banda, manteniendo los brazos completamente extendidos.
Activa el core y junta los omóplatos.
Tira de la banda hacia el pecho, guiando el movimiento con los codos.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte inferior del movimiento, sintiendo la contracción en los dorsales.
Suelta lentamente la tensión de la banda y regresa a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: jalón con agarre cerrado y espalda fija con banda elástica
exercises.en: band fixed back close grip pulldown
exercises.d: A band pulldown with a close grip from an overhead anchor. Builds the lats and biceps.
i: Sujeta la banda a un punto fijo por encima de ti, como una barra de dominadas o una viga resistente.
Siéntate en un banco o silla frente a la banda, con los pies apoyados en el suelo y las rodillas flexionadas.
Agarra la banda con un agarre cerrado, con las palmas hacia ti.
Mantén la espalda recta y activa el core.
Tira de la banda hacia el pecho, juntando los omóplatos.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte inferior del movimiento, sintiendo la contracción en los dorsales.
Suelta lentamente la banda de vuelta a la posición inicial, manteniendo el control durante todo el movimiento.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: sentadilla profunda (potty squat)
exercises.d: A bodyweight squat done as a deep, comfortable squat. Works the legs, glutes and core.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros, los dedos de los pies ligeramente hacia afuera.
Baja el cuerpo flexionando las rodillas y empujando las caderas hacia atrás como si te sentaras en una silla.
Mantén el pecho hacia arriba y la espalda recta durante todo el movimiento.
Baja hasta que los muslos queden paralelos al suelo o hasta donde puedas llegar cómodamente.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte inferior, luego empuja con los talones para regresar a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: elevación de gemelos de pie con apoyo
exercises.d: A calf raise holding on for balance, so you can focus on the calves.
i: Stand holding a wall or rail for balance.
Place your feet hip-width apart.
Rise up on your toes as high as you can.
Pause and squeeze your calves.
Lower slowly.

exercises.n: remo sentado con espalda recta y banda elástica
exercises.d: A seated row with a band and a straight back that trains the lats and mid back.
i: Sit on the floor with legs extended and a band around your feet.
Hold the ends with your arms straight.
Sit tall with a flat back.
Pull the band toward your waist, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Return slowly.

exercises.n: press de hombros sentado con banda elástica
exercises.d: A seated shoulder press using a resistance band. Builds the shoulders and triceps.
i: Siéntate en una silla o banco con la espalda recta y los pies apoyados en el suelo.
Sostén la banda elástica con ambas manos, con las palmas hacia adelante, y elévala hasta la altura de los hombros.
Empuja la banda por encima de la cabeza, extendiendo completamente los brazos.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte alta y luego baja lentamente la banda hasta la altura de los hombros.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: curl de bíceps sentado con banda elástica
exercises.d: A seated biceps curl using a resistance band. Builds the biceps.
i: Siéntate en una silla o banco con la espalda recta y los pies apoyados en el suelo.
Sostén la banda elástica con un agarre supino, con las palmas hacia arriba y los brazos extendidos a los lados del cuerpo.
Manteniendo la parte superior de los brazos inmóvil, exhala y flexiona la banda elástica hacia los hombros.
Haz una pausa breve en la parte alta, apretando los bíceps.
Inhala y baja lentamente la banda elástica de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: press de pecho sentado con banda elástica
exercises.d: A seated chest press using a resistance band. Builds the chest, shoulders and triceps.
i: Siéntate en una silla o banco con la espalda recta y los pies apoyados en el suelo.
Sostén las asas de la banda elástica en cada mano, con las palmas hacia abajo y los codos flexionados en un ángulo de 90 grados.
Extiende los brazos hacia adelante, alejando la banda elástica de tu pecho.
Haz una pausa por un momento al final del movimiento, luego regresa lentamente a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: rotación externa del pie con banda elástica
exercises.d: A seated ankle drill where you turn the foot outward against a band. It strengthens the outer ankle muscles.
i: Sit with one leg out and a band looped around the forefoot.
Anchor the other end to a fixed point on the inside.
Keep your heel still on the floor.
Turn your foot outward against the band.
Return slowly to the start.
Complete your reps, then switch feet.

exercises.n: flexión plantar del pie con banda elástica
exercises.d: Pointing the foot against a band to strengthen the calf and ankle.
i: Sit with your leg straight and a band looped around the ball of your foot.
Hold the band ends in your hands.
Point your toes away from you against the band.
Pause at the end of the range.
Return slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch feet.

exercises.n: eversión del pie con banda elástica
exercises.d: Turning the sole of the foot outward against a band to train the muscles on the outer side of the ankle.
i: Sit with your leg extended and a band around your forefoot.
Anchor the band on the inside of your foot.
Keep your leg still.
Turn the sole of your foot outward against the band.
Return slowly.
Complete your reps, then switch feet.

exercises.n: inversión del pie con banda elástica
exercises.d: Turning the sole of the foot inward against a band to train the muscles on the inner side of the ankle.
i: Sit with your leg extended and a band around your forefoot.
Anchor the band on the outside of your foot.
Keep your leg still.
Turn the sole of your foot inward against the band.
Return slowly.
Complete your reps, then switch feet.

exercises.n: retracción y protracción de escápulas
exercises.d: A shoulder blade drill where you pull the blades together and then spread them apart. It improves control of the scapulae.
i: Stand or sit tall with your arms forward at shoulder height.
Pull your shoulder blades together behind you.
Hold for a moment.
Then push your hands forward and let the blades spread apart.
Move slowly between the two positions.
Keep your neck relaxed and your ribs down.

exercises.n: elevación y depresión de escápulas
exercises.d: A drill where you shrug your shoulders up and then press them down. It builds control of the shoulder blades.
i: Stand or sit tall with your arms at your sides.
Shrug your shoulders up toward your ears.
Hold for a second.
Press your shoulders down away from your ears.
Move slowly through the full range.
Keep your arms relaxed and your head still.

exercises.n: sentadilla profunda con apoyo
exercises.d: A deep squat done holding a support for balance. Works the glutes and legs.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros, los dedos de los pies ligeramente hacia afuera.
Sujétate de un apoyo estable, como una silla o una pared, para mantener el equilibrio.
Baja el cuerpo hacia una posición de sentadilla flexionando las rodillas y empujando las caderas hacia atrás.
Mantén el pecho hacia arriba y la espalda recta durante todo el movimiento.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte inferior, luego empuja con los talones para regresar a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: bird dog v. 2
exercises.d: A floor stability move reaching opposite arm and leg to train the back and core.
i: Start on all fours with a neutral spine.
Extend one arm forward and the opposite leg back.
Keep your hips level and avoid arching your back.
Pause for a moment.
Return and switch sides.

exercises.n: sentadilla sumo en Smith
exercises.d: A sumo squat on a smith machine. Targets the glutes, inner thighs and quads.
i: Configura la máquina Smith con la barra a la altura de la cadera.
Ponte de pie con los pies más separados que el ancho de los hombros, con las puntas de los pies hacia afuera.
Colócate debajo de la barra, apoyándola sobre la parte superior de la espalda y los hombros.
Activa el core y mantén el pecho elevado mientras bajas el cuerpo hacia una posición de sentadilla, empujando las caderas hacia atrás y flexionando las rodillas.
Baja hasta que los muslos queden paralelos al suelo, o tan abajo como puedas hacerlo cómodamente.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte inferior, luego empuja con los talones para regresar a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: remo sentado con espalda recta y banda elástica
exercises.en: resistance band seated straight back row
exercises.d: A seated straight-back row using a resistance band. Builds the upper back and lats.
i: Siéntate en el suelo con las piernas extendidas y enrolla la banda elástica alrededor de los pies.
Sostén los extremos de la banda elástica con las manos, con las palmas enfrentadas.
Mantén la espalda recta e inclínate ligeramente hacia atrás, activando el core.
Tira de la banda elástica hacia el pecho, juntando las escápulas.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte superior, luego suelta lentamente la tensión y regresa a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: flexión plus
exercises.d: A push-up finished with an extra shove that spreads the shoulder blades at the top. It trains the chest and the serratus muscles that stabilise the shoulder blades.
i: Comienza en una posición de plancha alta con las manos un poco más separadas que la anchura de los hombros y el cuerpo en línea recta desde la cabeza hasta los talones.
Baja el cuerpo hacia el suelo flexionando los codos, manteniéndolos cerca de los costados.
Cuando el pecho esté justo por encima del suelo, empuja con las manos para extender los brazos y levantar la parte superior del cuerpo.
En la parte alta del movimiento, separa las escápulas empujando la parte superior de la espalda hacia el techo.
Haz una pausa por un momento y luego invierte el movimiento juntando las escápulas y bajando el cuerpo de nuevo a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: inclinación pélvica
exercises.d: A small rocking movement of the pelvis while lying on your back. It wakes up the abs and teaches you to control the position of your lower back.
i: Túmbate sobre tu espalda con las rodillas flexionadas y los pies apoyados en el suelo.
Coloca las manos a los lados del cuerpo.
Activa el abdomen e inclina la pelvis hacia arriba, presionando la zona lumbar contra el suelo.
Mantén esta posición durante unos segundos, concentrándote en contraer el abdomen.
Deshaz la inclinación y vuelve a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: retracción de mentón
exercises.d: Drawing your chin straight back to line up your head over your shoulders. It's a simple neck posture exercise.
i: Sit or stand tall with your eyes level.
Place a finger on your chin if it helps.
Draw your chin straight back as if making a double chin.
Keep your head level without tilting.
Hold for 3-5 seconds.
Release and repeat 8-10 times.

exercises.n: retracción de mentón asistida
exercises.d: A chin tuck with light help from your hand to guide the movement and feel the right position.
i: Sit or stand tall with your eyes level.
Place two fingers on your chin.
Gently guide your chin straight back.
Keep your head level and your shoulders relaxed.
Hold for 3-5 seconds.
Release and repeat 8-10 times.

exercises.n: burpee con patada lateral
exercises.d: A burpee that finishes with a side kick. It's a tough full-body conditioning move.
i: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Drop your hands to the floor and jump your feet back to a plank.
Do a push-up, then jump your feet back in.
Stand up and kick one leg out to the side.
Land and go straight into the next rep.
Alternate kicking sides.

exercises.n: remo de pie con agarre cerrado a un brazo y peso corporal
exercises.en: bodyweight standing close-grip one arm row
exercises.d: A standing, bent-over one arm row with a close grip, working the muscles between and around the shoulder blades. A light handheld weight keeps the pull honest.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros, las rodillas ligeramente flexionadas, y sujeta una mancuerna en una mano con agarre neutro.
Inclínate hacia adelante desde las caderas, manteniendo la espalda recta y el core activado.
Tira de la mancuerna hacia el pecho, manteniendo el codo cerca del cuerpo y juntando los omóplatos.
Haz una pausa breve en la parte más alta, luego baja lentamente la mancuerna de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado, luego cambia de lado.

exercises.n: remo de pie con agarre cerrado y peso corporal
exercises.d: A bent-over standing row with a close grip, pulling the hands toward your body. It builds the upper back and the muscles that squeeze the shoulder blades together.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros y las rodillas ligeramente flexionadas.
Inclínate hacia adelante desde la cintura, manteniendo la espalda recta y el core activado.
Extiende los brazos rectos frente a ti, sujetando la barra o las agarraderas con un agarre cerrado.
Tira de la barra o las agarraderas hacia el cuerpo, juntando los omóplatos.
Haz una pausa breve en la parte más alta del movimiento, luego suelta lentamente y vuelve a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: remo de pie a un brazo con toalla y peso corporal
exercises.en: bodyweight standing one arm row (with towel)
exercises.d: A standing one arm row using a towel as the handle, pulled toward the chest. It trains the upper back with very little equipment.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros, las rodillas ligeramente flexionadas, y sujeta una toalla con una mano.
Inclínate hacia adelante desde las caderas, manteniendo la espalda recta y el core activado.
Tira de la toalla hacia el pecho, juntando los omóplatos.
Haz una pausa breve en la parte más alta, luego baja lentamente la toalla de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado, luego cambia al otro brazo.

exercises.n: remo de pie a un brazo con peso corporal
exercises.d: A standing one arm row from a hip hinge, pulling a weight toward your chest one side at a time. Good for the upper back and lats.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros, las rodillas ligeramente flexionadas, y sujeta una mancuerna con una mano.
Inclínate hacia adelante desde las caderas, manteniendo la espalda recta y el core activado.
Deja que la mancuerna cuelgue recta frente a ti, con el brazo completamente extendido.
Tira de la mancuerna hacia el pecho, manteniendo el codo cerca del cuerpo.
Junta los omóplatos en la parte superior del movimiento.
Baja la mancuerna de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado, luego cambia de lado.

exercises.n: remo de pie con toalla y peso corporal
exercises.d: A standing row done with both hands on a towel, pulling toward your chest. It trains the upper back and shoulder blade squeeze with no gear.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros y sujeta una toalla frente a ti con ambas manos.
Flexiona ligeramente las rodillas e inclínate hacia adelante desde las caderas, manteniendo la espalda recta.
Tira de la toalla hacia el pecho, juntando los omóplatos.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte superior, luego suelta lentamente la tensión y regresa a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: remo de pie con peso corporal
exercises.d: A standing, bent-over row pulling a bar or handles toward your body with an overhand grip. It builds the upper back and the muscles that retract the shoulder blades.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros y las rodillas ligeramente flexionadas.
Sujeta una barra o las agarraderas con agarre prono, palmas hacia abajo.
Mantén la espalda recta y el core activado.
Tira de la barra o las agarraderas hacia el cuerpo, juntando los omóplatos.
Haz una pausa breve en la parte alta del movimiento.
Suelta lentamente y extiende los brazos de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: remo en sentadilla con toalla y peso corporal
exercises.d: A squat combined with a towel row, so legs and upper back work together. You pull the towel toward your chest as you sink down.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros, sujetando una toalla frente a ti con las palmas hacia abajo.
Flexiona las rodillas y baja el cuerpo hacia una posición de sentadilla, manteniendo la espalda recta y el pecho elevado.
Mientras bajas a la sentadilla, tira simultáneamente de la toalla hacia el pecho, juntando los omóplatos.
Haz una pausa breve en la parte más baja de la sentadilla, luego vuelve lentamente a la posición inicial mientras extiendes los brazos.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: remo en sentadilla con peso corporal
exercises.d: A squat paired with a pulling motion on a sturdy anchor or suspension trainer. It trains the legs and upper back in one flowing movement.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros, sujetando un objeto resistente o un entrenador de suspensión con los brazos extendidos.
Baja el cuerpo hacia una posición de sentadilla, manteniendo la espalda recta y las rodillas detrás de las puntas de los pies.
Desde la posición de sentadilla, tira del cuerpo hacia arriba en dirección al objeto o al entrenador de suspensión, juntando los omóplatos.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte superior, luego baja lentamente el cuerpo de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: gancho derecho de boxeo
exercises.d: A right-handed hook punch thrown in a boxing stance. It trains rotation and power from the hips.
i: Stand in a boxing stance with your hands up.
Bend your right elbow to about 90 degrees.
Pivot on your back foot and rotate your hips and torso.
Swing your fist in an arc to your target.
Snap back to guard position.
Keep your chin tucked and your left hand up.

exercises.n: press de banca con barra (rodillas a 90 grados)
exercises.d: A bench press with your feet up and your knees bent to 90 degrees. This keeps your lower back flat and your trunk working.
i: Lie on a bench and lift your feet with your knees bent to 90 degrees.
Grip the bar slightly wider than your shoulders.
Unrack and hold it over your chest.
Lower the bar to your mid chest with control.
Press it back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your lower back flat on the bench.

exercises.n: apertura con mancuernas (rodillas a 90 grados)
exercises.d: A dumbbell fly with your feet lifted and knees at 90 degrees. It stretches the chest and keeps your back flat.
i: Lie on a bench holding dumbbells above your chest.
Lift your feet so your knees are bent to 90 degrees.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Open your arms out wide until you feel a chest stretch.
Bring the dumbbells back together over your chest.
Move slowly and keep your back flat.

exercises.n: pullover con brazos rectos y mancuerna (rodillas a 90 grados)
exercises.en: dumbbell straight arm pullover (knees at 90 degrees)
exercises.d: A straight-arm pullover with knees bent to 90 degrees on a bench. It works the chest and lats and keeps the trunk braced.
i: Lie on a bench with your feet up and knees at 90 degrees.
Hold one dumbbell with both hands above your chest.
Keep your arms nearly straight.
Lower the dumbbell in an arc behind your head.
Pull it back over your chest.
Keep your ribs down and your back flat.

exercises.n: hiperextensión inversa con balón de estabilidad (fuera de un banco)
exercises.en: stability ball reverse hyperextension (off a bench)
exercises.d: A reverse hyperextension over a ball at the edge of a bench for glutes and lower back.
i: Lie face down with your hips over the ball and hands on the floor.
Hold the bench or the ball for stability.
Lift your legs until they are in line with your body.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower with control.

exercises.n: hiperextensión inversa inclinada
exercises.d: A reverse hyperextension on an incline bench that trains the glutes and lower back.
i: Lie face down on an incline bench with hips at the edge.
Hold the sides of the bench.
Raise both legs until they are in line with your torso.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.n: frog pump con peso corporal
exercises.d: A glute bridge with the soles of your feet together, taking glute work to the next level.
i: Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together and knees dropped open.
Bring your heels close to your hips.
Drive your hips up by squeezing your glutes.
Pause at the top.
Lower and repeat in quick pumps.

exercises.n: frog pump con peso
exercises.d: A frog-style glute bridge with extra weight on your hips for stronger glutes.
i: Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together and knees open.
Rest a weight on your hips.
Drive your hips up by squeezing your glutes.
Pause at the top.
Lower and repeat.

exercises.n: cargada colgado por debajo de las rodillas con barra v. 2
exercises.en: barbell hang clean below the knees v. 2
exercises.d: A clean started with the bar hanging below the knees. It builds explosive hip power.
i: Stand with the bar hanging below your knees in an overhand grip.
Hinge back with a flat back and shoulders over the bar.
Drive your hips forward and jump explosively.
Shrug and pull your elbows high.
Drop under the bar and catch it on your shoulders.
Stand tall, then lower the bar under control.

exercises.n: sentadilla con barra (con técnica de banda colgante)
exercises.d: A barbell squat with bands hanging weights from the bar. The wobble forces you to stay stable.
i: Set up the bar with bands hanging kettlebells or weights from each end.
Rest the bar across your upper back and step out.
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Squat down with a braced core.
Drive up through your feet.
Use a lighter load and move slowly.

exercises.n: press de banca con barra (con técnica de banda colgante)
exercises.en: barbell bench press (with hanging band technique)
exercises.d: A bench press with bands hanging weights from the bar. The shaky load trains control and stability.
i: Hang weights from each end of the bar with bands.
Lie on the bench and unrack the bar.
Hold it over your chest.
Lower the bar slowly to your mid chest.
Press up and keep the bar steady.
Use a lighter load than a normal bench press.

exercises.n: press militar con barra (con técnica de banda colgante)
exercises.en: barbell military press (with hanging band technique)
exercises.d: An overhead press with bands hanging weights from the bar. The unstable load trains control in the shoulders.
i: Hang weights from each end of the bar with bands.
Hold the bar at your shoulders and stand tall.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Press the bar straight overhead.
Lower it slowly back to your shoulders.
Use a lighter load and keep the bar steady.

exercises.n: salto de sentadilla goblet con kettlebell
exercises.d: A goblet squat that finishes with an explosive jump for leg power.
i: Hold a kettlebell at your chest with both hands.
Squat down with your chest tall.
Explode upward into a jump.
Land softly with bent knees.
Reset and go into the next squat.

exercises.n: pullover con brazos rectos y mancuerna (con técnica de banda colgante)
exercises.en: dumbbell straight arm pullover (with hanging band technique)
exercises.d: A straight-arm pullover with weights hung from the dumbbell by a band. The swing makes your shoulders and trunk work harder.
i: Hang a weight from the dumbbell with a band.
Lie on a bench and hold it above your chest with straight arms.
Lower it in an arc behind your head.
Pull it back over your chest slowly.
Keep your ribs down and your core tight.
Use a light load to stay controlled.

exercises.n: elevación glúteo-femoral
exercises.d: A hamstring exercise where you lift your torso from a face-down position on a glute-ham bench. It strengthens the hamstrings, glutes and lower back.
i: Ajusta la máquina de extensión de glúteos e isquiotibiales para que se adapte a tu cuerpo.
Colócate boca abajo en la máquina con los tobillos asegurados.
Coloca las manos sobre el pecho o crúzalas sobre el pecho.
Activa los isquiotibiales y los glúteos para levantar la parte superior del cuerpo hacia el techo.
Continúa levantando hasta que el cuerpo forme una línea recta desde la cabeza hasta los talones.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte superior, luego baja lentamente el cuerpo de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: sentadilla Frankenstein con barra
exercises.d: A front-loaded barbell squat held out in front of the body with straight arms. It hits the glutes and quads and demands a tall, braced torso.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros y sostén la barra frente al cuerpo con los brazos rectos.
Manteniendo la espalda recta, baja el cuerpo flexionando las rodillas y las caderas, como si fueras a sentarte en una silla.
Continúa bajando hasta que los muslos queden paralelos al suelo, o tan abajo como puedas hacerlo cómodamente.
Haz una pausa breve y luego empuja con los talones para volver a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: curl femoral 2-1 acostado en máquina
exercises.d: A lying machine leg curl that starts with both legs and finishes with one. It targets the hamstrings with a controlled, heavier lowering phase.
i: Ajusta la máquina a tu cuerpo y siéntate en ella con la espalda apoyada en el respaldo.
Coloca las piernas sobre la almohadilla de la palanca, justo encima de los tobillos.
Sujeta las asas a los lados de la máquina para mayor apoyo.
Manteniendo la parte superior del cuerpo inmóvil, exhala y flexiona las piernas hacia los glúteos.
Haz una pausa breve en lo alto, luego inhala y baja lentamente las piernas de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: carrera de pies rápidos
exercises.d: Running on the spot with very fast, small steps. It's a classic warm-up and speed drill.
i: Stand tall with your knees slightly bent.
Run on the spot as fast as you can with small steps.
Stay on the balls of your feet.
Pump your arms.
Keep your chest up.
Continue for 20-30 seconds.

exercises.n: trote elevado
exercises.d: A light, springy trot with high knees, like a pony. It's a fun cardio warm-up.
i: Stand tall and relaxed.
Move forward in a bouncy trot.
Lift each knee up with a springy step.
Stay on the balls of your feet.
Swing your arms in rhythm.
Continue for 30-60 seconds.

exercises.n: saltos en zigzag
exercises.d: Hopping diagonally forward in a zigzag pattern. It trains agility and lower leg power.
i: Stand with your knees slightly bent.
Hop forward and to one side.
Land softly on both feet.
Hop forward and to the other side.
Keep your hops light and quick.
Continue for 20-30 seconds.

exercises.n: skips
exercises.d: A simple skipping step with a hop on each foot. A playful way to warm up and lift your heart rate.
i: Stand tall and relaxed.
Step forward and hop on the same foot.
Switch and hop on the other foot.
Swing the opposite arm forward with each step.
Stay light on the balls of your feet.
Keep a steady rhythm.

exercises.n: remo inclinado con barra V en máquina
exercises.d: A machine row done in a bent-over stance with a v-bar handle. It builds the upper back and lats by pulling the handle toward your abdomen.
i: Ajusta la altura del asiento y colócate frente a la máquina.
Sujeta la barra en V con un agarre prono, manteniendo la espalda recta y las rodillas ligeramente flexionadas.
Tira de la barra en V hacia el abdomen, juntando los omóplatos.
Haz una pausa breve en la parte alta del movimiento, luego suelta lentamente el peso de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: abdominal de un cuarto
exercises.d: A short-range sit-up where you curl only partway up. It keeps tension on the abs and is easier on the lower back than a full sit-up.
i: Túmbate sobre tu espalda con las rodillas flexionadas y los pies apoyados en el suelo.
Coloca las manos detrás de la cabeza con los codos apuntando hacia afuera.
Activando el abdomen, levanta lentamente la parte superior del cuerpo del suelo, curvándote hacia adelante hasta que tu torso forme un ángulo de 45 grados.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte superior, luego baja lentamente la parte superior del cuerpo de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: medio abdominal (masculino)
exercises.d: A sit-up that stops at roughly half height, keeping constant tension on the abs. A gentle way to train the midsection.
i: Túmbate sobre tu espalda con las rodillas flexionadas y los pies apoyados en el suelo.
Coloca las manos detrás de la cabeza con los codos apuntando hacia afuera.
Activando el abdomen, levanta lentamente la parte superior del cuerpo del suelo, curvándote hacia adelante hasta que tu torso forme un ángulo de 45 grados.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte superior, luego baja lentamente la parte superior del cuerpo de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: medio abdominal estilo prisionero (masculino)
exercises.d: A half sit-up with the hands held behind the head, like a prisoner. It trains the abs through a short, controlled range.
i: Túmbate sobre tu espalda con las rodillas flexionadas y los pies apoyados en el suelo.
Coloca las manos detrás de la cabeza con los codos apuntando hacia afuera.
Activando el abdomen, levanta lentamente la parte superior del cuerpo del suelo, curvándote hacia adelante hasta que tu torso forme un ángulo de 45 grados.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte superior, luego baja lentamente la parte superior del cuerpo de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: abdominal completo con brazos sobre la cabeza (masculino)
exercises.d: A full sit-up with the arms stretched overhead, which makes the lever longer and the move harder. It trains the abs and hip flexors.
i: Túmbate sobre tu espalda con las rodillas flexionadas y los pies apoyados en el suelo.
Extiende los brazos por encima de la cabeza, manteniéndolos rectos.
Activando el abdomen, levanta lentamente la parte superior del cuerpo del suelo, curvándote hacia adelante hasta que el torso quede erguido.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte superior, luego baja lentamente la parte superior del cuerpo de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: flexiones de rodillas (masculino)
exercises.d: A beginner-friendly push-up with the knees on the floor. It builds chest, shoulder and triceps strength with less load than a standard push-up.
i: Comienza arrodillado en el suelo con las manos separadas a la altura de los hombros, los dedos apuntando hacia adelante.
Extiende las piernas hacia atrás, apoyándote en la punta de los pies, de modo que tu cuerpo forme una línea recta desde la cabeza hasta los talones.
Activa el core y baja el cuerpo hacia el suelo flexionando los codos, manteniéndolos cerca de los costados.
Continúa bajando hasta que el pecho esté justo encima del suelo, luego empuja hacia arriba a la posición inicial enderezando los brazos.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: toque de pies básico (masculino)
exercises.d: A simple standing forward fold to reach your toes. It loosens the hamstrings and lower back and gets the hips moving.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros y los brazos a los costados.
Inclínate hacia adelante desde la cintura, manteniendo la espalda recta y las rodillas ligeramente flexionadas.
Extiende las manos hacia las puntas de los pies, manteniendo las piernas lo más rectas posible.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte inferior, luego regresa lentamente a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: toque de pies de lado a lado (masculino)
exercises.d: A standing side bend where each hand slides down toward the same-side foot in turn. It mobilises the trunk and trains the obliques.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros y los brazos extendidos hacia los lados.
Dobla la cintura hacia la derecha, llevando la mano derecha hacia el pie derecho mientras mantienes la mano izquierda extendida hacia el lado.
Vuelve a la posición inicial y luego dobla la cintura hacia la izquierda, llevando la mano izquierda hacia el pie izquierdo mientras mantienes la mano derecha extendida hacia el lado.
Repite el movimiento de flexión lateral el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: toque de pies en círculo con brazos abiertos (masculino)
exercises.d: A standing toe touch with a circular path and a leg lifting behind you. It loosens the hamstrings and challenges balance.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros y los brazos extendidos hacia los lados.
Manteniendo las piernas rectas, flexiona el torso hacia adelante desde la cintura y lleva la mano derecha hacia los dedos de los pies.
Mientras bajas, levanta simultáneamente la pierna izquierda recta detrás de ti, manteniendo el equilibrio.
Regresa a la posición inicial y repite el movimiento llevando la mano izquierda hacia los dedos de los pies y levantando la pierna derecha detrás de ti.
Continúa alternando lados durante el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: toque de pies en círculo con manos entrelazadas al revés (masculino)
exercises.en: hands reversed clasped circular toe touch (male)
exercises.d: A toe touch with the hands clasped in reverse and moved in a circle. It opens the hamstrings and back while warming up the hips.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros y los brazos extendidos hacia los lados.
Inclínate hacia adelante desde la cintura, manteniendo la espalda recta y las rodillas ligeramente flexionadas.
Extiende las manos hacia abajo y entrelázalas detrás de las piernas.
Sube lentamente las manos en un movimiento circular por encima de la cabeza, manteniendo las piernas rectas.
Continúa el movimiento circular hasta que las manos toquen los dedos de los pies.
Invierte el movimiento y regresa las manos a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: flexión con toque al pecho (masculino)
exercises.d: A push-up where one hand taps the chest at the bottom of each rep, alternating sides. It adds a stability challenge to the chest and triceps.
i: Comienza en posición de plancha alta con las manos un poco más separadas que el ancho de los hombros y el cuerpo en línea recta.
Baja el cuerpo hacia el suelo flexionando los codos, manteniéndolos cerca de los costados.
Mientras te bajas, toca tu pecho con la mano derecha.
Empújate de vuelta hacia arriba hasta la posición inicial.
Repite el movimiento, esta vez tocando tu pecho con la mano izquierda.
Continúa alternando lados durante el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: flexión hindú modificada (masculino)
exercises.d: A modified hindu push-up that flows from a pike through a low dive to a lifted chest. It trains the chest, shoulders and triceps while opening up the spine.
i: Comienza en posición de flexión con las manos un poco más separadas que la anchura de los hombros y los pies separados a la altura de las caderas.
Baja el cuerpo hacia el suelo, flexionando los codos y manteniendo el core activado.
Mientras bajas el cuerpo, desplaza el peso hacia atrás y eleva las caderas hacia el techo, formando una V invertida con tu cuerpo.

Sigue bajando el cuerpo hasta que el pecho quede justo por encima del suelo y luego invierte el movimiento, empujando las caderas hacia abajo y extendiendo los brazos para volver a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: toque de pies en círculo con manos entrelazadas (masculino)
exercises.d: A standing toe touch with the hands clasped and moved in a circular path. It stretches the hamstrings and warms up the hips and back.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros y las manos entrelazadas frente al pecho.
