Flexiona ligeramente las rodillas e inclínate hacia adelante desde las caderas, manteniendo la espalda recta.
Baja las manos hacia los dedos de los pies con un movimiento circular, llegando tan lejos como puedas sin forzar.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte inferior, luego regresa lentamente a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: saltos de tijera (masculino)
exercises.d: A quick jumping drill where the legs cross in front of each other in the air. It raises your heart rate and builds light, springy legs.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros.
Salta del suelo y al mismo tiempo cruza la pierna derecha por delante de la pierna izquierda.
Al aterrizar, cambia rápidamente de pierna, cruzando la pierna izquierda por delante de la pierna derecha.
Continúa alternando las piernas y saltando lo más rápido posible.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: saltos con piernas abiertas (masculino)
exercises.d: A jump from a squat that ends with the legs spread wide, like a jumping jack with a squat start. It raises the heart rate and trains the legs.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros.
Flexiona las rodillas y baja el cuerpo hacia una posición de sentadilla.
Salta explosivamente hacia arriba, extendiendo las piernas y los brazos.
Mientras estás en el aire, separa las piernas y lleva los brazos hacia los lados.
Aterriza suavemente con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros, flexionando las rodillas para absorber el impacto.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: media sentadilla (masculino)
exercises.d: A shallow squat that bends the knees only partway. It is a gentle leg exercise good for warming up or high rep sets.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros.
Dobla las rodillas y baja el cuerpo como si te fueras a sentar en una silla.
Mantén el pecho elevado y el peso en los talones.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte inferior, luego empuja con los talones para regresar a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: salto en media sentadilla (masculino)
exercises.d: A shallow squat followed by a jump, with the arms swinging for momentum. It trains the leg power and gets the heart rate up.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros.
Flexiona las rodillas y baja el cuerpo hacia una posición de sentadilla.
Salta de forma explosiva, extendiendo las caderas y las rodillas mientras balanceas los brazos para generar impulso.
Aterriza suavemente sobre la punta de los pies y pasa de inmediato a la siguiente repetición.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: salto estrella (masculino)
exercises.d: A jump where arms and legs spread wide like a star at the top. It is a full-body cardio move that raises your pulse fast.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros y los brazos a los costados.
Flexiona ligeramente las rodillas y salta hacia arriba de forma explosiva.
Mientras saltas, separa las piernas y extiende los brazos hacia los lados, formando una figura de estrella con tu cuerpo.
Aterriza suavemente sobre la punta de los pies con las rodillas ligeramente flexionadas.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: jumping jack (masculino)
exercises.d: A jumping jack, hopping the feet apart while the arms go overhead and back again. A classic warm-up and cardio move.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies juntos y los brazos a los costados.
Salta, separando los pies y levantando los brazos por encima de la cabeza.
Al aterrizar, salta rápidamente de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: elevación en t en el suelo
exercises.d: Lying face down, you lift your arms out to the sides into a T. It strengthens the mid and upper back.
i: Lie face down with your arms out to the sides in a T.
Keep your forehead near the floor.
Turn your thumbs up toward the ceiling.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together and lift your arms.
Pause for a second.
Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.n: cobra boca abajo con palmas bajo los muslos
exercises.d: A face-down hold where you lift your chest with your palms tucked under your thighs. It builds lower back and upper back endurance.
i: Lie face down with your palms under your thighs.
Keep your neck long and look at the floor.
Lift your chest off the ground using your back muscles.
Squeeze your glutes.
Hold for 15-30 seconds.
Lower slowly and rest.

exercises.n: patadas de nadador
exercises.d: Lying face down, you flutter your legs like a swimmer. It works the lower back and glutes.
i: Lie face down with your arms extended in front.
Lift your chest and legs slightly off the floor.
Kick your legs up and down in small, fast alternations.
Keep your neck long.
Breathe steadily.
Continue for 20-30 seconds.

exercises.n: extensión de espalda acostado
exercises.d: A face-down lift of your chest off the floor. It strengthens the lower back muscles.
i: Lie face down with your hands beside your head.
Keep your legs straight and your feet on the floor.
Lift your chest using your lower back.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your neck in line with your spine.

exercises.n: extensión de espalda acostado con press
exercises.d: A lying back extension where you also press your arms forward at the top. It adds shoulder work to a back extension.
i: Lie face down with your hands near your shoulders.
Lift your chest off the floor.
Press your arms forward in front of you.
Pull them back to your shoulders.
Lower your chest slowly.
Keep your neck long throughout.

exercises.n: cobra boca abajo con manos entrelazadas
exercises.d: A face-down hold with your hands clasped behind you. It trains the back extensors and opens the chest.
i: Lie face down with your hands clasped behind your lower back.
Keep your neck long and look at the floor.
Lift your chest off the floor.
Reach your hands toward your feet.
Hold for 15-30 seconds.
Lower slowly and rest.

exercises.n: toque de dos pies (masculino)
exercises.d: A standing forward bend reaching both hands toward the toes. It loosens the hamstrings and lower back.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros y los brazos extendidos hacia los lados.
Inclínate hacia adelante desde la cintura, manteniendo la espalda recta y las rodillas ligeramente flexionadas.
Estira los brazos hacia la punta de los pies con ambas manos, manteniendo las piernas rectas.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte inferior, luego regresa lentamente a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: remo horizontal de deltoide posterior de pie en polea (con cuerda)
exercises.en: cable standing rear delt horizontal row (with rope)
exercises.d: A standing cable row with a rope that pulls the elbows wide. It targets the rear delts.
i: Attach a rope to a cable at chest height.
Hold the ends and step back.
Stand with your knees slightly bent.
Pull the rope toward your face with your elbows high and wide.
Squeeze your rear shoulders.
Return slowly.

exercises.n: remo sentado con agarre supino en polea
exercises.d: A seated cable row with an underhand grip that brings the biceps and lats into play.
i: Sit at a cable row with your feet braced.
Grip the handle with your palms facing up.
Sit tall with your chest up.
Pull the handle toward your lower ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return slowly without rounding your back.

exercises.n: apertura Hyght con mancuernas
exercises.d: A flat-bench dumbbell fly done with a wide arc and a stretch across the chest. It isolates the pecs.
i: Túmbate boca arriba en un banco con una mancuerna en cada mano, con las palmas enfrentadas entre sí.
Extiende los brazos rectos hacia arriba sobre el pecho, con una ligera flexión en los codos.
Manteniendo una ligera flexión en los codos, baja las mancuernas hacia los lados describiendo un amplio arco hasta sentir un estiramiento en el pecho.
Haz una pausa por un momento, luego invierte el movimiento y lleva las mancuernas de nuevo hacia arriba hasta la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: curl femoral inverso asistido en polea
exercises.d: A cable-resisted leg curl from a face-down position. It isolates the hamstrings with smooth, constant tension.
i: Ajusta la máquina de cable de modo que el accesorio para el tobillo quede en la posición más baja.
Túmbate boca abajo en el banco con las piernas rectas y el accesorio para el tobillo sujeto a los tobillos.
Sujétate de las agarraderas del banco para mantener la estabilidad.
Manteniendo quieta la parte superior del cuerpo, exhala y flexiona las piernas hacia los glúteos doblando las rodillas.
Haz una pausa breve en la parte más alta del movimiento, contrayendo los isquiotibiales.
Inhala y baja lentamente las piernas de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: empuje de caderas de rodillas con banda elástica (femenino)
exercises.en: resistance band hip thrusts on knees (female)
exercises.d: A kneeling hip thrust against a resistance band around the thighs. It trains the glutes with a hip extension.
i: Comienza arrodillándote en el suelo con las rodillas separadas a la altura de las caderas y los pies flexionados.
Envuelve la banda elástica alrededor de los muslos, justo por encima de las rodillas.
Coloca las manos en las caderas o extiéndelas frente a ti para mantener el equilibrio.
Activa los glúteos y los músculos del core.
Empuja las caderas hacia adelante y aprieta los glúteos mientras levantas las rodillas del suelo, extendiendo las caderas hasta que los muslos queden paralelos al suelo.
Mantén la posición por un momento y luego baja lentamente las rodillas de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: elevación lateral con landmine
exercises.d: A raise done with a barbell anchored in a landmine setup, lifting out and up to shoulder height. It works the shoulders with a smooth arc.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros y las rodillas ligeramente flexionadas.
Sujeta la barra con un agarre prono, apoyándola en la parte delantera de los hombros.
Manteniendo el core activado y la espalda recta, levanta la barra alejándola del cuerpo, elevándola hasta la altura del hombro.
Haz una pausa breve en la parte alta y luego baja lentamente la barra de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: plancha de rodillas
exercises.d: A plank held on the knees. It's an easier version that builds core strength.
i: Kneel and place your forearms on the floor under your shoulders.
Lift your hips so your body is in a line from your knees to your head.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Keep your neck neutral.
Hold for 20-45 seconds.
Lower and rest.

exercises.n: plancha de rodillas con toque al hombro (masculino)
exercises.d: A kneeling plank where you tap the opposite shoulder with one hand at a time. It trains the abs and shoulder stability.
i: Comienza en posición de rodillas con las manos en el suelo, separadas a la altura de los hombros.
Extiende las piernas hacia atrás, apoyándote en los dedos de los pies, y levanta el cuerpo a una posición de plancha.
Manteniendo el core activado y las caderas estables, levanta una mano del suelo y toca el hombro opuesto.
Devuelve la mano al suelo y repite con la otra mano.
Continúa alternando lados durante el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: elevación de gemelos en balón contra la pared (pelota de tenis entre rodillas)
exercises.en: exercise ball on the wall calf raise (tennis ball between knees)
exercises.d: A standing calf raise with your back on an exercise ball against a wall, dumbbells in hand, and a ball squeezed between the knees. It trains the calves and inner thighs.
i: Ponte de pie con la espalda contra una pared y coloca un balón de ejercicio entre tu zona lumbar y la pared.
Coloca los pies separados a la altura de los hombros y ligeramente por delante de ti.
Sujeta una mancuerna en cada mano, con los brazos extendidos a los lados.
Coloca una pelota de tenis entre las rodillas.
Levanta los talones del suelo, elevando el cuerpo sobre la punta de los pies.
Haz una pausa breve en la parte alta y luego baja lentamente los talones de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: elevación de gemelos en balón contra la pared (pelota de tenis entre tobillos)
exercises.en: exercise ball on the wall calf raise (tennis ball between ankles)
exercises.d: A standing calf raise with your back on an exercise ball against a wall, dumbbells in hand, and a ball squeezed between the ankles. It trains the calves.
i: Ponte de pie frente a una pared con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros.
Coloca un balón de ejercicio entre la pared y tu zona lumbar.
Sujeta una mancuerna en cada mano, con los brazos extendidos a los lados.
Coloca una pelota de tenis entre los tobillos.
Levanta los talones del suelo, elevando el cuerpo sobre la punta de los pies.
Haz una pausa breve en la parte alta y luego baja lentamente los talones de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: estiramiento de zona lumbar acostado (rodilla flexionada)
exercises.d: A gentle lying stretch that draws the knee toward your chest to ease the lower back.
i: Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Pull one knee toward your chest with both hands.
Keep your lower back relaxed on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.

exercises.n: estiramiento de zona lumbar acostado
exercises.d: A lying stretch hugging both knees toward your chest to release the lower back.
i: Lie on your back.
Pull both knees toward your chest.
Wrap your arms around your shins.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release slowly.

exercises.n: estiramiento abdominal
exercises.d: A stretch lengthening the front of the trunk and the abs.
i: Lie face down with hands under your shoulders.
Press up, lifting your chest.
Keep your hips on the floor.
Look straight ahead and relax.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.

exercises.n: estiramiento de pies y tobillos de lado a lado
exercises.en: feet and ankles side to side stretch
exercises.d: A seated stretch moving the feet side to side to loosen the ankles.
i: Sit with your legs extended.
Keep your heels on the floor.
Roll your feet slowly to the outside.
Then roll them inward.
Continue for 20-30 seconds.

exercises.n: toque de punta de pie frontal
exercises.d: A standing movement reaching down to touch your toes for a warm-up of the hamstrings and back.
i: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Hinge forward and reach toward your toes.
Let your head hang relaxed.
Rise slowly.
Repeat at a steady pace.

exercises.n: toque de ambas puntas de pie frontal
exercises.d: A wider standing toe touch that reaches down with both hands to warm up the legs and back.
i: Stand with feet wide apart.
Hinge forward with both arms reaching down.
Touch the floor or your toes.
Rise slowly.
Repeat for the set.

exercises.n: toque de punta de pie lateral
exercises.d: A standing toe touch with a sideways reach to warm up the obliques and hamstrings.
i: Stand with your feet wide apart.
Reach one hand toward the opposite foot.
Keep your other arm extended behind you.
Rise and switch sides.
Alternate at an easy pace.

exercises.n: toque lateral de ambas puntas de pie frontal
exercises.d: A wide-stance toe touch reaching both hands toward one side to loosen the trunk and legs.
i: Stand with feet wide apart.
Turn your torso slightly to one side.
Reach both hands to the foot on that side.
Rise, then turn to the other side.
Repeat at a steady pace.

exercises.n: flexión lateral de pie
exercises.d: A standing side bend that loosens the trunk and works the obliques.
i: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Raise one arm overhead.
Bend sideways, reaching over to the other side.
Return to upright.
Switch sides and repeat.

exercises.n: flexión lateral doble de pie
exercises.d: A standing side bend with both arms overhead for a longer reach through the trunk.
i: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Clasp your hands overhead.
Bend to one side, keeping your hips still.
Return to the center.
Bend to the other side and repeat.

exercises.n: flexión lateral doble de pie (brazo flexionado)
exercises.d: A standing side bend with your elbows bent that loosens the sides of the trunk.
i: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Place your hands behind your head with elbows out.
Bend to one side without twisting.
Return to the center.
Bend to the other side and repeat.

exercises.n: círculos con un brazo de pie
exercises.d: One-arm circles to warm up the shoulder joint.
i: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart.
Extend one arm out to the side.
Make slow circles, gradually larger.
Reverse the direction.
Switch arms.

exercises.n: círculos con los brazos de pie
exercises.d: Big arm circles with both arms to warm up the shoulders.
i: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart.
Extend both arms out to the sides.
Make slow circles forward.
Then reverse direction.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.

exercises.n: círculos alternados con los brazos de pie
exercises.d: Big alternating arm circles that warm up the shoulder joints and loosen the upper back before pressing or pulling work.
i: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and arms hanging at your sides.
Swing one arm forward, up and back in a large smooth circle.
As that arm finishes, start the same circle with the other arm.
Keep your ribs down and your neck relaxed.
Continue alternating for 20-30 seconds, then reverse the direction.

exercises.n: lanzamiento de brazos de pie
exercises.d: Open and close your arms in a relaxed fling to loosen the chest and shoulders. Handy as a quick warm-up.
i: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart and arms out in front at chest height.
Fling both arms wide open to the sides, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Swing them back across your body, letting one arm cross over the other.
Keep the motion loose and controlled, without arching your back.
Repeat for 15-20 swings.

exercises.n: elevación completa de piernas acostado
exercises.d: Raise both straight legs from the floor to work the lower abs and hip flexors.
i: Lie on your back with legs straight and hands under your hips or by your sides.
Press your lower back gently into the floor.
Lift both legs together until they point at the ceiling.
Lower them slowly, stopping just above the floor.
Keep your legs straight and do not let your back arch.

exercises.n: elevación de pierna en plancha lateral
exercises.d: Hold a side plank and lift the top leg to work the outer hips and the side of your trunk.
i: Lie on your side and prop yourself up on one forearm with elbow under the shoulder.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Raise your top leg to about hip height, toes pointing forward.
Lower it a little without dropping your hips.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: flexión de rodillas a postura del niño
exercises.en: kneeling push up to child pose
exercises.d: A knee push-up that ends by sitting your hips back into child pose, building the chest and giving the back a stretch.
i: Start on your hands and knees with hands slightly wider than your shoulders.
Lower your chest toward the floor, elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press back up to the start.
Push your hips back onto your heels and reach your arms forward into child pose.
Return to the start and repeat.

exercises.n: flexión sobre codos
exercises.d: Move between a forearm plank and a high plank, one arm at a time, to train the core and shoulders.
i: Start in a forearm plank with body in a straight line.
Press up onto one hand, then the other, into a high plank.
Lower back down to your forearms one arm at a time.
Keep your hips steady and avoid rocking side to side.
Alternate which arm leads each rep.

exercises.n: elevación de pierna hacia el lado acostado
exercises.d: Lower your legs to the side from a raised position to hit the lower abs and obliques.
i: Lie on your back with arms out to the sides and legs raised straight up.
Keep your shoulders on the floor.
Lower both legs toward one side, stopping just above the floor.
Bring them back up through the middle.
Repeat to the other side and keep alternating.

exercises.n: carrera y salto
exercises.d: Run in place and add a hop to lift the heart rate and wake up the legs.
i: Stand tall with feet under your hips.
Run on the spot at a steady pace, pumping your arms.
Every few steps, hop off one foot and land softly.
Stay light on the balls of your feet.
Keep going for 30-60 seconds at a pace you can hold.

exercises.n: carrera y salto de tijera
exercises.d: Run in place and throw in a jumping jack every few steps for a full-body cardio burst.
i: Stand tall and start jogging on the spot.
After a few steps, jump your feet wide while raising your arms overhead.
Jump your feet back together and lower the arms.
Resume running and repeat the pattern.
Keep your landings soft and keep going for 30-60 seconds.

exercises.n: carrera y media flexión de rodillas
exercises.d: Alternate running in place with a shallow knee bend to keep the heart rate up while the legs work.
i: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Jog on the spot for a few steps.
Pause into a shallow knee bend, hips back and chest up.
Stand tall and go straight back into running.
Repeat for 30-60 seconds.

exercises.n: carrera y salto de media sentadilla
exercises.d: Combine running in place with a half squat jump for a cardio drill that also trains the legs.
i: Stand tall and run on the spot for a few steps.
Drop into a half squat with your chest up.
Jump up, swinging your arms.
Land softly with bent knees and go back to running.
Repeat for 30-60 seconds.

exercises.n: abdominal en el suelo con pies en banco
exercises.d: A crunch with the calves resting on a bench, which keeps the hips bent and focuses the work on the abs.
i: Lie on your back and rest your lower legs on a bench, knees bent at about 90 degrees.
Place your hands lightly behind your head or across your chest.
Curl your shoulders off the floor by squeezing your abs.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat without pulling on your neck.

exercises.n: abdominal con giro en el suelo con pies en banco
exercises.en: floor twisting crunch feet on bench
exercises.d: A crunch with a rotation, with the legs on a bench, to train the abs and the obliques.
i: Lie on your back with your calves on a bench and knees bent.
Place your hands lightly behind your head.
Curl up and rotate so one shoulder moves toward the opposite knee.
Lower with control.
Alternate sides on each rep.

exercises.n: sentadilla completa en Smith
exercises.d: A full-depth back squat on the smith machine, where the fixed bar path gives extra stability. It trains the glutes, quads and thighs.
i: Configura la máquina Smith con la barra a la altura de los hombros.
Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros, con los dedos de los pies ligeramente hacia afuera.
Colócate debajo de la barra y posiciónala sobre la parte alta de la espalda, apoyándola en los trapecios.
Sujeta la barra con las manos un poco más separadas que el ancho de los hombros.
Suelta la barra del soporte y da un paso atrás, manteniendo una postura estable.
Manteniendo el pecho elevado y el core activado, inicia la sentadilla empujando las caderas hacia atrás y doblando las rodillas.
Baja el cuerpo hasta que los muslos queden paralelos al suelo, o tan abajo como tu flexibilidad lo permita.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la posición baja, luego empuja con los talones para volver a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: abdominal con peso en el suelo con pies en banco
exercises.en: weighted floor crunch feet on bench
exercises.d: A loaded crunch with the calves on a bench, for stronger abs once bodyweight crunches feel easy.
i: Lie on your back with your calves on a bench and knees bent.
Hold a weight plate or dumbbell against your chest.
Curl your shoulders off the floor by tightening your abs.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.n: abdominal con giro y peso en el suelo con pies en banco
exercises.en: weighted floor twisting crunch feet on bench
exercises.d: A loaded twisting crunch with the legs on a bench, building the abs and obliques.
i: Lie on your back with your calves on a bench and knees bent.
Hold a light weight against your chest with both hands.
Curl up and rotate one shoulder toward the opposite knee.
Lower with control.
Alternate sides each rep.

exercises.n: muscle up con peso
exercises.d: A muscle up with added weight, pulling from a hang up and over the bar into a dip position. It is an advanced move for lats, chest and triceps.
i: Comienza colgándote de una barra de dominadas con las palmas mirando hacia afuera y las manos un poco más separadas que la anchura de los hombros.
Activa el core y tira de tu cuerpo hacia arriba, hacia la barra, guiando con el pecho.
Al llegar a la parte alta del movimiento, cambia el agarre de modo que las palmas queden hacia ti.
Continúa subiendo hasta que el pecho llegue a la barra, luego haz una pausa de un momento.
Baja lentamente de nuevo a la posición inicial, manteniendo el control durante todo el movimiento.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: fondos de codos
exercises.d: A bench dip variation that bends the elbows to lower the hips. It trains the triceps and the front of the shoulders.
i: Siéntate en el borde de un banco o silla con las manos sujetando el borde junto a las caderas.
Desliza las caderas hacia adelante, fuera del banco, y estira las piernas, manteniendo los talones en el suelo.
Flexiona los codos y baja el cuerpo hacia el suelo, manteniendo la espalda cerca del banco.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la posición más baja, luego empuja con las manos para enderezar los brazos y levantar el cuerpo de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: fondos coreanos
exercises.d: A deep dip variation performed on parallel bars with a different hand and body position. It trains the chest and triceps.
i: Colócate entre dos barras paralelas con los brazos extendidos sosteniendo el peso de tu cuerpo.
Baja el cuerpo flexionando los codos hasta que los brazos queden paralelos al suelo.
Haz una pausa breve, luego empújate de nuevo hacia arriba a la posición inicial estirando los brazos.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: fondos imposibles
exercises.d: An advanced dip on parallel bars with the legs crossed or lifted. It trains the triceps and chest through a tough range.
i: Colócate entre dos barras paralelas con los brazos completamente extendidos y el cuerpo suspendido en el aire.
Flexiona las rodillas y cruza los tobillos.
Baja el cuerpo flexionando los codos hasta que los brazos queden paralelos al suelo.
Haz una pausa breve, luego empújate de nuevo hacia arriba a la posición inicial estirando los brazos.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: dominada a una mano con peso
exercises.d: An advanced one arm pull-up with added weight. It builds the lats and biceps and needs great pulling strength.
i: Sujeta la barra de dominadas con un agarre prono, un poco más ancho que la altura de los hombros.
Cuélgate de la barra con un brazo completamente extendido y el cuerpo recto.
Activa el core y tira de tu cuerpo hacia arriba en dirección a la barra flexionando el codo y contrayendo los músculos de la espalda.
Continúa subiendo hasta que la barbilla quede por encima de la barra.
Baja el cuerpo de nuevo a la posición inicial con control.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: stalder press
exercises.d: A gymnastics press where you shift your weight over the hands and lift the body up with straight arms. It trains the triceps and shoulders.
i: Comienza de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros y los brazos extendidos por encima de la cabeza.
Flexiona ligeramente las rodillas y activa el core.
Baja el cuerpo a una posición de sentadilla mientras mantienes los brazos extendidos por encima de la cabeza.
Mientras bajas en la sentadilla, empuja los brazos hacia el suelo, activando los tríceps.
Haz una pausa de un momento en la parte baja de la sentadilla, luego empuja con los talones para levantarte mientras al mismo tiempo elevas de nuevo los brazos por encima de la cabeza.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: elevador
exercises.d: A bodyweight hinge forward and back up again with the hands on the hips. It works the upper back and the muscles along the spine.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros y las rodillas ligeramente flexionadas.
Coloca las manos sobre las caderas o crúzalas frente al pecho.
Manteniendo la espalda recta, inclínate lentamente hacia adelante desde la cintura, bajando la parte superior del cuerpo hacia el suelo.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la posición más baja, luego sube lentamente la parte superior del cuerpo de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: dominada arquero
exercises.d: A wide pull-up where you pull toward one hand while the other arm stays straight. It builds lat strength on the way to the one arm pull-up.
i: Comienza colgándote de una barra de dominadas con un agarre prono, un poco más separado que el ancho de los hombros.
Activa el core y lleva los omóplatos hacia abajo y atrás.
Mientras te elevas, flexiona un brazo y lleva el codo hacia el costado, manteniendo el otro brazo recto.
Continúa subiendo hasta que la barbilla quede por encima de la barra y el brazo flexionado esté completamente doblado.
Bájate de nuevo con control, estirando el brazo flexionado y repitiendo el movimiento del otro lado.
Alterna los lados en cada repetición.

exercises.n: flexión arquero
exercises.d: A wide push-up that shifts the weight to one arm while the other arm stays straight. It trains the chest and triceps on the way to one arm push-ups.
i: Comienza en posición de flexión de brazos con las manos un poco más separadas que el ancho de los hombros.
Extiende un brazo hacia el lado, paralelo al suelo.
Baja el cuerpo flexionando los codos, manteniendo la espalda recta y el core activado.
Empuja hacia arriba para volver a la posición inicial.
Repite del otro lado, extendiendo el brazo opuesto hacia el lado.
Continúa alternando lados durante el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: repeticiones de front lever
exercises.d: A rep-based version of the front lever, pulling the body in a horizontal line from a bar. It trains the lats, upper back and core.
i: Cuélgate de una barra de dominadas con agarre prono, palmas hacia afuera.
Activa el core y lleva los omóplatos hacia abajo y atrás.
Manteniendo el cuerpo recto, levanta las piernas hasta que queden paralelas al suelo.
Mantén esta posición todo el tiempo que puedas, intentando llegar a 10-20 segundos.
Baja lentamente las piernas de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: front lever
exercises.d: A gymnastics hold with the body straight and parallel to the ground while hanging from a bar. It trains the abs, lats and upper back.
i: Comienza colgado de una barra de dominadas con agarre prono, manos separadas a la altura de los hombros.
Activa el core y lleva los omóplatos hacia abajo y atrás.
Flexiona las rodillas y llévalas hacia el pecho.
Al mismo tiempo, levanta las piernas y extiéndelas rectas frente a ti, manteniendo el cuerpo paralelo al suelo.
Mantén esta posición todo el tiempo que puedas, intentando lograr una posición completa de palanca frontal.
Para soltar, baja lentamente las piernas y regresa a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: back lever
exercises.d: A gymnastics hold hanging from a bar with the body horizontal and facing down. It trains the upper back, shoulders and core.
i: Comienza colgándote de una barra de dominadas con un agarre prono, con las manos un poco más separadas que el ancho de los hombros.
Activa el core y lleva los omóplatos hacia abajo y atrás.
Flexiona las rodillas y llévalas hacia el pecho.
Levanta lentamente las piernas, manteniéndolas rectas, hasta que el cuerpo quede paralelo al suelo.
Mantén esta posición durante unos segundos, luego baja lentamente las piernas de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: straddle planche (planche abierta)
exercises.d: A planche hold with the legs spread wide, which makes the lever shorter. It trains the shoulders, chest and core.
i: Comienza en posición de flexión con las manos separadas a la altura de los hombros y los pies bien separados.
Activa el core y traslada lentamente tu peso hacia adelante, llevando los hombros por encima de las manos.
Flexiona los codos y baja el cuerpo hacia el suelo, manteniendo los codos cerca de los costados.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la posición más baja, luego empuja con las manos para enderezar los brazos y levantar el cuerpo de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: planche completa
exercises.d: A gymnastics hold where the body is parallel to the floor and balanced on the hands. It builds extreme strength in the shoulders, chest and core.
i: Comienza en posición de flexión de brazos con las manos separadas a la altura de los hombros y los dedos apuntando hacia adelante.
Activa el core y desplaza lentamente el peso hacia adelante, levantando los pies del suelo.
Continúa desplazando el peso hacia adelante hasta que el cuerpo quede paralelo al suelo, equilibrándote sobre las manos.
Mantén esta posición todo el tiempo que puedas, conservando una línea corporal recta.
Baja lentamente los pies de nuevo al suelo y regresa a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: planche inclinada
exercises.d: A leaning plank where the shoulders move forward past the hands. It trains the shoulders, wrists and core on the way to the planche.
i: Comienza en una posición de flexión con las manos separadas a la altura de los hombros y el cuerpo recto.
Activa el core y traslada lentamente el peso hacia adelante, llevando los hombros más allá de las manos.
Mantén los codos ligeramente flexionados y el cuerpo recto mientras te inclinas hacia adelante.
Mantén esta posición durante unos segundos, luego vuelve lentamente a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: planche rana
exercises.d: A planche hold with the knees tucked in toward the arms. It builds shoulder, chest and wrist strength as a stepping stone to the full planche.
i: Comienza en posición de flexión de brazos con las manos separadas a la altura de los hombros y los pies juntos.
Dobla los codos y baja el cuerpo hacia el suelo, manteniendo la espalda recta.
Mientras bajas el cuerpo, levanta los pies del suelo y lleva las rodillas hacia el pecho.
Mantén esta posición durante unos segundos, luego extiende las piernas de nuevo y empújate hacia arriba a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: parada de manos
exercises.d: A balance hold on the hands with the body upside down, usually against a wall to start. It trains the shoulders, triceps and core.
i: Busca un espacio abierto con suficiente espacio para hacer un pino.
Coloca las manos en el suelo separadas a la altura de los hombros, con los dedos apuntando hacia adelante.
Lanza las piernas hacia la pared, usando el core y los hombros para mantener el equilibrio.
Una vez en posición de pino, activa los tríceps para sostener el peso corporal.
Mantén el pino el mayor tiempo posible mientras conserves el equilibrio.
Para bajar, lleva lentamente las piernas de vuelta al suelo.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: bandera
exercises.d: A gymnastics hold where you grip a vertical pole and hold your body out to the side. It trains the obliques, shoulders and lats.
i: Comienza sujetando un poste vertical con ambas manos, palmas una frente a la otra, y los brazos completamente extendidos.
Activa el core y levanta las piernas del suelo, manteniéndolas rectas.
Usando la fuerza del core y de la parte superior del cuerpo, levanta las piernas hasta que queden paralelas al suelo.
Mantén esta posición todo el tiempo que puedas, conservando una línea corporal recta.
Baja lentamente las piernas de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: skin the cat
exercises.d: A ring or bar move where you tuck up, pass the legs through the arms and then roll over the bar. It trains the back and shoulder mobility.
i: Comienza colgándote de una barra con los brazos completamente extendidos y el cuerpo relajado.
Activa el core y levanta las piernas, llevando las rodillas hacia el pecho.
Continúa levantando las piernas por encima de la cabeza, permitiendo que el cuerpo pase entre los brazos.
Una vez que las piernas estén completamente extendidas por encima de la cabeza, comienza a bajarlas de nuevo hacia la posición inicial.
Mientras bajas las piernas, permite que el cuerpo pase de nuevo entre los brazos hasta quedar colgado con los brazos completamente extendidos otra vez.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: thruster con barra
exercises.d: A front squat followed by an overhead press in one fluid movement with a barbell. It trains the legs, shoulders and heart rate.
i: Comienza de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros, sujetando una barra a la altura de los hombros con agarre prono.
Baja a una posición de sentadilla flexionando las rodillas y empujando las caderas hacia atrás.
Al llegar a la parte más baja de la sentadilla, empuja explosivamente con los talones para ponerte de pie, presionando simultáneamente la barra por encima de la cabeza.
Baja la barra de nuevo a la altura de los hombros mientras vuelves a bajar a la posición de sentadilla.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: dedos de fingal (strongman)
exercises.d: A strongman grip challenge based on the legend of Fingal's fingers. It tests hand and forearm strength.
i: Set up the implement in front of you.
Grip it firmly with both hands.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Lift it using your legs and hips.
Hold it steady for a moment.
Lower it under control.

exercises.n: lanzamiento de barril (strongman)
exercises.d: An explosive strongman lift where you heave a heavy keg up and over a bar behind you. It builds hip power and total body drive.
i: Stand with feet wide and the keg between your legs, gripping it low with both hands.
Hinge at the hips, keep your chest up and your back flat.
Drive your hips forward hard and pull the keg up your body.
Extend fully and throw the keg up and back over the bar.
Reset, step back to the start and repeat with control.

exercises.n: peso muerto con peso y barra
exercises.d: A classic deadlift lifting a loaded barbell from the floor to hip height. It trains the whole posterior chain and your grip.
i: Stand with feet hip width apart and the bar over your mid foot.
Hinge down, grip the bar just outside your legs and brace your core.
Push the floor away and keep the bar close as you stand up.
Lock out with hips and knees extended and shoulders back.
Lower the bar along your legs with a flat back to the floor.

exercises.n: sentadilla frontal al pecho con peso y barra
exercises.d: A squat with the barbell racked across the front of your shoulders. The front load keeps you upright and hits the quads hard.
i: Rest the bar on your front shoulders with elbows high and hands steadying it.
Stand with feet shoulder width apart and brace your core.
Sit down between your hips, keeping your chest tall.
Descend until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor.
Drive up through your whole foot and keep your elbows up the whole way.

exercises.n: press de banca con peso y barra
exercises.d: The standard flat bench press with a loaded barbell, the staple lift for chest size and pressing strength.
i: Lie on the bench with eyes under the bar and feet flat on the floor.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width and unrack it over your chest.
Lower the bar under control to your mid chest.
Press it back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your shoulder blades pinched and your feet planted throughout.

exercises.n: sentadilla frontal con barra (desde bloques)
exercises.d: A front squat started from a rack or blocks height, so you begin the rep with the bar already set. It builds quad and trunk strength.
i: Set the bar on the blocks or rack at front shoulder height.
Step in, rest the bar on your front shoulders with elbows high.
Lift it off and stand tall with feet shoulder width apart.
Squat down with a tall chest until your thighs pass parallel.
Stand back up by driving through your feet, then re-rack the bar.

exercises.n: muscle up con peso (en barra)
exercises.d: A weighted muscle up performed with the added load on a bar. An advanced pull and dip that trains the lats, chest and triceps.
i: Comienza colgándote de una barra de dominadas con las palmas mirando hacia afuera y las manos un poco más separadas que la anchura de los hombros.
Activa el core y lleva los omóplatos hacia abajo y atrás.
Flexiona los codos y tira del pecho hacia la barra, manteniendo el cuerpo recto.
Cuando tu pecho llegue a la barra, empuja hacia abajo con las manos y lleva los codos hacia atrás, elevando el cuerpo por encima de la barra.
Haz una pausa en la parte más alta del movimiento, luego baja lentamente de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: fondos con peso en barra recta
exercises.d: A weighted dip on a straight bar or parallel bars. It builds the chest, triceps and shoulders with added resistance.
i: Colócate entre las barras paralelas con los brazos completamente extendidos y el cuerpo recto.
Baja el cuerpo flexionando los codos hasta que los brazos queden paralelos al suelo.
Haz una pausa breve, luego empújate de nuevo hacia arriba a la posición inicial estirando los brazos.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: straddle maltese (maltesa abierta)
exercises.d: A ring hold with the arms out and the legs straddled. It builds the chest and shoulders and is a stepping stone toward the full maltese.
i: Comienza colgándote de un par de anillas con los brazos completamente extendidos y el cuerpo en línea recta.
Separa bien las piernas, formando una posición a horcajadas.
Activa el core y baja lentamente el cuerpo hasta que los brazos queden paralelos al suelo.
Mantén esta posición durante unos segundos, luego empújate de nuevo hacia arriba a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: maltesa completa
exercises.d: An advanced gymnastics hold on rings with the arms out wide and the body straight. It demands huge strength in the chest, shoulders and core.
i: Comienza de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros y los brazos extendidos rectos hacia los lados.
Inclínate lentamente hacia adelante, manteniendo los brazos rectos, hasta que la parte superior del cuerpo quede paralela al suelo.
Activa el core y mantén esta posición durante unos segundos.
Regresa a la posición inicial empujando con los pies y volviendo a ponerte de pie.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: complejo de halterofilia con barra
exercises.d: A flowing series of barbell lifts done back to back without putting the bar down. It works your whole body and your conditioning.
i: Load a light to moderate barbell and stand over it with feet hip width apart.
Perform the first lift of your chosen sequence, such as a deadlift.
Move straight into the next lift without setting the bar down.
Keep each rep crisp with a braced core and a flat back.
Finish all lifts for one round, then lower the bar and rest before repeating.

exercises.n: volteo de coche (strongman)
exercises.d: A strongman event where you lift one side of a heavy vehicle and flip it over. It takes full body strength and leg drive.
i: Squat low at the edge of the vehicle with a flat back and hands underneath.
Brace your core and pull your chest up.
Drive hard through your legs and lift the edge to hip height.
Shift your hands and push up and over with your legs and arms.
Let it roll over fully, then step back and reset for the next flip.

exercises.n: giro 360
exercises.d: A rotating movement that swings the arms and torso in a full circle. It gets the heart rate up and loosens the trunk.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros y las rodillas ligeramente flexionadas.
Mantén los brazos extendidos rectos frente a ti, paralelos al suelo.
Activa el core y mueve los brazos en un movimiento circular, rotando el torso mientras lo haces.
Continúa el movimiento circular, moviendo los brazos y rotando el torso el número de repeticiones deseado.
Recuerda respirar durante todo el ejercicio.

exercises.n: press martillo acostado en el suelo con mancuernas
exercises.en: dumbbell lying on floor hammer press
exercises.d: A floor press with palms facing each other, which is kind to your shoulders. It trains the chest and triceps through a short range.
i: Lie on the floor with knees bent and a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing in.
Start with your upper arms resting on the floor.
Press the dumbbells straight up over your chest.
Pause briefly at the top without locking out hard.
Lower slowly until your triceps touch the floor and repeat.

exercises.n: remo inclinado a dos brazos con agarre martillo en banco y mancuernas
exercises.en: dumbbell hammer grip incline bench two arm row
exercises.d: A chest supported row on an incline bench with a neutral grip. It targets the mid back with little strain on your lower back.
i: Set a bench to a low incline and lie chest down on it with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang with palms facing each other.
Row both dumbbells toward your hips, leading with your elbows.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower slowly to full arm extension and repeat.

exercises.n: apertura posterior con banda elástica
exercises.d: A band version of the reverse fly that works the back of your shoulders and upper back, handy for posture.
i: Hold the band in both hands in front of you with arms straight.
Stand tall with a soft knee bend and your core tight.
Pull your hands apart and out to the sides at shoulder height.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
Return slowly to the start without letting the band snap back.

exercises.n: peso muerto con kettlebell
exercises.d: A beginner friendly deadlift with a kettlebell between your feet. It teaches the hip hinge and builds glutes and hamstrings.
i: Stand with feet hip width apart and the kettlebell between your feet.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to grab the handle with both hands.
Keep your chest up and back flat.
Drive through your feet and stand tall, squeezing your glutes.
Hinge back down to set the kettlebell on the floor and repeat.

exercises.n: media levantada turca con kettlebell
exercises.d: The first half of a turkish get up, moving from lying to a seated position with the kettlebell overhead. It builds shoulder stability and core strength.
i: Lie on your back with a kettlebell pressed up in one hand and the same side knee bent.
Keep your eyes on the bell and your arm vertical.
Roll onto the opposite elbow, then onto your hand.
Come up to a tall seated position with your arm still locked overhead.
Reverse the steps slowly to lie back down, then switch sides.

exercises.n: press de pecho inclinado alternado con giro y banda elástica
exercises.en: band alternate incline chest press with twist
exercises.d: An alternating band press angled upward, with a torso twist added to bring in your core. It works the upper chest and trunk together.
i: Anchor a band low behind you and hold the handles at chest height.
Stand in a split stance with your core braced.
Press one hand up and forward while rotating your torso slightly.
Return under control and press with the other arm.
Keep your hips steady and alternate sides for the full set.

exercises.n: remo bajo alternado con giro y banda elástica
exercises.en: band alternate low row with twist
exercises.d: An alternating band row with a rotation, training your back and the muscles that twist your trunk.
i: Anchor a band in front of you at low height and hold both handles.
Stand in a staggered stance with arms extended.
Pull one handle back toward your hip while rotating your torso.
Squeeze your shoulder blade, then return slowly.
Repeat with the other arm and keep alternating.

exercises.n: jalón al pecho alternado con giro y banda elástica
exercises.en: band alternate lat pulldown with twist
exercises.d: A standing band pulldown done one arm at a time with a trunk twist. It trains your lats and adds core work.
i: Anchor a band high in front of you and hold both handles with arms overhead.
Stand tall in a staggered stance.
Pull one handle down toward your ribs while rotating your torso.
Keep your elbow tucked and shoulder down.
Return slowly and switch to the other arm.

exercises.n: flexión en planche completa
exercises.d: A push-up from the planche position with the feet off the ground. It is an elite bodyweight move for the chest, shoulders and triceps.
i: Comienza en posición de flexión de brazos con las manos un poco más separadas que el ancho de los hombros.
Activa el core y baja el cuerpo hacia el suelo, manteniendo los codos cerca de los costados.
Mientras te bajas, inclina el cuerpo hacia adelante y levanta los pies del suelo, equilibrándote sobre las manos.
Continúa bajando el cuerpo hasta que el pecho quede justo por encima del suelo.
Empuja con las manos y extiende los brazos para volver a subir el cuerpo a la posición inicial.
Mantén una línea recta desde la cabeza hasta los talones durante todo el movimiento.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: complejo de peso muerto con piernas rectas, cargada y paso con barra
exercises.en: barbell complex stiff leg deadlift clean step
exercises.d: A barbell complex that links a stiff leg deadlift into a clean and then a step. It builds posterior chain power and rhythm.
i: Stand holding a light barbell with an overhand grip at thigh height.
Lower the bar down your legs with soft knees and a flat back.
Stand up, then pull the bar explosively and catch it on your shoulders.
Take a controlled step forward with the bar racked.
Step back, lower the bar and begin the next round.

exercises.n: abdominal en banco romano
exercises.d: A sit up on a roman chair that gives you a big range of motion for your abs and hip flexors.
i: Sit on the roman chair with your feet locked under the pads.
Cross your arms over your chest and lean back slightly.
Curl your torso up until your chest nears your thighs.
Pause at the top and keep your neck relaxed.
Lower back slowly under control and repeat.

exercises.n: abdominal oblicuo con elevación de pierna flexionada
exercises.en: oblique crunches with bent knee leg lift
exercises.d: A side crunch combined with a bent knee lift. It trains the obliques and lower abs together.
i: Lie on your back with your hands by your head and knees bent.
Lift your shoulders and knees at the same time.
Twist and bring one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Hold briefly, then lower with control.
Alternate sides through the set.

exercises.n: abdominal oblicuo con elevación de pierna recta
exercises.en: oblique crunches with straight leg lift
exercises.d: A twisting crunch with your legs lifted straight, making your core work harder through the lever.
i: Lie on your back with legs raised straight and hands by your head.
Lift your shoulders off the floor.
Rotate to bring one elbow toward the opposite hip.
Keep your legs steady and low back pressed down.
Return slowly and alternate sides.

exercises.n: abdominal con peso en balón de estabilidad (rango completo)
exercises.d: A crunch over a stability ball while holding a weight, using the ball for a longer range of motion in your abs.
i: Sit on a stability ball and walk your feet out until your back is supported.
Hold a weight against your chest.
Let your torso drape back over the ball for a full stretch.
Curl up until your upper back clears the ball.
Lower slowly back into the stretch and repeat.

exercises.n: press de banca a un brazo con agarre abierto y mancuerna
exercises.en: dumbbell one arm wide grip bench press
exercises.d: A one arm dumbbell bench press with a wide elbow path, stressing the chest while your core resists rotation.
i: Lie on a bench with one dumbbell held over your chest.
Place your free arm on your stomach or out to the side.
Lower the dumbbell with elbow flared out until you feel a chest stretch.
Press it back up over your chest.
Keep your torso square, then switch arms after the set.

exercises.n: apertura en el suelo a un brazo con mancuerna
exercises.d: A one arm fly lying on the floor, a safe way to stretch and load the chest with a limited range.
i: Lie on the floor with knees bent and a dumbbell in one hand over your chest.
Keep a slight bend in your elbow.
Open your arm out to the side until your upper arm touches the floor.
Squeeze your chest to bring the dumbbell back above you.
Finish all reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: puente de glúteos con mancuerna
exercises.d: A loaded hip bridge that targets your glutes. Resting a dumbbell on your hips adds resistance.
i: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Hold a dumbbell across your hips.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips toward the ceiling.
Squeeze your glutes hard at the top.
Lower your hips slowly and repeat.

exercises.n: v up con mancuerna
exercises.d: A v up while holding a dumbbell, raising your arms and legs together to challenge the abs.
i: Lie flat with legs straight and a dumbbell held in both hands overhead.
Brace your core.
Lift your arms and legs together, forming a V shape.
Touch the dumbbell near your shins.
Lower back down slowly without dropping your legs.

exercises.n: puente lateral con mancuerna
exercises.d: A side plank with a dumbbell held on your hip or raised overhead. It trains the obliques and lateral stability.
i: Lie on one side with your elbow under your shoulder and legs stacked.
Hold a dumbbell on your top hip.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds without sagging.
Lower, then repeat on the other side.

exercises.n: peso muerto a una pierna con piernas rectas y mancuerna
exercises.d: A single leg hinge holding a dumbbell, which trains your hamstrings, glutes and balance.
i: Stand on one leg with a dumbbell in the opposite hand or both hands.
Keep a soft bend in your standing knee.
Hinge forward while your free leg extends behind you.
Lower the dumbbell toward the floor with a flat back.
Squeeze your glute to stand back up, then switch legs.

exercises.n: zancada a un brazo con mancuerna
exercises.d: A lunge holding a dumbbell in one hand. The uneven load makes your core work to keep you balanced.
i: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in one hand at your side.
Step forward into a long stride.
Lower your back knee toward the floor, keeping your torso upright.
Push through your front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs and switch the dumbbell hand halfway.

exercises.n: peso muerto con piernas rectas y mancuernas v. 2
exercises.d: A hip hinge with nearly straight legs holding dumbbells. It stretches and strengthens the hamstrings and glutes.
i: Stand with feet hip width apart holding dumbbells in front of your thighs.
Keep your knees slightly bent and back flat.
Push your hips back and slide the dumbbells down your legs.
Stop when you feel a hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.

exercises.n: zancada con mancuernas v. 2
exercises.d: A dumbbell lunge variation for leg strength and balance, working quads and glutes.
i: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step forward into a long stride.
Bend both knees until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and torso upright.
Push back to the start and switch legs.

exercises.n: elevación en y en polea
exercises.d: A cable raise that moves your arms into a Y shape, building the shoulders and the muscles that stabilise your shoulder blades.
i: Set the pulleys low and hold a handle in each hand, arms crossed in front.
Stand tall with a slight lean forward.
Raise both arms up and out into a Y shape.
Keep your thumbs pointing up and shoulders down.
Lower slowly to the start.

exercises.n: elevación lateral en máquina v. 2
exercises.d: A machine lateral raise that isolates the side delts with smooth, guided resistance.
i: Adjust the seat so your shoulders line up with the machine pivots.
Sit tall and place your arms against the pads.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly without letting the weights rest.

exercises.n: cruces en máquina
exercises.d: A machine crossover that brings your arms together across the body, isolating the chest.
i: Set the seat height and grip the handles with a slight elbow bend.
Sit tall with your back against the pad.
Sweep your arms together in front of your chest.
Squeeze your chest at the center.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch.

exercises.n: curl de muñeca con resorte de mano
exercises.d: A wrist curl using a hand grip spring, strengthening your forearms and grip.
i: Sit with a forearm resting on your thigh or a bench, palm up.
Hold the hand spring in that hand.
Squeeze the handles together by curling your wrist and fingers.
Hold briefly at full squeeze.
Release slowly, finish your reps, then switch hands.

exercises.n: curl a press con mancuernas
exercises.d: Curl the dumbbells and keep going into an overhead press, training the arms and shoulders in one smooth rep.
i: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand, palms forward.
Curl both weights up to shoulder height without swinging.
Rotate your wrists slightly and press the weights overhead.
Lower to your shoulders, then back down to your sides.
Brace your core and keep your ribs down.

exercises.n: toque de hombro inclinado
exercises.d: A plank on an incline where you tap each shoulder, building core and shoulder stability.
i: Place your hands on a bench or box and extend into a plank position.
Spread your feet slightly wider for balance.
Lift one hand and tap the opposite shoulder.
Keep your hips level and body in a straight line.
Alternate sides at a steady pace.

exercises.n: sentadilla frontal en polea
exercises.d: A squat with a cable held at your chest, keeping you upright while the quads and glutes work.
i: Set the cable low and hold the handle at your chest.
Step back to create tension and stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Sit down and back into a squat with your chest tall.
Descend until your thighs are parallel.
Drive up through your heels.

exercises.n: zancada lateral en polea
exercises.d: A sideways lunge against cable tension, training glutes, inner thighs and side to side strength.
i: Hold a low cable handle at your chest and stand sideways to the stack.
Step wide to one side and sit back into that hip.
Keep the other leg straight and feet flat.
Push off your bent leg to return to center.
Complete the reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: zancada en polea
exercises.d: A lunge with cable resistance, building leg strength with a constant load.
i: Hold a cable handle at chest height and step away from the stack.
Step forward into a long stride.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your torso upright and front heel down.
Push back to standing and alternate legs.

exercises.n: pull through de rodillas en polea
exercises.d: A kneeling hip hinge with a cable pulled between your legs. It teaches the hinge and trains glutes with little spinal load.
i: Kneel facing away from a low cable with a rope held between your legs.
Sit your hips back with a flat back.
Let the rope pull your hands back between your knees.
Drive your hips forward to a tall kneeling position.
Squeeze your glutes at the top and repeat.

exercises.n: extensión de tríceps a un brazo sobre la cabeza en polea alta
exercises.en: cable one arm high pulley overhead tricep extension
exercises.d: A single arm overhead extension on a high pulley that stretches and loads the long head of the triceps.
i: Face away from a high pulley and hold the handle overhead with one hand.
Stand in a split stance with your elbow pointing up.
Extend your arm forward and up until it is straight.
Keep your upper arm still.
Return slowly and switch arms after the set.

exercises.n: sentadilla frontal en polea v. 2
exercises.d: A second take on the cable front squat, holding the handle at your chest to stay upright and hit the quads.
i: Set the cable low and hold the handle against your chest.
Stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Sit down into a deep squat, chest tall.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Press through your heels back to standing.

exercises.n: zancada lateral en polea v. 2
exercises.d: A second variation of the cable side lunge for the glutes and inner thighs.
i: Hold a cable handle at chest height, standing sideways to the stack.
Step wide to the side and bend that knee.
Push your hips back and keep your chest up.
Push off the bent leg to return.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: zancada hacia delante en polea
exercises.d: A forward stepping lunge with cable tension, working quads and glutes.
i: Hold a low cable handle at your chest and stand facing away from the stack.
Take a big step forward.
Drop your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front knee stable over the ankle.
Push back to the start and switch legs.

exercises.n: remo sentado en el suelo con cuerda en polea
exercises.en: cable seated on floor row with rope
exercises.d: A floor seated cable row using a rope, which lets you pull the hands apart and squeeze the mid back.
i: Sit on the floor facing a low cable with legs extended and the rope in your hands.
Sit tall with a straight back.
Pull the rope toward your lower chest, spreading your hands.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Extend your arms slowly and repeat.

exercises.n: jalón al pecho con agarre paralelo en el suelo en polea
exercises.en: cable parallel grip lat pulldown on floor
exercises.d: A lat pulldown done from the floor with a neutral grip, focusing on the lats.
i: Kneel or sit on the floor under a high cable with a parallel grip handle.
Sit tall and lean back slightly.
Pull the handle down to your upper chest.
Drive your elbows down and back.
Return slowly to full arm extension.

exercises.n: press de pecho de pie en polea
exercises.d: A standing press with cables that trains the chest while your core keeps you steady.
i: Set the cables at chest height and hold a handle in each hand.
Step forward into a split stance.
Press the handles forward until your arms are straight.
Squeeze your chest at the end.
Return slowly with control.

exercises.n: caminata del oso
exercises.d: A crawl on hands and feet with the knees hovering off the floor. It works the shoulders, core and legs together.
i: Comienza apoyado sobre manos y rodillas, con las manos justo debajo de los hombros y las rodillas justo debajo de las caderas.
Levanta las rodillas ligeramente del suelo, manteniendo la espalda plana y el core activado.
Mueve la mano derecha y el pie izquierdo hacia adelante simultáneamente, seguido de la mano izquierda y el pie derecho.
Continúa avanzando a gatas, alternando los movimientos de manos y pies.
Mantén un ritmo constante y el core firme durante todo el ejercicio.
Continúa durante la distancia o el tiempo deseado.

exercises.n: saltos de patinador
exercises.d: A side-to-side hop that mimics a speed skater, landing on one foot at a time. It builds leg power and balance.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros.
Dobla ligeramente las rodillas y salta hacia la derecha, aterrizando sobre el pie derecho.
Al aterrizar, balancea la pierna izquierda detrás de la pierna derecha y toca el suelo con los dedos del pie izquierdo.
Salta inmediatamente hacia la izquierda, aterrizando sobre el pie izquierdo.
Al aterrizar, balancea la pierna derecha detrás de la pierna izquierda y toca el suelo con los dedos del pie derecho.
Continúa alternando los lados, saltando y tocando el suelo con cada pierna.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: press con agarre cerrado acostado en polea
exercises.d: A close grip press lying down with a cable, putting emphasis on the triceps.
i: Lie on a bench with the cable behind your head and hold the handle with a narrow grip.
Start with arms bent over your chest.
Press up until your arms are straight.
Keep your elbows close to your body.
Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.n: press con agarre cerrado de pie en polea
exercises.d: A standing close grip cable press that focuses on the triceps.
i: Set the cable at chest height and hold the handle with a narrow grip.
Stand in a split stance, core tight.
Press forward until your arms are straight.
Keep your elbows tucked in.
Return slowly to the start.

exercises.n: press con agarre cerrado sentado en polea
exercises.d: A seated close grip cable press for the triceps with a stable base.
i: Sit on a bench facing away from a cable at chest height.
Hold the handle with a narrow grip.
Press forward until your arms are straight.
Keep your back against the pad.
Return slowly and repeat.

exercises.n: sentadilla hawaiana
exercises.d: A deep bodyweight squat variation that builds leg strength and hip mobility.
i: Stand with feet slightly wider than your shoulders and toes turned out.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Sit your hips down and back into a deep squat.
Pause at the bottom without rounding your back.
Drive through your feet to stand up.

exercises.n: sentadilla shrimp
exercises.d: A single-leg squat with the back foot held behind you, demanding strong quads and good balance.
i: Stand on one leg and bend the other knee, holding that foot behind you.
Reach your free arm forward for balance.
Lower slowly until the back knee lightly touches the floor.
Drive through the front foot to stand.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: sentadilla patinador
exercises.d: A single-leg squat with the free leg swept behind, like a speed skater, for leg strength and balance.
i: Stand on one leg with the other knee bent and the foot lifted behind you.
Swing your arms forward for balance.
Sit your hips back and lower on the standing leg.
Lightly tap the back knee near the floor.
Stand up through the front foot, then switch legs after your reps.

exercises.n: balanceo con mancuerna
exercises.d: A hip driven swing using a dumbbell, building power in your glutes and hamstrings.
i: Stand with feet wider than hips and hold one dumbbell in both hands.
Hinge at the hips and swing the dumbbell between your legs.
Snap your hips forward to swing it to chest height.
Let your arms stay relaxed.
Guide it back down and hinge into the next rep.

exercises.n: sentadilla con cuerdas de batalla y brazos alternados
exercises.d: Squatting while whipping the battle ropes with alternating arms. It raises your heart rate and works legs and shoulders.
i: Hold one rope end in each hand and stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Sit into a squat position.
Whip the ropes up and down with alternating arms.
Keep your chest tall and your knees stable.
Continue for a set time at a steady pace.

exercises.n: sentadilla con salto y cuerdas de batalla con brazos alternados
exercises.en: battling ropes alternate arms jump squat
exercises.d: A high energy move combining a jump squat with alternating rope waves. It builds power and conditioning.
i: Hold the rope ends and stand in a squat position.
Start waving the ropes with alternating arms.
Jump up explosively and land softly.
Go straight into the next squat.
Keep going for a set time and rest when needed.

exercises.n: cuerdas de batalla con brazos de lado a lado
exercises.en: battling ropes side to side arms
exercises.d: Swinging the ropes from side to side to condition your shoulders and trunk.
i: Hold the rope ends in an athletic stance with knees bent.
Swing both ropes to one side.
Swing them across to the other side in a flowing motion.
Rotate through your torso a little.
Keep a steady rhythm for the set time.

exercises.n: zancada lateral con cuerdas de batalla y brazos alternados
exercises.en: battling ropes alternate arms side lunge
exercises.d: Side lunges while whipping the ropes alternately, working legs, shoulders and heart.
i: Hold the rope ends and stand with feet together.
Step wide to one side and sit into a side lunge.
Whip the ropes alternately with your arms.
Push back to the middle.
Alternate sides and keep the waves going.

exercises.n: círculo hacia dentro con cuerdas de batalla
exercises.d: Drawing circles with the ropes toward each other. It builds shoulder endurance.
i: Stand with knees bent and a rope end in each hand.
Move your arms in circles that turn inward.
Keep the circles even and large.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Continue for a set time then rest.

exercises.n: círculo hacia fuera con cuerdas de batalla
exercises.d: Drawing outward circles with the ropes, training shoulders and conditioning.
i: Stand with knees bent and a rope end in each hand.
Move your arms in circles that turn outward.
Keep the movement smooth and even.
Keep your core tight.
Continue for a set time.

exercises.n: apertura con cuerdas de batalla
exercises.d: Sweeping the ropes out and in like a fly, hitting the shoulders and upper body.
i: Stand with knees bent, a rope end in each hand and arms in front.
Sweep your arms out wide and slightly up.
Bring them back together in front of you.
Keep a steady rhythm.
Continue for a set time.

exercises.n: jumping jack con cuerdas de batalla
exercises.d: A jumping jack with rope waves added, so arms and legs both work hard.
i: Hold the rope ends with feet together.
Jump your feet apart while raising your arms and making waves.
Jump back to the start.
Keep your landings soft.
Keep a steady pace for the set time.

exercises.n: giro ruso con cuerdas de batalla
exercises.d: A seated twist where you swing the ropes side to side. It trains the obliques and conditioning.
i: Sit on the floor with knees bent and lean back slightly.
Hold the rope ends in front of you.
Twist your torso to one side and swing the ropes.
Twist to the other side.
Keep your chest lifted and continue for the set time.

exercises.n: salto dividido con cuerdas de batalla
exercises.d: Jumping lunges while waving the ropes, a demanding mix of power and cardio.
i: Hold the rope ends and stand in a split stance.
Start making waves with your arms.
Jump and switch legs in mid air.
Land softly in a lunge.
Keep switching for the set time.

exercises.n: olas altas con cuerdas de batalla
exercises.d: Big overhead wave style rope slams that fire up the shoulders and heart.
i: Stand with feet shoulder width apart and a rope end in each hand.
Bend your knees slightly.
Raise both arms overhead and slam the ropes down.
Repeat quickly to make big waves.
Keep your core braced for the set time.

exercises.n: olas bajas con cuerdas de batalla
exercises.d: Alternating or double low waves with heavy ropes that spike your heart rate and work the shoulders, arms and core.
i: Hold one rope end in each hand and stand in a quarter squat.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Whip the ropes down and up so waves travel low along the floor.
Keep the waves even and your hips stable.
Work for 20-30 seconds at a hard pace.
Rest, then repeat for several rounds.

exercises.n: remo invertido bajo una mesa
exercises.d: Pull your chest up to the underside of a sturdy table to train the back and arms using your own weight.
i: Lie under a sturdy table and grip the edge with both hands.
Extend your legs with heels on the floor and body in a straight line.
Pull your chest toward the table edge, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower with control until your arms are straight.
Keep your hips up the whole time.

exercises.n: remo invertido con rodillas flexionadas bajo una mesa
exercises.en: inverted row bent knee under table
exercises.d: An easier inverted row with bent knees, pulling up to a sturdy table to build back strength.
i: Lie under a sturdy table and grip the edge with both hands.
Bend your knees and plant your feet on the floor.
Lift your hips so your body forms a line from knees to shoulders.
Pull your chest to the table edge, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.n: flexión pike (en banco) v. 2
exercises.d: A pike push-up with your feet on a bench, loading the shoulders more than a flat push-up does.
i: Place your feet on a bench and your hands on the floor, hips piked high.
Walk your hands back until your body forms an inverted V.
Bend your elbows and lower your head toward the floor.
Keep your elbows at about 45 degrees from your body.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight throughout.

exercises.n: golpe de poder con cuerdas de batalla
exercises.d: An explosive overhead rope slam that builds conditioning and power through the whole body.
i: Hold a rope end in each hand and stand in an athletic stance.
Raise both ropes overhead while rising onto your toes.
Slam them down hard while dropping into a squat.
Keep your back flat and your core braced.
Reset and repeat at a steady, powerful pace.
Work in bursts of 15-30 seconds.

exercises.n: prensa de piernas sentado en máquina v. 2
exercises.d: A seated machine press that loads the thighs and glutes with a stable path.
i: Sit on the machine and set your back firmly against the pad.
Place your feet on the platform about shoulder-width apart.
Release the safety and lower the weight until your knees bend to about 90 degrees.
Press through your whole foot to extend your legs.
Stop just short of locking your knees.
Lower under control and repeat.

exercises.n: extensión de piernas sentado en máquina v. 2
exercises.d: A machine isolation move for the front of the thighs.
i: Sit on the machine with your back against the pad.
Hook your lower shins under the roller and align your knees with the pivot.
Extend your legs until they are nearly straight.
Squeeze your quads briefly at the top.
Lower slowly back to the start.
Avoid swinging or lifting your hips.

exercises.n: fondos entre sillas
exercises.d: Bodyweight dips using two sturdy chairs, working the triceps and chest.
i: Place two sturdy chairs facing each other and brace them against a wall.
Grip the seats, lift your body and straighten your arms.
Lower yourself by bending your elbows until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
Keep your elbows pointing back and your chest up.
Press up to straight arms.
Make sure the chairs cannot slide.

exercises.n: remo invertido entre sillas
exercises.d: A bodyweight row under a sturdy support between two chairs for the upper back and arms.
i: Set a sturdy bar or table edge between two stable chairs and lie under it.
Grip the support with straight arms and your body in a plank line.
Pull your chest toward the support.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your hips up the whole time.

exercises.n: abdominal asistido con silla
exercises.d: A sit-up with your feet or legs supported on a chair to focus on the abs.
i: Lie on your back and rest your lower legs on a chair seat, knees bent.
Cross your arms over your chest or place your hands by your ears.
Curl your torso up toward your knees.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower back down slowly.
Do not pull on your neck.

exercises.n: elevación de gemelos desde déficit con apoyo en silla
exercises.en: calf raise from deficit with chair supported
exercises.d: A calf raise from a raised step with a chair for balance, giving a deeper stretch and fuller range.
i: Stand with the balls of your feet on a step edge, holding a chair for balance.
Let your heels drop below the step to stretch your calves.
Rise as high onto your toes as you can.
Pause for a second at the top.
Lower slowly into the deep stretch.
Keep your knees almost straight.

exercises.n: giro inclinado
exercises.d: A standing bent-over rotation that mobilizes the spine and works the obliques.
i: Stand with feet wide and hinge forward at the hips with a flat back.
Extend your arms out to the sides.
Rotate your torso and reach one hand toward the opposite foot.
Return through the middle and twist to the other side.
Move with control and keep your hips square.
Do 10-12 reps per side.

exercises.n: sentadilla cerrada desde déficit
exercises.d: A close-stance squat with your heels raised on a small step to emphasize the quads.
i: Stand with your heels on a low platform and your feet close together.
Hold your arms in front for balance.
Squat down, keeping your knees over your toes.
Go as deep as comfortable with your chest up.
Drive up through your feet.
Stand tall without locking out hard.

exercises.n: elevación de piernas y cadera en el suelo
exercises.en: lying leg hip raise on floor
exercises.d: A floor leg raise that lifts the hips off the ground for a stronger lower-abs contraction.
i: Lie on your back with arms by your sides or holding something behind your head.
Raise your legs to vertical.
Lift your hips off the floor, pushing your feet toward the ceiling.
Lower your hips slowly.
Lower your legs without arching your back.
Keep movements smooth, not swinging.

exercises.n: marcha de glúteos
exercises.d: A hip-bridge hold with alternating knee lifts that trains glutes and pelvic stability.
i: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Raise one knee toward your chest without letting your hips drop.
Place that foot down and lift the other.
Keep squeezing your glutes the whole time.
Continue alternating for 10-20 marches.

exercises.n: curl de pierna deslizante en el suelo con toalla
exercises.en: sliding leg curl on floor with towel
exercises.d: A hamstring curl where your heels slide on a towel over a smooth floor.
i: Lie on your back with your heels on towels on a smooth floor.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Slide your heels away until your legs are nearly straight.
Pull your heels back toward your hips.
Keep your hips high throughout.
Move slowly to stay in control.

exercises.n: estiramiento de cadera con flexión y extensión
exercises.d: A gentle hip stretch that moves through flexion and extension to loosen the hips and glutes.
i: Lie on your back with your legs extended.
Pull one knee toward your chest with both hands.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Extend the leg again and press it down to the floor.
Repeat on the other leg.
Breathe slowly and stay relaxed.

exercises.n: balanceo completo con mancuerna
exercises.d: A hip-driven swing with a dumbbell, taking the weight from between the legs to overhead.
i: Hold one dumbbell with both hands and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Hinge back and swing the weight between your legs.
Drive your hips forward to swing the dumbbell overhead.
Let it fall back and hinge again.
Keep your back flat and your arms loose.
Control the dumbbell at all times.

exercises.n: zancada con mancuernas en posición frontal
exercises.d: A lunge with dumbbells held at your shoulders, which challenges your legs and trunk.
i: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height.
Step forward into a long stride.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee over your ankle.
Push back to the start.
Alternate legs for each rep.

exercises.n: zancada con barra en posición frontal
