exercises.d: A lunge with the barbell in the front rack, emphasizing quads and an upright torso.
i: Rest the barbell on your front shoulders with elbows high.
Step forward into a long stride.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your chest tall and your core braced.
Push through the front foot to return.
Alternate legs or finish all reps on one side.

exercises.n: cargada y press con mancuernas
exercises.d: A dumbbell clean followed by an overhead press for total-body power.
i: Stand over two dumbbells and grip them with a flat back.
Pull the weights up explosively and catch them at your shoulders.
Dip slightly and drive them overhead.
Lock out your arms.
Lower to your shoulders, then to the floor with control.
Keep the weights close to your body.

exercises.n: flexión pike (entre bancos)
exercises.d: A pike push-up with your feet on one bench and your hands between benches for extra depth.
i: Put your feet on one bench and your hands on the floor or a second bench.
Raise your hips into a pike.
Lower your head between your hands.
Keep elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your core tight.

exercises.n: flexión pike (entre sillas)
exercises.d: A pike push-up with your hands on two chairs so your head can drop lower.
i: Set two sturdy chairs shoulder-width apart and grip them.
Walk your feet back and lift your hips into a pike.
Bend your elbows to lower your head between the chairs.
Keep your back flat and elbows slightly in.
Press back up.
Make sure the chairs are stable.

exercises.n: elevación en y de pie
exercises.d: Raise your arms into a Y shape to strengthen the lower traps and shoulder stabilisers.
i: Stand tall with arms by your sides, thumbs pointing up.
Raise both arms diagonally overhead to form a Y.
Squeeze your shoulder blades down and back.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly.
Keep your neck long and avoid shrugging.

exercises.n: elevación en t de pie
exercises.d: Lift your arms out to the sides into a T shape to train the upper back and rear shoulders.
i: Stand tall with arms in front of you at chest height.
Open your arms out to the sides into a T.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Pause, then return slowly.
Keep your ribs down and avoid leaning back.

exercises.n: elevación en w de pie
exercises.d: Pull your elbows back into a W shape to strengthen the mid-back and rotator cuff.
i: Stand tall with elbows bent and hands in front of your chest.
Pull your elbows back and down, forming a W.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together and rotate your hands outward.
Pause briefly.
Return slowly and repeat.

exercises.n: rotación de la parte baja del cuerpo de pie
exercises.d: A standing trunk rotation at lower body level to loosen the hips and waist.
i: Stand with feet slightly wider than your hips and knees soft.
Hold your hands in front of your waist.
Rotate your hips and trunk to one side.
Return through the centre and rotate to the other side.
Move smoothly for 10-15 reps per side.

exercises.n: rotación de la parte alta del cuerpo de pie
exercises.d: A standing rotation of the upper body that mobilises the thoracic spine and warms up the waist.
i: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hands clasped in front of your chest.
Keep your hips facing forward.
Rotate your upper body to one side as far as is comfortable.
Return through the centre and rotate the other way.
Keep it smooth for 10-15 reps per side.

exercises.n: phelps de pie
exercises.d: Swim-style arm swings that loosen the shoulders and chest as a warm-up.
i: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart.
Swing both arms forward and up in big arcs.
Swing them back down past your hips behind you.
Keep the movement loose and rhythmic.
Continue for 20-30 seconds.

exercises.n: escurrir la toalla de pie
exercises.d: Twist your torso with arms wrapped as if wringing a towel, mobilising the waist and shoulders.
i: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hands clasped in front of you.
Rotate your torso to one side while your hands twist across.
Return to the centre and rotate the other way.
Keep your hips mostly facing forward.
Continue for 10-15 reps per side.

exercises.n: círculo de cadera de pie
exercises.d: Circle your hips to loosen the hip joints and warm up the glutes.
i: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hands on your hips.
Push your hips out to one side, then forward, back and around.
Draw a large smooth circle.
Keep your shoulders still.
Do 10 circles, then reverse direction.

exercises.n: contracción de glúteos acostado
exercises.d: Squeeze your glutes while lying down to activate them before heavier lower body work.
i: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Squeeze your glutes and lift your hips slightly.
Hold the squeeze for 2 seconds.
Lower your hips without relaxing completely.
Repeat for 12-15 reps.

exercises.n: barrido de hombros acostado
exercises.d: Slide your arms along the floor in a wide arc to mobilise the shoulders.
i: Lie on your back with arms straight out to the sides.
Sweep both arms up in an arc toward overhead.
Keep your arms as close to the floor as you comfortably can.
Return along the same path.
Move slowly for 10-12 reps.

exercises.n: rotación de la parte alta del cuerpo acostado
exercises.d: Rotate your upper body while lying down to loosen the mid-back.
i: Lie on your side with knees bent and arms stretched in front of you.
Keep your knees stacked.
Lift the top arm and open it across to the other side, following it with your eyes.
Return the arm to the start.
Do 10 reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: curl de pierna inverso asistido
exercises.d: A supported nordic-style curl where assistance lets you control the lowering for the hamstrings.
i: Kneel with your ankles secured and your torso upright.
Use the assistance as needed.
Lean forward slowly, resisting with your hamstrings.
Lower as far as you can control.
Pull yourself back up with your hamstrings and hands if needed.
Keep your hips extended.

exercises.n: círculos de hombros de pie
exercises.d: Circle your shoulders to loosen the joint and ease tension in the upper back.
i: Stand tall with arms relaxed at your sides.
Lift your shoulders up and roll them back in a large circle.
Keep your neck relaxed.
Do 10 circles, then reverse the direction.

exercises.n: alcance con un brazo, rodar y elevar de rodillas
exercises.en: kneeling one arm reach roll lift
exercises.d: A kneeling drill where one arm reaches, rolls and lifts to open the upper back and shoulders.
i: Start on hands and knees with hands under shoulders.
Reach one arm forward along the floor.
Roll that arm up and across, rotating your chest.
Lift it toward the ceiling, following your hand with your eyes.
Return and repeat, then switch arms.

exercises.n: dominada en L
exercises.d: A pull-up with the legs held out straight in an L shape. It trains the lats, biceps and core.
i: Sujeta la barra de dominadas con un agarre prono, un poco más ancho que la altura de los hombros.
Cuélgate con los brazos completamente extendidos y el cuerpo recto.
Activa los dorsales y los bíceps para llevar el cuerpo hacia arriba en dirección a la barra, manteniendo los codos cerca del cuerpo.
Continúa subiendo hasta que la barbilla quede por encima de la barra.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte superior, luego baja lentamente el cuerpo de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: L-sit en el suelo
exercises.d: A seated hold on the floor, hands beside the hips, with the legs lifted straight out. It trains the abs, hip flexors and triceps.
i: Siéntate en el suelo con las piernas extendidas frente a ti.
Coloca las manos en el suelo junto a las caderas, con los dedos apuntando hacia adelante.
Activa el core y levanta las piernas del suelo, manteniéndolas rectas.
Intenta llevar las piernas paralelas al suelo, formando una 'L' con el cuerpo.
Mantén esta posición durante el mayor tiempo posible.
Baja lentamente las piernas de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: V-sit en el suelo
exercises.d: A seated hold with both the legs and the upper body lifted into a V shape. It trains the abs, hip flexors and balance.
i: Siéntate en el suelo con las piernas extendidas frente a ti.
Inclínate ligeramente hacia atrás y levanta las piernas del suelo, manteniéndolas rectas.
Al mismo tiempo, levanta la parte superior del cuerpo del suelo y extiende los brazos hacia las piernas.
Mantén esta posición durante unos segundos, luego baja lentamente la parte superior del cuerpo y las piernas de nuevo a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: abdominal con balón medicinal
exercises.d: A crunch holding a medicine ball to add resistance for the abs.
i: Lie on your back with knees bent and hold a medicine ball on your chest.
Curl your shoulders off the floor.
Squeeze your abs at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your chin off your chest.
Breathe out as you crunch up.

exercises.n: elevación frontal con mancuernas v. 3
exercises.d: Lift dumbbells in front of you to work the front of the shoulders.
i: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Brace your core and keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise the weights in front of you to shoulder height.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly without swinging your body.

exercises.n: patadas de nadador v. 2 (masculino)
exercises.d: A face-down flutter kick, lifting the chest and legs off the floor and kicking in a swimming motion. It trains the glutes and lower back.
i: Túmbate boca abajo sobre una esterilla con los brazos extendidos por encima de la cabeza.
Activa el core y levanta el pecho y las piernas del suelo al mismo tiempo.
Mueve las piernas hacia arriba y hacia abajo con un movimiento de aleteo, como si estuvieras nadando.
Continúa el movimiento de patada el número de repeticiones deseado.
Baja el pecho y las piernas de nuevo a la posición inicial.

exercises.n: puente de cadera a una pierna (pierna recta)
exercises.d: A one-leg hip bridge with the other leg held straight, strongly working glutes and hamstrings.
i: Lie on your back with one knee bent and foot flat.
Extend the other leg straight.
Drive through your heel and lift your hips.
Keep your pelvis level.
Lower with control.
Switch legs after your set.

exercises.n: superman
exercises.d: A floor extension that lifts arms and legs to strengthen the lower back.
i: Lie face down with arms extended in front.
Lift your arms, chest and legs off the floor together.
Squeeze your glutes and lower back.
Hold for 1-2 seconds.
Lower slowly.
Keep your neck neutral.

exercises.n: elevación de piernas y cadera declinada
exercises.d: A leg raise on a decline bench, finishing with a hip lift for the lower abs.
i: Lie on a decline bench and hold the top edge.
Bring your legs up over your hips.
Lift your hips toward the ceiling.
Lower your hips first.
Lower your legs with control.
Avoid swinging.

exercises.n: lanzamiento hacia atrás con balón medicinal
exercises.d: An explosive overhead throw behind you that trains the hips and posterior chain.
i: Stand with a medicine ball held between your legs.
Squat slightly, then explode up.
Swing the ball up and back over your head.
Release it behind you at full extension.
Retrieve the ball.
Reset your stance and repeat.

exercises.n: salto dividido al cajón
exercises.d: A jump from a split stance onto a box, building leg power.
i: Stand in a lunge position facing a box.
Swing your arms and jump up.
Land with both feet softly on the box.
Stand tall.
Step down carefully.
Switch your front leg and repeat.

exercises.n: flexión y extensión de cuello sentado
exercises.d: A seated neck mobility drill moving the head forward and back.
i: Sit tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Lower your chin gently toward your chest.
Hold for a moment.
Slowly lift your head and look up slightly.
Move through a comfortable range only.
Repeat 8-10 times smoothly.

exercises.n: lanzamiento sobre la cabeza de pie con balón medicinal
exercises.d: An explosive overhead throw with a medicine ball, working the upper body and trunk.
i: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart holding the ball overhead.
Arch back slightly.
Throw the ball forward and down with force.
Follow through with your arms.
Pick up the ball.
Reset and repeat.

exercises.n: fondos en el suelo con silla
exercises.d: A seated dip with your hands on a chair behind you.
i: Sit on the floor with hands on a chair behind you.
Lift your hips off the floor.
Bend your elbows to lower your body.
Keep elbows pointing back.
Press up.
Brace the chair against a wall.

exercises.n: subida a la silla
exercises.d: A step-up onto a sturdy chair, a simple single-leg exercise.
i: Face a sturdy chair.
Place one foot fully on the seat.
Drive through that heel to stand up.
Bring the other foot up.
Step down with control.
Do all reps on one leg, then switch.

exercises.n: zancada lateral con mancuernas v. 3
exercises.d: A side lunge with dumbbells that works the thighs and inner thighs.
i: Hold a dumbbell in each hand.
Step wide to one side.
Sit your hips back and bend that knee.
Keep your other leg straight.
Push off to return to center.
Alternate sides.

exercises.n: giro ruso con mancuerna
exercises.d: A seated rotation with a dumbbell for the obliques.
i: Sit with knees bent and lean back slightly.
Hold a dumbbell with both hands in front of you.
Rotate your torso to one side.
Rotate to the other side.
Keep your chest lifted.
Move with control.

exercises.n: press svend con mancuerna
exercises.d: A plate-style squeeze press using a dumbbell held between your palms.
i: Stand holding a dumbbell upright between your palms.
Hold it at chest level.
Squeeze your palms together.
Press the weight straight out.
Return to your chest.
Keep the squeeze all the time.

exercises.n: superman con mancuernas
exercises.d: A loaded superman hold with dumbbells for the lower back and glutes.
i: Lie face down holding light dumbbells with arms extended.
Lift your chest, arms and legs.
Squeeze your glutes.
Hold for a moment.
Lower with control.
Keep your neck neutral.

exercises.n: burpee con flexión
exercises.d: A burpee that includes a full push-up for conditioning.
i: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat and place your hands on the floor.
Jump your feet back to a plank.
Do a push-up.
Jump your feet in and leap up.
Repeat at a steady pace.

exercises.n: split lateral (abertura de piernas)
exercises.d: A wide-leg stretch for the inner thighs and groin.
i: Sit or stand with your legs as wide as comfortable.
Keep your toes pointing up or forward.
Lower slowly into the split.
Keep your back long.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Come out gently.

exercises.n: pulso hacia arriba
exercises.d: Small upward pulses with your legs raised, targeting the lower abs.
i: Lie on your back with legs pointing to the ceiling.
Place your hands by your sides.
Lift your hips slightly with a small pulse.
Lower and repeat.
Keep movement small.
Do 15-20 pulses.

exercises.n: aducción de cadera en plancha lateral (rodilla flexionada)
exercises.d: A side plank with the top leg lifting inward, working the inner thighs and obliques.
i: Set up in a side plank with the bottom knee bent.
Keep your body straight.
Lift your hips.
Raise the bottom leg toward the top leg.
Lower with control.
Switch sides.

exercises.n: calentamiento en zancada (uno)
exercises.d: A dynamic lunge warm-up drill (part 1 of 7) that opens the hips and prepares your legs.
i: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your core braced.
Step into the lunge position described by this variation with control.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and your torso upright.
Move smoothly through the full range without bouncing.
Return to standing and repeat on the other side.
Do 8-10 slow reps per side as part of a warm-up.

exercises.n: calentamiento en zancada (dos)
exercises.d: A dynamic lunge warm-up drill (part 2 of 7) that opens the hips and prepares your legs.
i: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your core braced.
Step into the lunge position described by this variation with control.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and your torso upright.
Move smoothly through the full range without bouncing.
Return to standing and repeat on the other side.
Do 8-10 slow reps per side as part of a warm-up.

exercises.d: A dynamic lunge warm-up drill (part 3 of 7) that opens the hips and prepares your legs.
i: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your core braced.
Step into the lunge position described by this variation with control.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and your torso upright.
Move smoothly through the full range without bouncing.
Return to standing and repeat on the other side.
Do 8-10 slow reps per side as part of a warm-up.

exercises.d: A dynamic lunge warm-up drill (part 4 of 7) that opens the hips and prepares your legs.
i: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your core braced.
Step into the lunge position described by this variation with control.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and your torso upright.
Move smoothly through the full range without bouncing.
Return to standing and repeat on the other side.
Do 8-10 slow reps per side as part of a warm-up.

exercises.d: A dynamic lunge warm-up drill (part 5 of 7) that opens the hips and prepares your legs.
i: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your core braced.
Step into the lunge position described by this variation with control.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and your torso upright.
Move smoothly through the full range without bouncing.
Return to standing and repeat on the other side.
Do 8-10 slow reps per side as part of a warm-up.

exercises.n: calentamiento en zancada (seis)
exercises.d: A dynamic lunge warm-up drill (part 6 of 7) that opens the hips and prepares your legs.
i: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your core braced.
Step into the lunge position described by this variation with control.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and your torso upright.
Move smoothly through the full range without bouncing.
Return to standing and repeat on the other side.
Do 8-10 slow reps per side as part of a warm-up.

exercises.d: A dynamic lunge warm-up drill (part 7 of 7) that opens the hips and prepares your legs.
i: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your core braced.
Step into the lunge position described by this variation with control.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and your torso upright.
Move smoothly through the full range without bouncing.
Return to standing and repeat on the other side.
Do 8-10 slow reps per side as part of a warm-up.

exercises.n: estiramiento frontal de isquiotibiales
exercises.d: A simple stretch for the back of the thigh.
i: Place one heel forward on the floor with the toes up.
Keep that leg straight.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back.
Feel the stretch behind your thigh.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.

exercises.n: perro boca abajo
exercises.d: A classic yoga pose that stretches the back of the legs and shoulders.
i: Start on hands and knees.
Tuck your toes and lift your hips up and back.
Press your chest toward your thighs.
Keep your arms straight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower down gently.

exercises.n: zancada hacia adelante (masculino)
exercises.d: A bodyweight lunge stepping forward and pushing back, alternating legs. It builds the glutes, quads and balance.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de las caderas y las manos en las caderas.
Da un paso grande hacia adelante con el pie derecho, bajando el cuerpo hasta una posición de zancada.
Dobla la rodilla derecha hasta unos 90 grados, manteniendo la rodilla alineada con el tobillo.
Empuja con el pie derecho y vuelve a la posición inicial.
Repite con la pierna izquierda, alternando los lados durante el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: postura del guerrero
exercises.d: A standing yoga pose that builds strength and stretches the hips.
i: Take a long stance.
Bend your front knee over your ankle.
Raise your arms.
Keep your back leg straight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

exercises.n: estiramiento de cadera acostado con pierna recogida
exercises.d: A lying hip stretch pulling the knee in toward the chest.
i: Lie on your back.
Pull one knee toward your chest.
Keep your other leg relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release slowly.
Switch legs.

exercises.n: estiramiento de cadera externa en equilibrio de pie
exercises.d: A standing stretch for the outer hip that also challenges balance.
i: Stand tall near a support.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Sit back slightly.
Feel the stretch in your outer hip.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

exercises.n: estiramiento de cadera acostado con pierna recogida y manos arriba
exercises.en: lying leg tuck hip stretch with overhead hands
exercises.d: A lying knee-tuck stretch with arms extended overhead for a longer line.
i: Lie on your back with your arms overhead.
Pull one knee toward your chest.
Keep your arms reaching.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release slowly.
Switch legs.

exercises.n: estiramiento de cadera y espalda acostado con pierna recogida
exercises.en: lying leg tuck hip back stretch
exercises.d: A lying tuck stretch easing the hips and lower back.
i: Lie on your back.
Hug both knees toward your chest.
Rock gently if comfortable.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Relax your shoulders.
Release slowly.

exercises.n: estiramiento de cadera con giro acostado y pierna recogida
exercises.en: lying leg tuck hip twist stretch
exercises.d: A lying stretch with a spinal twist to open the hips and back.
i: Lie on your back and pull your knees in.
Drop both knees to one side.
Keep your shoulders on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return to the center.
Switch sides.

exercises.n: estiramiento de cadera acostado con pierna recogida hacia la derecha
exercises.en: lying leg tuck hip back to right stretch
exercises.d: A lying tuck stretch with the knees guided to the right.
i: Lie on your back and tuck your knees.
Lower your knees to the right.
Keep both shoulders down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Breathe slowly.
Return to center.

exercises.n: estiramiento de cadera con giro acostado y pierna recogida hacia la izquierda
exercises.en: lying leg tuck hip twist to left stretch
exercises.d: A lying tuck stretch with the knees guided to the left.
i: Lie on your back and tuck your knees.
Lower your knees to the left.
Keep both shoulders down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Breathe slowly.
Return to center.

exercises.n: sentadilla con toque alterno de talón y patada lateral
exercises.en: alternate heel touch side kick squat
exercises.d: A squat that adds a side kick and a heel touch for legs and coordination.
i: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Squat down.
Stand and kick one leg to the side.
Touch the heel with your hand.
Squat again.
Alternate sides.

exercises.n: zancada de sprinter alterna
exercises.d: A lunge with a sprint-style arm drive and alternating legs.
i: Stand tall.
Step back into a deep lunge.
Drive your arms like a sprinter.
Push back to standing.
Alternate legs.
Keep your torso upright.

exercises.n: zancada baja de sprinter dividida
exercises.d: A low lunge hold in a sprinter stance for the legs and hips.
i: Step into a long lunge.
Lower your back knee near the floor.
Keep your torso tall.
Hold the low position briefly.
Push up.
Switch legs.

exercises.n: zancada alta de sprinter dividida
exercises.d: A high lunge with the arms driving like a sprinter's. It builds leg strength, balance and hip stability.
i: Stand tall and step one foot well back into a staggered stance.
Bend both knees and lower into a lunge, back heel lifted.
Swing the arm opposite the front leg forward and the other arm back, like sprinting.
Keep your torso upright and the front knee over the ankle.
Push through the front foot to rise, then repeat all reps.
Switch legs and do the same number.

exercises.n: sostén de superman alrededor del mundo
exercises.d: A face-down superman hold with the arms sweeping in a circle. It strengthens the glutes, lower back and rear shoulders.
i: Lie face down with your arms extended overhead and legs straight.
Lift your arms, chest and legs a few centimetres off the floor.
Sweep your arms out to the sides and down toward your hips in a wide arc.
Sweep them back overhead along the same path.
Keep your neck neutral and legs lifted throughout.
Lower down with control after your set.

exercises.n: abdominal de codo a rodilla
exercises.d: A sit-up that finishes by driving one elbow toward the opposite knee. It works the abs and obliques.
i: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands behind your head.
Curl up and rotate your torso, bringing one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower your back to the floor with control.
Repeat on the other side, alternating.
Avoid pulling on your neck.

exercises.n: remo invertido con rodillas flexionadas entre sillas
exercises.en: inverted row with bent knee between chairs
exercises.d: A home row where you hang under a bar or broom handle set across two chairs, knees bent to make it easier. It trains the back and biceps.
i: Set a sturdy bar across two stable chairs and lie underneath it.
Grip the bar overhand, arms straight, knees bent and feet flat.
Keep your body in a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Pull your chest up toward the bar, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight again.
Make sure the chairs cannot slide.

exercises.n: curl invertido de mentón con rodillas flexionadas entre sillas
exercises.en: inverted chin curl with bent knee between chairs
exercises.d: An underhand-grip hang under a bar between two chairs, curling your body up with the biceps. Bent knees keep it manageable.
i: Place a sturdy bar across two stable chairs and lie underneath it.
Grip the bar underhand, arms straight, knees bent.
Keep your hips up and body in a line.
Curl yourself up by bending the elbows, keeping them close.
Lower with control until the arms are straight.
Check the chairs are stable before each set.

exercises.n: dominada con rodillas flexionadas entre sillas
exercises.en: pull up with bent knee between chairs
exercises.d: A beginner-friendly pull-up built from a bar across two chairs, with the feet on the floor and knees bent. It builds lats and arm pulling strength.
i: Set a sturdy bar across two stable chairs, high enough to sit under.
Sit or lie beneath it and grip the bar slightly wider than your shoulders.
Keep your knees bent with feet on the floor for light help.
Pull your chest toward the bar by driving elbows down.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Use your legs as little as you can.

exercises.n: flexión cobra
exercises.d: A push-up that flows into a cobra-style chest opening at the top. It trains the chest and arms and works the back and spine.
i: Start in a push-up position with hands under your shoulders.
Lower your chest to the floor with elbows tucked.
Press up and keep going, letting your hips sink forward.
Lift your chest and look slightly up, like a cobra.
Return to the plank by lifting your hips back.
Keep the movement smooth and controlled.

exercises.n: flexión cobra de rodillas
exercises.d: A kneeling version of the cobra push-up that is easier on the arms and core. It works the chest and gently extends the spine.
i: Kneel on a mat and place your hands under your shoulders.
Keep a straight line from head to knees.
Lower your chest to the floor with elbows close.
Press up and let your hips sink forward, lifting your chest into a cobra.
Shift your hips back to the start.
Repeat smoothly.

exercises.n: flexión declinada de rodillas en cajón
exercises.en: decline kneeling push up on box
exercises.d: A kneeling push-up with the hands on a box, so the body slopes downward. It's an easier push-up that still stresses the chest and shoulders.
i: Place a sturdy box in front of you and kneel on the floor.
Put your hands on the box edge, slightly wider than your shoulders.
Form a straight line from head to knees.
Lower your chest to the box with elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your hips from sagging.

exercises.n: flexión declinada contra la pared
exercises.d: A push-up with the feet up the wall and hands on the floor. The raised feet put more load on the upper chest and shoulders.
i: Place your hands on the floor and walk your feet up a wall behind you.
Set your hands under your shoulders in a straight body line.
Lower your chest toward the floor with elbows tucked.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your core tight and your hips level.
Walk your feet down to finish.

exercises.n: flexión rotacional de rodillas
exercises.d: A kneeling push-up that ends with a rotation and one arm reaching up. It trains the chest and trunk control.
i: Start in a kneeling push-up position, hands under shoulders.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press up and rotate your torso, lifting one arm toward the ceiling.
Look at your raised hand for a moment.
Bring the hand back down and lower for the next rep.
Alternate sides each rep.

exercises.n: sentadilla a una pierna en cajón bajo
exercises.d: A one-leg squat down to a low box, giving you a target depth. It builds single-leg strength and balance.
i: Stand in front of a low box or bench on one leg.
Extend the other leg forward and raise your arms for balance.
Sit your hips back and lower until you lightly touch the box.
Keep your chest up and knee tracking over your toes.
Drive through the heel to stand.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: sentadilla a una pierna con toque de talón
exercises.d: A single-leg squat where you reach down to touch the heel of the working foot. It challenges balance and leg strength.
i: Stand on one leg with the other foot slightly off the floor.
Sit your hips back and bend the knee to squat down.
Reach down toward the heel of your standing foot.
Keep your chest as tall as you can.
Push through your foot to rise.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: remo acostado en el suelo con rodillas flexionadas
exercises.en: lying floor row with bent knee
exercises.d: A row done lying on the floor, pulling against an anchored handle or towel, with knees bent. It works the back and biceps with no equipment.
i: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Hold a secure anchor, such as a towel around a sturdy post, with arms straight.
Pull your body toward your hands by driving the elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
Keep your hips on or near the floor.

exercises.n: marcha con piernas rectas acostado
exercises.d: Alternating straight-leg raises while lying on your back, like a slow march. It trains the lower abs and hip flexors.
i: Lie on your back, arms by your sides.
Press your lower back gently into the floor.
Raise one straight leg toward the ceiling.
Lower it as you raise the other leg.
Keep alternating in a slow, steady march.
Keep your back from arching.

exercises.n: jalón deslizante en el suelo con toalla
exercises.d: Slide your hands along the floor on a towel, from overhead down toward your sides. It teaches a pulldown pattern for the lats.
i: Kneel or lie face down with your hands on towels on a smooth floor.
Start with your arms extended overhead.
Press down and pull your arms back toward your hips, sliding the towels.
Squeeze your lats at the end.
Slide the hands back overhead with control.
Keep your core braced.

exercises.n: curl de puente deslizante en el suelo con toalla
exercises.en: sliding floor bridge curl on towel
exercises.d: A glute bridge with the heels on towels, sliding the feet in and out. It strongly works the hamstrings and glutes.
i: Lie on your back with your heels on towels on a smooth floor.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Slide your heels away until your legs are nearly straight.
Pull your heels back toward your glutes.
Keep your hips high throughout.
Lower your hips to finish the set.

exercises.n: pullover invertido autoasistido
exercises.d: A pullover-style move hanging under a bar, with the legs helping a bit. It builds the lats and shoulder strength.
i: Set a sturdy bar at hip height or lower and hang beneath it with an overhand grip.
Keep your feet on the floor to help as needed.
Pull your chest toward the bar and let your hips rise.
Continue to rotate your torso up and over the bar toward your hands, as your range allows.
Reverse slowly back to the start.
Use your legs only as needed.

exercises.n: movilidad de sentadilla completa
exercises.d: A deep squat hold with gentle movement to open the hips, ankles and lower back.
i: Stand with feet slightly wider than your shoulders, toes turned out.
Lower into a deep squat, keeping your heels down.
Press your elbows against your inner knees with hands together.
Shift gently side to side and hold the bottom.
Keep your chest lifted.
Stand up slowly.

exercises.n: plancha frontal con elevación de pierna
exercises.d: A forearm plank with alternating leg lifts. It builds core stability and glute strength.
i: Set up in a forearm plank with elbows under your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Lift one leg a few inches without rotating your hips.
Lower it and lift the other leg.
Keep your core tight and your hips level.
Breathe steadily.

exercises.n: balanceo de piernas hacia atrás y adelante
exercises.d: A dynamic warm-up swinging one leg forward and back. It loosens the hips and hamstrings.
i: Stand tall beside a wall or support and hold it for balance.
Shift your weight onto the inside leg.
Swing the outside leg forward and back in a controlled arc.
Keep your torso upright.
Increase the range gradually.
Switch legs after your reps.

exercises.n: abdominal de plancha lateral con codo a rodilla
exercises.en: elbow to knee side plank crunch
exercises.d: A side plank where you crunch the top elbow toward the knee. It targets the obliques and core.
i: Set up in a side plank on your forearm, top hand behind your head.
Lift your hips so your body is in line.
Bring your top elbow and knee together in a crunch.
Extend back to the side plank.
Keep your hips lifted throughout.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: estiramiento de cuádriceps en equilibrio de pie
exercises.d: A standing quad stretch with balance. It lengthens the front of the thigh and hips.
i: Stand tall, holding a wall for balance if needed.
Bend one knee and grab your ankle behind you.
Pull your heel toward your glutes with knees together.
Keep your hips tucked and your chest up.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release and switch legs.

exercises.n: postura del camello
exercises.d: A kneeling backbend that opens the chest, abs and front of the hips.
i: Kneel with knees hip-width apart and hands on your lower back.
Push your hips forward and lift your chest.
Lean back and reach for your heels if comfortable.
Let your head relax back gently.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing evenly.
Come up slowly, leading with your chest.

exercises.n: remo con peso corporal en el marco de una puerta
exercises.d: A row done by holding both sides of a doorframe and leaning back. It trains the back and arms.
i: Stand in a doorway and grip both sides of the frame firmly.
Lean back with arms straight and feet close to the frame.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Pull your chest toward the frame, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower with control.
Use a sturdy frame and a non-slip grip.

exercises.n: curl de pierna inverso autoasistido v. 2
exercises.en: self assisted inverse leg curl v. 2
exercises.d: A bodyweight Nordic-style leg curl where you lower yourself and use your hands to help back up. It builds strong hamstrings.
i: Kneel with your ankles anchored under something stable.
Keep your body straight from knees to head.
Lower your torso forward slowly, using your hamstrings to resist.
Catch yourself with your hands near the floor.
Push off lightly and use your hamstrings to return.
Keep your hips extended.

exercises.n: curl de pierna a una pierna sentado con banda elástica
exercises.en: resistance band seated single leg curl
exercises.d: A seated leg curl with a band around the foot. It isolates the hamstrings.
i: Sit on the floor with a band anchored in front and looped around one foot.
Extend your leg with a slight tension on the band.
Curl your heel toward your glutes, pulling against the band.
Squeeze the hamstring briefly.
Return with control.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: elevación de piernas dentro y fuera sentado en el suelo
exercises.en: seated in out leg raise on floor
exercises.d: A seated leg tuck, with legs pulled in then extended out. It trains the lower abs and hip flexors.
i: Sit on the floor, hands behind you for support.
Lean back slightly with legs extended and lifted.
Pull your knees toward your chest.
Extend your legs back out without touching the floor.
Keep your back long and your core tight.
Breathe steadily.

exercises.n: rana crujiente en el suelo
exercises.d: A floor ab move where knees and arms come together in a frog-like crunch. It works the abs.
i: Lie on your back with arms and legs extended.
Lift your shoulders and legs slightly off the floor.
Pull your knees in while reaching your hands toward your shins.
Squeeze your abs.
Extend back out without resting on the floor.
Keep your lower back pressed down.

exercises.n: bird dog con banda elástica
exercises.d: A bird dog with a band for extra resistance, training the lower back, glutes and core stability.
i: Start on hands and knees with a band looped under one hand and around the opposite foot.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Extend that arm forward and the opposite leg back against the band.
Pause, then return under control.
Do all reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: dead bug para tren superior con banda elástica
exercises.en: resistance band upper body dead bug
exercises.d: A dead bug with a band held in the hands, pulling it as the arms move. It builds core stability.
i: Lie on your back with knees bent over your hips, holding a band in both hands above your chest.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Pull one hand overhead while stretching the band.
Bring it back and alternate.
Keep your ribs down and core braced.
Move slowly.

exercises.n: estiramiento de hombro detrás de la espalda con banda elástica
exercises.en: resistance band shoulder stretch behind the back
exercises.d: A shoulder and chest stretch holding a band behind the back. It opens the front of the shoulders.
i: Stand tall holding a band behind your back with both hands.
Keep your arms straight and your hands wide.
Lift your hands away from your back gently.
Keep your chest open and your ribs down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release slowly.

exercises.n: curl de puente deslizante a una pierna en el suelo con toalla
exercises.en: single leg sliding floor bridge curl on towel
exercises.d: A one-leg bridge curl with the heel on a towel. It's a tougher hamstring and glute exercise.
i: Lie on your back with one heel on a towel on a smooth floor.
Lift the other leg straight up.
Raise your hips into a bridge.
Slide your heel away until the leg is nearly straight.
Pull the heel back toward your glutes.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: v up oblicuo en el suelo
exercises.d: A side-lying V-up that targets the obliques.
i: Lie on one side with legs together and an arm extended overhead.
Lift your legs and upper body at the same time.
Reach your top hand toward your feet.
Lower with control, not resting.
Keep your movement smooth.
Do your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: estiramiento de hombro en arco hacia atrás
exercises.d: A gentle backbend stretch that opens the shoulders and chest.
i: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Clasp your hands behind your back.
Lift your arms up behind you and open your chest.
Tilt back slightly if comfortable.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release slowly.

exercises.n: estiramiento de columna en arco hacia atrás
exercises.d: A gentle backbend that stretches the spine, hips and abs.
i: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Place your hands on your lower back.
Squeeze your glutes and push your hips forward.
Lean back gently, lifting your chest.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return upright slowly.

exercises.n: extensión de piernas sentado con banda elástica
exercises.d: A seated leg extension with a loop band around the ankle. It isolates the quadriceps.
i: Sit on a chair with a band anchored behind and looped around one ankle.
Start with your knee bent to 90 degrees.
Extend your leg until it is straight.
Squeeze the quad at the top.
Lower with control.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: pullover con puente de glúteos a una pierna y kettlebell
exercises.en: kettlebell single leg glute bridge pullover
exercises.d: A one-leg glute bridge with a kettlebell pullover, working glutes and lats.
i: Lie on your back with one foot flat, other leg raised.
Hold a kettlebell by the horns above your chest.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Lower the kettlebell back overhead in an arc.
Bring it back up as you hold the bridge.
Lower your hips, then switch legs.

exercises.n: puente de glúteos con piernas en banco (masculino)
exercises.en: glute bridge two legs on bench (male)
exercises.d: A bodyweight glute bridge with the shoulders on a bench and both feet on the floor. It trains the glutes and hamstrings.
i: Siéntate en el borde de un banco con la espalda apoyada en él y los pies planos sobre el suelo.
Coloca las manos en el banco junto a las caderas para mayor apoyo.
Activa los glúteos y los isquiotibiales, luego levanta las caderas del banco hasta que el cuerpo forme una línea recta desde las rodillas hasta los hombros.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte superior, luego baja lentamente las caderas de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: press pallof horizontal con sentadilla y banda elástica
exercises.en: band horizontal pallof press with resistance band squat
exercises.d: A squat combined with a Pallof press. It builds leg strength with anti-rotation core work.
i: Anchor a band at chest height and stand side-on, holding it at your chest.
Squat down, keeping your torso tall.
Stand and press the band straight out in front.
Resist the band trying to rotate you.
Bring your hands back to your chest.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: press de hombros a un brazo de rodillas con landmine
exercises.en: landmine kneeling one arm shoulder press
exercises.d: A kneeling single-arm press with a landmine. It trains the shoulders and builds core stability.
i: Kneel facing the end of a landmine barbell.
Hold the end at shoulder height with one hand.
Keep your core tight and torso upright.
Press the end up and forward until your arm is straight.
Lower with control.
Complete your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: movilidad de columna torácica de rodillas
exercises.d: A kneeling rotation drill for upper back mobility.
i: Kneel on all fours.
Place one hand behind your head.
Rotate your elbow toward the opposite arm.
Open up and rotate toward the ceiling.
Follow your elbow with your eyes.
Do your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: perro boca abajo con toque de pie
exercises.d: A downward dog with alternating hand-to-toe taps. It stretches the hamstrings and calves.
i: Start in a downward facing dog, hips high.
Press your chest toward your thighs.
Reach one hand back to touch the opposite foot.
Return the hand and switch sides.
Keep your hips high.
Move slowly with steady breathing.

exercises.n: movilidad de columna en perro boca abajo
exercises.d: A downward dog flowing with gentle spine movement. It loosens the back and hamstrings.
i: Start in a downward facing dog.
Bend one knee, then the other, pedaling gently.
Shift your hips side to side.
Let your spine twist a little.
Keep your hands pressed into the floor.
Breathe slowly.

exercises.n: levantarse con rodilla alta con landmine
exercises.d: A landmine move combining a stand-up with a high knee drive. It trains the legs and core.
i: Hold the end of a landmine barbell at your chest.
Stand from a squat, driving through your legs.
Raise one knee high as you stand.
Lower the foot and squat again.
Keep the barbell close to your chest.
Alternate legs each rep.

exercises.n: sentadilla con barra y bandas
exercises.d: A barbell squat with bands attached to increase tension at the top.
i: Set the bands on the rack and barbell.
Rest the bar on your upper back.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down with your chest up.
Drive up through your heels.
Brace your core throughout.

exercises.n: golpes alternados
exercises.d: Alternating punches at a steady pace to raise the heart rate.
i: Stand with a staggered stance and fists up.
Punch forward with one arm, rotating your torso slightly.
Pull it back as you punch with the other.
Keep your core tight.
Keep a steady rhythm for 30-60 seconds.
Rest briefly and repeat.

exercises.n: shuffle de boxeador
exercises.d: A light-footed shuffle used by boxers to keep the heart rate up.
i: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, knees soft.
Shift your weight from foot to foot.
Stay on the balls of your feet.
Keep your hands up like a guard.
Keep it light and quick for 30-60 seconds.
Rest briefly and repeat.

exercises.n: cuádriceps
exercises.d: A bodyweight squat variation focused on the front of the thighs. It trains the quads and glutes.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros.
Baja el cuerpo flexionando las rodillas y empujando las caderas hacia atrás como si te sentaras en una silla.
Mantén el pecho arriba y la espalda recta.
Baja hasta que los muslos queden paralelos al suelo.
Empuja con los talones para volver a ponerte de pie en la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: pulso de elevación de gemelos de pie con peso corporal
exercises.d: A standing calf raise with small pulses at the top. It builds calf endurance.
i: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a support for balance.
Rise up onto the balls of your feet.
Pulse up and down in small movements.
Keep your knees straight.
Lower fully when you finish.
Keep the movement controlled.

exercises.n: sentadilla con pulso y peso corporal
exercises.d: A squat held at the bottom with small pulses. It burns the quads and glutes.
i: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down until thighs are parallel.
Pulse up and down a few centimetres.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.
Keep your weight on your heels.
Stand up fully to finish.

exercises.n: remo invertido elevado entre 3 sillas
exercises.d: A harder inverted row with the feet elevated on a third chair. It builds the back and arms.
i: Set a bar across two stable chairs and place a third chair at your feet.
Lie under the bar and grip it overhand.
Put your heels on the third chair.
Pull your chest to the bar.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
Keep your body in a straight line.

exercises.n: remo invertido elevado con agarre supino entre 3 sillas
exercises.en: elevated inverted underhand grip row between 3 chairs
exercises.d: An inverted row with an underhand grip and elevated feet. It emphasises the lats and biceps.
i: Set a bar across two stable chairs and a third chair at your feet.
Lie under the bar and grip it underhand.
Place your heels on the third chair.
Pull your chest to the bar with elbows close.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
Keep your body straight.

exercises.n: remo invertido con agarre supino entre sillas
exercises.en: inverted underhand grip row between chairs
exercises.d: An inverted row with an underhand grip on a bar between two chairs.
i: Set a bar across two stable chairs.
Lie under it and grip underhand.
Keep your legs straight with heels on the floor.
Pull your chest to the bar.
Lower slowly.
Keep your body in a line.

exercises.n: estiramiento de movilidad de columna torácica acostado
exercises.d: A lying rotation stretch for the upper back.
i: Lie on your side with knees bent and arms in front.
Lift your top arm and open it toward the other side.
Follow your hand with your eyes.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return to the start.
Switch sides.

exercises.n: estiramiento de movilidad de columna torácica de rodillas
exercises.d: A kneeling thoracic rotation stretch.
i: Kneel on all fours.
Place one hand behind your head.
Rotate your elbow up toward the ceiling.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return to start.
Switch sides.

exercises.n: elevación en Y inclinada con mancuernas
exercises.d: A dumbbell raise on an incline bench, lifting the arms into a Y shape. It trains the lower traps and upper back.
i: Ajusta un banco inclinado a un ángulo de 45 grados y siéntate en él con una mancuerna en cada mano, con las palmas hacia adentro.
Inclínate ligeramente hacia adelante y deja que los brazos cuelguen rectos hacia abajo, manteniendo una ligera flexión en los codos.
Levanta los brazos hacia los lados y hacia arriba formando una Y hasta que queden paralelos al suelo.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte superior, luego baja lentamente los brazos de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: elevación en T inclinada con mancuernas
exercises.d: A dumbbell raise on an incline bench, lifting the arms into a T shape. It trains the rear delts and upper back.
i: Ajusta un banco inclinado a un ángulo de 45 grados y siéntate en él con una mancuerna en cada mano, con las palmas hacia adentro.
Inclínate hacia adelante y deja que los brazos cuelguen rectos hacia abajo, perpendiculares al suelo.
Manteniendo los brazos rectos, levántalos hacia los lados hasta que queden paralelos al suelo, formando una 'T' con el cuerpo.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte superior, luego baja lentamente los brazos de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: sentadilla con salto en profundidad y peso corporal
exercises.d: A squat that ends with an explosive jump, bringing the feet together in the air. It builds leg power and cardio.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros.
Baja el cuerpo hacia una posición de sentadilla flexionando las rodillas y empujando las caderas hacia atrás.
Salta hacia arriba explosivamente, extendiendo las caderas, las rodillas y los tobillos.
Mientras estás en el aire, junta rápidamente los pies.
Aterriza suavemente sobre las puntas de los pies y de inmediato vuelve a bajar a una posición de sentadilla.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: plancha lateral inclinada con peso corporal
exercises.d: A side plank held on an incline, resting on the forearm with the body in a straight line. It trains the obliques and core.
i: Comienza tumbado de lado con las piernas extendidas y apiladas una sobre la otra.
Coloca el antebrazo en el suelo justo debajo del hombro, con el codo flexionado en un ángulo de 90 grados.
Activa el core y levanta las caderas del suelo, formando una línea recta desde la cabeza hasta los pies.
Mantén esta posición durante el tiempo deseado.
Baja las caderas de nuevo al suelo y repite hacia el otro lado.

exercises.n: press inclinado alternado con mancuernas
exercises.d: A dumbbell press on an incline bench, with the arms alternating. It trains the upper chest and shoulders.
i: Siéntate en un banco inclinado con una mancuerna en cada mano, apoyadas sobre los muslos.
Recuéstate en el banco y usa los muslos para ayudar a levantar las mancuernas hasta la altura de los hombros, con las palmas hacia adelante.
Una vez a la altura de los hombros, gira las muñecas de modo que las palmas de las manos queden mirando hacia adelante.
Empuja las mancuernas hacia arriba con el pecho y los hombros, extendiendo completamente los brazos.
Baja las mancuernas de nuevo hasta la posición inicial, manteniendo los codos ligeramente flexionados.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado, alternando los brazos.

exercises.n: press de hombros alternado sentado con mancuernas
exercises.d: A seated dumbbell shoulder press with the arms alternating. It trains the delts and triceps.
i: Siéntate en un banco con la espalda recta y los pies planos sobre el suelo.
Sujeta una mancuerna en cada mano, con las palmas hacia adentro, y levántalas a la altura de los hombros.
Presiona una mancuerna hacia arriba, por encima de la cabeza, mientras mantienes la otra mancuerna a la altura de los hombros.
Baja la mancuerna levantada de vuelta a la altura de los hombros mientras presionas simultáneamente la otra mancuerna por encima de la cabeza.
Continúa alternando entre los brazos durante el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: curl de bíceps a press de hombros sentado (mancuernas)
exercises.en: dumbbell seated biceps curl to shoulder press
exercises.d: A seated dumbbell curl that flows straight into an overhead press. It trains the biceps and shoulders in one rep.
i: Siéntate en un banco con la espalda recta y los pies planos sobre el suelo.
Sujeta una mancuerna en cada mano con las palmas hacia adelante y los brazos completamente extendidos.
Manteniendo los codos cerca de tus costados, flexiona las mancuernas hacia los hombros.
Una vez que tus antebrazos estén verticales, gira las muñecas de modo que las palmas queden hacia adelante.
Presiona las mancuernas por encima de la cabeza hasta que los brazos estén completamente extendidos.
Baja las mancuernas de vuelta a la posición inicial invirtiendo el movimiento.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: transporte sobre la cabeza a un brazo con mancuerna
exercises.d: A one-handed overhead carry, walking while holding a dumbbell above your head. It trains the shoulders, core and balance.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros, sujetando una mancuerna con una mano.
Levanta la mancuerna por encima de la cabeza, extendiendo completamente el brazo.
Activa el core y mantén la espalda recta mientras caminas hacia adelante, sosteniendo la mancuerna por encima de la cabeza.
Continúa caminando durante la distancia o el tiempo deseado.
Cambia de mano y repite el ejercicio.

exercises.n: dominada sentado entre sillas
exercises.d: A seated pull-up using a bar between two chairs, with the legs assisting.
i: Set a bar across two sturdy chairs.
Sit on the floor beneath it and grip the bar.
Keep your legs bent for light help.
Pull your chest toward the bar.
Lower with control.
Use your legs as little as possible.

exercises.n: carrera lateral de ida y vuelta
exercises.d: A lateral shuttle run at speed to raise the heart rate.
i: Stand with knees bent in an athletic stance.
Shuffle to one side in quick steps.
Touch the floor or change direction.
Shuffle back the other way.
Keep your chest up.
Keep up the pace for 30-60 seconds.

exercises.n: pies rápidos v. 2
exercises.d: A quick on-the-spot footwork drill with fast, light steps. It raises the heart rate and builds foot speed.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros y los brazos a los costados.
Comienza moviendo los pies rápidamente hacia arriba y hacia abajo, como si estuvieras corriendo en el sitio.
Mantén los movimientos rápidos y ligeros, concentrándote en quedarte sobre la punta de los pies.
Continúa durante el tiempo o el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: flexión rotacional
exercises.d: A push-up with a rotation and arm reach at the top. It works the chest and trunk.
i: Start in a push-up position.
Lower your chest to the floor.
Press up and rotate, reaching one arm toward the ceiling.
Return the hand to the floor.
Lower again for the next rep.
Alternate sides.

exercises.n: curl martillo con botella
exercises.d: A hammer curl with water bottles as light weights. It trains the biceps and forearms.
i: Hold a filled bottle in each hand with palms facing each other.
Keep your elbows by your sides.
Curl the bottles toward your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower with control.
Avoid swinging.

exercises.n: empujes de poder
exercises.d: An explosive push away from a wall or support to train the upper back.
i: Stand facing a wall and lean in with arms extended.
Push away from the wall forcefully.
Retract your shoulder blades as you reach back.
Return to the wall with control.
Keep your core tight.
Reset between reps.

exercises.n: carrera con rodillas altas
exercises.d: A running-in-place move with high knees. It raises the heart rate.
i: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Run in place, driving your knees up toward waist height.
Pump your arms in rhythm.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep your chest tall.
Continue for 30-60 seconds.

exercises.n: flexión de rodillas con manos abiertas
exercises.d: A kneeling push-up with the hands wider apart. It puts more emphasis on the chest.
i: Kneel on a mat and place your hands wider than your shoulders.
Keep a straight line from head to knees.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your core tight.
Do not let your hips sag.

exercises.n: curl de bíceps acostado con toalla
exercises.d: Lie on your back and curl a towel held in both hands toward your chest, using your own resistance to work the biceps.
i: Lie on your back and hold a towel in both hands, arms extended.
Pull the towel taut and curl your hands toward your shoulders.
Keep your upper arms still and your elbows close to your sides.
Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly to the start.
Repeat for the planned reps.

exercises.n: remo superman con toalla
exercises.d: Lie face down with a towel held taut overhead, lift your chest and pull the towel toward you, training the upper back and spine.
i: Lie face down with arms extended overhead, holding a towel taut.
Lift your chest and arms slightly off the floor.
Pull the towel down toward your upper chest, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Extend your arms forward again with control.
Keep your neck neutral and repeat.

exercises.n: curl martillo y press alternado de pie con mancuernas
exercises.en: dumbbell standing alternate hammer curl and press
exercises.d: A standing dumbbell sequence that alternates hammer curls with overhead presses. It trains the biceps and shoulders.
i: Ponte de pie con una mancuerna en cada mano, con las palmas hacia tu cuerpo.
Mantén los codos cerca del torso y la espalda recta.
Exhala y flexiona la mancuerna de tu mano derecha hacia el hombro, manteniendo el brazo superior quieto.
Continúa levantando la mancuerna hasta que el bíceps esté completamente contraído y la mancuerna esté a la altura del hombro.
Inhala y baja lentamente la mancuerna de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el curl con la mano izquierda.
Después de completar el curl con la mano izquierda, exhala y presiona la mancuerna de la mano derecha por encima de la cabeza.
Extiende completamente el brazo y mantén la posición por un momento en la parte superior.
Inhala y baja lentamente la mancuerna de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el press con la mano izquierda.
Continúa alternando entre curls y press durante el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: puente de glúteos con marcha
exercises.d: A glute bridge held at the top while you alternate marching the knees. It trains the glutes and core stability.
i: Túmbate sobre tu espalda con las rodillas flexionadas y los pies apoyados en el suelo.
Activa los glúteos y levanta las caderas del suelo, formando una línea recta desde las rodillas hasta los hombros.
Manteniendo las caderas elevadas, levanta un pie del suelo y lleva la rodilla hacia el pecho.
Baja el pie de nuevo al suelo y repite el movimiento con la otra pierna.
Continúa alternando las piernas con un movimiento de marcha mientras mantienes la posición de puente.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: puente de glúteos con barra y piernas en banco (masculino)
exercises.en: barbell glute bridge two legs on bench (male)
exercises.d: A barbell glute bridge with your upper back on a bench and a bar across the hips. It builds the glutes and hamstrings.
i: Empieza sentado en el borde de un banco con la parte superior de la espalda apoyada contra él y los pies planos sobre el suelo, separados a la altura de las caderas.
Coloca una barra sobre las caderas, sujetándola con firmeza con ambas manos.
Activa los glúteos y el core, luego empuja con los talones para levantar las caderas del banco, creando una línea recta desde las rodillas hasta los hombros.
Haz una pausa breve en la parte alta, apretando los glúteos.
Baja lentamente las caderas de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: jalón a un brazo en polea
exercises.d: A one arm cable pulldown from a high pulley, pulling the handle down to your side. It trains the lats.
i: Sujeta una agarradera individual a una máquina de cable con polea alta.
Ponte de pie frente a la máquina con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros.
Sujeta la agarradera con un agarre prono y extiende el brazo por completo.
Mantén la espalda recta y el core activado.
Jala la agarradera hacia abajo en dirección al costado, manteniendo el codo cerca del cuerpo.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte baja del movimiento, apretando el dorsal.
Suelta lentamente la agarradera de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.
Cambia de lado y repite el ejercicio con el otro brazo.

exercises.n: estiramiento sentado de flexores, depresores y retractores del hombro (rodilla flexionada)
exercises.en: seated shoulder flexor depressor retractor stretch (bent knee)
exercises.d: A seated stretch that opens the front of the shoulder and lengthens the muscles that lift and pull the arm.
i: Sit on the floor with one knee bent and the other leg comfortable.
Place your hands behind you on the floor, fingers pointing away.
Slowly slide your hips forward while keeping your chest tall.
Feel the stretch in the front of your shoulders.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Release slowly and repeat on the other side if needed.

exercises.n: estiramiento de yoga en postura del puente
exercises.d: A deep backbend where you press up from the floor, opening the chest and hips and strengthening the back of the body.
i: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat near your hips.
Place your hands beside your head, palms down, fingers toward your shoulders.
Press through hands and feet to lift your hips and chest.
Straighten your arms as far as is comfortable and relax your neck.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, then lower slowly.

exercises.n: masaje con rodillo en la espalda alta
exercises.d: Roll your upper back over a foam roller to loosen tight spots and improve thoracic mobility.
i: Sit with a foam roller behind your upper back and lie back onto it.
Cross your arms over your chest and lift your hips.
Roll slowly between your shoulder blades and mid back.
Pause on tender spots for a few breaths.
Avoid rolling your lower back and continue for about a minute.

exercises.n: estiramiento con rodillo de rotadores externos y extensores de cadera acostado (pierna cruzada)
exercises.en: roll recumbent hip external rotator and hip extensor stretch (crossed leg)
exercises.d: Lying on your back with one ankle crossed over the other knee, pull the legs in to stretch the glutes and deep hip rotators.
i: Lie on your back with both knees bent and feet flat.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Pull the bottom thigh toward your chest with both hands.
Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Release slowly and repeat on the other side if needed.

exercises.n: liberación del piriforme con pelota
exercises.d: Use a small ball under the buttock to ease tension in the piriformis and deep hip muscles.
i: Sit on the floor and place a ball under one buttock.
Cross that ankle over the opposite knee for more access.
Shift your weight to find a tender spot and stay there.
Breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds, then roll gently.
Switch sides.

exercises.n: liberación del pectoral con pelota
exercises.d: Pin a ball between your chest and a wall to release tight pectoral muscles.
i: Place a ball between your chest and a wall, just below the collarbone.
Lean in until you feel pressure on the chest muscle.
Roll slowly in small circles or up and down.
Hold on tender spots for a few breaths.
Switch sides after about 30-60 seconds.

exercises.n: liberación del trapecio superior con pelota
exercises.d: Roll a ball against a wall under the top of your shoulder to relieve tight upper trapezius muscles.
i: Stand with your back to a wall and place a ball on top of one shoulder.
Lean into the wall to press the ball into the muscle.
Move slowly by bending your knees.
Pause on tender spots and breathe.
Switch to the other shoulder.

exercises.n: balanceo completo con kettlebell
exercises.d: An explosive hip hinge that swings the kettlebell overhead, training the glutes, hamstrings and shoulders.
i: Stand with feet shoulder width apart, kettlebell on the floor in front.
Hinge at the hips and grip the handle with both hands.
Hike the bell back, then drive your hips forward to swing it overhead.
Let it fall back between your legs while hinging again.
Keep your back flat and repeat in a smooth rhythm.

exercises.n: press estricto con kettlebell
exercises.d: A standing overhead press with a kettlebell and no leg drive, focused on shoulder strength.
i: Hold the kettlebell at shoulder height in the rack position.
Stand tall with glutes and abs tight.
Press the bell straight overhead until your arm is locked out.
Lower it back to the shoulder under control.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: press sots con kettlebell
exercises.d: Press kettlebells overhead from the bottom of a deep squat to challenge shoulder stability and hip mobility.
i: Hold kettlebells in the rack position and sink into a deep squat.
Keep your chest up and heels flat.
Press the bells overhead while staying in the squat.
Lower them back to the shoulders with control.
Stand up and repeat once the set is done.

exercises.n: zancada hacia delante con kettlebell
exercises.d: A lunge stepping forward while holding a kettlebell, working the thighs and glutes.
i: Hold a kettlebell at your chest or by your side.
Step forward with one leg into a long stride.
Lower until both knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs for the set.

exercises.n: zancada hacia atrás con kettlebell
exercises.d: A reverse lunge holding a kettlebell, friendly on the knees while building glutes and thighs.
i: Hold a kettlebell at your chest or by your side.
Step one leg back and lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front shin vertical and torso tall.
Push through the front heel to stand.
Alternate legs for the set.

exercises.n: paseo del granjero con kettlebell
exercises.d: Walk while holding heavy kettlebells at your sides to build grip, posture and total body stability.
i: Stand between two kettlebells and pick them up with a flat back.
Stand tall with shoulders back and arms straight.
Walk with short, controlled steps.
Keep your core braced and avoid leaning.
Set the weights down carefully after the distance.

exercises.n: zancada, cargada y press con kettlebell
exercises.d: Combine a lunge with a kettlebell clean and overhead press for a full body strength move.
i: Start standing with a kettlebell hanging in one hand.
Step back into a lunge while cleaning the bell to your shoulder.
Rise from the lunge and press the bell overhead.
Lower the bell to the shoulder, then to your side.
Alternate legs and switch hands after the set.

exercises.n: slingshot con kettlebell
exercises.d: Pass a kettlebell around your waist in a circle to build core control and coordination.
i: Stand with feet shoulder width apart and hold the kettlebell in one hand.
Pass it behind your back to the other hand.
Bring it around your waist to the front.
Keep your hips square and core tight.
Repeat in the same direction, then reverse.

exercises.n: sentadilla deck con kettlebell
exercises.d: Roll back onto the floor holding a kettlebell from a squat, then roll up into a squat again.
i: Hold a kettlebell at your chest and squat down.
Sit back and roll onto your back, keeping the bell close.
Use momentum to roll forward onto your feet.
Stand up out of the squat.
Keep a tight grip and repeat smoothly.

exercises.n: flexión profunda con kettlebell
exercises.d: A push-up with hands on kettlebell handles to lower the chest deeper than the floor allows.
i: Place two kettlebells shoulder width apart and grip the handles.
Set up in a straight plank position.
Lower your chest below your hands with elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your body in a straight line.

exercises.n: zancada con elevación de pierna
exercises.d: A lunge followed by lifting the back leg, working the glutes and balance.
i: Stand tall and step one leg forward into a lunge.
Lower until both knees reach about 90 degrees.
Press up and lift the rear leg behind or beside you.
Hold briefly with your core tight.
Lower and repeat, then switch sides.

exercises.n: zancada con salto
exercises.d: A lunge followed by a jump where the legs switch in mid-air. It builds leg power and raises your heart rate.
i: Comienza de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros.
Da un paso adelante con el pie derecho, bajando el cuerpo hasta una posición de zancada.
Empújate con el pie derecho y salta al aire, cambiando la posición de los pies en pleno vuelo.
Aterriza suavemente con el pie izquierdo hacia adelante y baja inmediatamente el cuerpo a una posición de zancada.
Continúa alternando entre zancadas y saltos el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: puente a una pierna con flexión de cadera
exercises.en: single leg bridge with hip flexion
exercises.d: A one-legged glute bridge with the other knee drawn up, building glute strength and pelvic control.
i: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Lift one knee toward your chest.
Press through the other foot to raise your hips.
Keep your hips level and avoid arching.
Lower slowly and switch sides after the set.

exercises.n: puente lateral con balanceo de brazo y pierna
exercises.en: side bridge with arm leg swing
exercises.d: A side plank with the top arm and leg swinging, challenging the obliques and balance.
i: Lie on one side and prop yourself on your forearm.
Lift your hips into a straight line.
Raise the top leg and arm.
Swing them toward each other under control.
Keep your hips high, then switch sides.

exercises.n: peso muerto a una pierna con elevación de rodilla
exercises.en: single leg deadlift with knee lift
exercises.d: A single-leg hip hinge that ends with a knee drive, training balance, hamstrings and glutes.
i: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend.
Hinge forward as the other leg extends behind you.
Return to upright by squeezing the glute.
Drive the free knee up toward your chest.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: tijeras (avanzado)
exercises.d: Hold both legs low and cross them repeatedly like scissors, working the lower abs.
i: Lie on your back with legs extended and hands under your hips.
Lift your head, shoulders and legs slightly off the floor.
Cross one leg over the other in a scissor motion.
Alternate sides in a controlled rhythm.
Keep your lower back pressed down.

exercises.n: elevación de pierna a una pierna con peso
exercises.d: Lift one leg while loaded with ankle weight, targeting the glutes and hip extensors.
i: Wear ankle weights and get on hands and knees or lie face down.
Brace your core and keep your hips level.
Raise the weighted leg without swinging.
Pause at the top and squeeze.
Lower slowly and switch legs.

exercises.n: balancear los brazos rápido en el sitio
exercises.d: Swing your arms quickly while standing to warm up the shoulders and raise your heart rate.
i: Stand with feet hip width apart and knees soft.
Swing both arms across your chest and open wide.
Keep your torso upright and relaxed.
Increase speed gradually.
Continue for 30-60 seconds.

exercises.n: trotar rápido en el sitio
exercises.d: Trot in place at a quick pace to warm up and get your heart rate up.
i: Stand tall with arms bent at your sides.
Lift your knees and run lightly on the spot.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Pump your arms with each step.
Keep the pace for 30-60 seconds or longer.

exercises.n: elevación alterna de piernas acostado en el suelo
exercises.d: Raise one leg at a time while lying on the floor, working the lower abs.
i: Lie on your back with legs straight and arms at your sides.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Raise one leg to about 90 degrees.
Lower it slowly and lift the other leg.
Alternate without arching your back.

exercises.n: giro con banda elástica
exercises.d: A standing rotation against band resistance for the obliques and core.
i: Anchor a band at chest height and hold the handle with both hands.
Stand sideways with arms extended.
Rotate your torso away from the anchor.
Return under control.
Finish reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: sentadilla con barra
exercises.d: The classic barbell squat that builds strength in the thighs and hips.
i: Set the bar on your upper back and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Sit your hips back and down until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your feet to stand tall.

exercises.n: abdominal con extensión de piernas (con balón de estabilidad)
exercises.d: A crunch on a stability ball combined with extending the legs for a deep ab workout.
i: Sit on a stability ball and walk your feet out until your back is supported.
Place your hands lightly behind your head.
Crunch up as you extend one leg.
Lower slowly and bend the knee.
Alternate legs for the set.

exercises.n: prensa de piernas a 45 grados con postura cerrada en trineo
exercises.en: sled 45 degrees narrow stance leg press
exercises.d: A 45 degree sled leg press with feet close together to emphasise the quads.
i: Sit in the sled with your back flat on the pad and feet close together on the platform.
Release the safety handles.
Lower the sled until your knees are bent to about 90 degrees.
Press through your feet to extend your legs without locking your knees.
Keep your hips on the seat.

exercises.n: prensa de piernas a 45 grados con postura abierta en trineo
exercises.en: sled 45 degrees wide stance leg press
exercises.d: A 45 degree sled leg press with a wide foot position that brings in the inner thighs and glutes.
i: Sit in the sled with your back flat on the pad and feet wide on the platform, toes slightly out.
Release the safety handles.
Lower the sled with your knees tracking over your toes.
Press back up without locking your knees.
Keep your hips on the seat.

exercises.n: abdominal con giro (brazos rectos)
exercises.d: A crunch with a twist and arms extended to work the abs and obliques.
i: Lie on your back with knees bent and arms straight up.
Lift your shoulders off the floor.
Twist to reach one side.
Return to center and twist the other way.
Keep your lower back on the floor.

exercises.n: v up
exercises.d: Lift your legs and torso together to form a V, a demanding core move.
i: Lie flat with arms extended overhead.
Raise legs and torso at the same time.
Reach your hands toward your toes.
Lower with control without touching the floor.
Keep your legs as straight as you can.

exercises.n: elevación vertical de piernas (en paralelas) v. 3
exercises.en: vertical leg raise (on parallel bars) v. 3
exercises.d: Support yourself on parallel bars and lift your legs to train the lower abs and hip flexors.
i: Support yourself on parallel bars with straight arms and shoulders down.
Let your legs hang together.
Raise your legs in front of you until they are about parallel to the floor or higher.
Lower slowly without swinging.
Keep your torso still.

exercises.n: estiramiento de isquiotibiales y espalda de pie
exercises.d: Fold forward from standing to lengthen the hamstrings and lower back.
i: Stand tall with feet hip width apart.
Hinge forward at the hips with a long spine.
Let your arms hang toward the floor.
Keep your knees soft.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Release slowly and repeat on the other side if needed.

exercises.n: estiramiento de movilidad sumo sentado
exercises.d: Sit with legs wide and lean forward to open the inner thighs and hips.
i: Sit on the floor with legs spread wide.
Keep your back straight and toes pointing up.
Lean forward from the hips.
Place your hands on the floor in front of you.
Stay for 20-30 seconds, then return slowly.

exercises.n: estiramiento sumo sentado con giro a la derecha
exercises.d: From a wide seated position, twist toward the right leg to stretch the inner thigh and torso.
i: Sit with legs spread wide and back tall.
Rotate your torso to the right.
Reach both hands toward your right foot.
Keep your hips grounded.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Release slowly and repeat on the other side if needed.

exercises.n: estiramiento sumo sentado con giro a la izquierda
exercises.d: From a wide seated position, twist toward the left leg to stretch the inner thigh and torso.
i: Sit with legs spread wide and back tall.
Rotate your torso to the left.
Reach both hands toward your left foot.
Keep your hips grounded.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Release slowly and repeat on the other side if needed.

exercises.n: estiramiento de movilidad sumo sentado con brazos arriba
exercises.en: sitting sumo with arms up mobility stretch
exercises.d: A wide seated stretch with arms overhead to open the hips, inner thighs and shoulders.
i: Sit with legs spread wide and back straight.
Raise both arms overhead.
Lean forward slowly from the hips.
Keep your arms extended and your chest open.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then sit tall.

exercises.n: zancada hacia adelante contralateral con mancuernas
exercises.d: A dumbbell lunge stepping forward with the opposite arm movement. It trains the glutes, quads and balance.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros, sujetando una mancuerna en cada mano.
Da un paso adelante con el pie derecho, manteniendo la espalda recta y el core activado.
Baja el cuerpo flexionando ambas rodillas hasta que el muslo derecho quede paralelo al suelo.
Empuja con el talón derecho para regresar a la posición inicial.
Repite con la pierna izquierda.
Alterna las piernas el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: rodillas altas contra la pared
exercises.d: A high-knee run in place with the hands on a wall for support. It raises the heart rate and trains the hip flexors.
i: Ponte de pie frente a una pared con los pies separados a la altura de las caderas.
Coloca las manos en la pared para mayor apoyo.
Activa el core y levanta la rodilla derecha hacia el pecho, mientras mantienes el pie izquierdo en el suelo.
Cambia rápidamente de pierna, llevando la rodilla izquierda hacia el pecho y bajando el pie derecho de nuevo.
Continúa alternando las piernas con un movimiento de carrera, llevando las rodillas lo más alto posible.
Mantén un ritmo rápido y la parte superior del cuerpo estable durante todo el ejercicio.
Repite durante la duración o el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: carrera en rueda
exercises.d: A fast running motion while holding on to a wheel. It raises your heart rate and challenges the core and shoulders.
i: Comienza en posición de plancha con las manos sobre el rodillo y el cuerpo recto.
Activa el core y comienza a hacer rodar el rodillo hacia adelante extendiendo los brazos.
Continúa rodando hasta que tu cuerpo quede completamente extendido y los brazos por encima de la cabeza.
Invierte el movimiento tirando del rodillo de vuelta hacia tu cuerpo, usando el core y los brazos.
