Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: empuje a carrera
exercises.d: A push-up that flows into fast alternating knee drives in the plank position. It raises the heart rate and trains the chest and core.
i: Comienza en posición de flexión con las manos separadas a la altura de los hombros y el cuerpo en línea recta.
Baja el pecho hacia el suelo flexionando los codos, manteniendo el cuerpo recto.
Empuja con las manos para extender los brazos y volver a la posición inicial.
Lleva rápidamente una rodilla hacia el pecho, luego cambia rápidamente y lleva la otra rodilla hacia el pecho.
Continúa alternando las rodillas tan rápido como puedas manteniendo una buena forma.
Continúa durante el tiempo o el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: giro acostado con rodillas flexionadas (masculino)
exercises.d: A lying twist with the knees bent, lowering them to each side. It loosens the lower back and hips.
i: Túmbate sobre tu espalda con las rodillas flexionadas y los pies apoyados en el suelo.
Extiende los brazos hacia los lados, perpendiculares al cuerpo.
Manteniendo las rodillas juntas, bájalas lentamente hacia un lado, intentando tocar el suelo con las rodillas.
Haz una pausa breve, luego activa el core y levanta lentamente las rodillas de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el movimiento hacia el otro lado.
Continúa alternando lados durante el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: abdominal con toque de rodilla
exercises.d: A crunch where the opposite hand reaches toward the knee on each rep. It trains the abs and obliques.
i: Túmbate sobre tu espalda con las rodillas flexionadas y los pies apoyados en el suelo.
Coloca las manos detrás de la cabeza con los codos apuntando hacia afuera.
Activando el abdomen, levanta los omóplatos del suelo y extiende la mano derecha hacia la rodilla izquierda.
Vuelve a la posición inicial y repite, esta vez extendiendo la mano izquierda hacia la rodilla derecha.
Continúa alternando lados durante el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: paso de rodillas con balanceo y peso
exercises.d: A kneeling step combined with a weighted swing. It trains the shoulders and core.
i: Comienza en posición de rodillas con las rodillas separadas a la altura de las caderas y la espalda recta.
Sostén un peso en cada mano, con los brazos extendidos rectos hacia abajo frente a ti.
Activa el core y balancea los pesos hacia arriba y por encima de la cabeza, manteniendo los brazos rectos.
Baja los pesos de nuevo a la posición inicial y repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: zancada con estiramiento y peso
exercises.d: A weighted lunge into a deep stretch for the hips. It trains the glutes and quads while opening up the hip flexors.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros.
Da un paso adelante con el pie derecho, manteniendo la espalda recta.
Baja el cuerpo flexionando las rodillas hasta que el muslo derecho quede paralelo al suelo.
Empuja con el talón derecho para regresar a la posición inicial.
Repite con la pierna izquierda.
Continúa alternando las piernas durante el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: sentadilla cosaca con peso (masculino)
exercises.d: A weighted side-to-side squat, shifting weight deeply over one leg with the other straight. It trains the glutes, quads and adductors.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies más separados que la anchura de los hombros y la punta de los pies apuntando ligeramente hacia afuera.
Sostén un peso frente al pecho con ambas manos.
Traslada tu peso hacia un lado y baja el cuerpo flexionando la rodilla del lado hacia el que te inclinaste, manteniendo la otra pierna recta.
Baja todo lo que puedas mientras mantienes el equilibrio y el pecho elevado.
Empuja con el talón de la pierna flexionada para volver a la posición inicial.
Repite con el otro lado, alternando entre las piernas.

exercises.n: zancada con balanceo y peso
exercises.d: A weighted lunge with an arm swing as you step forward. It trains the glutes, quads and shoulders.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros, sosteniendo un peso en cada mano.
Da un paso adelante con el pie derecho, bajando el cuerpo hasta una posición de zancada.
Mientras avanzas en la zancada, balancea los pesos hacia adelante y hacia arriba, manteniendo los brazos rectos.
Empújate con el pie derecho y vuelve a la posición inicial, balanceando los pesos de nuevo hacia abajo.
Repite con el pie izquierdo y continúa alternando las piernas el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: puente a una pierna con pierna extendida
exercises.en: single leg bridge with outstretched leg
exercises.d: A single leg glute bridge with the other leg held straight out. It trains the glutes and hamstrings and tests the core.
i: Túmbate sobre tu espalda con las rodillas flexionadas y los pies apoyados en el suelo.
Extiende una pierna recta hacia delante.
Activa los glúteos y levanta las caderas del suelo, formando una línea recta desde las rodillas hasta los hombros.
Mantén la posición alta por un momento, luego baja lentamente las caderas de nuevo a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado, luego cambia de pierna.

exercises.n: salto al cajón
exercises.d: An explosive jump onto a box that builds leg power.
i: Stand facing a sturdy box with feet shoulder width apart.
Swing your arms back and dip your hips.
Jump up and land softly on top of the box.
Stand fully upright.
Step down carefully and reset.

exercises.n: marcha de la muerte con peso muerto rumano y mancuernas
exercises.d: Walk forward doing Romanian deadlifts with dumbbells, a balance and hamstring challenge.
i: Hold dumbbells at your sides and stand tall.
Hinge at the hips on one leg as you step forward.
Keep your back flat and raise the rear leg.
Stand tall and step into the next rep.
Alternate legs as you move forward.

exercises.n: peso muerto rumano con postura dividida y barra hexagonal
exercises.d: A Romanian deadlift in a staggered stance using a trap bar for hamstring and glute strength.
i: Stand inside a trap bar with one foot slightly behind.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back.
Lower the bar along your legs.
Drive your hips forward to stand.
Finish reps, then switch the stance.

exercises.n: carrera de sprinter asistida con banda elástica
exercises.d: A sprinting drill with band assistance to practice fast leg turnover.
i: Anchor a band behind you and loop it around your waist.
Lean forward into a sprint position.
Drive your knees and pump your arms.
Stay light on your feet.
Repeat for short bursts.

exercises.n: remo acostado en rack con barra
exercises.d: Lie under a barbell on a rack and pull your chest up to it for the back muscles.
i: Set a barbell on a rack at a height you can reach lying down.
Lie under it and grip the bar overhand.
Pull your chest toward the bar.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly to full extension.

exercises.n: zancada caminando con rodillas altas
exercises.d: A walking lunge with a high knee between each step. It raises your heart rate and trains the legs.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de la cadera.
Levanta la rodilla derecha hacia el pecho lo más alto que puedas mientras mantienes el equilibrio sobre la pierna izquierda.
Da un paso adelante con el pie derecho y baja el cuerpo a una posición de zancada, flexionando ambas rodillas a un ángulo de 90 grados.
Empújate con el pie derecho y lleva la rodilla izquierda hacia el pecho.
Da un paso adelante con el pie izquierdo y baja el cuerpo a una posición de zancada.
Continúa alternando las piernas y avanzando con zancadas, manteniendo el core activado y un ritmo constante.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: carrera de paso corto
exercises.d: A run with short, quick strides. It raises the heart rate and builds foot speed.
i: Busca un espacio abierto o una cinta de correr para realizar el ejercicio.
Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de la cadera.
Comienza a trotar en el lugar, levantando las rodillas alto y moviendo los brazos.
Después de unos segundos, comienza a dar pasos cortos hacia delante, manteniendo un ritmo rápido.
Continúa corriendo con pasos cortos durante la duración o distancia deseada.

exercises.n: posición estática acostado de espaldas con almohadilla
exercises.en: static position lying back with pad
exercises.d: Hold a lying position on your back with a pad as a reference for setup and posture.
i: Place a pad on the floor or bench.
Lie on your back with your head supported.
Keep your spine neutral.
Relax your arms at your sides.
Hold the position and breathe.

exercises.n: posición estática sentado con la espalda en almohadilla
exercises.en: static position seated back with pad
exercises.d: Sit with your back against a pad to hold a proper seated posture.
i: Sit on the seat with your back against the pad.
Keep your feet flat on the floor.
Press your back gently into the pad.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.
Hold the position and breathe.

exercises.n: posición estática de pie
exercises.d: Hold a tall standing posture as a reference position.
i: Stand with feet hip width apart.
Keep your knees soft.
Stack ribs over hips and shoulders back.
Let your arms hang.
Hold and breathe steadily.

exercises.n: posición estática acostado boca abajo
exercises.d: Hold a face-down position to practice setting up for prone exercises.
i: Lie face down on a mat.
Extend your legs and rest your forehead down.
Keep your arms alongside your body.
Keep your hips relaxed.
Hold and breathe.

exercises.n: posición estática sentado de espaldas
exercises.d: Hold an upright seated posture with no pad.
i: Sit tall with feet flat on the floor.
Keep your back straight.
Place your hands on your thighs.
Relax your shoulders.
Hold and breathe.

exercises.n: flexión pike a cobra
exercises.d: A push-up flow that moves from pike position down and through to a cobra. It trains the shoulders, chest and spine mobility.
i: Comienza en posición de flexión con las manos un poco más separadas que la anchura de los hombros y los pies juntos.
Activa el core y eleva las caderas hacia el techo, formando una V invertida con tu cuerpo.
Baja la parte superior del cuerpo hacia el suelo flexionando los codos, manteniéndolos cerca del cuerpo.
Al bajar, desplaza el peso hacia adelante y haz la transición a una postura de cobra estirando los brazos y elevando el pecho.
Invierte el movimiento flexionando los codos y bajando el pecho de nuevo hacia el suelo.
Empuja con las manos para volver a la posición de V invertida.
Continúa el movimiento bajando las caderas de nuevo hacia el suelo, volviendo a la posición inicial de flexión.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: plancha reversa con elevación de pierna
exercises.d: A reverse plank where you lift one leg at a time. It trains the abs, glutes and the back of the body.
i: Siéntate en el suelo con las piernas extendidas frente a ti y las manos apoyadas en el suelo detrás de ti, con los dedos apuntando hacia los pies.
Presiona con las manos y levanta las caderas del suelo, llegando a una posición de plancha inversa.
Activa el core y levanta una pierna del suelo, extendiéndola recta hacia el techo.
Mantén la posición por un momento y luego baja la pierna de nuevo.
Repite con la otra pierna.
Continúa alternando las piernas durante el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: plancha lateral con apertura posterior y mancuerna
exercises.en: dumbbell side plank with rear fly
exercises.d: A dumbbell side plank with a reverse fly. It trains the rear delts, upper back and obliques.
i: Comienza tumbado de lado con las piernas extendidas y apiladas una sobre la otra.
Coloca el antebrazo en el suelo, justo debajo del hombro, manteniendo el codo flexionado en un ángulo de 90 grados.
Sujeta una mancuerna con la mano de arriba, con el brazo extendido recto hacia el suelo.
Activa el core y levanta las caderas del suelo, formando una línea recta desde la cabeza hasta los talones.
Manteniendo la posición de plancha lateral, levanta la mancuerna hacia el techo, apretando los omóplatos entre sí.
Baja la mancuerna de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado, luego cambia de lado.

exercises.n: plancha power point
exercises.d: A plank where you shift from your hands to your forearms and back, one arm at a time. It trains the abs and shoulders.
i: Comienza en posición de plancha alta con las manos directamente debajo de los hombros y el cuerpo en línea recta de la cabeza a los pies.
Activa el core y aprieta los glúteos para mantener una posición estable.
Baja el cuerpo hasta los antebrazos, un brazo a la vez, manteniendo una línea recta de la cabeza a los pies.
Mantén esta posición durante el tiempo deseado, con el core y los glúteos activados.
Para volver a la posición inicial, empuja con los antebrazos y eleva el cuerpo de nuevo a una posición de plancha alta.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: caminata en cinta inclinada
exercises.d: A walk on a treadmill with an incline, which makes the glutes and calves work harder. A steady, low impact cardio option.
i: Ajusta el nivel de inclinación de la cinta de correr a la intensidad deseada.
Ponte de pie sobre la cinta de correr con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros.
Comienza a caminar a un ritmo cómodo, asegurándote de mantener una forma correcta.
Activa los músculos del core y mantén la espalda recta durante todo el ejercicio.
Continúa caminando en la cinta inclinada durante la duración deseada de tu entrenamiento cardiovascular.
Disminuye gradualmente la inclinación y la velocidad de la cinta para enfriar antes de detenerte.

exercises.n: aducción de cadera acostado de lado (masculino)
exercises.d: A side-lying leg exercise that targets the inner thighs. It trains the adductors and hip stability.
i: Túmbate de lado con las piernas rectas y apiladas una sobre la otra.
Coloca el brazo de abajo bajo la cabeza para apoyarte.
Activa los aductores y levanta la pierna de arriba lo más alto posible sin rotar las caderas ni inclinarte hacia atrás.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la posición alta, luego baja lentamente la pierna de nuevo a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado, luego cambia de lado.

exercises.n: press de pecho acostado en el suelo con mancuernas
exercises.en: dumbbell lying on floor chest press
exercises.d: A dumbbell press performed lying on the floor, which limits the range of motion and is easy on the shoulders.
i: Lie on the floor holding dumbbells above your chest.
Lower them until your upper arms touch the floor.
Pause briefly.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your wrists straight.

exercises.n: arquero de pie
exercises.d: A standing movement that rotates the torso and draws one arm back like pulling a bow. It mobilises the upper back and shoulders.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros y las rodillas ligeramente flexionadas.
Extiende los brazos rectos hacia adelante a la altura de los hombros, paralelos al suelo.
Gira el torso hacia la derecha, manteniendo los brazos extendidos y la espalda recta.
Mientras giras, extiende el brazo derecho hacia adelante y el brazo izquierdo hacia atrás, imitando el movimiento de tensar un arco.
Mantén la posición por un momento y luego vuelve a la posición inicial.
Repite el movimiento, esta vez girando el torso hacia la izquierda y extendiendo el brazo izquierdo hacia adelante y el brazo derecho hacia atrás.
Continúa alternando lados durante el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: abdominal declinado con peso
exercises.d: A weighted sit-up on a decline bench. It trains the abs through a long range.
i: Túmbate boca arriba en un banco declinado con los pies sujetos debajo de las almohadillas para los pies.
Coloca las manos detrás de la cabeza o cruzadas sobre el pecho.
Activa el abdomen y levanta lentamente la parte superior del cuerpo del banco, curvándote hacia adelante hasta que el torso quede perpendicular al suelo.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte superior, luego baja lentamente la parte superior del cuerpo de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: paso de esquí
exercises.d: A side-to-side hopping drill that imitates a skier. It raises the heart rate and builds leg stamina.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros.
Dobla ligeramente las rodillas y mantén la espalda recta.
Salta hacia la derecha, aterrizando sobre el pie derecho mientras balanceas la pierna izquierda detrás de la pierna derecha.
Salta inmediatamente hacia la izquierda, aterrizando sobre el pie izquierdo mientras balanceas la pierna derecha detrás de la pierna izquierda.
Continúa alternando los saltos de lado a lado, imitando un movimiento de esquí.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: paso adelante y atrás
exercises.d: A stepping drill moving forward and back with the legs alternating. It raises the heart rate and warms up the legs.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros.
Da un paso adelante con el pie derecho, flexionando la rodilla y bajando el cuerpo hacia una posición de zancada.
Empuja con el pie derecho y da un paso atrás para regresar a la posición inicial.
Repite el movimiento con el pie izquierdo, alternando las piernas en cada paso.
Continúa dando pasos hacia adelante y hacia atrás, manteniendo un ritmo constante.
Repite durante la duración o el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: postura de pie (revisión de técnica) vista frontal
exercises.d: A front-view form check showing a correct standing posture.
i: Stand with feet hip width apart.
Keep your knees soft and hips level.
Stack your shoulders over your hips.
Look straight ahead.
Compare yourself to the correct posture.

exercises.n: postura de pie (revisión de técnica) vista lateral
exercises.d: A side-view form check showing a correct standing posture.
i: Stand with feet hip width apart.
Keep your ears over your shoulders and hips.
Keep a natural curve in your lower back.
Relax your arms.
Compare yourself to the correct posture.

exercises.n: salto de cuerda de lado a lado
exercises.d: Jump rope while hopping side to side to raise your heart rate and improve agility.
i: Hold the rope handles and stand tall.
Swing the rope overhead.
Hop side to side over the rope.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep a steady rhythm.

exercises.n: salto de cuerda con skip
exercises.d: Jump rope with an alternating skip step for a lighter, rhythmic cardio workout.
i: Hold the rope handles and swing the rope overhead.
Skip over the rope, alternating feet.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep your elbows near your sides.
Continue at a steady pace.

exercises.n: salto de cuerda con rodillas altas
exercises.d: Jump rope while driving your knees high for a hard cardio effort.
i: Hold the rope handles and swing the rope overhead.
Run over the rope.
Lift your knees to hip height.
Stay on the balls of your feet.
Keep your torso upright.

exercises.n: salto de cuerda alto
exercises.d: Jump rope with higher jumps to add power and intensity.
i: Hold the rope handles and stand tall.
Swing the rope overhead.
Jump higher than usual.
Land softly with bent knees.
Keep your rhythm.

exercises.n: abdominal con brazos en el pecho
exercises.d: A sit-up with the arms crossed on the chest. It trains the abs and hip flexors.
i: Túmbate sobre tu espalda con las rodillas flexionadas y los pies apoyados en el suelo.
Cruza los brazos sobre el pecho.
Contrayendo el abdomen, levanta la parte superior del cuerpo del suelo hacia las rodillas.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte superior, luego baja lentamente la parte superior del cuerpo de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: balanceo con kettlebell y agarre por encima
exercises.d: A kettlebell swing with an overhand grip that builds explosive hip power and a strong posterior chain.
i: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and a kettlebell on the floor in front of you.
Hinge at the hips and grip the handle with an overhand grip.
Hike the bell back between your legs.
Snap your hips forward and swing it to chest height.
Let it fall back and hinge again, keeping your back flat.

exercises.n: press de banca con mancuernas apretadas
exercises.d: A bench press with dumbbells pressed together to keep constant tension in the chest.
i: Lie on a bench holding dumbbells pressed together above your chest.
Squeeze them together throughout.
Lower them to your chest.
Press back up.
Keep your feet planted.

exercises.n: curl de bíceps inclinado alternado con mancuernas
exercises.d: Curl dumbbells one at a time while lying back on an incline bench to stretch and work the biceps.
i: Sit back on an incline bench with dumbbells hanging down.
Curl one dumbbell up with the palm facing up.
Lower it slowly.
Curl the other arm.
Keep your upper arms still.

exercises.n: zancada cruzada goblet con mancuerna
exercises.d: Hold a dumbbell at your chest and step behind and across into a curtsey lunge.
i: Hold a dumbbell at your chest.
Step one leg behind and across the other.
Lower until both knees bend.
Press through the front leg to return.
Alternate legs for the set.

exercises.n: rotación externa con mancuerna
exercises.d: A light external rotation for the rotator cuff.
i: Lie on your side with a dumbbell in the top hand and elbow bent.
Keep your elbow tucked at your side.
Rotate your forearm upward.
Lower slowly.
Switch sides after the set.

exercises.n: elevaciones laterales con pecho apoyado y mancuernas
exercises.d: Lateral raises with your chest on an incline bench to remove cheating and isolate the delts.
i: Lie chest-down on an incline bench holding dumbbells.
Raise your arms out to the sides.
Stop at shoulder height.
Lower slowly.
Keep your neck neutral.

exercises.n: sostén de rodillas a de pie con mancuerna
exercises.d: Move from a kneeling position to standing while holding a dumbbell.
i: Kneel on both knees holding a dumbbell at your chest.
Step one foot forward into a half-kneel.
Drive through that foot to stand.
Lower back into the kneeling position.
Alternate lead legs.

exercises.n: curl de bíceps arrastrado con mancuernas
exercises.d: A curl where the dumbbells travel up close to your torso, dragging along your body. It keeps tension on the biceps and limits shoulder swing.
i: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand, palms forward.
Pull your elbows back slightly and curl the weights up, keeping them close to your body.
Squeeze your biceps at the top without letting your elbows drift forward.
Lower the dumbbells slowly along the same path.
Keep your torso still and avoid swinging.

exercises.n: curl de bíceps sentado con agarre inverso y mancuernas
exercises.en: dumbbell seated reverse grip biceps curl
exercises.d: A seated curl with an overhand grip that hits the forearms and brachialis hard along with the biceps.
i: Sit on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing down, arms hanging at your sides.
Keep your elbows pinned to your sides and curl the weights up.
Stop when your forearms are near vertical and your wrists stay straight.
Lower the dumbbells slowly until your arms are fully extended.
Use a lighter weight than a normal curl.

exercises.n: elevación frontal sentado a un brazo con mancuerna
exercises.en: dumbbell seated one arm front raise
exercises.d: A seated single-arm raise that targets the front of the shoulder without leg drive helping out.
i: Sit upright on a bench holding a dumbbell in one hand, arm down at your thigh.
Raise the dumbbell straight in front of you to shoulder height with a soft elbow.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower it slowly back to your thigh.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: press de hombros sentado en balón de estabilidad con mancuernas
exercises.en: dumbbell seated on exercise ball shoulder press
exercises.d: An overhead press on a stability ball. The unstable seat makes your core work along with the shoulders.
i: Sit on a stability ball with your feet wide and a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height.
Brace your core and sit tall.
Press the dumbbells overhead until your arms are almost straight.
Lower them back to shoulder height with control.
Keep your ribs down and avoid leaning back.

exercises.n: sentadilla dividida goblet con mancuerna
exercises.d: A split squat holding one dumbbell at your chest. Great for working each leg on its own while the front load keeps you upright.
i: Hold one dumbbell vertically against your chest and step into a split stance.
Keep your torso tall and lower your back knee toward the floor.
Stop when your front thigh is about parallel to the ground.
Push through your front foot to stand back up.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: sentadilla goblet al cajón con mancuerna
exercises.d: A goblet squat that touches a box behind you, teaching depth control and sitting back into your hips.
i: Place a box or bench behind you and hold a dumbbell at your chest.
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Push your hips back and lower until you lightly touch the box.
Keep your chest up and knees in line with your toes.
Drive through your heels to stand up without rocking.

exercises.n: rotación externa con apoyo en banco y mancuerna
exercises.d: A light rotation exercise lying on a bench that strengthens the small rotator cuff muscles around the shoulder.
i: Lie on your side on a bench with a light dumbbell in your top hand, elbow bent 90 degrees at your side.
Keep your elbow tucked against your ribs.
Rotate your forearm upward, lifting the dumbbell toward the ceiling.
Lower it slowly back to the start.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: apertura posterior inclinada alternada con mancuernas
exercises.d: A chest-supported reverse fly done one arm at a time, aimed at the rear delts and upper back.
i: Lie chest down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging.
Raise one arm out to the side with a soft elbow until it is level with your shoulder.
Squeeze your shoulder blade, then lower slowly.
Repeat with the other arm.
Keep your neck relaxed and avoid swinging.

exercises.n: press de banca alternado con mancuernas (inicio alto)
exercises.d: A dumbbell bench press where you press one arm at a time, starting with both weights held high. It challenges chest strength and stability.
i: Lie on a flat bench and press both dumbbells up above your chest.
Keep one arm locked out and lower the other dumbbell to chest level.
Press it back up to the top.
Repeat with the other arm, alternating each rep.
Keep your feet planted and your back flat on the bench.

exercises.n: apertura de deltoide posterior inclinado alternada con mancuernas
exercises.en: dumbbell bent over alternate rear delt fly
exercises.d: A bent-over fly performed one arm at a time to target the rear shoulders and upper back.
i: Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back, a dumbbell in each hand hanging down.
Raise one arm out to the side to shoulder height with a soft elbow.
Lower it slowly.
Repeat with the other arm, alternating.
Keep your torso still and your neck neutral.

exercises.n: remo para deltoide posterior de rodillas en polea (con cuerda) (masculino)
exercises.en: cable kneeling rear delt row (with rope) (male)
exercises.d: A kneeling cable row with a rope that targets the rear delts. It trains the shoulders and upper back.
i: Sujeta una agarradera de cuerda a una polea baja y ponte de rodillas frente a la máquina.
Sujeta la cuerda con un agarre neutro (las palmas una frente a la otra) y extiende los brazos completamente frente a ti.
Manteniendo la espalda recta y el core activado, jala la cuerda hacia el cuerpo retrayendo los omóplatos.
Aprieta los omóplatos al final del movimiento y mantén la posición por una breve pausa.
Libera lentamente la tensión y vuelve a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: gusano v. 2
exercises.d: An inchworm walk-out, walking the hands forward into a plank and the feet back in. It stretches the hamstrings and trains the core and shoulders.
i: Comienza de pie con los pies separados a la altura de las caderas.
Inclínate hacia adelante desde la cintura y coloca las manos en el suelo frente a ti.
Camina con las manos hacia adelante hasta quedar en posición de plancha alta, con el cuerpo en línea recta de la cabeza a los pies.
Manteniendo las piernas rectas, camina con los pies hacia las manos, llevando las caderas hacia el techo.
Continúa caminando con las manos hacia adelante, repitiendo el movimiento durante el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: toque al hombro
exercises.d: A high plank where you tap the opposite shoulder with each hand. It trains the abs and builds shoulder stability.
i: Comienza en una posición de plancha alta con las manos justo debajo de los hombros y el cuerpo en línea recta.
Activa el core y levanta la mano derecha del suelo, extendiéndola para tocar el hombro izquierdo.
Coloca la mano derecha de nuevo en el suelo y repite tocando el hombro derecho con la mano izquierda.
Continúa alternando los toques de hombro mientras mantienes las caderas y el torso estables.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: salto con rodillas al pecho v. 2
exercises.d: An explosive jump where you pull your knees toward your chest in the air. It builds power and gets your heart rate up quickly.
i: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and arms ready.
Dip into a quarter squat and swing your arms up.
Jump as high as you can and pull your knees toward your chest.
Land softly on the balls of your feet with bent knees.
Reset briefly and repeat.

exercises.n: sprints con rodillas altas
exercises.d: Running in place at full speed with your knees driving high. A quick way to raise your heart rate and warm up your legs.
i: Stand tall with your arms bent at your sides.
Start running in place, driving each knee up to hip height.
Pump your arms in rhythm with your legs.
Stay on the balls of your feet and keep your chest up.
Go hard for 20 to 30 seconds, then rest.

exercises.n: zancada con pulso hacia delante y manos arriba
exercises.en: forward pulse lunge with hands overhead
exercises.d: A forward lunge held in the bottom position where you pulse up and down with your arms overhead. It burns the legs and challenges balance.
i: Stand tall and raise both arms straight overhead.
Step one foot forward into a lunge and lower until both knees are about 90 degrees.
Pulse up and down a few inches in the low position.
Push back to standing.
Switch legs and repeat.

exercises.n: frogger
exercises.d: A fast floor drill where you hop your feet out and in from a squat to a plank. It works your legs, core and heart at once.
i: Start in a deep squat with your hands on the floor.
Jump or step your feet back into a plank.
Hop your feet to the outside of your hands.
Stand up or jump up from the squat.
Repeat at a steady quick pace.

exercises.n: doble sentadilla con salto
exercises.d: A squat followed by two quick jumps in a row. It builds explosive leg power and stamina.
i: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Lower into a squat and explode into a jump.
Land softly and immediately jump a second time.
Land with bent knees and sink back into the squat.
Keep your chest up and repeat.

exercises.n: squat thrust
exercises.d: A burpee without the push-up and jump. You drop to a plank and spring back to your feet for a steady conditioning move.
i: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Squat down and place your hands on the floor.
Kick your feet back into a plank.
Jump your feet back toward your hands.
Stand up and repeat at a steady pace.

exercises.n: sentadilla con salto y rodillas al pecho
exercises.d: A squat that explodes into a tuck jump. It trains explosive leg power and fast landings.
i: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Lower into a squat with your arms back.
Explode upward and pull your knees toward your chest.
Land softly with bent knees.
Sink straight into the next squat and repeat.

exercises.n: press y sentadilla con mancuernas (muslos)
exercises.d: A squat combined with an overhead press. The legs drive the movement while the shoulders finish the press.
i: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Drive up through your heels as you stand.
Use that momentum to press the dumbbells overhead.
Lower them to your shoulders and go into the next squat.

exercises.n: zancada cardio
exercises.d: Lunges done at a brisk pace to lift your heart rate while working the legs.
i: Stand tall with your hands on your hips or swinging with the movement.
Step forward and lower into a lunge.
Push off the front foot and return to standing.
Switch legs and keep a quick rhythm.
Keep your torso upright throughout.

exercises.n: sentadilla sobre la cabeza con mancuernas
exercises.d: A squat with dumbbells held locked out overhead. It builds leg strength and demands strong shoulders and core.
i: Press two dumbbells overhead with your arms straight.
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Sit down into a squat while keeping the weights above your head.
Keep your chest up and ribs down.
Stand back up, driving through your heels.

exercises.n: sentadilla dividida con pie delantero elevado en bosu y mancuernas
exercises.en: dumbbell split squat front foot elevated with bosu ball
exercises.d: A split squat with the front foot on a bosu ball for a deeper range and extra balance work.
i: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and place your front foot on a bosu ball, back foot behind you.
Keep your torso upright.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Press through your front foot to stand.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: subida al cajón a una pierna v. 2
exercises.d: Step up onto a box or bench with one leg to build single-leg strength.
i: Stand facing a sturdy box or bench.
Place one foot fully on it.
Drive through that heel to stand tall on the box.
Lower slowly back down.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: elevación de gemelos de pie a una pierna con apoyo
exercises.en: standing single leg calf raise with support
exercises.d: Raise your heel on one leg while holding a support for balance, building the calf.
i: Stand on one foot and hold a wall or rail for balance.
Rise as high as you can onto the ball of your foot.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly below flat if you can do so comfortably.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: elevación de gemelos de pie a una pierna con mancuerna v. 2
exercises.en: dumbbell standing single leg calf raise v. 2
exercises.d: A one-legged calf raise holding a dumbbell for extra load. It builds calf strength and ankle balance.
i: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and stand on the opposite leg, lightly touching a wall for balance.
Rise up onto the ball of your foot as high as you can.
Pause at the top.
Lower your heel slowly below the start if possible.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: equilibrio a una pierna
exercises.d: A simple balance hold on one leg that trains stability in the ankle, hip and core.
i: Stand tall with your feet together.
Lift one foot off the floor and bend the knee slightly.
Keep your hips level and eyes on a fixed point.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds.
Switch legs and repeat.

exercises.n: equilibrio a una pierna en bosu
exercises.en: single leg stand on bosu ball
exercises.d: A balance hold on one leg on an unstable bosu ball. It challenges the ankle and hip stabilisers.
i: Place a bosu ball dome-up in front of you.
Step onto it with one foot near the center.
Lift your other foot and hold it off the ground.
Keep your hips level and your core tight.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds, then switch legs.

exercises.n: sentadilla dividida con rodada
exercises.d: A split squat paired with a backward roll to challenge your control and leg strength.
i: Start in a split stance with your torso upright.
Lower into a split squat until the front thigh is parallel.
Sit back and roll onto your back with control.
Roll up and return to the split stance.
Stand and repeat, then switch legs.

exercises.n: sentadilla lateral dividida con rodada
exercises.d: A lateral squat done from a split position, followed by a roll, for leg strength and coordination.
i: Stand with feet wide and toes forward.
Shift your weight to one side and squat on that leg, keeping the other leg straight.
Roll back with control and roll up again.
Push back to the centre.
Alternate sides.

exercises.n: extensión de tríceps cruzada alta de pie en polea
exercises.en: cable standing high cross triceps extension
exercises.d: A one-arm cable pushdown from a high pulley, crossing the body to isolate the triceps.
i: Set a cable to a high position and hold the handle with one hand.
Stand facing the machine with your elbow bent and tucked.
Press the handle down and across your body until your arm is straight.
Return slowly to the start.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: salto de escalón
exercises.d: Explosive jumps up a flight of stairs that build leg power and speed.
i: Stand at the bottom of a staircase with your feet together.
Bend your knees and swing your arms back.
Jump up onto a step, landing softly with both feet.
Step back down carefully.
Reset and repeat.

exercises.n: remo inclinado con agarre abierto y barra
exercises.en: barbell bent over wide grip row
exercises.d: A bent-over row with a wide overhand grip that emphasises the upper back and rear delts.
i: Hold a barbell with a wide overhand grip and hinge forward with a flat back.
Let the bar hang at arm length below your chest.
Pull the bar toward your lower chest, flaring your elbows.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower the bar with control.

exercises.n: elevación de deltoide posterior inclinado acostado con barra
exercises.en: barbell incline lying rear delt raise
exercises.d: A chest-supported raise with a barbell that isolates the rear shoulders.
i: Lie chest down on an incline bench holding a barbell hanging below you.
Keep your arms nearly straight.
Raise the bar by lifting your elbows out and back.
Squeeze your rear delts at the top.
Lower the barbell slowly.

exercises.n: zancada cruzada con barra
exercises.d: A lunge where you step diagonally behind you with a barbell on your back. It works the glutes and outer hips.
i: Rest a barbell across your upper back and stand tall.
Step one leg back and across behind the other, like a curtsey.
Lower until your front thigh is near parallel.
Push through your front heel to stand.
Alternate sides or finish one side first.

exercises.n: press de pecho en el suelo con barra
exercises.d: A barbell press from the floor. The floor limits the range and takes pressure off your shoulders.
i: Lie on the floor with your knees bent and a barbell set above your chest.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width.
Lower the bar until your upper arms touch the floor.
Pause briefly.
Press the bar back up to full extension.

exercises.n: zancada sobre la cabeza con barra
exercises.d: A lunge performed with a barbell held locked out overhead. It builds leg strength and demands shoulder and core stability.
i: Press a barbell overhead and hold it with straight arms.
Step forward into a lunge.
Lower until both knees are around 90 degrees.
Push off your front foot back to standing.
Alternate legs and keep the bar steady.

exercises.n: elevación frontal sentado con barra
exercises.d: A seated front raise with a barbell that trains the front delts without using leg drive.
i: Sit on a bench holding a barbell with an overhand grip, resting on your thighs.
Raise the bar straight in front of you to shoulder height.
Pause at the top.
Lower it slowly to your thighs.
Keep your back straight and avoid swinging.

exercises.n: sentadilla frontal en banco con barra
exercises.d: A front squat to a bench behind you, which helps with depth control and keeps the load in front.
i: Place a bench behind you and rest the bar across your front shoulders.
Keep your elbows high and your chest up.
Sit back and down until you lightly touch the bench.
Drive through your feet to stand.
Avoid rocking or collapsing onto the bench.

exercises.n: subida frontal al cajón con barra
exercises.d: A step up with a barbell racked on your front shoulders, which keeps your torso upright and works the quads.
i: Rack a barbell across your front shoulders and stand facing a box.
Place one foot fully on the box.
Drive through that heel to step up and stand tall.
Lower back down slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: press de pecho en balón de estabilidad con barra
exercises.en: barbell chest press on stability ball
exercises.d: A barbell press with your upper back on a stability ball, which adds a core and balance challenge.
i: Sit on a stability ball and walk your feet out until your upper back rests on it.
Keep your hips up and take the barbell above your chest.
Lower the bar to your chest.
Press it back up to full extension.
Keep your core tight and feet planted.

exercises.n: encogimiento detrás de la espalda con barra
exercises.d: A shrug with the bar held behind your thighs, which shifts the load slightly to the mid traps.
i: Stand holding a barbell behind your back with straight arms.
Keep your chest up and shoulders relaxed.
Shrug your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly without rolling your shoulders.

exercises.n: peso muerto rumano sumo con barra
exercises.d: A romanian deadlift in a wide stance, hitting the hamstrings, glutes and inner thighs.
i: Hold a barbell in front of your thighs with a wide stance and toes turned out.
Push your hips back, keeping your knees slightly bent.
Lower the bar along your legs until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Keep your back flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.

exercises.n: zancada cruzada goblet con kettlebell
exercises.d: A curtsey lunge holding a kettlebell at your chest. It targets the glutes and outer hips.
i: Hold a kettlebell by the horns at your chest and stand tall.
Step one leg back and across behind the other.
Lower until your front thigh is near parallel.
Push through your front heel to return.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: peso muerto con piernas rectas y kettlebell
exercises.d: A stiff-legged deadlift with a kettlebell that stretches and strengthens the hamstrings.
i: Stand holding a kettlebell with both hands in front of your thighs.
Keep your legs almost straight with a soft knee.
Hinge at the hips and lower the bell along your legs.
Keep your back flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand.

exercises.n: peso muerto a una pierna con apoyo trasero y kettlebell
exercises.d: A one-leg deadlift with the back foot lightly touching the floor for support, so you can focus on the working leg.
i: Hold a kettlebell and stand with one foot slightly behind, toes on the ground as a kickstand.
Hinge at the hips over your front leg.
Lower the bell toward the floor with a flat back.
Drive through your front heel to stand.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: pullover con kettlebell en posición de 3 meses
exercises.d: A lying pullover with a kettlebell that stretches and works the lats and chest.
i: Lie on your back holding a kettlebell with both hands above your chest.
Keep your arms slightly bent.
Lower the bell back over your head in an arc.
Stop when you feel a stretch in your lats.
Pull it back over your chest.

exercises.n: press de hombros a un brazo de pie bottoms-up con kettlebell
exercises.en: kettlebell standing bottoms up one arm shoulder press
exercises.d: A one-arm overhead press holding the kettlebell upside down, which demands wrist and shoulder control.
i: Hold a kettlebell upside down by the handle at shoulder height.
Squeeze the handle and brace your core.
Press the bell straight overhead, keeping it balanced.
Lower it back to your shoulder with control.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: press militar sentado a un brazo con kettlebell
exercises.en: kettlebell seated one arm military press
exercises.d: A seated overhead press with one kettlebell, which removes leg drive and keeps the work on the shoulder.
i: Sit on a bench with a kettlebell held at your shoulder.
Sit tall with your core braced.
Press the bell straight overhead until your arm is straight.
Lower it slowly to your shoulder.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: press de banca a un brazo con kettlebell
exercises.d: A bench press with one kettlebell at a time, adding stability demand for the shoulder and core.
i: Lie on a bench holding a kettlebell above your chest.
Keep your wrist straight and your feet planted.
Lower the bell to the side of your chest.
Press it back up to full extension.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: press de banca a un brazo bottoms-up con kettlebell
exercises.en: kettlebell bottom up one arm bench press
exercises.d: A bench press holding the kettlebell upside down, which forces tight control of the shoulder and wrist.
i: Lie on a bench holding a kettlebell upside down above your chest.
Squeeze the handle and keep your wrist stacked.
Lower the bell slowly toward your chest.
Press it back up while keeping it balanced.
Use a light weight and switch arms after your reps.

exercises.n: elevación lateral con kettlebell
exercises.d: A lateral raise using a kettlebell, which trains the side delts.
i: Stand holding a kettlebell in one hand at your side.
Keep a soft bend in your elbow.
Raise your arm out to the side to shoulder height.
Lower it slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: elevación lateral con toalla
exercises.d: A no-equipment side raise using a towel for resistance, so you can train the delts at home.
i: Hold a towel with both hands and stand on its middle with one foot, or pull its ends apart.
Keep your elbows slightly bent.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Lower slowly.
Keep tension on the towel throughout.

exercises.n: curl de pierna deslizante en el suelo con toalla v. 2
exercises.en: sliding leg curl on floor with towel v. 2
exercises.d: A bodyweight hamstring curl where your heels slide on a towel across the floor.
i: Lie on your back with your heels on towels on a smooth floor.
Lift your hips off the ground.
Slide your heels toward your butt, curling your legs.
Slowly slide them back out.
Keep your hips high throughout.

exercises.n: sentadilla búlgara con silla
exercises.d: A single-leg squat with your rear foot resting on a chair, which builds strength and balance.
i: Stand facing away from a chair and rest the top of one foot on it.
Step your front foot forward so it is stable.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Push through your front foot to stand.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: apertura de deltoide posterior con sábana
exercises.en: rear delt fly with bed sheet
exercises.d: A no-equipment fly that uses a bed sheet pulled apart to work the rear shoulders.
i: Hold a bed sheet taut in both hands in front of you.
Keep your arms nearly straight.
Pull your hands apart, opening your arms out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly and keep tension on the sheet.

exercises.n: extensión de tríceps sobre la cabeza con sábana
exercises.en: overhead triceps extension with bed sheet
exercises.d: A home triceps exercise that uses a bed sheet as resistance.
i: Hold a bed sheet with both hands behind your head, one hand pulling up, one down.
Keep your elbows pointing forward.
Press your top hand overhead against the resistance.
Return slowly to the start.
Finish your reps, then swap hand positions.

exercises.n: remo de deltoide posterior con sábana
exercises.en: rear delt row with bed sheet
exercises.d: A rowing pattern that uses a bed sheet anchored around a door handle or post to work the upper back.
i: Loop a bed sheet around a sturdy anchor and hold the ends.
Lean back with your arms straight.
Pull your hands toward your chest, elbows flared out.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return slowly.

exercises.n: sentadilla pistol asistida con sábana
exercises.en: assisted pistol squat with bed sheet
exercises.d: A single-leg squat where you hold a bed sheet anchored to something sturdy for assistance.
i: Hold the ends of a bed sheet anchored to a door or post.
Stand on one leg with the other leg extended forward.
Sit down on your standing leg, using the sheet as support.
Lower as far as you can control.
Push up to stand and switch legs after your reps.

exercises.n: curl de bíceps con sábana
exercises.d: A bicep curl using a bed sheet and your own opposing arm for resistance.
i: Hold a bed sheet with both hands, one arm pulling down, the other curling up.
Keep your elbow at your side.
Curl the working hand toward your shoulder against the resistance.
Lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: remo invertido con sábana
exercises.d: A bodyweight row using a bed sheet looped around a sturdy anchor, such as a closed door.
i: Anchor a bed sheet securely and hold both ends.
Lean back with your body straight.
Pull your chest toward your hands.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower yourself slowly.

exercises.n: salto lateral en plancha frontal
exercises.d: Hop your feet side to side from a high plank for a core and cardio challenge.
i: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
Brace your core.
Hop both feet a short way to one side.
Hop them back to the other side.
Keep your shoulders stable and your hips low.

exercises.n: flexión inversa
exercises.d: A pushup where your hands are behind you, working the triceps hard.
i: Sit on the floor and place your hands behind you, fingers pointing toward your hips.
Lift your hips off the floor.
Bend your elbows and lower your hips.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your elbows pointing back.

exercises.n: curl de bíceps acostado con doble pierna y toalla
exercises.en: lying double legs biceps curl with towel
exercises.d: A lying curl where you pull a towel wrapped around your feet with your hands, so your legs provide resistance.
i: Lie on your back and wrap a towel around both feet, holding the ends.
Lift your legs slightly and press them against the towel.
Curl the towel toward your chest while your legs resist.
Lower slowly.
Keep your elbows at your sides.

exercises.n: apertura alta con banda elástica
exercises.d: A band chest fly from a high anchor, pulling downward to work the lower chest.
i: Anchor a band high and hold one end in each hand, facing away.
Step forward and lean slightly.
Bring your hands together in front of your waist with a soft elbow.
Squeeze your chest at the end.
Return slowly.

exercises.n: press de pecho de pie en máquina
exercises.d: A standing chest press on a lever machine, pressing the handles forward. It builds the chest, shoulders and triceps.
i: Ajusta la altura del asiento y colócate en la máquina con los pies planos en el suelo.
Agarra las asas con un agarre prono y coloca las manos a la altura del pecho.
Empuja las asas hacia adelante hasta que los brazos queden completamente extendidos, manteniendo los codos ligeramente flexionados.
Haz una pausa por un momento y luego lleva lentamente las asas de vuelta hacia el pecho, manteniendo el control durante todo el movimiento.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: good morning sentado en máquina
exercises.d: A seated good morning on a lever machine, hinging forward at the hips and back up. It trains the glutes, hamstrings and lower back.
i: Ajusta la altura del asiento de modo que tus caderas queden un poco más altas que tus rodillas.
Siéntate en la máquina con la espalda apoyada en el respaldo y los pies planos sobre los apoyapiés.
Sujeta las asas o los lados del asiento para mayor estabilidad.
Manteniendo la espalda recta, inclínate lentamente hacia adelante desde las caderas hasta que la parte superior de tu cuerpo quede paralela al suelo.
Haz una pausa por un momento y luego vuelve lentamente a la posición inicial empujando con los glúteos y los isquiotibiales.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: abdominal sentado en máquina v. 2
exercises.d: A second take on the seated machine crunch, curling forward against resistance. It trains the abs.
i: Siéntate en la máquina de palanca con la espalda apoyada en el respaldo y los pies sujetos bajo las almohadillas.
Coloca las manos en las asas o en los lados del asiento para mayor apoyo.
Activa el abdomen y flexiona lentamente el torso hacia adelante, llevando el pecho hacia las rodillas.
Haz una pausa por un momento en la parte superior del movimiento, apretando el abdomen.
Vuelve lentamente a la posición inicial, dejando que tu espalda se redondee ligeramente.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: curl de bíceps sentado alternado con mancuernas
exercises.d: Seated curls, alternating arms, to build the biceps.
i: Sit upright holding a dumbbell in each hand with arms hanging.
Keep your elbows by your sides.
Curl one dumbbell up to shoulder height.
Lower slowly.
Alternate arms and avoid swinging.

exercises.n: curl de bíceps inclinado con mancuernas v. 2
exercises.d: Curling from an incline bench stretches the biceps at the bottom for a deep contraction.
i: Sit back on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging.
Keep your shoulders against the bench.
Curl both dumbbells toward your shoulders.
Pause and squeeze.
Lower slowly to a full stretch.

exercises.n: subida con salto al cajón
exercises.d: A step up with an explosive jump at the top, which builds leg power and raises your heart rate.
i: Stand facing a sturdy box or step.
Place one foot on top.
Drive through it and jump up into the air.
Land softly on the box and step back down.
Switch legs and keep a steady rhythm.

exercises.n: sentadilla a una pierna con mancuerna v. 2
exercises.d: A single-leg squat holding a dumbbell for balance and extra load.
i: Hold a dumbbell at your chest and stand on one leg.
Extend your other leg in front of you.
Lower into a squat as far as you can control.
Push through your heel to stand.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: prensa de piernas horizontal sentado en máquina
exercises.d: A seated leg press on a lever machine that builds the quads and glutes.
i: Sit on the machine with your back against the pad and feet on the platform.
Release the safety and press the platform away.
Stop just before your knees lock.
Lower the weight slowly until your knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Keep your hips down and your back flat on the pad.

exercises.n: sentadilla curtsy
exercises.d: A squat where the leg steps diagonally behind and across the body, like a curtsy. It trains the glutes and outer thighs.
i: Ponte de pie con los pies separados a la altura de los hombros.
Da un paso en diagonal hacia atrás y a través de tu cuerpo con el pie derecho, cruzándolo detrás de la pierna izquierda.
Flexiona ambas rodillas como si hicieras una reverencia, bajando el cuerpo hacia el suelo.
Mantén el torso erguido y el peso sobre el pie delantero.
Empuja con el pie delantero para regresar a la posición inicial.
Repite en el otro lado, dando un paso en diagonal hacia atrás y a través de tu cuerpo con el pie izquierdo.

exercises.n: sentadilla con remo a un brazo y banda elástica
exercises.en: band squat with single arm row
exercises.d: A squat combined with a one-arm band row. It trains your legs and your back together.
i: Anchor the band at a low point and hold the handle in one hand.
Stand tall with feet shoulder width apart and the band under light tension.
Sit your hips back and down into a squat while keeping your chest up.
Stand up and, at the top, pull the handle to your ribs with your elbow close to your body, then let it return slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: peso muerto con remo a un brazo y banda elástica
exercises.en: band deadlift with single arm row
exercises.d: A hip hinge paired with a one-arm band row. It works your posterior chain and your upper back.
i: Anchor the band at a low point and hold the handle in one hand.
Stand with soft knees and the band under light tension.
Push your hips back and lower your torso with a flat back.
Drive your hips forward to stand, then row the handle to your ribs.
Lower the handle under control. Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: zancada con rodilla alta y remo a un brazo con banda elástica
exercises.en: band high knee lunge with single arm row
exercises.d: A lunge that finishes with a high knee, combined with a one-arm band row. It builds leg strength and balance.
i: Anchor the band at a low point and hold the handle in one hand.
Step back into a lunge and lower until your front thigh is about parallel.
Push through your front foot and drive the rear knee up to hip height.
Row the handle to your ribs while balancing on one leg.
Return to the start under control. Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: peso muerto a una pierna con piernas rectas y remo a un brazo con banda elástica
exercises.en: band single stiff leg deadlift with single arm row
exercises.d: A single-leg hip hinge with a one-arm band row. It challenges your balance and trains hamstrings, glutes and back.
i: Anchor the band at a low point and hold the handle in one hand.
Stand on one leg with a soft knee and the band under light tension.
Hinge forward at the hips while the free leg extends behind you.
Keep your back flat, then pull the handle to your ribs.
Lower the handle and stand tall again. Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: sentadilla con sostén pallof horizontal y banda elástica
exercises.en: band squat with horizontal pallof hold
exercises.d: A squat while holding the band out in front of you against sideways pull. It trains your legs and anti-rotation core strength.
i: Anchor the band at chest height and stand side-on to it.
Hold the handle with both hands at your chest, then press it straight out.
Keep your hips and shoulders square as you squat down.
Stand back up while holding the band steady.
Complete your reps, then turn around and repeat on the other side.

exercises.n: sentadilla dividida con sostén pallof horizontal y banda elástica
exercises.en: band split squat with horizontal pallof hold
exercises.d: A split squat done while holding the band out in front of you. It builds single-leg strength and core stability.
i: Anchor the band at chest height and stand side-on to it.
Take a split stance and press the handle straight out with both hands.
Lower your back knee toward the floor without letting the band twist you.
Push through your front foot to rise.
Finish your reps, then switch legs and anchor side.

exercises.n: paso lateral con sostén pallof horizontal y banda elástica
exercises.en: band side step with horizontal pallof hold
exercises.d: Side steps in a half squat while holding the band out in front of you. It works your hips and resists rotation through the core.
i: Anchor the band at chest height and stand side-on to it.
Press the handle straight out and sink into a quarter squat.
Take small steps sideways away from the anchor, keeping your torso square.
Step back in under control.
Repeat for your set, then switch sides.

exercises.n: plancha frontal con jalón a un brazo y banda elástica
exercises.en: band front plank with single arm pulldown
exercises.d: A front plank with a one-arm band pulldown. It trains core stability while your arm works against the band.
i: Anchor the band overhead and set up in a forearm or high plank.
Brace your abs and keep your hips level.
Pull the band down with one hand toward your hip without twisting.
Return the arm slowly to the start.
Alternate arms and keep your body in one straight line.

exercises.n: bicicleta acostado para tren superior con banda elástica
exercises.en: band upper body lying air bike
exercises.d: Lying on your back, you pedal your arms against the band like a bicycle. It hits your abs with added resistance.
i: Lie on your back with the band anchored behind your head, a handle in each hand.
Lift your shoulders and legs slightly off the floor.
Alternate pulling one handle toward your opposite knee in a pedalling motion.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
Continue at a steady pace for your set.

exercises.n: esquiador con banda elástica
exercises.d: A skiing motion with the band: swing both arms down and back while hinging at the hips. It works your lats, hips and core.
i: Anchor the band overhead and hold a handle in each hand.
Stand with soft knees and arms extended in front of you.
Pull the handles down and back past your hips as you hinge forward.
Return the arms up and stand tall in one smooth motion.
Keep your back flat and move with control.

exercises.n: press de pecho de pie con banda elástica
exercises.d: A standing press against band tension. It builds your chest, shoulders and triceps.
i: Anchor the band behind you at chest height and hold the handles at your chest.
Stand in a staggered stance with your core braced.
Press both hands forward until your arms are straight.
Pause briefly, then return slowly to your chest.
Keep your shoulders down and your back still.

exercises.n: salto dividido con remo a un brazo y banda elástica
exercises.en: band split jump with single arm row
exercises.d: An explosive split jump with a one-arm band row. It builds power in your legs and trains your back.
i: Anchor the band at a low point and hold the handle in one hand.
Start in a split stance with a slight bend in both knees.
Jump up and switch legs in mid-air.
Land softly in the opposite split stance and row the handle to your ribs.
Alternate legs, and switch rowing arm for the next set.

exercises.n: zancada con salto y remo a un brazo con banda elástica
exercises.en: band jump lunge with single arm row
exercises.d: A jumping lunge combined with a one-arm band row. It raises your heart rate and builds leg power.
i: Anchor the band at a low point and hold the handle in one hand.
Start in a lunge position with your chest up.
Jump and switch legs in mid-air.
Land softly in a lunge and pull the handle to your ribs.
Keep your front knee over your ankle on each landing.
Switch rowing arm for the next set.

exercises.n: arquero con mancuernas
exercises.d: A wide-stance move where one arm extends sideways like drawing a bow. It trains your shoulders and upper back.
i: Stand with feet wide and hold a dumbbell in one hand.
Shift your weight toward the empty-hand side and bend that knee.
Raise the dumbbell out to the side, keeping the other leg straight.
Lower with control and shift back to the center.
Repeat all reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: flexión con brazos cruzados
exercises.d: A push-up with your hands crossed under your chest. It puts extra load on the triceps.
i: Start in a high plank with your hands crossed under your chest.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your chest toward the floor with your elbows close.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Switch which hand is on top each set.

exercises.n: flexiones inclinadas (en cajón)
exercises.d: An incline push-up with the hands on a box. It trains the chest, shoulders and triceps with less load than a floor push-up.
i: Coloca las manos en el borde de una caja o una superficie elevada, ligeramente más separadas que la altura de los hombros.
Extiende las piernas detrás de ti, apoyándote en la punta de los pies, formando una línea recta desde la cabeza hasta los talones.
Baja el pecho hacia la caja doblando los codos, manteniendo el cuerpo en línea recta.
Haz una pausa breve en la parte baja, luego empújate de nuevo hacia arriba a la posición inicial estirando los brazos.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.d: A jumping lunge combined with a one-arm band row. It raises your heart rate and builds leg power.

i: Anchor the band overhead and hold a handle in each hand.
Stand with soft knees and arms extended in front of you.
Pull the handles down and back past your hips as you hinge forward.
Return the arms up and stand tall in one smooth motion.
Keep your back flat and move with control.

exercises.en: resistance band squat with horizontal pallof hold
exercises.d: A squat while holding the band out in front of you against sideways pull. It trains your legs and anti-rotation core strength.
i: Anchor the band at chest height and stand side-on to it.
Hold the handle with both hands at your chest, then press it straight out.
Keep your hips and shoulders square as you squat down.
Stand back up while holding the band steady.
Complete your reps, then turn around and repeat on the other side.

exercises.n: sentadilla dividida con sostén pallof horizontal y banda elástica
exercises.en: resistance band split squat with horizontal pallof hold
exercises.d: A split squat done while holding the band out in front of you. It builds single-leg strength and core stability.
i: Anchor the band at chest height and stand side-on to it.
Take a split stance and press the handle straight out with both hands.
Lower your back knee toward the floor without letting the band twist you.
Push through your front foot to rise.
Finish your reps, then switch legs and anchor side.

exercises.n: golpe con banda elástica
exercises.d: A standing forward punch against a resistance band. It trains your chest, shoulders and triceps.
i: Anchor the band behind you and hold a handle in each hand at your shoulders.
Stand in a staggered stance with a braced core.
Punch one hand forward and rotate your torso slightly.
Return the hand and punch with the other side.
Keep the movement quick but controlled.

exercises.n: remo inverso inclinado con mancuernas
exercises.d: A bent-over row with an underhand grip. It works your upper back, lats and biceps.
i: Hold a dumbbell in each hand with palms facing forward.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back and let the weights hang.
Pull the dumbbells to your lower ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your neck neutral throughout.

exercises.n: flexión elevada
exercises.d: A push-up with your hands on a raised surface. It is easier than a floor push-up and a good way to build chest strength.
i: Place your hands on a bench or box slightly wider than your shoulders.
Step back so your body forms a straight line.
Lower your chest to the edge with your elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your hips from sagging.

exercises.n: abdominal estrella (principiante)
exercises.d: A crunch where your arms and legs spread like a starfish and then come together. It is a beginner-friendly ab move.
i: Lie on your back with your arms and legs spread wide.
Brace your abs and press your lower back down.
Crunch up, bringing your elbows toward your knees as they pull in.
Lower back to the starfish position under control.
Breathe out as you crunch.

exercises.n: plancha frontal con toque de pie
exercises.d: A front plank where you tap one foot out to the side at a time. It challenges core stability and hips.
i: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders.
Brace your abs and keep your hips level.
Tap one toe out to the side and bring it back.
Repeat with the other foot.
Keep your body steady and avoid rocking.

exercises.n: abdominal (brazos rectos)
exercises.d: A crunch with your arms reaching toward your knees. It focuses on your upper abs.
i: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Extend your arms straight toward your knees.
Curl your shoulders off the floor, keeping your arms reaching.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly without pulling on your neck.

exercises.n: remo con pulso
exercises.d: A rowing movement with small pulses at the top of the pull. It builds endurance in your upper back.
i: Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back and arms hanging.
Pull your elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades.
Pulse in short movements at the top.
Lower your arms under control.
Keep your neck neutral.

exercises.n: toque de hombro declinado
exercises.d: A plank with your feet raised where you tap alternate shoulders. It trains shoulder strength and core stability.
i: Place your feet on a bench and your hands on the floor under your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Lift one hand and tap the opposite shoulder.
Return it and tap with the other hand.
Keep your hips from rocking.

exercises.n: flexión pseudo planche
exercises.d: A push-up with your hands near your hips and your body leaning forward. It strongly loads shoulders and chest.
i: Start in a plank with your hands turned out beside your lower ribs.
Lean your shoulders forward beyond your hands.
Lower your chest with your elbows close to your body.
Press up while keeping the lean.
Keep your core braced.

exercises.n: elevaciones laterales en el aire con cambio de palmas
exercises.en: mid air lateral raises with switching palms
exercises.d: A lateral raise where you turn your palms over at the top. It works the side of your shoulders from two angles.
i: Stand with a light dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Raise your arms out to shoulder height with palms down.
Turn your palms up in mid air, then back down.
Lower the weights slowly.
Keep your elbows slightly bent.

exercises.n: alrededor del mundo acostado
exercises.d: Lying on your back, you sweep your arms in a big arc overhead. It opens up your shoulders and chest.
i: Lie on your back with your arms by your sides.
Raise your arms to the ceiling.
Sweep them in a wide arc overhead toward the floor.
Continue the arc back down to your sides.
Move slowly and keep your ribs down.

exercises.n: hiperextensión acostado en el suelo
exercises.d: Lying face down, you lift your chest and legs off the floor. It strengthens your lower back and glutes.
i: Lie face down with your arms extended or by your sides.
Squeeze your glutes and lift your chest and legs slightly.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower back down with control.
Keep your neck neutral.

exercises.n: remo inclinado con toalla
exercises.d: A row using a towel for resistance. It trains your back and arms with no equipment.
i: Hold a towel with both hands and stretch it taut.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back.
Pull the towel toward your chest while pulling it apart.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly.

exercises.n: hiperextensión acostado en el suelo con toalla
exercises.d: A lying back extension while holding a towel taut. It builds your lower back and glutes with extra upper back work.
i: Lie face down holding a taut towel in front of you.
Lift your chest and legs off the floor.
Keep pulling the towel apart.
Pause at the top.
Lower back down with control.

exercises.n: curl martillo con ambas piernas acostado con toalla
exercises.en: lying double legs hammer curl with towel
exercises.d: Lying on your back, you loop a towel around your feet and curl it with a hammer grip. It trains your biceps.
i: Lie on your back and loop a towel around both feet.
Hold the ends with palms facing each other.
Pull the towel toward your chest while pushing your feet against it.
Pause, then slowly extend your arms.
Keep your elbows near your sides.

exercises.n: curl de bíceps inverso a una pierna acostado con toalla
exercises.en: lying single leg reverse biceps curl with towel
exercises.d: Lying on your back, you curl a towel looped around one foot with an overhand grip. It targets your forearms and biceps.
i: Lie on your back and loop a towel around one foot.
Hold the ends with an overhand grip.
Pull the towel toward you while the foot resists.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly, then switch legs.

exercises.n: colgado en handboard con inclinación
exercises.d: A hang from a sloped hangboard hold. It builds finger and forearm strength for climbing.
i: Grip the sloped hold with open hands.
Step off the ground and hang with straight arms.
Keep your shoulders active and your core tight.
Hold for 5-10 seconds.
Rest fully, then repeat.

exercises.n: colgado en handboard con agarre abierto
exercises.d: A hang from a hangboard using an open hand grip. It builds finger strength with less strain on your joints.
i: Grip the edge with fingers extended and a slight arch.
Step off and hang with straight arms.
Keep your shoulders engaged.
Hold for 5-10 seconds.
Lower down and rest before the next hang.

exercises.n: colgado en handboard con medio crimp
exercises.d: A hang from a hangboard in a half crimp grip. It builds finger strength for climbing.
i: Place your fingers on the edge with the knuckles bent at about 90 degrees.
Step off and hang with straight arms.
Keep your shoulders engaged.
Hold for 5-10 seconds.
Rest fully between hangs.

exercises.n: colgado en handboard con codos a 90 grados
exercises.d: A hangboard hold with your elbows bent to 90 degrees. It builds pulling strength and grip.
i: Grip the hold and pull yourself up until your elbows are at 90 degrees.
Keep your shoulders back and your core tight.
Hold for 5-10 seconds.
Lower down under control.
Rest before the next hold.

exercises.n: colgado en handboard con codos a 135 grados
exercises.d: A hangboard hold with your elbows bent to about 135 degrees. It builds grip and pulling strength in a partly pulled position.
i: Grip the hold and pull up slightly so your elbows bend to about 135 degrees.
Keep your shoulders back and your core tight.
Hold for 5-10 seconds.
Lower down under control.
Rest before the next hold.

exercises.n: abdominal (en banco)
exercises.d: A crunch performed lying on a bench. It trains your abs with a slightly larger range of motion.
i: Lie on a bench with your knees bent and feet flat.
Place your hands by your temples.
Curl your shoulders up, bringing your ribs toward your hips.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly without pulling on your neck.

exercises.n: flexión lateral con banda elástica
exercises.d: A standing side bend against band tension. It trains your obliques.
i: Stand on the band and hold the handle in one hand.
Keep your chest up and your hips square.
Bend sideways toward the band hand.
Return to upright.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: remo sentado con espalda recta y banda elástica
exercises.d: A seated row with a band while keeping your back straight. It builds your upper back and lats.
i: Sit with legs extended and the band around your feet.
Hold the handles with your arms straight and your back tall.
Pull your elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades.
Pause briefly.
Return slowly without rounding your back.

exercises.n: giro con banda elástica (arriba y abajo)
exercises.d: A diagonal twisting movement against band tension. It trains your obliques and rotational strength.
i: Anchor the band at a low point and stand side-on to it.
Hold the handle with both hands.
Rotate your torso and pull the band diagonally upward across your body.
Return slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: remo sentado con toalla
exercises.d: A seated row using a towel for resistance. It trains your lats and upper back.
i: Sit with your legs extended and loop a towel around your feet.
Hold the ends with arms straight.
Pull the towel toward your lower ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Extend your arms slowly.

exercises.n: curl de bíceps inverso con ambas piernas y toalla v. 2
exercises.en: two legs reverse biceps curl with towel v. 2
exercises.d: A reverse curl using a towel looped around both feet. It trains your biceps and forearms.
i: Lie on your back and loop a towel around both feet.
Hold the ends with an overhand grip.
Pull the towel toward your chest while your legs resist.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly.

exercises.n: curl martillo con ambas piernas y toalla v. 2
exercises.en: two legs hammer curl with towel v. 2
exercises.d: A hammer curl using a towel looped around both feet. It trains your biceps and brachialis.
i: Lie on your back and loop a towel around both feet.
Hold the ends with palms facing each other.
Pull the towel toward your chest while your legs resist.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly.

exercises.n: elevación lateral en plancha
exercises.d: A plank where you lift one arm out to the side. It challenges your core and shoulders.
i: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders.
Brace your abs and keep your hips level.
Lift one arm out to the side to shoulder height.
Lower it with control.
Alternate arms and avoid twisting.

exercises.n: abducción de cadera de pie con banda elástica
exercises.d: A standing leg lift to the side against band tension. It trains your outer hips and glutes.
i: Loop the band around your ankles or anchor it to one foot.
Stand tall holding a support if needed.
Lift one leg out to the side, keeping your toes forward.
Return slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: caminata hacia delante en plancha
exercises.d: From standing, you walk your hands out to a plank and back. It trains your core, shoulders and hamstring flexibility.
i: Stand tall with your feet hip width apart.
Hinge forward and place your hands on the floor.
Walk your hands out to a front plank.
Hold briefly with your hips level.
Walk your hands back and stand up.

exercises.n: extensión y flexión de espalda de pie
exercises.d: A standing movement where you arch and then round your back. It warms up your spine.
i: Stand with your feet hip width apart and hands on your hips.
Gently arch your back and look slightly up.
Round your back and tuck your chin.
Move slowly between positions.
Stay within a comfortable range.

exercises.n: sentadilla en smith con banda elástica
exercises.d: A smith machine squat with resistance band tension added. It builds your quads and glutes under a guided bar path.
i: Set the bar on the smith machine and attach the band as required.
Place the bar on your upper back with your feet slightly forward.
Lower into a squat until your thighs are about parallel.
Drive through your heels to stand.
Keep your chest up.

exercises.n: sentadilla en polea con banda elástica
exercises.d: A squat against band tension that builds the quads and glutes while the band pulls you forward, so your core has to work too.
i: Anchor the band at chest height and hold the handles at your chest, facing away from the anchor.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and brace your core.
Sit your hips back and down until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Keep your chest tall and knees tracking over your toes.
Push through your heels to stand up.
Repeat for the desired reps.

exercises.n: remo inclinado con banda elástica
exercises.d: A hinged rowing move with a band that works the muscles between and around the shoulder blades.
i: Stand on the middle of the band with feet hip-width apart and hold an end in each hand.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Pull your elbows back toward your hips, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause briefly, then lower with control.
Keep your neck neutral throughout.

exercises.n: remo inclinado en polea
exercises.d: A hinged row on the cable stack that trains the mid back and lats with steady tension all the way through.
i: Attach a handle or bar to a low pulley and grab it.
Step back and hinge at the hips with a flat back and soft knees.
Start with your arms extended toward the pulley.
Pull the handle toward your lower ribs, driving your elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight again.

exercises.n: remo inclinado con disco
exercises.d: A rowing movement holding a weight plate, good for the mid back and for grip strength.
i: Hold a weight plate firmly with both hands at its edges.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back and slightly bent knees.
Let the plate hang below your chest with arms extended.
