i: Stand facing the landmine anchor with a wide stance and hold the bar end against your chest.
Brace your core and keep your elbows tucked in.
Sit down between your legs, knees tracking over your toes.
Lower until your thighs are about parallel.
Press through your heels to stand tall.

exercises.n: superman con giro
exercises.d: A floor exercise where you lift your limbs off the ground and add a rotation, training the lower back and glutes.
i: Lie face down with your arms extended overhead and legs straight.
Lift your arms, chest and legs off the floor.
Rotate your torso slightly to one side while holding the lift.
Return to the center, then rotate to the other side.
Lower down with control and keep your neck neutral.

exercises.n: extensión de tríceps sentado con peso
exercises.d: A seated overhead extension with added weight that isolates the triceps.
i: Sit upright on a bench and hold the weight overhead with both hands.
Keep your elbows pointing forward and close to your head.
Lower the weight behind your head by bending your elbows.
Extend your arms to straighten them fully.
Keep your back straight and core tight.

exercises.n: rueda abdominal con apoyo en la pared
exercises.d: An ab wheel rollout where a wall stops the wheel, making it a safer way to train your abs and core.
i: Kneel facing a wall with the ab wheel on the floor in front of you.
Grip the handles and tuck your pelvis under.
Roll forward until the wheel touches the wall.
Pull the wheel back by contracting your abs.
Keep your back flat and avoid sagging at the hips.

exercises.n: zancada hacia delante con apertura posterior en suspensión
exercises.en: suspender forward lunge with rear fly
exercises.d: A lunge combined with a rear delt fly on suspension straps, working legs, shoulders and upper back together.
i: Hold the straps with both hands, leaning back slightly with arms extended.
Step one foot forward into a lunge.
As you lower, pull your arms out wide in a rear fly.
Push through the front foot to return to standing and bring your hands together.
Switch legs on the next rep.

exercises.n: abdominal con elevación de piernas
exercises.d: A crunch paired with a leg raise to train both the upper and lower abdominals.
i: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head and legs extended.
Crunch your shoulders off the floor.
At the same time lift your legs toward the ceiling.
Hold for a moment, then lower slowly.
Keep your lower back pressed into the floor.

exercises.n: toque de talón con presión en la pared
exercises.d: A lying core move with your feet pressed against a wall, tapping each heel alternately to challenge your lower abs.
i: Lie on your back with your hips and knees bent at 90 degrees and feet flat on a wall.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Lower one heel to tap the floor while the other foot stays on the wall.
Return and tap with the other heel.
Move slowly without arching your back.

exercises.n: abdominal reverso a bicho muerto
exercises.d: A reverse crunch that flows into a dead bug, training lower abs and control of the trunk.
i: Lie on your back with knees bent over your hips.
Curl your pelvis off the floor in a reverse crunch.
Lower your hips and extend one leg and the opposite arm.
Return to the start, then repeat on the other side.
Keep your lower back flat.

exercises.n: zancada lateral con kettlebell
exercises.d: A lateral lunge holding a kettlebell, working glutes, quads and inner thighs.
i: Stand tall holding a kettlebell at your chest.
Take a big step to the side.
Sit back into that hip while keeping the other leg straight.
Push off the bent leg to return to standing.
Complete all reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: empuje de pecho de rodillas con balón medicinal
exercises.en: medicine ball half kneeling chest push
exercises.d: A half kneeling chest pass motion with a medicine ball that trains pushing power and core stability.
i: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward and hold a medicine ball at your chest.
Brace your core and stay tall.
Push the ball forward explosively or against a wall.
Catch it or bring it back to your chest.
Switch the kneeling leg after your set.

exercises.n: sentadilla hack abierta en trineo
exercises.d: A hack squat on a sled with a wide foot position, stressing the quads, glutes and inner thighs.
i: Set your back on the pad and place your feet wide and slightly turned out on the platform.
Release the safety handles.
Lower by bending your knees until your thighs are parallel to the platform.
Press through your feet to extend your legs without locking out.
Keep your hips and back against the pad.

exercises.n: abdominal con toque de pies y piernas rectas con peso
exercises.en: weighted straight leg toe touch crunch
exercises.d: A crunch with straight legs raised, reaching toward your toes while holding a weight for extra resistance.
i: Lie on your back with your legs straight up and a weight held in both hands.
Reach the weight toward your toes.
Lift your shoulder blades off the floor.
Lower slowly with control.
Keep your legs vertical and your neck relaxed.

exercises.n: dominadas supinas con peso
exercises.d: A chin up with added load, building pulling strength in your lats and biceps.
i: Attach the weight with a belt and grip the bar with palms facing you.
Hang with arms straight.
Pull your chest toward the bar by driving your elbows down.
Pause with your chin above the bar.
Lower under control to full extension.

exercises.n: encogimientos de pie con barra hexagonal
exercises.d: A shrug done holding a trap bar at your sides, loading the traps with a neutral grip.
i: Stand inside the trap bar and lift it, holding the handles at your sides.
Keep your arms straight and chest tall.
Shrug your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Hold briefly at the top.
Lower slowly and do not roll your shoulders.

exercises.n: remo inclinado con barra hexagonal
exercises.d: A bent over row using a trap bar, working your back and arms with a neutral grip.
i: Stand in the trap bar and hinge forward with a flat back, gripping the handles.
Brace your core.
Row the bar toward your lower ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower the bar with control.

exercises.n: peso muerto con barra hexagonal desde déficit
exercises.d: A trap bar deadlift while standing on a raised platform, increasing range of motion for legs and back.
i: Stand on a low platform inside the trap bar.
Squat down and grip the handles with a flat back.
Brace and push the floor away.
Stand tall and squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower the bar with control to the start.

exercises.n: press pallof horizontal con piernas en tijera en polea
exercises.en: cable split stance horizontal pallof press
exercises.d: An anti-rotation press from a split stance that teaches your core to resist twisting.
i: Set the cable at chest height and stand sideways in a split stance.
Hold the handle at your chest with both hands.
Press the handle straight out in front of you.
Hold for a second without letting your torso twist.
Return the handle to your chest, then switch sides.

exercises.n: peso muerto sumo desde bloques con barra
exercises.d: A sumo deadlift with the bar raised on blocks, shortening the pull and loading hips, legs and back.
i: Stand with a wide stance and toes out in front of a bar on blocks.
Grip the bar inside your knees and set a flat back.
Push the floor apart with your feet and stand up.
Lock out by squeezing your glutes.
Lower the bar back to the blocks with control.

exercises.n: press arnold de pie con mancuernas
exercises.d: The rotating shoulder press popularized by Arnold, hitting all heads of the delts.
i: Stand holding dumbbells at chest height with palms facing you.
Press up while rotating your palms to face forward.
Fully extend your arms overhead.
Lower while rotating back to palms facing you.
Keep your core tight and avoid arching.

exercises.n: sentadilla dividida con aducción y banda elástica
exercises.d: A split squat with a band pulling you outward, adding inner thigh work.
i: Anchor the band to the side and loop it around the working leg.
Step into a split stance.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Press back up while resisting the band.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: curl zottman sentado con mancuernas
exercises.d: A seated curl that turns your palms down on the way back, training biceps and forearms.
i: Sit upright holding dumbbells with palms facing forward.
Curl both dumbbells up to shoulder height.
At the top rotate your palms to face down.
Lower slowly in that reverse grip.
Rotate your palms back up at the bottom.

exercises.n: encogimientos horizontales sentado en polea
exercises.d: A seated shrug using a horizontal cable pull, keeping steady tension on the traps.
i: Sit facing a low cable with a handle in each hand.
Start with arms straight and shoulders forward.
Pull your shoulders back and up.
Squeeze your traps at the end.
Return slowly to the start.

exercises.n: cuerdas de batalla sentado
exercises.d: Seated battle rope waves that raise your heart rate while working the arms and core.
i: Sit tall on the floor or a bench holding the ends of the ropes.
Brace your core.
Whip the ropes up and down in alternating waves.
Keep a steady fast rhythm for 20-30 seconds.
Rest, then repeat.

exercises.n: peso muerto rumano con landmine
exercises.d: A hip hinge using a landmine barbell, training hamstrings and glutes.
i: Stand holding the end of the bar close to your thighs.
Soften your knees and push your hips back.
Lower the bar along your legs with a flat back.
Feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.

exercises.n: apertura posterior inclinado con banda elástica
exercises.en: resistance band bent over rear delt fly
exercises.d: A bent over fly with a band that targets the rear delts and upper back.
i: Stand on the band and hinge forward holding the handles.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly.

exercises.n: extensión de tríceps sobre la cabeza con barra recta en polea
exercises.en: cable overhead tricep extension straight bar
exercises.d: An overhead cable extension with a straight bar, stretching and loading the triceps.
i: Set a straight bar on a low pulley and face away from it.
Hold the bar overhead with elbows bent.
Keep your elbows pointing forward.
Extend your arms to straighten them fully.
Lower the bar back behind your head slowly.

exercises.n: peso muerto reeves con barra
exercises.d: A wide stance deadlift variation using a very wide grip, training hips and back.
i: Stand with a wide stance and hold the bar with a wide grip.
Set a flat back and chest up.
Drive through your feet to lift.
Lock out your hips at the top.
Lower the bar with control.

exercises.n: flexión escapular de rodillas
exercises.d: A kneeling push up that moves only the shoulder blades, strengthening the muscles that stabilize them.
i: Kneel in a plank position with straight arms.
Keep your elbows locked.
Let your chest sink by pinching your shoulder blades together.
Push the floor away to spread them apart.
Keep your core braced.

exercises.n: sentadilla con salto y manos en la nuca
exercises.d: A jump squat with hands behind your head for an explosive leg workout.
i: Stand with your hands behind your head and feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel.
Explode upward into a jump.
Land softly on bent knees.
Go straight into the next rep.

exercises.n: extensión de tríceps en trineo de potencia
exercises.d: A triceps extension done on a sled machine, giving steady load through the whole motion.
i: Set up on the sled and grip the handles or bar.
Keep your elbows tucked.
Extend your arms to straighten them.
Squeeze your triceps at the end.
Return slowly.

exercises.n: press arnold sentado a un brazo con mancuerna
exercises.en: dumbbell seated one arm arnold press
exercises.d: A seated one arm Arnold press for shoulders with rotation through the movement.
i: Sit upright with a dumbbell in one hand at chest height, palm facing you.
Press up while rotating your palm forward.
Fully extend overhead.
Lower while rotating back.
Finish all reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: flexión a un brazo sobre balón medicinal
exercises.en: single arm push up on medicine ball
exercises.d: A hard push up with one hand on a medicine ball, challenging balance and chest strength.
i: Place one hand on the ball and the other on the floor in a plank.
Spread your feet for balance.
Lower your chest toward the ball.
Press back up.
Finish your reps, then switch hands.

exercises.n: apertura invertida a un brazo en polea
exercises.d: A single arm reverse fly on a cable to isolate the rear delts.
i: Stand sideways to a cable at shoulder height and grab the handle with the far hand.
Keep a slight bend in your elbow.
Pull your arm across and back in an arc.
Squeeze your rear delt.
Return slowly, then switch arms.

exercises.n: sentadilla frontal a una pierna con kettlebell
exercises.d: A front squat holding one kettlebell on one side, challenging legs and core stability.
i: Hold a kettlebell at your shoulder with one hand.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down with your chest tall.
Drive through your heels to stand.
Switch sides after your set.

exercises.n: bicho muerto con balón medicinal
exercises.d: A dead bug holding a medicine ball overhead to add trunk control demand.
i: Lie on your back holding a medicine ball above your chest, knees bent over your hips.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Lower the ball overhead while extending the opposite leg.
Return to the start.
Alternate sides.

exercises.n: press de hombros boca abajo acostado con mancuernas
exercises.en: dumbbell face down lying shoulder press
exercises.d: A face down press on an incline bench that works the rear shoulder.
i: Lie face down on an incline bench holding dumbbells at ear height.
Press the dumbbells up and slightly back.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your chest on the bench.

exercises.n: remo con parada en el suelo desde rack con barra
exercises.d: A row starting from the rack pins, resetting every rep for strict pulling.
i: Set the bar on pins at knee height.
Hinge forward and grip the bar.
Row it to your lower ribs.
Lower it back to the pins and pause.
Reset your back before the next rep.

exercises.n: bicho muerto con peso
exercises.d: A dead bug with added weight to increase core work.
i: Lie on your back holding a weight above your chest.
Raise your knees over your hips.
Extend the opposite arm and leg.
Return to the start.
Alternate sides, keeping your back flat.

exercises.n: sentadilla con contrapeso y peso
exercises.d: A squat holding a weight out in front as a counterweight, helping you stay upright.
i: Hold a weight at chest height and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Extend your arms forward as you descend.
Squat until thighs are parallel.
Keep your chest tall.
Stand back up through your heels.

exercises.n: sentadilla patinador con contrapeso y peso
exercises.d: A single leg skater squat with a counterweight held in front for balance.
i: Hold a weight out in front and stand on one leg.
Bend your standing knee while reaching your rear leg back.
Lower until your rear knee nearly touches the floor.
Push back to standing.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: rompecráneos california con barra EZ
exercises.d: A skullcrusher that mixes a pullover motion, loading the triceps from a long position.
i: Lie on a bench holding an ez bar above your chest.
Lower the bar toward your forehead.
Let it travel back past your head slightly.
Extend your arms to return.
Keep your upper arms still.

exercises.n: ondas alternas con cuerdas de batalla y levantada de rodillas
exercises.en: battling ropes alternating waves with kneeling get up
exercises.d: Alternating rope waves mixed with standing up from kneeling for a full body conditioning move.
i: Kneel holding the rope ends.
Make alternating waves with your arms.
Rise to a standing position while continuing.
Wave for a few more seconds.
Return to kneeling and repeat.

exercises.n: peso muerto sumo con tirón alto y kettlebell
exercises.en: kettlebell sumo deadlift with high pull
exercises.d: A sumo deadlift flowing into a high pull, working legs, hips and upper back.
i: Stand wide over a kettlebell and grip it with both hands.
Drive up through your legs.
Pull it to chin height with elbows high.
Lower it under control.
Keep your back flat.

exercises.n: peso muerto maleta con kettlebell
exercises.d: A one-sided deadlift holding the kettlebell at your side like a suitcase, training the core as well.
i: Stand beside a kettlebell and hinge to grip it.
Keep your back flat.
Stand up without leaning sideways.
Lower it back to the floor.
Switch hands after your set.

exercises.n: subida al cajón a una pierna con kettlebell
exercises.d: A step up holding a kettlebell, training each leg separately.
i: Hold a kettlebell and stand facing a box.
Place one foot on the box.
Drive through that heel to step up.
Lower slowly.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: sentadilla dividida con banda elástica
exercises.d: A split squat with a band adding resistance for the legs.
i: Stand on the band in a split stance and hold the ends at your shoulders.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front shin vertical.
Push back up.
Switch legs after your set.

exercises.n: abducción cruzada con banda elástica
exercises.d: A hip abduction with a band that crosses the body, working the outer hips.
i: Attach the band to a low anchor and loop it around your outer ankle.
Stand tall and hold support if needed.
Move that leg across then out to the side.
Control the return.
Switch legs after your set.

exercises.n: sentadilla con giro y banda elástica
exercises.d: A squat paired with a band twist for core and legs.
i: Anchor the band at chest height and stand sideways, holding the end.
Squat down.
Rise and rotate your arms away from the anchor.
Return to the center.
Complete all reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: curl de bíceps con agarre cerrado y banda elástica
exercises.d: A band curl with a narrow hand position to emphasize the outer biceps.
i: Stand on the band and grip it close to your feet with a narrow hold.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl your hands to your shoulders.
Squeeze the top.
Lower slowly.

exercises.n: extensión de tríceps sobre la cabeza con banda elástica v. 2
exercises.d: A second version of the band overhead extension for the triceps.
i: Stand on one end of the band and hold the other overhead with both hands.
Bend your elbows behind your head.
Extend your arms upward.
Keep your elbows close to your ears.
Lower under control.

exercises.n: extensión de tríceps a un brazo sobre la cabeza con banda elástica
exercises.en: band overhead single arm triceps extension
exercises.d: A one arm overhead band extension to isolate each triceps.
i: Stand on the band and hold the other end overhead with one hand.
Bend your elbow behind your head.
Extend your arm upward.
Keep your upper arm still.
Switch arms after your set.

exercises.n: extensión de tríceps a un brazo sobre la cabeza con banda elástica v. 2
exercises.en: band overhead single arm triceps extension v. 2
exercises.d: A second version of the one arm overhead band extension.
i: Anchor or stand on the band and hold it overhead in one hand.
Bend your elbow so your hand drops behind your head.
Extend your arm fully.
Keep your core tight.
Switch arms after your set.

exercises.n: extensión de tríceps acostado con agarre inverso y banda elástica
exercises.d: A lying pressdown with an underhand grip, targeting the triceps.
i: Lie on your back with the band anchored overhead and grip it palms up.
Keep your elbows pointing at the ceiling.
Press your hands down toward your thighs.
Squeeze your triceps.
Return slowly.

exercises.n: patada de tríceps con banda elástica
exercises.d: A kickback with a band for the back of the arm.
i: Stand on the band and hinge forward holding the other end.
Pin your upper arm to your side.
Extend your elbow straight back.
Squeeze your triceps.
Return slowly, then switch arms.

exercises.n: jalón inclinado con banda elástica
exercises.d: Hinge forward and pull a band down toward your hips, like a lat pulldown from a bent over position. It trains the lats and the muscles between your shoulder blades.
i: Anchor the band high and hold it with both hands, arms extended.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back and soft knees.
Pull the band down toward your hips, driving your elbows back.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom for a moment.
Let the band rise slowly until your arms are straight again.
Keep your torso still and your neck neutral.

exercises.n: remo con agarre cerrado y banda elástica
exercises.d: A row with the hands close together against band tension. It works the mid back and lats with extra focus on the elbows staying tight to the body.
i: Anchor the band at chest height and hold both ends with hands close together.
Step back until the band is taut and stand tall with soft knees.
Row your hands toward your lower ribs, elbows brushing your sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
Extend your arms slowly back to the start.
Keep your shoulders down and avoid leaning back.

exercises.n: remo de pie a un brazo con giro y banda elástica
exercises.en: band standing single arm twist row
exercises.d: A one arm band row where you rotate the torso as you pull. It trains the lats and back while the trunk resists and controls the twist.
i: Anchor the band at chest height and hold the handle in one hand.
Stand sideways to the anchor with feet shoulder width apart.
Row the handle toward your ribs while turning your torso gently toward the pulling side.
Squeeze your back at the end of the pull.
Return slowly, untwisting as your arm extends.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: remo alto con agarre estrecho y banda elástica
exercises.d: A high row with a narrow grip against a band. It targets the upper back and rear shoulders as you pull toward the face.
i: Anchor the band at or above head height and grip it with hands close together.
Step back until there is tension and stand tall.
Pull your hands toward your upper chest, elbows high and out.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly with control.
Keep your ribs down and avoid arching your back.

exercises.n: remo alto con agarre estrecho y banda elástica v. 2
exercises.en: band narrow grip high row v. 2
exercises.d: A second variation of the narrow grip high row using a band. It builds the upper back and rear shoulders.
i: Anchor the band high and grip it with hands close together.
Step back to create tension and stand tall.
Pull your hands toward your upper chest, elbows flaring slightly.
Pause and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Extend your arms slowly back to the start.
Keep your torso upright throughout.

exercises.n: apertura en el suelo con mancuernas
exercises.d: A chest fly performed lying on the floor, which limits the range at the bottom to protect the shoulders. It isolates the pecs.
i: Lie on your back with knees bent and a dumbbell in each hand above your chest.
Soften your elbows slightly and keep that bend.
Open your arms wide until your upper arms touch the floor.
Pause briefly without resting your weight.
Squeeze your chest to bring the dumbbells back together above you.
Move slowly and keep your wrists stacked over your elbows.

exercises.n: apertura baja a un brazo con mancuerna
exercises.d: A single arm fly that sweeps the dumbbell from low up to the chest. It works the upper pecs and front shoulder.
i: Stand with feet staggered and hold a dumbbell at your side with a slight elbow bend.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Sweep the dumbbell out and up in an arc to chest height in front of you.
Squeeze your chest at the top.
Lower slowly along the same arc.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: rompecráneos acostado en el suelo con mancuernas
exercises.d: A triceps extension lying on the floor, bending only at the elbows. The floor limits the range and keeps tension on the triceps.
i: Lie on your back with knees bent, a dumbbell in each hand over your chest.
Keep your upper arms vertical and still.
Bend your elbows to lower the weights toward your head.
Stop when your upper arms touch the floor lightly.
Extend your elbows to press the weights back up.
Keep your elbows pointed forward and avoid flaring them.

exercises.n: curl con agarre cerrado y mancuernas
exercises.d: A biceps curl with the dumbbells held close together. This emphasises the outer biceps through a controlled curl.
i: Stand tall holding dumbbells with palms forward and hands close together.
Pin your elbows to your sides.
Curl the weights up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Avoid swinging your torso.

exercises.n: flexión arquero a un lado
exercises.d: A push up where one arm does most of the work while the other extends out to the side. It builds unilateral chest and arm strength.
i: Start in a wide push up position with hands well outside your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Shift your weight to one arm and bend that elbow while the other arm stays straight.
Lower your chest toward the bent arm side.
Push back up and shift to the centre.
Alternate or complete reps on one side, then switch.

exercises.n: curl de muñeca neutro sentado con peso
exercises.d: A seated wrist curl with palms facing each other. It strengthens the forearms and wrists.
i: Sit with your forearm resting on your thigh, hand hanging past the knee.
Hold the weight with a neutral grip, thumb up.
Curl your wrist up toward your forearm.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly until your wrist is extended.
Complete all reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: elevación de gemelos sentado con peso
exercises.d: A seated calf raise with weight resting on your thighs. The bent knee focuses the work on the soleus beneath the calf.
i: Sit on a bench with feet flat and the weight resting on your thighs.
Place the balls of your feet on a raised edge if possible.
Lift your heels as high as you can.
Pause and squeeze your calves.
Lower your heels slowly below the edge for a stretch.
Hold the weight steady throughout.

exercises.n: elevación lateral de pierna y cadera acostado en el suelo
exercises.en: lying leg hip side raise on floor
exercises.d: A side lying raise where you lift both legs together toward the ceiling. It works the obliques and the sides of your trunk.
i: Lie on your side with legs stacked and straight.
Rest your head on your lower arm and brace your core.
Lift both legs together a short way off the floor.
Pause at the top, squeezing your side.
Lower slowly without touching the floor.
Complete reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: press tate sentado hacia delante y atrás con mancuernas
exercises.en: dumbbell seated front and back tate press
exercises.d: A seated triceps move where the dumbbells go from the chest outward in front and back. It hits the triceps from a unique angle.
i: Sit upright holding dumbbells above your chest, palms facing your feet.
Keep your upper arms close to your torso.
Lower the weights with elbows flared until they touch your chest.
Extend your elbows to push the weights up and slightly forward.
Return to the start in a controlled path.
Keep your back straight and avoid arching.

exercises.n: abdominal lateral con peso
exercises.d: A side crunch holding a weight to load the obliques. It builds strength along the sides of the waist.
i: Lie on your side with knees bent and hold a weight against your chest.
Support your head lightly.
Crunch your top ribs toward your hip.
Pause and squeeze your side.
Lower slowly without losing tension.
Complete all reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: flexión con patada pasante
exercises.d: A push up followed by a quick kick of one leg through underneath your body. It builds chest strength with coordination.
i: Start in a push up position with hands under your shoulders.
Lower your chest and press back up.
Lift one hand and rotate, sweeping the opposite leg through underneath you.
Return the leg and hand to the starting position.
Repeat the push up and kick on the other side.
Stay controlled and keep your core braced.

exercises.n: elevación de gemelos en sentadilla mantenida
exercises.d: Hold a squat while lifting and lowering your heels. It combines quad endurance with calf work.
i: Stand with feet shoulder width apart and lower into a half squat.
Hold that depth with your chest up.
Raise your heels as high as you can.
Lower your heels slowly.
Repeat while holding the squat position.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.

exercises.n: zancada hacia atrás con elevación frontal y mancuernas
exercises.d: Step back into a lunge and raise the dumbbells in front. It trains the legs and shoulders together.
i: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand at your thighs.
Step one foot back into a lunge.
As you lower, raise the dumbbells in front to shoulder height.
Push through your front foot to stand back up.
Lower the dumbbells as you return.
Alternate legs for each rep.

exercises.n: flexión con toque de rodilla
exercises.d: A push up where you pull a knee toward your elbow after each rep. It adds a core challenge to a standard push up.
i: Start in a push up position with a straight body.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up to straight arms.
Bring one knee toward the same side elbow.
Return the foot and repeat on the other side.
Keep your hips level and your core braced.

exercises.n: curl de muñeca a un brazo en polea
exercises.d: A wrist curl using cable resistance on one arm. It strengthens the forearm flexors.
i: Sit by a low pulley with your forearm resting on your thigh.
Hold the handle with your palm facing up.
Curl your wrist up as far as you can.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly under control.
Complete all reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: devils press con mancuernas
exercises.d: A full body move: burpee onto dumbbells, then swing them overhead. It builds power and conditioning.
i: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Squat and place the dumbbells on the floor, then step or jump your feet back.
Do a push up if you like.
Jump your feet forward and stand up, swinging the dumbbells overhead.
Lower the dumbbells under control.
Keep your back flat and move with rhythm.

exercises.n: sentadilla con salto con barra hexagonal
exercises.d: An explosive jump squat holding a trap bar. It develops lower body power.
i: Stand inside a trap bar with feet shoulder width apart.
Grip the handles and stand tall.
Squat down quickly with your chest up.
Jump up explosively off the floor.
Land softly with bent knees.
Reset before the next rep.

exercises.n: balanceo con kettlebell y banda elástica
exercises.d: A kettlebell swing with a band adding tension at the hips. It builds hip drive and posterior chain power.
i: Set up with the band around your hips and the kettlebell in front of you.
Hinge back and swing the bell between your legs.
Drive your hips forward powerfully.
Let the kettlebell rise to chest height.
Guide it back between your legs as you hinge.
Keep your back flat and arms relaxed.

exercises.n: sentadilla pistol con salto sobre cajón
exercises.d: A single leg squat to a box followed by a jump. It builds balance and explosive leg strength.
i: Stand in front of a box on one leg, other leg forward.
Squat down on one leg to touch the box.
Drive through your heel and jump upward.
Land softly on the same leg.
Control your balance and reset.
Complete reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: sentadilla pistol con salto
exercises.d: A single leg squat with an explosive jump at the top. It trains leg power and balance.
i: Stand on one leg with the other extended forward.
Lower into a single leg squat.
Explode upward off the standing leg.
Land softly on the same leg.
Sink back into the next squat.
Complete reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: plancha de oso
exercises.d: A plank on hands and toes with knees hovering just off the floor. It challenges the core and shoulders.
i: Start on hands and knees with wrists under shoulders.
Tuck your toes and lift your knees a few centimetres off the floor.
Keep your back flat and hips level.
Brace your abs and breathe steadily.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower your knees to rest.

exercises.n: rack pull en smith
exercises.d: A partial deadlift from knee height on a Smith machine. It overloads the back and hips.
i: Set the bar at knee height in the Smith machine.
Grip the bar and set your back flat.
Drive through your feet and extend your hips.
Stand tall and squeeze your glutes.
Lower the bar to the start with control.
Keep the bar close to your legs.

exercises.n: apertura posterior inclinado con peso corporal
exercises.en: bodyweight bent over rear delt fly
exercises.d: A bent over fly using only your arms as resistance. It trains the rear shoulders and upper back.
i: Hinge forward with a flat back and arms hanging down.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly.
Keep your neck neutral.

exercises.n: peso muerto rumano con barra y banda elástica
exercises.d: A Romanian deadlift with a band adding resistance as you stand. It builds the hamstrings and glutes.
i: Stand on the band with it attached to the barbell and hold the bar at your thighs.
Push your hips back with soft knees.
Lower the bar along your legs to mid shin.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Keep your back flat throughout.

exercises.n: press de hombros inverso en máquina (con discos)
exercises.d: A plate loaded press with a reverse grip on a lever machine. It targets the front shoulders.
i: Adjust the seat and sit with your back against the pad.
Grip the handles with a reverse grip.
Press the handles up until your arms are extended.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly to shoulder level.
Keep your core braced.

exercises.n: press de hombros de pie con peso
exercises.d: A standing overhead press with weight in hand. It builds shoulder and triceps strength.
i: Stand with feet shoulder width apart, weight at shoulder height.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Press the weight straight overhead.
Lock out without leaning back.
Lower slowly to your shoulders.
Keep your ribs down.

exercises.n: encogimientos (en barras paralelas)
exercises.d: A shrug performed supported on parallel bars. It lifts and lowers the shoulders to train the traps.
i: Support yourself on parallel bars with straight arms.
Let your shoulders sink down.
Push up to elevate your shoulders toward your ears.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control.
Keep your elbows locked.

exercises.n: encogimiento escapular colgado
exercises.d: A hang from a bar where you pull your shoulder blades down and up. It strengthens the upper back and improves shoulder control.
i: Hang from a pull up bar with straight arms.
Relax your shoulders up toward your ears.
Pull your shoulder blades down, lifting your body slightly.
Pause briefly.
Relax back to the hang.
Keep your elbows straight.

exercises.n: sentadilla con talones elevados y barra
exercises.d: A barbell squat with heels on a plate for extra knee travel. It emphasises the quads.
i: Place your heels on small plates under the bar.
Set the bar on your upper back.
Brace your core and squat down.
Keep your torso upright.
Drive through your feet to stand.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.

exercises.n: sentadilla completa en smith con banda elástica
exercises.d: A deep Smith machine squat with a band adding resistance. It builds quads and glutes.
i: Attach the band to the Smith machine and set the bar on your back.
Place feet slightly forward of the bar.
Squat as deep as you can with control.
Keep your chest up.
Drive up through your heels.
Stand tall without locking hard.

exercises.n: pullover sentado en polea
exercises.d: A seated pullover using a cable. It isolates the lats with constant tension.
i: Sit at a high pulley holding the rope or bar with straight arms.
Lean slightly forward.
Pull the handle down in an arc to your thighs.
Squeeze your lats.
Return slowly with arms straight.
Avoid bending your elbows.

exercises.n: dominadas supinas colgado con peso
exercises.d: A chin up from a dead hang with added weight. It builds lats and biceps strength.
i: Attach weight and hang from the bar with palms facing you.
Start from straight arms.
Pull your chest toward the bar.
Get your chin over the bar.
Lower fully with control.
Avoid swinging.

exercises.n: remo para deltoide posterior con banda elástica
exercises.d: A wide rowing motion with a resistance band. It strengthens the rear shoulders.
i: Anchor the band at chest height and hold the handles.
Step back for tension.
Pull your hands out to the sides with elbows high.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return slowly.
Keep your torso upright.

exercises.n: press cubano sentado con mancuernas
exercises.d: A seated move combining an upright row, rotation and press. It strengthens shoulders and rotator cuff.
i: Sit tall holding dumbbells at your thighs.
Row them up to chest height with elbows high.
Rotate your forearms upward.
Press the dumbbells overhead.
Reverse the path slowly.
Use light weights.

exercises.n: press de banca con banda elástica y mancuernas
exercises.d: A dumbbell bench press with a band adding tension at lockout. It builds chest strength.
i: Lie on a bench with a band across your upper back and hands.
Hold dumbbells at chest level.
Press up against the band.
Lock out at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your feet flat.

exercises.n: subida al cajón con press sobre la cabeza y peso
exercises.d: A step up combined with an overhead press. It trains legs and shoulders together.
i: Hold weight at your shoulders and stand facing a bench.
Step up with one foot.
As you stand, press the weight overhead.
Lower the weight as you step down.
Alternate legs.
Keep your core braced.

exercises.n: sentadilla sobre la cabeza con banda elástica
exercises.d: A squat with a band held overhead. It improves mobility and leg strength.
i: Stand on the band and hold it overhead with wide grip.
Brace your core.
Squat down keeping arms overhead.
Keep your chest up.
Drive up through your feet.
Keep your arms in line with your ears.

exercises.n: abdominal con piernas al lado y barra EZ
exercises.en: ez bar legs side pull in sit up
exercises.d: A sit up with legs pulled to the side while holding an EZ bar. It works the abs and obliques.
i: Lie on your back holding an EZ bar over your chest.
Bend your knees.
Sit up while pulling your knees to one side.
Lower slowly.
Repeat on the other side.
Keep the bar stable.

exercises.n: abdominal reverso con barra EZ
exercises.d: A reverse crunch holding an EZ bar behind your head. It targets the lower abs.
i: Lie on your back holding an EZ bar overhead.
Lift your legs with knees bent.
Curl your hips off the floor.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your arms steady.

exercises.n: rodillo abdominal de rodillas con barra EZ
exercises.d: Roll the EZ bar forward from a kneeling position and back. It strongly challenges the core.
i: Kneel holding the EZ bar on the floor.
Brace your core.
Roll forward with a flat back.
Stop before your back sags.
Pull the bar back to the start.
Keep your hips in line.

exercises.n: giro arriba y abajo con barra EZ
exercises.d: Move the EZ bar in an arc with a twist. It trains the obliques.
i: Stand holding the EZ bar in front of you.
Raise it overhead.
Lower it diagonally across your body, twisting.
Return overhead.
Alternate sides.
Move with control.

exercises.n: elevación lateral parcial con mancuernas
exercises.d: Short range lateral raises that keep tension on the side delts.
i: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides.
Raise them out to the sides.
Stay within the mid range, between hip and shoulder height.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly.
Avoid shrugging.

exercises.n: flexión sobre nudillos
exercises.d: A push up on your knuckles to keep wrists straight. It builds chest and arm strength.
i: Make fists and place them under your shoulders.
Keep your body straight.
Lower your chest.
Press up.
Keep wrists neutral.
Brace your core.

exercises.n: press pallof de media rodilla en polea
exercises.d: Press a cable away from your chest while kneeling on one knee. It trains anti rotation.
i: Kneel on one knee side on to a cable at chest height.
Hold the handle at your chest.
Press it straight out.
Resist the twist.
Bring it back.
Switch sides.

exercises.n: rotación externa de media rodilla en polea
exercises.d: A rotator cuff exercise in a half kneeling stance.
i: Kneel on one knee beside a cable at elbow height.
Hold the handle with elbow at your side.
Rotate your forearm outward.
Pause.
Return slowly.
Switch sides.

exercises.n: face pull de media rodilla con banda elástica
exercises.en: resistance band half kneeling face pull
exercises.d: A face pull in a half kneeling stance with a band.
i: Anchor the band at face height.
Kneel on one knee.
Pull the handles toward your face.
Flare your elbows.
Return slowly.
Keep your chest up.

exercises.n: press pallof de aductores de media rodilla en polea
exercises.en: cable half kneeling adductor pallof press
exercises.d: A pallof press with the inner thigh engaged.
i: Kneel on one knee with the cable at chest height.
Hold the handle at your chest.
Press it forward.
Squeeze your inner thigh.
Return.
Switch sides.

exercises.n: press pallof con puente de glúteos en polea
exercises.en: cable pallof press with glute bridge
exercises.d: Combine a pallof press with a glute bridge.
i: Lie on your back with a cable beside you.
Hold the handle at your chest.
Bridge your hips up.
Press the handle forward.
Return and lower.
Switch sides.

exercises.n: salto en profundidad a salto de valla
exercises.d: Drop off a box and hop over a hurdle.
i: Stand on a box.
Step off.
Land softly.
Jump over the hurdle immediately.
Land softly.
Reset.

exercises.n: peso muerto contra cadenas con barra
exercises.d: A deadlift with chains adding load toward lockout.
i: Set chains on the bar.
Grip the bar.
Brace.
Drive your feet through the floor.
Stand tall.
Lower with control.

exercises.n: apertura contra cadenas
exercises.d: A chest fly with chains adding load.
i: Lie on a bench with chains.
Hold weights above your chest.
Open arms.
Stretch your chest.
Bring weights together.
Keep elbows soft.

exercises.n: press de banca contra cadenas con barra
exercises.d: A bench press with chains adding load.
i: Lie on bench.
Unrack the bar.
Lower to chest.
Press up.
Lock out.
Keep feet planted.

exercises.n: press de hombros a un brazo con landmine y banda elástica
exercises.en: landmine resistance band one arm shoulder press
exercises.d: One arm landmine press with a band.
i: Hold the landmine end at your shoulder.
Brace your core.
Press up and forward.
Lock out.
Lower slowly.
Switch arms.

exercises.n: peso muerto sumo con barra y banda elástica
exercises.d: A wide stance deadlift with band resistance.
i: Set the band over the bar.
Stand wide.
Grip inside your legs.
Drive up.
Squeeze glutes.
Lower with control.

exercises.n: curl nórdico de isquios asistido con banda elástica
exercises.en: resistance band assisted nordic hamstring curl
exercises.d: A nordic curl using a band for assistance.
i: Kneel with ankles secured.
Hold the band.
Lower your body forward.
Use the band to help.
Pull back up.
Keep hips extended.

exercises.n: fondos asistidos con banda elástica
exercises.d: Dips with a band looped around the bars to take some of your weight. It builds triceps and chest strength while you work toward unassisted dips.
i: Loop a band around the dip bars and set your knees or feet in it.
Grip the bars and straighten your arms with your chest up.
Lower your body until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
Keep your elbows close and your shoulders down.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Use a thinner band as you get stronger.

exercises.n: dominadas supinas asistidas con banda elástica (desde rodilla)
exercises.d: A chin-up with a band under one knee to lighten the load. It builds lats and biceps on the way to full chin-ups.
i: Attach a band to a pull-up bar and place one knee in the loop.
Grab the bar with an underhand, shoulder-width grip.
Hang with your arms straight and your core tight.
Pull your chest up until your chin clears the bar.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight.
Switch knees halfway through your sets.

exercises.n: dominada supina alrededor de la barra
exercises.d: A chin-up variation where you pull your body around the bar rather than straight over it. It challenges lats, biceps and grip.
i: Grab the bar with an underhand grip and hang with straight arms.
Brace your core and pull your elbows down.
Pull your chest toward the bar, sweeping your head around one side.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower with control back to a full hang.
Alternate the side you pass on each rep.

exercises.n: salto de cajón de 2 a 1
exercises.d: Jump up onto a box with both feet and step or drop down with one. It builds explosive leg power and single-leg control.
i: Stand facing a sturdy box with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Swing your arms and jump up, landing softly on the box with both feet.
Stand tall on top of the box.
Step down with one leg first, then the other.
Reset and repeat, alternating the leading leg.
Land quietly with bent knees.

exercises.n: salto de cajón de 1 a 2
exercises.d: Push off with one leg to land on a box with both feet. It trains explosive single-leg power and a stable landing.
i: Stand facing a sturdy box on one leg.
Drive your arms up and push off explosively from that leg.
Land softly on the box with both feet at once.
Stand fully upright before stepping down.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.

exercises.n: arrancada dividida con kettlebell
exercises.d: A snatch where you drop into a split stance as the kettlebell goes overhead. It trains hip power, shoulder stability and coordination.
i: Stand over a kettlebell in a hip hinge with a flat back.
Swing it back, then drive your hips forward.
As the bell rises, step into a split stance and punch it overhead.
Lock out your arm with the bell resting behind your wrist.
Stand up, bring your feet together and lower the bell to a swing.
Switch arms after your reps.

exercises.n: elevación lateral en 4 direcciones con mancuernas
exercises.d: A shoulder series that moves the dumbbells through four raise positions in one set. It hits all heads of the delts with light weight.
i: Stand with a light dumbbell in each hand and a slight knee bend.
Raise both arms out to your sides to shoulder height.
Lower, then raise them to the front to shoulder height.
Lower, then hinge forward slightly and raise them out to the rear.
Return and finish with a raise to the sides again.
Keep the weights light and avoid swinging.

exercises.n: equilibrio en estrella a una pierna
exercises.d: Balance on one leg while reaching the other foot toward points of an imaginary star. It builds stability, control and ankle strength.
i: Stand on one leg with a soft knee.
Reach your free foot forward and tap lightly, then return.
Tap out to the side, then return.
Tap behind you, then return.
Keep your hips level and chest tall.
Switch legs after a set of taps.

exercises.n: press de pecho con banda elástica en máquina
exercises.d: A machine chest press with bands adding extra resistance at the top. It builds the chest and triceps with a stable path.
i: Adjust the seat so the handles line up with your mid chest.
Sit back with your shoulder blades pinned to the pad.
Grip the handles and press forward until your arms are nearly straight.
Feel the band tension build as you lock out.
Lower slowly until you feel a stretch across your chest.
Keep your wrists straight.

exercises.n: remo bajo en máquina (con discos)
exercises.d: A plate-loaded machine row pulling from low to your torso. It builds the mid back and lats with a guided path.
i: Sit with your chest against the pad and your feet planted.
Grab both handles with straight arms.
Pull the handles toward your lower ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Pause for a moment at the end.
Let the arms extend slowly under control.
Do not lean back to move the weight.

exercises.n: remo bajo a un brazo en máquina (con discos)
exercises.en: lever one arm low row (plate loaded)
exercises.d: A one-arm version of the plate-loaded low row. Working one side at a time helps fix strength differences in your back.
i: Sit with your chest on the pad and grab one handle.
Start with your arm extended and shoulder relaxed forward.
Pull the handle back, driving your elbow past your torso.
Squeeze your shoulder blade toward your spine.
Lower slowly until your arm is straight.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: trepar barras de mono
exercises.d: Swing from bar to bar along a horizontal ladder. It builds grip, shoulders and back with a playful challenge.
i: Grab the first bar with both hands and hang.
Swing your body slightly and reach for the next bar with one hand.
Release the back hand and reach for the following bar.
Keep a steady rhythm using your hips for momentum.
Continue to the end of the ladder.
Drop down softly and rest before the next pass.

exercises.n: jalón con agarre neutro abierto en polea
exercises.d: A lat pulldown with a wide handle that keeps your palms facing each other. It builds back width with less wrist strain.
i: Sit at the pulldown station and lock your thighs under the pads.
Grab the wide neutral-grip handles with straight arms.
Lean back slightly and lift your chest.
Pull the handles down toward your upper chest, driving your elbows down.
Pause, then let the bar rise slowly.
Do not swing your torso.

exercises.n: sentadilla frontal con barra de seguridad
exercises.d: A squat with a safety squat bar held in front using its handles. It loads the quads and keeps your torso upright.
i: Set the safety bar on a rack and step under the pad.
Hold the handles, rest the pad on your shoulders and unrack.
Step back and set your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down while keeping your chest tall and elbows up.
Go as deep as you can with good form.
Drive up through your whole foot to stand.

exercises.n: sentadilla con talones elevados y barra de seguridad
exercises.d: A safety bar squat with your heels raised on a small platform. The elevation lets your knees travel forward to target the quads.
i: Place plates or a wedge under your heels in front of the rack.
Unrack the safety bar and step onto the platform.
Keep your chest upright and brace your core.
Squat down with your knees tracking over your toes.
Pause briefly at the bottom.
Press up and rack the bar when done.

exercises.n: tiger tail antebrazo
exercises.d: Rolling a handheld foam roller along your forearm to ease tight muscles. It is a quick self-massage for grip and wrists.
i: Rest your forearm on a table, palm up.
Hold the tiger tail roller in your other hand.
Roll slowly from wrist to elbow with moderate pressure.
Pause on tender spots for a few seconds.
Turn your palm down and repeat.
Switch arms and roll for 30-60 seconds each.

exercises.n: tiger tail isquiotibiales
exercises.d: Using a handheld roller on the back of your thigh to loosen tight hamstrings. It works well before or after leg training.
i: Sit on the floor with one leg extended.
Hold the roller by both handles on the back of your thigh.
Roll from the knee toward your hip with steady pressure.
Slow down on tight spots.
Keep breathing and keep the leg relaxed.
Switch legs after 30-60 seconds.

exercises.n: tiger tail cuello
exercises.d: Gently rolling a handheld roller along the back and sides of the neck. It helps loosen stiff neck and upper trap muscles.
i: Sit or stand tall with relaxed shoulders.
Hold the roller by both handles behind your neck.
Roll gently up and down along one side with light pressure.
Avoid pressing on the spine itself.
Repeat on the other side.
Roll for 30-60 seconds and stop if it hurts.

exercises.n: tiger tail peroneos
exercises.d: Rolling the outer side of your lower leg with a handheld roller. It eases tension in the muscles along the outside of the calf.
i: Sit with your leg bent or extended and the outer shin facing up.
Hold the roller by the handles on the outside of your lower leg.
Roll from the ankle to just below the knee.
Use gentle pressure and avoid the bone.
Pause on any tight areas.
Switch legs after 30-60 seconds.

exercises.n: press pallof acostado en polea
exercises.d: A Pallof press done lying on your back that resists rotation. It strengthens the deep core and obliques.
i: Lie on your back beside a low cable pulley with a handle in both hands.
Hold the handle at your chest, arms bent.
Brace your core to stay flat.
Press your arms straight up while resisting the cable pull.
Hold a second, then bring the handle back to your chest.
Finish your reps and switch sides.

exercises.n: remo al mentón acostado en polea
exercises.d: An upright row done lying on your back with a low cable. The lying position takes your lower back out of the movement.
i: Lie on your back with your feet toward a low pulley.
Hold a bar or handle with an overhand grip, arms straight.
Pull the handle up toward your chin, leading with your elbows.
Keep the handle close to your body.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.n: encogimientos acostado en polea
exercises.d: A shrug performed lying down with a cable pulling from your feet. It trains the upper traps with steady tension.
i: Lie on your back with a low pulley near your feet.
Hold the handle with straight arms down by your sides.
Shrug your shoulders toward your ears.
Squeeze at the top for a second.
Lower slowly to a full stretch.
Keep your arms straight throughout.

exercises.n: elevación frontal acostado en polea
exercises.d: A front raise lying on your back using a low cable. It isolates the front delts without any body swing.
i: Lie on your back with your head toward a low pulley.
Hold the handle with straight arms by your hips.
Raise your arms in an arc until they point straight up.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly back toward your thighs.
Keep your ribs down and core braced.

exercises.n: empuje y tirón de media rodilla en polea
exercises.d: From a half kneeling stance you press one handle forward and pull another back at the same time. It challenges core stability and coordination.
i: Kneel on one knee between two cable stations, holding a handle in each hand.
Keep your torso tall and your core braced.
Press one handle forward while pulling the other toward your ribs.
Return to the start under control.
Do not let your torso twist.
Switch your kneeling leg after a set.

exercises.n: carrera assault
exercises.d: A run on a self-powered curved treadmill where your effort sets the speed. It is a hard cardio workout for the legs and lungs.
i: Step onto the curved treadmill and hold the handles.
Lean slightly forward and begin to run.
Drive your knees and push the belt back with each stride.
Keep a steady rhythm, or alternate sprints and rest.
Land on the balls of your feet.
Slow down gradually to finish.

exercises.n: levantamiento turco bottoms-up a la rodilla con kettlebell
exercises.en: kettlebell bottoms up to knee turkish get up
exercises.d: A Turkish get-up holding the bell upside down, moving only up to a kneeling position. It builds shoulder stability and core control.
i: Lie on your back holding a kettlebell upside down in one hand, arm straight up.
Bend the same-side knee and plant the foot.
Roll onto your elbow, then your hand.
Lift your hips and sweep the straight leg back to kneel.
Reverse the steps slowly to lie down.
Keep your eyes on the bell and switch sides after your reps.

exercises.n: supinación sentado con peso
exercises.d: Seated forearm rotation holding a weight to turn your palm upward. It builds forearm strength and wrist control.
i: Sit with your forearm resting on your thigh, hand over the knee.
Hold a weighted handle or dumbbell end in your hand.
Start with your palm facing down.
Rotate your forearm slowly until your palm faces up.
Return slowly to the start.
Switch arms after your reps.

exercises.n: curl de muñeca inverso sentado con peso
exercises.d: Wrist curls with palms down while seated, using a weight. They build the muscles on top of the forearm.
i: Sit with your forearms on your thighs, palms facing down.
Let your hands hang over your knees holding weights.
Lower your wrists to stretch the forearms.
Curl your wrists up as high as you can.
Lower slowly.
Keep your forearms still on your thighs.

exercises.n: curl de muñeca a un brazo sentado con peso
exercises.en: weighted seated one arm wrist curl
exercises.d: A one-arm wrist curl, palm up, seated with a weight. It builds the forearm flexors and grip.
i: Sit and rest one forearm on your thigh, palm up.
Let the weight roll toward your fingertips.
Curl your wrist up as far as you can.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.
Finish your reps and switch arms.

exercises.n: curl de muñeca inverso a un brazo sentado con peso
exercises.en: weighted seated one arm reverse wrist curl
exercises.d: A one-arm reverse wrist curl, palm down, seated with a weight. It strengthens the top of the forearm.
i: Sit and rest one forearm on your thigh, palm down.
Let your hand hang over your knee with the weight.
Lower your wrist for a stretch.
Lift your hand up as high as you can.
Lower slowly under control.
Complete your reps and switch arms.

exercises.n: remo para deltoide posterior sentado e inclinado con mancuernas
exercises.en: dumbbell seated bent over rear delt row
exercises.d: A seated bent-over row with elbows flared wide to hit the rear delts. Sitting keeps your legs from helping.
i: Sit at the end of a bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Lean forward with a flat back, arms hanging.
Pull the weights toward your sides with elbows flared out.
Squeeze your rear delts and upper back.
Lower slowly.
Keep your chest close to your thighs.

exercises.n: doble elevación frontal inclinada con apoyo en el pecho y mancuernas
exercises.en: dumbbell incline two front raise with chest support
exercises.d: A front raise with both arms while lying chest down on an incline bench. The support stops you from cheating with your back.
i: Set a bench to an incline and lie chest down on it.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging.
Raise both arms forward to shoulder height or just above.
Pause for a second.
Lower under control.
Keep your head neutral and your movement smooth.

exercises.n: press sentado con agarre cerrado y mancuernas
exercises.d: A seated overhead press with the dumbbells held close together, palms facing in. It works the front delts and triceps.
i: Sit upright on a bench with back support, dumbbells at shoulder height.
Hold them close together with palms facing each other.
Press them overhead until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight and ribs down.
Lower slowly back to your shoulders.
Do not arch your lower back.

exercises.n: elevación lateral a frontal sentado con mancuernas
exercises.en: dumbbell seated lateral to front raise
exercises.d: A seated raise that combines a side raise and a front raise in one rep. It builds the delts from two angles.
i: Sit tall on a bench holding light dumbbells at your sides.
Raise both arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Lower them back to your sides.
Raise both arms to the front to shoulder height.
Lower and repeat.
Avoid leaning back or swinging.

exercises.n: apertura invertida a un brazo (con apoyo) con mancuerna v. 2
exercises.en: dumbbell one arm reverse fly (with support) v. 2
exercises.d: A supported one-arm reverse fly that isolates the rear delts. Bracing with your other hand helps you keep a steady torso.
i: Hinge forward and brace your free hand on a bench or support.
Hold a light dumbbell hanging straight down.
Raise the dumbbell out to the side with a slight elbow bend.
Lift until your arm is about parallel to the floor.
Pause and lower slowly.
Finish your reps and switch arms.

exercises.n: press pallof horizontal con banda elástica
exercises.d: A standing Pallof press with a resistance band anchored at chest height. It trains your core to resist rotation.
i: Anchor a band at chest height and stand sideways to it.
Hold the handle at your chest with both hands.
Step away until the band is taut and brace your core.
Press your hands straight out in front of you.
Hold for a second without twisting, then bring them back.
Complete your reps and switch sides.

exercises.n: carrera de ida y vuelta con banda elástica
exercises.d: Quick side-to-side steps against band tension. It trains lateral leg power, agility and glute strength.
i: Anchor a band at hip height or place it around your waist with a partner or post.
Get into a slight squat with your chest up.
Shuffle sideways several steps against the tension.
Keep your feet from crossing.
Shuffle back the other way under control.
Stay low throughout.

exercises.n: salto de longitud a salto vertical
exercises.d: A forward jump followed straight away by a jump up. It trains explosive power in two directions.
i: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and swing your arms back.
Jump forward as far as you can.
Land softly with bent knees.
Immediately explode into a vertical jump with your arms up.
Land softly and reset.
Take a short rest between reps.

exercises.n: lanzamiento por encima de la cabeza con balón medicinal
exercises.d: Throwing a medicine ball up and forward from overhead. It builds full-body explosive power through the core and shoulders.
i: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart holding a medicine ball overhead.
Lean back slightly and brace your core.
Throw the ball forward or against a wall as hard as you can.
Follow through with your arms.
Catch or pick up the ball and reset.
Keep your back from over-arching.

exercises.n: caminata con kettlebell sobre la cabeza
exercises.d: Walking while holding a kettlebell locked out overhead. It builds shoulder stability, core control and grip.
i: Clean and press a kettlebell overhead with one arm.
Lock out your elbow with the bell stable.
Stand tall with your ribs down.
Walk forward with slow, controlled steps.
Keep your wrist straight and avoid leaning.
Lower the bell and repeat on the other arm.

exercises.n: salto a una pierna sobre tabla
exercises.d: A one-leg jump over or onto a board to build power and landing control. It trains single-leg explosiveness.
i: Stand on one leg next to or in front of a board.
Bend slightly and swing your arms.
Jump up and across or onto the board.
Land softly on the same leg with a bent knee.
Hold the landing for a second.
Finish your reps and switch legs.

exercises.n: sentadilla frontal con landmine
exercises.d: A squat holding the end of a landmine bar at your chest. The angled bar helps keep you upright and easy on the back.
i: Load the landmine bar and hold the end against your chest with both hands.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Brace and squat down, keeping your chest tall.
Go as deep as you can with a flat back.
Drive up through your whole foot.
Keep your elbows pointing down.

exercises.n: peso muerto rumano con landmine v. 2
exercises.d: A Romanian deadlift using the landmine bar for an angled load. It builds the hamstrings and glutes with a good hip hinge.
i: Hold the end of the landmine bar with both hands in front of your thighs.
Stand with soft knees and a flat back.
Push your hips back and slide the bar down your legs.
Lower until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.

exercises.n: abdominal con brazos rectos y mancuerna
exercises.d: A crunch holding a dumbbell straight above your chest. It loads the abs while your arms stay locked.
i: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Hold a dumbbell with both hands, arms straight up.
Curl your shoulders off the floor, reaching toward the ceiling.
Squeeze your abs at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your arms straight and your neck relaxed.

exercises.n: giro ruso con piernas rectas y mancuerna
exercises.d: A Russian twist with your legs straight and a dumbbell in hand. The longer lever makes it a tough oblique exercise.
i: Sit with your legs straight out and heels just off the floor.
Lean back slightly with a flat back.
Hold a dumbbell in both hands in front of your chest.
Rotate your torso to one side, then the other.
Keep your legs steady.
Move smoothly and breathe.

exercises.n: abdominal en v con mancuerna v. 2
exercises.d: A V-up holding a dumbbell, raising your torso and legs together. It trains the whole abdominal wall.
i: Lie on your back with your legs straight, holding a dumbbell overhead.
Brace your core.
Lift your legs and torso together, reaching the dumbbell toward your feet.
Form a V at the top.
Lower slowly with control.
Keep your lower back pressed down.

exercises.n: abdominal con giro y brazos rectos con mancuerna
exercises.en: dumbbell straight arm twisting sit up
exercises.d: A sit-up with a rotation while holding a dumbbell on straight arms. It works the abs and obliques.
i: Lie on your back with knees bent, holding a dumbbell over your chest.
Sit up while keeping your arms straight.
Twist toward one side at the top.
Return to centre and lower slowly.
Alternate sides on each rep.
Keep your feet down and movement controlled.

exercises.n: abdominal con peso v. 2
exercises.d: A crunch with weight held on your chest or behind your head. The added load makes the abs work harder.
i: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Hold a weight against your chest.
Curl your shoulders and upper back off the floor.
Squeeze your abs at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your chin off your chest.

exercises.n: abdominal con balón medicinal v. 2
exercises.d: A crunch holding a medicine ball for extra resistance. It targets the abs with a simple, adjustable load.
i: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Hold a medicine ball against your chest or overhead.
Curl your shoulders off the floor.
Reach the ball toward your knees.
Lower slowly.
Keep your lower back on the floor.

exercises.n: salto vertical a una pierna
exercises.d: A vertical jump from one leg to build explosive power and balance. Each side gets its own work.
i: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend.
Swing your arms back.
Jump straight up as high as you can.
Land softly on the same leg.
Reset your balance.
Finish your reps and switch legs.

exercises.n: puente de cadera con piernas rectas
exercises.d: A hip bridge with your legs straight and heels on the floor. It shifts more work to the hamstrings and glutes.
i: Lie on your back with your legs straight and heels on the floor.
Place your arms by your sides.
Press through your heels and lift your hips.
Form a straight line from shoulders to heels.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly.

exercises.n: sentadilla de descenso
exercises.d: A single-leg squat that lowers you off a step. It builds quad strength and knee control.
i: Stand on a step with one foot hanging off the edge.
Hold your arms in front for balance.
Squat down on the standing leg and lower the free heel to the floor.
Keep your knee tracking over your toes.
Press back up to the start.
Finish your reps and switch legs.

exercises.n: desplazamiento lateral
exercises.d: Quick lateral steps in an athletic stance. It builds agility, coordination and leg endurance.
i: Stand with your feet slightly wider than your shoulders and knees bent.
Keep your chest up and your weight on your toes.
Step sideways without crossing your feet.
Move quickly for a few steps.
Change direction and shuffle back.
Stay low throughout.

exercises.n: carrera hacia atrás
exercises.d: Running backwards at a comfortable pace. It raises your heart rate and strengthens the quads and calves.
i: Find a clear, flat area or treadmill at a low speed.
Stand tall with your arms bent.
Run backwards, landing on the balls of your feet.
Glance over your shoulder from time to time.
Keep a steady, controlled pace.
Slow down gradually to finish.

exercises.n: caminata en elíptica v. 7
exercises.d: Steady walking motion on an elliptical trainer. It is a low-impact way to raise your heart rate and build endurance.
i: Step onto the pedals and hold the handles lightly.
Start moving in a smooth, walking-style stride.
Stand tall with your shoulders relaxed and core braced.
Choose a moderate resistance and keep a steady pace.
Continue for 10 to 30 minutes, depending on your fitness, then cool down slowly.

exercises.n: estiramiento con círculos de rodilla v. 2
exercises.d: Gentle knee circles with the leg slightly bent that loosen up the knee area and calves. Handy as a warm-up or a loosening drill.
i: Stand with your feet together and bend your knees slightly.
Place your hands on your knees for support.
Slowly rotate your knees in a circle in one direction.
Keep the movement smooth and controlled.
Switch to the other direction after 8 to 10 circles.

exercises.n: estiramiento de barco
exercises.d: A seated stretch that opens up the front of the torso and abs. It leaves your midsection feeling long and loose.
i: Lie on your stomach with your legs together.
Place your hands under your shoulders.
Press up, lifting your chest and straightening your arms.
Keep your hips on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower slowly and relax.

exercises.n: estiramiento mirando al techo v. 2
exercises.d: A standing stretch where you reach up and look toward the ceiling to open the front of the body. It opens the hips and thighs.
i: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Reach both arms overhead and slightly back.
Tilt your head back to look at the ceiling while pressing your hips forward.
Keep your core engaged so your lower back is not over-arched.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily, then relax.

exercises.n: estiramiento de pies y tobillos
exercises.d: A gentle stretch for the feet and ankles. It helps loosen stiff joints and the muscles around them.
i: Sit on a chair or the floor with one leg extended.
Point your toes away from you.
Hold for 15 seconds.
Pull your toes back toward your shin.
Hold for another 15 seconds.
Switch legs and repeat.

exercises.n: estiramiento con rotación de pies y tobillos
exercises.d: Rotating the foot in slow circles to mobilise the ankle. It warms up the joint and relieves stiffness.
i: Sit with one leg extended or crossed over your knee.
Hold your lower leg steady.
Draw slow circles with your foot.
Do 10 circles in one direction.
Switch to the other direction.
Repeat on the other foot.

exercises.n: estiramiento con círculos de cadera
exercises.d: Big circles with your hips that loosen the joint and the muscles around it. A good warm-up for leg days.
i: Stand with your feet slightly wider than shoulder width.
Place your hands on your hips.
Rotate your hips in a wide circle.
Do 10 circles in one direction.
Reverse and circle the other way.
Keep your shoulders still and your knees soft.

exercises.n: elevación de rodilla
exercises.d: Lifting your knee toward your chest to warm up the hips and activate the hip flexors. A simple dynamic drill.
i: Stand tall with your arms at your sides.
Lift one knee up toward your chest.
Hold it for a moment.
Lower the foot with control.
Alternate legs.
Keep your standing leg steady and your back straight.

exercises.n: estiramiento de espalda media
exercises.d: A stretch that rounds the middle back and spreads the shoulder blades. It relieves tension from sitting or rowing.
i: Stand or sit and clasp your hands in front of you.
Straighten your arms and push them forward.
Round your upper back and tuck your chin.
Feel the stretch between your shoulder blades.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release slowly and repeat.

exercises.n: zancada estática con mancuernas
exercises.d: A split-stance lunge done in place with dumbbells in hand. It builds strength in the front thigh and glutes without any stepping.
i: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand in a long split stance, rear heel lifted.
Keep your torso upright and core braced.
Bend both knees and lower until the back knee nearly touches the floor.
Press through the front heel to stand back up without moving your feet.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: puente de glúteos a una pierna con mancuerna
exercises.d: A one-legged hip bridge with a dumbbell resting on your hips. It hits the glutes hard and challenges hip stability.
i: Lie on your back with one knee bent, foot flat, and the other leg extended or raised.
Rest a dumbbell across your hips and hold it steady.
Drive through the planted heel and lift your hips until your body forms a straight line.
Squeeze your glute at the top for a second.
Lower with control and repeat, then switch legs.

exercises.n: curl de pierna acostado con mancuerna
exercises.d: Lying face down, you curl a dumbbell held between your feet toward your glutes. A simple way to train the back of the thighs without a machine.
i: Lie face down on a bench and grip the edge for support.
Have a dumbbell gripped between your feet, or placed by a partner, with legs straight.
Bend your knees and curl the weight toward your glutes.
Pause briefly at the top without lifting your hips.
Lower slowly until your legs are almost straight.

exercises.n: peso muerto con piernas rectas y mancuernas
exercises.d: A hip hinge with nearly straight legs and dumbbells. It stretches and strengthens the hamstrings, glutes and lower back.
i: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Keep your legs almost straight with a soft knee and a flat back.
Push your hips back and lower the weights along your legs until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall and squeeze your glutes.

exercises.n: sentadilla sobre la cabeza con peso corporal
exercises.d: A deep squat performed with your arms locked out overhead. It trains the legs while testing shoulder and hip mobility.
i: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and raise both arms straight overhead.
Brace your core and keep your arms in line with your ears.
Sit your hips back and down into a deep squat, chest tall.
Drive through your heels to stand, keeping your arms locked overhead.

exercises.n: zancada caminando con mancuernas
exercises.d: Lunging forward step after step with a dumbbell in each hand. It builds leg and glute strength and balance.
i: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step forward with one leg and lower until both knees are about 90 degrees.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee over your ankle.
Push through the front foot and bring the back leg forward into the next step.
Alternate legs for the desired number of steps.

exercises.n: estiramiento cruzado de flexores de cadera de rodillas
exercises.d: A kneeling lunge stretch with a cross-body reach to deepen the stretch along the front of the hip.
i: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward in a lunge, on a mat.
Tuck your pelvis slightly and keep your torso upright.
Reach the arm on the kneeling side up and across toward the opposite side.
Shift your hips gently forward until you feel the stretch at the front of the hip.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.n: estiramiento de cuádriceps acostado
exercises.d: A stretch for the front of the thigh done lying on your side or front. It loosens tight quads after leg work.
i: Lie on your side with your legs stacked and your head resting on one arm.
Bend the top knee and grab that ankle with your top hand.
Pull your heel toward your glutes while keeping your knees close together.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.n: estiramiento de cuádriceps
exercises.d: A standing stretch for the front of the thigh. Easy to do anywhere to ease tight quads.
i: Stand tall, using a wall or support for balance if needed.
Bend one knee and grab the ankle behind you.
Pull your heel toward your glutes, keeping your knees together and hips square.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

exercises.n: giro sentado (brazos rectos)
exercises.d: A seated rotation with your arms held straight out, loosening the spine and working the waist gently.
i: Sit tall on the floor with your legs crossed or extended.
Extend both arms straight out to the sides at shoulder height.
Rotate your torso slowly to one side, keeping your spine long.
Hold for a moment, then rotate to the other side.
Repeat for 8-10 slow rotations each way.

exercises.n: estiramiento de una pierna (rodilla flexionada)
exercises.d: A pilates move where you alternate pulling one knee in while the other leg extends. It builds core control and coordination.
i: Lie on your back, lift your head and shoulders, and bring both knees toward your chest.
Place your hands on one shin and extend the other leg out low.
Switch legs smoothly, drawing the other knee in.
Keep your lower back pressed down and your abs tight.
Continue alternating with a steady breath rhythm.

exercises.n: estiramiento de una pierna recta
exercises.d: A pilates exercise where you scissor your straight legs while holding the raised one. It trains the abs and tests hamstring flexibility.
i: Lie on your back, lift your head and shoulders off the mat.
Extend one leg straight up and the other hovering low.
Hold the raised leg with both hands and pulse twice toward you.
Switch legs and repeat, keeping your torso steady.
Keep your lower back anchored throughout.

exercises.n: estiramiento inclinándose hacia delante
exercises.d: A standing side-leaning stretch that opens up the lats and the side of the torso.
i: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Raise one arm overhead and keep the other hand resting on your hip.
Lean slowly toward the opposite side, lengthening along the raised arm.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Return to upright and switch sides.

exercises.n: estiramiento de columna (en balón de estabilidad)
exercises.d: A gentle back stretch draped over or kneeling at a stability ball. It lengthens the spine and relaxes the torso.
i: Kneel in front of a stability ball and place your forearms or hands on top.
Roll the ball forward as you sink your hips back.
Let your head drop between your arms and lengthen your spine.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing deeply.
Roll the ball back in to come up.

exercises.n: estiramiento de columna hacia delante
exercises.d: A seated pilates stretch where you round forward over your legs, one vertebra at a time. It mobilizes the spine and stretches the hamstrings.
i: Sit tall with legs extended hip-width apart and arms reaching forward.
Flex your feet and lift your torso up out of your hips.
Curl your chin to your chest and round forward, reaching past your toes.
Hold for a breath, then stack your spine back up slowly.
Repeat for several slow reps.

exercises.n: pullover con mancuerna en el suelo
exercises.d: A pullover lying on the floor, which limits the stretch range and keeps the focus on the lats and chest.
i: Lie on your back with knees bent and hold one dumbbell with both hands above your chest.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Lower the weight in an arc behind your head until your upper arms touch the floor.
Pull it back over your chest using your lats.
Keep your ribs down and core tight throughout.

exercises.n: flexión lateral de pie (brazo flexionado) v. 2
exercises.d: A bodyweight side bend with one arm bent behind your head, working the obliques.
i: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and one hand behind your head, elbow bent.
Place your other hand on your hip.
Bend sideways toward the hand on your hip without leaning forward.
Squeeze your side to return upright.
