Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: pullover con brazos flexionados y mancuerna
exercises.d: A pullover with the elbows kept bent, lying on a bench. It stretches and strengthens the chest and lats.
i: Lie back on a bench holding one dumbbell with both hands above your chest.
Bend your elbows slightly and keep them bent throughout.
Lower the dumbbell back over your head until you feel a stretch in your chest.
Keep your ribs down and your core braced.
Pull the dumbbell back over your chest and repeat.

exercises.n: prensa vertical de piernas en trineo
exercises.d: A leg press on a sled that moves straight up, pressing the weight vertically. It loads the thighs and glutes heavily.
i: Lie on your back under the sled and place your feet shoulder-width on the platform.
Release the safety catches and lower the platform until your knees are deeply bent.
Keep your lower back flat on the pad.
Press the platform up without locking your knees.
Lower under control for each rep.

exercises.n: tijeras de pie
exercises.d: A quick jumping drill where your legs swap front and back like scissors. Good for conditioning and coordination.
i: Stand tall with one foot forward and one back, arms ready.
Hop lightly and switch your leg positions in the air.
Swing your arms opposite to your legs for balance.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep a quick, steady rhythm for the set.

exercises.n: empuje con silla
exercises.d: A push-up variation with hands on a sturdy chair. It makes pressing easier while still training chest and arms.
i: Place a stable chair against a wall and set your hands on the seat edge.
Walk your feet back until your body is straight.
Lower your chest toward the seat, elbows at about 45 degrees.
Push back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight and hips level.

exercises.n: patada con abdominal reverso
exercises.d: A reverse crunch finished with a leg kick upward, hitting the lower abs.
i: Lie on your back with arms by your sides and knees bent over your hips.
Curl your hips off the floor, bringing your knees toward your chest.
Kick your feet up toward the ceiling.
Lower your hips slowly and bend your knees again.
Avoid swinging; use your abs to lift.

exercises.n: abdominal con elevación de una pierna
exercises.d: A crunch where one leg lifts as you curl up. It adds a lower-abs challenge to the basic crunch.
i: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands behind your head.
Extend one leg and lift it a few inches off the floor.
Curl your shoulders up toward your hips.
Lower slowly, then repeat.
Switch legs halfway through or alternate each rep.

exercises.n: abdominal mantenido
exercises.d: A crunch held at the top to keep the abs under tension. Simple and burns quickly.
i: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Place your hands lightly behind your head or across your chest.
Curl your head and shoulders off the floor.
Hold the top position for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily.
Lower down with control.

exercises.n: círculo de abdominal reverso en banco
exercises.d: A bench reverse crunch where your knees trace a circle. It works the lower abs and obliques.
i: Lie on a bench and grip behind your head for support.
Bring your knees up over your hips.
Curl your hips up and draw a small circle with your knees.
Reverse the circle on the next rep.
Lower your hips slowly each time.

exercises.n: abdominal oblicuo en plancha lateral
exercises.d: A side plank with a knee-to-elbow crunch. It trains the obliques and shoulder stability together.
i: Set up in a side plank on one forearm, feet stacked or staggered.
Put your free hand behind your head.
Bring your top knee and elbow together beneath your torso.
Extend back to the side plank position.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: flexión lateral con mancuerna v. 2
exercises.d: A weighted side bend using a dumbbell to load the obliques.
i: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in one hand at your side.
Place your other hand behind your head.
Bend sideways toward the weighted side, keeping your hips still.
Squeeze the opposite side to return upright.
Finish your reps, then switch hands.

exercises.n: curl de bíceps en máquina
exercises.d: A biceps curl on a plate-loaded lever machine that guides the path. It builds the front of the upper arm.
i: Adjust the seat so your elbows line up with the machine pivot.
Grip the handles with palms up.
Curl the handles toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are nearly straight.

exercises.n: curl araña con barra
exercises.d: A barbell curl done chest-down on an incline bench, which removes swinging and isolates the biceps.
i: Lie chest-down on an incline bench with your arms hanging and a barbell in your hands.
Grip the bar with palms facing up, shoulder-width.
Curl the bar toward your shoulders without moving your upper arms.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly to full extension.

exercises.n: pullover con barra v. 2
exercises.d: A pullover with a barbell lying on a bench. It stretches and strengthens the lats and chest.
i: Lie on a bench holding a barbell over your chest with a close grip.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Lower the bar in an arc behind your head until you feel a deep stretch.
Pull it back over your chest using your lats.
Keep your core braced and your ribs down.

exercises.n: pullover con agarre abierto y barra
exercises.d: A pullover using a wider grip, which spreads the load across the lats and chest.
i: Lie on a bench with a barbell held wider than shoulder-width above your chest.
Keep your elbows slightly bent.
Lower the bar behind your head in a smooth arc.
Pull the bar back over your chest.
Maintain a stable core and avoid arching your back.

exercises.n: elevación frontal alterna con mancuernas
exercises.d: Raising one dumbbell at a time in front of you to shoulder height. It targets the front of the shoulders.
i: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows and your torso still.
Raise one arm forward to shoulder height.
Lower it slowly as you raise the other arm.
Avoid swinging; keep alternating for your reps.

exercises.n: apertura con giro y mancuernas
exercises.d: A dumbbell fly where you rotate your wrists through the movement for a stronger chest squeeze.
i: Lie on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand above your chest, palms facing in.
Open your arms wide in an arc with elbows slightly bent.
Rotate your wrists as you lower until you feel a chest stretch.
Bring the dumbbells back together, twisting them to finish with palms inward.
Control the weight on the way down.

exercises.n: extensión de tríceps a un brazo con mancuerna
exercises.d: A single-arm overhead extension with a dumbbell. It isolates the triceps and builds arm strength.
i: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and press it overhead.
Keep your upper arm close to your head with the elbow pointing up.
Bend the elbow and lower the dumbbell behind your head.
Extend the elbow to press the weight back up.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: rompecráneos inclinado con barra
exercises.en: barbell incline triceps extension skull crusher
exercises.d: An incline version of the skull crusher, lowering a barbell behind your head to hit the long head of the triceps.
i: Lie back on an incline bench holding a barbell above your chest, arms straight.
Keep your upper arms still.
Bend your elbows and lower the bar toward your forehead.
Extend your arms to return to the start.
Keep your elbows pointing forward.

exercises.n: curl inclinado con agarre cerrado en polea
exercises.d: A biceps curl on an incline bench with a cable and a narrow grip. It keeps constant tension and a deep stretch.
i: Lean back on an incline bench in front of a low cable with a straight bar.
Grip the bar close together with palms up.
Curl the bar toward your shoulders, upper arms still.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are nearly straight.

exercises.n: press militar de pie con peso corporal
exercises.d: A standing overhead press without weight, good for learning the pressing path or warming up.
i: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart and fists at your shoulders.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Press your arms straight overhead.
Lower back to your shoulders with control.
Avoid leaning back.

exercises.n: curl de pierna de pie en máquina
exercises.d: A standing single-leg curl on a lever machine. It targets the hamstrings one side at a time.
i: Stand facing the machine and set the pad behind your working ankle.
Hold the supports for balance.
Curl your heel toward your glutes.
Squeeze your hamstring at the top.
Lower slowly, then switch legs.

exercises.n: abdominal en cuatro apoyos
exercises.d: A four-point hold on hands and knees where you engage the abs. A gentle way to learn core bracing.
i: Start on hands and knees with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips.
Keep your back flat and neck neutral.
Draw your belly button toward your spine.
Hold for 15-30 seconds while breathing normally.
Relax and repeat.

exercises.n: sentadilla a una pierna con barra
exercises.d: A one-legged squat with a barbell on your back. It builds leg strength and balance, so use light weight.
i: Rest a barbell on your upper back and stand on one leg, other leg lifted in front.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Sit your hips back and lower as deep as you control.
Drive through your heel to stand.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: curl acostado con agarre normal en polea
exercises.d: A biceps curl performed lying on your back with a cable. The lying position keeps constant tension on the biceps.
i: Lie on your back with your feet toward a low pulley and grab the bar with an underhand grip.
Pin your upper arms to the floor beside you.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight and repeat.

exercises.n: rompecráneos inclinado en polea
exercises.d: A skull crusher on an incline bench with cable resistance, giving steady tension on the triceps.
i: Set an incline bench facing away from a low cable and hold the bar overhead.
Keep your upper arms still.
Bend your elbows and lower the bar toward your forehead.
Extend your arms to return.
Keep your elbows from flaring.

exercises.n: fondos en banco en el suelo v. 2
exercises.d: A dip where your hands rest on a bench behind you and your feet stay on the floor. It builds the back of the upper arms.
i: Sit on the floor with your back to a bench and place your hands on its edge.
Lift your hips and extend your legs slightly in front.
Bend your elbows and lower your body.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your shoulders away from your ears.

exercises.n: extensión de tríceps acostado en polea (con cuerda)
exercises.d: A lying triceps extension on a bench using a cable rope. It keeps constant tension on the triceps.
i: Lie on a bench with your head toward a low pulley and hold the rope above your chest.
Keep your upper arms still.
Bend your elbows and lower the rope behind your head.
Extend your arms to return.
Spread the rope slightly at the end.

exercises.n: abdominal oblicuo alterno
exercises.d: A crunch that alternates elbow-to-knee across the body, hitting the obliques.
i: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands behind your head.
Lift your shoulders off the floor.
Twist and bring one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Return to center and switch sides.
Move slowly and avoid pulling on your neck.

exercises.n: extensión de tríceps en polea (barra V) v. 2
exercises.d: A triceps pushdown using a V bar on a high cable, a classic for the back of the arms.
i: Stand facing a high pulley and grip the V bar with elbows at your sides.
Keep your torso upright and slightly forward.
Push the bar down until your arms are straight.
Squeeze your triceps for a moment.
Let the bar rise slowly, elbows still.

exercises.n: press pallof horizontal en polea v. 2
exercises.d: An anti-rotation press where you push a cable straight out and resist the twist. Great for core stability.
i: Stand sideways to a cable set at chest height, hands holding the handle at your chest.
Step away to load the cable and brace your core.
Press the handle straight out in front of you.
Hold for a second without rotating.
Bring it back to your chest, then switch sides.

exercises.n: curl de bíceps con banda elástica v. 2
exercises.d: A simple biceps curl with a band underfoot. It trains the front of the arms with elastic resistance.
i: Stand on the band with feet shoulder-width apart and hold the ends, palms up.
Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.
Curl your hands toward your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly against the band.

exercises.n: jalón de rodillas con banda elástica
exercises.d: A kneeling pulldown using a band anchored overhead. It builds the lats at home.
i: Anchor a band high and kneel facing it, holding the ends.
Lean back slightly and brace your core.
Pull your elbows down toward your ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly with control.

exercises.n: extensión de tríceps sobre la cabeza con banda elástica v. 3
exercises.d: A triceps extension with a band held overhead. It trains the long head of the triceps.
i: Stand holding a band behind your head, one hand low and one hand high.
Keep your elbows close to your head.
Extend your top arm straight overhead.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly, then switch sides.

exercises.n: fondos en banco con piernas en el banco
exercises.en: bench dip with legs on bench
exercises.d: A harder bench dip with your feet on a second bench. It places greater load on the triceps.
i: Place your hands on one bench behind you and your heels on another in front.
Straighten your legs and lift your hips.
Bend your elbows to lower your body.
Press back up.
Keep your back close to the bench.

exercises.n: encogimientos con peso corporal
exercises.d: A shoulder shrug without weight for warming up or light trap work.
i: Stand tall with arms by your sides.
Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Hold for a second.
Lower them slowly.
Avoid rolling your shoulders.

exercises.n: sentadilla con pausa de 2 segundos y barra
exercises.d: A barbell back squat with a two second pause at the bottom, removing bounce and building strength.
i: Set a barbell on your upper back and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Brace your core and sit down into a deep squat.
Pause for two seconds at the bottom.
Drive through your heels to stand.
Keep your chest up throughout.

exercises.n: sentadilla patinador con contrapeso
exercises.d: A single-leg squat with arms forward as a counterweight. It builds balance and strength.
i: Stand on one leg and extend the other behind you.
Reach your arms forward for balance.
Bend your standing knee and lower slowly.
Touch lightly with your back knee if needed.
Drive back up and switch legs.

exercises.n: fondos a una pierna en el suelo
exercises.d: A floor dip with one leg raised for extra challenge. It targets the triceps and core balance.
i: Sit on the floor with hands behind you and knees bent.
Lift your hips and extend one leg out.
Bend your elbows to lower.
Press back up.
Switch legs after your reps.

exercises.n: postura de descanso del animal (yoga)
exercises.d: A resting yoga pose that gently stretches the back and hips, similar to child pose.
i: Kneel on a mat and sit back toward your heels.
Fold forward and stretch your arms ahead.
Rest your forehead on the floor.
Breathe deeply and hold for 30-60 seconds.
Release slowly.

exercises.n: abdominal lateral de pie
exercises.d: A standing crunch where you lift a knee to the side toward your elbow. It works the obliques.
i: Stand tall with your hands behind your head.
Lift one knee out to the side.
Crunch your elbow down toward it.
Return to standing.
Repeat on both sides.

exercises.n: remo inclinado con agarre inverso en polea
exercises.en: cable bent over reverse grip row
exercises.d: A bent-over row with a cable using an underhand grip, which emphasizes the lower lats and biceps.
i: Stand facing a low cable and hinge forward with a flat back.
Grip the bar with palms up.
Pull the bar toward your lower ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly.

exercises.n: remo inclinado con cuerda en polea
exercises.en: cable bent over row with rope attachment
exercises.d: A bent-over row with a cable rope, allowing a neutral grip and a good squeeze at the end.
i: Attach a rope to a low pulley and hinge forward with a flat back.
Grip the rope with palms facing each other.
Pull the rope toward your lower chest.
Spread the rope as you squeeze your back.
Lower with control.

exercises.n: curl de bíceps de pie con peso corporal v. 2
exercises.d: A light, no-equipment biceps curl using self-resistance, useful for warming up.
i: Stand tall with arms at your sides.
Make fists and curl your hands to your shoulders.
Tense your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your elbows pinned.

exercises.n: elevación de gemelos sentado en smith
exercises.d: A seated calf raise with a barbell on a Smith machine, working the lower calf muscle.
i: Sit on a bench under the bar with the balls of your feet on a raised block.
Rest the bar across your thighs with a pad.
Lift your heels as high as possible.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly for a full stretch.

exercises.n: press de pecho inclinado a un brazo en máquina (con discos)
exercises.en: lever incline one arm chest press (plate loaded)
exercises.d: A one-armed incline press on a plate-loaded lever machine. It trains the upper chest one side at a time.
i: Sit on the machine and grip one handle.
Set your back firmly against the pad.
Press the handle forward and up.
Squeeze your chest at the top.
Return slowly, then switch arms.

exercises.n: postura del cocodrilo (yoga)
exercises.d: A low plank-like yoga pose held just above the floor. It strengthens the core and arms.
i: Lie face down with palms under your shoulders.
Tuck your toes and lift your body.
Lower into a low plank with elbows tucked in.
Keep your body straight and hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower to the floor.

exercises.n: bicho muerto colgado
exercises.d: A hanging variation of the dead bug, extending opposite arm and leg. It builds core control.
i: Hang from a pull-up bar with a firm grip.
Lift your knees to hip height.
Extend one leg while keeping control of your torso.
Return and switch legs.
Avoid swinging.

exercises.n: apertura baja alterna de pie en polea
exercises.d: A standing cable fly from a low pulley, sweeping the arms up and across one at a time. It trains the upper chest.
i: Stand between two low pulleys holding the handles.
Take a small step forward with a slight lean.
Sweep one arm up and across toward the center of your chest.
Return slowly.
Alternate sides.

exercises.n: rotación del balón medicinal alrededor de la cabeza
exercises.d: Circle a medicine ball around your head to warm up the shoulders and challenge your core and balance.
i: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart, holding a medicine ball at chest height.
Brace your core and keep your hips still.
Pass the ball around your head in a smooth circle, keeping it close.
Complete several circles, then reverse the direction.
Keep your ribs down and avoid leaning back as the ball passes behind you.

exercises.n: caminata en parada de manos
exercises.d: An advanced bodyweight skill where you walk on your hands while inverted. It builds shoulder strength, balance and body control.
i: Kick up into a handstand against a wall or with a spotter, hands shoulder-width apart.
Squeeze your glutes and legs together and push tall through your shoulders.
Shift your weight onto one hand and move the other forward a small step.
Alternate hands in short, controlled steps, keeping your core tight.
Come down safely with control, and practise on soft ground.

exercises.n: cargada colgado y envión con mancuernas
exercises.d: An explosive lift that takes a dumbbell from the hang to your shoulder and then overhead. It builds power through the hips, legs and shoulders.
i: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell hanging in front of your thighs.
Hinge at the hips, then drive them forward and shrug as you pull the dumbbell up.
Drop under it and catch it at your shoulder with a slight knee bend.
Dip a little, then drive up through your legs and press the dumbbell overhead.
Lower it back to your shoulder, then to the hang under control.

exercises.n: remo alto con agarre inverso en máquina (con discos)
exercises.en: lever reverse grip high row (plate loaded)
exercises.d: A plate-loaded machine row with an underhand grip that trains the lats and upper back while the biceps assist.
i: Sit at the machine with your chest against the pad and grab the handles underhand.
Set your shoulders back and down.
Pull the handles toward your lower ribs, driving your elbows back.
Squeeze your back at the end of the pull.
Slowly extend your arms without letting your shoulders round forward.

exercises.n: remo invertido con banda elástica
exercises.d: A bodyweight row with a band added for extra load. It builds the upper back and biceps while your core keeps the body straight.
i: Anchor the band to a sturdy bar or rack and hold it while lying under the anchor point.
Keep your body in a straight line with heels on the floor.
Pull your chest up toward your hands, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower yourself under control until your arms are straight.

exercises.n: deslizamiento de pierna de pie con toalla
exercises.d: A standing exercise where one foot slides on a towel to work the hips and thighs while the standing leg balances you.
i: Stand on a smooth floor with one foot on a towel and hold a support if needed.
Bend the standing knee slightly and keep your chest tall.
Slide the towel foot out to the side or back as far as you can control.
Pull it back to the start using your hip and thigh muscles.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: postura de piernas en la pared (yoga)
exercises.en: legs up the wall yoga pose
exercises.d: A restful pose where your legs rest up a wall, gently stretching the backs of the legs and easing tension in the lower back.
i: Sit sideways next to a wall and lie back as you swing your legs up the wall.
Move your hips close to the wall, with your arms relaxed at your sides.
Keep your knees soft if the hamstrings feel tight.
Breathe slowly and relax your shoulders and jaw.
Hold for 1-5 minutes, then bend your knees and roll to one side to come up.

exercises.n: zancada con barra en posición frontal v. 2
exercises.d: A forward lunge with the bar resting on your front shoulders. The front load works the quads and glutes and challenges your core.
i: Rest the barbell on the front of your shoulders with elbows high.
Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Step forward into a long stride and lower until both knees reach about 90 degrees.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs, keeping your torso upright.

exercises.n: lanzamiento rotacional con paso atrás y balón medicinal
exercises.en: medicine ball step behind rotational throw
exercises.d: An explosive rotational throw that starts with a step behind. It builds power through the hips and trunk.
i: Stand sideways to a wall, holding a medicine ball at hip height.
Step your rear foot behind you and load your weight onto it.
Rotate your hips and torso toward the wall.
Throw the ball hard into the wall at chest height.
Catch it, reset, and switch sides after your set.

exercises.n: plancha con serrucho
exercises.d: A plank variation where you rock your body forward and back in small motions. It heavily challenges the abs and shoulders.
i: Get into a forearm plank with elbows under your shoulders.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs.
Shift your body forward so your shoulders move past your elbows.
Rock back to the start in a slow, smooth motion.
Keep your hips level and avoid sagging.

exercises.n: plancha con balanceo de cadera
exercises.d: A plank with a rolling twist of the hips from side to side. It works the obliques and deep core muscles.
i: Start in a forearm plank with feet slightly wider than hip-width.
Brace your abs and keep your shoulders stable.
Rotate your hips to one side, lowering them toward the floor.
Roll back through the middle to the other side.
Keep the movement controlled and breathe steadily.

exercises.n: plancha con extensión de pierna
exercises.d: A plank where you lift and extend one leg at a time, testing core stability and strengthening the glutes.
i: Get into a forearm or high plank with a flat back.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes.
Lift one leg straight behind you without rotating your hips.
Lower it with control.
Repeat on the other leg and alternate.

exercises.n: postura de la sentadilla de oración (yoga)
exercises.d: A deep squat with palms together that opens the hips and inner thighs and builds ankle and hip mobility.
i: Stand with feet wider than hips and toes turned out.
Lower into a deep squat, keeping your heels down if you can.
Press your palms together at your chest.
Use your elbows to gently press your knees outward.
Hold for 30-60 seconds while breathing slowly.

exercises.n: levantada del prisionero
exercises.d: A bodyweight get-up with your hands behind your head. It builds leg strength, balance and hip control.
i: Kneel on the floor, with your hands behind your head.
Keep your chest tall and your core braced.
Step one foot forward and drive up through it to stand.
Lower back down with control to kneeling.
Alternate the leading leg on each rep.

exercises.n: empuje y envión con mancuernas
exercises.d: An explosive overhead lift that uses a leg drive to send dumbbells overhead. It builds power and shoulder strength.
i: Hold dumbbells at shoulder height, feet hip-width apart.
Dip by bending your knees slightly while keeping your torso upright.
Drive up through your legs explosively.
Press the dumbbells overhead as you straighten, then lock out your arms.
Lower them back to your shoulders with control.

exercises.n: zancada hacia atrás con barra en posición frontal
exercises.d: A reverse lunge with the barbell in a front rack. Stepping back keeps the load on the glutes and quads with less knee stress.
i: Rest the barbell across your front shoulders with elbows high.
Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Step one leg back and lower until both knees are around 90 degrees.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs and keep your torso upright.

exercises.n: remo bajo con cuerda en polea
exercises.en: cable low row with rope attachment
exercises.d: A seated cable row using a rope that lets your hands travel close to your body. It targets the lats and mid back.
i: Sit at the low pulley with the rope attached, feet on the platform and knees slightly bent.
Grab the rope ends with a neutral grip and sit tall.
Pull the rope toward your lower stomach, driving your elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly until your arms are straight without rounding your back.

exercises.n: postura del bote de remo (yoga)
exercises.d: A seated V-shaped balance, also called boat pose, that works the abs and hip flexors.
i: Sit with your knees bent and your feet on the floor.
Lean back slightly, keeping your chest lifted and back long.
Lift your feet and extend your legs into a V shape.
Reach your arms forward alongside your legs.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.

exercises.n: giro ruso con kettlebell
exercises.d: A seated twisting exercise with a kettlebell that targets the abs and obliques.
i: Sit on the floor with knees bent and lean back a little.
Hold a kettlebell by the horns at your chest.
Lift your feet slightly if you can, and keep your back straight.
Rotate your torso to one side, then the other.
Move with control and keep your chest lifted.

exercises.n: flexión alterna de hombro de espaldas a la pared
exercises.en: alternate shoulder flexion back to wall
exercises.d: A wall-supported drill to improve overhead reach, one arm at a time, while keeping the back flat against the wall.
i: Stand with your back, head and hips against a wall.
Keep your ribs down and your lower back near the wall.
Raise one arm forward and overhead as far as you can without arching.
Lower it with control.
Alternate arms for the set.

exercises.n: círculo de hombros
exercises.d: A simple warm-up where you roll the shoulders in circles to loosen the upper back and shoulder joints.
i: Stand tall with your arms relaxed by your sides.
Lift your shoulders up toward your ears.
Roll them back and down in a smooth circle.
Complete several slow circles.
Reverse the direction and repeat.

exercises.n: flexión lateral con kettlebell v. 2
exercises.d: A standing side bend with a kettlebell that trains the obliques and the muscles along the side of the trunk.
i: Stand tall, holding a kettlebell in one hand at your side.
Keep your feet hip-width apart and your core braced.
Bend sideways toward the weighted side without twisting.
Use your obliques to return to upright.
Finish your reps, then switch hands.

exercises.n: sentadilla dividida con barra en posición frontal
exercises.d: A split squat with the bar in a front rack position, building leg strength and core control.
i: Rest the barbell on your front shoulders with elbows high.
Take a split stance with one foot well in front of the other.
Lower your back knee toward the floor while keeping your torso upright.
Press through the front foot to rise.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: sentadilla con banda elástica
exercises.d: A squat with a resistance band for added load. It builds strength in the legs and hips.
i: Stand on the band with feet shoulder-width apart and hold the handles at your shoulders.
Brace your core and keep your chest tall.
Sit your hips back and bend your knees to lower into a squat.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your feet to stand up.

exercises.n: postura de la foca de pie (yoga)
exercises.d: A standing back-bending pose that opens the chest and front of the hips and stretches the abdomen.
i: Stand with feet hip-width apart and your hands on your lower back.
Lengthen through your spine.
Lift your chest and gently arch backward.
Keep your neck relaxed and your legs strong.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, then come back up slowly.

exercises.n: subida al cajón con kettlebell
exercises.d: A step-up on a bench or box while holding a kettlebell, working the quads and glutes one leg at a time.
i: Stand facing a sturdy box or bench holding a kettlebell at your chest or by your side.
Place one foot fully on the box.
Press through that heel to stand tall on top.
Lower back down slowly with control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: subida al cajón con rodilla arriba y barra
exercises.d: A step-up finished with a knee drive, training the glutes and legs along with balance and hip flexor control.
i: Rest a barbell on your upper back and stand facing a box.
Place one foot on the box and press up through that heel.
Drive the other knee up toward your hip at the top.
Lower the knee and step back down under control.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: postura del ángulo recto (yoga)
exercises.d: A wide-legged forward fold that stretches the hamstrings and inner thighs.
i: Stand with your feet wide apart and toes pointing forward.
Place your hands on your hips and lengthen your spine.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back.
Lower your hands to the floor or to your shins.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then rise slowly.

exercises.n: peso muerto sumo con kettlebells
exercises.d: A wide-stance deadlift with a kettlebell or two that trains the glutes, inner thighs and legs.
i: Stand with feet wide and toes turned out, kettlebells on the floor between your feet.
Hinge down and grip the handles with a flat back.
Push through your feet and stand up, squeezing your glutes.
Keep the kettlebells close to your body.
Lower back down by hinging at the hips.

exercises.n: postura de la palmera al viento (yoga)
exercises.d: A standing side stretch with your arms overhead that lengthens the sides of the body and opens the shoulders.
i: Stand tall with feet together and arms overhead, palms joined.
Reach up through your fingertips.
Lean gently to one side without twisting.
Breathe and hold for 15-20 seconds.
Return to center and repeat on the other side.

exercises.n: postura del águila (yoga)
exercises.d: A balancing pose with wrapped legs and arms. It stretches the hips and shoulders and builds focus.
i: Stand tall and bend both knees slightly.
Lift one leg and wrap it across the other thigh.
Cross your arms in front, one elbow over the other, palms together.
Lift your elbows and sink your hips slightly.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.n: postura del tigre (yoga)
exercises.d: A hands-and-knees pose where one leg extends back and the spine arches, mobilising the back and hips.
i: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Round your back and draw one knee toward your nose.
Then extend that leg back and up while lifting your chest.
Move smoothly with your breath.
Do your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: tiger tail tríceps
exercises.d: A triceps exercise using a bodyweight or stick-style handle, focused on straightening the elbows against resistance.
i: Set up facing your anchor or support, with your upper arms close to your body.
Brace your core and keep your elbows still.
Straighten your arms fully to engage the triceps.
Squeeze at the bottom for a moment.
Return slowly to the start.

exercises.n: remo al mentón con kettlebell
exercises.d: A vertical pull with a kettlebell that works the shoulders and upper traps.
i: Stand tall holding a kettlebell with both hands in front of your thighs.
Keep it close to your body.
Pull it up toward your chest, leading with your elbows.
Stop at about chest height.
Lower slowly under control.

exercises.n: zancada caminando con barra en posición frontal
exercises.d: A walking lunge with the barbell in a front rack, challenging the legs, balance and core.
i: Rest the barbell across your front shoulders with elbows high.
Step forward into a long stride.
Lower until both knees reach about 90 degrees.
Push through the front foot and bring the back leg through into the next step.
Keep walking, alternating legs, with an upright torso.

exercises.n: postura del guerrero ii (yoga)
exercises.d: A strong standing pose with wide legs and arms outstretched, building leg strength, hip opening and stamina.
i: Stand with your feet wide apart and turn your front foot out.
Bend the front knee over the ankle.
Extend your arms out to the sides at shoulder height.
Gaze over your front fingertips and keep your torso upright.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.n: elevación frontal alta sentado con barra
exercises.d: A seated barbell raise that lifts the bar high in front of you, working the front delts.
i: Sit on a bench holding a barbell with an overhand grip, in front of your thighs.
Keep your back straight and your core braced.
Lift the bar forward and up to eye level or higher.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly under control.

exercises.n: apertura con banda elástica (pronado a 90 grados)
exercises.d: A band pull-apart with an overhand grip and arms at 90 degrees that hits the rear delts and upper back.
i: Stand holding a band in front of you at shoulder height with an overhand grip.
Keep your arms straight and your core braced.
Pull your hands apart until the band touches your chest.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly to the start.

exercises.n: press de banca con kettlebell suspendido de banda y barra
exercises.en: barbell bench press with band suspended kettlebell
exercises.d: A bench press with kettlebells hanging from bands on the bar. The swinging load forces your stabilising muscles to work harder.
i: Lie on a bench and unrack the barbell with kettlebells hung from bands.
Plant your feet and brace your core.
Lower the bar slowly to your mid chest.
Press it up to full extension while keeping the bar steady.
Rack the bar safely when finished.

exercises.n: dominadas supinas con resistencia de banda elástica
exercises.d: A chin-up with a band adding resistance, building the lats and biceps.
i: Attach a band to the bar and loop it around your body or waist.
Hang from the bar with an underhand grip.
Pull yourself up until your chin clears the bar.
Squeeze your back at the top.
Lower with control to a full hang.

exercises.n: bird dog con deslizamiento de pierna
exercises.d: A bird dog variation where the leg slides along the floor, improving core stability and coordination.
i: Start on all fours with a sliding disc or towel under one foot.
Brace your core and keep your hips level.
Slide that leg straight back as you extend the opposite arm forward.
Return to the start in a controlled way.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: sentadilla sumo con toque al suelo
exercises.d: A wide-stance squat in which you touch the floor between your feet. It trains the glutes, thighs and hip mobility.
i: Stand with your feet wide and toes turned out.
Push your hips back and squat down.
Touch the floor with your fingertips between your feet.
Keep your chest lifted and your knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your heels to stand.

exercises.n: elevación de piernas acostado (modificada)
exercises.d: An easier lying leg raise that trains the lower abs. Bent knees reduce the strain on the lower back.
i: Lie on your back with your hands by your sides.
Bend your knees slightly and press your lower back into the floor.
Raise your legs until your hips flex to about 90 degrees.
Lower them slowly without arching your back.
Stop short of the floor and repeat.

exercises.n: marcha en el sitio
exercises.d: A low-impact cardio move where you march in place to raise your heart rate and warm up the legs.
i: Stand tall with your arms bent at your sides.
Lift one knee up toward hip height.
Lower it and lift the other knee.
Swing your arms in rhythm with your steps.
Keep a steady pace for 1-3 minutes.

exercises.n: patada de burro en polea
exercises.d: Kicking one leg back from a hands-and-knees position against cable resistance. It isolates the glutes.
i: Attach an ankle strap to a low cable and get on all fours facing the machine.
Hook the strap around one ankle.
Keeping the knee bent, drive your heel up toward the ceiling.
Squeeze your glute at the top without arching your back.
Return slowly and repeat, then switch legs.

exercises.n: curl de bíceps arrastrado con barra EZ
exercises.d: A curl where the bar drags up your torso with elbows pulled back. It keeps tension on the biceps and reduces shoulder help.
i: Stand holding an ez bar with an underhand grip at your thighs.
Keep the bar close to your body.
Curl it up while moving your elbows back behind you.
Let the bar slide up your torso to chest height.
Lower slowly under control.

exercises.n: remo acostado con agarre cerrado supino en rack con barra
exercises.en: barbell lying close grip underhand row on rack
exercises.d: A bodyweight row hanging under a barbell set in a rack, using a close underhand grip to target the lats and biceps.
i: Set a barbell in a rack at about waist height.
Lie underneath and grab it with a close underhand grip.
Keep your body straight and heels on the floor.
Pull your chest to the bar.
Lower yourself under control.

exercises.n: remo acostado con agarre cerrado prono en rack con barra
exercises.en: barbell lying close grip overhand row on rack
exercises.d: A bodyweight row under a rack-mounted barbell with a close overhand grip, targeting the upper back and lats.
i: Set a barbell in a rack at about waist height.
Lie beneath it and grip the bar overhand with hands close together.
Keep your body straight from head to heels.
Pull your chest to the bar and squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower with control.

exercises.n: remo acostado con agarre cerrado paralelo en rack con mancuernas
exercises.en: dumbbell lying close grip parallel row on rack
exercises.d: A chest-supported row lying on a rack with a neutral grip, working the lats and mid back.
i: Lie face down on a high bench or rack with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang with palms facing each other.
Row the dumbbells toward your ribs, keeping elbows close.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top.
Lower slowly to full extension.

exercises.n: remo acostado con agarre abierto en rack con mancuernas
exercises.en: dumbbell lying wide grip row on rack
exercises.d: A chest-supported row with a wide elbow path that emphasises the upper back and rear delts.
i: Lie face down on a high bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Row the dumbbells up with elbows flaring out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower under control.

exercises.n: empuje de trineo de potencia
exercises.d: A heavy sled push that builds leg drive and conditioning.
i: Load the sled and grip the handles at chest or hip height.
Lean forward with a straight body line.
Drive through your legs with powerful steps.
Keep your core tight and push the sled forward.
Maintain a steady pace for the set distance.

exercises.n: elevación lateral de cuello acostado con peso
exercises.d: A gentle neck exercise lying on your side and lifting the head against light resistance to strengthen the side neck muscles.
i: Lie on your side with your head supported at the edge of the bench.
Place a light weight or plate on the side of your head, held steady.
Lift your head slowly toward the ceiling.
Pause, then lower under control.
Complete your reps, then switch sides. Use light weight.

exercises.n: elevación lateral de cuello acostado de lado con peso
exercises.en: weighted side lying side neck raise
exercises.d: A gentle neck exercise lying on your side and lifting the head against light resistance to strengthen the side neck muscles.
i: Lie on your side with your head supported at the edge of the bench.
Place a light weight or plate on the side of your head, held steady.
Lift your head slowly toward the ceiling.
Pause, then lower under control.
Complete your reps, then switch sides. Use light weight.

exercises.n: movimiento de cuello de lado a lado acostado con peso
exercises.en: weighted lying neck side to side
exercises.d: A lying neck exercise moving the head side to side against light resistance to strengthen the neck.
i: Lie face up with a light weight on your forehead.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly turn your head toward one side.
Return to the middle and turn the other way.
Use light weight and smooth movement.

exercises.n: giro de cabeza y cuello acostado con peso
exercises.d: A lying neck twist with light resistance to work the muscles that rotate the head.
i: Lie face up with a light weight resting on your forehead.
Keep your chin slightly tucked.
Rotate your head slowly to one side.
Return to the middle and rotate to the other side.
Keep the movement small and controlled.

exercises.n: sentadilla con rodillas altas v. 2
exercises.d: A squat followed by a high knee drive, combining leg strength with a bit of cardio.
i: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down with your chest lifted.
Stand up explosively and drive one knee up toward your chest.
Land softly and drop into the next squat.
Alternate knees on each rep.

exercises.n: paso lateral alterno
exercises.d: A low-impact move stepping one leg out at a time, raising your heart rate while working the legs.
i: Stand with feet together and hands in front of your chest.
Step one foot out to the side.
Bring it back and step the other foot out.
Keep your knees slightly bent.
Keep a steady rhythm for 30-60 seconds.

exercises.n: curl de pierna alterno con golpes
exercises.d: A cardio combination of heel-to-glute kicks and punches that works the hamstrings and arms together.
i: Stand tall with your fists in front of your chin.
Curl one heel up toward your glute.
Punch forward as you curl the leg.
Lower the leg and repeat on the other side.
Keep a steady rhythm and stay light on your feet.

exercises.n: paso de tijera
exercises.d: A low-impact version of the jumping jack where you step out instead of jumping.
i: Stand with feet together and arms at your sides.
Step one foot out to the side while raising your arms overhead.
Step it back as you lower your arms.
Repeat on the other side.
Keep a steady pace for 30-60 seconds.

exercises.n: cargada de potencia y envión con mancuernas
exercises.d: An explosive lift pulling dumbbells from the floor to the shoulders and then overhead.
i: Stand over dumbbells with feet hip-width apart.
Hinge down and grip them with a flat back.
Pull explosively, extend your hips and shrug.
Catch the dumbbells at your shoulders, then dip and drive them overhead.
Lower to your shoulders, then the floor with control.

exercises.n: subida al cajón con kettlebell v. 2
exercises.d: A step-up with a kettlebell, held in a different position, to train the quads and glutes unilaterally.
i: Stand facing a bench or box holding a kettlebell.
Place one foot flat on the box.
Press through that heel to stand up.
Lower back down slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: zancada caminando con kettlebell en posición frontal
exercises.d: Walking lunges with kettlebells held in the front rack position. Builds leg strength while the core works to keep you upright.
i: Clean two kettlebells to the front rack, elbows tucked and close to your ribs.
Stand tall with your feet hip width apart.
Step forward and lower until both knees are around 90 degrees.
Push through the front foot and bring the back leg forward into the next step.
Keep your torso upright and the bells steady against your chest.
Continue alternating legs for the planned distance.

exercises.n: sentadilla búlgara asistida
exercises.d: A single-leg squat with the rear foot raised on a bench and a hand lightly holding a support for balance. Trains quads and glutes with less wobble.
i: Stand facing away from a bench and hold a sturdy post or rack with one hand for balance.
Place the top of your rear foot on a bench behind you.
Step your front foot far enough forward to stay balanced.
Lower straight down until your front thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee tracking over your toes.
Drive through the front heel to stand, then switch legs after your set.

exercises.n: sentadilla búlgara asistida con mancuernas
exercises.d: A rear-foot-elevated split squat with a dumbbell in one hand and the other hand on a support. Builds single-leg strength in the quads and glutes.
i: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and rest the other hand on a sturdy support, standing away from a bench.
Place the top of your rear foot on a bench behind you.
Step your front foot far enough forward to stay balanced.
Lower straight down until your front thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee tracking over your toes.
Drive through the front heel to stand, then switch legs after your set.

exercises.n: sentadilla búlgara asistida con kettlebell
exercises.d: A rear-foot-elevated split squat holding a kettlebell, with a free hand on a support. Builds single-leg strength in the quads and glutes.
i: Hold a kettlebell at your chest in one hand and rest the other hand on a sturdy support, standing away from a bench.
Place the top of your rear foot on a bench behind you.
Step your front foot far enough forward to stay balanced.
Lower straight down until your front thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee tracking over your toes.
Drive through the front heel to stand, then switch legs after your set.

exercises.n: face pull sentado con banda elástica
exercises.d: A seated band pull toward the face that targets the rear delts and upper back. Good for shoulder health and posture.
i: Anchor a band at chest height and sit facing it, holding the ends with both hands.
Sit tall with arms extended and the band under light tension.
Pull the band toward your face, flaring your elbows out and high.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
Pause briefly, then return slowly with control.
Keep your ribs down and avoid leaning back.

exercises.n: press bottoms-up a un brazo de media rodilla con kettlebell
exercises.en: kettlebell half kneeling one arm bottoms up press
exercises.d: A one-arm overhead press with the kettlebell held upside down from a half-kneeling stance. Challenges shoulder stability, grip and core.
i: Kneel on one knee with the opposite foot flat in front, back upright.
Hold a kettlebell by the handle with the bell pointing up, at shoulder height.
Squeeze the handle tight and brace your core.
Press straight overhead while keeping the bell balanced.
Lower under control back to the shoulder.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: puente de glúteos elevado con banda elástica
exercises.d: A glute bridge with your feet raised and a band adding resistance. Targets the glutes with a deep range of motion.
i: Lie on your back with your feet on a bench and a band around your thighs just above the knees.
Bend your knees and place your arms by your sides.
Push your knees out against the band and drive through your heels.
Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your glutes at the top for a moment.
Lower your hips slowly and repeat.

exercises.n: empuje de cadera con barra y banda elástica
exercises.d: A barbell hip thrust with a band around the knees to add outward tension. Strongly works the glutes and hip stabilisers.
i: Sit with your upper back against a bench, a padded barbell over your hips and a band above your knees.
Plant your feet hip width apart and push your knees out against the band.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips until your torso is level.
Keep your chin tucked and ribs down.
Squeeze your glutes hard at the top.
Lower with control and repeat.

exercises.n: cargada colgado con mancuernas
exercises.d: Explosive lift taking dumbbells from hip level to the shoulders. Builds power through the hips and back.
i: Stand holding dumbbells at your thighs, then push your hips back to lower them to the knees.
Keep your back flat and arms straight.
Drive your hips forward powerfully and shrug.
Pull the dumbbells up close to your body and rotate your elbows under them.
Catch them on your shoulders in a slight quarter squat.
Stand tall, then lower them back to your thighs and reset.

exercises.n: remo invertido con agarre abierto en suspensión
exercises.d: A bodyweight row hanging under straps with a wide grip. Works the upper back and lats while the core keeps you rigid.
i: Hold the handles of a suspension trainer with a wide overhand grip and lean back, arms straight.
Walk your feet forward to set the difficulty.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Pull your chest toward the handles, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower yourself with control until your arms are straight.

exercises.n: remo invertido con agarre abierto en suspensión en el suelo
exercises.en: suspension wide grip inverted row on floor
exercises.d: A bodyweight row hanging under suspension straps with a wide grip. It builds the upper back and shoulders.
i: Hold the handles with a wide, overhand grip and lie back with your body straight.
Keep your heels on the floor and your core tight.
Pull your chest toward the handles, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight and repeat.

exercises.n: remo inclinado con agarre abierto y banda elástica
exercises.en: band bent over wide grip row
exercises.d: A bent-over row with a band and a wide grip. Targets the upper back and rear shoulders.
i: Stand on the band with feet hip width apart and grab it with a wide overhand grip.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back and soft knees.
Pull your hands toward your lower ribs, elbows flaring out.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your torso still throughout.

exercises.n: remo bajo de pie a un brazo con agarre abierto y banda elástica
exercises.en: band one arm standing wide grip low row
exercises.d: A standing single-arm row from a low anchor, using a band. Trains the lats and mid back one side at a time.
i: Anchor a band low and stand facing it, holding the end in one hand.
Step back until the band is taut, feet hip width apart.
Pull your elbow back and out, leading with the elbow.
Squeeze your shoulder blade toward your spine.
Return slowly to a straight arm.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: remo sentado con agarre abierto y banda elástica
exercises.d: Seated rowing with a band and a wide grip. It works the upper back and rear shoulders.
i: Sit with your legs extended and loop the band around your feet.
Grab the band with a wide grip and sit tall.
Pull your hands toward your chest with elbows flared.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly with control and repeat.

exercises.n: extensión de espalda a 45 grados
exercises.d: A back extension on an angled bench that strengthens the lower back and glutes. Hinging at the hips keeps the movement safe and smooth.
i: Set the pad at hip level and hook your heels under the rollers.
Cross your arms over your chest or hold them behind your head.
Lower your torso with a straight spine until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Raise your torso by squeezing your glutes and lower back.
Stop when your body forms a straight line.
Avoid over-arching at the top.

exercises.n: elevación de glúteos e isquios v. 2
exercises.d: A posterior chain exercise on a glute ham bench. Works the hamstrings and glutes through a long range of motion.
i: Set your feet on the platform with your thighs against the pad and knees just behind it.
Start with your torso hanging down and your body straight.
Curl your body up by bending your knees and squeezing your hamstrings.
Finish with hips extended and torso upright.
Lower slowly with control, keeping your hips locked.
Repeat for reps.

exercises.n: puente lateral con pierna flexionada y mancuerna
exercises.en: dumbbell side bridge with bent leg
exercises.d: A side plank on a bent knee holding a dumbbell. Strengthens the obliques and trunk while teaching stability.
i: Lie on your side with your knees bent and your forearm under your shoulder.
Hold a dumbbell in your top hand, resting on your hip.
Lift your hips so your body forms a line from head to knees.
Hold the position while breathing steadily.
Keep your hips stacked and do not sink.
Lower and switch sides after your set.

exercises.n: puente lateral con piernas rectas
exercises.d: A side plank with both legs straight, held on one forearm. It strengthens the obliques and hips.
i: Lie on your side with your elbow under your shoulder and legs stacked.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Keep your core tight and your neck neutral.
Hold for 20-40 seconds without letting your hips sag.
Lower down and repeat on the other side.

exercises.n: abdominal con presión acostado
exercises.d: A lying core move where you press your arms and legs together to crunch the abs. Targets the front of the trunk.
i: Lie on your back with arms and legs extended.
Brace your abs and press your lower back to the floor.
Lift your shoulders and bring your knees toward your chest.
Reach your hands to your knees and squeeze.
Return slowly without letting your feet touch down.
Repeat for reps.

exercises.n: masaje con balón en el pie
exercises.d: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the foot sole. A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.
i: Place the ball under your foot sole while seated or standing.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your breathing steady and avoid rolling over bone or joints.
Repeat on the other side if needed.

exercises.n: masaje con balón en el peroneo
exercises.d: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the outer lower leg (peroneus muscles). A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.
i: Place the ball under your outer lower leg (peroneus muscles) while sitting on the floor with your leg extended.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your breathing steady and avoid rolling over bone or joints.
Repeat on the other side if needed.

exercises.n: masaje con balón en el tibial anterior
exercises.d: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the shin (tibialis anterior). A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.
i: Place the ball under your shin (tibialis anterior) while kneeling or sitting on the floor.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your breathing steady and avoid rolling over bone or joints.
Repeat on the other side if needed.

exercises.n: masaje con balón en la pantorrilla
exercises.d: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the calf. A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.
i: Place the ball under your calf while seated with your leg extended.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your breathing steady and avoid rolling over bone or joints.
Repeat on the other side if needed.

exercises.n: masaje con balón en el poplíteo
exercises.d: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the back of the knee (popliteal area). A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.
i: Place the ball under your back of the knee (popliteal area) while sitting on the floor with your knee gently bent.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Use very light pressure here and stop if you feel tingling.
Repeat on the other side if needed.

exercises.n: masaje con balón en el tibial posterior
exercises.d: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the inner calf (tibialis posterior). A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.
i: Place the ball under your inner calf (tibialis posterior) while sitting on the floor with your leg rotated outward.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your breathing steady and avoid rolling over bone or joints.
Repeat on the other side if needed.

exercises.n: masaje con balón en el recto femoral
exercises.d: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the front of the thigh (rectus femoris). A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.
i: Place the ball under your front of the thigh (rectus femoris) while lying face down on the floor.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your breathing steady and avoid rolling over bone or joints.
Repeat on the other side if needed.

exercises.n: masaje con balón en el vasto lateral
exercises.d: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the outer thigh (lateral vastus). A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.
i: Place the ball under your outer thigh (lateral vastus) while lying on your side.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your breathing steady and avoid rolling over bone or joints.
Repeat on the other side if needed.

exercises.n: masaje con balón en los aductores
exercises.d: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the inner thigh (adductors). A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.
i: Place the ball under your inner thigh (adductors) while lying face down with your thigh turned out.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your breathing steady and avoid rolling over bone or joints.
Repeat on the other side if needed.

exercises.n: masaje con balón en el tensor de la fascia lata
exercises.d: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the front outer hip (tensor fasciae latae). A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.
i: Place the ball under your front outer hip (tensor fasciae latae) while lying on your side.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your breathing steady and avoid rolling over bone or joints.
Repeat on the other side if needed.

exercises.n: masaje con balón en el glúteo medio
exercises.d: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the side of the glutes (gluteus medius). A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.
i: Place the ball under your side of the glutes (gluteus medius) while lying on your side or leaning on a wall.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your breathing steady and avoid rolling over bone or joints.
Repeat on the other side if needed.

exercises.n: masaje con balón en el piriforme
exercises.d: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the deep glutes (piriformis). A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.
i: Place the ball under your deep glutes (piriformis) while sitting on the floor with your ankle over the opposite knee.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your breathing steady and avoid rolling over bone or joints.
Repeat on the other side if needed.

exercises.n: masaje con balón en el piriforme v. 2
exercises.d: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the deep glutes (piriformis). A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.
i: Place the ball under your deep glutes (piriformis) while lying on your back with your knee falling across your body.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your breathing steady and avoid rolling over bone or joints.
Repeat on the other side if needed.

exercises.n: sentadilla completa con press sobre la cabeza con peso corporal
exercises.en: bodyweight full squat with overhead press
exercises.d: A deep squat followed by a press overhead. Warms up legs and shoulders together.
i: Stand with feet shoulder width apart and hands at your shoulders.
Squat down until your thighs pass parallel.
Drive up through your heels as you stand.
Press both arms overhead as you reach the top.
Lower your hands back to your shoulders.
Repeat in a smooth rhythm.

exercises.n: plancha frontal a perro boca abajo con peso corporal
exercises.en: bodyweight front plank to downward dog
exercises.d: Moves between a plank and downward dog. Builds core strength and opens up the hamstrings and shoulders.
i: Start in a straight-arm plank with hands under shoulders.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Push your hips up and back into an inverted V.
Press your heels toward the floor and lengthen your spine.
Return to plank with control.
Keep moving smoothly for reps.

exercises.n: toque de hombro de rodillas
exercises.d: A kneeling plank with alternating shoulder taps. Trains anti-rotation core control and shoulder stability.
i: Start on hands and knees, then lift your knees slightly into a kneeling plank.
Keep a straight line from head to knees.
Lift one hand and tap the opposite shoulder.
Place it back down without rocking your hips.
Alternate sides at a steady pace.
Keep your abs tight throughout.

exercises.n: estiramiento de barbilla al pecho
exercises.d: A gentle neck stretch that lengthens the muscles at the back of the neck. Useful after long periods of sitting.
i: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly lower your chin toward your chest.
Place your hands lightly on the back of your head if you want a deeper stretch.
Keep your shoulders down away from your ears.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return slowly to neutral.

exercises.n: estiramiento de gemelos
exercises.d: A standing wall stretch for the calf muscles. Helps with ankle mobility and tight lower legs.
i: Stand facing a wall with your hands on it.
Step one foot back with the heel on the floor.
Bend your front knee and lean forward.
Feel the stretch in the back calf.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs and repeat.

exercises.n: postura del puente setu bandhasana
exercises.d: A yoga backbend that strengthens the glutes and opens the chest and hip flexors.
i: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet hip width apart.
Place your arms alongside your body, palms down.
Press through your feet and lift your hips.
Roll your shoulders under and lengthen your chest.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Lower down slowly.

exercises.n: estiramiento de aductores
exercises.d: A seated stretch for the inner thighs. Improves hip flexibility.
i: Sit on the floor with the soles of your feet together.
Hold your ankles and sit tall.
Let your knees fall out to the sides.
Gently press your elbows on your thighs.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release slowly.

exercises.n: estiramiento de pectoral posterior v. 2
exercises.d: A back-clasped chest opener that lengthens the pecs and the front of the shoulders.
i: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Clasp your hands together behind your back.
Straighten your arms and lift them gently away from your body.
Open your chest and pull your shoulder blades together.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.
Release and repeat.

exercises.n: estiramiento de hombros de calentamiento con banda elástica
exercises.d: A light band drill that warms up the shoulder joint and loosens the surrounding muscles before training.
i: Hold a light band with both hands in front of your thighs, hands wide.
Keep your arms straight and your core braced.
Lift the band overhead and continue back behind your head as far as is comfortable.
Return along the same path to the start.
Keep the movement slow and controlled.
Repeat for 10-15 reps, widening your grip if it feels tight.

exercises.n: thruster a un brazo con kettlebell
exercises.d: A front squat into an overhead press with one kettlebell. It combines legs and shoulders in one flowing move.
i: Hold a kettlebell at your shoulder with one hand in the rack position.
Squat down with your chest up and elbow close.
Drive up through your legs.
Use that momentum to press the kettlebell overhead.
Lower it back to your shoulder, repeat, then switch arms.

exercises.n: flexión con kettlebell
exercises.d: A push-up with your hands on kettlebell handles for a deeper range of motion. It builds the chest and arms.
i: Place two kettlebells on the floor shoulder-width apart and grip the handles.
Extend your legs into a plank position.
Lower your chest between the handles with elbows at about 45 degrees.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Press back up until your arms are straight and repeat.

exercises.n: peso muerto a una pierna con kettlebell
exercises.d: A balance-focused hip hinge on one leg with a kettlebell. It trains the hamstrings and glutes.
i: Hold a kettlebell in one hand and stand on the opposite leg.
Hinge forward at the hips while extending the free leg back.
Lower the kettlebell toward the floor with a flat back.
Keep your hips level and your standing knee slightly bent.
Drive your hips forward to stand, then switch legs.

exercises.n: paso lateral en sentadilla con kettlebell
exercises.d: Stepping sideways into a squat while holding a kettlebell at your chest. It works the thighs and hips.
i: Hold a kettlebell at your chest with both hands.
Step out to the side and sit back into a squat.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.
Push through your heels and bring your feet together.
Alternate directions or complete all steps on one side before switching.

exercises.n: balanceo a un brazo con kettlebell
exercises.d: A hip-driven swing with one hand on a kettlebell. It builds explosive posterior chain power.
i: Stand with feet slightly wider than your shoulders and the kettlebell in front of you.
Hinge back and swing the bell between your legs.
Snap your hips forward to swing it to chest height.
Let the arm stay relaxed; the hips do the work.
Let the bell fall back and hinge again. Switch hands after your set.

exercises.n: caminata del granjero con kettlebell
exercises.d: Walking while carrying a heavy kettlebell in each hand. It builds grip, posture and core stability.
i: Pick up a kettlebell in each hand and stand tall.
Pull your shoulders back and brace your core.
Walk forward in controlled steps.
Keep the kettlebells from swinging.
Walk for a set distance or time, then set them down carefully.

exercises.n: cargada a un brazo con kettlebell
exercises.d: Pulling a kettlebell from the floor to the shoulder with one arm. It trains explosive hip power and coordination.
i: Stand over a kettlebell and hinge to grip it with one hand.
Swing it back slightly between your legs.
Drive your hips forward and pull the bell up close to your body.
Rotate your hand around so it lands softly in the rack position.
Lower it back down under control, repeat, then switch arms.

exercises.n: cargada y press a un brazo con kettlebell
exercises.en: kettlebell single arm clean and press
exercises.d: A clean followed by an overhead press with one kettlebell. It links hip power with shoulder strength.
i: Hinge and swing the kettlebell back, then clean it to your shoulder.
Settle into a stable rack position with your core tight.
Bend your knees slightly, then press the bell straight overhead.
Lock out your elbow with your biceps near your ear.
Lower it to your shoulder, then to the floor. Switch arms after your set.

exercises.n: arrancada con kettlebell
exercises.d: Swinging a kettlebell from between your legs to overhead in one motion. It builds power through the whole body.
i: Stand over the kettlebell and hinge to grip it with one hand.
Swing it back between your legs.
Drive your hips forward and pull the bell up close to your body.
Punch your hand through to catch it overhead with a straight arm.
Lower it back under control and repeat, then switch arms.

exercises.n: zancada hacia delante y press con kettlebell
exercises.d: A forward lunge combined with an overhead press of a kettlebell. It trains legs and shoulders together.
i: Hold a kettlebell at your shoulder in the rack position.
Step forward into a lunge.
As you push back up, press the kettlebell overhead.
Lower the bell to your shoulder as you step back.
Alternate legs or finish one side before switching.

exercises.n: slingshots de pie con kettlebell
exercises.d: Passing a kettlebell around your body in circles while standing. It works the shoulders, core and grip.
i: Stand tall holding a kettlebell by the handle with both hands.
Pass it behind your back from one hand to the other.
Bring it around to the front and pass it again.
Keep your hips steady and your core tight.
Reverse direction halfway through your set.

exercises.n: abdominal a un brazo con kettlebell
exercises.d: A sit-up while holding a kettlebell overhead with one arm. It adds shoulder stability to an abdominal move.
i: Lie on your back with knees bent and a kettlebell held straight up in one hand.
Keep your eyes on the kettlebell and your arm locked.
Curl up and sit all the way to standing or upright.
Control your descent back to the floor.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: remo para deltoide posterior con kettlebell
exercises.d: A bent-over row with elbows flared to hit the rear shoulders. It builds upper back and posture muscles.
i: Hinge forward with a flat back holding a kettlebell in each hand.
Let the weights hang below your chest.
Pull your elbows out wide and up toward the ceiling.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.n: pullover con brazos flexionados y rodillas flexionadas con kettlebell
exercises.en: kettlebell bent arm pullover with knees bent
exercises.d: A floor pullover with a kettlebell and bent knees. It stretches and works the lats and chest.
i: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Hold a kettlebell by the horns above your chest with elbows slightly bent.
Lower it back over your head, feeling a stretch in your lats.
Keep your lower back close to the floor.
Pull it back over your chest and repeat.

exercises.n: press diamante
exercises.d: A narrow push-up variation with the hands close together, putting extra load on the triceps and inner chest.
i: Start in a plank position with your hands under your chest, thumbs and index fingers forming a diamond.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your chest toward your hands, elbows tracking back close to your ribs.
Pause briefly just above your hands.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight so your hips do not sag.

exercises.n: thruster a un brazo con mancuerna
exercises.d: A squat into an overhead press with a single dumbbell, training the legs and shoulders together.
i: Hold a dumbbell at your shoulder with one hand and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down with your chest tall and knees tracking over your toes.
Drive up through your heels.
Use that momentum to press the dumbbell overhead until your arm is straight.
Lower it back to your shoulder as you sink into the next squat.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: thruster a un brazo con kettlebell
exercises.d: A kettlebell squat-to-press combo done with one arm that works the legs, shoulders and core in one flow.
i: Hold a kettlebell in the rack position at one shoulder, feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down with your torso upright and elbow close to your body.
Stand up powerfully through your heels.
Press the kettlebell overhead as you rise, finishing with a straight arm.
Lower it back to the rack and go into the next squat.
Switch arms after your set.

exercises.n: cargada y envión con kettlebell
exercises.d: A kettlebell version of the classic lift: swing it to the shoulder, then drive it overhead with a leg push.
i: Stand over a kettlebell with feet shoulder-width apart and hinge to grab it.
Swing it back between your legs, then drive your hips forward.
Pull the bell up and guide it into the rack position at your shoulder.
Dip slightly with your knees, then explode up.
Punch the kettlebell overhead and lock out your arm.
Lower it back to the rack, then to the floor with control. Switch sides.

exercises.n: cargada a un brazo con kettlebell
exercises.d: A powerful hip-driven pull that brings a kettlebell from the floor to the rack position on one shoulder.
i: Stand over a kettlebell with feet shoulder-width apart and hinge at the hips to grab the handle.
Hike it back between your legs.
Snap your hips forward and pull the bell close to your body.
Rotate your hand around the bell so it lands softly in the rack at your shoulder.
Stand tall with your elbow tucked in.
Lower the bell back down with control and switch arms.

exercises.n: press de banca inclinado con banda elástica
exercises.d: An incline press using a band for resistance, targeting the upper chest and front shoulders.
i: Set an incline bench and anchor a band behind it or under the bench.
Sit back with the band handles at chest level.
Brace your core and keep your shoulder blades pulled together.
Press the handles up and slightly forward until your arms are straight.
Lower slowly back to the start, feeling the band pull.
Keep your wrists straight throughout.

exercises.n: patada atrás inclinado a un brazo en polea
exercises.en: cable bent over single arm kickback
exercises.d: A one-arm cable kickback that isolates the triceps with constant tension.
i: Set a low pulley with a single handle and hinge forward at the hips.
Hold the handle with your elbow bent at your side, upper arm parallel to the floor.
Keep your upper arm still and straighten your elbow back.
Squeeze your triceps at full extension.
Return slowly to the start.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: curl arrastrado en smith
exercises.d: A biceps curl where the bar is dragged up along the body, keeping the load on the biceps and reducing shoulder swing.
i: Stand close to the smith bar with an underhand shoulder-width grip.
Let the bar hang at arm length against your thighs.
Pull your elbows back and drag the bar up along your torso.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower the bar along the same line with control.
Keep your torso still and avoid leaning back.

exercises.n: sentadilla good morning
exercises.d: A combo of a hip hinge and a squat that warms up and strengthens the glutes, hamstrings and lower back.
i: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hands behind your head.
Push your hips back and hinge forward with a flat back.
Come back up to standing.
Bend your knees and sink into a squat with your chest tall.
Stand up and repeat the hinge, then the squat.
Keep your core braced and your weight over your mid-foot.

exercises.n: burpee con sentadilla
exercises.d: A burpee with a squat finish that raises your heart rate and works the whole body.
i: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Drop into a squat and place your hands on the floor.
Jump or step your feet back into a plank.
Lower your chest down, then press back up.
Jump your feet forward to your hands.
Stand and finish with a bodyweight squat before the next rep.

exercises.n: zancada diagonal
exercises.d: A lunge stepped out at an angle that trains the legs and hips in a different plane, with a quick, springy pace.
i: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot out diagonally, about 45 degrees away from you.
Bend both knees and lower into a lunge, keeping your chest up.
Push off the front foot to return to the start.
Alternate legs each rep.
Keep your front knee pointing the same way as your toes.

exercises.n: puente torácico
exercises.d: A bridge-like drill that opens the upper back and shoulders while rotating the spine.
i: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and one hand behind you.
Lift your hips toward the ceiling.
Reach your free arm up and over, rotating your chest toward the ceiling.
