exercises.n: sentadilla con pausa
exercises.d: Squat with a hold in the bottom position. It builds strength out of the hole and control.
i: Set the bar on your upper back and stand shoulder width apart.
Brace your core and squat down to depth.
Pause in the bottom for about two seconds, staying tight.
Drive up through your whole foot.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.

exercises.n: elevación de piernas sentado en el suelo con peso
exercises.en: weighted seated leg raise on floor
exercises.d: Seated leg raise with added weight. It challenges the lower abs and hip flexors.
i: Sit on the floor with your hands behind you and weight secured to your legs or between your feet.
Lean back slightly and brace your core.
Raise your legs up while keeping them as straight as you can.
Lower them slowly without touching the floor.
Keep your back from rounding too far.

exercises.n: deslizamiento de serrato en la pared con banda elástica
exercises.d: Wall slide with a band around the forearms to engage the serratus. It improves shoulder blade control.
i: Stand facing a wall with a band around your forearms just below the elbows.
Place your forearms on the wall and push slightly outward against the band.
Slide your arms up the wall, reaching overhead.
Keep your ribs down and shoulder blades moving freely.
Slide back down slowly.

exercises.n: deslizamiento de serrato en la pared
exercises.d: Sliding the forearms up a wall to wake up the serratus anterior. It helps with shoulder blade movement.
i: Stand facing a wall with your forearms resting on it.
Keep your elbows at shoulder width.
Press into the wall and slide your arms up as high as you can.
Keep your ribs down and neck relaxed.
Slide back down slowly and repeat.

exercises.n: deslizamiento de serrato en la pared con banda elástica y rodillo
exercises.en: resistance band serratus wall slide with foam roll
exercises.d: Wall slide with a band and a foam roller between your forearms and the wall. It adds stability and serratus activation.
i: Put a band around your forearms and place a foam roller on the wall under them.
Press your forearms into the roller and push slightly out against the band.
Roll the roller up the wall as you reach overhead.
Keep your ribs down and shoulders away from your ears.
Roll back down slowly.

exercises.n: deslizamiento de serrato en la pared con rodillo
exercises.d: Wall slide with a foam roller under your forearms. It teaches smooth shoulder blade movement and serratus control.
i: Stand facing a wall with a foam roller under your forearms against the wall.
Press your forearms firmly into the roller.
Roll the roller up the wall as you reach overhead.
Keep your core braced and neck relaxed.
Roll back down under control.

exercises.n: sentadilla dividida goblet con mancuerna v. 2
exercises.d: Split squat holding one dumbbell at your chest. It builds the legs and glutes one side at a time.
i: Hold a dumbbell vertically at your chest and step into a long split stance.
Keep your torso upright.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Drive through your front heel to stand back up.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: rotación de espalda de rodillas
exercises.d: Rotating the upper back from a kneeling position. It improves spinal rotation and loosens the mid back.
i: Kneel on all fours with one hand behind your head.
Keep your hips still and your core lightly braced.
Rotate your elbow down toward the other arm, then open toward the ceiling.
Follow the elbow with your eyes.
Do your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: flexión con salto de tijera
exercises.d: A push up combined with a jumping jack leg motion. It raises your heart rate while training chest and shoulders.
i: Start in a high plank with your feet together.
Lower into a push up with control.
Push back up and jump your feet wide.
Jump your feet back together.
Keep your body straight and move rhythmically.

exercises.n: elevación de piernas acostado con balón medicinal
exercises.d: Leg raise gripping a medicine ball between your feet. The extra load makes the lower abs work harder.
i: Lie on your back with a medicine ball squeezed between your feet.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Raise your legs until they are vertical.
Lower them slowly without letting your back arch.
Keep your grip on the ball firm.

exercises.n: abdominal oblicuo con elevación de piernas
exercises.d: Raise your legs and crunch to the side. It targets the lower abs and the obliques together.
i: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head.
Lift your legs together toward the ceiling.
Crunch your shoulders up and toward one side as the legs tilt the other way.
Lower and repeat to the other side.
Keep movements slow and controlled.

exercises.n: extensión de tríceps a un brazo en polea (con cuerda)
exercises.en: cable single arm triceps pushdown (rope attachment)
exercises.d: One-arm pushdown with a rope on a high cable. The rope lets you spread the ends at the bottom for a strong triceps squeeze.
i: Attach a rope to a high pulley and grip it with one hand.
Keep your elbow tucked at your side.
Press the rope down until your arm is straight, turning the end out slightly.
Squeeze your triceps.
Return slowly, then switch arms.

exercises.n: remo inclinado a un brazo en landmine v. 2
exercises.en: landmine one arm bent over row v. 2
exercises.d: One-arm row with the end of a landmine barbell. It builds the lats and upper back.
i: Stand over the end of a landmine bar and hinge your hips back with a flat back.
Grab the bar end or attachment with one hand.
Pull the bar up toward your hip, leading with your elbow.
Squeeze your back at the top.
Lower slowly, then switch sides.

exercises.n: hiperextensión con peso
exercises.d: Back extension holding a weight at your chest. It trains the lower back, glutes and hamstrings.
i: Set the pad at hip level on a hyperextension bench with your feet secured.
Hold a weight plate or dumbbell against your chest.
Lower your torso with a straight back.
Raise it until your body forms a straight line.
Do not overarch at the top.

exercises.n: curl femoral con balón de estabilidad
exercises.d: Hamstring curl with your heels on a stability ball. It also challenges balance and the core.
i: Lie on your back with your heels on a stability ball.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Curl the ball toward your glutes by bending your knees.
Extend your legs again slowly.
Keep your hips high the whole time.

exercises.n: doble salto de cuerda
exercises.d: Jumping rope with two passes of the rope per jump. It is great conditioning that builds coordination.
i: Hold a jump rope with the handles at your hips.
Jump slightly higher than normal.
Spin the rope fast with your wrists so it passes twice under your feet.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Rest between short rounds as needed.

exercises.n: burpee silencioso
exercises.d: A low-impact burpee without the jump. It raises your heart rate while staying quiet and gentle on the joints.
i: Stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Squat down and place your hands on the floor.
Step your feet back into a plank.
Step your feet forward to your hands.
Stand up tall.
Keep a steady pace for 30-60 seconds.

exercises.n: A boca abajo acostado
exercises.d: Lying face down, arms form an A shape and lift. It strengthens the upper back and shoulder blade muscles.
i: Lie face down with your arms out at about 45 degrees, palms down.
Rest your forehead lightly or look at the floor.
Lift your arms and chest slightly while squeezing your shoulder blades.
Hold for a second.
Lower with control and repeat.

exercises.n: T boca abajo acostado
exercises.d: Lying face down, arms out to the sides in a T and lifted. It trains the muscles between the shoulder blades.
i: Lie face down with arms straight out to the sides, thumbs up.
Keep your neck neutral.
Lift your arms off the floor by squeezing your shoulder blades.
Hold briefly.
Lower slowly.

exercises.n: W boca abajo acostado
exercises.d: Lying face down, you pull the arms into a W shape. It builds the rear shoulders and mid back.
i: Lie face down with elbows bent and hands by your head.
Keep your neck neutral.
Lift your elbows and hands off the floor, pulling the shoulder blades together.
Hold for a second.
Lower with control.

exercises.n: de W a T boca abajo acostado
exercises.d: Lying face down, you move from a W to a T shape. It trains the back of the shoulders and upper back.
i: Lie face down in a W with elbows bent.
Lift your arms slightly off the floor.
Straighten your arms out to the sides into a T.
Pull back to the W while keeping your shoulder blades squeezed.
Repeat smoothly.

exercises.n: de W a Y boca abajo acostado
exercises.d: Lying face down, you move from a W to a Y shape. It works the upper back and lower traps.
i: Lie face down in a W with elbows bent.
Lift your arms slightly off the floor.
Reach your arms forward and wide into a Y.
Pull back into the W with your shoulder blades squeezed.
Keep your neck relaxed and repeat.

exercises.n: plancha inversa sobre codos
exercises.d: A hold with your back to the floor, supported on your elbows. It strengthens the entire back of the body.
i: Sit with legs extended and elbows under your shoulders.
Press into your elbows and lift your hips.
Form a straight line from head to heels.
Squeeze your glutes and breathe steadily.
Hold for 20-40 seconds.

exercises.n: toque de punta en V sentado
exercises.d: Hold a V sit and reach to tap your toes. It strengthens the abs and challenges balance.
i: Sit on the floor and lean back, lifting your legs into a V.
Reach both arms forward.
Crunch up and tap your toes with your fingers.
Lower slightly back while keeping your feet up.
Keep your chest open and repeat.

exercises.n: puente lateral con pierna flexionada
exercises.d: Side plank with the knees bent for a gentler version. It builds the obliques and hip stability.
i: Lie on your side with knees bent and your forearm under your shoulder.
Lift your hips so your body forms a line from shoulder to knee.
Keep your hips stacked and core tight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower and switch sides.

exercises.n: superman de W a Y
exercises.d: Lying face down, lift your body and move your arms from a W to a Y. It trains the whole back side.
i: Lie face down, arms in a W with elbows bent.
Lift your chest and legs slightly off the floor.
Reach your arms forward into a Y.
Return to the W while keeping the lift.
Lower fully after your reps.

exercises.n: superman W
exercises.d: Face down, lift your chest and legs with arms in a W. It builds the lower back and upper back.
i: Lie face down with elbows bent and hands by your head.
Squeeze your glutes.
Lift your chest, arms and legs slightly off the floor.
Pull your shoulder blades together and hold for a second.
Lower slowly.

exercises.n: toque alterno de punta acostado en el suelo
exercises.d: Lying on your back with legs raised, you reach up to touch your toes alternately. It works the abs and obliques.
i: Lie on your back with both legs raised toward the ceiling.
Extend your arms up.
Crunch up and reach one hand toward the opposite foot.
Lower and reach with the other hand.
Keep your legs steady.

exercises.n: giro en banco de glúteos e isquios
exercises.d: Hips lifted into a bridge, you twist from side to side. It trains the trunk rotators and glutes.
i: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat and arms out wide.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Rotate your knees and hips to one side.
Return to center and rotate to the other side.
Stay controlled and keep your shoulders on the floor.

exercises.n: elevación de gemelos a una pierna en el borde de un escalón
exercises.en: single leg calf raise off step
exercises.d: One-legged calf raise from the edge of a step. It builds calf strength with a deep stretch.
i: Stand on one foot on the edge of a step, holding a rail for balance.
Let your heel lower below the step.
Rise as high as possible on your toes.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly, then switch legs.

exercises.n: postura del cangrejo
exercises.d: Seated backbend with hips lifted, like an upside down table. It opens the chest, shoulders and front of the hips.
i: Sit with knees bent and hands behind you, fingers pointing toward your feet.
Press into your hands and feet.
Lift your hips until your torso is flat.
Let your head relax back gently.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.

exercises.n: estiramiento colgado
exercises.d: Hanging from a bar to stretch the lats and shoulders. It also decompresses the spine.
i: Grab a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, hands shoulder width apart.
Hang with your arms straight and feet off the floor.
Relax your shoulders and let your body lengthen.
Breathe steadily.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.

exercises.n: círculos de cadera hacia adelante de rodillas
exercises.d: Circle your hips in a kneeling position. It warms up the hip joints and glutes.
i: Kneel with your hands on your hips.
Push your hips forward slightly.
Draw large circles with your hips, leading forward and around.
Do several circles in one direction.
Switch direction and repeat.

exercises.n: estiramiento de cuello de rodillas
exercises.d: Kneeling side neck stretch. It releases tension in the sides and back of the neck.
i: Kneel tall with your back straight.
Tilt your head to one side, ear toward shoulder.
Place a hand lightly on your head for a gentle pull.
Keep the opposite shoulder low.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.n: presión de talón
exercises.d: Pressing the heel down toward the floor to lengthen the calf. It helps ankle flexibility.
i: Stand with the ball of one foot on a low step or wall, heel on the floor.
Hold something for balance.
Press your heel gently down and back.
Keep your knee straight for the calf.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

exercises.n: extensión cervical boca abajo
exercises.d: Lying face down, you gently lift your head. It trains the muscles at the back of the neck.
i: Lie face down with your forehead on the floor or a towel.
Keep your arms by your sides.
Slowly lift your head a few inches, keeping your chin tucked.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.n: sostén isométrico de extensión cervical boca abajo
exercises.d: Hold your head lifted while lying face down. It builds endurance in the neck extensors.
i: Lie face down with your arms by your sides.
Tuck your chin slightly.
Lift your head a few inches off the floor.
Hold steady while breathing normally.
Hold for 10-20 seconds, then lower slowly.

exercises.n: retracción de mentón acostado
exercises.d: A small nodding motion lying on your back. It trains the deep neck muscles and improves head posture.
i: Lie on your back with your head resting on the floor and knees bent.
Gently draw your chin toward your throat.
Press the back of your head lightly into the floor.
Hold for 3-5 seconds.
Release and repeat.

exercises.n: retracción de mentón sentado
exercises.d: Gently glide your chin straight back while seated to wake up the deep neck flexors and ease a forward head posture.
i: Sit tall on a chair with your shoulders relaxed and eyes forward.
Keep your chin level, not tilted up or down.
Slide your head straight back as if making a double chin.
Hold for 2-3 seconds without tensing your jaw.
Return slowly to the start and repeat for 10-12 reps.

exercises.n: sostén de rodillas a de pie con mancuernas, agarre de cargada
exercises.en: dumbbell kneeling hold to stand clean grip
exercises.d: Hold dumbbells at your shoulders from a half-kneeling position and rise to standing. It builds single-leg strength, hip drive and balance.
i: Kneel on one knee with the other foot flat in front and hold dumbbells at your shoulders.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Drive through the front foot to stand tall.
Lower back down under control to half kneeling.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: rotación interna de hombro a 90 de abducción con mancuerna
exercises.en: dumbbell shoulder internal rotation at 90 abduction
exercises.d: Rotate a light dumbbell forward with your upper arm held out at shoulder height. It strengthens the internal rotators of the shoulder.
i: Lie on your side or stand with your upper arm out at 90 degrees and elbow bent 90 degrees.
Hold a light dumbbell with the forearm pointing up.
Rotate your forearm forward and down without moving the upper arm.
Pause briefly at the bottom.
Return slowly to the start, then switch arms after your reps.

exercises.n: sentadilla a press sobre la cabeza con mancuernas
exercises.d: Squat with dumbbells at your shoulders, then press them overhead as you stand. A full-body move that links leg drive into a press.
i: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, dumbbells at your shoulders.
Sit your hips back and down into a squat with your chest up.
Drive up through your feet to stand.
Use that momentum to press the dumbbells overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower them to your shoulders and go into the next squat.

exercises.n: press inclinado apretando mancuernas
exercises.d: Press two dumbbells held together up from an incline bench. The constant squeeze keeps the chest working through the whole rep.
i: Set a bench to a low incline and lie back with dumbbells pressed together over your chest.
Keep squeezing them against each other the whole set.
Lower them slowly to your upper chest.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your shoulder blades pinched back and feet planted.

exercises.n: press svend inclinado con peso
exercises.d: Squeeze a weight plate between your palms and push it forward while on an incline. It hits the inner chest with a constant squeeze.
i: Set a bench to an incline and sit back with a weight plate held between your palms at chest height.
Squeeze the plate hard with both hands.
Push it straight out until your arms are extended.
Pull it back to your chest while still squeezing.
Keep your back against the pad and shoulders down.

exercises.n: zancada con giro y kettlebell
exercises.d: Lunge forward while holding a kettlebell at your chest and rotate over the front leg. Trains legs and trunk rotation together.
i: Stand holding a kettlebell at chest height with both hands.
Step forward into a lunge, front knee over your ankle.
Rotate your torso toward the front leg, keeping hips square.
Turn back to center and push off the front foot to return.
Alternate legs for each rep.

exercises.n: zancada hacia atrás con kettlebell
exercises.d: Step back into a lunge while holding a kettlebell. Stepping backward is kind on the knees and loads the glutes and quads.
i: Stand tall holding a kettlebell at your chest or by your side.
Step one foot back and lower until both knees are about 90 degrees.
Keep your torso upright and front heel down.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: zancada sobre la cabeza a un brazo con kettlebell
exercises.d: Lunge while holding one kettlebell locked out overhead. The overhead load challenges balance, shoulder stability and the legs.
i: Press a kettlebell overhead with one arm and keep that arm straight.
Step forward into a lunge and lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your ribs down and the weight stacked over your shoulder.
Push back to standing.
Finish your reps, then switch the kettlebell to the other arm.

exercises.n: abdominal con press y kettlebell
exercises.d: Sit up from the floor with a kettlebell and press it overhead at the top. A core and shoulder combo move.
i: Lie on your back with your knees bent, holding a kettlebell at your chest.
Curl and sit up using your abs.
Press the kettlebell overhead as you reach the top.
Lower it back to your chest.
Roll back down slowly and repeat.

exercises.n: sentadilla sumo con kettlebell v. 2
exercises.d: Squat with a wide stance and a kettlebell hanging between your legs. It works the glutes, inner thighs and quads.
i: Stand with feet wide and toes turned out, holding a kettlebell with both hands in front of you.
Keep your chest tall and back flat.
Sit down between your legs until your thighs are about parallel.
Push your knees out over your toes.
Drive through your heels to stand and squeeze your glutes.

exercises.n: press en landmine
exercises.d: Press the end of an angled barbell up and forward. The arc is friendly to the shoulder and trains pressing and trunk stability.
i: Anchor one end of a barbell and hold the other end at your shoulder with both hands.
Stand with feet staggered and core braced.
Press the bar up and forward until your arms are straight.
Lower it back to your shoulder under control.
Keep your ribs down and avoid leaning back.

exercises.n: muscle clean con barra
exercises.d: Pull a barbell from the floor to your shoulders using only arm and hip drive, with no re-bending of the knees. A good clean-technique builder.
i: Set up over the bar with hands just outside your knees and your back flat.
Pull the bar off the floor, extending your hips and knees.
Shrug and pull the elbows high, keeping the bar close.
Rotate your elbows under and catch the bar on your shoulders without dropping into a squat.
Lower the bar back down under control.

exercises.n: zancada sobre la cabeza con mancuernas
exercises.d: Hold two dumbbells overhead and lunge. The load above you trains balance, core and shoulder stability along with leg strength.
i: Press two dumbbells overhead with straight arms.
Step forward into a lunge, lowering your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your core tight and the dumbbells over your shoulders.
Push off the front foot to come back.
Alternate legs each rep.

exercises.n: press svend con peso corporal
exercises.d: Press your palms together hard in front of your chest and push them forward and back. It needs no equipment and fires the inner chest.
i: Stand or sit tall with your palms together at chest height.
Squeeze your palms hard against each other.
Push your hands straight out in front of you.
Bring them back to your chest while still squeezing.
Keep your shoulders down and repeat.

exercises.n: apertura de pecho sentado tipo almeja
exercises.d: Sit tall and open your elbows wide like a clam to stretch the front of the chest and shoulders.
i: Sit tall with your fingers lightly behind your head.
Start with your elbows pointing forward.
Slowly open your elbows out and back as far as is comfortable.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.

exercises.n: apertura de pecho acostado en el suelo
exercises.d: Lie on the floor and sweep dumbbells out and together in an arc. The floor limits the range, which is gentle on the shoulders.
i: Lie on your back holding dumbbells above your chest, palms facing in.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Open your arms out until your upper arms touch the floor.
Squeeze your chest to bring the weights back together.
Keep your wrists straight and the motion slow.

exercises.n: rotación de palmas arriba y abajo
exercises.d: Hold your arms out and rotate your palms up and down. A simple warm-up for the shoulders and forearms.
i: Stand tall and raise your arms out to your sides at shoulder height.
Turn your palms up so your thumbs point back.
Rotate them down so your thumbs point forward.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your arms level.
Repeat smoothly for 10-15 rotations.

exercises.n: mirada al cielo sentado
exercises.d: Sit upright and slowly tip your head back to look up. It stretches the front of the neck.
i: Sit tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly tip your head back to look up at the ceiling.
Keep your mouth closed and move only as far as feels comfortable.
Hold for 15-20 seconds.
Return your head to neutral slowly.

exercises.n: rotación externa de hombro a 90 grados en polea
exercises.d: Rotate your forearm up and back against a cable with your upper arm at shoulder height. It strengthens the rotator cuff external rotators.
i: Set a cable at shoulder height and stand sideways to it.
Hold the handle with your upper arm out at 90 degrees and elbow bent 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm up and back without moving your upper arm.
Pause, then return slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: rotación interna de hombro en polea
exercises.d: Pull a cable handle across your body with your elbow tucked at your side. It trains the internal rotators of the shoulder.
i: Set a cable at elbow height and stand sideways to it.
Hold the handle with your elbow tucked against your side at 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm across your stomach.
Return slowly, keeping your elbow pinned.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: rotación interna de hombro a 90 grados en polea
exercises.d: Rotate your forearm down and forward against a cable with your upper arm held at shoulder height. It builds shoulder internal rotation strength.
i: Set a cable at shoulder height and face away from it.
Hold the handle with your upper arm out at 90 degrees and elbow bent 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm forward and down, keeping your upper arm still.
Pause, then return slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: remo de pie en polea
exercises.d: Pull a cable handle toward your torso from a standing position. It trains the mid-back and teaches a strong, upright posture.
i: Set a cable at chest height and hold the handle, stepping back until there is tension.
Stand tall with your core braced.
Pull the handle toward your ribs, driving your elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.n: press de banca con agarre inverso y barra
exercises.d: Bench press with an underhand grip. It shifts more load to the upper chest and also works the triceps.
i: Lie on a bench and grip the bar with palms facing you, about shoulder-width.
Unrack the bar over your chest.
Lower it to your lower chest with elbows tucked.
Press it back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your feet down and shoulder blades pinched.

exercises.n: elevación frontal a un brazo con agarre supino y mancuerna
exercises.en: dumbbell single arm underhand front raise
exercises.d: Lift one dumbbell to the front with your palm facing up. This variation trains the front delt and upper chest.
i: Stand tall with a dumbbell in one hand, palm facing forward.
Keep your core braced.
Raise the dumbbell in front of you to shoulder height.
Lower it slowly to your thigh.
Complete your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: press en el suelo a un brazo con mancuerna
exercises.d: Press one dumbbell up from the floor. Lying on the floor limits the range of motion and challenges your core to stay still.
i: Lie on your back with your knees bent, holding a dumbbell at chest level.
Rest your other arm on the floor.
Press the dumbbell straight up until your arm is straight.
Lower it until your upper arm touches the floor.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: press a un brazo en landmine
exercises.d: Press the end of a landmine barbell with one arm. The angled path is shoulder friendly and challenges your trunk.
i: Anchor a barbell and hold the free end at your shoulder with one hand.
Stand with feet staggered and core tight.
Press the bar up and forward until your arm is straight.
Lower it back to your shoulder.
Complete your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: zancada sobre la cabeza a un brazo con mancuerna
exercises.d: Lunge while holding one dumbbell overhead. The one-sided load challenges balance and trunk stability.
i: Press a dumbbell overhead with one arm and lock it out.
Step forward into a lunge.
Lower your back knee toward the floor, keeping your torso upright.
Push through the front foot to return.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: sentadilla con mancuerna sobre la cabeza a un brazo
exercises.d: Squat while holding a dumbbell overhead with one arm. It builds leg strength and demands good shoulder and trunk control.
i: Press a dumbbell overhead with one arm and keep it locked out.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit your hips back and down into a squat.
Keep your ribs down and the weight over your shoulder.
Drive up to standing, then switch arms after your reps.

exercises.n: press de banca declinado alterno a un brazo con mancuerna
exercises.en: dumbbell single arm alternate decline bench press
exercises.d: Press dumbbells on a decline bench one arm at a time. It hits the lower chest and keeps your core working to stay balanced.
i: Lie on a decline bench holding a dumbbell in each hand over your chest.
Lower one dumbbell to the side of your chest.
Press it back up until your arm is straight.
Repeat with the other arm.
Keep your core tight and the bench-side arm steady.

exercises.n: apertura alterna a un brazo con mancuerna
exercises.d: Perform chest flys with one dumbbell at a time. The alternating pattern challenges stability while working the chest.
i: Lie on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand above your chest.
Keep a soft bend in your elbows.
Lower one arm out to the side in a wide arc.
Squeeze your chest to bring it back up.
Alternate with the other arm.

exercises.n: paseo del granjero unilateral con kettlebell
exercises.d: Walk while carrying a kettlebell in one hand. It builds grip and demands a strong trunk to stay upright.
i: Pick up a kettlebell in one hand and stand tall.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders level.
Walk with steady steps without leaning to the loaded side.
Walk for a set distance or time.
Switch hands and repeat.

exercises.n: cargada de potencia con una mancuerna
exercises.d: Explosively pull one dumbbell from the floor to your shoulder. It builds power through the hips and legs.
i: Stand over a dumbbell with feet hip-width apart.
Hinge down and grip it with a flat back.
Explode up through your hips and shrug.
Pull the dumbbell up and catch it at your shoulder.
Lower it back down under control, then switch arms.

exercises.n: salto de tijera cruzado con salto
exercises.d: A jumping jack where your arms and legs cross over each other at the center. It raises your heart rate and warms up the whole body.
i: Stand with your feet together and arms by your sides.
Jump your feet apart while raising your arms overhead.
Jump again, crossing your legs and your arms in front of you.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep a steady rhythm and continue for 30-60 seconds.

exercises.n: toque alterno de punta con elevación de pierna
exercises.d: Lie on your back and tap each toe up toward the ceiling in turn. It targets the lower abs.
i: Lie on your back with both legs raised straight up.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Reach one leg up so your toes tap toward the ceiling.
Alternate legs with control.
Keep your core tight and breathe steadily.

exercises.n: elevación de piernas en silla romana
exercises.d: Raise your legs while supported by the arm pads of a captain's chair. It is a classic lower-ab exercise.
i: Rest your forearms on the pads and press your back against the support.
Let your legs hang straight down.
Raise your knees or straight legs to hip height or higher.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower your legs slowly without swinging.

exercises.n: sentadilla con leñador y mancuerna
exercises.d: Squat down and swing a dumbbell diagonally across your body. It trains legs, trunk rotation and shoulders in one movement.
i: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell with both hands by one hip.
Sit into a squat.
Stand up and swing the dumbbell diagonally across to overhead on the other side.
Rotate your torso and pivot your back foot as you go.
Return and repeat, then switch sides.

exercises.n: fondos de tríceps en el suelo
exercises.d: A floor dip with hands behind you and hips lifted. It trains the triceps with just your bodyweight.
i: Sit on the floor with knees bent and hands behind you.
Lift your hips off the floor.
Bend your elbows to lower your hips.
Push through your palms to straighten your arms.
Keep your elbows pointing back.
Keep your shoulders away from your ears.

exercises.n: giro en polea v. 2
exercises.d: Rotate your torso against a cable. It strengthens the obliques and builds control of your trunk rotation.
i: Set a cable at chest height and stand sideways to it.
Hold the handle with both hands in front of your chest.
Rotate your torso away from the cable, arms extended.
Keep your hips facing forward.
Return slowly, then switch sides after your reps.

exercises.n: peso muerto con mancuernas v. 2
exercises.d: Lift dumbbells from the floor by hinging at the hips. It strengthens your glutes, hamstrings and back.
i: Stand with feet hip-width apart, dumbbells at your sides or in front of your thighs.
Hinge at the hips and bend your knees slightly.
Lower the dumbbells along your legs with a flat back.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.

exercises.n: patada trasera en polea v. 2
exercises.d: Kick one leg straight back against a cable with an ankle strap. It isolates the glutes.
i: Attach an ankle strap to a low cable and hold the machine for support.
Stand tall with a slight bend in the standing knee.
Kick your working leg straight back.
Squeeze your glute at the top without arching your back.
Return slowly and switch legs after your reps.

exercises.n: sentadilla sumo con mancuerna
exercises.d: Squat with a wide stance holding a dumbbell between your legs. It hits the glutes and inner thighs.
i: Stand with feet wide and toes turned out, holding a dumbbell with both hands in front of you.
Keep your chest tall.
Sit down until your thighs are about parallel.
Push your knees out over your toes.
Drive through your heels to stand.

exercises.n: cargada y envión con barra
exercises.d: Lift a barbell from the floor to your shoulders, then drive it overhead. A technical full-body lift for power and speed.
i: Set up over the bar with a flat back and hands outside your knees.
Pull the bar off the floor and catch it at your shoulders in a squat.
Stand up with the bar racked.
Dip slightly and drive the bar overhead, splitting your feet.
Recover your feet, stand tall and lower the bar under control.

exercises.n: jalón con agarre inverso en polea
exercises.d: Pull a bar down to your chest with an underhand grip. It works the lats and gets the biceps more involved.
i: Sit at a pulldown station with palms facing you, hands shoulder-width apart.
Lean back slightly and keep your chest up.
Pull the bar down to your upper chest.
Squeeze your shoulder blades down and together.
Let the bar rise slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.n: salto lateral con giro
exercises.d: Jump while twisting your hips and legs to the side. It warms up the core and legs.
i: Stand with your feet together and arms bent.
Jump and twist your hips and legs to one side while your shoulders face forward.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Jump again and twist to the other side.
Keep a steady rhythm for 30-45 seconds.

exercises.n: giro abdominal de pie
exercises.d: Twist your torso from side to side while standing. It warms up the trunk and works the obliques lightly.
i: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, arms bent in front of your chest.
Keep your hips facing forward.
Rotate your upper body to one side.
Come back through the center and rotate the other way.
Keep a smooth rhythm for 20-30 twists.

exercises.n: contracción de espalda sentado
exercises.d: Squeezing your shoulder blades together while seated. It strengthens the upper back and improves posture.
i: Sit tall with arms at your sides or elbows bent.
Draw your shoulder blades back and together.
Hold the squeeze for 2-3 seconds.
Release slowly.
Keep your neck relaxed.
Repeat for your reps.

exercises.n: rotación de tronco sentado
exercises.d: A seated twist of the upper body. It mobilises the spine and warms up the obliques.
i: Sit tall with arms crossed on your chest.
Keep your hips facing forward.
Rotate your torso to one side.
Return to the centre.
Rotate to the other side.
Move smoothly without forcing the twist.

exercises.n: fondos de tríceps en el suelo v. 2
exercises.d: A floor dip with hands behind you and hips lifted. It trains the triceps with just your bodyweight.
i: Sit on the floor with knees bent and hands behind you.
Lift your hips off the floor.
Bend your elbows to lower your hips.
Push through your palms to straighten your arms.
Keep your elbows pointing back.
Keep your shoulders away from your ears.

exercises.n: toque de cuello sentado
exercises.d: A seated move tapping toward your neck area. It gently mobilises the neck and shoulders.
i: Sit tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Bring one hand up toward the side of your neck.
Tap lightly.
Switch to the other hand.
Keep your head level.
Continue at a gentle pace.

exercises.n: pulsos de contracción de espalda sentado
exercises.d: Small pulses while squeezing your shoulder blades together seated. It strengthens the upper back.
i: Sit tall with elbows bent.
Draw your shoulder blades together.
Pulse your elbows back in small movements.
Keep your shoulders down.
Maintain the squeeze throughout.
Continue for 20-30 seconds.

exercises.n: elevación de brazos tras la espalda sentado
exercises.d: Lifting your arms behind your back while seated. It strengthens the upper back and rear shoulders.
i: Sit tall with hands clasped behind your back.
Straighten your arms.
Lift your hands slightly away from your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly.
Keep your chest lifted.

exercises.n: bailarina sentado
exercises.d: A seated arm movement like a ballet arm sweep. It loosens the shoulders and warms up the upper body.
i: Sit tall with arms by your sides.
Sweep your arms out and up in a wide arc.
Bring your hands overhead.
Lower them back with control.
Keep the movement graceful.
Repeat at an easy pace.

exercises.n: estiramiento de rotación sentado
exercises.d: A seated twist held as a stretch. It opens the spine and the muscles around your waist.
i: Sit tall with legs crossed or extended.
Place one hand behind you and the other on the opposite knee.
Rotate your torso toward the back hand.
Keep your spine long.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

exercises.n: cargada desde colgado en smith
exercises.d: Pull a Smith machine bar from the knees up to your shoulders. The fixed track helps you learn the hang clean pattern.
i: Stand at the bar with it hanging at your knees, hands just outside your legs.
Keep your back flat.
Extend your hips and shrug explosively.
Pull your elbows high and catch the bar on your shoulders.
Lower the bar back to your knees and repeat.

exercises.n: arrastre de trineo de potencia
exercises.d: Drag a loaded sled behind you by walking backward or forward. It builds leg drive and conditioning.
i: Load a sled and attach a harness or straps.
Lean slightly forward and brace your core.
Walk with powerful steps, pushing through the balls of your feet.
Keep your back straight.
Cover a set distance, then rest and repeat.

exercises.n: pase de pecho contra la pared con balón medicinal
exercises.en: medicine ball chest pass against wall
exercises.d: Throw a medicine ball hard against a wall from your chest and catch it on the rebound. It builds explosive pressing power.
i: Stand facing a wall with the ball held at your chest.
Take a small step back and set your feet.
Push the ball forcefully at the wall.
Catch it with soft elbows as it returns.
Bring it back to your chest and repeat.

exercises.n: isométrico de cuello posterior
exercises.d: Press the back of your head into your hands without moving. It strengthens the muscles at the back of the neck.
i: Sit or stand tall with your hands clasped behind your head.
Keep your chin level.
Press your head back into your hands without letting it move.
Hold for 5-10 seconds.
Relax and repeat a few times.

exercises.n: estiramiento colgado en barra hacia atrás
exercises.d: Hang from a bar with your body leaning back to stretch your lats and shoulders.
i: Hold a bar with an overhand grip.
Lean your body back and let your arms and shoulders lengthen.
Relax your ribs and breathe slowly.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Step out of the stretch carefully.

exercises.n: estiramiento de recepción frontal asistido con banda elástica
exercises.en: resistance band assisted front rack stretch
exercises.d: Use a band to pull yourself into a front rack position. It stretches your wrists, lats and shoulders.
i: Loop a band around a sturdy anchor and hold it with both hands in a front rack position.
Step back and let the band help your elbows lift.
Keep your elbows high and chest tall.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release the tension slowly.

exercises.n: zancada con salto a una pierna
exercises.d: A lunge jump where you land on a single leg. It builds explosive leg power and balance.
i: Stand in a lunge position.
Lower down, then jump explosively off your front leg.
Land softly on the same leg.
Control the next repetition, keeping your torso upright.
Switch legs after your reps.

exercises.n: flexión de pino con kipping
exercises.d: Use a leg kick to help drive yourself up from a handstand push-up. It lets you handle more reps and volume overhead.
i: Kick up into a handstand against a wall.
Lower your head toward the floor under control.
Bend your hips and knees slightly, then drive them back out as you press.
Press up to lockout.
Keep your core tight and move carefully.

exercises.n: sostén de rodillas a de pie con peso corporal
exercises.d: Rise from a half-kneeling position to standing. It is a bodyweight move for hip and leg strength and balance.
i: Kneel on one knee with the other foot flat in front.
Hold your arms in front of you for balance.
Drive through the front foot to stand tall.
Lower back down under control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: salto de lado a lado
exercises.d: Hop laterally from one foot to the other. It builds ankle stability, leg power and agility.
i: Stand on one foot with a slight knee bend.
Hop sideways to the other foot.
Land softly and balance for a second.
Hop back to the first foot.
Keep your hips level and repeat for 20-30 hops.

exercises.n: subida lateral al banco
exercises.d: Step sideways onto a box or step. It works the quads and glutes and builds single-leg strength.
i: Stand sideways next to a box.
Place your near foot on the box.
Press through that foot to step up.
Lower back down slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: subida lateral al banco con rodilla arriba
exercises.en: lateral step up with knee drive
exercises.d: Step sideways onto a box and drive the other knee up. It adds balance and hip flexion to the lateral step up.
i: Stand sideways next to a box with one foot on top.
Press through that foot to step up.
Drive your other knee up toward your chest.
Lower back down with control.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: escalador deslizante con toalla
exercises.d: From a plank, slide your feet on towels to bring your knees to your chest. A core and cardio move that is easy on the joints.
i: Place your feet on towels on a smooth floor and get into a plank.
Keep your core tight and shoulders over your wrists.
Slide one knee toward your chest.
Slide it back and switch legs.
Keep a steady pace and a flat back.

exercises.n: salto de tijera en plancha sobre codos
exercises.d: Hold a forearm plank and jump your feet apart and together. It trains the core while raising your heart rate.
i: Get into a forearm plank with your elbows under your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Jump your feet wide apart.
Jump them back together.
Keep your hips level and continue for 20-40 seconds.

exercises.n: salto de tijera deslizante en plancha con toalla
exercises.d: From a plank, slide your feet apart and together on towels. It works the core and hips without any impact.
i: Put your feet on towels on a smooth floor and get into a high plank.
Brace your core.
Slide your feet wide apart.
Slide them back together.
Keep your hips level and repeat.

exercises.n: plancha sobre manos
exercises.d: A straight-arm plank held on the hands. It builds trunk stiffness and shoulder stability.
i: Place your hands under your shoulders and extend your legs behind you.
Tuck your toes and lift your hips so the body forms a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs.
Keep your neck neutral and look at the floor.
Hold for 20-40 seconds, then lower your knees.

exercises.n: flexión inclinada con agarre cerrado
exercises.d: A push-up with hands close together on a raised surface. The easier angle keeps the focus on your triceps.
i: Place your hands close together on a bench or sturdy box, just under your chest.
Step back until your body is straight from head to heels.
Lower your chest toward the edge, elbows tucked close to your ribs.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your hips from sagging throughout.

exercises.n: sentadilla con lanzamiento de balón medicinal a la pared
exercises.en: medicine ball throw squat with wall
exercises.d: Squat down with a medicine ball, then drive up and throw it against a wall. It trains explosive power through the legs and shoulders.
i: Stand facing a wall at arm's length and hold a medicine ball at your chest.
Squat down with your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.
Drive up explosively and throw the ball at the wall.
Catch the ball on the rebound with soft hands.
Reset your stance and repeat for controlled reps.

exercises.n: estiramiento de cuello sentado
exercises.d: A gentle seated stretch for the back of the neck. It helps ease tension from desk time.
i: Sit tall on a chair with your shoulders relaxed.
Place one hand on the back of your head.
Gently guide your chin toward your chest until you feel a stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.
Release slowly and repeat.

exercises.n: pica deslizante en plancha con toalla
exercises.d: From a plank with your feet on towels, slide your feet in to lift the hips into a pike. It hits your abs hard and challenges shoulder stability.
i: Put your toes on towels on a smooth floor and get into a straight-arm plank.
Brace your abs and keep your arms straight.
Slide your feet toward your hands as your hips rise into a pike.
Pause briefly at the top.
Slide your feet back to the plank without letting your hips drop.

exercises.n: salto al cajón a una pierna
exercises.d: A one-legged jump onto a box. It builds explosive power and single-leg control.
i: Stand facing a sturdy box on one foot.
Swing your arms and dip into a short quarter squat.
Jump up and land softly on the box on the same foot.
Stand tall, then step down carefully.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: puente de glúteos a una pierna con rotación externa
exercises.en: single leg glute bridge with external rotation
exercises.d: A one-legged glute bridge with the hip turned outward. It targets the glutes and the small hip stabilisers.
i: Lie on your back with one knee bent and the other leg lifted.
Press through your planted heel and raise your hips.
Turn the raised knee gently outward as you hold the top.
Keep your hips level and squeeze your glutes.
Lower with control, finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: aducción de cadera de pie v. 2
exercises.d: Standing leg swings across the body to work the inner thigh. A simple move for the adductors.
i: Stand tall next to a wall or chair and hold on for balance.
Lift the outer leg slightly off the floor.
Swing it across the front of your standing leg.
Return slowly to the start without leaning.
Finish your reps, then turn around and switch legs.

exercises.n: pulso de rodillas
exercises.d: Small pulsing leg lifts from a kneeling position. It gives your glutes a burning, focused workout.
i: Kneel on all fours with your hands under your shoulders.
Lift one leg back with the knee bent at about 90 degrees.
Pulse the foot upward in small, controlled movements.
Keep your hips square and your back flat.
Finish the set, then switch legs.

exercises.n: cruce de brazos
exercises.d: A dynamic arm swing across the chest that warms up the pecs and shoulders.
i: Stand tall with your arms out to the sides at shoulder height.
Swing both arms forward and cross them in front of your chest.
Open them back out and squeeze your shoulder blades slightly.
Alternate which arm is on top.
Keep a steady, relaxed rhythm.

exercises.n: apertura de pie con peso corporal
exercises.d: A standing fly motion without weights, squeezing the arms together. It teaches chest engagement and works as a warm-up.
i: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your arms out wide with slightly bent elbows.
Brace your core and keep your chest proud.
Sweep your arms together in front of your chest.
Squeeze your pecs hard for a second.
Open your arms back out with control.

exercises.n: pulso en la pared
exercises.d: Small pulses in a wall push-up position. It keeps constant tension on your triceps.
i: Stand facing a wall and place your hands on it, close together at chest height.
Step your feet back so your body leans in a straight line.
Bend your elbows slightly to bring your chest toward the wall.
Pulse in short, controlled movements.
Keep your elbows tucked and your core tight.

exercises.n: extensión de pierna a una pierna en máquina (con discos)
exercises.d: A plate-loaded machine extension done one leg at a time. It isolates the quads and evens out left-right differences.
i: Sit in the machine and adjust the pad to rest on your lower shin.
Place one foot under the pad and keep the other planted.
Extend your knee until your leg is almost straight.
Pause briefly and squeeze your quads.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: remo de pie con agarre cerrado en polea
exercises.d: A standing cable row with a close grip. It trains your lats and mid back while challenging posture.
i: Attach a close grip handle to a cable at chest height and step back.
Stand with a slight knee bend and a braced core.
Pull the handle toward your lower ribs, elbows close to your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.n: burpee con salto largo y flexión
exercises.en: burpee long jump with push up
exercises.d: A burpee with a push-up that finishes in a long forward jump. It is a tough full-body conditioning move.
i: Stand tall, then squat and place your hands on the floor.
Jump your feet back and do one push-up.
Jump your feet back toward your hands.
Explode into a long jump forward.
Land softly with bent knees and go into the next rep.

exercises.n: thruster de cargada de potencia
exercises.d: A power clean flowing straight into a front squat and overhead press. It is a big full-body power movement.
i: Set up with the barbell over mid-foot and grip it just outside your knees.
Pull the bar explosively and catch it on your shoulders in a quarter squat.
Stand, then sink into a full front squat.
Drive up and press the bar overhead.
Lower the bar to your shoulders and then to the floor with control.

exercises.n: cargada y envión con barra v. 2
exercises.d: The classic Olympic lift. You clean the bar to your shoulders, then jerk it overhead.
i: Grip the bar just outside your knees with a flat back.
Pull explosively and drop under the bar, catching it on your shoulders.
Stand up fully and reset your feet.
Dip, drive, and split your legs as you punch the bar overhead.
Recover your feet and lower the bar with control.

exercises.n: cluster
exercises.d: A weightlifting combo where a clean flows into a front squat and a push press. It trains power and stamina together.
i: Start with the barbell on the floor and pull it to your shoulders in a clean.
Stand up with the bar racked on your shoulders.
Squat down into a deep front squat.
Drive up and press the bar overhead.
Lower the bar to your shoulders and repeat.

exercises.n: arrastre trasero de trineo de potencia v. 2
exercises.d: Dragging a weighted sled backward while walking. It builds thigh strength with very little joint impact.
i: Load the sled and grip the handles or strap in front of you.
Lean slightly back with your chest up.
Walk backward in small, powerful steps.
Keep your knees soft and your core tight.
Cover your distance, then rest and repeat.

exercises.n: muscle-up con peso corporal v. 2
exercises.d: An advanced pull-up that transitions into a dip above a bar. It builds serious pulling and pushing strength.
i: Hang from a pull-up bar with a false or standard grip.
Pull explosively, bringing the bar toward your lower chest.
Lean forward and rotate your wrists over the bar.
Press up until your arms are fully straight.
Lower yourself back down with control.

exercises.n: estiramiento lateral de cuello sentado
exercises.d: A seated lateral neck stretch. It loosens the side of the neck and upper traps.
i: Sit tall and relax your shoulders.
Tilt your ear toward one shoulder.
Rest your hand lightly on your head for a gentle added stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return to centre and switch sides.

exercises.n: sostén de puente de glúteos a una pierna recta
exercises.en: single straight leg glute bridge hold
exercises.d: Holding a glute bridge with one leg straight. It trains the glutes and challenges hip stability.
i: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Straighten one leg.
Lift your hips with the planted foot.
Hold with hips level.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower and switch legs.

exercises.n: curl de bíceps tipo mesero con mancuerna
exercises.d: A dumbbell curl in which the weights are held and curled up in front of the shoulders. It trains the biceps.
i: Ponte de pie con una mancuerna en cada mano, con las palmas hacia adelante.
Mantén la parte superior de los brazos cerca del cuerpo y los codos pegados.
Flexiona lentamente las mancuernas hacia los hombros, manteniendo las muñecas rectas.
Haz una pausa breve en la parte alta, luego baja lentamente las mancuernas de vuelta a la posición inicial.
Repite el número de repeticiones deseado.

exercises.n: abdominal de rodillas con banda elástica
exercises.d: A kneeling crunch pulled down against a resistance band. It adds load to the abs.
i: Anchor the band overhead and kneel facing it.
Hold the handles beside your head.
Crunch your ribs toward your hips, rounding your spine.
Squeeze your abs at the bottom.
Return slowly to the start without sitting back on your heels.

exercises.n: abdominal de pie con banda elástica
exercises.d: A standing crunch against band tension. It trains the abs without lying on the floor.
i: Anchor the band high and stand facing it with your feet hip-width apart.
Hold the handles at your head.
Bend forward by crunching your ribs toward your pelvis.
Squeeze your abs hard.
Return slowly to standing.

exercises.n: press de hombros sobre la cabeza a un brazo con banda elástica
exercises.en: resistance band single arm overhead shoulder press
exercises.d: A one-arm overhead press with a resistance band. It trains each shoulder separately and challenges your trunk.
i: Stand on the band with the handle in one hand at shoulder height.
Brace your core and keep your ribs down.
Press the handle straight overhead.
Pause at the top without leaning.
Lower with control, finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: press de hombros sobre la cabeza con banda elástica
exercises.d: A two-handed overhead press using a resistance band. It is an easy way to train the shoulders anywhere.
i: Stand on the middle of the band and hold a handle in each hand at your shoulders.
Brace your abs and stand tall.
Press both handles overhead until your arms are straight.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly back to shoulder height.

exercises.n: abdominal de rodillas con banda elástica v. 2
exercises.en: resistance band kneeling ab crunch v. 2
exercises.d: A second variation of the kneeling band crunch. It loads the abs through the full crunch range.
i: Anchor the band overhead and kneel facing it.
Hold the band at your forehead or beside your head.
Pull your elbows toward your knees as you curl down.
Hold the squeeze for a second.
Return slowly while keeping the tension.

exercises.n: escalador v. 2
exercises.d: A mountain climber in plank position, a second variation. It raises your heart rate and works the core.
i: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
Brace your core.
Drive one knee toward your chest.
Switch legs quickly.
Keep your hips low and level.
Continue for 20-40 seconds.

exercises.n: andar en bicicleta al aire libre
exercises.d: Cycling outdoors at an easy to moderate pace. It is a low-impact way to build endurance.
i: Adjust your saddle so your leg is almost straight at the bottom of the pedal stroke.
Wear a helmet and check your brakes.
Start at an easy pace to warm up.
Pedal smoothly at a steady, comfortable rhythm for 20-60 minutes.
Cool down with a few minutes of easy pedalling.

exercises.n: sprint
exercises.d: Short, all-out running efforts. It builds speed and conditioning.
i: Warm up well with jogging and dynamic stretches.
Start in a staggered stance and lean slightly forward.
Drive your arms and knees as you accelerate.
Run at maximum effort for 10-30 seconds.
Slow down gradually and rest fully before the next sprint.

exercises.n: postura de ángulo lateral extendido (yoga)
exercises.d: A wide-legged yoga lunge with a long side stretch. It opens the hips and sides of the body.
i: Step your feet wide apart and turn one foot out.
Bend the front knee over the ankle.
Rest your forearm on your thigh and reach the other arm overhead.
Lengthen the whole side body and look up if comfortable.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and switch sides.

exercises.n: encogimientos con agarre abierto en smith
exercises.d: A shrug on the Smith machine with a wide grip. It builds the upper traps.
i: Set the bar at thigh height and grip it wider than shoulder width.
Stand tall with your arms straight.
Shrug your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly without rolling your shoulders.

exercises.n: encogimientos con agarre abierto y barra
exercises.d: A barbell shrug with a wide grip. It targets the upper traps.
i: Stand holding a barbell in front with a wide overhand grip.
Keep your arms straight and your chest up.
Lift your shoulders straight toward your ears.
Hold the top for a second.
Lower slowly under control.

exercises.n: encogimientos con agarre abierto tras la espalda en smith
exercises.d: A wide-grip shrug with the Smith bar held behind your body. It shifts the load toward the back of the traps.
i: Stand with your back to the bar, set at thigh height, and grip it wide behind you.
Lift the bar off the hooks and stand tall.
Shrug your shoulders straight up.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and keep your arms straight.

exercises.n: encogimientos con agarre abierto tras la espalda y barra
exercises.d: A wide-grip shrug with the barbell held behind your body. It hits the traps from a slightly different angle.
i: Hold a barbell behind your thighs with a wide overhand grip.
Stand tall with your chest up.
Shrug your shoulders straight up.
Squeeze at the top for a second.
Lower slowly without leaning forward.

exercises.n: abdominal miotático en bosu
exercises.d: A deep, stretched crunch over a Bosu ball. The extra range loads the abs strongly.
i: Lie back over a Bosu ball with your lower back supported.
Place your hands beside your head and your feet flat.
Let your torso extend gently over the ball.
Crunch up, bringing your ribs toward your hips.
Lower slowly through the full range.

exercises.n: peso muerto y remo inclinado con mancuernas
exercises.d: A deadlift position held into a bent-over row. It trains your back and hamstrings together.
i: Stand holding dumbbells in front of your thighs.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back and soft knees.
Row the dumbbells toward your lower ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower the weights slowly and stand back up.

exercises.n: puñetazo cruzado en posición de sentadilla
exercises.en: cross body punch in squat position
exercises.d: Punching across the body from a low squat. It builds leg endurance and trunk rotation.
i: Stand in a wide stance and sink into a half squat.
Keep your fists up near your chin.
Punch one arm across your body, rotating your torso.
Pull it back and punch with the other arm.
Stay low and keep a quick, controlled rhythm.

exercises.n: caminata de pared
exercises.d: Walk your feet up a wall into a handstand-like position, then walk back down. It builds shoulder strength and trunk control.
i: Lie face down with your feet against a wall.
Place your hands beside your chest and push up into a plank.
Walk your feet up the wall as your hands walk toward it.
Stop where you can keep your body straight and braced.
Walk back down slowly with control.

exercises.n: dominada supina con brazos flexionados
exercises.d: A chin-up holding the arms bent at the top. It builds strength in the lats and biceps.
i: Hang from a bar with an underhand, shoulder-width grip.
Pull yourself up until your chin clears the bar.
Keep your elbows bent and your body still.
Hold briefly at the top.
Lower slowly until just short of straight arms.

exercises.n: abdominal declinado sobre la cabeza con una mancuerna
exercises.en: single dumbbell decline overhead sit up
exercises.d: A decline sit-up holding one dumbbell overhead. The load adds resistance for the abs.
i: Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured.
Hold one dumbbell with both hands above your head.
Curl up and sit forward, keeping the weight overhead.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly to the start.

exercises.n: zancada con curl de bíceps y balón medicinal
exercises.en: medicine ball lunge with biceps curl
exercises.d: A lunge combined with a medicine ball curl. It trains the legs and arms in one go.
i: Stand holding a medicine ball at your thighs.
Step forward into a lunge.
Curl the ball up toward your chest as you lower.
Push back to standing while lowering the ball.
Alternate legs on each rep.

exercises.n: curl de bíceps con extensión sobre la cabeza en balón de estabilidad con mancuernas
exercises.en: dumbbell biceps curl with overhead extension on stability ball
exercises.d: Sitting on a stability ball, you curl a dumbbell and then press it overhead into an extension. It works both arms muscles and trunk balance.
i: Sit tall on a stability ball holding a dumbbell.
Curl the dumbbell up with your elbow at your side.
Raise it overhead, lifting it with both hands.
Lower it behind your head for a triceps extension.
Extend, return to the front, and repeat.

exercises.n: peso muerto con curl de bíceps y barra EZ
exercises.en: ez barbell deadlift with biceps curl
exercises.d: Deadlifting an EZ bar and finishing with a curl. It combines a hip hinge and an arm exercise.
i: Stand with an EZ bar in front of your thighs.
Hinge at the hips and lower the bar along your legs.
Stand tall by driving your hips forward.
Curl the bar up to your chest.
Lower it and repeat.

exercises.n: extensiones inversas de la vieja escuela
exercises.d: A classic reverse hyper lift on a bench, raising the legs behind you. It trains the lower back and glutes.
i: Lie face down over a bench with your hips at the edge.
Hold the bench and keep your legs hanging down.
Lift your legs behind you until your body is straight.
Pause and squeeze your glutes.
Lower slowly without swinging.

exercises.n: contracción abdominal hacia adentro de rodillas
exercises.d: Pulling your belly in while kneeling. It teaches deep abdominal control.
i: Kneel on all fours with your hands under your shoulders.
Relax your belly toward the floor.
Draw your navel up toward your spine.
Hold for 10-15 seconds while breathing normally.
Release slowly and repeat.

exercises.n: extensión de tríceps acostado en polea (baja)
exercises.d: Lying on a bench with a low cable, extending the arms. It isolates the triceps.
i: Lie on a bench with a low pulley behind your head.
Hold the bar or rope with your arms up over your face.
Keep your upper arms still.
Bend your elbows to lower the handle toward your forehead.
Extend your arms back up.

exercises.n: abdominal bicicleta acostado
exercises.d: A lying alternating crunch that pedals the legs while the elbow meets the opposite knee. It works the abs and obliques.
i: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head.
Lift your shoulders and bring your knees up.
Extend one leg while turning your opposite elbow toward the other knee.
Switch sides in a smooth pedalling motion.
Keep your lower back pressed down.

exercises.n: press de hombros inclinado con mancuernas
exercises.d: A dumbbell press on an incline bench. It trains the shoulders and upper chest.
i: Set a bench to about 60 to 75 degrees and sit back with a dumbbell in each hand.
Hold the weights at shoulder height.
Press the dumbbells up until your arms are straight.
Lower slowly to shoulder level.
Keep your back against the pad.

exercises.n: abdominal bicicleta con giro a 45 grados
exercises.d: A twisting bicycle crunch with the torso leaning back at 45 degrees. It strongly targets the abs and obliques.
i: Sit and lean back to about 45 degrees with your feet raised.
Place your hands behind your head.
Bring one knee in as you twist the opposite elbow toward it.
Alternate sides in a pedalling motion.
Keep your chest lifted and your core tight.

exercises.n: abdominal con giro en el aire
exercises.d: A twisting crunch with the legs held in the air. It works your abs and obliques.
i: Lie on your back with your knees raised.
Place your hands behind your head.
Lift your shoulders and twist toward one knee.
Return and twist toward the other side.
Keep a slow rhythm and press your lower back down.

exercises.n: abdominal encogido acostado
exercises.d: A crunch where your knees pull in as your chest comes up. It trains the abs.
i: Lie on your back with your legs extended just off the floor.
Place your hands behind your head.
Pull your knees in and crunch your chest toward them.
Squeeze your abs at the top.
Extend and lower slowly.

exercises.n: toque de punta acostado
exercises.d: Lying with the legs up, reach your hands toward your toes. It trains the upper abs.
i: Lie on your back with your legs straight up.
Reach your arms up toward your toes.
Lift your shoulders off the floor and touch your toes.
Lower your shoulders slowly.
Keep your legs steady.

exercises.n: subida al banco enfocada en glúteos con peso corporal
exercises.d: A step-up that emphasises the glutes by leaning slightly forward. It builds single-leg strength.
i: Stand in front of a bench and place one foot on it.
Lean your torso slightly forward.
Press through your heel and step up until standing.
Lower slowly back down.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: flexión escalonada de rodillas
exercises.d: A push-up from your knees with hands set at staggered heights. It builds the chest in a more manageable way.
i: Kneel and place your hands on the floor, one slightly forward of the other.
Keep your body straight from knees to head.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up.
Keep your elbows at about 45 degrees.
Switch hand positions on the next set.

exercises.n: thruster press de rodillas en landmine
exercises.d: From a kneeling position, you drive the landmine bar up into a press. It builds shoulder power.
i: Kneel facing the landmine and hold the end of the bar at your chest.
Sit your hips back toward your heels.
Drive through your hips and press the bar up.
Straighten your arms fully at the top.
Lower back to your chest with control.

exercises.n: press de pecho con impulso de velocista y mancuernas
exercises.d: Pressing dumbbells from the chest while driving one knee up like a sprinter. It combines upper body strength with a core-driven leg movement.
i: Lie on a bench holding dumbbells at your chest.
Drive one knee up toward your chest.
Press the dumbbells up until your arms are straight.
Lower the dumbbells and switch legs.
Keep a steady rhythm.

exercises.n: posición de manos de pie (pronación, supinación, neutro)
exercises.d: A forearm drill that rotates the hands through pronation, neutral and supination. It builds wrist and forearm control.
i: Stand tall with your arms hanging by your sides.
Bend your elbows and hold your forearms in front of you.
Rotate your palms down, then to neutral, then up.
Move slowly and keep your elbows still.
Repeat for several smooth rounds.

exercises.n: cargada completa con barra
exercises.d: The full clean lifts the barbell from the floor to the shoulders while dropping into a front squat. It builds explosive power.
i: Stand with the bar over mid-foot and grip it just outside your knees.
Pull the bar explosively with a flat back.
Drop under the bar and catch it on your shoulders in a front squat.
Stand up fully.
Lower the bar with control to the floor.

exercises.n: curl predicador de rodillas en polea
exercises.d: A kneeling curl with the arms propped on a bench and a cable. It isolates the biceps.
i: Kneel in front of a bench with a low cable beside you.
Rest your upper arms on the pad.
Curl the handle up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.n: curl predicador con torso girado y mancuerna
exercises.d: A preacher curl with your torso turned slightly. The changed angle puts extra tension on the biceps.
i: Sit at a preacher bench with a dumbbell in one hand.
Rotate your torso slightly toward the working arm.
Curl the dumbbell up to shoulder height.
Squeeze your biceps.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: curl predicador con torso girado en máquina
exercises.d: A machine preacher curl with a slight torso turn. It keeps steady tension on the biceps.
i: Sit at the machine and adjust the seat so your arms rest on the pad.
Turn your torso slightly toward the working arm.
Curl the handle up toward your shoulder.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly, then switch arms.

exercises.n: sentadilla completa desde déficit con kettlebell
exercises.d: A deep squat with a kettlebell while standing on a raised platform. It increases range of motion for the legs.
i: Stand on a low platform holding a kettlebell at chest height.
Brace your core.
Sit your hips down as deep as you can.
Keep your chest up and heels down.
Drive through your feet to stand.
Keep the kettlebell close to your body.

exercises.n: tabla de equilibrio v. 2
exercises.d: Standing on a balance board to train stability. It strengthens the ankles and the small stabilisers in the feet.
i: Place the board on a flat, non-slip surface.
Step onto it with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Keep your knees soft and your core tight.
Tilt gently without letting the edges touch the floor.
Balance for 30-60 seconds.

exercises.n: apertura posterior con mancuernas (45 grados)
exercises.d: Raise dumbbells out to the sides on an incline of about 45 degrees to hit the rear delts and upper back.
i: Set a bench to 45 degrees and lie chest down on it, a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang below you with a soft bend in the elbows.
Raise the weights out to the sides until your arms are level with your torso.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower slowly under control.
Keep your neck neutral and avoid swinging.

exercises.n: sentadilla con barra hexagonal
exercises.d: Squat while standing inside a trap bar, which keeps the load at your sides. Builds legs and glutes with a friendly upright torso.
i: Stand inside the trap bar with feet shoulder-width apart and grip the handles.
Brace your core and keep your chest tall.
Sit your hips back and down until your thighs are about parallel.
Drive through your whole foot to stand up.
Lock out your hips at the top without leaning back.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.

exercises.n: peso muerto rumano a una pierna en landmine
exercises.en: landmine one leg stiff leg deadlift
exercises.d: A single-leg hip hinge holding a landmine bar. It trains hamstrings and glutes and challenges your balance.
i: Hold the end of the landmine bar in front of you with both hands.
Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend.
Hinge at the hips and lower the bar while your free leg reaches back.
Keep your back flat and hips square.
Squeeze your glutes to return to standing.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: abdominal con giro ruso y barra EZ
exercises.en: ez bar russian twist sit up
exercises.d: A sit-up that adds a twist while holding an EZ bar. Works the abs and obliques together.
i: Lie on your back with knees bent and hold the EZ bar over your chest.
Curl up into a sit-up position.
At the top, rotate your torso to one side, moving the bar with you.
Rotate back to center and lower yourself with control.
Alternate sides each rep.
Keep the weight light enough to move smoothly.

exercises.n: abdominal con press de hombros y barra EZ
exercises.en: ez bar shoulder press sit up
exercises.d: Combine a sit-up with an overhead press using an EZ bar. Trains the abs, shoulders and triceps in one flowing rep.
i: Lie on your back with knees bent, holding the EZ bar at your chest.
Sit up while keeping the bar close to your body.
Once upright, press the bar overhead.
Lower the bar back to your chest.
Roll back down slowly to the floor.
Brace your core and avoid yanking with your neck.

exercises.n: zancada lateral elevada
exercises.d: A side lunge performed with the lunging foot on a raised platform for extra range. Works glutes and inner thighs.
i: Stand tall next to a low step or platform.
Step one foot sideways onto the platform.
Push your hips back and bend that knee while the other leg stays straight.
Keep your chest up and the planted foot flat.
Push back to the start.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: deslizamiento de serrato en la pared con balón de estabilidad
exercises.d: Slide your forearms up a wall on a stability ball to wake up the serratus anterior and improve shoulder control.
i: Place a stability ball against a wall and rest your forearms on it.
Step back slightly so your body leans in.
Slide your forearms up the ball as you reach overhead.
Push into the ball and spread your shoulder blades at the top.
Slide back down slowly.
Keep your ribs down and avoid arching your lower back.

exercises.n: zancada hacia atrás desde déficit
exercises.d: A reverse lunge starting from a raised platform so you go deeper. Great for glutes and quads.
i: Stand on a low step with your feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot back and down off the step.
Lower until the front thigh is about parallel.
Keep your torso tall and front knee stable.
Push through the front heel to return to the step.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: sentadilla buenos días con mancuerna
exercises.d: Blend a good morning hinge with a squat while holding a dumbbell. Builds the posterior chain and legs.
i: Hold a dumbbell at your chest and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Hinge at your hips with a flat back until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Stand back up and then sit down into a squat.
Drive up through your heels.
Repeat the hinge and squat as one rep.
Keep your chest up throughout.

exercises.n: subida al banco enfocada en glúteos con mancuernas
exercises.d: A step-up with a forward lean and a high box that shifts the work onto the glutes.
i: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and face a bench or box.
Place one foot fully on the box and lean your torso slightly forward.
Push through the heel of that foot to stand up.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower with control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: subida al banco enfocada en glúteos en polea
exercises.d: A step-up with a cable that is set to put more work on the glutes. It builds strength in the hips.
i: Hold the cable handle and stand facing a step.
Place one foot on the step.
Lean slightly forward from the hips.
Drive through the heel to stand up.
Lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: remo inclinado con agarre estrecho pronado en smith
exercises.en: smith bent over narrow pronated grip row
exercises.d: A bent-over row on the smith machine using a narrow overhand grip. Hits the lats and mid back.
i: Set the bar at knee height and grip it with hands close together, palms down.
Hinge forward with a flat back and unlock the bar.
Pull the bar toward your lower ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower the bar slowly.
Keep your hips back and torso still.

exercises.n: apertura con banda elástica (45 grados)
exercises.d: Pull a band apart with your arms angled upward at about 45 degrees. Strengthens the rear shoulders and upper back.
i: Hold a resistance band in both hands in front of you.
Raise your arms to about 45 degrees above horizontal.
Pull the band apart by moving your hands out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly to the start.
Keep your ribs down and your shoulders away from your ears.

exercises.n: jalón dorsal con cuerda en máquina multimodo
exercises.en: lever multy mode rope lat pulldown
exercises.d: A lat pulldown on a lever machine using rope handles. The multi-mode setup lets you vary the pulling path.
i: Sit at the machine and grab the rope handles.
Set your thighs under the pads and sit tall.
Pull the handles down toward your upper chest.
Drive your elbows down and back.
Let the handles rise slowly until your arms are straight.
Avoid leaning back too far.

exercises.n: peso muerto rumano en máquina de barra T
exercises.d: A Romanian deadlift on a T-bar lever machine. Targets the hamstrings and glutes with a guided path.
i: Stand at the T-bar lever and grip the handles.
Lift to stand with a slight bend in your knees.
Push your hips back and lower the bar along your thighs.
Stop when you feel a strong hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand.
Keep your back flat all the way.

exercises.n: press de hombros de pie con barra
exercises.d: An overhead press done standing. It builds shoulder strength and total-body stability.
i: Hold the bar at shoulder height with hands just outside shoulder-width.
Stand tall with glutes and core braced.
Press the bar straight overhead, moving your head back slightly.
Lock out with the bar over mid-foot.
Lower the bar back to your shoulders.
Avoid leaning back.

exercises.n: pullover con mancuerna v. 2
exercises.d: Arc a dumbbell from overhead to your chest while lying on a bench. Works the chest and lats with a deep stretch.
i: Lie across or along a bench holding one dumbbell with both hands over your chest.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Lower the dumbbell back behind your head in an arc.
Feel the stretch through your chest and lats.
Pull it back over your chest.
Keep your hips low and ribs down.

exercises.n: press de banca svend
exercises.d: Press a weight plate away from your chest while squeezing it. A chest isolation move with constant tension.
i: Lie on a bench holding a plate between your palms at chest level.
Squeeze your palms together hard.
Press the plate straight up until your arms extend.
Keep squeezing the plate throughout.
Lower it back to your chest slowly.
Keep your feet planted.

exercises.n: rotación de tronco en máquina
exercises.d: Rotate your torso against machine resistance. Trains the obliques and trunk rotation strength.
i: Sit in the machine and adjust the pads so your hips are fixed.
Hold the handles or brace your arms on the pads.
Rotate your torso to one side in a smooth motion.
Pause briefly at the end.
Return to center slowly.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: abdominal con giro cruzado v. 2
exercises.d: A sit-up with a cross-body twist, a second variation. It works the abs and obliques together.
i: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands behind your head.
Sit up while rotating your torso.
Bring one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Lower back down slowly.
Alternate sides each rep.
Avoid pulling on your neck.

exercises.n: swing, cargada, sentadilla frontal y press sobre la cabeza con kettlebell
exercises.en: kettlebell swing clean grip front squat overhead press
