exercises.n: flexión lateral sentado en silla
exercises.en: seated side bend on a chair
exercises.d: A gentle seated side bend that works the obliques and loosens the sides of the trunk.
i: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Reach one arm overhead and lean slowly to the opposite side without twisting.
Pause briefly, then return to upright.
Repeat on the other side and keep alternating.

exercises.n: curl drag con banda elástica
exercises.d: A curl variation where the elbows travel back as you pull, putting the biceps under steady band tension.
i: Stand on the band with feet hip-width apart and hold the handles at your thighs.
Keep your chest up and core braced.
Curl by dragging your hands up your body while the elbows move behind you.
Squeeze at the top for a moment.
Lower under control until your arms are straight.

exercises.n: halo en media rodilla con kettlebell
exercises.d: A kettlebell circle around the head from a half kneeling stance that mobilises the shoulders and challenges core stability.
i: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward and hold the kettlebell upside down at chest height.
Squeeze your glutes and keep your ribs down.
Circle the bell around your head slowly, keeping it close.
Complete the reps, then reverse the direction.
Switch the kneeling leg and repeat.

exercises.n: rotación escapular externa de pie con peso corporal
exercises.d: A standing drill that rotates the arms outward while drawing the shoulder blades back. It wakes up the rotator cuff and upper back.
i: Stand tall with your elbows bent at your sides.
Keep your palms facing forward.
Rotate your forearms outward and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Hold for a second.
Return slowly to the start.
Keep your ribs down and your shoulders away from your ears.

exercises.n: press de columna torácica en T de pie con peso corporal
exercises.d: A standing movement that presses the arms overhead to open up the thoracic spine. It improves upper back extension.
i: Stand with your feet hip width apart.
Clasp your hands in front of your chest.
Press your arms up and slightly back while lifting your chest.
Extend through your upper back without flaring your ribs.
Return to the start under control.
Repeat for smooth, slow reps.

exercises.n: puente de isquiotibiales
exercises.d: A bridge with the heels placed farther away so the hamstrings and glutes do more of the lifting.
i: Lie on your back with knees bent and heels placed a bit farther from your hips.
Press your heels into the floor.
Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.n: rotación interna de hombro de pie con banda elástica
exercises.en: resistance band standing shoulder internal rotation
exercises.d: A light band drill that strengthens the internal rotators of the shoulder, handy for joint health.
i: Anchor the band at elbow height and stand sideways to it.
Tuck your elbow against your side with the forearm pointing forward.
Rotate your forearm across your belly, keeping the elbow fixed.
Return slowly to the start.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: rotación externa de hombro de pie con banda elástica
exercises.en: resistance band standing shoulder external rotation
exercises.d: A band drill that strengthens the small rotator cuff muscles on the back of the shoulder.
i: Anchor the band at elbow height and stand sideways to it.
Hold the handle with the elbow tucked at your side, bent 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm outward away from your belly, keeping the elbow fixed.
Pause, then return slowly.
Complete the reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: elevación lateral a un brazo de pie con banda elástica
exercises.en: resistance band standing single arm lateral raise
exercises.d: A one-arm side raise using band tension to train the middle part of the shoulder.
i: Stand on the band and hold the handle in one hand at your side.
Keep a slight bend in the elbow and your torso still.
Raise your arm out to the side up to shoulder height.
Lower slowly against the band.
Complete the reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: rotación externa de hombro a 90 grados de pie con banda elástica
exercises.en: resistance band standing 90 degrees shoulder external rotation
exercises.d: A band rotation with the upper arm raised to shoulder height, building rotator cuff strength for overhead positions.
i: Anchor the band at shoulder height and hold the handle with your elbow raised to shoulder level, bent 90 degrees.
Keep the upper arm still.
Rotate your hand up and back until the forearm points to the ceiling.
Return slowly to the start.
Do all reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: press de hombros sobre la cabeza con banda elástica v. 2
exercises.en: resistance band overhead shoulder press v. 2
exercises.d: An overhead press with a band, training the shoulders and triceps with tension that rises toward the top.
i: Stand on the band with feet shoulder-width apart and hold the handles at shoulder height.
Brace your core and keep ribs down.
Press the handles overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower them back to your shoulders under control.
Repeat without leaning back.

exercises.n: pass through con banda elástica
exercises.d: A band stretch that moves overhead and behind you, opening up the shoulders and chest.
i: Hold the band in front of your thighs with a wide grip and straight arms.
Stand tall.
Raise the band overhead and keep going back behind your body.
Reverse the path to return to the front.
Widen your grip if it feels too tight.

exercises.n: balanceo lateral con kettlebell v. 2
exercises.d: A swing performed to the side of the body that hits the obliques and hips while the legs drive the kettlebell.
i: Stand with feet wider than hips and hold a kettlebell with both hands.
Hinge at the hips and swing the bell between your legs.
Drive your hips forward and swing it up and across to one side.
Let it fall back through your legs and swing to the other side.
Keep your back flat throughout.

exercises.n: estiramiento sentado con brazos rectos sobre la cabeza
exercises.en: seated over head straight arm stretch
exercises.d: A seated overhead reach that stretches the chest and shoulders. It helps open up the upper body after desk time.
i: Sit tall on a chair or bench.
Interlace your fingers and straighten your arms.
Raise them overhead with palms facing up.
Lift your chest and reach slightly back.
Breathe normally and hold for 20 to 30 seconds.
Release slowly.

exercises.n: giro ruso con kettlebell
exercises.d: A seated twist holding a kettlebell. It builds the obliques and trunk rotation strength.
i: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and lean back slightly.
Hold a kettlebell with both hands at your chest.
Keep your back straight and rotate your torso to one side.
Touch the kettlebell lightly near the floor.
Rotate to the other side in a controlled way.
Keep your feet down or lifted if you can stay stable.

exercises.n: paso lateral desde sentadilla
exercises.d: A squat that steps one leg out to the side before returning. It works the legs and hips with a bit of lateral movement.
i: Stand with your feet together.
Squat down by pushing your hips back.
Stand up while stepping one foot out to the side.
Bring that foot back in and squat again.
Alternate sides each rep.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.

exercises.n: prensa de piernas angulada en máquina
exercises.d: A plate-loaded angled press that works the thighs and glutes with a stable seated position.
i: Sit in the machine with your back flat on the pad and feet on the platform shoulder-width apart.
Release the safety handles.
Lower the platform until your knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Press through your whole foot until your legs are nearly straight.
Do not lock your knees out.

exercises.n: plancha con toque lateral al suelo
exercises.d: A plank where you tap a hand to the floor at the side, challenging the obliques and anti-rotation control.
i: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders and feet wide.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Reach one hand out to tap the floor at the side without twisting your hips.
Return it and tap with the other hand.
Keep the pace steady and controlled.

exercises.n: inclinación hacia atrás sentado en silla
exercises.en: seated lean back on a chair
exercises.d: A seated lean back that wakes up the abs by holding the torso against gravity.
i: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Lean back slowly while keeping your back straight.
Stop where you can still hold your form, then return to upright using your abs.

exercises.n: puñetazo cruzado sentado en silla
exercises.en: seated cross body punch on a chair
exercises.d: A seated punching drill that raises your heart rate and works the chest, shoulders and trunk.
i: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Raise your fists to guard position.
Punch one arm across your body, rotating the trunk slightly.
Pull it back and punch with the other arm.
Keep a quick, smooth rhythm.

exercises.n: estiramiento sobre la cabeza sentado en silla
exercises.en: seated overhead stretch on a chair
exercises.d: A simple seated stretch that opens up the sides of your back and shoulders.
i: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Interlace your fingers and raise your arms overhead.
Turn your palms to the ceiling and reach up tall.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.

exercises.n: estiramiento con flexión hacia delante sentado en silla
exercises.en: seated forward bend stretch on a chair
exercises.d: A seated forward fold that stretches the hamstrings and lower back.
i: Sit near the front of a sturdy chair and extend one leg with the heel on the floor.
Keep your back long.
Hinge forward from the hips and reach toward your toes.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs and repeat.

exercises.n: enrollado hacia delante sentado en silla
exercises.en: seated forward roll up on a chair
exercises.d: A seated roll-up that curls the spine forward one segment at a time. It trains the abs and spinal control.
i: Sit tall on the edge of a chair with your arms crossed or reaching forward.
Tuck your chin and round your lower back.
Roll your spine forward one segment at a time.
Reach toward your knees and pause.
Roll back up slowly to a tall position.
Keep the motion smooth and controlled.

exercises.n: sentadilla de patinador con contrapeso en bosu
exercises.en: bosu ball balance counterbalanced skater squat
exercises.d: A single-leg squat on a bosu ball with the free leg reaching back for balance, challenging the legs and stability.
i: Stand on one foot on the bosu ball and hold your arms in front for balance.
Reach the free leg back behind you.
Sit your hips back and lower into a single-leg squat.
Drive through the standing foot to rise.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: press de hombros contrario de rodillas con mancuerna
exercises.d: A kneeling one-arm press where the opposite knee is down, adding core and hip stability to the shoulder work.
i: Kneel on one knee and hold a dumbbell at shoulder height in the hand opposite the raised knee.
Keep your torso tall and glutes tight.
Press the dumbbell overhead until your arm is straight.
Lower under control to your shoulder.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: elevación con giro de abajo a arriba de rodillas con mancuerna
exercises.en: dumbbell kneeling twist down up raise
exercises.d: A diagonal chopping and lifting pattern from a kneeling position that trains the obliques and shoulders.
i: Kneel on both knees and hold one dumbbell with both hands beside one hip.
Keep your hips square.
Twist and lift the dumbbell diagonally up across your body.
Reverse the path back down to the hip.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: sentadilla de rodillas a de pie
exercises.d: A flowing move from kneeling up into a squat, working the legs, glutes and balance.
i: Kneel on both knees with your torso upright.
Step one foot forward and then the other so both feet are flat.
Press up to stand, then sit back into a squat.
Return to kneeling under control.
Alternate which foot steps first.

exercises.n: elevación de tibial con apoyo en pared y peso corporal
exercises.d: A wall-supported toe raise that strengthens the muscles at the front of the shins.
i: Stand with your back against a wall and your feet a bit in front of you.
Keep your legs straight.
Lift your toes toward your shins as high as you can.
Lower slowly to the floor.
Keep the movement smooth and repeat.

exercises.n: Y a T a W boca abajo acostado
exercises.en: lying prone y to t to w
exercises.d: A prone sequence of arm positions that strengthens the upper back and shoulder blade muscles.
i: Lie face down with your forehead near the floor and arms extended overhead in a Y.
Lift your arms slightly and hold.
Move them out to a T, then bend the elbows into a W.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Reverse the order and repeat.

exercises.n: apretón de codos en la espalda media
exercises.d: A simple drill that squeezes the elbows back to engage the mid back. It trains the muscles between the shoulder blades.
i: Stand or sit tall with your hands by your head or elbows bent in front.
Pull your elbows back and down.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Hold for a second at the end.
Return slowly to the start.
Keep your neck relaxed.

exercises.n: curl de piernas sentado en máquina (con discos)
exercises.d: A plate-loaded seated curl that isolates the hamstrings.
i: Sit in the machine and adjust the pad above your ankles.
Keep your back against the support.
Curl your heels down and back as far as you can.
Squeeze your hamstrings briefly.
Return slowly without letting the weight crash.

exercises.n: sentadilla sumo con banda elástica
exercises.d: A wide-stance squat with a band adding resistance to the glutes and inner thighs.
i: Stand on the band with feet wider than shoulders and toes angled out.
Hold the band at your chest or shoulders.
Sit down between your legs, keeping your chest up.
Push your knees out over your toes.
Drive up through your heels and squeeze your glutes.

exercises.n: plancha china
exercises.d: A plank variation held with a modified base that challenges core stability.
i: Set up in a plank on your forearms with elbows under shoulders.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs.
Keep your body in one straight line.
Breathe steadily and hold for 20-40 seconds.
Lower down to rest.

exercises.n: eversión de pie sentado con banda elástica
exercises.d: A seated ankle drill that works the muscles on the outside of the lower leg.
i: Sit with one leg extended and loop the band around the forefoot, anchored on the inside.
Keep your leg still.
Turn your foot outward against the band.
Return slowly.
Finish the reps, then switch feet.

exercises.n: inversión de pie sentado con banda elástica
exercises.d: A seated ankle drill that works the muscles on the inside of the lower leg.
i: Sit with one leg extended and loop the band around the forefoot, anchored on the outside.
Keep your leg still.
Turn your foot inward against the band.
Return slowly.
Finish the reps, then switch feet.

exercises.n: curl predicador con balanceo y mancuernas
exercises.d: A preacher curl with a little controlled swing to push past the sticking point.
i: Rest your upper arms on a preacher pad and hold dumbbells with an underhand grip.
Keep your shoulders down.
Curl the weights up with a small drive from the bottom.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are almost straight.

exercises.n: extensión horizontal de tríceps a un brazo de pie en polea
exercises.en: cable standing single arm horizontal triceps extension
exercises.d: A one-arm cable pushdown in a horizontal path, isolating the triceps.
i: Set the cable at chest height and stand facing away holding the handle by your shoulder.
Take a split stance for balance.
Extend your arm forward until it is straight.
Return slowly while keeping the elbow still.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: estiramiento dinámico alterno de pecho sentado en silla
exercises.en: seated alternate dynamic chest stretch on a chair
exercises.d: A seated dynamic stretch that opens the chest by alternating arms.
i: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Open one arm out to the side and rotate the trunk slightly.
Feel the stretch across your chest.
Return and switch arms in a smooth rhythm.

exercises.n: apertura de pecho con codos sentado en silla
exercises.en: seated elbow chest fly on a chair
exercises.d: A seated chest fly with bent elbows that squeezes the pecs by pressing the arms together.
i: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Raise your elbows to chest height with forearms up.
Squeeze your elbows together in front of you.
Open them out again under control.
Keep your shoulders away from your ears.

exercises.n: rotación externa sentado en silla
exercises.en: seated external rotation on a chair
exercises.d: A seated rotation drill for the back of the shoulders and rotator cuff.
i: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Tuck your elbows at your sides bent to 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearms outward, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Return slowly and repeat.

exercises.n: press de pecho sentado en silla
exercises.en: seated chest press on a chair
exercises.d: A seated pressing motion done with bodyweight tension to work the chest and triceps.
i: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Bring your hands to chest height and press your palms together.
Press forward until your arms are straight.
Draw them back to your chest slowly.

exercises.n: cruce de brazos sentado en silla
exercises.en: seated arm crossover on a chair
exercises.d: A seated arm crossover that works the chest and warms up the shoulders.
i: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Open your arms wide to the sides at shoulder height.
Sweep them together so they cross in front of your chest.
Open back out and alternate which arm is on top.

exercises.n: press de pecho declinado sentado en silla
exercises.en: seated decline chest press on a chair
exercises.d: A seated press angled downward to bias the lower chest.
i: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Start with your hands at chest height.
Press them diagonally down and forward until your arms are straight.
Return slowly to the chest and repeat.

exercises.n: pec deck sentado en silla
exercises.en: seated pec dec on a chair
exercises.d: A seated pec dec motion without a machine, squeezing the chest by bringing the forearms together.
i: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Raise your forearms in front of you with elbows bent at shoulder height.
Squeeze your forearms together.
Open them back to the sides under control.

exercises.n: press de pecho inclinado sentado en silla
exercises.en: seated incline chest press on a chair
exercises.d: A seated press angled upward to emphasise the upper chest.
i: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Start with your hands near your chest.
Press them diagonally up and forward until your arms are straight.
Lower back to the chest slowly.

exercises.n: press de hombros sentado en silla
exercises.en: seated shoulder press on a chair
exercises.d: A seated overhead press without equipment that trains the shoulders and triceps.
i: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Raise your hands to shoulder height with elbows bent.
Press them overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower back to your shoulders under control.

exercises.n: giros de boxeo sentado en silla
exercises.en: seated rotating boxing rolls on a chair
exercises.d: A seated drill of circular arm rolls and trunk rotation that lifts your heart rate.
i: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Raise your fists in a boxing guard.
Roll your arms in circles while rotating your trunk side to side.
Keep a quick, rhythmic pace.

exercises.n: toque de hombro sentado en silla
exercises.en: seated shoulder tap on a chair
exercises.d: A seated drill where you tap each shoulder with the opposite hand, adding light coordination and shoulder work.
i: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Reach one hand across to tap the opposite shoulder.
Return and tap with the other hand.
Keep the pace steady.

exercises.n: balanceo abierto y por debajo sentado en silla
exercises.en: seated open up and under swing on a chair
exercises.d: A seated swing that opens the chest and then sweeps the arms underneath, warming up the trunk and shoulders.
i: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Swing both arms open to the sides.
Rotate and sweep them under and across your body.
Open back out and alternate directions with a smooth rhythm.

exercises.n: extensión de tríceps sobre la cabeza sentado en silla
exercises.en: seated overhead triceps extension on a chair
exercises.d: A seated overhead extension that works the triceps using your own arm resistance.
i: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Raise your arms overhead and bend your elbows so your hands drop behind your head.
Extend your arms back up until straight.
Lower slowly and keep your elbows pointing forward.

exercises.n: círculos de brazos con agarre inverso sentado en silla
exercises.en: seated underhand arm circle on a chair
exercises.d: A seated arm circle with palms up to warm up the shoulder joints.
i: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Extend your arms out to the sides with palms facing up.
Draw small circles, then gradually bigger.
Reverse the direction after a set.

exercises.n: prensa lateral de piernas en trineo
exercises.d: A sideways leg press on a sled that targets the glutes and outer hips.
i: Position yourself on the sled in a side-facing posture with one foot on the platform.
Brace your core and keep your hips stable.
Push the platform away with the working leg.
Return slowly under control.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: elevación en Y inclinado con apoyo de espalda en polea
exercises.en: cable incline y raise with back support
exercises.d: A Y-shaped raise with cables while supported on an incline bench, working the shoulders and upper back.
i: Lie chest-down on an incline bench with a cable handle in each hand.
Keep your neck neutral.
Raise your arms forward and up in a Y shape.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly with straight arms.

exercises.n: press de hombros inclinado con agarre cerrado y barra V en polea
exercises.en: cable incline close grip shoulder press with v bar
exercises.d: A close-grip incline cable press using a V bar that trains the shoulders and triceps.
i: Sit on an incline bench with a cable and V bar anchored low behind you.
Hold the bar at chest height with a narrow grip.
Press upward until your arms are straight.
Lower back to the chest slowly.
Keep your back against the pad.

exercises.n: elevación en Y inclinado con correas de muñeca y apoyo de espalda en polea
exercises.en: cable incline y raise wrist straps with back support
exercises.d: A cable Y raise using wrist straps to reduce grip demand, supported on an incline bench.
i: Fasten the wrist straps to the cables and lie chest-down on an incline bench.
Keep your neck neutral.
Raise your arms forward and up into a Y shape.
Squeeze your shoulders at the top.
Lower slowly.

exercises.n: zancada de reverencia con mancuernas v. 2
exercises.d: A lunge where one leg crosses behind you, working the glutes and outer hips with added load.
i: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides.
Step one foot back and across behind the other leg.
Lower until the front thigh is nearly parallel to the floor.
Push through the front foot to stand.
Alternate legs or finish one side before switching.

exercises.n: zancada caminando con bolsa con peso
exercises.d: A walking lunge carrying a weighted bag, building the legs, glutes and core.
i: Hold the bag at your chest or on your shoulders.
Stand tall.
Step forward and lower until both knees are about 90 degrees.
Push through the front foot and bring the back leg forward.
Continue, alternating legs.

exercises.n: empuje de torque tank
exercises.d: A hard push of a torque tank sled across the floor that fires up the legs and the heart.
i: Grip the handles of the tank and lean forward.
Keep your back flat and core tight.
Drive with short, powerful steps.
Keep your hips low and push over the distance.
Rest and repeat.

exercises.n: jalón con cuerda de batalla
exercises.d: A rope pull that brings the rope toward you, working the back, arms and grip with a conditioning effect.
i: Anchor the rope and hold the ends in a staggered stance.
Lean back slightly with your core tight.
Pull the rope toward you hand over hand.
Keep your chest tall and drive with your legs.
Return smoothly and repeat.

exercises.n: burpee con salto al cajón
exercises.d: A burpee that finishes with a jump onto a box, great for full-body conditioning.
i: Stand facing a box.
Drop into a squat, kick your feet back and lower into a push-up.
Jump your feet back in.
Explode up and jump onto the box.
Step down carefully and repeat.

exercises.n: peso muerto rumano en máquina (con discos)
exercises.d: A hip hinge on a plate-loaded machine that trains the hamstrings and glutes.
i: Stand in the machine and grip the handles with a flat back.
Keep a soft bend in your knees.
Hinge at the hips, pushing them back as you lower.
Stop when you feel the hamstrings stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand.

exercises.n: extensión alterna de rodilla sentado en silla
exercises.en: seated alternate knee extension on chair
exercises.d: A seated leg extension done by alternating legs, working the thighs without equipment.
i: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Straighten one knee by lifting the foot until the leg is level.
Squeeze your thigh, then lower slowly.
Switch legs and keep alternating.

exercises.n: pullover en anillas
exercises.d: An advanced ring move that sweeps the body over the rings, working the lats and core.
i: Hang from the rings with an overhand grip.
Pull your hips up and bring your knees to your chest.
Rotate backward, pulling the body over the rings.
Lower under control.
Keep the movement smooth.

exercises.n: sentadilla dividida con elevación de talón
exercises.d: A split squat with a heel raise added at the top. It works the quads, glutes and calves together.
i: Stand in a split stance with one foot well forward.
Lower into a split squat with an upright torso.
Push up through your front foot to stand.
Rise onto the toes of your back foot or both feet.
Lower your heel and repeat.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: remo seal acostado con barra en rack
exercises.en: barbell lying seal row on rack
exercises.d: A chest-supported barbell row lying on a raised bench or rack, removing the lower back from the lift.
i: Lie face down on a raised bench so the bar hangs below you.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulders.
Row the bar up toward your chest by pulling elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly.

exercises.n: peso muerto a una pierna en máquina hack squat
exercises.en: leverage single leg deadlift on hack squat machine
exercises.d: A single leg deadlift performed on a hack squat machine. It trains the glutes and hamstrings with extra stability.
i: Step onto the machine platform and set your back against the pad.
Place one foot on the platform and lift the other slightly.
Hinge at the hip and lower with control.
Drive through the standing foot to come back up.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Do your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: peso muerto rumano con postura escalonada en smith
exercises.d: A Romanian deadlift in a staggered stance on the smith machine. It focuses on the hamstrings and glutes of the front leg.
i: Stand under the smith bar with one foot slightly behind the other.
Grip the bar and unrack it.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back and the bar close to your legs.
Lower until you feel a stretch in the hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Switch which foot is forward after your set.

exercises.n: elevación lateral de pie en máquina
exercises.d: A standing machine lateral raise that isolates the side shoulders.
i: Stand in the machine with pads against your arms.
Keep your torso upright.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.

exercises.n: elevación de rodilla acostado con mancuerna y peso
exercises.d: A lying knee raise holding a dumbbell between your feet or legs, challenging the lower abs.
i: Lie on your back with a dumbbell secured between your feet.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
Bring your knees toward your chest.
Lower your feet slowly without touching the floor.
Repeat for controlled reps.

exercises.n: paso rápido con banda elástica
exercises.d: A quick lateral stepping drill with a band around the legs to speed up the feet and fire the glutes.
i: Place a band around your thighs or ankles.
Stand in a quarter squat.
Take quick small steps to the side.
Keep tension on the band and your chest up.
Move in both directions.

exercises.n: flexión de cadera a una pierna acostado en polea
exercises.en: cable lying single leg hip flexion
exercises.d: Lying on your back with a cable strapped to one ankle, you pull the knee toward your chest. It builds hip flexor strength.
i: Lie on your back with the ankle strap attached to the low cable and one foot in it.
Brace your core and press your lower back into the floor.
Pull the knee up toward your chest with control.
Pause briefly, then lower the leg slowly against the cable.
Keep the other leg relaxed and your hips still.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: flexión de cadera acostado en polea (sentadilla inversa)
exercises.d: Lying on your back, you pull both knees toward your chest against cable resistance, like a squat in reverse. It works the hip flexors and lower abs.
i: Lie on your back with the cable attached to both ankles or a strap around your feet.
Start with your legs extended and your core braced.
Pull your knees toward your chest in a smooth curl.
Pause at the top without lifting your head.
Lower your legs slowly until they are almost straight.
Keep your lower back flat on the floor throughout.

exercises.n: extensión de dedos con banda elástica
exercises.d: Opening your fingers against a band strengthens the small extensor muscles of the hand and forearm. It is a good balance for all the gripping you do.
i: Loop a light band around your fingers and thumb of one hand.
Rest your forearm on a table or your thigh.
Start with the fingers curled in a relaxed fist.
Spread your fingers open against the band's pull.
Close them back slowly with control.
Do all reps, then switch hands.

exercises.n: apertura invertida a 45 grados en polea
exercises.d: Hinged forward at about 45 degrees, you pull the cable handles apart in a wide arc. It targets the rear shoulders and upper back.
i: Set two cable handles at a low or mid height and grab them crossed over.
Hinge forward at the hips to about 45 degrees with a flat back.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Pull the handles out and back in a wide arc until your arms are in line with your torso.
Squeeze your shoulder blades gently at the end.
Return slowly and keep your torso still.

exercises.n: press con rotación externa en media rodilla en polea
exercises.en: cable half kneeling external rotation press
exercises.d: From a half kneeling stance you rotate the arm outward and press the cable overhead. It trains shoulder stability along with the press.
i: Kneel on one knee side-on to the cable with the handle at chest height.
Hold the handle near your shoulder with your elbow bent.
Brace your core and keep your hips square.
Rotate your forearm outward, then press the handle overhead.
Return along the same path with control.
Finish your reps and switch sides.

exercises.n: jab de pie en polea
exercises.d: A quick punch thrown against cable resistance builds fast, explosive pushing power. It also trains the trunk to resist twisting.
i: Stand facing away from the cable with the handle at chest height in one hand.
Take a staggered stance and keep your core tight.
Punch the handle forward quickly, rotating your hips a little.
Stop just before your elbow locks out.
Return the hand with control to your chin.
Do all reps, then switch arms.

exercises.n: pronación de antebrazo en polea
exercises.d: You rotate the forearm so the palm turns down against cable resistance. It strengthens the pronator muscles of the forearm.
i: Sit beside a low cable and hold the handle with your forearm resting on your thigh.
Start with your palm facing up and your wrist neutral.
Rotate your forearm so the palm turns down.
Pause, then rotate back slowly against the cable.
Keep your elbow still and move only the forearm.
Complete your reps and switch arms.

exercises.n: enrollador de muñeca neutro
exercises.d: You wind a rope with a weight on it by turning a bar with a neutral grip. It builds forearm and grip endurance.
i: Hold the wrist roller with a neutral, thumbs-up grip and your arms out in front.
Let the weight hang from the rope with the rope unwound.
Roll the bar with your wrists to wind the rope up.
Keep your arms steady and your shoulders relaxed.
When the weight reaches the bar, lower it slowly by unwinding.
Stop if your forearms burn too much to keep control.

exercises.n: buenos días con bolsa con peso
exercises.d: Hinging forward with a weighted bag on your back trains the hamstrings, glutes and lower back. It teaches a strong hip hinge.
i: Place the weighted bag across your upper back and hold it in place.
Stand with your feet hip width and your knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and lower your torso with a flat back.
Go down until you feel a stretch in the hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall again.
Keep your neck neutral all the way.

exercises.n: peso muerto con postura escalonada y kettlebell
exercises.d: A deadlift with a staggered stance holding a kettlebell. It loads one leg more than the other.
i: Stand with one foot slightly behind the other.
Hold a kettlebell in front of your thighs.
Hinge at the hips and lower the bell toward the floor.
Keep your back flat and weight mostly on the front foot.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Switch stances after your set.

exercises.n: flexión con rodillas al pecho
exercises.d: A push-up with a knee tuck toward the chest at the top. It combines upper body pressing with an ab crunch.
i: Start in a push-up position with a straight body.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up.
Pull one knee toward your chest.
Return the leg and repeat on the other side.
Keep your hips level.

exercises.n: aducción escapular en extensión de espalda a 45 grados
exercises.d: On a 45 degree bench you lift your torso and pull your shoulder blades together. It works the lower back and upper back at once.
i: Set up on the 45 degree bench with your hips on the pad and your feet locked in.
Cross your arms or hold them out wide.
Raise your torso until your body forms a straight line.
At the top, pull your shoulder blades together.
Lower back down slowly without rounding.
Do not overarch at the top.

exercises.n: aducción escapular en extensión de espalda inclinado
exercises.en: bent over back extension scapular adduction
exercises.d: From a bent over position you raise your torso and squeeze the shoulder blades together. It strengthens the whole back chain.
i: Stand and hinge forward with a flat back and your arms hanging.
Keep your knees softly bent.
Raise your torso toward upright.
At the top, pull your shoulder blades together.
Lower back to the bent over position slowly.
Keep your neck in line with your spine.

exercises.n: elevación en Y de pie en polea v. 2
exercises.d: Raising the arms in a Y shape against cable tension works the lower traps and shoulders. It supports healthy overhead movement.
i: Stand facing the low cable with a handle in each hand or one handle at a time.
Start with your arms low and a slight bend in your elbows.
Lift your arms up and out to form a Y shape.
Keep your thumbs pointing up and your ribs down.
Lower slowly back to the start.
Avoid shrugging toward your ears.

exercises.n: jab de pie en polea v. 2
exercises.d: A second variation of the cable punch, built for quick power in the pushing muscles. Your trunk works to stay stable.
i: Stand facing away from the cable and hold the handle at chest height.
Step into a staggered stance and brace your core.
Punch forward fast and rotate your torso slightly.
Stop short of locking out your elbow.
Pull the hand back under control.
Repeat, then switch arms.

exercises.n: elevación lateral a un brazo en polea v. 2
exercises.en: cable single arm lateral raise v. 2
exercises.d: Lifting one arm out to the side against a cable keeps constant tension on the side delt. It builds shoulder width.
i: Stand side-on to the low cable and hold the handle with the far hand.
Keep a slight bend in your elbow.
Raise your arm out to the side up to shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly against the cable.
Avoid leaning or swinging, then switch arms.

exercises.n: salto de lado a lado v. 2
exercises.d: You hop from one side to the other over an imaginary line. It builds lateral agility, leg power and conditioning.
i: Stand on two feet with your knees slightly bent.
Hop sideways to one side, landing softly on the balls of your feet.
Immediately hop back to the other side.
Keep your chest up and your hips low.
Use your arms for balance and rhythm.
Go for a set time or a set number of reps.

exercises.n: elevación de una pierna sentado
exercises.d: Seated on a bench or floor, you lift one straight leg to train the hip flexors and thigh. It is a simple core and leg exercise.
i: Sit tall on the edge of a bench with your hands beside you.
Extend one leg straight out in front.
Lift the leg a few inches higher while keeping the knee straight.
Pause and lower it slowly.
Keep your back straight and your core tight.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: deslizamiento de sentadilla con talones en la pared
exercises.d: Sliding down a wall into a squat with your heels planted teaches good squat depth and control. It trains the quads and glutes.
i: Stand with your back against a wall and your feet a little forward.
Press your heels into the floor.
Slide down the wall until your thighs are near parallel.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Press through your heels to slide back up.
Keep your back in contact with the wall.

exercises.n: estiramiento de zancada lateral v. 2
exercises.d: Sinking into a wide side lunge stretches the inner thigh and groin. A good opener before lower body work.
i: Stand with your feet wide apart and toes pointing forward.
Shift your weight to one side and bend that knee.
Keep the other leg straight with the foot flat or toes up.
Sit your hips back and feel the stretch on the inner thigh.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides and repeat.

exercises.n: zancada lateral en media rodilla
exercises.d: From a half kneeling position you shift your weight sideways to open the hips and inner thigh. It builds hip mobility.
i: Start in a half kneeling position with one knee down and the other foot forward.
Turn your front foot out to the side.
Shift your hips sideways toward the straight leg.
Keep your chest up and feel the inner thigh open.
Return to the center with control.
Do all reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: apertura posterior a un brazo sentado de lado en máquina
exercises.en: lever side seated single arm rear delt fly
exercises.d: Seated sideways on a machine, you pull one arm back in a wide arc. It isolates the rear delt.
i: Sit sideways on the machine with your chest against the pad.
Grab the handle with the outside hand.
Start with your arm in front of you and a soft bend in your elbow.
Pull the handle out and back until your arm is in line with your shoulder.
Return slowly without letting the weight stack touch down.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: extensión de espalda zercher con barra
exercises.d: Holding a barbell in the crook of your elbows, you hinge and extend the back. It loads the lower back, glutes and core.
i: Hold the barbell in the crook of your elbows against your chest.
Set up on a back extension bench with your hips on the pad.
Lower your torso with a flat back until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Raise your torso until your body is in a straight line.
Avoid hyperextending at the top.
Use a light weight and control the bar.

exercises.n: plancha bird dog
exercises.d: A plank where you extend an opposite arm and leg to challenge balance. It builds trunk stability.
i: Get into a plank on your hands or forearms with your body in a line.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Lift one arm forward and the opposite leg back.
Keep your hips level and do not twist.
Hold for a few seconds.
Return and switch sides.

exercises.n: hiperextensión inversa en balón de estabilidad
exercises.d: Lying face down over a ball, you lift your legs behind you to work the glutes and lower back.
i: Lie face down over the ball with your hands on the floor.
Let your legs hang down with your toes light on the floor.
Squeeze your glutes and raise both legs until they are in line with your body.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly without swinging.
Keep your hands planted and your core tight.

exercises.n: abdominal con balón medicinal en balón de estabilidad
exercises.en: medicine ball crunch on stability ball
exercises.d: Crunching on a stability ball while holding a medicine ball adds range and load to the abs.
i: Sit on the ball and roll down until your lower back is supported.
Hold the medicine ball against your chest or overhead.
Brace your core and crunch your ribs toward your hips.
Pause at the top.
Lower back over the ball with control.
Keep your feet firmly on the floor.

exercises.n: abdominal de tijeras acostado
exercises.d: Lying on your back, you crunch up while scissoring your legs. It works the upper and lower abs together.
i: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head.
Lift your shoulders and your legs slightly off the floor.
Scissor your legs up and down in alternating motion.
Crunch your ribs toward your hips.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
Continue for a set count of reps.

exercises.n: leñador sentado en balón de estabilidad
exercises.d: Seated on a ball, you chop diagonally across your body. It trains the obliques and trunk control.
i: Sit tall on the ball with your feet wide.
Hold the weight or handle high on one side.
Rotate and chop diagonally down to the opposite hip.
Keep your arms mostly straight and your hips steady.
Return along the same path.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: sprint contra la pared
exercises.d: Leaning into a wall, you drive your knees in a fast running pattern. It practises sprint posture and builds speed.
i: Place your hands on a wall and lean forward with a straight body line.
Brace your core.
Drive one knee up while the other leg stays extended.
Switch legs quickly in a running rhythm.
Keep your hips level.
Go hard for 10-20 seconds, then rest.

exercises.n: sentadilla dividida con pierna delantera elevada en smith
exercises.en: smith front leg elevated split squat
exercises.d: With the front foot raised on a step and the bar on your back, you sink into a deep split squat. It loads the quads and glutes.
i: Set a low platform under the smith bar and put your front foot on it.
Place the bar across your upper back and unrack it.
Step the back foot behind you.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Press through the front heel to stand.
Do all reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: sentadilla dividida elevada en smith
exercises.d: A split squat with the rear foot raised on a bench, done on a smith machine. It targets the quads and glutes with extra stability.
i: Place a bench behind the smith machine and rest your back foot on it.
Position the bar on your upper back and unrack it.
Step the front foot forward.
Lower your hips until the front thigh is near parallel.
Drive up through the front foot.
Complete the reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: isométrico de front lever agrupado colgado
exercises.d: Hanging from a bar, you hold your body horizontal with your knees tucked. It builds lats and core strength.
i: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip.
Pull your shoulder blades down and tuck your knees to your chest.
Lean back and raise your hips until your back is horizontal.
Keep your arms straight.
Hold for 5-15 seconds.
Lower back down with control.

exercises.n: isométrico de front lever agrupado avanzado colgado
exercises.en: hanging advanced tucked front lever hold
exercises.d: A harder front lever hold with the knees tucked but the hips open. It demands strong lats and core.
i: Hang from a pull-up bar with straight arms.
Lift your body to horizontal in a tucked position.
Open your hips slightly so your back is flat.
Keep your shoulder blades pulled down.
Hold for 5-10 seconds.
Lower down slowly.

exercises.n: isométrico de front lever colgado
exercises.d: The full front lever: a straight horizontal body hold under a bar. It is an advanced test of back and core strength.
i: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip.
Pull your shoulder blades down and tighten your core.
Raise your whole body to horizontal with your legs straight.
Keep your arms locked and your body in one line.
Hold for as long as you can with good form.
Lower down slowly.

exercises.n: curl de pierna con cadera recta en balón de estabilidad
exercises.en: straight hip single leg curl on stability ball
exercises.d: With your heels on a ball and hips lifted, you curl it in with one leg. It hits the hamstrings and glutes hard.
i: Lie on your back with one heel on the ball and the other leg raised.
Lift your hips so your body forms a line.
Curl the ball toward your glutes with the one leg.
Keep your hips high.
Extend the leg slowly back out.
Finish the reps and switch legs.

exercises.n: escalador con patada cruzada
exercises.d: A mountain climber variation where you bring each knee across toward the opposite elbow. It raises your heart rate and works the obliques.
i: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders.
Brace your core.
Drive one knee across your body toward the opposite elbow.
Return the foot and switch legs quickly.
Keep your hips low and level.
Keep up a steady pace for a set time.

exercises.n: elevación de cadera inclinada
exercises.d: Lying on an incline bench, you lift your hips off the pad by curling the pelvis. It targets the lower abs.
i: Lie on an incline bench and hold the top edge behind your head.
Bring your legs up so your knees are over your hips.
Curl your pelvis up to lift your hips off the bench.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly without swinging.
Keep the movement small and controlled.

exercises.n: salto a una pierna en 4 direcciones
exercises.d: Hopping on one leg forward, back and side to side trains balance, ankle stability and power.
i: Stand on one leg with a soft knee.
Hop forward and land softly.
Hop back to the start, then hop to each side.
Hold each landing for a moment.
Keep your chest up and your knee over your foot.
Repeat the pattern, then switch legs.

exercises.n: caída desde cajón con aterrizaje a dos pies
exercises.d: You step off a box and land on both feet to practise soft landings. It builds impact control.
i: Stand at the edge of a low box.
Step off without jumping.
Land on both feet at the same time.
Bend your hips and knees to absorb the impact.
Hold the landing for a second.
Step back up and repeat.

exercises.n: salto pogo a dos pies
exercises.d: Small, quick hops off the balls of both feet. It builds calf and ankle stiffness and bounce.
i: Stand tall with your knees nearly straight.
Hop off the balls of your feet.
Keep your heels off the ground.
Bounce quickly with minimal knee bend.
Stay light and quiet on landing.
Go for a set time or number of hops.

exercises.n: movilización de hombro en extensión de pie con palo
exercises.en: stick standing shoulder mobilization in extension
exercises.d: Holding a stick behind your back, you lift it away to open the front of the shoulders. It improves shoulder extension.
i: Stand tall holding a stick behind your back with an overhand grip.
Keep your arms straight.
Lift the stick back and away from your body.
Stay tall and avoid leaning forward.
Hold for a moment.
Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.n: movilización de hombro en rotación externa de pie con palo
exercises.en: stick standing shoulder mobilization in external rotation
exercises.d: Using a stick to guide the arm, you rotate the shoulder outward. It improves external rotation range.
i: Stand holding a stick with both hands, elbows tucked at your sides and bent.
Push the stick with the stronger hand to rotate the other arm outward.
Keep your elbow glued to your side.
Move only as far as is comfortable.
Return to the start slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

exercises.n: movilización de hombro en abducción con palo
exercises.d: Using a stick, you guide one arm out and up to the side. It opens up shoulder range overhead.
i: Hold a stick with both hands in front of you.
Keep one arm relaxed and guide it with the other.
Raise the stick sideways and up.
Keep your torso upright.
Pause at the top.
Lower and switch sides.

exercises.n: flexión alterna de hombro de pie con cuerda
exercises.en: standing alternating shoulder flexion with rope
exercises.d: A standing drill that lifts one arm at a time in front of you while holding a rope. It warms the shoulders and improves control.
i: Stand tall holding a rope in one hand at your side.
Raise your arm forward to shoulder height or above.
Hold briefly at the top.
Lower it slowly.
Alternate arms each rep.
Keep your ribs down and shoulders relaxed.

exercises.n: elevación frontal de pie con palo
exercises.d: Raising a stick in front of you with straight arms warms up the shoulders. It is a light, controlled drill.
i: Stand tall holding a stick at your thighs with an overhand grip.
Keep your arms straight.
Raise the stick in front of you to shoulder height or above.
Keep your ribs down and your core tight.
Lower slowly to the start.
Repeat for smooth reps.

exercises.n: press con brazos rectos acostado en el suelo con mancuernas
exercises.en: dumbbell lying straight arm press on floor
exercises.d: A floor press with the arms kept straight. It trains the chest and shoulders without a big range of motion.
i: Lie on the floor with a dumbbell in each hand above your chest.
Keep your arms straight and your wrists strong.
Lower your arms slightly and then press back up.
Squeeze your chest at the top.
Keep your feet planted and core tight.
Control the weights through each rep.

exercises.n: rotación torácica con postura abierta
exercises.d: In a wide stance you rotate your upper back to loosen the thoracic spine. It helps with trunk twisting.
i: Stand with your feet wide and your knees slightly bent.
Hinge slightly forward with your hands behind your head.
Rotate your chest to one side as far as you can.
Keep your hips facing forward.
Return to the center.
Rotate to the other side and repeat.

exercises.n: desplazamiento adelante y atrás
exercises.d: Quick shuffling steps forward and back build footwork and conditioning. It keeps your heart rate up.
i: Stand in an athletic stance with soft knees.
Shuffle forward a few steps on the balls of your feet.
Shuffle back to the start without crossing your feet.
Keep your hips low and your chest up.
Move quickly but stay balanced.
Repeat for a set time.

exercises.n: elevación de tibial sentado en el suelo
exercises.d: Sitting on the floor, you pull your toes toward your shins to work the muscles at the front of the lower leg.
i: Sit on the floor with your legs straight and your hands behind you.
Keep your heels on the floor.
Pull your toes up toward your shins.
Hold for a moment.
Lower the toes slowly.
Repeat for the set.

exercises.n: jalón al pecho abierto con agarre neutro en polea v. 3
exercises.en: cable neutral grip wide pulldown v. 3
exercises.d: A wide, neutral grip pulldown on a cable machine that builds the lats and upper back.
i: Sit at the pulldown station with your thighs under the pads.
Grab the wide neutral grip handles.
Lean back slightly and keep your chest up.
Pull the handles down toward your upper chest.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom.
Let the handles rise slowly with control.

exercises.n: elevación de gemelos de pie con isométrico
exercises.d: A standing calf raise held at the top. It builds calf endurance.
i: Stand tall with your feet hip width apart.
Rise onto the balls of your feet.
Hold the top position for 20 to 30 seconds.
Keep your ankles straight and stable.
Lower your heels slowly.
Rest briefly between holds.

exercises.n: flexión con agarre abierto e isométrico
exercises.en: isometric hold wide hand push up
exercises.d: A wide-grip push-up held halfway down. It builds chest strength under tension.
i: Start in a push-up position with hands wider than your shoulders.
Lower your chest until your elbows are bent.
Hold this position for 10 to 20 seconds.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Press back up to the start.
Rest and repeat.

exercises.n: flexión inclinada en barra alta
exercises.d: With your hands on a high bar, you do an easier incline push up. A great stepping stone toward floor push ups.
i: Set a bar at about waist or chest height.
Place your hands on it slightly wider than your shoulders.
Walk your feet back so your body is in a straight line.
Lower your chest to the bar.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your core and glutes tight.

exercises.n: rodillo abdominal inverso con isométrico en anillas
exercises.en: ring isometric hold reverse ab rollout
exercises.d: Holding a reverse rollout position on rings challenges the abs and shoulders. A tough anti-extension hold.
i: Hang or set yourself up with the rings under your forearms.
Brace your core and tuck your pelvis.
Move into the rollout position and stop.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Hold for 10-20 seconds.
Return slowly.

exercises.n: extensión de cadera a 45 grados con énfasis en glúteo v. 2
exercises.en: 45 degree hip extension glute focused v. 2
exercises.d: A hip extension on a 45 degree bench that emphasises the glutes. It strengthens the posterior chain.
i: Set the pad at hip height and lock your heels in.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Hinge forward at the hips with a straight back.
Drive your hips forward and squeeze your glutes.
Stop when your body is in a straight line.
Lower slowly each rep.

exercises.n: sentadilla dividida elevada
exercises.d: A split squat with the rear foot on a bench builds leg strength and balance, one leg at a time.
i: Stand a stride length in front of a bench and rest your back foot on it.
Keep your torso upright.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front knee over your foot.
Drive through the front heel to stand.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: flexión pike elevada desde déficit en anillas
exercises.en: ring elevated pike push up from deficit
exercises.d: A pike push up with feet elevated and hands on rings, so you go deeper. It builds strong overhead pressing.
i: Set the rings low and put your hands on them with your feet on a box.
Raise your hips into a pike shape.
Lower your head between the rings.
Keep the rings steady and close to your body.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your core tight.

exercises.n: dominada isométrica sentado
exercises.d: Holding the top of a pull up while seated helps you build pulling strength. It works the lats and arms.
i: Set up a bar so you can sit under it.
Grab the bar with an overhand grip.
Pull yourself up until your chin is above the bar.
Hold the top position.
Hold for 5-10 seconds.
Lower down slowly.

exercises.n: dragon flag negativo acostado en el suelo
exercises.d: Lying on the floor, you lower your straight body slowly for the dragon flag. A tough ab and core strengthener.
i: Lie on a mat and hold something fixed behind your head.
Raise your body into a straight line on your upper back.
Brace your core.
Lower your body slowly keeping it straight.
Stop just above the floor.
Bring your legs back up and reset.

exercises.n: medio dragon flag negativo acostado en el suelo
exercises.en: lying floor negative half dragon flag
exercises.d: A gentler dragon flag lowering with your knees bent. It builds the strength needed for the full move.
i: Lie on a mat and hold something fixed behind your head.
Lift your hips and tuck your knees.
Brace your core.
Lower your body slowly with bent knees.
Stop just above the floor.
Reset and repeat.

exercises.n: dominada supina con agarre cerrado e isométrico
exercises.en: isometric hold close grip chin up
exercises.d: A close grip chin-up held at the top or halfway. It builds pulling strength and grip.
i: Grip the bar with palms facing you and hands close together.
Pull yourself up until your chin is over the bar.
Hold for 5 to 15 seconds.
Keep your shoulders down and core tight.
Lower slowly under control.
Rest and repeat.

exercises.n: patada de aleteo horizontal acostado en el suelo
exercises.d: Small alternating kicks while lying down. It trains the lower abs and hip flexors.
i: Lie on your back with your legs straight and hands under your hips.
Lift your feet a few inches off the floor.
Kick your legs up and down in small alternating motions.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
Breathe steadily.
Continue for 20 to 40 seconds.

exercises.n: dragon flag negativo a una pierna acostado en el suelo
exercises.en: lying floor single leg negative dragon flag
exercises.d: A dragon flag lowering with one leg extended and one tucked. It's a step between the half and full versions.
i: Lie on a mat and hold something fixed behind your head.
Raise your body into a straight line with one leg tucked.
Extend the other leg straight.
Lower slowly while keeping your hips level.
Stop just above the floor.
Reset and switch legs.

exercises.n: sentadilla al aire con banco ancho
exercises.d: An air squat with a wide stance, touching a bench to guide your depth. It works the glutes and inner thighs.
i: Stand in front of a bench with your feet wide and toes turned out.
Push your hips back and lower down.
Lightly touch the bench.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Press through your heels to stand.
Keep your chest tall.

exercises.n: extensión de cadera de pie con palanca larga
exercises.d: Standing on one leg, you extend the straight leg behind you. It strengthens the glutes and trains balance.
i: Stand tall holding a support if needed.
Keep your leg straight.
Lift it back behind you.
Stop when your hips begin to tilt.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower it slowly and switch legs.

exercises.n: flexión con pausa isométrica
exercises.d: A push-up held in place at the top or bottom. It builds chest, arm and core strength.
i: Start in a straight-arm plank with hands under your shoulders.
Lower halfway down until your elbows are bent.
Hold the position for 10 to 20 seconds.
Keep your body straight from head to heels.
Press back up.
Rest and repeat.

exercises.n: puente de isquiotibiales a una pierna
exercises.d: A one-legged bridge with your heel planted that works the hamstrings and glutes.
i: Lie on your back with one foot flat and the other leg raised.
Press your heel into the floor.
Lift your hips until your body forms a line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: press jm en smith
exercises.d: A hybrid of a close grip bench press and skull crusher done on a smith machine. It loads the triceps.
i: Lie on a bench under the smith bar with a shoulder width grip.
Unrack the bar over your chest.
Lower the bar toward your chin or upper chest by bending your elbows.
Keep your elbows slightly in.
Press the bar back up.
Use a light weight and control the path.

exercises.n: prensa de pierna angulada a una pierna en máquina
exercises.d: Pressing with one leg on an angled leg press machine focuses the work on the quads and glutes.
i: Sit on the machine and place one foot on the platform.
Release the safety handles.
Lower the platform until your knee is bent about 90 degrees.
Press through your heel to push it back.
Do not lock your knee at the top.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: apertura de pecho de pie en máquina
exercises.d: Standing at a machine, you bring your arms together in front of your chest. It isolates the chest.
i: Stand in the machine with your hands on the handles.
Keep your elbows slightly bent.
Bring the handles together in front of your chest.
Squeeze your chest at the end.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch.
Keep your chest tall and your back still.

exercises.n: saltitos repetidos
exercises.d: Quick, low hops on the spot that keep your feet barely off the floor. They warm up the calves and ankles and build bouncy reactive strength.
i: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and arms relaxed at your sides.
Hop up a few centimetres by pushing through the balls of your feet.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and rebound straight away.
Keep your knees almost straight and your chest tall.
Continue for 20-30 seconds at a quick, steady rhythm.

exercises.n: elevación de gemelos de pie con rodilla flexionada y apoyo en silla
exercises.en: standing bent knee calf raise with a chair support
exercises.d: A calf raise with the knees slightly bent while holding a chair. It targets the deeper soleus muscle.
i: Stand behind a chair and hold it for balance.
Bend your knees slightly.
Raise your heels as high as you can.
Pause at the top.
Lower your heels slowly.
Keep your knees bent throughout.

exercises.n: elevación de gemelos de pie con rodilla flexionada desde déficit con barra
exercises.en: barbell standing bent knee calf raise from deficit
exercises.d: A standing calf raise with a bent knee and the balls of your feet on a raised edge, which shifts work toward the soleus. The deficit gives a deeper stretch at the bottom.
i: Rest a barbell across your upper back and stand with the balls of your feet on a low platform.
Soften your knees into a slight bend and keep that angle throughout.
Lower your heels below the platform until you feel a stretch in your calves.
Press up onto your toes as high as you can.
Pause briefly at the top, then lower slowly with control.

exercises.n: elevación de gemelos alternada de pie con rodilla flexionada y apoyo en silla
exercises.en: standing bent knee alternating calf raise with a chair support
exercises.d: An alternating calf raise with the knees bent, using a chair for balance. It works the soleus one side at a time.
i: Stand behind a chair and hold it with both hands.
Bend your knees slightly.
Raise one heel as high as possible.
Lower it slowly.
Raise the other heel.
Keep alternating without locking your knees.

exercises.n: mantenimiento a 15 cm del suelo acostado
exercises.d: A floor hold where you lie on your back with your legs and shoulders lifted about six inches. It trains deep abdominal tension and endurance.
i: Lie on your back with your legs straight and arms by your sides.
Press your lower back into the floor and brace your abs.
Lift your heels and shoulders about 15 cm off the floor.
Keep your lower back flat and breathe steadily.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then lower and rest.

exercises.n: peso muerto rumano a sentadilla con mancuernas
exercises.d: A combo that links a Romanian deadlift with a squat in one fluid rep. It works the hamstrings, glutes and quads together.
i: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Push your hips back and lower the weights along your legs with a flat back.
Feel the hamstring stretch, then drive your hips forward to stand.
Bend your knees and sit down into a squat with your chest up.
Stand back up and repeat the sequence.

exercises.n: peso muerto rumano a sentadilla con kettlebell
exercises.d: A Romanian deadlift flowing straight into a squat while holding a kettlebell. It trains the hips and thighs with a nice rhythm.
i: Hold a kettlebell with both hands in front of your thighs.
Hinge at the hips and slide the bell down your legs with a flat back.
Squeeze your glutes to return to standing.
Bend your knees and lower into a squat, keeping the bell close to your chest.
Stand up and repeat for the planned reps.

exercises.n: mantenimiento dish
exercises.d: A gymnastics-style hollow position on your back with arms and legs reaching away. It builds strong, braced abs.
i: Lie on your back with arms overhead and legs straight.
Press your lower back into the floor and tighten your abs.
Lift your arms, shoulders and legs a few centimetres off the floor.
Keep your body in a shallow dish shape and breathe.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then relax.

exercises.n: elevación de piernas sentado en el suelo
exercises.d: From a seated position with hands behind you, you lift your legs to train the lower abs and hip flexors.
i: Sit on the floor with your hands planted behind your hips and legs extended.
Lean back slightly and brace your abs.
Raise both legs together a short way off the floor.
Lower them slowly without letting your heels drop to the ground.
Repeat for the planned reps.

exercises.n: postura pike
exercises.d: A folded stance with hips high and head down, shifting weight over your hands. It opens the hamstrings and loads the shoulders.
i: Start on all fours and walk your feet in while lifting your hips high.
Form an upside-down V with straight arms and legs.
Press the floor away and let your head hang between your arms.
Keep your heels reaching toward the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.

exercises.n: inclinación lateral colgado
exercises.d: While hanging from a bar, you lean your body to each side to work the obliques and grip.
i: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip and legs together.
Brace your abs and keep your arms straight.
Lean your legs and hips toward one side, bending through the waist.
Return to centre under control.
Lean to the other side and alternate for the planned reps.

exercises.n: subida al cajón
exercises.d: A simple step onto a box that trains the thighs and glutes one leg at a time.
i: Stand facing a sturdy box or bench at a comfortable height.
Place one foot fully on the box.
Press through that heel and stand up on the box.
Step back down with control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: elevación lateral a un brazo acostado de lado en polea
exercises.en: cable side lying single arm lateral raise
exercises.d: Lying on your side, you raise a cable handle out and up to isolate the side delts with constant tension.
i: Set a low pulley and lie on your side with the handle in your top hand.
Keep your arm straight or slightly bent.
Raise the handle in an arc up to about shoulder height or a bit higher.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.n: remo al mentón acostado en polea (barra sz)
exercises.d: An upright row done lying on your back with a cambered bar on a low cable. It hits the delts and traps with steady tension.
i: Lie on your back with your feet toward a low pulley and grip the SZ bar.
Start with arms extended over your thighs.
Pull the bar up toward your chin, leading with your elbows.
Pause when your elbows reach shoulder height.
Lower the bar slowly to the start.

exercises.n: sentadilla sumo con cinturón en máquina
exercises.d: A wide-stance squat on a belt squat machine where the load hangs from your hips, sparing your spine. It works the glutes and inner thighs.
i: Attach the belt around your hips and stand with a wide stance, toes out.
Keep your chest tall and brace your core.
Bend your knees and sit down between your legs.
Lower until your thighs are about parallel.
Drive through your feet to stand up.

exercises.n: peso muerto rumano con cinturón en máquina
exercises.d: A hip hinge using a belt machine so the weight hangs from your hips. It trains the hamstrings and glutes without loading the back.
i: Wear the belt and stand tall with soft knees.
Push your hips back and lower your torso with a flat back.
Stop when you feel a stretch in the hamstrings.
Squeeze your glutes and drive your hips forward to stand.
Repeat with smooth control.

exercises.n: remo para deltoide posterior con suspensión
exercises.d: A suspension-strap row with wide elbows that targets the rear delts and upper back.
i: Hold the handles and lean back with arms straight and body in a line.
Brace your core and glutes.
Pull your hands toward your chest with elbows flared out wide.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight again.

exercises.n: elevación de puntas sentado en máquina
exercises.d: A seated machine raise where your knees stay bent, which emphasises the soleus under the calf.
i: Sit at the machine with the pads over your thighs and balls of your feet on the platform.
Lower your heels for a calf stretch.
Press up onto your toes as high as you can.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.n: dominadas asistidas por compañero
exercises.d: A pull-up where a partner supports your legs or hips. It lets you build pulling strength while you work toward full reps.
i: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip.
Have your partner hold your legs or hips.
Pull your chest toward the bar.
Pause at the top.
Lower yourself slowly.
Ask your partner to give just enough help.

exercises.n: dominadas asistidas con cajón
exercises.d: A pull-up with your feet on a box for light assistance. It helps you build up to full pull-ups.
i: Place a box under a pull-up bar.
Grip the bar and rest one or both feet on the box.
Pull up until your chin clears the bar.
Use your legs as little as possible.
Lower slowly.
Keep your core tight.

exercises.n: dominadas asistidas con cajón a una pierna
exercises.en: box single leg assisted pull up
exercises.d: A pull-up with only one foot on a box for assistance. It is a step closer to a full pull-up.
i: Place a box under a pull-up bar.
Grip the bar and rest one foot on the box.
Pull up until your chin clears the bar.
Push lightly with the foot on the box.
Lower slowly.
Switch the assisting leg on the next set.

exercises.n: salto con contramovimiento y balanceo de brazos
exercises.d: A vertical jump with a quick dip and an arm swing that adds momentum. It builds explosive leg power.
i: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and arms back.
Dip quickly into a quarter squat while swinging your arms down and back.
Swing your arms forward and up as you explode off the floor.
Extend fully through hips, knees and ankles.
Land softly with bent knees and reset.

exercises.n: salto con contramovimiento y manos en la cadera
exercises.d: A vertical jump with hands on your hips so the legs do all the work. It develops explosive leg power.
i: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hands on your hips.
Dip quickly into a quarter squat.
Explode upward, extending hips, knees and ankles.
Reach for maximum height without using your arms.
Land softly on bent knees and reset.

exercises.n: buenos días sentado con mancuernas
exercises.d: A seated good morning with a dumbbell held at your chest, bowing forward to train the lower back with less leg involvement.
i: Sit on a bench with feet flat and hold a dumbbell against your chest.
Sit tall and brace your core.
Hinge forward from the hips, keeping your back flat.
Stop when your torso is about halfway down.
Squeeze your back and glutes to sit tall again.

exercises.n: sentadilla con agarre de cargada y talones elevados con barra
exercises.en: barbell elevated heel clean grip squat
exercises.d: A squat with your heels raised and a clean-width grip, which keeps the torso upright and loads the quads.
i: Place your heels on small plates and hold a bar across your upper back with a clean-width grip.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Sit down into a deep squat with knees tracking over toes.
Pause at the bottom.
Drive up through your feet to stand.

exercises.n: dead bug con kettlebell y peso
exercises.d: A dead bug done while holding a kettlebell overhead, adding load to the core challenge.
i: Lie on your back holding a kettlebell above your chest with straight arms.
Raise your knees to a tabletop position.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Extend one leg out while keeping your back flat.
Return it and alternate sides.

exercises.n: dead bug con pullover de kettlebell
exercises.d: A dead bug combined with a kettlebell pullover, where arms and legs extend in opposite directions.
i: Lie on your back holding a kettlebell above your chest and knees at tabletop.
Brace your core and keep your lower back down.
Lower the kettlebell overhead while extending the opposite leg.
Return to the start under control.
Switch sides and repeat.

exercises.n: paso patrick con peso corporal
exercises.d: A step-down drill that builds knee and hip control. It strengthens the quads and glutes.
i: Stand on a low step on one leg.
Slowly bend the knee and lower the other heel to the floor.
Keep your knee tracking over your toes.
Tap the floor lightly.
Push through the standing leg to rise.
Do your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: paso patrick desde cajón con peso corporal
exercises.d: A step-down from a box that strengthens the quads and teaches knee control.
i: Stand on the edge of a step box on one leg.
Lower the other foot toward the floor.
Keep your knee in line with your toes.
Touch the floor lightly.
Push up through the standing leg.
Do your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: paso poliquin con peso corporal
exercises.d: A controlled step-up and down drill often used for knee strength. It trains the quads and glutes.
i: Stand with one foot on a low step.
Lower the other foot toward the floor with control.
Keep your knee in line with your toes.
Touch the floor lightly.
Drive back up through the working leg.
Do your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: paso poliquin desde cajón con peso corporal
exercises.d: A box step-down drill that builds knee strength and control in the quads and glutes.
i: Stand on a step box on one leg.
Lower the other foot toward the floor with control.
Keep your torso upright.
Lightly tap the floor.
Press up through your working leg.
Do your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: paso peterson desde cajón con peso corporal
exercises.d: A step-down drill with a slow, controlled lowering. It builds quad strength and knee stability.
i: Stand on a step box on one leg.
Lower the other foot slowly toward the floor.
Keep your knee stable and your torso tall.
Touch the floor lightly.
Rise back up through the working leg.
Do your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.n: salto en profundidad desde cajón
exercises.d: A plyometric where you step off a box, land, and jump up immediately. It trains reactive strength in the legs.
i: Stand on the edge of a low box with feet hip-width apart.
Step off, do not jump, and land on both feet.
Absorb the landing by bending your knees and hips.
Immediately explode upward into a jump.
Land softly and reset.

exercises.n: tirón isométrico a media altura del muslo
exercises.d: A max-effort pull against a fixed bar at mid-thigh height. It builds force production through the hips and back.
i: Set a bar in a rack at mid-thigh height and grip it just outside your legs.
Stand with a flat back and slightly bent knees.
Brace your core and chest up.
Pull up on the bar as hard as you can without it moving.
Hold for 5 seconds, then release gradually.

exercises.n: caminar hacia atrás en cinta
exercises.d: Walking backwards at a gentle pace on a treadmill. It works the quads and gets your heart rate up in a joint-friendly way.
i: Set the treadmill to a very slow speed and hold the handrails.
Turn to face away from the direction of the belt.
Step back gently, landing on the toes first.
Keep your chest tall and take small steps.
Continue for several minutes at a comfortable pace.

exercises.n: peso muerto con kettlebell v. 2
exercises.d: A hip hinge lifting a kettlebell from the floor. It teaches solid deadlift mechanics and builds the posterior chain.
i: Stand with feet hip-width apart and the kettlebell between your feet.
Hinge and bend your knees to grip the handle with a flat back.
Brace your core and push the floor away.
Stand fully tall, squeezing your glutes.
Lower the bell back to the floor with control.

exercises.n: zancada frontal con disco sobre la cabeza y peso
exercises.d: A forward lunge holding a plate overhead. It trains the legs while challenging shoulder stability and the core.
i: Hold a weight plate overhead with straight arms.
Step forward into a long stride.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your torso upright and the plate steady.
Push back to the start and alternate legs.

exercises.n: zancada frontal sobre la cabeza con peso corporal
exercises.d: A forward lunge with your arms stretched overhead, adding a core and shoulder challenge to the leg work.
i: Stand tall with your arms extended overhead.
Step forward into a long stride.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your ribs down and arms in line with your ears.
Push back to the start and alternate legs.

exercises.n: paso sobre cajón con mancuernas
exercises.d: Stepping across a box with dumbbells in your hands. It builds single-leg strength and balance.
i: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand beside a box.
Step one foot up onto the box.
Press through it and bring your other foot up.
Step down to the far side one foot at a time.
Repeat, alternating the leading leg.

exercises.n: giro de tronco de pie con balanceo de brazos
exercises.d: A dynamic standing twist where your arms swing with the rotation. It loosens up the spine and obliques.
i: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and arms relaxed.
Rotate your torso to one side, letting your arms swing around.
Let your back heel lift slightly if needed.
Rotate smoothly to the other side.
Continue at an easy rhythm for 30 seconds.

exercises.n: flexión de rodilla acostado en máquina
exercises.d: The classic lying leg curl on a machine, isolating the hamstrings.
i: Lie face down on the machine with the pad above your heels.
Grip the handles and keep your hips down.
Curl your heels toward your glutes.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly back to the start.
